reviews.author: Navigator23411951929
reviews.title: Unsatisfied—Far From a Grand Reopening
reviews.text:
From start to finish, this was one of the worst hotel experiences I’ve ever had. While the property had just reopened and was clearly aiming for a fresh start, it was absolutely not ready for a grand opening or to handle the volume of guests they accepted.
The most glaring issue was the complete breakdown in customer service. The staff themselves were not to blame—they were visibly overworked, overwhelmed, and doing their best under impossible conditions. Management, however, failed to properly prepare, staff, or support their team, and it showed in every aspect of the stay.
We checked in online ahead of time, yet still waited over three hours for our room to be ready on the first day. After finally getting access, we experienced additional delays of over an hour and twenty minutes just for room-related requests. Even with an upgraded “family concierge” package, there was no housekeeping service provided, which was both disappointing and unacceptable given the expectation that comes with that level of upgrade.
Dining was another major frustration. Guests should not have to wait over an hour and a half for something as simple as burgers and fries, especially when food options are already extremely limited. To make matters worse, several restaurants ran out of food entirely. During dinner, we waited over an hour just for appetizers to arrive. This level of disorganization and inefficiency made every meal a stressful and time-consuming ordeal rather than an enjoyable experience.
First impressions matter, and unfortunately, this one was lasting—for all the wrong reasons. With so many travel options available, there is simply no reason to return after such a poorly managed and frustrating stay. Customer service is everything in hospitality, and this hotel failed in nearly every category.
I sincerely hope they take the time to regroup and improve, because in its current state, it is not ready to deliver the experience guests expect or deserve.

reviews.author: Dragos
reviews.title: Too much noise in the room!
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Cancun, on the 7th floor, and unfortunately my experience has not been what I expected from a resort of this level.

One of the main issues is the constant noise. Music from the reception/lobby area travels all the way up, making it very difficult to relax or sleep, especially in the evenings. The hotel seems to cater more to a party-oriented crowd, with many guests celebrating and creating a lively—but often disruptive—atmosphere.

In my opinion, this hotel is not ideal for families or for guests who are looking for peace and quiet. There is no dedicated stage or separate area for entertainment or parties. Instead, events take place in the main areas of the hotel, which directly affects guests staying in nearby rooms.

For a resort that promotes comfort and relaxation, I would strongly recommend creating a designated entertainment space, away from guest rooms, to avoid disturbing those who simply want to rest.

Overall, if you are looking for a calm, family-friendly environment, this may not be the best choice. However, if you enjoy a more social and energetic atmosphere, it might suit you better.

reviews.author: MSNC2014
reviews.title: Either the most exclusive hotel in the world — or something quite different
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun appears to have allegedly reopened after renovation on April 1, and from the beach it actually looked quite nice. We had stayed there many years ago, were intrigued to see the refreshed property, and were even considering moving over from our current hotel.

That turned out to be impossible — and not in the chic, velvet-rope, ultra-luxury sense.

We first walked up from the beach side, simply hoping to have a quick look and speak to the front desk. Instead, we were curtly told to leave.

No problem, we thought — perhaps just an awkward misunderstanding. So we tried calling the hotel multiple times. We asked their hotel operator to connect us to the front desk, and each time the call was dropped. Four times in a row.

Still assuming this must be some opening-week chaos, we later drove over in person to speak to the front desk directly. Security called up, disappeared for a while, then came back to inform us that we were not allowed to enter and should call reservations.

So we did. Central reservations genuinely tried to help and, to their credit, were clearly embarrassed once we explained what had happened. But they could not help either, seemed almost at a loss for words, and were unable to provide even an alternative direct number or email address for the hotel.

So: is this simply an astonishing customer-service breakdown? Or is Paradisus Cancun aiming to become the most exclusive hotel in the world — not because everyone wants to get in, but because apparently no one can? By the end, we were left wondering whether it was a hotel or a very elegant cover for some more mysterious operation. If so, mission accomplished.

reviews.text: Espera que te traten pésimamente si no eres extranjero. Los bar tenders de la alberca principal son muy groseros y mal encarados m al igual que CASI TODA la gente en los restaurantes. Fuimos a un viaje de trabajo al rededor de 100 personas de la empresa donde trabajo y no había quien no platicara un mal trato y un mal servicio. En recepción cuando nos dieron habitación, a los americanos les explicaban todo el mapa del hotel y los servicios, a nosotros solo nos daban el tríptico y nos decían que ahí venía toda la información. Nos negaron mesas pero si preguntaban extranjeros los pasaban inmediatamente. La comida pésima! Sin chiste, insípida y siempre tienen muy poca variedad. Solamente tres meseros fueron sumamente amables y atentos, todos los demás del personal con quien interactúanos fueron groseros y despectivos. Pésima experiencia con el servicio. reviews.author: Katie C
reviews.title: Do NOT use Fernanda Romero to book ANY Otium international tours
reviews.text: Fernanda Romero is a complete liar. Do not book any Otium international tours with her. I have been to Cancun between 35-40 times. I booked Xcaret Xplor with her. My biggest concern was using their transportation and being stuck on the bus for hours to pick up and drop off people at other resorts (which has happened to us several times in the past- be aware of this. You will be on the bus for HOURS there and back depending on what tour you are doing. Majority of the time, the person you book with will fail to share this with you and you get stuck on a bus for a long time. I explained to Fernanda that we would pay for our own private transportation to avoid this. She told me that the bus ride to Xplor from Paradisus would be an hour and a half with 2-3 stops, and that the ride home there would be NO stops and we’d be back to Paradisus in an hour. What a liar! We had 3 stops at other hotels to pick people up and it took 2 1/2 hours (not 1 1/2 like she said to get there. On the way home, we were the SIXTH stop and it took almost 2 hours to get home (not like the NO stops she said and one hour home). I used the what’s app to communicate my concerns and she completely lied in the messages. Also told me I could “take a nap” on the ride home. I spoke to her supervisor, Mauricio Montreal and will be interested to see how he handles this. I am so angry I fell for this. Don’t trust what they say. I asked the bus driver if they always make multiple stops and he said yes and apologized to me for the info I was given when I booked. I spoke to my concierge at Paradisus and he said he doesn’t trust many of the Otium workers, except Patricia. What a shame that Otium hires people that are untrustworthy. I am not one to complain, but damn, this situation really made me angry. I also spoke to the front desk at the paradisus and asked for them to make a report. I can’t be the only person she’s lied to to profit off of. Karma is a bitch! She also said I asked for a discount. What? Absolutely not! We paid over $1,000 today for a family of 4, plus were willing to pay the extra entrance fee to explor and for private transportation if we went that route. I was willing to pay extra money to avoid this bus issue. She is a scammer and liar! Do NOT use her.

reviews.author: Trav4Work
reviews.title: Just go somewhere else.
reviews.text:
I was here as part of a wedding venue, but was underwhelmed from the start.  No instructions on how to check in for “preferred guests” was available.  If you are one of those guests taken to pyramid 5, and your room isn’t ready, you’d have to take your luggage all the way to the main entrance if you want to explore.  On top of that, no one explains or offers to make reservations for dinner that day and if they do, not until you get access to your room.  For the most part that sums up this place - “left to your own devices”.

Pool towels?  Get them yourself…. Drinks?  You may, MAY, have someone come by, but easier to get them yourself then wait 15 minutes (oh and like the US expect a tip for grabbing a beer).  Clear dishes or get another drink?  Clear them yourself, or track a server down….  Reservations?  Go make them yourself, because even if you have a concierge, they can’t do anything after 1600, and most places are full.  

While not every experience was like this, the overall customer service is lacking and the hospitality is ZERO.  Great example is our wedding party bride books a reservation at one of the restaurants for 12 people the day after their ceremony.  Only to be told at check in that they will not only be splitting the group into several tables but absolutely REFUSE to sit them near each other.  And this was right when they opened so we were not an inconvenience to a busy restaurant. 

Let’s talk about the food - average at best.  Nothing stood out and everything just tasted grey.  In fact the steakhouse for adults only was exactly that - grey steak and not cooked very well.  If you’re a bread lover like me, then avoid this place!  Breads are dry and stale because they leave them out unprotected but even the croissants taste like packaged bready cardboard and not the wonderful flakey pastry we expect.  Liquor seemed very watered down and the included wine was an insult to the pallet. 

One major exception to my complaining is housekeeping.  They stopped by daily to tidy the room, replace towels, and were very kind when called or knocking on the door. 

Another problem for me was the linens at this hotel; polyester.  Which is great if you want to wake in the middle of the in a sweat.  Or if you want limp dinner napkins that slide or blow away at the slightest of movement.  

So when I come to Cancun, I’m avoiding this place.  Even with their impending renovation, the lack of class and hospitality is something that a new coat of paint can not fix.

reviews.author: S N
reviews.title: Save yourself. Go elsewhere. March 2025.
reviews.text:
This hotel is a two star at most and not worth the money. There is an impressive level of incompetence and disregard for customer service.

We are currently staying at this hotel and would recommend families stay elsewhere. Despite the comments below, if you do choose to stay here I recommend paying extra for the family concierge to make a terrible experience slightly less terrible.

Stay elsewhere for the following reasons
1. Restaurant will suddenly run out of food (without warning or any alternatives) in the middle of the day.
2. Service is abhorrent. Difficult to find anyone to get water or any drink. Buffet will open but the speciality food stations (which have all the decent food) will stay closed for an extra 30-40 minutes.
3. There are salespeople located throughout the hotel who constantly that hassle you for upgrades and other additional paid services. It’s unfortunately not something you can escape as they are throughout the main floor and beach area.
4. Buffet food (after waiting in a lengthy line) is limited, repetitive, and sits out for hours. Several guests outside of our family and including our family were sick. Servers act annoyed when guests sit in their section. One had the audacity to tell us that the hostess shouldn’t have sat us in his section because he already had too many people (even though his section was clearly not full).

Save yourself the experience and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: T R
reviews.title: Stay Away! GOOD REVIEWS ARE FAKE
reviews.text:
We’ve been coming to Cancun for the last 10 years and this was hands down the worst resort. I’d rather get stuck in the airport. 

Transportation- They don’t provide transportation from the airport but recommend a company. The company canceled on us and told us to find our own way. Great start. 

Elevators- it would take us 10 minutes waiting for an elevator to get to our room

Very crowded- they oversold and there are people who have to lay on the grass and concrete near the pool because there aren’t enough beds for everyone. People put their towels out at 6am to claim beds. 

Upsell- every restaurant and bar try to upsell you on everything. Restaurants only have about 5 main course items on their menus to try to get you to buy stuff. 

Food- very below average. You have to make a reservation for every place even though it’s visibly empty. They won’t let you eat there unless you reserve it. Buffet food was a slight step up from eating garbage. 

Service- almost all the waiters were very slow and not friendly. We did like our waitress at the sports bar. She was a bright spot. 

The family concierge tried their best to make our stay better but there’s nothing they could do.

If you’re reading any of the good reviews about this place, they have to be fake. There’s no way anyone could enjoy this place.

reviews.author: Flo
reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text:
I never write negative reviews, but I feel compelled to share our experience at Paradisus Cancun to help other families who may be considering staying here. I’ve been to Mexico and Cancun specifically over a dozen times, so this is coming from experience!

Unfortunately, this resort was a huge disappointment. The food wasn’t great and most food options don’t open until 8 AM or 1 PM, which is impractical when traveling with a toddler. Service was shockingly bad—we constantly had to ask multiple times for simple requests before receiving anything. We got our high chair mid meal, begged for water, etc. 

The private family concierge check-in, which is supposed to be a perk, ended up being the slowest check-in and check-out process I’ve ever experienced. At one point, I asked a staff member for help with my parents’ day pass check-out, and she laughed in my face.

The entire resort is an upcharge—from dinner menu items (only 4-5 options are actually included, the rest cost extra) to poolside day beds, everything is an additional fee. Good luck finding a spot to sit unless you wake up at 5 am. We walked past several people laying on the grass because there are no chairs available. 

Drinks were bad, and the facility feels run down. Lines for everything were unbearably long, with overworked and unhelpful staff making the experience even more frustrating.

One night, we tried to go to dinner early when the restaurant was completely empty, but we were told it was full—even after explaining that we had a toddler and would be quick.

The only positive? We paid for a large suite, and I do like our room. But beyond that, I can’t recommend this resort to anyone, especially families. There are far better options in Cancun that actually deliver on the “luxury all-inclusive” promise. Save your money and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Kelly G
reviews.title: Not All Inclusive
reviews.text:
Lets start by saying I posted a review while still at the resort and they got upset at me.... Quite unprofessional.  Now that I am gone, and they cannot retaliate, I will give a legit review. One thing I noticed, look how many good reviews are 1 to 2 reviews... these are likely employees/ownership. I have many reviews and I am real and I give it straight. 

Ok here we go.

1. We paid for All Inclusive. This is NOT. Half of the resort was off limits. There is a heated nice pool and about 1/3 of the property we were not allowed to access because our all inclusive was not really all inclusive......This is false advertising straight up. 

2. The restaurants.. So "all inclusive" includes free food/drinks. However the way Paradisus solves this is so bad. Basically every included restaurant (except the buffet) requires a reservation at least 1 full day in advance. So 1st day, you will not be able to eat at any restaurants. The way to make reservations is also really horrible. There is ONE! lady at a desk from 10am to 2pm. And she is the ONLY way to reserve any restaurants. So yes there will be HUGE line waiting for this ONE lady to make reservations for the ENTIRE hotel. It took me 1.5 hours in line to make a reservation. This is when I also found out some restaurants I cannot eat at with our "all inclusive" pass. So that was really lame. However, I will say this. All the restaurants give you the same food as the buffet. Same Exact Food, most likely sitting out all day. There are pieces of rice on dessert. Pretty gross actually. I was sad to not be able to eat at the steak restaurant, but I imagine its just as bad as all the other ones. Yes at these restaurants they all have additional items you can pay for for extra, However All included should be all included. 

3. My "all inclusive" was supposed to come with a concierge. I saw our concierge the first day then no time after. So another scam. 

4. Resort, looks lovely. However many places are off limits. So all the nice pictures you see most likely are off limits. This is the entire 1st floor, either the restaurants or spa nice areas.

5. When you walk out the back door to the beach there is another bar and cabanas on the beach,.... nice right?? ... No, this they call a completely seperate company (its really all the same). The chairs provided by the resort will all be reserved with someones stuff by 7am. Every one, every day. I heard people reserve at 3am for the next day. The ONLY places available were these cabanas... They charge 250USD! to "rent" a cabana for the day, yes that is $5,116.870 pesos!. Yes you can order the same crappy food from the resort and pay much more here. This is ridiculous and probably pissed me off the most on this trip. You own the chairs, let your customers who already paid you use the chairs!!! Total SCAM.

6. The good was the beach. They are so lucky to have this beach. They have not yet figured out a way to pay per wave, or per sun, but I assure you they are working on it.

Overall very unhappy with Paradisus by Melia. The main thing is they know this, they want your money and will do anything to get it all. I will next time go to a place that respects their customers. Melia does NOT>

Regards

reviews.author: Jay L
reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
Our experience at the Paradisus resort was nothing short of a nightmare, and I would strongly advise against staying here if you are looking for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation.

From the moment we arrived late at night, our stay was riddled with issues. We were given a room facing the street, directly across from a nightclub that blasted deafening music until 4 a.m., making it nearly impossible for my family, including young children, to get any sleep. The noise was unbearable, and it felt like we were inside the nightclub itself. Exhausted and frustrated, I approached the front desk the next morning, only to be told that no other rooms were available. A staff member assured me he would speak to a supervisor about moving us, but the next day, the answer was the same—no availability. I asked again on the third day, and once again, I was told no rooms were open. It became blatantly clear that the staff had no intention of accommodating us, despite the severe noise disturbance and the fact that our family’s comfort was severely compromised.

The incompetence and lack of professionalism extended beyond the front desk. The resort’s restaurants were poorly managed and disorganized. We had a dinner reservation at 6 p.m. and arrived 15 minutes early. Shockingly, the host informed us that we could not be seated until exactly 6 p.m., despite the restaurant being completely empty. This rigid and nonsensical policy left us standing around unnecessarily and showed a complete lack of customer care and flexibility.

Our health and safety were also jeopardized during this stay. On the last day, my children fell ill with a virus and fever, raising serious concerns about the resort’s hygiene and sanitation practices. To make matters worse, my wife had a drink at one of the bars that caused her lips to swell up, leading us to question the safety and quality of their food and beverages. These alarming incidents left us worried and upset, casting serious doubt on whether proper cleaning protocols were being followed, especially in dining areas.

The negative experience didn’t end there. Our checkout process was downright rude and impersonal. We checked out at 6 a.m. with no other guests present at the front desk, yet the staff member did not greet us or even ask about our stay. Instead, he coldly informed me of a charge, processed the payment, and hurriedly dismissed us without so much as a thank you or farewell. This shocking level of indifference and discourtesy was incredibly off-putting and completely unprofessional.

While the resort grounds were well-maintained and the food was decent, the rooms were outdated and in poor condition. Our sink was leaking, and the bathroom had a musty, moldy odor that was both unpleasant and concerning. It was clear that the rooms were not being properly maintained or cleaned. Additionally, the pool and beach lounge chairs were constantly occupied by guests who left their belongings unattended for hours, preventing other families from finding seating. The staff did absolutely nothing to manage this issue, leading to frustration and inconvenience.

Overall, while the resort may look appealing at first glance, the shocking lack of customer service, unbearable noise levels, outdated and poorly maintained rooms, serious sanitation concerns, disorganized staff, and health risks made our stay a complete disaster. I would never recommend Paradisus resort to anyone, and I will certainly not be returning. This was by far one of the worst vacation experiences we have ever had. Save yourself the frustration, discomfort, and potential health risks—choose another destination for your vacation.

reviews.author: Julia Yu
reviews.title: Bad service and Food
reviews.text: The rooms and construction of the hotel are fine. The only thing is the customer service, it seems like they're not willing to service my family. (Not sure why) Especially the restaurants, I cannot make reservation online but had to book it in person at a certain time period. Which I think it was stupid because by the time I got to book it was already all full. My mother got really upset because we been eating buffet for the past 2 days already when we are staying here for 6 nights. Honestly buffet was not good too, when we finally ate at blueagave, aquamarina, the food is not good. For the service it was awful, we waited 5 minutes until they came to ask for our drinks. This trip at the paradisus was not exceptional, my last trip at the other hotel was MUCH BETTER than this hotel. My mom was mad half of the time because of this customer service and food quality plus unavailability of restaurants. This will not be my returning hotel.

reviews.author: Nancy L
reviews.title: Fuyez
reviews.text: C’est ma pire expérience d’hôtel au Mexique. J’ai payer pour un 5*, plutôt un 3*. L’hôtel va fermer pour rénovation majeure, ça veut tout dire. Il y a des palapas pour le 1/4 des chambres, faut se lever à 5hr du matin pour réserver des places, pas vraiment de place pour adultes seulement et beaucoup d’enfants, le staff a été coupé, les travailleurs sont essoufflé… pauvres personnel…malgré tout il garde le sourire. On fait la file le matin pour aller déjeuner. Nourriture ok pas plus…aller ailleurs

reviews.author: Adolfo C
reviews.title: Un barco encallado en la arena
reviews.text:
He viajado varias veces a Cancún
Estuvimos en el Oasis, Iberostar etc
Elegimos el Paradisus por las buenas opiniones. Y encontramos una “oferta” de u$s 400 la noche para 2. Nos gusta el mar Caribe. Si tu interés es conseguir una sombrilla cerca de la playa y disfrutar del mar caribe: no vengas a este hotel. Más vale contratar un hotelito en el centro y te compras una sombrilla y marchas a la playa. Aquí no es posible. Estás en un barco encallado en la arena ! y no puedes tocar el mar!!.
O sea, debes sumar a tu presupuesto un frasco de bloqueador 50 por día, pues si quieres ir a la playa debes estar al sol sin excepción. Bah, en realidad hay una opción: te levantas a las 4:00 am y vas a tirar un par de toallas sobre 2 reposeras !!todos los días de tu estadía!!! (olvídate de descansar).

reviews.author: Vleria
reviews.title: No gasten plata en este hotel
reviews.text:
Un desastre
La comida en los restaurant horribles y nada adaptado para los niños
Desde que llegamos hemos venido al buffet. Todos con mala predisposición. Cero ganas de ayudar

En el buffet ni hay papas fritas lo más básico del mundo

Pague Family Concierge al pedo porque no hay ninguna diferencia!!!!!! El desayuno de Family Concierge es un desastre

Todo absolutamente jamás volvería a Paradisus Cancún
He estado en Paradisus Playa del Carmen y nada q ver!!!!

Lo único bueno es el Kids y la playa pero tenes q ir a reservar 6.30 de la mañana o no conseguis lugar
No volveré más por la mala atención en todos los lugares

reviews.author: Dalectro
reviews.title: Very bad
reviews.text: This is my 28th time in Cancun, been to Melias before, great service and quality so I have always wanted to visit this property. There were absolutely no chairs after 8AM (except if you want to rent a bed for $250) People were laying down on the cement, grass and sand all day long.Precensed a couple of verbal fights over "chairs" with children present. VIP had absolutely no benefits at this property (only check in) Requested early arrival late departure, not available. After waiting 2 hrs for my room, I got a freshly painted room triggering my wife's asthma. The food was very, very bad. Poorly managed property,very overcrowded with just one buffet operating for breakfast and lunch (15-20 minute line forms outside. The staff did its best with what they had but absolutely not a 5-star resort, for the money you can do way better elsewhere. Sour taste and a bad experience overall. First time we have encountered these conditions after vacationing in Mexico for the past 20 years. Melia broke our hearts this time. Advise anyone looking at this property, please and save them the hassle. All guests we interacted with shared the same sentiments.

reviews.author: mauricio k
reviews.title: Avoid this place. Must have reservations. Concierge service is terrible. Pools are freezing cold
reviews.text:
Worst place to stay in cancun. Having come to cancun for 20 years and staying at every level of hotel, all inclusive or a la carte, and this is by far the worst experience. All restaurants, except the crappy buffet, are reservation only. Which means, you have an early dinner, look for a cool place to grab a bite at 10 that is completely empty, NOPE they can't seat you. Mind you, they close at 11. There isn't a soul inside, there is nowhere else to go because the 4 other restaurants say the same thing. You can't eat anywhere without a reservation, hard stop.  Our check in happened at 5 first day, the "concierge" closes at 5, they're the only person who can book you anywhere. So your SOL, you're literally going to go home without getting seated at a restaurant.
Room service isn't bad, takes 90 minutes at least
Bars all close at 2300. Room service can't take you drinks after 2300

Ordered drinks at the bar, they swished some tap water in the cup after someone else had used, no soap, no washing. Great way to catch something unexpected and very disappointing.

This place really is terrible
Poorly organized, poorly run. The app doesn't work
The beach isn't swimmable.
The pools aren't heated. They're un-swimmable unless you enjoy 65 degrees water
You can't eat without a reservation.
The concierge that you pay for is a joke. Only available "9-4". Waste of $$
The rooms are run down. This place is shutting down in june allegedly, and rightly so. Hopefully they don't open back up because this really is a terrible use of your money. 0/5. Awful experience
The ONLY saving grace is a handful of the staff, the majority are honestly terrible. Joan was awesome to helping us get a table, armando at the luggage check in was excellent, but the one who really saved us this trip was Gaudencio. He made the experience bearable. His counterpart Francisco en la playa was also excellent. These are the people who make the hotel and made it bearable. If you can't cancel your reservation and you're stuck at this place, find these people and tip them because they will treat you excellently

reviews.author: Alex N
reviews.title: Highly disappointing stay. The reviews on this resort are not honest!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin, I don’t know how this hotel has a 4.5 star Rating.

1. The room was missing a drain in the tub and had no water pressure for the shower handle. I called and asked for it to be fixed and scheduled a time for next day at 10am. No One ever came. 

2. We noticed the place has very little customer service. No one is excited or even has any desire to help you with anything.

3. The restaurants offer horrible attitude towards customers.  The only restaurant we went to that had exceptional service was SAL and thats because its not part of the all inclusive. Highly overpriced for what it is. You would be better off going to Harry’s or something out of the resort. It would be cheaper and better.

4. The Buffet has very little customer service. Very common to wait half hour for a cappuccino or basic request. 

5. The place is older and ran down. Not very upkept. The shower head was wobbling and paint was falling apart in many places all throughout the whole place. 

6. If you want to sleep, pyramid 3 is not the place. All night you can hear the music and party as if you’re next to it.

reviews.author: Arii A
reviews.title: Pesima experiencia
reviews.text: Pesimo servicio, goteras dentro del hotel el cual era peligroso para los huéspedes, el personal nos queria miver de lugares que supuestamente eran de reserva y al momento que les mencione que me mandaran el manager 3 veces nunca llego. Evento de fin de año pésima organización

reviews.author: Joel S
reviews.title: AVOID if you like good service and good food. Shocking experience.
reviews.text:
Disappointing Experience – Not Worth the Hype or Cost

We had high expectations for Paradisus Cancun based on its reputation and our past experiences with Melia hotels, but this stay was an absolute letdown from start to finish.

1. Poor Baby Accommodation:
We pre-booked a crib for our baby, anticipating a smooth arrival after 24 hours of travel. Shockingly, no crib was arranged. After arguing for 30 minutes at 11 PM, we finally received one, but not before experiencing unnecessary stress and frustration. At one point, staff left us without a safe sleeping solution for our baby—completely unacceptable.

2. Substandard Rooms:
The room was outdated and poorly maintained. Issues included:

	•	A strong smell of mould and damp.
	•	Broken bath and shower rail.
	•	Non-functional electrical sockets.
	•	Mismatched balcony furniture (one lounge chair, one normal chair).
	•	Missing basic amenities like a kettle, leaving us scrambling to find hot water for baby formula.
This was far from the luxury experience advertised on the website.

3. Poor Food Quality and Limited Options:
The food was consistently disappointing—dry, overcooked, and lacking variety. There were no suitable options for our baby, as everything was overly salty or poorly prepared. Mealtimes were further complicated by long waits for a high chair, adding to the frustration.

4. Overcrowding and Lack of Facilities:
The hotel was severely overcrowded. Sunbeds were unavailable unless reserved at 6 AM. On our first day, we had no choice but to sit in the shade all day. The only alternative was to pay $250 for a Bali bed, which felt like a money grab.

5. Damaged Facilities:
The hotel’s infrastructure showed visible signs of neglect, including damaged bridges near the pool. It was clear that maintenance is not a priority here.

6. Misleading Advertising:
The promotional photos and descriptions do not reflect reality. While we understand some variation is expected, the disparity was glaring. This is not the luxurious experience promised—it felt more like a budget hotel.

7. Stressful Experience:
This entire experience caused significant stress for my wife and me, particularly as we were travelling with a baby. What should have been a relaxing holiday turned into a series of disappointments and frustrations.

8. Poor Service Resolution:
When we raised these concerns with guest services, their response was inadequate. Offering a 20% refund and charging us a penalty

reviews.author: Edgar Josue Miguel Montaño
reviews.title: Solo nos queda el recuerdo
reviews.text:
Mi experiencia en este hotel fue muy decepcionante. Hace años era un gran lugar, pero actualmente muestra un evidente deterioro en sus instalaciones y falta de mantenimiento.

Los alimentos son de calidad regular y el personal parece desmotivado, sin esforzarse por brindar una experiencia acogedora. Además, hay una evidente falta de personal en el área de alimentos y los pasillos estaban sucios durante mi estadía.

El aire acondicionado es otro gran problema, ya que no baja de 21 grados, lo que resulta insuficiente para el clima caluroso.

Es urgente que el hotel reciba atención y mejoras inmediatas. Mi última interacción con el equipo fue aún más frustrante, ya que intentaron justificar la pésima atención en lugar de aceptar las críticas de manera profesional.

En resumen, recomiendo buscar otras opciones como Palace, donde la calidad y el servicio están garantizados.

reviews.author: Aleyda F
reviews.title: “Horrible all inclusive resort” Do not come here, please read my review!!
reviews.text: So sad to express this has been a TERRIBLE Experience!!! Run from this place if you can!! From the outdated One bedroom master suit we were supposed to get, Melia/Paradisus Cancun gave us the most OUTDATED  ROOM  I have EVER gotten for the amount of MONEY I paid!!! The two bathrooms have MOLD on the roof, furniture is not what they show online but very, very outdated it. All the walls around the room have marks on OR are dirty and we were told that’s “THE WAY IT IS”. Today Saturday 22, 2024 we were told none of their “All Inclusive” restaurants had available reservations for us who are “ all inclusive customers paying $120 per day times 3 guests times 7 nights”. My son tried to order from their “24 hour room service” last night  and we were told  his wait time was 2 hours”. When we used the “lunch” or “dinner” restaurants included in “the mandatory all you can eat” the wait time was at least 45 minutes or longer before they EVEN BRING YOU WATER” after you were sat down, and by the time you get your meal, they “were COLD”!  When speaking to our “Concierge Person” for HELP, she said this resort is CLOSING in one month and  because they are “OPENING A NEW RESORT IN A YEAR”,  THEY ARE NOT REPAIRING ANY ROOMS AND THEY HAVE WAITING ISSUES WHEN IT COMES TO RESTAURANTS, ROOMS OR THEIR ATTITUDES!!   RUN FROM THIS PLACE IF YOU CAN!! Because EVEN THOUGH THEY HAVE REDUCED THE AMOUNT OF STAFFING HELPING THROUGH OUT THE HOTEL, THEY HAVE NOT CHARGED THEIR MEMBERS ANY LESS MONEY FOR OUR LACK OF SERVICE!! RUN AWAY  FROM THIS HOTEL AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE!! DO NOT BUY THEIR TIMESHARE OPTIONS!! They ARE HORRIBLE!! YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!!😞

reviews.author: Anas A
reviews.title: Worst stay at all inclusive resort
reviews.text:
Our stay at this resort was a huge disappointment, and it should be rated as a 3-star hotel at best, not the “premium” destination it claims to be.

Upon arrival, we were told to wait hours to check in. Despite having a scheduled 3 pm check-in time, we didn’t get our room until 11 pm. The excuse was that rooms needed cleaning, but it’s hard to believe a resort of this size has no rooms ready for guests, especially when check-in is a standard time. The entire process was disorganized and unprofessional.

The room itself was filthy and outdated. The furniture was worn out and broken, and the bathroom was barely functional. The sink batley has any water let alone hot water, and the showerhead was on the verge of falling off. To make matters worse, we found ants inside the room, which added to the already unpleasant environment. Cleanliness was a major issue throughout the resort, and it was hard to relax knowing the place was so neglected.

The staff had an attitude, and the customer service was non-existent. After my wife wrote a review, we were promised by management that they would “make things right,” but when we spoke to customer relations, no action was taken. They offered empty reassurances but didn’t follow through on any solutions.

Expect to waste an hour every day just to make dinner reservations. Even when we were first in line on one day, we were denied our preferred restaurant because others had already booked. Only when we asked did they explain that reservations could be made for multiple days in advance—something they should’ve communicated clearly. The food was bland, and the main buffet restaurant, Malva, was dirty, with long lines to get in. The overall dining experience was disappointing, and the options were limited.

Despite being an “all-inclusive” resort, basic services were sorely lacking. No beach services were offered, not even something as simple as access to cold and clean water. There were no lifeguards at the pool or beach, and finding a sunbed was nearly impossible. When we asked, we were told to rent a cabana for $250 a day or just put our towel on the ground.

We traveled with a newborn and requested a kettle to prepare bottles. Instead, they brought us dirty water in a thermos, which was completely unacceptable.

Overall, this resort is outdated, poorly managed, and provides subpar service. It doesn’t live up to its claims and definitely isn’t worth the price. Save your money and book elsewhere.

reviews.author: simul
reviews.title: 1/5 Stars – If You Like Loud Music, Long Lines, and Mystery Meal, This Place Is Perfect
reviews.text:
Where do I even begin? We booked this trip with high hopes and an even higher bill, expecting a 5-star paradise. What we got was a 1-star comedy of errors that would’ve been funny if we weren’t the ones paying for it.

 *The Room: A Moldy Disco Party  
We paid extra for an "ocean view exclusive room"—what a joke. The view was more "loudspeaker central" than "tranquil ocean." Every morning, we were blasted awake by loud music from the activity site below. Want to rest at night? Too bad! The in-house entertainment echoed right into our room until late. And let’s not forget the delightful aroma of mold. I half-expected a mushroom farm to pop up in the corner. 
 
*The Food - A Culinary Tragedy:

1. Reservations – Chaos with a Side of Queue: Want to eat at one of the “exclusive” restaurants? Be ready to queue up like you’re trying to buy concert tickets in 1995. There’s no online system—just a sweaty, long line between 10 AM and 4 PM. By the time you get to the front, your patience has already left the building. We tried five restaurants, but each one was a bigger disappointment than the last. Eventually, we gave up and settled for the chaotic walk-in buffet.

2. Dietary Restrictions – Danger Zone: This hotel is a complete nightmare for anyone with allergies, dietary preferences, or religious restrictions. The buffet and food stations lacked clear labeling, so every meal felt like a game of Russian roulette. Are you Muslim, Jewish, vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, or just someone with a peanut allergy? Too bad! For example:  
- At the taco station, beef, chicken, and pork were cooked *on the same grill, * with zero separation. Cross-contamination was the special of the day.  
- There were no clear ingredient lists for dishes. Someone with a nut allergy would have no idea if they were about to eat something dangerous. 
- If you're vegetarian or vegan, your options are limited to wilted lettuce or overly sweet fruit. If you're a foodie like me, listen to this: I ordered Chilean Basa with risotto. What arrived was a mystery fish and something resembling risotto but made with wheat. Wheat!

3. Quality – When Basic Goes Bad: Even basic food was a disaster. Pizza—usually the safest option—was naan bread with cheap, rubbery cheese. Burgers tasted like soggy cardboard, and chicken wings were drowned in a pool of overly sweet sauce. My pizza-loving kid couldn’t eat a slice—twice! Tacos, in a Mexican hotel!, were a mess, and even the salad bar somehow managed to feel depressing. 
 
4. Walk-In Buffet – The Hunger Games: With a hotel that boasts a 5,000+ guest capacity, there’s *one* buffet for walk-ins. The wait for a table was 15-20 minutes minimum, and once inside, it was crowded and understaffed. To make things worse, food labels were gathered behind the dishes, leaving you guessing what you were eating—and whether it would kill you.

* Entertainment - A Masterclass in Boredom: We chose this hotel expecting endless activities for our family, especially our 11-year-old son. What we got instead:  
- Activities that were poorly planned and started late (if at all).
- No variety—one dull activity at a time.
- Zero announcements for changes/canceled activities, leaving us waiting aimlessly.
- Rainy days were especially bleak. With no indoor activities for adults, we were left sitting in our damp, noisy room, wondering what on earth we paid for.
- Nighttime shows? Imagine cramming 5,000+ guests into a 30-seat venue to watch a 1-hour show that felt like a middle school talent recital. If you didn’t feel like standing in a crowd, your only option was to sit outside in the dark, waiting for the noise to end.  

* Pool & Beach - A Game of Musical Chairs: The pool area was overcrowded and unclean. Unless you woke up at 7 AM to claim a chair, you will have hard time. The pool itself wasn’t much better—my son refused to swim after seeing floating debris in the water. Thankfully, Cancun beach was turquoise clean, peaceful, and free.  

* Staff - Trying Their Best but Overwhelmed: The staff was kind and polite, but it was obvious they were severely understaffed. They couldn’t keep up with the demands of thousands of guests, so service was slow and inconsistent.  

* Final Thoughts: This hotel doesn’t deserve its 5-star rating or the outrageous prices it charges. It’s a logistical mess with terrible food, poor entertainment, and a complete lack of consideration for guests with dietary needs or restrictions. If you enjoy long lines, loud music, and mediocre food, this is the place for you. For everyone else: save your money, your sanity, and your stomach.

reviews.author: michellesamadzada
reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!!!!!
reviews.text: BEWARE! I have been to Mexico many times and visited many all inclusive resorts. I’m currently on my vacation and am writing this review on my second day here. the check in process doesn’t make sense. There’s one person checking everyone in and took about an hour. Let’s start with the pool/beach area. Youre lucky if you’re able to find a spot. We had to hunt down a staff member just to order food by the pool. The food is okay but here’s what I’ve been dealing with for the past two days. I’m currently writing this at 1am in hotel room. NOISE COMPLAINT. I was woken up at 3 in the morning last night and now at 12 to literal banging. We asked if we could change rooms and the staff did NOT care. DO NOT COME HERE IF YOU WANT TO RELAX. This is the worst resort in Cancun. We were thinking we were staying at a luxe property but this is far from it.

reviews.author: SAI
reviews.title: The WORST AI with non existent customer service
reviews.text: I wish I could give zero stars but unfortunately that’s not an option. This was by far the worst resort I’ve been to. The only good thing is the amazing people at kidsdom. Food was atrocious, staff unfriendly and rude and to top it off I had stuff stolen from my room!! Avoid at alll costs and go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Cs S
reviews.title: Would rate zero if I could
reviews.text: I strongly recommend finding a different place. The facilities are in disrepair, with water leaking from the ceiling near our room. We spotted a cockroach at our door (the doors don’t seal, making it easy for pests to enter). A rat was seen outside near the bar. The customer service was abysmal, particularly from Alonzo, the front desk “supervisor”, who offered no compensation or apology for the issues we faced. If you decide to book here, ensure you aren’t near a wedding reception area, as we were subjected to loud music and heavy bass throughout the night, causing our windows to rattle. I highly suggest you choose another hotel. As a family of five, we travel to Cancun yearly for family time, rest and relaxation. We have average expectations, but these conditions and the service were unacceptable. I felt compelled to voice my concerns. We’ve had excellent experiences with clean rooms and great service at Villa Del Palmar and Moon Palace. We will 100% never return to any Melia properties.

reviews.author: Dianne E
reviews.title: Frustrated stay. NOT 5 STARS!!!
reviews.text:
I was looking forward to a relaxing stay. At a 5 star resort, certain expectations are to be assumed. Well. I was wrong! 
First, when we arrived, no one showed us to our room or how to work fans, lights, AC, etc. had to call maintenance who never came. Light switches don’t work. Ceiling fan doesn’t come on. Electrical switches in walls- some work, some don’t.

Food is mediocre at best. Observed people at buffet picking up food and put back for others. No hand sanitizer stations. 
Drinks watered down. 
Will NOT be back or recommend to others!

reviews.author: Sulecindy
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
I did not have a great time here. I always have a blast when i go to resorts  with my kids. I did everything i could to prepare for this trip even with communicating with the staffs prior but was just disappointed. 

I booked 2 double bed rooms in the family concierge and it was not worth it. Rooms are very outdated and broken. My first room did not have a bathroom door. The balcony door was broken, the pulled out sofa bed was bad and broken. My 5 year old son was sinking, the light switches were not working, the ac had problems too. I demand to change room since i did not get the double bed room that i asked for. The 2nd room only the beds were better, we had a bathroom sliding door but it’s jam-i needed full strength to slide thru, the shower handle to turn on and off was falling off, my refrigerator was old and not working that well too

I also had maybe a cockroach in my room walking the walls and i saw some at the buffet too but did not want to say anything. 

Also please note that they are closing for a whole new remodel in feb or march which is very much needed so workers kind of dont care and are leaving since they will be out of job soon. 

My personal concierge manuel suck. He had attitude and i have to ask him to make sure to book all my free stuff that is included in the family concierge room such as milk and cookies before bed for the kids, bath robe and toys for kids which i did not get but got tshirts and hats, free 2 hr sunset cruise, free 1 hour hydrotherapy, 1 free dinner at sal steak house, 1 free cabana. 

please take note that check in for cabana is from 9 to 11am and if you dont check in, then it will be canceled. manuel told me at 10:48am that my cabana was ready. I figure i can check in later so i went down after i got my 5 year old and 1 year old ready only to find out that if you dont check in between 9 to 11am then it’s cancel. I was pissed… he gave me  12 min notice to go down to check in? Are u serious.. going down the elevator with the strollers can take 4 mins… let alone to walk down to the pool. Smh! When i txt manuel he said he didnt know that either… pls make sure u get to ur cabana on time!

I also wanted to point out the most resort have a steak house and usually that’s free but this resort did not unless you have it included on your package. Also most resort have a tepanyaki too but this one did not

Another thing i want to mention is the food is ok. I had better at other resorts..

Also please take note that you have to make your reservation for restaurant early downstairs cause it gets booked up fast, most of the time when i walked in to restaurants i had to wait because no reservation or i got denied cause they are full. Although the tables were not full, i think it’s because there is not enough staff to support the restaurant. 

Anyway, I want to give a big shout out to Lucas at Cielo restaurant because he generally cares and made my trip better and he also feels proud of working for paradisus and said the service should not be like that. 

 Shout out to Boris the supervisor at Lemon Fish because he was very nice, caring and accomodating. He helped me get a seat when i didnt have a reservation and he geniuely went out his way to make sure we have a good dinner too. Thank you Jorge and Carlos at lemon fish too! You guys were so attentive during our dinner time.

Shout out to Rennan and Erick at Aqua Marina. They were so nice, always checked up on us if we needed more food or drinks! Love the positive vibes. Also make shre to order the fried fish there! It’s so good!

Shout to to felipe the doorbell guy. He was also very nice and friendly. 

Shout out to Jose and Eduardo at Sal because they provided great customer service also. 

Lastly, shout out to Giovanni the manager because he was able to get me whatever i needed. He also came to check up on me and talk to me bout the service. He  was very professional and understanding. He cares about the company and really wants to improve their service

I had so many problem here that i don’t think i will come back.

reviews.author: Lucy D
reviews.title: Rubbish- don’t care about woman!!!!
reviews.text: They don’t care about woman at alll!! I had a bad experience with a man at the hotel so complained and they kicked me out as they didn’t want ‘bad rep’ at the hotel!! NEVER AGAIN!!!!!!!!!!!!! Don’t stay here if you care for your daughters, sisters, mothers and aunties.

reviews.author: Erica K. Singleton
reviews.title: Buyer Beware - I’d Never Return
reviews.text:
Just don’t! I traveled here with my husband and son for vacation and  began looking for other resorts to transfer to on my second day of a 5 night vacation. The food was horrible - cold, hair-riddled, with extremely long lines not only buffet, but for restaurant reservations. I a have been home for 1 day and am still experiencing a sour stomach grin the food.  I live in Houston, visit Mexico quite often and had the worst tacos my life from their restaurant that specializes in tacos. On multiple occasions we were sat 45 mins after of reserved time. We’re asking with multiple families waited at the entrance with stay passing by without acknowledgment. 

To be a beach resort, they ran out of towels each day either no options to use anything else. When asked where to find towels, we were told, “go check on the other end. If they don’t have any …sorry. 

Our room was filthy upon check-in. When moved to a service room two days in, there were handfuls of hair stuck to the shower walls.

reviews.author: Giuditta G
reviews.title: Warning: the hotel is closing for 2+ years so the service is currently TERRIBLE!!!
reviews.text:
I don’t usually leave negative reviews but I actually want to help families and hard working people SAVE their hard earned money! Do NOT book this hotel. We found out the company is renovating and going to CLOSE in May 2025 for renovations. They have let go of staff, their service is absolutely terrible not just ok but TERRIBLE. They tell you to get things yourself. We even upgraded to the adults only side and it was still terrible service. The rooms on the regular side are sub par - our upgrade was much nicer. Also they don’t ask you if you want more food at restaurants, they want you to just leave. You can tell the staff isn’t happy except LUIS the bartender whose always awesome. The staff is trained to give you less. There’s always options of upgrades on the menus to pay for. They have overpriced everything to make a dollar. They no longer care if patrons are happy since they’re closing down and they just want to take as much as they can get before closing down and becoming a new place. It’s literally a joke. The hydro spa was a nice surprise at least. The food was NOT TASTY at all! It’s so suprising because my friend stayed in March at Grand Park Royale cancun it was incredible service, infinity pool, amazing service - and great great food. Very upscale and awesome. The room service was also great but at this hotel it was disgusting. Oh and the nightlife is so disappointing here. No shows. No teams to guide us to other things. It was so random people were so bored at night. It was just super strange all around. Thank God there was good weather and wonderful beach. 

I really feel bad for families that are going to spend a premium to stay here only to experience all of this and just wanted to share to try to help families pick a different place. 

Apparently the reviews previously are good because it WAS spectacular before. But now before they close they really don’t care anymore at all. Save your money. Invest it where you’ll have wonderful food and service.

reviews.author: carlosrodriguez2024
reviews.title: Engaño
reviews.text: Estoy de acuerdo con el tema de protección al medio ambiente, pero en ninguna parte del proceso de reservación te explican que habrá un cobro de "impuesto ambiental" y al cobrármelo se negaron a darme recibo de dicho cobro.

reviews.author: Pauline Brandon H
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK YOUR WEDDING HERE
reviews.text:
If I could give this venue ZERO stars, I absolutely would. This has been the worst, most stressful experience, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. From the very start, Gloria and her team have been deceitful and unprofessional. Despite having everything in writing—signed contracts and even a voice recording where Gloria personally promises the Del Prado ballroom—they are now refusing to honor what was agreed upon. Instead, they’ve tried to push us into another space, one that was never discussed or part of the deal. This is a classic bait-and-switch tactic, which is completely unacceptable, especially for something as important as a wedding.

What makes it even worse is that they didn’t tell us about the change until we flew out to the hotel for our tasting! After months of planning and clear communication, they waited until we arrived on-site to inform us that the Del Prado ballroom, which we had paid for, was no longer available. They didn’t notify us ahead of time or give us the chance to make alternative plans—just dropped this bombshell when we were already there. The level of disrespect and unprofessionalism is unbelievable.

To top it all off, they tried to scam us on the room block too. The prices they quoted us were actually *higher* than what was listed on their own website. When we questioned it, there was no clear explanation, and it felt like they were trying to squeeze as much money out of us as they could.

If that wasn’t bad enough, the communication has now gone silent. Gloria and her team have stopped answering our emails and calls entirely. We’re weeks away from our wedding, and we don’t even know if we still have a venue. The level of stress this has caused us is beyond words, and instead of offering solutions, they’ve left us completely in the dark.

And to add insult to injury, they are refusing to return our deposit, even though they have failed to honor the terms of the contract and their promises. Holding onto our money while giving us the runaround is just disgraceful.

I cannot emphasize this enough: stay far away from this venue. Gloria and her team lack basic professionalism, integrity, and honesty. The bait-and-switch tactics, inflated room charges, and complete lack of communication have turned what should have been an exciting time into an absolute nightmare. Please don’t make the same mistake we did. Save yourself the heartache, stress, and frustration, and look elsewhere for your special day.

reviews.author: Kathy L
reviews.title: Traveler Beware of Paradisus Candun
reviews.text: My only bad review: 9/2024 Paradisus trip 2nd after excellent 2018 stay. I highly recommended our group’s Paradisus stay due to 2018 experience but was very embarrassed with 2024 experience because it suffered greatly by comparison. We stayed in 3rd pyramid. Loud 1st floor bar music nightly until 11 pm entertained less than 20-30 occupants but music permeated through pyramid disturbing all that wanted romantic evening or to get offspring to sleep. VERY BAD Paradisus planning. We told Expedia check in staff we didn’t want to be disturbed by noise everyone complained about in Expedia reviews & were assured that our rooms wouldn’t be impacted which was a complete Expedia check in staff FALSEHOOD & MISREPRESENTATION. We endured EVERY night with great displeasure–it was too inconvenient to pack up & move all parties to different rooms. We were isolated in resort 1 day due to rain & watched it pour from ceilings all day. Unenthusiastic staff squeegeed slowly all water that fell & was sometimes 2” deep onto travertine tile–a hazard to all. Mold comes with water & great health hazard to all. Malva buffet food was cold & often unidentifiable concoctions so we would eat elsewhere. All resort restaurants serve breads & pastries that are delivered & frozen until served only to taste like cardboard. Most food would be uneaten due to lack of quality–horrible waste of resources. Waitstaff accommodating for tips but food, rainwater and noise at Paradisus VERY disappointing.

reviews.author: tatiana b
reviews.title: No recomiendo este hotel
reviews.text:
No fue positiva la estancia en este hotel. 
Realmente es un hotel que para lo que cuesta está muy descuidado. 
No tiene aire acondicionado en el hotel, solo en la habitación y eso que muy regular. 
Hace un calor impresionante todo el tiempo y no prenden para nada el AC
La comida no me gustó , las habitaciones están Viejas y la ducha muy horrible, se moja todo el baño cuando se abre. 
Todo lo cierran 11:00 pm.  No hay donde tomar algo. 
No recomiendo para nada este hotel. No volveré,

reviews.author: Yazmin Anaís Z
reviews.title: El servicio ha sido pésimo.
reviews.text:
La experiencia ha sido pésima, el trato del personal del hotel hacia mí y mis amigas ha sido lamentable. Hemos tenido demasiados problemas con este hotel. 
Dañaron nuestro coche y no se quieren hacer responsables, nos pusieron un brazalete que tiene menos beneficios que el que realmente adquirimos y ahora no nos hacen el cambio de brazalete para gozar de los beneficios que sí pagamos.

Sí, el hotel es bellísimo pero pagar tanto dinero para no gozar de casi ningún beneficio no es algo satisfactorio.
Constantemente pedimos ayuda con los problemas que se volvieron repetitivos  y nadie nos ha ayudado hasta hoy.
Todos dicen que tomarán el caso para ver que se pude hacer pero hasta este momento no nos resuelven nada. 

Llegamos el domingo 15 de septiembre de 2024 y ya pedimos nuestro rembolso de los días restantes ya que pagamos hasta el día 22 de septiembre de 2024 y siguen sin darnos una respuesta. Nosotras ya no queremos estar aqui, el personal es demasiado horrible y nadie te explica nada.
 Nos acercamos con un muchacho que dice ser el gerente de socios (porque cabe mencionar que tenenos una membresía, somos socias del hotel y aún así nos tratan así) Pero ser socios de este hotel no vale la pena, él nos dijo que lo único que podíamos hacer era poner una reseña en esta app y escribimos aquí para que a nadie más le pase lo que a nosotras.

reviews.author: Jonathan L
reviews.title: What you see from the advertisement is not what you are getting. Be aware of Cancun Paradisus.
reviews.text:
We had to pay extra $3500 at the check in because my son just turned 13 years old. They told us we will need two room instead of one suite. Originally, We got the ocean suite which we never had an issue with before. They didn’t care much. We had to pay $3500. However , when I asked them for the second room for my son, they said we were mot getting the second room. They were scamming us. This is our first trip after the pandemic.  The manager didn’t care. Even with the family concierge, We paid extra for it. But it doesn’t exist. Nothing like before. 
When we checked in, we had to wait 2 hours. Before with the family concierge, we were invited us to a special room to check in. No more. Take a look at pictures of this run down place. Mold all over. Broken drawers, broken phone, the TV has a big vertical line, the bed was disgusting. See the photos. Motel 6 could be better than this. 
I don’t recommend this place to anyone. The management is not doing well. Workers are all depressed.  The trip was unbelievably ruined from the check in until we left the hotel. 
They only care about how to get kore people to sell their membership. 
The corporate office should know about this. I am going to contact them and let them know what was happening there. By the way, broken swimming pool light was still there after my daughter got her foot cut really bad. No one cared. Never replaced. 
No more Paradisus Cancun. Never again.

reviews.author: Getaway258231
reviews.title: Not worth it - Food is of inferior quality - all-inclusive was like we have been robbed
reviews.text: Hotel room washroom was in a bad shape. Basic hygiene was not followed at the restaurants (NO HAND SANITIZER at the restaurant entry point) - inferior quality of food - even a coke you get is flat. Veg and non-veg food are cross contaminated - so if you are vegetarian forget, you will be hungry - just like us, we had a terrible time here. All-inclusive is a rip off.

reviews.author: Rainy S
reviews.title: Disappointing Stay with Poor Maintenance and Service
reviews.text:
Stay from Aug10 - 16, 2024.

My recent stay at this hotel was marred by inadequate facilities and extremely disappointing service. We booked a premium suite with a sunset view for 6 nights, but our experience was far from satisfactory. The room we were given was unfinished, with numerous issues including a blocked stove, missing kitchen appliances, a non-working outlet, a hole in the bathroom, and ineffective air conditioning. Despite requesting a room change, the staff was unhelpful and unresponsive, only moving us to a slightly better room after much delay.

The service at the hotel's Melva restaurant was equally frustrating. During a busy breakfast period between 9-11am, we encountered poor service from a staff member named Brenanda. After waiting in line, we initially seated at a table of 2.  We informed her that although our room had only 2 occupants, we needed a table for 10. So we were taken back to the front desk and left waiting. Brenanda ignored us for another 30 minutes.

When we pointed out an empty table for 10, she told us to wait. After 45 minutes, another server, Edwardo, informed us that we had only 10 minutes to eat because they closed at 11am. Despite our told him that we hadn’t been seated, they refused to prepare the table until we complained about the poor service and Brenanda's disregard. Only then did they say it would take 2 minutes to clean the table, though they could not explain their previous inaction.

The facility’s maintenance was also lacking, with poor upkeep evident throughout. I was particularly surprised that the hotel offers wedding services despite such poorly trained staff. The disparity in service quality was evident, with some staff offering decent service if tipped well, while others were indifferent regardless of tipping.

One important note for future guests: if you encounter issues or poor treatment, go directly to guest services. The regular staff seemed unresponsive to complaints and requests, but guest services were more effective in addressing problems.

Overall, this stay did not meet the standards expected from a premium booking and left much to be desired in terms of both accommodation and hospitality.

reviews.author: Carol z
reviews.title: Significant service disparities between towers; disappointing treatment of families and poor group seating in restaurant
reviews.text:
My husband and I stayed in the adults-only tower (Tower 5), while our friends and their family stayed in Towers 1-4. This gave me a broader perspective on the services provided to guests in different towers. My husband and I were given different wristbands than our friends. Although the service we received was average—daily check-ins from the concierge and responses to our requests (we are very low maintenance and only requested towels and water, with no need for room cleaning)—I noticed a significant difference in how our friends staying in the other towers were treated.

First, they didn’t receive what they paid for. One of the so-called "premium" suites had no microwave, sofabed, stove, or working fridge, while the other premium suites they booked had all of these amenities. They reported the issue immediately, but the staff didn’t respond with an immediate room change. The room change wasn’t completed until we went to the lobby and repeated our request to the fourth person we spoke to (thank you, Janet and Adrian), who seemed to be the only staff members who cared about our stay. I’ve traveled enough to understand that issues can arise during a stay, but it’s the attitude with which guests are treated that matters. It was a big disappointment that our request (which was not a favor but simply an expectation to receive what we paid for) wasn’t addressed until the fourth time we raised it. This cost us almost 12 hours of our vacation due to the resort’s inefficiency.

Second, when my husband and I walked in the adults-only area of the resort, the staff who passed by would smile and nod. However, when walking in Towers 1-4, there was no such treatment. It made me feel bad for the families with kids who had to stay in Towers 1-4. The price difference between the towers isn’t significant, but the difference in service is drastic. Families with kids don’t deserve this disparity.

Lastly, the restaurant staff were not trained to properly seat large groups or prioritize resort guests. We understand that we can’t all sit at the same table, but they should at least seat us in the same area. It was clear that they were just trying to place us randomly. When we asked to be seated together, the default answer to any request was “no.” Another instance was at Aqua Marina (another restaurant), where they couldn’t seat us because the kitchen was at capacity. However, our request was just to sit at the table while waiting, but again, the answer was “no” with no explanation.

In summary, my suggestion is that if you have kids, don’t choose this resort because the disparity in treatment will ruin your stay. If you don’t have kids and are interested in staying in the adults-only tower, I would also advise against it, as the staff outside of your tower won’t prioritize your requests—unless you’re determined to stay inside your tower the entire time. I hope this helps.

reviews.author: AnsonS
reviews.title: Adult Only vs. Non-Adult Only: A Tale of Disparate Experiences at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Review of Paradisus Cancun Part 1 (August 10-16, 2024)
We recently stayed at Paradisus Cancun with a large group of 24 people. Our group was divided between two room types: 2 of us in the Adult Only Junior Suite Ocean View and the remaining 22 in Premium Suite Sunset View, across a total of 9 rooms. Despite the minimal price difference of $40 between these room categories, the service we received varied significantly.
From the outset, the differences were noticeable. Adult Only guests had a distinct check-in experience, with a more efficient and expedited process, and were granted early access to the hotel—2 to 3 hours before non-Adult Only guests. They also received a higher level of concierge service, with daily check-ins and more personalized attention, in stark contrast to the limited and often unresponsive concierge service provided to the rest of our group.
Another major discrepancy was in the amenities. Adult Only guests enjoyed complimentary access to private cabanas, while non-Adult Only guests were required to pay an additional $200 daily for the same privilege. Additionally, the Adult Only pool area, which had superior menu options and service, was off-limits to those staying in the Premium Suites.

Adult Only guests had access to three additional restaurants, including one complimentary meal at Sal Steakhouse. In contrast, non-Adult Only guests were required to pay extra to dine at Sal Steakhouse. This disparity was particularly notable given the minimal price difference between the room categories.

In terms of room amenities, there was a clear difference in the quality of bottled water provided. Adult Only guests received sanitized bottled water, whereas non-Adult Only guests were provided with tap water, which led to concerns about hygiene and safety.

The room conditions also differed noticeably. The Adult Only rooms were newer, with updated shower facilities, better air conditioning, and more pleasant hallways.
Given that the price difference between the room categories is relatively minor, the disparity in service and amenities was surprising and disappointing. We suggest that Paradisus Cancun consider offering a more equitable experience for all guests, regardless of their room type, to enhance overall satisfaction.

Part2
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun from August 10-16, 2024, we encountered significant issues with the restaurant services, particularly with accommodating our large group.
On our second day, we went to the Malva buffet for breakfast with a group of 9. Fernanda, who was responsible for seating arrangements, initially told us to wait while she served others who arrived after us. Despite observing several empty tables that could have accommodated our group, we were made to wait for 45 minutes without any effort to clean or prepare a table for us.
When we escalated the issue to Manager Eduardo, he suggested seating us outside, despite the availability of an empty large table inside. Only after insisting on speaking to higher management did Eduardo finally arrange a suitable table for us. Additionally, our attempts to address these issues with Guest Services were met with indifference, as our concerns were ignored and no apologies were offered.
Overall, the restaurant’s lack of preparedness for handling larger groups and the poor service from certain staff members significantly impacted our dining experience. For future improvements, we recommend better training and support for handling larger groups to ensure that all guests receive fair and efficient service.

Part3
During our stay at Paradisus Cancun from August 10-16, 2024, we experienced several issues with the service and accommodations that impacted our overall experience.
At various restaurants throughout the hotel, we noticed a distinct change in attitude from the servers whenever we requested seating for a large group. This inconsistency in service was frustrating and contributed to a sense of being unwelcome.
Service at the beach chairs was also problematic. Since beach chairs were available to all guests free of charge, we faced unprofessional behavior from the staff, including being reprimanded when ordering more than two drinks.
Additionally, the coffee stations had a similar issue. The servers’ attitude shifted negatively when we ordered more than two coffees, which was surprising and disappointing.
In terms of accommodations, the Premium Suite Sunset View was advertised to include an outdoor tub, but not all rooms were equipped with one. We also encountered maintenance issues; in one room, the fridge was broken and rusted, and the provided water was stale. The glass bottles used for water were filled with tap water and seemed unsanitized. After drinking this water, several of us felt unwell. Despite requesting plastic bottled water, the staff was uncooperative and refused to provide it.
These service and maintenance issues need addressing to improve the guest experience. Better training and consistent standards are essential for ensuring that all guests feel valued and receive the quality of service expected at a resort of this caliber.

reviews.author: ddpmp
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
Customer service issues at Paradisus Cancun from Aug 10, 2024 - Aug 13, 2024
I am a Melia Vacation Club Member (timeshare owner). I arrived at Paradisus Cancun at
approximately 2:00 PM on Saturday August 10, 2024.
My room was not ready as checkin time is 4:00 PM. I was also told by the front desk that my
concierge would be Jenny. Then they proceeded to look around the Atrium for Jenny who
wasn’t there and said she would contact me which she never did. I have never waited for my
room to be ready before. I went to the pool bar and sat in the heat until 4:30 PM waiting for my
room. No one ever contacted me. Since my room wasn’t ready I waited an extra half hour to
give them some leeway. Still no one contacted me not even to apologize that the room still
wasn’t ready and give a new estimate as to when the room would be ready. Proper customer
service dictates that since I am an owner and my room was not ready was to move me to
another room that was ready when I arrived. At the very least communicate with me to keep
me updated on when my room would be ready. However it was nothing but crickets. I had to
go back to the checkin desk and demand they get me into a room. They put me on the 2nd
floor which was unacceptable after my long wait and nearly every other stay I have been in
room 2508. I went to the front desk and asked to speak to the hotel manager. I asked to be
moved to either The Reserve (Adults only area of the resort) or to room 2508. They moved me
to rooms 2509 and 2510. At this time I was told once again that my concierge would be Jenny
and she was off today (contradicting what I was told by the checkin desk). I was told Jenny
would contact me first thing in the morning when she got to work. I was also told they were
having the mini bar stocked for me right away.
Several hours later the mini bar was not stocked. I called the operator to get someone to
restock the minibar. Again I waited and waited and no one showed. I had to call the operator
every 15 minutes until someone finally showed up at my room to restock the mini bar.
Next I discovered the bathroom in room 2509 had no running water except the toilet, Both
rooms 2509 and 2510 had issues with the drapes working properly. One drape would not move
at all. The wand on one of the drapes came off in my hand while tracking to open them. One
drop was not even attached to the wand mechanism that opens it. I again had to call the
operator to send maintenance up to fix the water and drapes. I told them that they could come
into the room any time the next day to fix the issues.
The next morning when I showered I discovered that the shower in room 2510 (because the
shower in room 2509 wouldn’t work) that I could not get any shampoo out of the resort
provided shampoo bottle. I had brought a travel size of bottle of shampoo that I used that
morning. I expected that when housekeeping came that they would refill the shampoo bottle. I
left my room for the day. Upon returning to my room I found that I could still not get anything
out of the shampoo bottle. Once again I had to call the operator and was told that someone
would be there immediately. Again I waited over an hour before I had to start calling the
operator every 15 minutes to get housekeeping to replace the shampoo bottle with one that
worked. I also checked the bathroom in room 2509. The handwashing sinks now had water.
However the shower was still dry as a bone, no water to be had. Next I checked the drapes.
The non moving drape was fixed. The drape that was not connected was still not connected.
I never heard anything from Jenny until 5:00 PM AFTER I had to constantly complain to get
things taken care. This by the was supposed to be Jenny’s job since the only thing the
concierges have done was book restaurant reservations and on this trip the restaurants no
longer take reservations.
After 24 hours of non stop customer service issues which Noe (hotel manager) and Emayel
(vacation club supervisor) and Jenny (non existent concierge) were supposed to take care of
but I had to deal with myself, I booked the first flight home I could get as there was no
indication that anyone at the hotel was not going to do anything to improve customer service.
Customer service on this visit was non existent. I have never had this poor of customer service
at the hotel. However, I have had the same or worse level of poor customer service at 2 other
Melia properties I stayed at in the past.
I paid $100 dollars per person per night for 7 days all inclusive fee plus taxes which came to
$1,472.00. I only stayed 3 nights so I am owed the return of the all inclusive fee plus taxes for
the remaining 4 days, $841.12. Since I left early due to the poor customer service I received,
the hotel is also responsible for refunding me the cost to change my flights home in the amount
of $1,091.80. Finally, I had an excursion to Xcaret booked for the day that I left that I cancelled
on Sunday which cost $455.98 that Xcaret refused to refund therefore the hotel is responsible
for compensating me for the cost of the lost excursion.
In total the resort owes me $2,388.90. If I would have received proper customer service I would
have stayed for my original planned 7 nights and would not have incurred all of these financial
losses therefore the resort is directly responsible for all of these fees due to lack of customer
service.

reviews.author: Querube M
reviews.title: Poor Service Quality, not a great Family resort for those with small children
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at Paradisus for a couple of nights and we were very disappointed. My husbands family is actually from the Dominican and we go to an all-inclusive resort every year, we are sad to say that the service was not great. Consider booking at another resort, they are some amazing ones out there. Here is my list of items that we experiences that were not great: 

Service Quality: Throughout our stay, we experienced consistently poor service. The staff did not appear enthusiastic or attentive, which impacted our overall experience negatively.
