Check-In Process: The automatic online check-in service was non-functional, leading us to wait in line to speak to someone and get our room assigned. This inefficiency added unnecessary frustration to our arrival.

Delay in Room Requests: Despite requesting a bed and crib upon arrival, it took multiple follow-ups before these items were finally provided. This delay was inconvenient and did not meet our expectations for prompt service.

Family Activities: the resort is marketed as a family destination, but we found the kids' activities to be lacking. The kids' room and available activities were subpar compared to other resorts we’ve visited in Punta Cana, making it less appealing for families with children.

Dining Reservations: Securing reservations at your restaurants was challenging. We attempted to book a table at 9:30 am, but the only available option was the Dominican restaurant, which was not suitable for children.

reviews.author: YESIKA A
reviews.title: PÉSIMO SERVICIO, INSTALACIONES VIEJAS, PERSONAL GROSERO, HORAS DE ESPERA PARA RESTAURANTES.
reviews.text:
Quedé decepcionada de este hotel. Además de que no es lo que se ve en la fotos, esta viejo, dejado, con gotera, paredes manchadas de humedad y el servicio es terrible. Para poder cenar en alguno de los restaurantes es una pesadilla. No hay reservaciones por lo que te apuntan a como vas llegando, siempre te dicen que es mínimo una hora, pero hubo días que hasta dos horas, al ver los restaurantes tienen al menos 4 o 5 mesas vacías y mientras se va acumulando la gente. Cuando logras entrar te dicen que la comida tardará  de 40 a 60 minutos, al pedir los refrescos/bebidas te dicen que se tardarán 20 minutos. El servicio de los meseros es terrible.Mi cuñado pidió a un mesero cebollas y cilantro para unos tacos y después de decir que tardaría 20 minutos en traerlo (mientras que la cebolla estaba a la vista), agarró el plato y con la mano aventó la cebolla. Al reclamar, los meseros se juntaron y junto con la encargadilla llamaron a seguridad porque se les había "reclamado" el aventar la cebolla con las manos, que hagan lo que hagan uno no puede reclamar nada, así te avienten la cebolla con las manos.
Los restaurantes son comida de baja calidad y el servicio deja mucho que desear. NO LO RECOMIENDO, EL SERVICIO ES PÉSIMO, EL TRATO ESPANTOSO,EL PERSONAL DE SERVICIO GROSERO Y EL HOTEL NO VALE LA PENA. NO TIENE SHOWS DE NOCHE. POR LO QUE COBRAN HAY MUCHO MEJORES HOTELES.

reviews.author: R2227YSpeterh
reviews.title: Disappointing expectations
reviews.text:
The checked in service was not friendly.  We asked if we could have the rooms in the same building and the same floor.  Their answer was oh the rooms are preselected and they don't even pretend to help and accommodate.  When I told them it was my birthday and if there's something special they can do and the guy doesn't bother to look at me and told me flatly to talk to the bell boys.

The Buffett area is very small for such a big resort.  Be prepared for a long lineup if you wished to eat there.  The food selection is not good at all and it's just meh.  Fruit selection is also terrible especially for a tropical country.  Their juices are not freshly pressed as opposed to many others I have been to.

They do not have many lounge chairs and if you wished to get one, you need to make sure you're there by 7.  Their night activities is either boring or none at all.  We pretty much end up going back to our rooms early.

The only positive thing is the beautiful beach. 

I'll definitely not come back here nor will I recommend this resort.

reviews.author: vinnyrkj
reviews.title: Worst management
reviews.text:
Paradisus Management,

I am writing to express my profound disappointment and anger over the appalling treatment my family and I experienced during our recent stay at your resort. We were wrongfully accused of assaulting one of your co-workers, an accusation that is not only baseless but utterly disgraceful. This false allegation caused us significant distress and tarnished our vacation.

The harassment did not end there. Upon our return to the hotel, another family member was wrongfully accused of being the individual initially accused. This continuous mistreatment is beyond unacceptable. Additionally, we were refused service when we wanted food, under the unfounded pretext that we were wasting food. This is an outrageous and baseless assumption, and it is deeply insulting to us as paying guests.

To make matters worse, when we ordered room service, our food would take an hour or more to arrive. This level of incompetence and lack of hospitality is shocking for a resort that claims to offer high-quality service.

The most disturbing aspect of our stay was the complete lack of evidence supporting any of the accusations. It felt like a random pick, similar to a random security check at an airport. At this hotel, it seems they randomly pick victims to harass and mistreat. Despite spending a significant amount of money to enjoy a vacation, we were instead kicked out and threatened in various ways, given only 30 minutes to leave the premises.

We repeatedly asked to see camera footage to clear up these accusations. Guess what? They have almost no cameras—barely a few at the entrance and the gift shops. This lack of security measures is alarming and only adds to the sense of injustice we felt.

I sincerely advise other guests to be extremely careful when considering a stay at this resort. You could easily become a victim of their random and baseless accusations. Our entire experience at Paradisus was nothing short of a nightmare. The resort's inability to provide even the most basic level of respect and service has left us with a lasting negative impression. We will never return to Paradisus, and we will be sure to share our horrendous experience with others to prevent them from enduring similar treatment.

This was, without a doubt, the worst resort experience we have ever had.

reviews.author: mogginsKent
reviews.title: Worst food ever experience.
reviews.text:
Stayed her for 10 nights in the reserve but standard ocean front room. Room is very tired but bed is very comfortable.
The main problem with the hotel was the food. The worst menus ever. Travelled to at least 30 caribbean/Mexican resorts and have always had nice evening meals. NOT 1 restaurant had nice food. Most nights we just went to bed around 7 to avoid going to dinner. On 3 occasions in the buffet restaurant hairs were found in the food not on top.  Nothing seemed to match. If they did meat, which was not good, there was nothing to match it up with. Potatoes were never cooked just hard and full of salt. Carrots covered in pepper. Pizza was like biting into cardboard. Had Jerk chicken in one restaurant sauce was terrible tasted of liquorice. Having been to Jamaica 11 times never tasted jerk like it before.  Breakfast at the reserve restaurant would take over an hour and they only got the order correct once. Every dessert looked nice but tasted of nothing.  If  you were vegetarian you have no chance here. I ordered an omelette with onion, and tomato. It was cooked in a long line of egg mix with 3 other peoples omelette. As a result ended up with the smallest omelette ever with bacon after waiting in line 20 mins. Just gave up. 
Went to the spa- OMG what a dirty grotty place. I stayed 5 mins and left. A spa should be relaxing and luxurious. The wood on the floor was filthy, hand rail into the pool was broken. Was given a chair to sit on and the wheel feel off. The place needs to be gutted.
Went to the sports bar to watch football/soccer. Asked the barman to change the channel only to be told he doesn't have the remote its else where, waited ages for the person to come in but during the 90 mins it was turned over about 20 times.
All in all a very badly run hotel.  Only positive most staff were very friendly and drinks were good .  Drink service around the reserve pool was very good. Osca,and Caesar very good.

reviews.author: Seb Szpak
reviews.title: RUDE.
reviews.text:
So basically only arrived 3 days ago. And already problems. Wouldn’t recommend. For a start you’re told when you arrive your mini bar is restocked everyday. This is a lie you have to go all the way to reception to ask for it to get restocked and if your late they won’t send someone until the next day. 

Another problem is that when you arrive you’re told that the bar closes at 11pm, however this is also a lie tried going to the bar at 10:45 and got rejected because they’re closed? So decided to go to reception to ask for a bottle of Prosecco, wasn’t allowed that to even have a drink. Then some lady came from reception (worker) and interrupted the chat I was having with the gentlemen in the desk and started being VERY RUDE, saying no you’re not getting anything. On top of that she said “the bar stops serving at 10:30pm but closes at 11pm” so what sense does this make? Very false information we got told and that’s very disappointing. Not professional and I really hope this woman who works at the reception who was RUDE gets dealt with. I will definitely be making a complaint about SEVERAL things here. We are a GUEST at your hotel and this is horrible behaviour to treat your GUEST.

reviews.author: Sandy O
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here!
reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY HERE!!  We went to celebrate our anniversary and booked in the Adults Only Reserve section. We splurged for the 2 room master Suite Ocean View.  Save your money and what a joke! Where do I start on room? Closet light in bedroom  would not turn off because it was wired in with no light bulb to simply unscrew… yes we tried and closet doors are open open slats. Turned in constant requests… never fixed.  Fridge not restocked daily as promised. No water bottles left.  Bathroom toilet rack fell off, shampoo/conditioner dispenser in shower fell off wall …again we called for repairs more than once and never fixed. Last straw was night we were sitting out on our balcony and my wife’s chairs bottoms fell out and over she went…..and no she by no way overweight!   We had included steak dinner 1 night at restaurant. Never happened because apparently this restaurant was only open on certain days. Breakfast a nightmare! Only 1 restaurant for both sides.  Line was out the door wrapped around atrium every morning.  
We love Mexico and the people and have traveled all over this beautiful country. Yes, we are returning but never again to the Paradisus. This once great resort,  I am sure,  is in dire need of major renovations and apparently management changes.

reviews.author: Gabriela M
reviews.title: Un asco de hotel
reviews.text: Un asco de hotel. La infraestructura no es mala pero si es vieja. El problema radica en su pésima atención y en su nula atención al cliente. Nunca me había tocado quedarme en un hotel donde los reclamos del cliente valieran tan poco. Se nos inundó la pieza y se nos mojó todo, no hay toallas en la piscina, todos los restaurantes tienes que esperar una hora para comer y muchos problemas más

reviews.author: rlaughter1981
reviews.title: HORRIBLE STAY, BOOK SOMEWHERE ELSE
reviews.text: This resort is a 2-star, not five. Terrible food, customer service, a flooded room, the reserve experience is overrated. Management doesn't go above and beyond for guest that have room issues which we did the whole time we were there. I felt like I was working the whole time just for my stay versus having a vacation. Book somewhere else if you can.

reviews.author: Olivia H
reviews.title: Stay away from!
reviews.text: This hotel is collapsing by the hour; everything is falling apart, I am afraid the hotel will be evacuated before we finish our stay. I don’t know how the authorities allow them to stay open. Our stay was an unmitigated nightmare. We went through 6 rooms to find two that were acceptable. Condensation is bursting through walls, ceilings. Towels and rags all through the hotel to prevent guests from slipping and smashing their heads against the floor. Power outlets are not working and probably an electrocution hazard. You can’t report anything because the phones aren’t working and there’s a huge line at the check in. ACs are all super noise from running 24 hours a day. Moldy smell in most rooms. The staff tries, but they are losing the fight against humidity and lack of investment. The good things: the food buffet is very good and the daily entertainment is excellent.

reviews.author: Ricardo Ramos
reviews.title: EL HOTEL MAS NEFASTO DEL CARIBE
reviews.text:
He tenido la fortuna de viajar a muchos lugares del caribe y quedarme en muchos hoteles. Nunca me había tocado un lugar tan nefasto como este hotel supuestamente de 5 estrellas. Tiene serios problemas de mantenimiento y malas decisiones gerenciales que hacen que muchas cosas funcionen mal. Además de todo lo anterior al plantear los problemas al hotel, no solucionan nada y solo andan con evasivas. Algunos ejemplos de los problemas que tuvimos:
- Se inundó la habitación y se me mojaron todas las cosas.
- Todos los restaurantes tienen más de una hora de espera para poder ingresar. 
- No tienen línea telefónica para servicio a la habitación (estuvo fuera los 9 dias)
- Nunca hay toallas en la piscina. 
- Los horarios de buffet y shows son super limitados y generan muchos problemas finalmente.
- No reponen nada en la habitación salvo que vayas y pelees por las cosas en recepción. 

En resumen si quieren ir a un todo incluido de clase mundial donde no tengas que preocuparte de nada más que pasarlo bien... NO VAYAS A ESTE HOTEL, PORQUE ES TODO LO CONTRARIO!!!

reviews.author: Aman B
reviews.title: Downgraded and worst experience from ground up.
reviews.text:
Where should I start, so much to complain about. Everything at resort was messed right from the time we reached at security gates. It is long review but know that we travel twice year to Cancun for all inclusive and have stayed at lot of resort like hyatt siva, hyatt Zilara, secrets, dreams, moon palace, Hilton mar-caribe, Le Blanc to name a few. 
1. Security:  I had private transport from airport and the security was trying to find my name in reservation by my LastName,FirstName and unable to find. I kept telling him to look by first name and our driver helped too but he wont listen. Finally after 15 min pointing his sheet he understood and found the reservation by FirstName, LastName. 
2. Check-in: Reached around 1pm and check-in time is 3pm. Stood for 90 min in the line to get checked in despite the fact they had 4 counters open and about 20 parties but they take super long time. There is guest services across the hall but they are not ready to checkin which they could as they have all access to change rooms, assign etc.They tell us if we want to upgrade to Ocean view because current room has 'lagoon' view. Upgrade price of $175 for 3 nights (this is important). We did not opt as we thought its okay to have some water view(lagoon). 
3. Entry: Finally at 3pm we get room access. The room assigned is in lower level (basement) and outside window its only trees. We asked about lagoon,  they said that on that side of resort the higher you go the lagoon is visible.  That’s why they refer it sometimes as ‘sunset view’. We asked for upgrade and they told us that get in the line again as normal check-in line, remember that 90 min wartime?. I was furious and I told them I have a 9 month old baby then they listened to us. Then they told us that 'right now no ocean rooms available so check tomorrow' or come later after 430pm after it gets little empty at check-in desks to 'lock' for tomorrow. View wasn’t the only issue in this room. The bathroom ceiling had paint and caulking falling off into the bathtub while taking a bath on the head. Taps were rusted and towels were not usual towels but dirty beach towels.
4. Evening: We go again around 9pm when all check-ins are done and ask for upgrade for the 'next' day so they can lock a room for us. Magically now they have ocean view rooms available as early as today. We are surprised and ask to upgrade it they tell us cost is $100 per night making it $300 for 3 nights and same $300 for 2 nights ALSO. See how the price changed in few hours from $175 for 3 nights and also 2 nights upgrade or all 3 nights I still pay the same even if I have already spend 8 hours in that old room? we had argument with the check-in person for 30 min trying to make him understand that he must honor the price quoted to us both on email before we came here and the same price told to us in afternoon($175) and that it cannot be the same rate for both 2 night upgrade and 3 nights. I already to pay $120 for 2 nights to upgrade.  With no option had to call his manager who did the override and we were then given 2 nights upgrade for $120. 
5. New Room: Next day finally we are moved to new room. It took around 1.5 hr to move the room --- room assign, updating the tags, bags were sent by bellboy to wrong room so tracking that and getting to new ones. All messed up. 
6. New room night - In night I noticed that the AC was not cooling enough, I checked the vents and it was cold air but still temperature was not dropping below 24 Celsius although setting was to 18.5 celsius. The reason, it was facing ocean so all warm air from outside was ENTERING the room. Yes the entire sliding window doors had open spots and you could hear winds gushing in and waving the curtains. it was 11pm at this time and my 9 month old was sleeping so we decided to stay in room only and we slept without any top on in that temperature. 
7. Room maintenance - Next day we tell them the issue and I show them videos. They tell me that I need to be in room and some maintenance guy will come and check if they can fix it or not and based on their review they will decide to move our room or not. I mean I am on vacation and after spending night like that, in day time they want us to wait for someone else to come and sit with them for however long it takes to fix it? Anyways we are send to room and we wait for someone to come. 45min and no one comes. I walk out and hunt for these men and I see some guys fixing other room and I have to pull them to my room with my broken Spanish so they can see. Not sure what is guest services is there for. 
8. Room fix - Okay this blew me off. They are using DUCT TAPE to stop the winds from entering. I still let them try it but the Frame is huge, think of entire width and height of the room. They block a spot and then another one is noticed. After spending an hour on this (yes I am on vacation and we are doing this) now it started to rain, And guess what, now water is entering the room through gaps below the door frame. They are trying to fix this now again with tape until I stop them and ask them to tell front desk that we need new room as this will take time. Finally after total of 3 hours I am assigned a room which I could have got when I told them initially. This was my entire afternoon well spent while I should have been in pool with a drink. 
9. Dining - No restaurants need reservation but lunch nothing is open. There is one buffet place and one other that ONLY serves TACOS at lunch. That's it. choose your tortilla, protein and sauce and done. There is also a pizza place by the pool and that is all. If you stay 3-4-5 days etc then you are having pizza daily. There was an Aqua marina by the pool but that itself is a mess. it took 2 hours to dine there. The waitress was only attending bigger tables maybe for tips. We were party of 2 so no attention. A simple slice of cake (premade) was taking 45-50 min. We stood up and walked away and manager came and we told him of their behavior and waitress ignoring us, instead of listening he was rude to say 'thank you for coming' and walking away! 
10. Drinks- All drinks are watered down. Unless you are in reserve or VIP categories it is not worth being in this resort for drinks. That too I have heard of Reserve doing better but not tried it. 3 days at resort and tried multiple bars not a single once hit me or my partner. They all felt watery. The display bottles specially for vodka, mezcal, tequila would be nice brands but they dont use them and instead take out some other from closet or make a pre-mix using local one.
11. Food- Average food. Even in the buffet not much options and weird open meats. Everyone was lining for egg station as that was only thing to eat but that one guy and entire resort for eggs, think of wait times. The kept food was getting cold, not rapid to refill them or reheat. It was only to fill stomach. The restaurants very slow service and felt other places too that bigger tables and local Spanish speaking parties were treated better. 
12. Pool side service - Apparently you can order finger foods like burger fries wings from pool side servers which no one told us about and we saw some folks having It and asked them and that’s how we got to know. But a server comes once in an hour or 90 min even though there are dedicated servers for the areas. Finally we got hold of one who got us food after an hour and it was cold as from fridge now. The wings has all sauce stuck to it because it wasn't fresh anymore.
13. Room Service Order - Phone lines were not working so watsapp used for placing the order. Despite that, the order was incomplete. It was cold, the nachos soggy which I think is a trend at this resort now but incomplete on a written order? Either way we tell them and they take another hour to prep and send it.
14. Rude staff - Room service had to refill the mini bar. My wife was changing so when knocked the door she asked him to wait. Instead, he BARGED INTO the room when my wife was topless waist up. She screamed and that is when he rushed out. 
15. Other issues -- A major stink in the room. We tell the bellboy that there is smell when we move into room and instead of finding help he tells us that he used to work in paint factory so has lost sense of smell. I am like okay but I need help. Nope nothing. The mini-bar. All 3 times we moved, it only had beers and after multiple times calling room services when someone finally came to put in water and other sodas. 

Overall - This resort needs a major renovation. It earns respect only because of its location in hotel zone and the beach location which honestly is nature and not their's but service, rooms, food, drinks, guest services anything you expect from all-inclusive 4 star resort was nowhere to be seen.
I was there was 3 nights and It did not feel of a vacation but me running around after the maintenance team, guest services, room services, bell boys, and literally every other staff just to get settled in. Daily I found myself spending 3-4 hours of the afternoon in these 'errands'. 
I am never returning to this resort and my 2 other friends who had booked for future have already cancelled. You should think again too.

reviews.author: Jason Z
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere!
reviews.text: Vacation June 4 – 13 2024.  Upon arriving in Cancun, I was immediately impressed with the airport transportation arrangement.  Our private shuttle to Paradisus was outstanding.   The property (Paradisus) was large and seemed overall more of a (4 Star) environment having traveled to actual 5 Star properties elsewhere (Europe, Turkiye etc.).  The front desk was understaffed at our time of arrival and after travel an extended check-in wait is the last thing you want.  The immediate staff presented a courteous and hospitable front which seems to be where it stops, they put their “faces” out front as our dealings with other staff weren’t as pleasant.  Once we arrived at our room, we found small items in disrepair and the room had a musty/stale smell overall.  As we settled in and within a few short hours it became apparent that our A/C was not working properly.  After several calls to the front desk and even notification to our concierge who was supposed to report the issue, maintenance finally arrived.  Upon check of the room temperature, it was 80 Degrees.  The maintenance individual checked a few basic items on the unit but then advised that he did not know what was wrong and thereby couldn’t fix it.  We then requested another room.  Again, after several hours and multiple trips down to the front desk we were advised that a room was ready but the sleeping arrangement would be modified from our double to a single king.  This was unacceptable as I refuse to have my child sleep on a couch/couch bed for over a week.  Some time later a more appropriate room was offered and the reasoning for the time lapse was that it had to be approved from a manager who was off-site!  C’mon!  Upon arriving in the second room, the spiral continued.  The balcony sliding door was very hard to open/close and the handle from the outside had fallen off so re-entry was impossible.  The faucet handle for the shower wasn’t attached so it would fall off when you touched it.  The sink faucet fixture wasn’t tightened so the entire assembly moved when you touched it.  Just when you thought that was enough, our 2nd day in the room the A/C completely went out at night (for the entire night).  Approximately 10 hours without A/C.  It was cooler on the balcony at night than in the room.  In Cancun, in June…..This is highly unacceptable!  After repeating the various complaint processes throughout the night as before with the previous rooms A/C we got absolutely nowhere without any relief.  The next morning an older maintenance man arrived after so many complaints that I cannot count, and immediately the A/C was restored.  A fix as simple as the branch breaker from outside the room needed to be restored after a recent power outage.  I mean, this is 5 Star? Wow.  In our daily partaking of the “all inclusive” dining experience we and everyone else we spoke with agreed that the portions were extremely inadequate, more like snack size vs. meal size.  If you find yourself at the buffet just to quell your hunger be prepared to eat virtually the same thing everyday.  While the outside areas are somewhat relaxing, there are poolside activities that are extremely loud which may disturb your peace of mind and or a nap per se if you so inclined to do so during the afternoon.  The main pool is drab and has maintenance issues, I cut my calf on the exposed tile as many of the areas are sharp.  The secondary pool near the adult area is where it’s at.  A much nicer pool with a far better environment.  The staff are pleasant yet infrequent having to retrieve our drinks ourselves several times.  If you smoke…..there are only 2 public areas for the entire facility which are designated.  One by the front entrance and one at the secondary pool mentioned above.  If you have the opportunity to utilize room service, your food will arrive cold – luke warm at best.  Aside from everything, our greatest disdain was the constant attempts by staff to upsell you and offer excursions.  We were literally followed throughout the entire facility by one individual and it didn’t matter where, in the pool, while smoking, walking too and from, this man tried to get us to buy into Melia properties.  From what I saw, no thank you.  Our day excursion to Chichen Itza was a nice break, even though I feel like tourists are taken advantage of financially.  In some respects you feel “stolen from” by the very people you hired to provide your excursion.  Playing on fears about insect spray, hats, umbrellas……literally trying to sell you everything for inflated prices and always asking for tips in the process.  Our guides spoke way too much, to the point where that was the most annoying aspect.  I mention the excursion because of the travel arrangements, our bus was late so the hotel staff urgently contacted the company for us and made sure pick-up was enroute.  However, while we were picked up at the front main lobby door, upon return at the end of the day we were dropped in the street.  Really!  Of all the events that transpired, one left me infuriated and I’m retired so pretty much laid back for the most part.  My 11 year old son wanted to go to the “Escape Rooms” and I was happy to go because as a family resort there’s very little for children to do other than swim at the pools because the beach is covered in sea-weed and the waves/current are too strong to enjoy without being knocked down or sucked out.  After paying $80 (US) to enter the event, 9 rooms in 1 hour, we began.  We achieved the clues for the 1st room quickly and moved to the 2nd.  In a matter of minutes we figured out the combination needed for the lock to exit the room.  I tried the combination many times, my son tried several times himself, but the lock to exit the room would not operate.  After 20+ minutes of trying to apply the combo and being yelled at over a handheld radio the attendant entered the room.  He tried the same combination we had tried several times (the correct one) and could not get the lock to function.  After repeated attempts he entered the combo and slammed the lock at which point it opened.  He advised it was jammed and needed force!  He then asked if we’d like to continue with only 20’ish minutes left to go thru 6 rooms, I almost died!  So you’re telling me that after forcefully clearing a lock malfunction made for a children’s excursion you’re advising me I have 20+/- min left and asking me if I’d like to continue?  To sum it up, after demanding a refund at the front desk, after being yelled at by staff at the guest services desk by a child who shouldn’t be in front line customer service we left the next day and after the 3-4 vacations we take globally each year, we were glad to head home without a refund ($80), never to return again.  The highlight of the entire vacation was the city of Valladolid that we stopped at during our excursion.  The shops were great, the jewelry very nice, and the churros amazing and the people very hospitable.  I will never stay at another Melia property again, ever!

reviews.author: Khishigt M
reviews.title: Sorely disappointed, unhelpful staff/not safe infrastructure
reviews.text:
I'm sorely disappointed with this resort.

Firstly, when we got there, our check in process took about 2 hours in total - as they had me in a different pyramid than the rest of my family so we were pushed into upgrading our rooms into ocean view rooms. The first room on an upper floor they gave us was not ready, so we went back to the front desk to have them switch to a different room. We had to re-check in and go through this whole process again for another room. When my family came, it was the same deal - we had to upgrade them as well and it took about an hour for all of this configuration.

On the third day - the front desk was incessantly calling all of my family claiming that I need to urgently report to the front desk for something extremely pressing (refusing to tell us what it was for). I ran from the pool to the front desk, only for them to not only know what I was talking about. I waited about 45 minutes for them to locate the person who called. They tried gaslighting me to tell me they would never demand something like that or have the authorization to call my family. They found him, I ran over, the pressing matter was that my signature on a small receipt slightly varied from my passport. I asked why this couldn't wait, he had no answer. He claimed he was trying to contact me the entire trip, this can't be true - I was at the pool for about an hour and I was working from the room the entire trip.

This is the story that takes the cake - we're there for almost a week at this point. I noticed the balcony wall was damaged but didn't think anything of it, since you know, they already allowed us to stay the entire week. I took off work for the last day of our vacation, and of course I spent it CRYING at the front desk:

They called and said we must move rooms because of the wall, but guess what - there are no more ocean view rooms so they need to downgrade us claiming there are absolutely no other rooms in the ENTIRE resort. They offered us a refund for one day of the upgrade. We paid for the upgrade for the entire stay, so they're only refunding us for the day we're not in our ocean view room. Then they switched it up to refunding us for two days. We kept telling them we only have one day left, we bought a cabana for this day, you didn't care that we stayed all week. They forced us to move, they brought security over to man the door while my husband spoke to the front desk. They claimed there was absolutely no other rooms at all available in any pyramid other than the one they're offering us. They got "approval" from their manager to give us a refund for the upgrade for the entire stay and we agreed to move rooms. This took about 3 hours.

After being forced to move, the room they moved us to did not have a working AC and the room was NOT cleaned (add insult to injury)!!! There was toothpaste in the sink, pubic hair in the shower and a moldy smell in the room. I went back downstairs to an extremely unhelpful lady at the front desk and they were, once again, trying to gaslight me. Half the day was over at this point, I missed the opportunity to hang out with my family along with the cabana we paid for. I started crying and I showed her the photos of said pubic hair, etc. and she told me to sit tight and wait for the cleaning staff. They can "clean" it all they want but they're not going to get rid of the moldy smell in a day, I kept pushing for any other room. After waiting for 45 minutes, no person came. I went to check back in. They went back to figure things out, another 45 minutes later, they miraculously found an alternative room with two twin beds. We were so exhausted at this point, we're 5 hours deep at this point, the entire last day is ruined. We took whatever room and asked for the cabana reservation to be moved to next morning since we weren't able to use it at all. They said "we made a special exception for you to get a refund of your upgrade so we can't do anymore."

Great. Fantastic. Thanks so much guys for a really wonderful vacation.

reviews.author: Nir S
reviews.title: Been charged for an upgrade upon checkout!
reviews.text:
Worst experience in hotel in cancun, was told upon checkout thay the hotel charge me the incorrect amount for the upgrade so I was charged an additional $381 at checkout for the $381 that I was already been charged at check in. 
Will never come back here!

reviews.author: Jesse H
reviews.title: La peor exprencia en Cancún
reviews.text: Ciertos cuartos no trabaja el aire acondicionado. Tuve que quejarme varias veces para que me cambiaran y aún así el nuevo cuarto también no se enfriaba más de 22 centígrados aunque lo tenía en el nivel más bajo. La tercera noche perdió el hotel la luz y de nuevo otra noche en calor. No regresaría a este hotel y menos pagaría para Meliá Rewards.

reviews.author: Ivan M
reviews.title: Pésima calidad de hotel
reviews.text: Lamentable la calidad de comida de todos los restaurantes, no hay ni uno solo  que realmente sea rica la comida. El bufete por las mañanas es un total caos y es muy sucio y aunque tienen varios restaurantes mucha de la comida se repite. Si observan a detalle muchas personas dejan los platos recién servidos porque carecen de sabor y calidad. La atención del personal es buena, sin embargo el hotel no cuenta con una buena administración e infraestructura y es muy lamentable. El peor hotel de Cancún, y por mucho

reviews.author: Fiza A
reviews.title: PARIDISUS CANCUN WORST RESORT!!!
reviews.text: Paradisus resort has provided us with an incredibly disappointing experience. Upon arrival, I immediately wanted to leave. Despite booking a reserved adults-only room with Priceline, which included access to various restaurants, the receptionist informed us that only the basic all-inclusive package was available. The room was subpar, and the service was atrocious. We were unable to take advantage of the promised deals to explore the hotel fully. Furthermore, we were charged for an upgrade to an adults-only room that we never received. Despite spending hours speaking with the receptionist and their team, no resolution was reached. They were uncooperative, refusing to let me speak with the manager or provide any assistance. There was no refund offered for the upgrade fee. After spending eight hours on the phone with Priceline, the issue remains unresolved, with no guarantee of a refund. We feel trapped in this hotel with our issues unresolved, which is incredibly frustrating and has ruined our vacation experience. The staff's rudeness and lack of concern for customer comfort only exacerbated the situation. I suspect they are intentionally misleading us, even claiming that we booked through Expedia despite our reservations being made through Priceline. They continue to deny this, even after Priceline confirmed our booking. I strongly advise against staying at this resort if you desire decent service.

reviews.author: brunonn2024
reviews.title: Decepcionante
reviews.text: Chega nem perto de ser 5 estrelas. Qualidade de atendimento, alimentos, quartos e horários de funcionamento lamentaveis.

reviews.author: Hunter R
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE!! Housekeeping STEALS!!
reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY HERE!! My Lululemon shorts were STOLEN from the room. Management refused to reimburse or replace, even though I found out the housekeeper who cleaned the room have been fired meaning they were stolen. security even went through all of my personal possessions and luggage in case I was lying about not having the shorts which is an invasion of privacy to say the least. 

Another co-worker had her purfume laptop charger stolen from her room. 

Air conditioning does not work in many of the rooms.

Horrible customer service and you may not come home with all your things, DO NOT STAY HERE!

reviews.author: Andre
reviews.title: Don’t stay here and waste your money.
reviews.text:
Don’t come and stay here. 
Zero maintenance.
Terrible customer service.
No good food at any of the restaurants. 
Problems with A/C and no working showers amongst many problems with our group. 
Way way subpar customer service.
I’m sure none of the staff has gone through training.

reviews.author: Giorgia
reviews.title: Paradisus????????
reviews.text: Don't waste your money with the Reserve much better Paradisus Cancun. The only positive thing about the Reserve is Sante restaurant for lunch ( Cesar and Moses are amazing).

reviews.author: Francisco Gonzalez
reviews.title: SIN PALABRAS
reviews.text:
Es una decepción de hotel, habitaciones de los años 80, instalaciones mediocres, muebles viejos , el que se arriesga ? lo comprobará.!!!

Yo tengo una Máster Suite y nada que ver con lo que ofrecen en otros hoteles. $ 12 mil pesos la noche 

MEXICANOS,, por favor,  no vengan a este seudo lugar ( hotel), la discriminación está muy notoria, el restaurante estaba vacío y te levantan del restaurante para hacer fila.

Una burla y discriminación, en fin, lamentablemente tengo que quedarme algunos días más , pero debo de ser sincero, no todo está mal, existes gente muy amable y sencilla que te trata bien.

Pero en la vida, regresaría !!! Les recomiendo el Hard Rock!!!

reviews.author: Gurmit M
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus before Covid. I liked it everything was very good and service was great. But that is not the same anymore.  Service is very bad and manger David was very rude we complained about smell in one room he said we have to live with it.

reviews.author: sennabanita
reviews.title: Not so good experience
reviews.text: We just checked into this resort yesterday. We booked a junior suite ocean view room. Only after getting the room we realised this is not an ocean view room but more of a partial ocean view room. From inside of the room you can see other buildings, only from a corner of the balcony you can see the some partial view of the ocean. This is very deceiving, these rooms shouldn’t sold as an ocean view in the first place. All I can see backside dirty pipes of the tiki bar and then some ocean. When we requested for a change, we were told no other room is available in this property. Be aware of this as it can happen to anyone. This is my worst stay so far in the Mexico. Pool and restaurants (we used only one so far) seem very comparable to other resorts we have stayed in Mexico. But the experience with room is super unpleasant and expected. I’ll add some photos and update with rest of my experience in this stay.

reviews.author: P P P
reviews.title: Not 5 star!
reviews.text: After a long flight we were shown to our room,which was terribly disappointing it was tired,had a mouldy bathroom it was without pictures and soft furnishings,nothing like the pictures on the British Airways website and hotel website.We are then shown to another which had a rusty fridge and rusty oven in,again very run down,then another where the bed was pushed against the wall so you couldn’t get out of bed ! The next day after complaining we were moved to The Reserve,the furniture is old but has been given a basic coat of white paint,the curtains were hanging down,the bathroom light didn’t work and the noise from the balcony was horrendous as there was building work on a new hotel next door,and for 2 days the lift was out of order.In the main building when it rained there were piles of towels left in the corridors,to soak up the water,the drinks were sub standard,most cocktails were not as they should be,and some restaurant food was very poor,infact my husband was given raw chicken at one.I was ill with stomach problems the whole time I was there and weeks after I returned home.Some staff are very pleasant and some are just plain rude.All in al,this is definately not a five star hotel,it may of been when it was originally built but sadly it is not now,so we would not recommend this hotel and will never return here.

reviews.author: AlwaysOnVacation520
reviews.title: Super honest review
reviews.text:
Will not go back cuz of the following :

1) rooms aren't clean, I found hairs on towels, contact lenses on the floor, cigarette butts in the balcony.  The overall room looks old. 

2) rave party outside the hotel that will wake u up from 1am-4am, my baby had nightmares  every night cuz of that.  We went to front desk to complaint, and lady says there's ntg they can do cuz the party it's outside the hotel.  We didn't have a single good night sleep since our arrival.

3) food, the buffet service was overall ok, some restaurants food can also be found in buffet, so by day 3-4 we were fed up with the same food that were just overlapping over and over again. 

4) Beach is nice, BUT always missing towels 

We had the worse experience ever and can't wait to leave mostly cuz of the lack of sleep.

reviews.author: Ronnette C
reviews.title: Terrible food horrible service outdated rooms this resort is supposed to be kid friendly  but it was not geared to kids
reviews.text: I DO NOT RECOMMEND. I overheard lots of families complaining All week long. The food was really bad even the breakfast limited options but the worst resort food i have run into thus far. We had to leave the resort to eat thats how bad it was. Also lots of non working restrooms throughout the resort. When we checked in they advertised several restaurants but only 4 were actually open on the resort the others we were told were open during certain hours we went and they never opened. A portion of the ceiling fell on a lady as we were making our way to breakfast my oldest daughter saw this and was traumatized she was walking on eggshells the rest of the trip. When we got back to our room that same day the ceiling was coming down so we called right away they told us 15-20 mins they came the next day. It was from the humidity in the room the ac in our room was broken they never offered us to change rooms or anything the day before checkout they came to fix it. The humidity in the room made our clothes damp. While we were attempting to eat in the buffet Wednesday night a cockroach was crawling on my chair we left and went to McDonalds for dinner. The pools were decent however they had limited seats for tons of ppl first come first serve but not enough seating to accommodate the amount of guest. We originally had a king size bed bedroom they switched us without explaining or asking if we wanted that. The room was terrible very outdated tiny bed leaning to one side. The tub/shower was very old and cracking and had been painted over. There was a leak inside the hallway 2 rooms down from mine which attracted water bugs to that area. The espresso counter was decent for the most part. Several kids activities were advertised but each time I attempted to take my daughter the activity was cancelled from some nonsense reason.  I will never visit a melia property again not even for free. Thankfully I travel a decent amount a year so I was about to go off the resort to safe locations with my kids to make the best of our stay. Please update the rooms and expand the restaurants to accommodate the amount of guests!!!!!

reviews.title: Very, very old, run down and unorganized.
reviews.text: Rooms are very small and many, many things broken. They say they will take care of it but never did. We paid extra for the retreat but don’t fall for their verbiage. The only thing worth it is the adults only private pool. Our “Retreat Junior Suite” was just like any regular hotel room.Very old and rundown.

reviews.author: Bailey S
reviews.title: Corrupt manipulative cheats
reviews.text:
So absolutely disappointed in staying here. Our first time to a family resort as we have only ever gone to adults only resorts and it was horrible. I was expecting the quality to be less compared to the 5 star adult only resorts were used to but this was by far the worst resort we’ve been too. I won’t even go into the hour long waits at reception to check in ( and then to re wait another few hours the next day to switch rooms to the one we actually paid for ) 
But all of those things were minor compared to the blatant discrimination that we experienced. To keep it short we rented a cabana by the pool , guy said 55$ US 
Bill comes in at 255$ US ..we maybe thought it was because they’re gave us lobster and champagne (which the guy said was included in our cabana) but I thought maybe it was miscommunication and of course we’ll pay for what we used. Come to find out ALL the other canbanas around us paid no more that 55 with everything included . I feel so manipulated and cheated . Everyone was so kind I’ve been going out of my way to tip generously and then to find out how our kindness was taken advantage of by the staff here left such a sour taste in my mouth. I’ve only ever stayed at high end resorts and have never experienced such cunning and disgusting service. I will never stay here nor do I recommend anyone with standards to stay here it’s just untrustworthy and corrupt . It’s day 2 of my stay and I’m utterly disappointed.

reviews.author: Dhiren D
reviews.title: Poor Stay - The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We stayed here after staying at Parasidus Playa Del Carmen La Perla with royal service. We had a concierge here, but the team could not handle requests or communicate replies. 

We had difficulties in the room, such as missing a hair dryer, flooded bathroom, missing kettle, mugs, and coffee, snack, some of which were resolved after a few days of requesting. 

The resort was very busy and we had long queues for tables at restaurants, which had no option to book, With waits of up to an hour.  Long waits for room service order also with the longest being almost 2hrs

Given the price we paid for the Reserve, it didn't feel luxurious, and we often had to chase with the concierge that things like the Bali beds were booked, but when we went to use them, they weren't, and we hadn't been told anything. Would have been simpler to make our own bookings. 

Not a good experience. We have stayed at many Melia properties, but this is not up to the usual standard, and I'm not sure we will consider Melia properties in the future.

reviews.author: Sightseer600697
reviews.title: This place sucks, horrible place, do not stay here
reviews.text: Waste of money, horrible customer service, this place is claiming to be 5-star hotel, but the service and the experience is 3 stars. Plan on spending lot more money when you get in the place. Staff expect you to tip every place in order to give good service.

reviews.author: Gary S
reviews.title: Off to bad start
reviews.text: Check in process was disorganized and took too long. Assigned room was flooded. While waiting in reception area, overheard two other families with flooded rooms. Waiting for another room - taking over an hour. No upgrades offered. Won’t be returning here.

reviews.author: Daniel E
reviews.title: Bed bugs worst experience ever
reviews.text: Thank god my vacation has come to an end. I have been all over the world travelling and I have never had a worse experience both with staff and cleanliness in my life. Please see attached photos of my arms and hands after night one(bed bugs) I was itchy all week. The staff is absolutely horrible. The managers laugh and smirk at you the entire time you try and talk to them while lying through their teeth. Nicole at the adult only pool bar could be the rudest person I have ever met. Stay as far away from this place as possible u less you want to look like you had chicken pox all week.

reviews.author: Kenny E
reviews.title: Bed bugs and HORRIBLE Staff!
reviews.text:
Beware of this resort!  There are bed bugs in the rooms (see attached pictures) and the staff are amongst the rudest staff that I have ever seen.  I have been to many high end resorts and the staff at the Paradisus is by far the worst.  They try and upcharge you whenever they can and will call security on you if you try and talk to them.

There are only about 50 chairs next to the main pool at a resort with 2,000 rooms.  If you do not wake up at 5am to secure a chair then you will never get one.  The food is average at best and everything shuts down at 11pm.  There is no nightlife at this resort whatsoever and is the most boring place to be after dinner.  If you like going to bed at 8pm then this resort is perfect.

The pool concierge, Nicole, at the adults only section (the reserve) is one of the worst human beings alive.  She constantly screams at guests, has absolutely no respect and tries to get people kicked off the resort for no reason.  How she still has a job is a mystery in itself.  

The spa staff will get you in trouble if you use the change room to get changed in and will write a report on you if you get naked to change into your bathing suit.  

I would never go to this resort again even if I was paid to go there.  It is unorganized, under staffed and an absolute disaster.  I am a professional in my late thirties and I highly suggest you book another place in Cancun to stay at - take my word for it.

reviews.author: Vanildo N
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN DO LUXO AO LIXO
reviews.text: Depois de 8 meses que fizemos nossa reserva tivemos uma experiência NEGATIVA deste empreendimento. Ao chegarmos no Hotel fizemos o o check in, pagamos e ficamos aguardado a liberação dos aptos. Foi nos oferecidos os apartamentos 3010 e 3009 que ficam no 3  pavimento Inferior, de frente para um jardim, contrariamente do que dizia a minha reserva que as unidades eram voltadas para a Lagoa Nichupte. Fomos solicitar a troca de aptos mas a informação era de que o Hotel estava lotado e não seria possivel. Pedimos para falar com uma Gerente, ( ROSANA ZANINOR) e a mesma disse que estava la para atender a quem  PAGA MAIS!  edi o dinheiro que ja havia pago de volta e depois de idas  e vindas, resolveram devolver o dinheiro , e fomos para outro Hotel onde fomos MUITO BEM RECEBIDOS.O Paradisus ja nao e mais o mesmo, com de fato não e, como  demonstrado pela Senhora Rosana que NÃO TEM ABSOLUTAMENTE NENHUM PERFIL COMO ADMINISTRADORA, que com certeza vira com uma resposta padrão. GOSTARIA , POR FIM QUE ESTA AVALIAÇÃO FOSSE ENCAMINHADA A PALMAS DE MAYORCA ONDE FICA  A DIRETORIA DO EMPREENDIMENTO EM QUESTÃO.

reviews.author: Nika P
reviews.title: AVOID if you are a vegetarian
reviews.text:
If you are a strict VEGETARIAN I would AVOID this hotel. We found a huge lack of service for a 5* rated hotel. In the buffet, vegetarian food was often mixed with the meat, often touching one another, spoon contamination between meat and vegetarian dishes and a lot of the veggie hot food had hidden animal fats. We raised our concerns with the Manager of the hotel who said she would make contact with the head chef and we would hear from them soon in order to make the necessary food arrangements. We didn't receive any communication. As a pregnant lady on holiday with my 2 year old son and husband, this was a far from relaxing holiday as food was always an issue at every meal time. 

When we booked the hotel we made a reservation for a travel cot and king size bed. We walked into our room after a long journey to Cancun to find two twin beds and no cot. After informing concierge we were told the beds and cots are never guaranteed even though that is what we paid for. We found concierge to be very rude and lack sympathy.  It put us in a very difficult position not having a cot for our son. 

We were really looking for a relaxing holiday before the birth of our 2nd child so it is a real shame that we had such a terrible experience. If you do ever visit this hotel, make sure you arrive at the restaurant at 6pm on the dot to receive a table otherwise you could risk waiting 1-2 hours for a table, not ideal for a family. 

On a positive note, the beach was beautiful and clean, and my son really enjoyed the evening entertainment in the hotel :)

reviews.author: Sharda R
reviews.title: Terrible service for a 5 star !!
reviews.text:
This resort is worst than a dumpster fire. At checkin the young lady who’s checking us in was on the phone the entire time which took over half hour ; my room number was in 3000 which I assume was on the 3 rd floor. On the way bell hop is explaining all the restaurants are in the lower level where I’ll be staying at first I did  not understood him so I asked him to repeat himself. Which he reiterated I’ll be in the basement; I stopped him and asks him to take me  back to the checkin since I paid for a king junior suite with a lagoon view.  The audacity of this check in attendant without asking or discussing where she was putting me to stay. When I got back to checkin another young lady was there; claimed she couldn’t give the room I booked. After going back and forth she became extremely rude referring to me as LADY keeping on telling me she cannot accommodate me meanwhile acting as if she’s doing me a favor by giving me any room.
Finally I asked for a manager she found a king junior suite lagoon view in the 3rd pyramid. On the way to the room elevator has no light, hallways are dimly lit  and felt quite unsafe. The new room was the biggest disappointment its stunk of cleaning solution, beyond outdated and old, outlets did not work and the balcony was disgustingly dirty. Spoke to the manager again at 7.00 pm we were finally accommodated in the first pyramid with double beds with a promise of a king room the next day. This room was an upgrade from the last one.  We went to get dinner at 8.00 pm none of the restaurants were accepting more guest for the evening so we dined at the subpar buffet.  During the evening the power went off we called the front desk we we were told we did not know how to use the light switches and someone would be up shortly to show up NO ONE EVER came or checked on us.  We were told the new room would be ready at 3.30 pm the next day; leave your bags in the old room and it will be moved. Our bags were never moved we had to do it our selves.  
At beach on a daily basis not enough chairs and umbrellas unless you were willing to fork out $220.00 per day. I will never go back to this resort neither will I ever recommend anyone to stay there. I absolutely hate this resort it’s my 8-9 time to Cancun and last last  stay at the paradisus Cancún.

reviews.author: GrandTour29272562748
reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text: I had terrible experience going here. I have travelled with my wife and 5 month old baby on our 5th anniversary. We have booked Nikte package and a room with King bed and crib for the baby. We got assigned a room with two separate single beds and no crib. I made multiple trips to the reception to get our room changed and get a crib in our room . I never got help and folks at reception were rude.

reviews.author: Shockerx3k
reviews.title: Racism is subtle but evident
reviews.text:
If you are black do not come here.  You will be treated as a second-class guest.   Racism is subtle.   Like placing in poor seating locations or putting in a basement suite.    Today I had to seat myself for breakfast and the waiter only arrived as I almost finished my meal.  I've observed Asian and Caucasian guests receive superior service which I found amusing as I usually always tip and they usually have not by my observations.    The only exception is the OUTSTANDING SERVICE I received at the moet bar by the beach.   Everywhere else it was subpar and racism was evident.    I sincerely regret booking this vacation and will not be returning.   The food is also not very good.  
I have found racism to rampant in Mexico.in general for African Americans, especially in Cancun.   The last time I was here via cruise ship I received similar treatment.    If you are African American i encourage you to spend you money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Clullo
reviews.title: So disappointing.
reviews.text: This is was our 2nd time staying at la paridisus, our 1st was in 2020 and it was a wonderful experience, this time, everything from the room to the food and service has completely gone downhill. Upon chechin we were given a room that was infested with bugs and the front door was so warped that the door wouldn't lock without slamming it hard. The maids left the door unlocked twice while we were out an that was after we brought the problem to managements attention and requested that they ensure they do whats necessary to ensure our door is locked while we were away. Thankfully none of our belongings went missing. For safety and health reasons, I requested a different room and was denied by the manager. These inconveniences wasted our entire 1st day then, we were subjected to having to deal with both problems our entire stay. Unacceptable. So disappointed.

reviews.author: Suryavarman
reviews.title: HORRIBLE! Please AVOID
reviews.text:
This hotel is one of the worst I have been to. I spend close to 50 days in a year vactaioning and I am a Top Contributor on Tripadvisor.

We made the terrible mistake of booking this hotel for 5 nights during the Christmas period and they literlly ruined everything about Christmas!

Rooms: 
- The hotel needs to refurbish every room. Hands down. We were multiple families and none of our rooms were good. And we paid $6400 for these horrible rooms.
- Broken doors, broken beds, shady curtains. I have seen hotels where flush does not work, and this hotel had that too. But to top it, it had a 24x7 leaking shower cable and they will not fix it. So we had a room with dripping water sound all the time.
- The ac vents were open and disgusting because they never cleaned.
- In our room we were a party of 2 adults and 2 kids and when we asked to change the room because of the problems, they offered us a king bed suggesting that 2 of us sleep on the floor.
- There was a locker in all the rooms but all of them were broken which meant we were unsure if our immigration docs will last.
- People would come randomly into the room as if its their room in the name of room service. But there was no service.
- To get water into the room, we had to make multiple phone calls.
- To get the bell boy to come to the room, we had to wait over 45 mins.
- We booked the room through jetblue travel and the hotel had the audacity to say that they have politics with jetblue so they cannot service as per what was agreed. We paid for a romantic couples dinner which we never got.

Food:
- Another horror story.
- This so called all inclusive restaurant has 5-6 restaurants. 
- The food has fancy names but the portions are the sizes of peanuts.
- Every restaurant had 40-50 mins wait. 
- Servers dont even look at you.
- If you are lucky that they saw ou and you ask the servers to get you same thing or anything for that matter, they throw tantrums. One server even said "how many time will you order the same"... 
- The only place where you can get food faster is the buffet. You get to wait for less time. Its not no-wait.
- The buffet food is basically whatever people do not eat in other restaruants deep fried.

Staff:
- I seriously want to know if this hotel pays the staff any salaries.
- The whole idea of going to an all-inclusive is to not carry wallets or any accessories and enjoy the surroundings. Here you got to carry your money.
- People only work if you tip them. And nothing comes for $1. 
- The guy at the pool bar asked me to pay for a can of pepsi.
- The breakfast buffet omlet lady only looks at you if you wave a $ bill at her. Otherwise no food for you.
- In the 5 days we were there, I spent close to $400 in tips.

Grounds:
- The hotel is small.
- Its only one building.
- The other building is a time share.
- In total its like 1.5 acres.
- I heard the private cab driver say that Moonpalace is a much nicer hotel with 20 acres of property, and nobody comes to paradisus because of how horrible it is.
- The beach is full of shell dust and even the cabanas on the beach are not free. I dont know whats included in the all-inclusive.
- Drinks in this all inclusive is 10% drink and 90% water. 

Spa:

- Sadly we ended up using the spa too and it was just more grimy rooms with super old equipment that were ready to fall apart.

Charges:
- Remmeber I said that the hotel has 5-6 restaurants. of the 5-6 retsaurants, 2 are not free. So how is this an all-inclusive restaurant?
- Charges for cabanas, charges for drinks, charges for everything expect the water fruit ice cream at the beginning.

Every employee at the hotel tries to run away from having to do their job. They just point you to the next person and walk away. They do not clean the rooms. They do not refill water or the bar in the room and when asked, they act as if they are doing us a favor.

This hotel has a time share and they treat everyone as if they are some beggars. 

If you want to pay top dollar and make your self feel like a beggar begging for food, this is the hotel for you.

This is as bad as it gets.

Even writing this review makes me feel so terrible that I had to put myself through this ordeal during Christmas.

Nobody even smiles at this hotel. Everyone is busy trying to make a quic buck in tips.

reviews.author: Karine T
reviews.title: Hôtel infesté de coquerelles
reviews.text: Coquerelles dans ma chambre et dans le lobby qui est entouré des restaurants. Nourriture du buffet le soir très passable, meme qualité que Cuba. Piscines très sales. Manque de chaises à la piscine et à la plage, il faut payer 250$ par jour pour tous les lits de plage ou de psicine qui sont vides. Vol retardé. Valise perdue. Les photos des chambres sur les sites ne correspondent pas du tout à celles aur place. Tres vieux et tout brise (pognées de porte, porte du balcon etc.. Hotel très désuet qui ne mérite pas ses 5 etoiles. Seuls points positifs sont : le personnel sur place viennent nous voir touts les 5 minutes pour les drink, la plage est superbe, lobby très beau, bon café et l'animation le.soir est bien.

reviews.author: Gwenn M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun has become a 2 star hotel in one years time!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun has gone down hill so fast in the past year, I would now give it a 2 star rating and that is being very generous. They have all these people pushing the “Circle” membership,(timeshare) it’s a joke, they are just looking for money. The electrical sockets are falling out of the walls, the AC works intermittently, shower leaks, and so on. They are now holding big convention groups and weddings. These events take the resort over, you can’t get into the restaurants on the property that are part of the “all inclusive package” that you pay for. No one lets you know when you book your vacation that these events will be going on while you are trying to enjoy your vacation. STAY AWAY from this property if you are looking for a pleasant vacation.

reviews.author: Rachel S
reviews.title: Sunglasses were stolen from our room
reviews.text: On the second last day of our holiday my sunglasses were stolen from our room. We had left the room to go for dinner and returned around two hours later, our room was cleaned while we were out and my sunglasses were gone when we returned. We reported the incident and were told we would be contacted within 48hours with a follow up, that was nearly a month ago. I have sent countless emails and the hotel has ghosted us.

reviews.author: tamhn2024
reviews.title: Poor staff training & management
reviews.text:
One of the worst customer service for a 5 star hotel. Check in front desk was rude & unprofessional. Staffs at blue agave just hanging around and talking while we brought it to their attention twice that we’d like to order. Waiter at Aqua Marina was nice but definitely couldn’t not handle a big party. He became rude & mean until we slipped him some cash so we can just get the dinner over with. This is my 4 times in Cancun & stayed at different 4/5 stars resort.  Paradisus is definitely a disappointment. Standards are low here. Rooms were dirty & missing things like hair dryer, iron, remote, towels. It baffles me that this is even a 5 star resorts if not for the beautiful lobby & location. 
Also they need to have more lounge chairs on the beach bc we didn’t even come on a busy weekend or anything. Most of the resort guests were laying on the sand bc there are not enough chairs

reviews.author: dpeff
reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: After visiting 6 years ago we were anxious to come back to the wonderful experience we had before. We loved the many choices of restaurants and good food. That has all been taken away. everything changed. we booked 5 rooms on 5 diff floors after asking to be together and promised to make note of it  Air conditioning broke in 3 rooms. sink and shower clogged in 2 rooms. Had wash clothes for only 3 nights out of 8. Pool staff were friendly and helpful We ended up eating outside resort most of the time after paying for all inclusive. very expensive and very disappointed. Found out on 3rd day we had an excursion included after spending $$ on the same type of outing. Staff is not helpful. Breakfast waiters were good. Rooms are very dated. Only people from the Reserve seem to have a good experiance

reviews.author: Carlos M
reviews.title: Terrible service from hotel staff
reviews.text:
The attention of the hotel employees is awful. At the buffet I had to ask twice for a spoon and none of the waiters brought it, and it was like that in all the meals. On the Ginger Bar the lady Nurvi refused to serve me the wine in glass even when I asked her to do so, she served it in plastic cups, and when I tried to get her name she refused to give it to me. There is a bad attitude towards the guests.
I tried to enter the Italian restaurant and the waitlist was 2 hours, and there were empty tables in the restaurant so I asked why they are not allowing peoplet to enter, and the answer was that they dont have capacity to serve all tables. So I went to the buffet and they had pizza in there, so I tried to grab some, but they told me that I cant take the pizza because they were intended for the Italian restaurant only (the one I couldn't enter before), that the pizza for the buffet was already over and they were not cooking anymore for the buffet. So I asked to the manager why I couldnt get pizza, and his answer was that if he give pizza to me then he will need to give pizza to everyone because everybody wanted pizza.
Sunbeds are never available in the pool area, and you need to wake up at 6 a.m. if you want to get one. 
So in summary, everybody has a bad attitude towards the hotel guests.

reviews.author: SdlT
reviews.title: PURE CHAOS
reviews.text: We had three Reserve Oceanview rooms over New Year's. The rooms were acceptable but the balcony is useless because the minute you sit down, the wall blocks your view of the beach entirely. Everything about this resort was pure CHAOS.  There are too many people and too few staff.  The hotel knows exactly how many people they have booked and there is no excuse for the understaffing and long waits for everything.  As a previous reviewer mentioned, there are lines for everything, long waits for food, lack of available reservations, lack of chairs, 3-hour wait for room service, etc.  The buffet is a nightmare and, on one night, they ran out of the main course at 9pm (this from a Spanish hotel chain).  On New Year’s Eve, they had the same fixed menu in all of the restaurants with only two entrée choices--duck and short rib.  It is nonsensical for a hotel that highlights their variety of restaurants to serve the exact same menu in all of them on the same evening with only two entrée choices.  The food choices, the lines, and the poor quality of the food made this trip miserable.  The chaotic, crowded environment is the farthest thing from relaxing or fun. And to top it all off, the staff was often rude and dismissive (when they weren’t soliciting tips).  This is not a top-tier hotel.

reviews.author: wnmansour
reviews.title: Would not recommend
reviews.text: Really bad experience, we stay in Mexico for New year every year. This was the worst hotel we've stayed at in the last 10 years. We stayed at a melia 11 years ago and we had the same bad experience. I am very disappointed it how the staff treated the guests

reviews.author: Silvia P
reviews.title: Invece che il Paradiso...l'inferno
reviews.text: Da utilizzatori abituali delle strutture Melia mai ci saremmo aspettati di pagare così tanto e ricevere così poco...la formula all inclusive andrebbe bandita, per lo meno per alcune categorie di hotel. A marzo eravamo stati al Me London Melia, che e' una meraviglia e un vero 5 stelle...nulla a che vedere!!!

reviews.author: Fabián M
reviews.title: Un desastre de atención
reviews.text:
El precio es muy alto para la calidad de servicio recibida. La insistencia en tomar una presentación para ser "socio Circle" es incomodo, no te dejan disfrutar las vacaciones tranquilo. Y en cuanto a la estancia las habitaciones son antiguas, con tomacorrientes que no funcionan, el wifi tiene señal débil. En la tarifa en línea no es cierto de que se incluyen todas las tasas e impuestos. A la llegada al hotel tienes que pagar otro impuesto. Las habitaciones de la piramide 3 son ruidosas a altas horas de la noche y madrugada.
Los restaurantes no están disponibles para todos los huespedes.

reviews.author: Susana A
reviews.title: THE WORST!! DO NOT WASTE YOUR VACATION TIME/MONEY!! PLEASE READ ENTIRELY BEFORE GOING AND VIEW MY PICS
reviews.text: I’ve been to Mexico 3 other times and this was my fourth time (second time in Cancun). Paradisius Cancún hotel was the absolute worst resort I stayed! For all the money we paid for this “all inclusive” this is the first time that we were charged if we wanted to eat at certain restaurants or have certain dishes. The food was TERRIBLE !! I’ve NEVER experienced anything more horrible. Room service was disgusting, the consistency of the steak was that of a “meat” I’ve never had before. It was as if I threw it on the floor, it’d bounce back it was so rubbery. The ceviche was nauseating because it looked and tasted like rotten fish guts.  The only food at the entire resort that was doable/eatable was their French fries and chicken nuggets. NONE of the food served was hot (even at the buffet). There was ONE restaurant that was good, which was the Lemon Fish, but good luck getting in there. The wait to that place is crazy but understandable since that’s the only place with decent food (still not served hot). Now for the rooms…I couldn’t wait to actually leave because they were so gross, dirty, and rusted !!!! I’ll let the video I post speak for itself on that aspect. The room had ONE outlet and one in the bathroom, that’s it! The outside and lobby of the resort is stunning though ! I wish they would upkeep the rooms as they do their lobby areas. The service was great (as they want a good tip so of course they were nice) some were genuinely nice but others forced it. The spa was great! The drinks all tasted watered down like crazy!! The mudslides were ok though. Mixed drinks and ALL THEIR JUICES tasted like 4:1 mix where 4 parts were water and 1 part possibly juice. DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY GOING HERE. I wish I had this review before booking. At check out, they tried to make me pay twice for a cake I paid for when it was charged to my room. I explained that and they tried to make me pay again or else  couldn’t check out. They called the manager because I told them if I see a double charge I will have my bank cancel one so they tried to force me to sign a paper that states I approve these transactions which I obviously refused to do and began recording because it was getting out of hand. To top it all off, one of their souvenir shops charge my brother US$120 for one dolphin stuffy which he gave them cash for and when he did not receive change, he asked them what is the conversion and they told him it’s 120 USD and not in pesos so he asked them to give him his money back right then and there and they refused and said he has to buy things up to that value if he did not want that one dolphin stuffy. Scammers! Again, I’ve stayed at other resorts and this was the worst! If this was my first experience in Mexico, I never would have come back, so I’m glad that this is only one out of the four places that I’ve been to that has been terrible.

reviews.author: Cléa C
reviews.title: Un faux 5 étoiles
reviews.text:
Personnel très froid, pas du tout accueillant, même pas de merci au revoir au Check out, tout simplement pas digne d’un resort 5 étoiles comme ils le prétendent.

Resto 1h30 d’attente alors que 5 restaurants dans le complexe
Ne change pas les sets de table entre deux clients : des morceaux de guacamole frais sur mon set pas nettoyé ??

Petit dej 20min pour être placé et 25min d’attente aux œufs qui sont mal cuits
Chambre vieille, sent la peinture, rideaux de douche et baignoire trop ancien, 2 serviettes pour 3 personnes, pas de peignoirs ni de chaussons

Trop de chambres pour la capacité de transat ou restauration : certains se retrouvent allongés dans le sable en payant 500€ une nuit c’est inadmissible
Correct mais ne mérite pas un 5 étoile ni son prix c’est du vol

Les français fuyez si vous aimez la bonne gastronomie

reviews.author: Annie C
reviews.title: Déçue , à fuir
reviews.text: Extrêmement déçue contrairement au Melia zanzibar, chambré vieillotte, 1h30 d attente pour les dîners, la queue même au petit déjeuner .Au Check out même pas demander si nous étions satisfaites du séjour , à peine un au revoir , une indifférence totale. Ne mérite pas un 5 étoiles , à fuir!!!!!

reviews.author: Navigate01309587737
reviews.title: Péssimo atendimento
reviews.text: Tivemos que comer no chão hoje a tarde.  Sem cadeiras para refeição. Sentamos onde estávamos e Comemos ao lado da piscina. No meio do caminho de transeuntes. Hotel com fila pra tudo. Pra café da manhã, para almoço, jantar. Tivemos que reclamar ao staff sobre a refeição que meu filho não conseguia de forma alguma uma vez que tem alguma restrição alimentar. Só reclamando muito se conseguia algo nesse hotel. Não recomendo e nem volto mais. 5 estrelas somente na fachada. Hotel muito bonito mesmo porém atendimento é péssimo. Parece que estão pouco se importando com hóspede. Aliás agora há pouco me serviram uma sobremesa e o garçom indicou que eu pegasse a que estava suja dentro do prato. Meu filho pequeno pegou a colher de sobrmenesa e jogou dentro do prato. O garçom nem ofereceu outra colher. Aliás ofereceu depois que me viu 10 minutos olhando para a sobremesa. Enfim. Não vale a pena se estressar.nem se hospedar aqui neste hotel.

reviews.author: Feioso
reviews.title: VERGONHOSO!!!
reviews.text:
Vergonhosa a postura desse hotel em muitos aspectos. O pior de todos é  não  disponibilizar  espreguiçadeira para os hóspedes. Ao invés  disso colocam cabanas e cobram por isso e acreditem, muito caro, tantona praia como em volta das piscinas!
Acreditem se quiser, o hóspede  tem que pagar para usar
 acomodações  de piscina mesmo estando dentro do hotel.
Na praia a situação é  ainda pior, sentar-se, apenas pagando ou sente-se direto  na areia se não puder pagar. Simplesmente vergonhoso!
Outro ponto muito questionável foi a alimentação, eles primam apenas pela quantidade e não pela qualidade, infelizmente eu e minha esposa pegamos uma infecção intestinal muito provavelmente pela falta de higiene no preparo dos alimentos, resultando três dias sem sair das acomodações e com terríveis cólicas mesmo tomando remédios. 
Sem contar filas intermináveis na entrada dos restaurantes, (café da manhã,  almoço e jantar) simplesmente ridículo,  vejam as fotos publicadas. 
Fiquei hospedado na torre 1 e os restaurantes ficam todos na torre 3, tinhamos que caminhar pelo menos 15 a 20 minutos para chegar, esse é um ponto super desconfortável para todos.

reviews.author: Jt
reviews.title: Never again, save your money and go somewhere else
reviews.text: Terrible hotel that is not up to standards on so many levels. Management even concurred with my complaints and this was a generous 2 star rating. The food is terrible and you spend the entire waiting on lines for restaurants starting at 6pm; the selections are poor (fast food level) and the buffet is a zoo 24-7.  The wait times run 1-1.5 hrs which is insane and they don't take reservations. The rooms are dirty and bathrooms need grouting and caulking; they are very outdated especially for the top beach front view (the best accommodations with the concierge service- which I didn't even comprehend (it doesn't exist). If you order room service expect 20 min delays even if you call the night ahead to pre order.The gym is so dirty and we workout 6 days at home as avid athletes. Upon arrival it looked like it was from the 1980's and super dusty with debris of sand and sweat(cleaning does not occur). Overall I warn you not to waste your money here bc you will get what you pay for and perhaps pick up COVID.

reviews.author: Val M
reviews.title: Don't come here if you expect to relax by the pool.
reviews.text:
Do not stay at this hotel. Came in a couple of days ago and have a few more. We stayed here 5 years ago and it was great. Now getting a spot by a pool is impossible - need to get up at 7am before people throw their stuff to reserve every bed . All cabanas are $220 per day.  So basically there's nowhere to stay at the beach or by the pool unless you get up before 7 or want to just throw some towels on the sand. Management is of no help - pool guy is really nice but there's not much he can do. 
Rooms are pretty beat up, hot food in buffet is cold half the time, wait time for restaurants can be well over an hour and they don't take reservations.
