Basically, if you really want to enjoy the stay, be ready to lay for an upgrade to whatever club program they have or keep paying for cabanas and other extras.

reviews.author: Nav A
reviews.title: Extremely poor room service , house keeping and unfriendly guest checkin staff.
reviews.text:
I’m here with my kids. Pretty much everything about this all inclusive resort makes me write this review.

We ordered room service.  I was told it will arrive in 60 minutes. It arrived in 90 minutes ( after 2 reminders). But more importantly, the food items were wrong, the food was cold and one of the worst chicken tenders and steak we’ve ever had.

I had to call 4 times  over  4 hours and ultimately show up physically at guest services  myself to get the hotel to provide the roll away bed they had told me they n every phone call that it’s coming now..

I called to get some towels  and was told will come soon and no one brought it even after I called 30 minutes later to remind them ( when I got the same response that they are on their way).

We were told that our room will not have the ocean view but will have the lagoon view. But there was neither of those.  The room was on the lowest floor in the corner of the ocean facing wing with big concrete wall next to it with zero view of anything besides the hotel building itself. 

I would strongly advise against staying at this hotel especially with kids / families. I had booked it especially so that room service will be strong. Rather everything is broken when it comes to delivering anything to the room or any housekeeping.

Avoid booking here.

reviews.author: Hotshotreview
reviews.title: Nice location dishonest service
reviews.text:
First I want to say that I never leave reviews but my experience here was so frustrating that I wanted to tell someone about it.

Initially when I booked this resort(we have stayed at many Meliá hotels in the past) I called immediately to ensure that my two nikte suites would be near one another. I was assured no problem I had put notes in your file it will be fine when you arrive.

Then when I arrive I am told I have to pay for another person since I only booked for 6(which was their error not mine, except I did not check prior to arrival) and they made me pay almost 50% my entire stay for just one person additional.

Then we get our rooms - 1 had no a/c, broken handles for shower and was barely large enough for our items and us. The other room was not stocked with chips, candies, nuts, drinks, bath robes, or slippers. And the rooms were not even on the same floor let alone close to each other.
So I spoke with my concierge who assured me it would be rectified tomorrow and to pack our things so they could move them to the new room.

The next day we were locked out of our room all day so they could move our things, which never happened so I spent 3 hours in the “guest services” area being passed around from supervisor to supervisor with not a single person actually trying to help the situation. I was told many lies about why they were unable to accommodate our family. When I pointed it out they just said… oh no that’s not what they meant. I still would like to speak to a supervisor that would take lying to guest as a serious concern. I was told that they are completely booked - however I was able to look online and see they still had many rooms available including a larger suite so I asked if they could just move us all to that larger suite which they told me no. I then offered to pay for the upgrade and finally got their attention.

The following day I was approached by my concierge to see if I liked the new room, which I had to pay for in order to solve my own problem. Which she sympathized with me but still offered no consideration for.

TLDR this hotel does not care about guests, problems with all 3 rooms we inhabited during our stay. Supervisors and managers will lie to get you out of their hair.

reviews.author: Neli
reviews.title: Nunca mais voltaria.
reviews.text:
A estrutura do hotel é  bonita, os quartos são  bons e grandes.
Um primeiro  e grande problema está  na distância  entre as torres do hotel, pois os restaurantes ficam todos no mesmo piso de uma das torres e nós  caminhávamos  15 minutos para  chegar até  eles.
O pior para nós  foi quanto a alimentação.  Existem uns 6 restaurantes aproximadamente, porém  isso é  apenas uma estratégia  de descentralizar os hóspedes de irem apenas a um.
Mas na realidade, quase tudo sai de uma mesma cozinha, com apresentação  de formas diferentes.
A quantidade de comida é  grande, mas a forma como é  servida deixa a desejar. As carnes quase  sempre duras. As  pizzas sempre frias e  ressecadas por tanto tempo paradas. 
Risoto todo grudado, fora do ponto.
As sobremesas sempre sem gosto de nada  variando apenas a cor da gordura  que usam para decolar.
As bebidas  são  mais ou menos.
Porém,  o ponto mais vergonhoso é quando queremos  uma cadeira na volta da piscina, pois nunca tem. As 8 horas da manhã, tudo está  ocupado e demarcado por toalhas  porém  sem nenhuma pessoa. 
As palapas da volta das piscinas vergonhosamente são  cobradas a parte com um custo bem salgado. Mas o pior são  as acomodações  da praia, porque ou você  paga ainda mais caro pra ocupar umas cabanas, ou senta na areia, pois o hotel não  disponibiliza cadeiras de praias. Ou seja, mesmo pagando muito bem,  o hotel ainda tenta esfolar o hóspede  por todos os lados. Outro ponto vergonhoso são  os funcionários  movidos a propina. Cancún  never more.

reviews.author: Suhas K
reviews.title: Manager who doesn’t care about customer safety
reviews.text: While the hotel and rooms are good, we had a terrible experience at Paradisus. In their Blue Agave restaurant, my kid bent down to pick up a towel behind our table when one of the curtains fell on my kid causing a safety issue. It was clearly shoddy work done at the restaurant. The manager came to us, accused my kid of walking all over it (mind you there was NO sign anywhere not to walk). The manager, Ulises threatened us with fines and insisted it’s the fault of whoever was near it. This person didn’t even apologize for the safety issue caused that could’ve hurt my kid. He clearly didn’t care about the safety of customers looking to put blame on them. I’ve been to many resorts around the world and no manager has ever treated customers like the way this person has done. My kids are now hesitant to walk near any walls for the fear something might fall down and be blamed for it. Beware of such managers who might ruin peace of mind and cause unnecessary stress

reviews.author: Nanynyoyo G
reviews.title: Pésimo Hotel. En especial el cuarto.
reviews.text: Pésima experiencia en un hotel 5 estrellas. Agarre el NITKE ocean view que segun es version luxury. Y nada luxury ni cercas d los otros hoteles alrededor. Sigo aquí y sin ayuda a los problemas que e reportado desde el día uno. El cuarto me lo encontré manchado del sillón y con la cortina rrota, reporte esto desde el primer día para no ser culpado de esto. El mini bar no enfría nada y todo esta caliente. El balcón no tiene sillas de balcón como los demás cuartos y según está haciendo todo lo posible en traérmelos. Ya es la tercera ves que reportó y nada. El aire acondicionado en la noche Nadamas tira aire pero no enfría . Según vendra alguien arreglarlo. No pido o quiero otro corto solo que me dejen un cuarto habitable para unas buenas vacaciones en familia. Pero ya perdí dos dias en algo que ni 2 estrellas es. El lavabo se tarda años en ir el agua. No es coraje pero si tristesa en pagar algo para la familia y no recibirlo.

reviews.author: Mohamed O
reviews.title: Do yourself a favor by staying somewhere else
reviews.text: Sadly, I do not recommend this hotel. They have many challenges & some of them are beyond imagination. 1- Food Taste: We tried all the restaurants that are part of the All Inclusive & 90% of them were way below average. I based myself on people reviews when choosing this resort but i am soo puzzled!!!!!!! people simply lost their taste buds, they also lost their sense of temperature cz all what we ate was cold so the concept of Temperature Danger Zone is surely absent. Service was one time good & one time bad. I need to mention that Beatriz, Jorge (Lemon Restaurant), Melvin & Camil were awesome. The worst places were Blue Agave & Aqua 2- Housekeeping has a very long way to go. 3- Maintenance has 2 long ways to go from rooms status & the sewage smell near Cielo. The only thing that was average was the Ice cream shop but was closed 4 days out of the 7 days we were there. 4- Hygiene level was surely the top of the pyramid. They were washing the glasses in a bucket with home soap & rinse it. I saw this horrifying practice one day before we left so it was toooooooo late. I stopped drinking & eating after that(((((((((((((( my wife was happy as i needed to loose weight but when you pay $5500 for something like that, I feel robbed & my money wasted in the drain(((((((((((. Note that even my daughter stopped eating last 2 days. Can u imagine that a 3 year old can tell bad quality while all these adults don't hahahahaha. There are many many things but I have no time & I am not here to give Melia free advice but they surely are NOT 5 Star or even 4 Star. I suggest you go elsewhere unless you have no issue in low hygiene level & you want to fill up your stomach. I feel bad for the money I saved the last 2 years to go to this vacation((((((((((((

reviews.author: Erick G
reviews.title: Pésima experiencia
reviews.text: Venden este hotel como experiencia de lujo y nada que ver el servicio fue pésimo me faltaron al respeto y me robaron, las peores vacaciones que he tenido, las habitaciones están en mal estado, te hacen comprar un paquete premium para bebidas internacionales y luego hay que darle dinero a los meseros para que te den lo que ofrecen en el paquete, la comida del restaurante mexicano (cielito lindo) el peor de todos, el otro restaurante Peruano se tardaron una hora para servir la comida, las toallas viejas, en resumen pésima experiencia.

reviews.author: SOLOMIYA G
reviews.title: Terrible service
reviews.text: If there was a way to give a negative review I would do that. To say that we are disappointed is an understatement. In April of 2023 we purchased two Nikte ocean view rooms for our family of 9 including 5 children and one was 9 months old. We have been to Paradisus many times and were excited to go again. When we arrived we were placed in rooms that were under construction. All throughout the day there were loud noises, banging, terrible smell of paint, spackle, and other construction things. After multiple complaints to Paradisus employees and telling them that we will never come back and will leave an honest review about our experience, Paradisus manager Rosanna contacted us. She asked us to give Paradisus a second chance and that she will provide complimentary upgrade for our next stay and will move us to another room further from the construction area. We were moved to a different room where there was still loud noises throughout our whole stay, to say that our baby was not comfortable and not able to rest is also an understatement. After a few days a manger made contact with us and provided a certificate of upgrade for our next stay. They told us to make a reservation and email the reservations and it will be upgraded because of the inconvenience we had. We didn't intend to go back to Paradisus at all but because management was trying to make it right. We made a reservation for December 15-23 and emailed the manager that provided the certificate, after she didn't answer we emailed a different person. After booking our reservation I started to receive "upgrade your experience to the Nikte suite" solicitations from a Daniel Feliciano so I decided to reply to him. I replied to that email and attached the certificate to Daniel and he stated that there are no rooms available for upgrade. So he sent us an email stating we can upgrade and when I reached out and provided the certificate all of a sudden there are no rooms available. This is very upsetting as we were already getting prepared to go and the kids were excited to see their favorite resort. We have been going to Paradisus from 2016. The construction was not only bad because of smell and loud noises but it was very dangerous as it was not properly guarded and kids easily could walk into the construction area and even possibly fall of the balcony. If I was able to attach video you would be able to see and hear the loud noises and what a mess that contraction was. Terrible experience.

reviews.author: Kay R
reviews.title: Not an all inclusive. Disappointed.
reviews.text:
Very disappointing.  The entire experience from check in to check out was full of 'misunderstandings' as the staff phrased it. We paid for the highest level and that still wasn't 'all inclusive'. We booked a Ocean View Suite and it wasn't ocean view and then were charged more because they had a 'misunderstanding' during the booking process. We made reservations for cabanas and there was a 'misunderstanding' so we were moved from the one we were set up at to a less desirable one. We made a reservation at the Premier steak house thinking it was all included only to get there and be told seafood or Premier cut steaks were extra... keep in mind we had the highest level of stay. Which means no one really has all inclusive. In our room, the refrigerator was broken, the sink didn't drain well and the shower was broken. They fixed the sink and shower. 
The mini bar was beer and pop... no alcohol. Room service was a ridiculous small menu and not worth our time. 
The grounds are beautiful!!! The pool is great! 
We met 3 other couples and they all felt the same way .... this is the only 'all inclusive' resort that nickle and dimed the guests at every turn.
I would never recommend it to any one. Sorry.

reviews.author: oscarX252DR
reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: There is no maintenance in the hotel, quality control is non existent. Lost time calling to clean the room, fix jacuzzi, doing refill of bar. Restaurant food & beverage quality is poor compared to last visit

reviews.author: David E
reviews.title: Before next all inclusive experience... read this
reviews.text:
My first All inclusive expereince in life started and finished in Cancun. I never understand how people can be like that. eating all at the same time like is not life after the last meal, or like they are in war against healthy style of life. Off course bad quality of food is less expensive then the maths are in place here with the concept of "All Inclusive"
I know only one thing after my first experience here, it was the last oen. Thank you!!

reviews.author: mogginsKent
reviews.title: Worst food ever experience.
reviews.text:
Stayed her for 10 nights in the reserve but standard ocean front room. Room is very tired but bed is very comfortable.
The main problem with the hotel was the food. The worst menus ever. Travelled to at least 30 caribbean/Mexican resorts and have always had nice evening meals. NOT 1 restaurant had nice food. Most nights we just went to bed around 7 to avoid going to dinner. On 3 occasions in the buffet restaurant hairs were found in the food not on top.  Nothing seemed to match. If they did meat, which was not good, there was nothing to match it up with. Potatoes were never cooked just hard and full of salt. Carrots covered in pepper. Pizza was like biting into cardboard. Had Jerk chicken in one restaurant sauce was terrible tasted of liquorice. Having been to Jamaica 11 times never tasted jerk like it before.  Breakfast at the reserve restaurant would take over an hour and they only got the order correct once. Every dessert looked nice but tasted of nothing.  If  you were vegetarian you have no chance here. I ordered an omelette with onion, and tomato. It was cooked in a long line of egg mix with 3 other peoples omelette. As a result ended up with the smallest omelette ever with bacon after waiting in line 20 mins. Just gave up. 
Went to the spa- OMG what a dirty grotty place. I stayed 5 mins and left. A spa should be relaxing and luxurious. The wood on the floor was filthy, hand rail into the pool was broken. Was given a chair to sit on and the wheel feel off. The place needs to be gutted.
Went to the sports bar to watch football/soccer. Asked the barman to change the channel only to be told he doesn't have the remote its else where, waited ages for the person to come in but during the 90 mins it was turned over about 20 times.
All in all a very badly run hotel.  Only positive most staff were very friendly and drinks were good .  Drink service around the reserve pool was very good. Osca,and Caesar very good.

reviews.author: Carly
reviews.title: An old dirty hotel
reviews.text:
We arrived with high hopes (group of 9 adults 3 kids)- Upon arrival a staff member was very dismissive. My sister had 2 rooms (one for her and husband, one for her older children). Staff told her that their family would be separated into two different towers! She had to fight to be in the same tower.

Check in was 3pm. When me and another travel member arrived at our rooms at 4pm the rooms were DIRTY WITH THE PRIOR GUESTS FILTH!. Disgusting. Was told that they haven’t cleaned the rooms yet. Completely unacceptable.

If you are coming with young kids, the hotel is NOT stroller accessible. You have to walk down 2 flights of stairs to get from the pool to beach, no ramp. Also, the towers only connect from one level so if you are trying to get - for example - from the spa (im tower 1) to a restaurant (in tower 2) you have to climb up the stairs then down another flight of stairs. I have never climbed so many stairs in my life. there is zero continuity in the hotel, everything is far away from everything else.

We did not get the upgraded rooms and assumed this meant we would lack certain amenities such as butler service etc. I was wrong. The rooms were disgusting, mold in the shower. ZERO toiletries or amenities in the room. No turn down service (what kind of luxury hotel does not have turn down service??)

 I called for our room to get cleaned because they never serviced it during the daytime, to have my calls be ignored. I had to walk all the way to front desk to request this which was a major inconvenience.

We encountered quite a few rude staff members which I have never experienced on vacation. My family usually goes to Breathless Resort where everything and everyone is pristine and top notch.

I will admit the food was very good and the ice cream bar was phenomenal 

Martín at breakfast buffet was great

The reserve section is in another tower, which we walked by and looked very clean and well
kept

reviews.author: P R
reviews.title: Don’t waste your time or money!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have been to Cancun many times but this was my 11 year old daughter’s first time. We picked Paradisus because of the location and the amount of restaurants that were going to be provided. Before we left, we had heard about how there was music that’s played for hours every night and building three was not the place to be. My husband called ahead of time, a week, and told them that we do not want to be in building three and we wanted a higher level to where we would not be disturbed by the music. When we got to the resort, they put us in building three and on level four right smack in the middle of all the loud music. My husband talked to the front desk and the manager on two separate days but still were given the same excuse that the hotel was sold out and there was no rooms. Yet the front desk was always busy with new coming families. So that told us that the resort was not indeed sold out. Bad service!

Then, if you want to enjoy the pool or the beach and have a lounge chair, you have to get out there by at least 6 o’clock in the morning to get one. As my daughter and I went out in the morning at 8 o’clock everything was already taken, but the thing was there was no people sitting on the loungers. There was just towels covered that people reserved for when they decided to go out. One day I asked the worker if there were any extra chairs anywhere that he could bring out since some of the Palapas did not have chairs underneath them and he basically laughed in my face. My daughter could not believe he did that. My husband did go to the guest services and someone came and brought us some chairs, but one of them was broken. So we had to drag ourselves out of bed at 6 o’clock in the morning so we could put a towel on a chair and then we went back to bed. I think the most frustrating is that some chairs had towels on them for more than half the day before any people arrived. It is not fair for families that want to stay at the resort and enjoy the ocean and the pool while other people reserve their areas with towels, go on excursions, eat lunch and then come to party at the pool or the ocean. I was at this resort for a whole week, and was only given drinks once while at the beach and the pool. I had to always go get my own drinks from the bar. I even put in an order a few times and my stuff never came. Yet other families that unfortunately had lighter skin than me received better service because we watched them getting drinks the whole time. Bad service!

Next, the restaurants only catered to families that had more than four people in them. For example, we were in line 2nd in line for the buffet on Thanksgiving day, and a worker came over and we asked if we could sit outside and he said yes yes the lady behind us said we want to sit outside too, but we have six people. He told the lady and us to follow him which we did. He sat the people of six and then he told us to get in line again and tell the hostess we wanted to sit outside and we had to get really mean with him and tell him that he told us to follow him. Finally he found a table that was for two people and he squeezed in another chair for us so we could sit outside. Bad service again!

Our TV went out on Thanksgiving day, which is a big deal to have a TV because we like to watch American football. My husband called at 8 o’clock and let them know the TV was not working two hours later as we’re still waiting for the TV to be fixed, my husband went down to guest services and was told that the manager was not available because he was off and no one could help but they would send somebody again to look at the TV. My husband called a third time and told them we were still waiting for someone to come and fix the TV. No one came at all that day. My husband and I had to mess around with the TV, trying to find any kind of reset button and we finally got it to work after a whole day. No one still never came to look at the TV we didn’t get an apology. We didn’t get any support from guest services. Bad service again!

If you have kids and want to play pool or foosball good luck because the whole week we stood there for hours waiting and huge families use them over and over and did not let others enjoy but only having one of each was absolutely ridiculous for the large resort. 

One afternoon we decided to go to the restaurant that’s by the pool and we saw other people in there with their swimsuits so my daughter and I walked in with our towels around us. The guy told us we needed to be dry. We told him we were dry but I still went ahead and put my cover on but my daughter had the towel around her like a dress. He then told me that I needed to have a cover for my daughter and I told him why would she need a cover when there is a lady sitting down there in her 20s with a bikini on. He looked at the lady and said oh because she has shorts on which if you looked at her did not even look like she had shorts on. Absolutely ridiculous that you let a young lady with her breast hanging out at lunch and my 11-year-old who’s wearing a one piece that does not show any cleavage but yet we were asked to cover up. If there is a dress code and no swimsuits are allowed, then it needs to be stated with a sign and it needs to be for everyone. Bad service!

The only positives we had was Rodrigo, who is at the taco bar outside by the pool, always had an amazing smile, and made delicious tacos for us every day. Then Moses, who was our waiter in the restaurant Cielo, he made sure we really understood the menu when we asked questions he even made some adjustments so my daughter would have something to enjoy eating and it was delicious food. Finally, I did not get her name Unfortunately she is new to the resort she told us it was her second day she was working at the blueagave restaurant. She was so nice and had a smile on her face and welcomed us to the restaurant. 

This is by no means a 4.5 star hotel. The food is mediocre no changes daily for the buffet. The suites were not suites, they were regular size rooms. I will say the ocean views were stunning, but it’s not the room that makes that it’s the Caribbean Sea.

We made the most of our vacation and we had a great time being together as a family swimming in the ocean, eating together, enjoying the scenery in the hotel but we catered to ourselves. We will definitely go back to Cancun, but we will never stay at the Paradisus or a Melia resort. The only thing that could make this trip the best trip ever is if I were to get my money back.

reviews.author: bhuvanviswan
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I spent a lot of money to get to this resort! Resort amenities are good but service is horrible. I upgraded my self from lagoon view to nikte junior suite by paying good extra money but service is terrible. AC water dripping and flooded the floor, did not tidy up the room daily, did not give the towels daily I need to ask multiple times. Last day I asked for 4 towels from morning 6 am I called up to guest services 3 times but they said some one will come someone will come but no one showed up finally we all came back home by not showered the last day! Malva service is sucks. I spent $300 in tops with $1 and $5 usd bills they don’t serve coffee and milk we had to go and take water ourselves many times. Is this what we get for so much we paid and defective room flooded woth water, mini bar not working regularly had to call to fix so many times and tidy up room and bath towels and requesting coffee with tipping bills over bills is it too much to ask? So disappointed. Lili is so passionate and very assertive to help but sadly things fell apart one by one, no one helps without seeing the tips and malva folks don’t help even after taking tips. They don’t even re-fill drinking water

reviews.author: sierrarose4
reviews.title: Vacationers Beware!
reviews.text:
Stayed at Paradisus Cancun at the beginning of November (11/1-11/6). 

Upon arrival, we were greeted with such great service and attentive staff. The lobby was truly awe-inspiring with the greenhouse dome appearance and all of the greenery. In reality, it was all smoke & mirrors. 

We arrive to our "Junior Suite Ocean View" room and immediately knew something was wrong. The room didn't match what was advertised online whatsoever. In fact, there was a connecting door which led to living room that did not belong to our suite. It appeared that we had a bedroom belonging to a 2-Bedroom Master Suite. We went back to check-in to see if it was a mistake. Especially since our parents seemed to have received the correct room (later found out they were "upgraded" to a Master Suite despite their room matching a Junior Suite description.) We overheard two other couples facing similar issues - each were assigned a room that they did not book online. This was an immediate red flag so we asked to speak to a manager. 

Jonathan, Manager of the Front Desk, sits down with us and explains that the resort is fully booked and there is nothing they can do for us. We explain our frustrations. Jonathan's attitude was rude and dismissive - does not have a care in the world cause "there is nothing he or anyone above him can do to help us." His exact words. We left extremely frustrated. I ended up emailing customer service. Sure enough, someone reaches out that they want to help. They explained that the room we booked was not a mistake, they just haven't updated photos online...the most they could do was provide Reserve wristbands so we could indulge in their amenities, but we could not switch our rooms to Reserve since it was closed for renovations. It felt like slapping a bandaid on a much larger issue. The entire resort needs renovations. A lot of water damage throughout the hallways, old elevator systems, outdated room accommodations, etc. This is NOT a 5-star resort. 

Besides the room fiasco, we did truly enjoy the food at each restaurant. Drinks were great. The beach was absolutely beautiful. Most of the staff went above and beyond to create a memorable experience. Entertainment each night was great, especially for Day of the Dead. 

I would recommend this resort for anyone looking for a "deal" on a "5-star" resort but doesn't care much for luxury amenities. Or ocean views since most room's view seems to obstructed with plants - haha. It was truly disappointing because after so much research, I wish we would've splurged on Nizuc, Xcaret, or Excellence. Lesson learned.

reviews.author: Que T
reviews.title: Avoid this place at all costs
reviews.text:
The resort was ok - the food is mediocre and none of the restaurants opened/closed at the time that they advertised on their brochures. I paid extra for upgrading my room to The Reserve section which was advertised as the adult-only section. I'm a light sleeper so I did the room upgrade to be in a section without kids to minimize the noise. Based on the map that I was provided at check-in, the Reserve section is shown to be in Tower 5 but I was placed in Tower 3. As the stay went on, I heard screaming children in the rooms next door so it seems that I was not given the room that I paid extra for - this was the first red flag.

The experience that soured my trip was by the front desk staff and the resort's business practices - I felt like I might have gotten scammed. The front desk staff were terrible. The resort seems very dishonest as well - most hotels would automatically provide guests with their folios at check-outs, but this resort did not do so until it was asked. When checking out, I asked for a copy of my folio. The front desk staff replied "Folio for what?" - it's strange for a front desk agent to ask such a question as he was responsible for guest check-ins and check-outs...When he finally provided me with the folio, I noted that I was overcharged for the stay (this was probably why the resort was reluctant to provide folios to guests). I asked for a refund and the front desk staff refused to help. He dismissed my concern and told me that this is how the folio is supposed to look without any further explanation. Since I had to catch my flight, I did not have time to speak to a supervisor. Once I got home, I even re-checked my original booking multiple times and confirmed that I was indeed overcharged. I tried to contact the property regarding my overpayment and no one replied to my messages. When I first booked my reservation, the resort was very responsive regarding buying upgrades, etc. Now that they got my money, they ignored me. As of today, I still have not heard back from them regarding this issue. It's incredibly disturbing and unprofessional - I will not be returning and will not recommend this resort to anyone else. Stay away at all costs.

reviews.author: Flyer65770523664
reviews.title: Horrible Old Resort
reviews.text:
The overall experience was horrible and I’m not sure where to begin, but i guess we can start with the room.. first they put my wife and I and two kids in a room with a single bed, after we made them aware that it’s 4 of us and one bed (they should have seen and known this at the check in) they put us in another room. The 2nd room that we were placed in didn’t have a table or chairs on the balcony. It took 4 calls, 3 front desk visits and 3 full days for them to bring us 2 chairs… we never received a table, so we ate our room service on our beds. One day when it rained , we literally had water dripping in the hotel by the slide door. Several over the lights in the room were burn out and they brought us 2 remote controls before getting us one that worked. The shampoo/body wash holder fell on the first day and it was never replaced. I’m the shower, the hot and cold were opposites so if you wanted hot water you have to turn it to cold. Yes, this is a minor thing but for a 5 star hotel you would expect better. Also, the pain in our room and all around the resort is peeling. The resort is old and in need of major renovations. The food gross and you did not have much of a variety. My wife found a long piece of hair in the potato’s that they had at the Buffett and all the cook did was pulled it out and let people continue to eat. Several days that we were there it rained… the resort does not have much entertainment so if it rains you are SOL. Also, our room was on the lagoon side, if you are a light sleeper or have small children DO NOT stay in a room in the lagoon side. There is an outdoor club across the street that house music blasting until 5AM.. it literally felt like a club in our room. 

We travel a lot and have been to man resorts in Mexico and the Caribbean and this by far is the worst(hotel,food,entertainment ), least accommodating resort we have been to. I highly suggest going to Hyatt Ziva instead.

reviews.author: Yadira R
reviews.title: Super mal sus habitaciones
reviews.text:
Tuvimos nuestra boda este pasado  21 de Octubre. 
La mayoría de nuestros invitados (casi 125 invitados) tuvieron problemas con sus habitaciones,desde climas sin funcionar, ( en su mayoria no dieron opciones de cambio de habitación  solo decian que lo revisarian y pasaron 3 dias y nada), humedad en habitaciones,regaderas en malas condiciones,cucarachas., un invitado tenía que poner su medicamento en refrigerador y su frigobar no funcionaba y no pudieron llevarle uno, tenia que ir al cuarto de otro invitado a guardarlo y esa persona tenia problemas con sus rodillas asi que se imaginaran como la pasó ,la verdad nos dio mucha pena por que por nuestra boda se hospedaron ahí, sabemos que nuestros familiares no querían  molestar con sus malos ratos ya que era un dia especial  pero la verdad  muy muy mal y triste saber todo esto.
 El hotel es bello en diseño y su naturaleza pero lo que respecta  a sus habitaciones la verdad  deja mucho que desear.
su comida promedio al igual que sus bebidas. No un hotel de 4 diamantes como se promocionan.

reviews.author: Getaway60142481829
reviews.title: Melia Scam at Paradisus
reviews.text: Ok place but our trip ended on a low note. We were hope the we could stay again with this Company. Sadly we will never trust them again. They push the Melia Circle and it is a scam. Fortunately we checked before agreeing to join and waste thousands. The scammers at the Melia Circle suck you in along with hotel staff. They even followed my wife to the restroom. They say leave the room and you will not get a great deal. Fortunately we didn’t have our IDs with us and had to return to our room. A quick check on reviews at several site revealed the the Melia Circle is a rip off. Don’t visit hotels of the Melia a company the support scams.

reviews.author: Chirag B
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE - DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY
reviews.text: If I can give negative stars, I would have done so for this resort. Service was horrible, the food was not up to par. Our entire room got flooded with water due to rain and throughout the resort, there were water leaks from roof. In check-in area, they kept water buckets to collect water! Don't waste your vacation time in this resort. It felt like the employees were trained to say "NO" to everything. Lot of the restaurants were not even open. Drinks were all sugary, no alcohol at all in them. We paid for NIKTE and it was absolute rip off! There was no premium alcohol whatsoever. Breakfast has only 1 restaurant option and the menu is the same. There was 1 bread that was not changed/touched for our entire stay! For this price you can find something better!

reviews.author: Eduardo A
reviews.title: Disappointing. Will not return to ANY Melia resort.
reviews.text:
I would not recommend this resort.
1- Rooms: I was changed 3 times - AC not working, roaches in the room and finally the last 2 days in one room where only one shower had hot water.
2- Food: Unimpressive. there are no real lunch options if you don't like to eat at the buffet, which is crowded and unclean. They also seem to change/close restaurants for dinner without much warning to their guest. Not a lot of choices to eat as advertised.
3- Staff was ok, but please stop trying to upsell their membership !. we could not step out of our room without someone trying to soliciting us to attend one our their sales pitches. it is annoying and sours the entire vacation.
As a final thought, this resort is old and need basic updating like better AC, more choices in restaurants and better trained restaurant staff.

reviews.author: anir1004
reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: Worst experience ever. Staff was rude, unprofessional and not at all friendly. Very bad good options and no vegetarian options at all. This resort has zero entertainment options and worst quality of service

reviews.author: FERNANDA R
reviews.title: PESIMO SERVICIO Y ACTITUD DEL PERSONAL
reviews.text:
Hola buenas tardes,

Queria compartir mi experiencia y la verdad es que no fue nada buena:

- Actitud de los meseros y concierge es muy mala. 
- Recibieron un grupo grande y no puede ser que no se prepararon con los insumos suficientes, en todos los centros de consumo de lo que ofrecian en la carta no tenian, si pediamos ciertos platillos su respuesta era "uy no de ese no tenemos" hasta agua del dia decia que no tenian. 
- En el bar del piso 1 solicitamos botana (cacahuates, ya que en su mayoria de los bares ponen y al ser un hotel todo incluido suponiamos que tenian) 
y la respuesta de los meseros y bartenders fue de "uy no aqui no manejamos cacahuates a veces tomamos de un cuarto la botana que sobran de los que ponen en las habitaciones) que respuesta es esa? 
Minutos despues cuando dimos $100 pesos de propina, pudieron conseguir botana y nos la llevaron. 
- No hay buena comunicaciòn entre el personal, nos daban mal los horarios de los centros de consumo, decian que el  ultimo sitting era 10:30 y ya que llegabas al restaurante te decian que no, que era 10:00 pm 

No se si los empleados no se sienten motivados por sus jefes pero si les encargo que mejoren el servicio, me sorprendio bastante la actitud negativa del personal siendo un hotel en Cancùn.

reviews.author: María luisa
reviews.title: Estado hotel pesimo
reviews.text: Llegue al hotel el dia 4/09/23 las habitaciones son antiguas, el aire acondicionado muchisimo ruido, olor a antiguo en el hotel a humedad, en los restaurantes no te dan agua mineral te dan agua natural.Los meseros son pésimos , los vasos de todas las instalaciones son de vasos reciclados , los lavan en los fregaderos muy sucios sin pasar por lavavajillas, los cogen del suelo del día anterior y los pasan un poco por el grifo y te sirven en ellos , no volveré a ningún melia

reviews.author: saulmontes92
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We unfortunately had a bad experience for our 7th wedding anniversary, staying at this place and we hope you don’t. If you want to get back to your hotel and sweat more than you did outside this is the place for you. Uncomfortable to say the least. If you have any interest in food, run away as far as possible. We saw live roaches at two of there restaurants crawling over the food.

reviews.author: Mike S
reviews.title: Rapist/Abducter inside Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
********TRAVELERS BE AWARE*********
By far the worst hotel experience I've ever had. We had a party of 20 people that stayed here at Paradisus Cancun by Melia. On our night of the stay my wife was followed to our room as she was walking alone by a unknown individual. This predator waited until my wife went into the room and he starts forcing himself in through the door. He kept knocking and slamming on the door. My wife was screaming at him from the other side that this is not your room and you need to leave. He didn't care and this kept going for another 5 minutes as she was on the phone with me. I told her to call the front desk to tell them to send security to the room immediately. As she was on her cell phone with me as well as the front desk from the room phone I could hear the suspect banging on the door and speaking in Spanish. I took off running at this point towards the room from the gazebo location with my brother as well. 

We get to the forth floor several minutes after and the predator is still outside the door room 4410 I start yelling at him and he was not worried at all. My brother does the same and at this point he takes out his long key that looked like a knife and is flexing it towards my brother's face. At this point I put the suspect in a choke hold and slammed him to the ground. No security was there no manager was there no one to help my wife besides myself my brother and my sister in-law who ran for several minutes from outside the hotel to the 4th floor. The manager that arrived 15 minutes later his name is Jose Maday Molina who approached us as with a nasty attitude asking us with an authority why is this guy on the ground raising his voice towards me. As I was beyond furious with anger and beyond belief disappointed with the entire hotel staff after what we had gone through. No police were called by the hotel security or the manager. I'm fact my brother had to call the police on his own. The hotel failed us the Entire staff failed us the security failed us and were completely useless. I will report this place to the American Embassy in Mexico since none of the managers have even apologized to any of us. This place needs to be shut down. Do not take your family here. Please please stay away from Paradisus Cancun, don't be fooled by the name.

reviews.author: Linda Aitken
reviews.title: DO NOT GO HERE! 2 x couples we have been in 8 rooms in 11 days! Building work ongoing. Drainage in room 1 and 2 stinking
reviews.text: £11,000 for a holiday from hell. No working shower, 3 nights of water coming thru ceiling, we changed rooms 4 times, only got decent room by paying $600. And now the hotel is lying about it disgusted. Building work on top floor of atrium, just covered with tarpaulin,  dust and bits of plaster falling everywhere. We witnessed, men in the full main swimming pool, underwater chiselling out the grout, then sweeping the bottom of the pool. Pool was never emptied and children were back playing in it the next day, with large sharp pieces of cement still on floor of pool. Sat in main sports bar and a piece of plaster fell from the ceiling and hit me. It Was immediately filled with plaster and painted over. I have travelled the world and never seen such lack of care, service or safety from a hotel.

reviews.author: dawn g
reviews.title: Horrible stay away far away!!!
reviews.text: The worst experience from the moment we checked in.  I’ve been at this hotel when it was the gran Meliá and they should’ve stayed that way because this hotel isn’t worth $100. We stayed in the reserve section, it was a ghost town away from civilization! No swim up bar the bar by the pool closed at 4 while all the other ones are open smh.  We booked two rooms next to each other. We got one room on one floor and the other room on another level. They said they couldn’t give us rooms together because they were booked and there was literally nobody there. We had no air conditioning and our refrigerator didn’t work so we had to move the next day to another room and what a coincidence The room was next to our friends room, where we wanted to be the night before when we checked in. The elevators wasn’t  working. we requested The room to be decorated for my friend’s birthday it never happened. We were supposed to have bottles of champagne in our rooms. Nothing we requested double beds we got a king size bed  The breakfast was horrible. Everything was soggy and cold.  Alcohol drinks were watered down. We had to walk, literally half mile to get to any restaurants in the hotel, or to see a human being. The only good thing about our stay, was our concierge Jose.  I talked with upper management Aaron and told him all of our concerns. I never heard from him after the first night of our stay I’m sure it went in one ear and out the other the hotel looks like it’s going under. The staff is overworked they don’t clean the beach anymore so you can’t see white sand it’s covered with seaweed. The entertainment is a joke! Save your money and go someplace else! Horrible experience and waste of money!!!

reviews.author: mark t
reviews.title: Good setup, poor execution
reviews.text:
Good setup, poor execution 
I think if you’re booking this resort without the adults only reserve upgrade option you should look elsewhere. We came here with kids and like the title says good idea horrible execution. From the start the main lobby and building has no AC. I’ve been to resorts that have no AC in the semi outdoor hallways but this is beyond since most of the restaurants and activities are in the lobby, main big building. Then we got to our room, the rooms haven’t been updated since they build the resort, provably from the 90s(except the adults only reserve section so we told by concierge). Everything falling apart, we had to switch rooms because like other reviews said AC was barely working. I had to go back and talk to the supervisor 3 times before I got a new room 4 hours later. 

Outside there is no system for towels or keycards, so everyone picks up a towel leaves them on the chairs and leaves, and you’re stuck wondering if they are taken or the person just left. If you’re not there at 6am you will have no place sit or lay for the rest of the day and there is no incentive for people to grab their towels when they done with the pool so you have no idea if the chairs are still take or not even at 4 pm. Other resorts manage this better either having enough chairs to accommodate their guests or towel cards so when you leave you have to return them.  

 The pool water wasn’t filtered well either. The second biggest weird issue is buffet, there are 5 large buildings and the hotel was packed and they have only 1 guy cooking pasta station and 1 guy cooking hibachi, 1. So I was stuck in line to get a plate for 30 mins, other open buffet choices weren’t that great either, 1 or 2 hot stations. Buffet also had a line to get seated, I’ve never waited this long for a buffet meal in an all inclusive. Especially with kids you don’t have patients or time to be waiting to get seated, also they don’t have a reservation system for restaurants so you end up getting a 40-90 min wait to come back to try one of the other places. Completely mismanaged, when they tell you it’s an hour and half wait they tell you you have to stay here with your full party! You cannot put your name down and come back. We came back to the Italian rest at 9:30 and saw a bunch of tables available the host told us it’s too late even though they close at 10 pm. We went up to guest services they gave some bs excuse and weren’t helpful at all. 

Also constantly harassed by their sales people always trying to “give you a free coupon” or some bs, even calling our room at 8 am! 

 Overall I would not recommend, especially if you’re going with kids. There are much better resorts which are more updated and more organized and have better service for the same price!

reviews.author: Ali G
reviews.title: Avoid this scam! Terrible food
reviews.text:
We booked this trip for our honeymoon and it was the most disappointing experience. We booked a junior suite and it was a mediocre hotel room that wasn’t that nice and smelled of mildew. The staff was hit and miss. Some were pleasant and others looked miserable to be there. 

The food was absolutely terrible and the wait times were incredibly long with no way to make a reservation. We were told this was adults only but it was only the building we were staying in. If we wanted to go to food or any activities, it was mostly families. 

There wasn’t very many chairs to sit in around the pool unless you made a reservation for a cabana. But you could only reserve a cabana two of the days that you were there. 

They tried to sell us a timeshare which was infuriating. We booked a excursion through Odium, and they never showed up to take us on our excursion. It has been over a month, and despite the ongoing communication with the hotel, we have still not received our $300 back. 

It would have been cheaper for us to book a regular hotel and drink and eat all we wanted. And the food would have been better. 

Never coming back to a Melia resort again.

reviews.author: carlos h
reviews.title: MUY MALO
reviews.text:
Dicen qué hay diversión pero no es así, es bastante aburrido, después de las 9 pm si vas en familia no hay nada que hacer, yo llegue con dos adolescentes de casi 17 años y nos sacaron del único lugar donde hay un futbolito y una mesa de billar (para un hotel de este tamaño es un ridiculo), entonces cuál es la diversión si vas en familia? 
Cuidado si llegas antes, te dicen primero que la habitación te la dan a las 3 pm, cuando llegas al counter a esa hora te dicen que es a partir de las 3 pm y que debes seguir esperando…
Las camas de la playa te las cobran a casi 300 USD … Ya Que debes consumir con vino, langosta y camarones para usarlas…
Dos de los restaurantes no están incluidos…
En algunos rest hay platillos que si los pides debes pagar adicional…
El AC de la Habitación casi no enfría y hace mucha bulla, no descansas bien…
Las máquinas de hielo no sirven… tienes recipiente para hielo en la habitación, pero no te sirve de nada ya que las máquinas no funcionan… increíble …
Muy lamentable … llegue apenas hoy y ya me quiero ir, lamentablemente me tengo que quedar la estancia completa porque ya la pague… para nunca más volver a este hotel …
Tengan cuidado y no se dejen engañar, es un todo incluido que no incluye ni lo básico … MUY MAL …

reviews.author: Katrina M
reviews.title: Be forewarned! $$$
reviews.text:
1. Lemon Grass restaurant did not serve me Wagyu, it was prime rib due to the amount of fat on the super thin piece I had, which was half of the cut. 
2. The hotel never forewarned us that the shop inside does the US exchange at a much lower value than government decrees. Example: at the time we were there the exchange for $1 us equaled $16.89 pesos. The item I purchased should have been $220US, but they charged me $250US. When I went back to question the value, the store explained that they charge $14pesos per US dollar. 
3. There are NOT enough chairs at the pool to accommodate everyone and to enjoy being outdoors we had to purchase a cabana to have a place to sit!! Ridiculous! 
4. Our “concierge” hunted us every day at the pool to get us to listen to a sales pitch for one hour in exchange for having a massage, cabana, or something else for free. We told them repeatedly NO but came back every.single.day!
5. There was a booming disco/club every night that you can hear over the loud a/c. I am a light sleeper and had to use my noise cancelling headphones every night in order to sleep!!
6. The air conditioner in our room was always set at 65 but when you looked at the display, it would say 69.

reviews.author: Alejandro S
reviews.title: Hotel horrible
reviews.text:
La comida está mala, en el buffet aparte de pocas opciones las qué hay saben muy mal o están frías, igual en las albercas, pagas un todo incluido y aún tienes que pagar por camas en las albercas (hay muy pocos camastros y se llenan muy rápido) el servicio lentooo y malo. 

Lo peor de todo es en las noches con sus fiestas privadas que no dejan dormir NADA

reviews.author: Klayton2307
reviews.title: Way too hot
reviews.text: Way too hot in the common area. Family members as well as myself sweating at multiple restaurants inside the hotel. Room cleaners left filled trash cans, and dirty dishes in the room and  Failed to replace new towels. Communication issues with guest services and transportation upon arrival. Requested kid teepee and milk and cookies that came with the Nikte experience, but were not provided. Was unable to reach managers on multiple occasions. Was told I was going to receive a callback, but never received one. Multiple communication issues with staffing. Did not feel pampered or feel that I was at a luxury hotel outside of the amazing views of the oceans.

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: Terrible start
reviews.text: My husband and I arrive yesterday July 24th. We were excited to meet our family from Scotland here to celebrate a 25 year wedding anniversary and 55th birthday, to my disappointed our family has had a series of service failures since  arrival and little to no assistance has been provided to rectify the situation. I recommended this resort as I have visited in the past, I also work for an airline and have heard good things about the resort. The service failures range from strong mildew smelling rooms, having to move rooms twice ( unable to unpack) , basic room service orders ( English breakfast tea w/ milk) wrong. Having to pay additional  for new rooms, and then a shower head that is broken and left un repaired after multiple asks. The main pool is undergoing repairs leaving grit and chunks of tile and cement in the floor of the pool. What is most disappointing is the complete lack of customer service and desire to fix these issues. I am truly disappointed, and can only hope our remaining stay becomes more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Tourist42748507493
reviews.title: No Value, Many Children, Temperature isn't regulated
reviews.text: First off, we knew that it was a hot time of year to go. This was our second trip to the Paradisus. The last time was when they were named named Gran Melia 12 years ago. What we discovered this time around was that the main building atrium, the elevators, and more are not tempered. Which really would have helped with reprieve from heat. The room was on the top floor which did give us a nice view but the room struggled with getting cool. I know you are saying "well its tough to keep when heat is that high (90 deg F)." As a controls and HVAC professional, true if it was 95 with 100 percent humidity. That was not the case. The filter was the cheapest one a person could have put in, might as well not have one at all. Next the water was off for the night and it got nasty with the the toilet full. Now read up on this; the food is made in one area, the buffet. All restaurant's get their food within that area and bring it to you for extra service or extra cost. I can't verify that the expensive steak house, which isn't worth it, gets the food from the buffet but 95% sure it does. I have photo's to give example from Italian restaurant. I will review the excursions separate since they were awesome and separate from resort. The Cabana's were great. The service was ok, just think they work them too hard. This is not a place for adult only. Children were everywhere including the swim up bar, not ordering though did see one parent give a infant vodka drink. They also let them take ice cream into the pool...lol. Make sure you have tip money. Really look around before selecting this resort. O and the reason they get a so called green award is the place turns off electricity, no temperature control in atriums, reuse of plastic cups, etc.. I am sure they do some good. Staff is outstanding.

reviews.author: Arturo R
reviews.title: Pésimo viejo y malo
reviews.text:
Un hotel viejo al que solo le dieron una manita de gato, ayer en la llegada se tres cuartos dos con problemas 1 estaba ocupado o no lo hicieron y el otro no servía el aire acondicionado, nadie te explica coml sirve el hotel si no eres socio todo cuesta dinero como ñas camas de la alberca y playa dejando poco espacio para los clientes todo incluido, comida media goteras en todos lados, cuartos en construcción terrible las fotos engañan si pudiera pedir reembolso lo haría y me haría del hotel.
Para nunca regresar

reviews.author: LuvTravel K
reviews.title: Overall bad experience
reviews.text: Horrible dishonest hotel trying to rip off customers. Room is small and very dated. Food is always the same at the buffet. Worst of all is the service. Seems no body cares about anything. And the bartender at the main pool is the worst. Stay away from this resort

reviews.author: Excursion63784282642
reviews.title: Crooks
reviews.text: Our experience at this hotel was worse than being homeless. The temp was 90F and the AC wasn't working, the room service never showed up. We had a power outage, our sink drain and toilet drain both were clogged. We never had a renewal of our refreshments, our shuttle was canceled because of delay in service and we were made to pay for it. They have hidden fees everywhere (ex.charge 10$ for coconut water in an all inclusive package). Tried calling the supervisors, i.e Gabriella from front desk, Rosana from guest services with no communication or recourse. The hotel staff themselves complain of the operational issues faced by them, they were drenching in sweat with no air conditioning. The staff promised that they will process refund of our stay, but nothing happened. Please refund my money, or we shall do a formal report of the pilferage your hotel does.

reviews.author: Penelope Y
reviews.title: Terrible food
reviews.text:
Food was the worst waiting times to be seated almost 45 to 1 hour 
food terrible flavors served cold 
Room
Not working the air conditioning and was not
Fixed they send us a Fan
Not great in entertainment

reviews.author: dcobiellas
reviews.title: Worse experience of my life, will never come back
reviews.text: The hotel was clean, customer service at breakfast buffet was good, hit and miss. I did not pay extra for The Reserve, we were a family of 8, 4 adults and 4 kids. The front desk rep Julian, was rude and not accommodating, pushing us to pay extra $800 to upgrade the room, he made me feel that because I didn't want to upgrade I was less than the rest. The rooms that he gave us were old, air conditioning was not working, there was water coming from the ceiling in the bathroom, cracks in the walls, just a disaster. Activies were lacking, nothing to do for families after 9pm, just go to your hot room and try to make it to the next day. The only restaurants where the food was partially good were Lemon Fish and the Italian, that's it, food at Blue Agave was mediocre and also at Aqua Marine. I don't know what's going on with customer service, but it was not the best; there was no effort to make our stay more pleasant and this is a 5 start hotel. Maybe it was because we didn't upgrade the room or pay for the The Reserve. It was really disappointing.  We were 4 in the room, and they only brought 3 towels every day, even when I asked for 4 multiple times, it is something small, but I consider good customer service  when small things like this are taken care of without having to remind them to do it. Also, get ready to wake up at 5am if you want a chair by the pool, we had to put our stuff in the grass every day because there were not available chairs.  None of the rules were enforced.  We have been to Paradisus Punta Cana twice and everything was excellent that's why we choose this hotel, but it was a big mistake. Expensive and not worth it. I will never come back, it was a planned family trip and we all left disappointed. Thank you Paradisus for the worse vacation of my life.

reviews.author: AADHAV S
reviews.title: Left outside for hours
reviews.text: We came for check in at 10 am after getting up at 4 and taking a flight and everything, and then when we arrive they unapologetically say that the room is not ready and come back in FOUR HOURS. The guy at the desk gives us completely wrong information about a lot of things and all the restaurants he says are open are closed. After 4 hours we come back and the guy calmly says, no sorry the room still isn’t ready, come back in another 30 minutes. We can’t even do anything, we don’t even have our luggage because they took them, and we’re bored out of our minds. Horrible, horrible service, I would never recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: nusenr
reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
Room 3559,
- the refrigerator was not working
- still doesn't have a coffee maker
- the room is very hot children are sweating all night. the thermostat says 69 never went below 75 degrees
- we were supposed to at the coffee bar sweets and snacks didn't know until they entered our room
- housekeeping only left 3 clean towels in total.
- The concierge never approached them the entire time we were here.

My room 3006
- We were never given a promised room. we had to except a room on the first floor. this should not be acceptable for the upgrade we paid for.
- refrigerator not working. had to be fixed to separate complaints
- there was only one small towel left in my room.
- never sent us a chair only one chair on the outside balcony all the time
- when i dial 0 i usually have to call 2-4 times to get anything i need when i ask them what i ordered they don't know
- the concierge is not very responsive, reservations are not well organized, one restaurant even changed our reservation at 7pm to 7:30pm. no one informed us of the change. It ruined our entire dinner that night with my family. my wife went to our room. So they didn't want to seat my family because she wasn't there.
- at the pool bar he served us 4 drinks and then complained that the other people didn't have the same bracelet so they will have to charge us.
- security is giving us a hard time because we are saving 4 chairs for our family and he will have to remove our things. everyone in the hotel does the same thing every morning
- The fact that we cannot make reservations leaves us waiting from 45 to 1hr. that is not the service we paid for.
- The steakhouse won't let my son in, but they can charge me adult price for my 13 year old. now andres tells me and my wife you have to be at least 15 years old
- the room is not cleaned properly in the morning. - Even the garbage is forgotten.
- Room service ordered for three days brought me chicken last night and they said we couldn't do that. my wife had to wash them in the bathroom
- no bathroom door. three people are in my room. There is no privacy when we are in the shower. someone was delivering room service and I was getting out of the shower.
- I have been in the hospitality industry for over 25 years. I have never experienced staff not knowing the rules of the property. they just make them up. it is very unprofessional. If I were the general manager, I would be embarrassed. My wife's family owns a Hyatt Regency and is appalled at how disorganized her property is.

I need you to send me your corporate contact. I don't feel comfortable paying for this stay at her hotel. I will report everything to her corporation because this is ridiculous and unacceptable.

reviews.author: Shaman
reviews.title: AC does not work in the rooms
reviews.text: Beware, if you need AC to be comfortable, skip this resort. Everyone who is here is complaining about the AC barely working and nothing is getting done about it. The rooms do not cool further than 75-77 degrees F. That’s with it running all night with shades and doors closed and lights off. There is no exception , not even in the reserve nikte rooms. In the regular rooms you will definitely struggle.

reviews.author: ZM
reviews.title: Horrible experience at so-called luxury resort
reviews.text:
Booked a stay in the reserve section and we’re completely disappointed by the whole experience. 

Unpleasant Odor: Upon checking into our room, we were immediately greeted by an appalling stench that persisted throughout our stay, making it difficult to enjoy the luxury we expected. We chose to endure this discomfort for a few days, hoping that it would improve, but to no avail.

Misrepresented Room: We were promised a room with a picturesque lagoon view but instead faced a disappointing sight of a bush and an ongoing construction site, which was not as advertised. When we finally gathered the courage to voice our concerns of about room smell/view to your staff, we were met with defensiveness and felt attacked for not having voiced our complaints earlier. They changed our room, but unfortunately it was only for the end of our stay.

Subpar Food Quality: The meals provided at the resort were below acceptable standards, resulting in week long severe food poisoning. The taste, variety, and health standards were all lacking.

Unprofessional Staff Attitude: When we communicated our dietary restrictions and received an incompatible meal, the staff members responsible were dismissive and showed a lack of empathy, which is not expected from a reputed resort.

Unhygienic Conditions: the night we were moved into our new room, we discovered roaches in the bathroom of our supposedly luxurious accommodations, which was unhygienic and unsightly.

Noise Pollution: A loud club across resort premises played music into the early hours of the morning, causing considerable disturbance and depriving us of a peaceful night's sleep.

The day we left we were informed the resort’s workers had gone on strike. This occurrence serves as a clear indication of the unsatisfactory conditions prevailing at the resort. It is crucial for the management to promptly address these concerns and take appropriate action.

reviews.author: Yashvinder S
reviews.title: They spoiled our vacation. First timers in Cancun.
reviews.text:
Thank for for spoiling our vacation. Thr hotel staff is rude.. only trying to make money from the tips. The food quality and choices are just average. Everything from the checkin process to the service is horrible to say the least. 

We booked the hotel for our first trip to Cancun. They’re located in the hotel zone so we booked it. Paid over $1000 fo
The room was not ready upon arrival at 6pm. Was asked to wait 45 mins in a restaurant so not able to hit the water on the first day. When inside the room, the minibar was empty and waited another 1 hour for someone to restock it.
Their main restaurant with buffet - Malva does not impress with the food. Only live stations for pasta and tacos had long line. The buffet food selection was also quite average.
Decided to go to BlueAgave which seemed like a good ala’carte restaurant choice but they also had very limited options. Majorly just focused on tacos and frankly they too were not that good.
For late dinner we decided to go to buffet and made peace with whatever was available. The kids were really hungry and they got fried wings.
We even checked at the Lemon Fish restaurant but we’re told at 9:45 that the kitchen closes at 10… even though the restaurant is open till 11pm as mentioned.
Next morning we woke up late and decided to have lunch straightaway at the Lunchbox, another ala’carte restaurant. To our surprise we were told that ‘for today’ the lunchbox has the same menu as the buffet. So basically buffet… WTF. We again made peace and had little food at the Malva buffet…. Again!
At the pool we found out that the covered cabanas are paid. No surprises there but the helper their quoted us $255 for the cabana, along with some food and a bottle of champagne. Wow!!!! We skipped and started looking for a beach chair which was obviously free.
Now here’s the fun part. We found a couple of beach chairs but there was a book, just a book on each one of them. We checked with the staff and they assigned those to us. Few mins later a guy shows us saying this is his chair since his books are on them. Apprentice he put his stuff on 8 chairs at 7 am and left. After a little argument someone from the staff stepped in and asked that ‘gentleman’ to vacate with his stuff.
After all the tussle and bad experience we went inside the pool and actually felt like vacation for a while. We had fun with the kids. The water temperature was good and we stayed there for a couple of hours.
I felt hungry and decided to eat something. The restaurant Agua Marina was close by looking into the menu serves ceviche. After 15 mins of waiting we got the table. And the waiter showed up after another 15 mins. To my surprise they were out of ceviche. How could that be the case be cause one of the things that the cabana guy mentioned above, in the food items - was ceviche 😡
Anyway we ordered what was available and it took another 45 mins to get the food. By the way I’m sitting here right now writing the review and the first food just arrived.
I’ll continue updating this review as I stilll have a day left here to survive.

reviews.author: Rafael K
reviews.title: Terrible Place
reviews.text: We had the unfortunate surprise to discover that Melia had not paid its employees for over 90 days. As a result, the service offered was appalling. And we were insulted by some employees who said that we didn't have enough purchasing power to be there in that hotel. Never again will I return to Club Melia Paradisus in Cancun. And I certainly do not recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Lily E
reviews.title: Hotel from hell
reviews.text: HORRRIBLE!!! DO NOT COME HERE!! NO VENGAS AQUI!!!!! I came here with friends in the “Junior Suite” is awful. The entire room looks like a morg. Our first night the dirt on the floor is awful your feet were black if you walked shoeless. Then after asking to switch rooms our ac was broken and spent the entire night sweating. Then when after calling 3 times over the span of 10 hours to come fix it they finally did and it wasn’t fixed. Then the shower and toilet wouldn’t work. Then the celling was peeling and falling on the floor and you could see mold. Then after complaining they finally brought us to our new room where the outlets wouldn’t work and coackroacks spotted. Don’t come here it’s the hotel from hell. The reviews telling u it’s nice are bots.

reviews.author: Tam N
reviews.title: Whatever you do, do not book here!!!!
reviews.text: This place is absolute horrible. Front desk staff has zero clue about customer service or being proactive regarding concerns from guest. Everything is simply ignored and pushed off to the next shift. No issue I brought to this staff was ever addressed and even when it was it was 2+ hours for any kind of resolution!  And to be clear they never resolved anything without prompting. I wouldn’t suggest booking here if you’re looking to have a restful and relaxing vacation. Now if you want a vacation where  you’re constantly arguing for basics like towels or even having a room with  working plumbing (literally no water in the suite and couldn’t flush the toilet)  this is the place for you. Water dripping from the ceiling outside the room for two days. When I reported it to Johnathan he said they would have to investigate…I said no need let me show you the video! It’s like this place opened yesterday and everyone in management is clueless! Literally everyone! They offered a spa service to accommodate us for our troubles…this is after three days of fighting but at that point why would I trust you all to do ANYTHING! Now the wait staff worked hard and as best they could but I certainly see why they went on strike a week ago! Do. Not. Book. Don’t waste your money!

reviews.author: Ryan B
reviews.title: Lacks service standards
reviews.text:
A stream of consciousness:

Eliu - blatantly rude front desk agent. Helped the white guests with a very positive and welcoming attitude. When it was out party's turn he was completely dismissive and rude when it came to questions we had about our room or stay

Other members in our room needed to get new bracelets for our stay, the front desk agent gave them to us without even asking for an ID or a name on the reservation. We even asked if they needed ID and they said no. They just cut the bracelets and gave it to them without really scanning anything. Felt completely unsafe.

Food & Beverage really holding down the fort on service and making people feel welcomed

Raphael & Nathanael - Lunchbox and Lemonfish were amazing!

Liliana at YHI also delivered an excellent service

Service at Sante was amazing

Calling in for room service was really rude and deep sighing whenever we called for food. We were accused of ordering later and the manager asked to see our phone because we were texting and our room phone was broken.  They are uncommunicative and lack proper service standards. 

Sal - I'm not sure. Service is great but half our party was asked to leave to put on shoes because they were wearing sandals, but the white straight parties before and after were also wearing sandals and were not asked to leave even after we brought it up to the staff.

Overall, not BIPOC Queer friendly. Steer clear until they have an actual action plan that is better than whatever apology they have to reply to this post.

Lacking name tags

Mentioned our phone is broken every day and they had not bothered to fix it

Whoever gave this racist and homophobic hotel their five stars needs to be reprimanded as well. I've never been so disrespected at "luxury" hotel in my life. One of the reasons we even felt comfortable booking here was because Melia was supposed to "inclusive."

reviews.author: Dennis K
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience - Below Average Food and Service
reviews.text:
We stayed for 8 days and had the all-inclusive package. I believe May is considered the offseason which we appreciated as the hotel wasn't too crowded. It also meant we had a considerable amount of seaweed on the beach and the waves were strong than expected. We have a toddler so we stayed mainly in the pools so this wasn't too much of a downer for us. For context, we have been to Cancun before so I can draw from that experience and make comparison in my review here. 

Food: the Italian restaurant and the seafood one (out by the pool) were ok. The buffet style one was ok also. The Japanese one was substandard. Overall, and compared to my other Cancun visits, the dining experience was not impressive. 

Service: Surprisingly, and compared to my other visits, communication in English was more challenging than expected. The front desk and customer service staff were ok but the restaurant and bar staffs were hit or miss. And perhaps it's a hangover from COVID and due to the labour shortage across all regions, the staffs were not as friendly and responsive as I remember from my other visits (all at other resorts). We often had to be nice or tip to get a reasonable level of service in the timely manner. 

Finally, this ruined our experience for sure and the main reason for the one star rating, we had a very unpleasant experience at the Lunch Box restaurant where we showed up as the first guests of the evening (with reservation). As I noted above, it's the slower season so it was just us for the first twenty minutes or so. We asked for a highchair as we entered which the hostess confirmed and said it would be brought over shortly. Didn't come for the first 15 minutes or so, therefore, I walked up to the hostess to check on status of the highchair. Her reaction was abominable - she looked over at me, did not react or respond, walked away and spoke to the waiters. It was distasteful and rude, but I returned to my seat - I try to give people benefit of the doubt. Perhaps unsurprisingly, the highchair didn't come for a few more minutes (again it was just us in the restaurant until now), and I asked the hostess again. Same reaction (a stare over, rolling eyes, no response, walk away and speak to others). I mean if that is the type of service you'll be getting at a premium resort, it is a no-thank-you for me. I asked for her name so that I can follow up with her supervisor. What was more baffling was that, during our meal, the supervisor did show up and apologized for not bringing over the highchair in a timely manner. But no apology about the hostess' behavior from the supervisor nor a personal apology from the hostess herself. They were missing the point. I told the supervisor about my experience but I don't think he cared too much. I later followed up with the customer service desk manager to formally lodge my complaint to ensure this is appropriately tended to. For sure I wanted to vent but also wanted to make sure appropriate actions be taken to correct this behavior, attitude, and lack of professional service. The manager was apologetic and promised to follow up internally and said that they would eventually inform me how the complaint was managed and what came about from it, which I appreciated and actually believed in. A day later, I was told that the hostess was engaged and was given a formal warning. However, after numerous attempts to hear the end of it, the staffs have been unresponsive. I followed up even after the trip to give them one last chance to make it (somewhat) right. At this point, I can only assume it was swept under the rug. Anyways, I wanted to make sure those who are interested are informed of what potentially may happen during your visit and what you may experience. I would not recommend Paradisus Cancun to anyone I know.

reviews.author: C L
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK HERE!!!  BE WARNED!
reviews.text: Booked reservations for 4 premium master rooms for our extended family vacation.  Upon arrival, we were informed that we actual have 4 studio junior suites— NOT WHAT WE HAD BOOKED.  They pulled the ol’ bait and switch on us, folks.  Additionally, check in process takes over an hour and any dinners require setting up reservations through a “concierge” and you may or may not get the time and restaurant that you are wanting.  DO NOT BOTHER COMING HERE.  Not relaxing, not welcoming, just a real pain and hassle.

reviews.author: christopher z
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
Dear Hotel
I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration with my recent stay at your hotel for my honeymoon. Unfortunately, my experience was far from satisfactory, and I feel compelled to share my grievances with you.

To start with, the presence of mold in the bathroom was appalling and unacceptable. The fact that the hotel has not taken proper care of its facilities and cleanliness is a cause for concern, and it poses a severe health hazard to your guests. Furthermore, the inconvenience of having to switch rooms twice due to clogged showers was a significant disruption to our experience.

To make matters worse, we encountered roaches in our room, which was incredibly distressing and uncomfortable. This is simply unacceptable, and it reflects poorly on the hotel's hygiene standards.

Moreover, the customer service we received was nothing short of abysmal. The lack of empathy and responsiveness from the hotel staff was frustrating and only added to our already negative experience. As newlyweds, we were hoping for a memorable and comfortable honeymoon experience, but unfortunately, that was not the case.

I would like to request a refund for my stay, as it did not meet the standards we were promised. I would also like to urge you to take immediate action to address these issues and ensure that they do not happen to any other guests in the future.
