It is crucial for a hotel to provide exceptional customer service, cleanliness, and maintenance to ensure a positive and memorable experience for its guests

reviews.author: Raiinbaby
reviews.title: What a scam.
reviews.text: The hotel room had no A/C and we had to sleep outside due to how hot the room got. The laundry staff took $30 from us for laundry and then the front desk extorted us for that same “payment” under the excuse that the staff doesn’t speak English and took it as a tip even tho we clearly asked how much we owed and they said $30. Once I questioned it- they told me not only did I have to pay it again, it was now $60 for a few pants and bathing suits. The staff was walking around charging $300 for cabanas and then later we were told that they were supposed to be free and not to give them that money because they are just asking and are considering it a tip. When questioned about that, the front desk used the excuse that they don’t understand English well and probably just assumed it was a tip for their service. My entire group left feeling like the hotel runs a very scammy business and uses the fact that they speak Spanish as a way to take more money from you.

reviews.author: VVal12
reviews.title: Cockroaches infestation BEWARE!!!
reviews.text:
Nightmare experience! 
Booked this hotel for my family for 1 night because our flight was canceled.  
Check in took more than 1 hour in a line.
We were given an extremely old room in building 1. Room number 1401
AC was blowing in the face non stop, so it was impossible to sleep. At 3am I went to the barroom and turn on the light. 1 cockroach was sitting on the ceiling, another one was on the floor. I stepped back, and could not believe my eyes. One more was running near the trashcan. I went back to the bedroom, turn on the light, yelled at my husband that we need to pack bags - cockroaches in the barroom. I put my clothes on and noticing another cockroach crawling up the curtains.
I scream and move a suitcase - 2 more roaches running, they were sitting under the suitcase, one more under baby stroller. I screamed on the top of my lungs… I videotaped what I could and was out of the room in 10 seconds. 
They gave us another room with sea view. Who needs sea view when your luggage could be infested with roaches?   We spent 3 hours checking our luggage and backpacks, washing and throwing away things roaches could crawl on. It was the worst night ever! I was mentally and physically exhausted. We left in 4 hours to catch up with a new flight. 
My family should be compensated for the real horror night we went through and for our belongings we had to throw away.
I’ll file a complaint with local health and safety organization asap.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Cerdeira
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio al cliente
reviews.text:
Buenas instalaciones, pésimo servicio al cliente.

1. Tuvimos que acudir hasta 4 ocasiones a recepción para hacer check in (mala capacitación, poca comunicación). 

2. Nunca nos dieron la cuna para nuestra bebé.

3. Pagamos upgrade de 3 habitaciones y al querer pagar por late check out, nos ofrecieron para compensar las diversas situaciones que este fuese gratis.

4. Al final decían que solo aplicaba para 1 habitación es decir unos salimos a la hr normal y otros no, yo nunca les pedí eso gratis, ellos lo ofertaron y no pensaban respetarlo.

5. Muy bien Cris (customer service), muy bien Kemil (botones), muy bien Miguel (mesero del restaurante lemon)… El resto y particularmente Antony de recepción y Andrei (necesitan mucha pero mucha capacitación).

reviews.author: Amadea N
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL AND I WILL NEVER VISIT MEXICO AGAIN
reviews.text:
EVERYTHING is wrong with this place. To be clear, I stayed at the Reserve side of Paradisus Cancun. This means $500USD/night. My company then had an offsite at the regular side of Paradisus Cancun. This is  day 3/10 and I’m already close to tears. 

Service:
They love to talk the talk, but won’t walk the walk. Everyone here is trained to be super nice and accommodating, but when push comes to shove, it’s still a no no no. 

Day 1 - Check-in:
On checkin, they found two bookings as my company  booked through the reservation desk and there were two overlapping nights. My company confirmed with me they had not booked the overlap, but the front desk kept insisting I pay the additional cost. They did this “pleasantly” by showing me a piece of paper with the amount due repeatedly. I insisted no, and they
 kept going back and forth/calling people/checking with managers until after an hour or so confirmed they would not charge me the overlap and cancel it on their own. Given the mishap, which made me miss the sunset/ability to go to the pool or beach, management said we could keep our Reserve wristbands throughout our whole stay. 

The Reserve room, Junior Suite Ocean View:
The room was nice upon arrival, the view was really nice. But the room felt “new” and it’s hard to explain until you experience it itself but once again it was like the service - empty promises. Things were broken, super cheap, lights wouldn’t turn off, TV only played cable and couldn’t connect to anything despite having all the right cables. 

The Reserve concierge experience:
As part of the Reserve, you get a personal concierge that communicates with you via text and is supposed to book things for you. Great! Don’t get excited, it’s just a texting buddy. Because they don’t onboard you - they don’t tell you what parts of the resort require reservations (that they help you to book). Why does this matter?

Things that require a reservation here:
1. ALL restaurants except the Mexican place and the buffet place. This means if you do not reserve, you will NOT be eating at any of these restaurants. We arrived on Saturday, and everything was booked upon arrival. ??? 
2. Bali beds by the pool AT THE RESERVE SECTION THAT YOU PAY FOR. All beds are booked, they remain unoccupied for hours but you can’t have them unless you actually book them through your concierge. The service staff will tell you to leave nicely though LOL 

So yes, we paid the Reserve price but could never use any of these exclusive things LOL. 

CALCULATIVE to the tee:
Forget hospitality here. It’s all about what they can overcharge you for. Spent so much time negotiating with the front desk that you are right up to your checkout time? $50 an hour if you want to have a late checkout. 

Bring your own stuff because the cheapest small bottle sunscreen here is $27USD. My boyfriend bought one and left it at the counter of the shop, we came back the next morning for it and they said they’d have to check the cameras and it would take 3-days. Made us buy the sunscreen again. 

Coconut water? $10 each coconut 

Daybeds? $250 each. 

Food:
The Mexican place is dank, and I think it’s because it does exactly what it does without trying to pass off as a international cuisine. All other international foods were subpar. WITHOUT MY CONCIERGE’S HELP, because she had told me it was impossible, I managed to get into Sal. Sal is a steakhouse included in the Reserve experience, but reservation only. We got there right on opening and waited an hour for the host to see if he could fit us in. Despite the restaurant being 40% empty, they gave us a table. Food was ok. 

If you don’t drink alcohol, which we do not, this resort is not worth it. Their regular drinks are bad, their fruit juice is all canned and not actual juice. I’ve only been drinking water and while writing this seated at Senta, I have purchased a $10 coconut.

Check-out/Switching rooms:
Despite having already booked me for the second room AND not granting me a late checkout, the Reserve front desk said my next room would not be available until 3pm. On checkout, they said we would have to return our Reserve wristbands, even though they had said we did not need to as a courtesy. Seeing that this was another empty promise, I insisted and they obliged. This band only gives me access to the Reserve pool, no food or reserve desk etc. 

TLDR: ABSOLUTELY NOT. I could be paying $500 a night at a plethora of other hotels and being perfectly satisfied. But no, I’ve been on the brink of tears since arriving and today I finally cracked.

reviews.author: constanza del p... r
reviews.title: Horrible ! Busquen un mejor hotel
reviews.text: Horrible 😞, no vayan el hotel esta viejo , la atención de la recepción es horrible , nunca contestan el teléfono cuando necesitas algo , lo único bueno eran simpáticos los meseros del desayuno en restarante melva, lo demás deja mucho que desear , el room service nunca llega , el de mantenimiento tampoco, la luz de corta a diario , pues ! Mejor me hubiera hospedado en otro lado , era mi viaje de cumpleaños y fue un desastre.

reviews.author: Paula P
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
Horrible…
Lo único bueno del hotel es la ubicación, que hay autobuses para poder moverte a 300m.
Lo malo;
- habitaciones extremadamente antiguas, luces que no funcionan, aire acondicionado EXTREMADAMENTE RUIDOSO, cucarachas, grifos que gotean y funcionan mal,…
- los restaurantes del hotel, dejan mucho que desear referente a la comida y el buffet,… eso ya es catastrófico. Un buffet donde no hay frutas tropicales, la existencia de carne o pescado es con suerte las sobras de los restaurantes en forma de tacos o mechados en salsa incomibles. La calidad es terrible y la variedad igual.
- la animación del hotel… con una hora al día les sobra. No hay actividades en la playa o piscina, no hay teatro ni discoteca, …
- zonas de agua ; las camas balinesas pretenden que pagues 300$ y las tumbonas que hay a las 6 de la mañana ya han puesto todos los huéspedes pertenencias para que así queden ocupadas y no habiendo sitio para los demás aún dejándolas vacías.
- la playa… la playa es horrible, no parece caribe, a los 2m es muy profunda, hay mucho oleaje, está llena de piedras y la zona de playa es muy inclinada impidiendo así que se pueda ni pasear por ella.
- las fotos de internet NO se corresponden
Y por último mencionar, que los recepcionistas te roban. Pidiendo a la llegada diversas tasas de las cuales no te dan recibo y que al cotejar con nuestra agencia de viajes no avisaron de esto era totalmente una estafa
Horrible

reviews.author: Kara B
reviews.title: E.COLI ..SHIGA TOXIN 1
reviews.text:
I’ve been to traveling to Mexico since I was 9  years old.. I’m 36 now… this was BY FAR the WORST experience I’ve ever had.   Prepare to drop a lot of money to eat AWFUL/undercooked buffet, food the entire time… You will not be able to get a reservation at any of the “nicer “restaurants either it will take roughly 60-90 minutes before you receive your food. .. also WATCH OUT for the poolside /room service hamburgers … they ARE NOT FULLY COOKED. I’m talking RAW. 
I will come back and write a full review and list out other details of WHY this resort is absolute trash but I need to warn people…  I was hospitalized in the emergency room THREE times upon returning from this resort… I contracted Shiga toxin one from Paradisus…. This specific strain of E. coli can lead to HUS, which can cause your kidneys to shut down and be life-threatening. The amount of agony and pain I was in for over a week from the pure negligence and POOR food handling by paradisus staff is astounding.  

I FILLED the toilet with an alarming amount of blood each time I sat down. It was TERRIFYING . This lasted more then 7 days. 3 trips to the ER. THREE!!!
I’m not the only one in my party that was served under cooked food. 
PLEASE im BEGGING you  don’t go to this resort and If you DO decide to go here  (especially
If you bring small kids as HUS is FAR more life threatening to children )  PLEASE watch your food . It’s either undercooked or prepared by staff that doesn’t wash their hands . PLEASE BE CAREFUL . I wouldn’t wish my experience on anyone 

Oh! and don’t forget about the FOUR dead bodies they just found on the beach about a week ago….

reviews.author: Passenger24221816335
reviews.title: Not a 5 or 4 star resort, more like 1 star.
reviews.text:
FACTS: Trust me I will not be talking about long lines, check-Ins or a person's attitude.

What I will be talking about is the outdated rooms that are poorly (fix) constructed that should have been remodeled. Bad food too something we all love to hate.

I HAVE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS TO PROVE EVERYTHING THAT I AM SAYING.

Here is the kicker, this place had 2 years to fix everything due to covid. But they did not.

Room 2016 & 3109 tower 2 and 3.

• 3109: Roaches, Gnats Fruit Flies, Cracked and Broken Tube Tiles, Unpainted Sheetrock and Mold. The tube was horrible, molded caulking around the tub and rust. Bathroom ceiling sheetrock was poorly constructed. Ceiling and walls had black mold spots. Bathroom makeup lamp rusted. Bathroom mirror was rusty and peeling. The caulking around the tissue holder was molded. The entire bathroom was poorly caulk. All of the lights and electrical covers were yellow which means they have not been changed in about 10 years. Lamp shade rusty and old.

• 2016: Small sofa in the room had red stains on it if it was blood or red dry. Toilet was cracked and glued back together with Liquid Nail Caulk. Roaches in the room also. All of the lights and electrical covers were yellow too. Room poorly painted and repaired, old rusty shower heads.

FOOD Restaurants

Note: I paid for the upgrade to be able to dine at Sal's Steak House. So here is the breakdown of each restaurant.

1. Sal's was good, maybe because it cost me an additional $384.00 after we were finished eating. So be aware only the unpopular steaks come with the menu. The premium steaks ribeyes, cowboys, tomahawks and t-bones you have to pay out of pocket for them.

2. Malva: buffet breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu was great. Plenty of food options to choose from. Keyword (buffet).

3. Lemon Fish: was not able to get a reservation here, small restaurant.

4. Agave Mexican: One word (Horrible). The guacamole has no taste to it, no lime, salt, cilantro and other spices. The queso cheese is not exist queso cheese at this place, it's just melted mozzarella cheese put in a small cast iron bowl and placed in the oven that turns into a bowl of grease. This is not authentic Mexican food, pretty much like frozen mexican food.

5. Aqua Marina: (HORRIBLE) this location was the worst. The pasta had no taste and came out cold if it was premade the morning before. The barbecue ribs taste if they've been in the microwave for reheating. Every hot dish we ordered came out cold. We contacted the manager and got up and left.

Respectly,

reviews.author: GABRIEL B
reviews.title: PÉSIMO SERVICIO PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text: Habiendo visitado la perla de Playa del Carmen en múltiples ocasiones,  está fue una experiencia terrible, pésimo servicio solo con excepción de unas ciertas personas, que me gustaría mencionarlas pero creo de nada les servirá a ellos, la comida buena pero en caso tardaron demasiado en recepción malísimo el servicio, se reservó una habitación de hospitalidad para bañarnos y salir, no la registraron y terminaron mándanos al spa para bañarnos, bueno podría hacer muy larga la reseña pero con esto es suficiente. “NADA RECOMENDABLE”

reviews.author: rsilva2023
reviews.title: las peores vacaciones
reviews.text:
servicio muy por debajo de lo esperado y no se respetan las condiciones de la tarifa con lo que el hotel finalmente te entrega. relacion precio calidad no se ajusta
la reserva señala "incluye Restaurante SAL",  pero llegando te indican que es una noche,  el equipo de consierge te da una serie de explicaciones pero no resuelve nada.
ascensor no funciona durante 5 días y había que subir 6 pisos a pie

reviews.author: Chris P
reviews.title: Not good at all
reviews.text: We just got back today from a 5 night stay at this resort. We had 2 reserve rooms, master suite and junior suite. Not sure where the 4 and 5 star reviews stayed, but it could not have been this resort. From the start is was bad. We checked in at the Reserve, and to be honest, the representative was not very friendly. I will say, most of the staff were very friendly, hence the 1 star for them. Elevator in the reserve did not work, we had to walk up 6 flights of stairs to get to our rooms all week, it was horrible. Our Concierge was a no show, we met him once on day 2 and never saw him again. Now to the really bad part, the FOOD and drinks. The food was HORRIBLE at every restaurant. We ate at Sal's WOW it was bad. Steaks were raw, lobster tail was over cooked, then the next 1 was raw. Grilled ceasar was not grilled, it was soggy. The buffet was maybe the worst I have ever had. We had breakfast there a few times, and trust me, it was horrible. We looked in for dinner and Golden Coral looks better. Lemon Fish was okay. The reserve  restaurant was bad as well. Overall, every restaurant had a very limited menu and all the food was served cold or old. Night 4 we went across the street to Toro and had 1 of the best dinners in a while, Last night we visited their sister restaurant, Rosanegra, was also great. Overall the drinks were watered down. Some places honored the Reserve quality, some did not, very strange. Nothing really going on during the day besides the pool and beach. At night their was a dj  a few times for a few hours. Sport was was okay, but closed by midnight and stopped serving liquor at 11:30. Pool sticks were broken, missing tips, we were told that is the way it is. Buyer be ware this place is a money pit.

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.title: Horrible experience, stay away
reviews.text: Came for bday trip. Spent 4 hours in line to check in. 1st I was told the room was not ready. Then we were assigned a room overlooking industrial Ac that was very noisy. The manager refused to change the room. We asked to change a room and a new room magically appeared. The new room was moldy. The front-desk refused to issue a refund. Stay away, they lack basic customer svc skills and will ruin your vacation.

reviews.author: boidu
reviews.title: Très très déçus
reviews.text:
Une usine, beau maïs qu'en apparence, Des que vous regardez d un peu près c'est vieux et l' entretien est fait à la va vite et superficielle ment.
De nombreux manquement et qui ne sont satisfaits que si vous insistez, indigne d un 5 étoiles !!!
Point positif, personnel disponible et avenant, nourriture du self excellente au petit déjeuner et à midi...le soir c est une autre histoire !!!

reviews.author: Braulio G
reviews.title: No vale lo que cuesta
reviews.text: Habitaciones anticuadas, plagas en los cuartos, falta de contactos, falta de luz en habitaciones, servicio pésimo, comida sin sabor. Discriminación de compatriotas a pesar de dejar propina. Auque, como dejar propina con semejante experiencia?.

reviews.author: elenaromo
reviews.title: Horrible servicio
reviews.text: Discriminación por parte del mismo personal de restaurantes y barras, si no les hablas en inglés no te atienden, las habitaciones en malas condiciones eléctricas. El minibar y plancha no servían, las bebidas tibias y no se podía ni planchar por que no servía nada

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Poor service, poor food, OK facilities
reviews.text:
Firstly the positives: the staff are very friendly, the view from the pool overlooking the beach is nice, and the a la carte steak restaurant is very nice.

Sadly that is where the positives end, we had a number of issues during our stay which forced us to leave early, and the handling of our complaints both at the hotel and after the fact with Melia customer service were incredibly disappointing, in fact they refuse to even acknowledge that the service provided was poor. The negative points are as follows:

- the concierge himself was incredibly friendly and helpful, however, presumably due to expectations placed on them by hotel management, was incredibly pushy to attend a sales pitch for their private membership/timeshare program. Even after explaining we weren't interested we were still pushed multiple times per day, even being approached more than once when simply trying to relax by the pool

- the food quality in the buffet restaurant is poor. We have stayed at a number of other Melia resorts in Europe and the food quality here is substantially lower

- aggressive sales tactics for other services such as scuba diving/jet skis etc

- a number of leaking ceilings throughout the hotel and one particularly horrendous smell coming from a storage cupboard that we had to walk past every day to get to the restaurant

Certainly not value for money in the slightest, avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Travis W
reviews.title: Not worth it for the cost
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed for 4 nights. We had 2 rooms. The first room reeked of sewage and when the cleaning lady came in she knew right away. We watched her go right to the shower drain, spray a solution down it, and walk out. After a days long battle with the front desk we were able to get a new room. The food was sub par for an all inclusive. There is no kids pool, it's literally just a shallow pool tucked on the far end of the resort. The Kidsdom staff were extremely nice and helpful. The hospitality staff at the front desk was extremely sub par. No one would take accountability for anything and they all passed the buck on to other colleagues, making the guest wait longer and longer, hoping we'd just drop whatever the issue was and move on. 

The price we paid for the all inclusive aspect was not worth it. Our two best meals came at off site restaurants.

There are much better family friendly options with exceptional customer service up north in Playa Mujeres or further south than the hotel zone.

reviews.author: Emma A
reviews.title: No acepten membresía !!
reviews.text: Estuvimos hace dos años en el hotel Meliá, y nos ofrecieron una membresía la cual estuvimos pagando por estos dos años y más el pago inicial con un total de $5000 y ahora que tratamos de usarla pretenden cobrar 3,500 por solo seis noches ,, los cual en el mercado solo cuesta alrededor de 4,000 entonces yo pagaría 8,000 cual es el beneficio de tener una membresía si se va a pagar el doble ,, aparte no me contestan los emails para la cancelación de esta membresía y cuando llamo a solo pasan las llamadas y al final nadie contesta ,, por favor no compren estas membresía solo es una estafa !!!

reviews.author: reenzyseason
reviews.title: If you can’t get the reserve, don’t go
reviews.text:
I booked through chase travels and didn’t see an option for the reserve. When we checked in, I asked if we could upgrade, but he said there were no reserve rooms available. He still got us a concierge, her name was Teresa. She walked us to our room but really wasn’t too helpful after that. She booked our spa for us and got us a “discounted rate”. 

The rates were always changing. One day it’s $350 for a couples massage, but it we participate in their “discount program” 45 min explanation, it’s $95. We opted out and said we’d rather pay full price than have someone shove a time share down our throats during our vacation. Then the next day for no reason at all, suddenly our massages would be $200 if we did them that day instead of Wednesday like we wanted. We took the seal and honestly the experience was only worth that much. Their spa is very cramped. You get a set ten min in the sauna and ten min in the steam room and then you take two very cold showers before you get in the hot tub…. Which is not very hot. The massages were fine. They provided robes but no slippers, you had to wear your own. 

Now the rest of the resort was horrible. Our room in pyramid one was the WORST looking motel room I’ve ever stayed at in the ten all inclusive resorts I’ve visited in my life. The restroom was small. I just can’t elaborate any more than to say DO NOT STAY IN PYRAMID one. 

The food in the entire resort was DISGUSTING. Almost inedible. We tried all diff types of food and from all diff restaurants. The buffet was very limited in options much less in vegetarian options. Smallest buffet I’ve seen at an all inclusive. We ate at agua marine the first day and couldn’t finish our food the fish was tasteless as was the steak. The lunch box was similar… the chicken sandwich said it came with pickles and ranch but it didn’t. Again the fish was very fishy, not flavorful. The nachos were gross with a cheese sauce that tasted more like butter than cheese. There’s certain restaurants that are reserve only that must be better. Or at least they can’t be worse. We left the resort to eat outside because of how bad it was. We tried to make reservations for our stay within an hour of arrival and most everythjnt was booked. What was left was only available at 5pm or 10pm. Again I think the reserve got preference. 

The pool was always too cold. The drinks were very watered down which was to be expected, and tasted way too sweet like artificial sweetener. 

The elevators are extremely small and almost always being used by staff to transport things as they don’t seem to have a service elevator so we can’t even get on the elevator to go in and out of our room due to that. We took stairs always. 

The only pro about this resort is it’s located on a bus stop so that’s easy. The beach is gorgeous. And that’s about it. 

I’ve been to praradisus Palma real in DR and I can’t believe this piece of ish place is related to that one. Two completely diff worlds.

reviews.author: rebeccawhitfield12
reviews.title: Appalling customer service and horrible food
reviews.text: Worst resort I’ve ever been to. Ricardo from OTIUM desk and our concierge Frida were both extremely rude and unhelpful. Ricardo got in my face at one point and made me feel uncomfortable and unsafe. All the food was really bad and you could tell it was very cheap. I paid for the reserve but nobody told me what was and wasn’t included. Overall I feel taken advantage of by this place and will never return. I’ll make sure to tell my friends to never stay at this resort. I also never heard back from anyone when I tried to escalate things. And I’m sure I never will!

reviews.author: Jonathan K
reviews.title: Pesima experiencia  paradisus
reviews.text:
Hacen fiestas lprivadas y no se puede dormir !!
No dan respuesta el nombre de Manager no lo dan !
Restaursntes malos ! Restaurant italiano con tallarines cortados .
Te tratan de cobrar extra por todo muy mala experiencia !!
Los tours siempre tratan de engancharte para q compres su club de socios !!
Agotador !

reviews.author: Casdober
reviews.title: Desepción con Melia
reviews.text:
Mi opinión la voy a hacer muy breve. Espero que me responda Melia en ves del hotel.
dicho eso:
Creo que la gente que atiende,  sinceramente es extraordinadria,  en general los méxicanos son super amables.
Pero, debo decir que tengo una membresia de las más altas en Melia, y NO me siento atendido como tal,  he tenido la oportunidad de estar en varios hoteles de esta cadena, y sinceramente, tienes que tirar tu credencial para que "traten" de atenderte mejor. Me ha pasado en el Malia de Zanzibar, Madrid, Punta Cana, y ahora en Cancun...
De ahí mi comnetario.  
Espero que Melia me responda,  si no... les contare todas mi "anecdotas" con estos hoteles... mientras tanto NO recomiendo hacerse socio.

reviews.author: Kelly W
reviews.title: Theft from room safe
reviews.text:
Use caution , we are sol melia vacation club members for nearly 20 years , never before had an issue but this trip on our second day and employee hot our safe forever $400 cash .
Hotel has refuses to do anything and dragged their feet while we were at the resort. 
In 20nyears of world travel we have never made any theft claims .

reviews.author: Traveler17092523102
reviews.title: Be Warned -Worst Experience Ever!
reviews.text:
Before arrival, Otium could have been more courteous as I was trying to arrange the offered transportation to the hotel. Unfortunately, they kept hanging up the phone. 
I arrived at Paradisus and waited 30+ minutes to be checked in and rushed through. When I asked for details on the resort, I was told to read the card. 

The room view I purchased differed from what I received, and they could not accommodate it. In my room, the toilet ran nonstop, the power went out every morning, and the outlets stopped working, causing the refrigerator to leak. Imagine maintenance coming to your room every day. 

Housekeeping took items from my room, walked in on me naked without knocking, and just stood there taking a mental picture. 

I could not reserve half the restaurants because they were closed for the week. Moreover, finding a spot on the beach was challenging due to people holding places with towels. 

On the last day, I woke up late. My alarm did not sound because the power went out again! I called guest services, but they never came. I barely made my flight. 

I exercised much patience and consideration, but this prompted me to reach out to the guest services manager (ZANNINO, ROSANNA). She rushed through my concerns and promised to make things right and email me. 

I did not expect to be emailing for two months for what she offered. She never made things right or kept her promises and became verbally abusive, yelling at me over the phone. Because of this, I opted not to return.

reviews.author: michaelO5652IB
reviews.title: Not even close to luxury
reviews.text: Room service is terrible - items on the menu are often "not available", no alcohol can be delivered to the room (what!?), mini bar is awful, rooms are outdated, AC never stops running, are among the worst things with this hotel. We've stayed at some of the other 5 start hotels on the strip, and this more in line with a budget hotel (3 star). Don't waste your money.

reviews.author: Armin L
reviews.title: No good communication and just overcharging
reviews.text: I should say it was a great experience staying with them and specially their kids club service for the young kids, but the last day on the check out time was an awful note in my trip. It started when the receptionist informed me about the $120 USD standing in my room ,which was billed from few nights ago during the dinner time. The key point, which I brought it up to the attention of receptionist was, me and wife during that night asked for the wine, and waiter offered us lots of different bottles, which we asked for the one that is included to our room deal. Three times asked from the same waiter and confirmed with another different waiter was our approach. The interesting point was the time that when he(waiter) was talking to us regarding the food, notified us on some food are not included in our room deal, so it doesn't mean that he didn't understand us.

reviews.author: armin2572023
reviews.title: Bad customer service and information exchanging
reviews.text: We loved the entire experience until the last day before the check out, which was told for additional $120 USD charge on our room due to one the night's dinner charges. As I told to the receptionist, me and wife asked at least three times from the waiter regarding the wine, which was offered by the waiter if it is included in our room deal or not, he clearly said it is. We even asked another waiter to confirm it and he also agreed on it. It is getting interesting, when our waiter told us regarding some food that aren't included in our room deal. 10 Minutes before been picked up, I was informed with that charge and they even tried to reach out to the restaurant, but clearly no answer from no one. As I mentioned, we were happy with our experience until the last minute, which it just gave us unpleasant customer service right before leaving.

reviews.author: Ainatay2aina
reviews.title: Roach infestation
reviews.text: 1st night… I had a roach crawl up my leg in our bathroom. Next morning… woke up to 8 roaches in our room. They were in our bed, closet, dresser, and floor. They moved us to a 2nd room that had roaches as well. We open the refrigerator and found one crawling along the side. Moved us a 3rd time. This time there were no roaches inside the room but were outside on our balcony wall. The whole situation was poorly handled. I was promised a refund which I never received and as of today they still did not send me proof that they are going to refund me. Jan 30th to Feb 1st. Room 5419, 5009, and 4206. Beautiful resort but infested with roaches. I will NEVER come back.

reviews.author: Sherpa23193738876
reviews.title: Hotel with Inefficient management
reviews.text: Terrible hotel with inefficient management. So many bosses starring at their computer terminal with out being accountable for anything. We (9 of us) booked 4 rooms paid extra money for their Reserva category with benefits for premium drinks and restaurant. Everything in the hotel, drinks and food even with that category shows up as extra. Once they run out of drinks they do not even replace it. The quality and choices of food was limited and not that great. Poor maintenance, floors with puddles of water, roof in the corridors leaking. My daughter fell hit her head and injured her knee and finger. No compensation from the hotel. She wasted all her vacation in pain. I have stayed in a lot of Meliá hotels. This is by far is the worst one. I will not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: Martin M
reviews.title: Do not stay here.
reviews.text:
Not even close to other properties in Cancun at this price point.
The upgrade to the Reserve is basically an upgrade to a normal room just about anywhere in Cancun.
Please note this is my 20th visit. 
Other recent properties were 
Secrets Cancun
Hyatt Ziva Cancun
RIU multiple
Gran Caribe Real
Princess resorts etc 
The food and service is average.
Entertainment at this resort is basically non existent.
No animation staff
No music 
Activities non existent 
Water sports non existent 
Service at restaurants/ buffet average at best
No pride in what they do here 
Unwelcoming atmosphere
Do yourself a favour 
Save your money look for anything but.
The upgrade is $100 USD per night - this basically gets you a normal room that’s semi recently renovated - again this is likely 90% of resorts in Cancun
No bath / jacuzzi in the room 
Just standard shower etc 
2 cabana days per week are included with your upgrade .
A concierge that books your restaurant - you can do this yourself.
Mexican restaurant- uninspiring 
Fish restaurant- same 
Buffet average - a grilling station that is never on etc ..
This is basically a hotel with a room and average restaurants at best . It ends there.  The interior is unique and beautiful- but so are the others.
Room 5403 
Presently still here

reviews.author: R G
reviews.title: Extremely Horrible Room Experience.
reviews.text:
1) I spent about $5600 for me and my daughters to book 1 Bedroom Suite Deluxe Ocean View in The Reserve category directly from the Melia site.  At the time of booking and a couple of weeks before arriving I confirmed the booking and made sure they will be providing 2 beds.  Reservation also confirmed it

2) On arrival on 12/21, they first charged my credit card within 5 minutes of arrival and then said the room I booked is not available but there is another room with 2 beds. I checked the room and there is no ocean view from the balcony.  It faces another building of same hotel.  I went back to check-in area and all they said we are sorry and they will move me next day

3) Next day they moved me to the room and it only had 1 King bed and they said they will send an extra bed as we are 3.  In Spite of asking three 3 times no one came

4) I had to sleep on the tiny couch in the living room.  Now you tell me after spending about $5600 for 5 nights and sleeping on the couch.

5) During check I complained and they did not do anything

6) After arriving back ,  I emailed and only thing they say " we are sorry for the inconvenience

I would not recommend this Hotel to anyone as they dont provide the room what they promised and they would charge within minutes of arrival and then you are stuck with that hotel.

reviews.author: Sightseer41580511215
reviews.title: Far from paradise
reviews.text:
Went for a music festival (Sunsoaked), and can tell you this resort fell short on every expectation. Paid over $3500 for 4 days, food was terrible. Upgraded to "The Reserve" 
 and into a suite after they moved me from the the Fiesta Americana, where i had booked a room with a pool in it. Weren't able to enjoy the real perks as most things need a reservation. The steakhouse (need a reservation and only open while the event was going on). Breakfast was more European style, and not really my thing. Drinks were very much watered down, unless you started tipping heavy (i know, that's the expectation) but for a trip where i spent close to $5k to enjoy, nothing was magical about this resort and i would recommend going anywhere else but the Melia hotels. Staff and location are the 2 thigs i can say were amazing every step of the way. Spend your money at one of the branded hotels, and don't fall for the all-inclusive tag. Suite was large, but i was by myself in the room and really only wanted the pool in my room that i originally reserved. No sorry. No ask to move. Just moved to the reserve and told it was better. I can imagine it was not.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.title: Don’t bring babies here
reviews.text:
Horrible experience with baby. Loud live music in the lobby almost every night until 11pm. The room is shaking with it. Called the concierge but nothing was done. 
They should not have advertised it as family friendly hotel.

If you like party, this might be for you.

reviews.author: agarcia2023
reviews.title: Cucarachas en las tuberías y mala atención en recepción
reviews.text: Mi cuarto tenía cucarachas que salían de las tuberías por la noche. Además, un amigo tuvo problemas con su pago y lo trataron como vagabundo en lugar de ser comprensivos y dar una ayuda servicial. Al final el pago procedió pero no nos quita el mal sabor de voca.

reviews.author: Chary A
reviews.title: Que decepción...
reviews.text: Ya me había hospedado anteriormente en este hotel y siempre me iba con un excelente sabor de boca, desgraciadamente en esta ocasión no fué así, el servicio deja mucho que desear, si no das propina te ignoran y son hasta groseros, mucha discriminación al nacional, las instalaciones de la habitación muy viejas y en mal estado, llovió y llegó el agua hasta las camas, pocos contactos eléctricos y los que habían muy viejos y flojos, la limpieza deja mucho que desear, los alimentos del bufet poco variados, acostumbren desayunar exactamente lo mismo todos los días que se hospeden, siempre faltan toallas para alberca y el personal del restaurante de la alberca discriminan al nacional bien cañón, que desgracia que después de tener tan buenos recuerdos de ese hotel todo se haya venido abajo en esta visita, obviamente no regreso.

reviews.author: Janis
reviews.title: Unheated pool and spas
reviews.text: We are at Melia paradisus Cancún. The property is great but they are not heating any of the pools. There are many families here this holiday week but hardly anyone is in the pool because It’s too cold. Even the hot tub is not heated.  For the amount of money we are spending for 5 rooms, it is very disappointing that none of our 11 people use the pools comfortably.  Many of the staff also seem surprised that the heaters are not in use.  We would like to have the heaters turned on during our stay.

reviews.author: drjunaid
reviews.title: For those how know what service is
reviews.text: My tip to people who are looking to stay in Cancun "There are better all-inclusive Hotels in Cancun than Paradius. Also, other hotels do not have a discriminatory system that this hotel has. This hotel makes you and your kids feel inferior in this day and age. The reason why people go to all-inclusive is because they can eat everywhere. There are a lot of better options for your money that you are spending then to spend money with this hotel. Look into Moon Palace Grand, Moon Palace, Hyatt, Dreams, La Blanc before you even consider this hotel.

reviews.author: Junaid Syed
reviews.title: There are better all inclusive hotels. This was my worst experience.
reviews.text: We went to the steak restaurant. The service was poor. Steak was so tough that I couldn’t eat it. The person waiting on us so rude. I have been coming to Cancun for the last 20 years and never had an experience of waiter behave so rudely as well as his manager. First and last time in this hotel. I stayed here because my friend was staying here. They’re a lot better all inclusive hotels in Cancun. Consider other hotels.

reviews.author: d00byd00
reviews.title: Horrible food, run!
reviews.text: The level of food was disgusting. This was the worst food ive eaten in my 20 years of travelling. The staff can be a mixed bag, the reserve is not worth anything unless your an adult as everything you get with reserve is adults only

reviews.author: barbaradlg83
reviews.title: Pésima experiencia
reviews.text: Horrible la habitación con plaga de juanes, la atención de todo el personal pésima, poca amabilidad y actitud de todos. Las albercas heladas , poca variedad en el bufett, está muy viejo y sucio el hotel .

reviews.author: Tracy S
reviews.title: The Reserve not so reserved!
reviews.text:
Don't pay for the upgrade to have a kid free or exclusive part of the hotel. Kids and purple band customers tramped through all day long. No one was paying attention to the rules. There needs to be "gold band only area and no kids" sign posted for this area. It was a disappointment. Room service was meh, no to go boxes for the buffet, and the EDM music we heard all night was horrible. Our concierge was nonexistent.

The best part was Rueben and Miguel, day servers at the Reserve.

reviews.author: thetravelingblondie
reviews.title: Disappointing-will not return
reviews.text:
We stayed with this hotel in 2019 and had a great experience, so, since we were heading back from Holbox and needed to stay close to the airport for a morning flight, we elected to stay here again. 

Where do I begin? We arrived at 4:30pm and we were informed that all the restaurant reservations were taken, so the only “all inclusive” restaurant we were able to eat at for 3 meals was the buffet. 

Our room was is terrible condition-one plug was literally hanging out of the wall, the sliding door didn’t open (the track was broken) and all night there was a club bumping bass until 3am above us. 

Such a disappointment and waste of money. Go elsewhere!

reviews.author: Marigold
reviews.title: Stressful  Trip
reviews.text:
Where to start ... Cancun always was our favorite getaway place for me and my family. My daughter got married at Ocean Coral & Turquesa Hotel in Puerto Morelos Mexico. It was so magical and beautiful. My eldest son decided to get married at the Fiesta Americana Cancun and again they went above and beyond to make their wedding magical. Since the both weddings were amzing my youngest son chose Paradisus for his wedding, assuming he would have the same experience like his siblings. He assumed it would be even more spectacular since this hotel was more expensive and a five-star hotel, but it turned into a nightmare leaving a bitter taste.
WE WERE WRONG. They served completely the wrong meal plate that we chose on the wedding day. They forgot some tables (we thought they already served them) and served the meal very late. Instead of giving the meal of steak and chicken, with pasta and veggies, they served meat with a spoon of potatoes for 1 plate, and chicken with potatoes for the next one. There was not even a choice for guests, they had to eat what they were served. If you asked for chicken instead (the other dish they were serving) they refused to give it to you. Guests were swapping meals with each other at their table. Embarrassing.
The worst part was the wedding card box. It was not given to us at the end of the night. When we went to pick up the box the next day, there was cash missing and some of the card envelopes were open and missing. When we spoke to the manager, Jose, he declined the robbery and he refused to show us the footage, as they have cameras all over the hotel.
They took responsibility for the meal confusion by offering a SPA TREATMENT
after spending $25000 USD for 55 ppl. This is what they offered.. I NEVER FELT SO INSULTED LIKE THAT DAY.
After escalating the matter to a higher level, they offered to refund $800, which we HAVEN'T receive yet
It was a very stressful week and a disappointment… I'm very shocked.
If my first daughter's wedding was like this I would never encourage a destination wedding..
Some other issues…
*Rooms were old and outdated. The floor was stained with shoe spots. I had to take a picture and show the front desk so they would come and clean it.
*The Bath tub was dirty with a ring of mold around the top of it.
*The buffet was very basic. The same standard food everyday. A lot of stew dishes, which seemed to be leftovers from the day before. Long line ups waiting for omelet for breakfast, as there was only one chef. It felt like a continental buffet, not special at all.
*Very outdated way to make reservations for restaurants. Reservations were very limited. I was only able to make one reservation at 9 PM for the entire week I was there! They make it hard for you so you are forced to eat at the buffet.
*Went to the pool and it looked like someone vomited, we called for assistance it took them one hour to come.
*The beach shower was broken. No water to wash your feet from the sand.
*Hard to get towels for the beach.
* The alcohol drinks were very poor quilty. Definitely intentional brands.
Paradisus is a 3 star hotel with a lot of improvements needed.. far from 5 stars. YES, there were a few good things but unfortunately all of the bad things overshadow the good..
Bad management, Bad food, Bad wedding. So sad

reviews.author: Courtney B
reviews.title: Worst stay ever
reviews.text:
Worst stay at an all inclusive resort ever. One thing after another led to a terrible experience. We were traveling as a family including grandparents and our 10 month old baby and stayed for a week. 

Our first night we went to the buffet and there were cockroaches running over our feet and climbing up the bench seats. We literally ran out of there because one of them tried to crawl in the diaper bag! So gross. Also the food was not labeled and I ate the biggest scoop of the spiciest salsa of my life! My mouth was on fire for a good 30 minutes, which was both hilarious and infuriating at the same time. 

We were assigned a concierge on the second day of our stay. We told him we were flexible for dinner reservations and that he could book them between 6-7pm at any restaurant for the week and that we would like to try them all. He said this would help him to make the reservations because we didn’t demand specific restaurants or times. We still had 2 out of 4 reservations that were not booked correctly. Really poor communication. We were booked for Sal’s after an excursion day and we even had to cut our excursion a little short so we could get back in time for our reservation. When we showed up to Sal’s the hosts rushed over and were very abrasive and rude and said no they can’t seat us because there are no babies allowed. That would have been nice to know before we were standing in front of them. Especially when we rushed our excursion to Chichen-itza for nothing. So we were forced to eat at the roach buffet again and again there were cockroaches running all over the floor. The following night we were booked for the Italian restaurant and when we showed up for our reservation the host said he didn’t have a table for us. He said they were double booked and tried to seat us in the entryway! Like the waiting area! All 7 of us plus the baby! Meanwhile there was a table set for 10 and they never showed up; so we had to beg for that table instead. 

We made poolside Cabana reservations several days ahead of time for 3 of the days during our stay. The first day was no problem. The next day we were standing waiting for Elliot for 20 minutes until finally another staff member told us our cabanas were given away. Neither Jose (our concierge) nor Elliot ever communicated to us that we needed to “check in by 11” the first time we made a reservation, but that was their excuse for not having cabanas for us that day.  

The waiters at the pool got our orders wrong every time we ordered food or drinks. Sometimes we never got what we ordered. The elevators were broken and we had to lug the stroller up and down all the flights of stairs everywhere we went. 

We have never had to complain before because we usually have good experiences with club Melia but this was on another level. We could have overlooked some things but it was just one inconvenience after another and left a really poor taste in our mouth about the whole vacation. We did not have the pleasant experience that we expected to have.

reviews.author: Navigator639231
reviews.title: Pésima recepción
reviews.text: Acabo de llegar y a pesar de ser reserve no te dan opción para reservar en ningún restaurante mas que los que les sobra y buffet. Lo había leído antes y confirmo. No reserven en este hotel. Justifican diciendo que solo tienen 10 mesas en cada restaurante y tienen 5 pirámides. Ilógico pero bueno mejor hubiese ido a secrets. Me voy el jueves y pues ni modo a cenar  puro buffet. Ojo no vengan si quieren conocer los restaurantes a la carta. Desde el inicio se los condicionaran

reviews.author: gaston b
reviews.title: Sistema de membresia no es más que un chiste y ya acercándose a la ESTAFA.
reviews.text:
En el año 2014 compre una membresia más cual utilice todos los años y fui viendo y viviendo el deterioro por falta de mantenimiento de los 2 lugares que visite:
