reviews.author: ShaanS74
reviews.title: You're better off staying on the street - never again.
reviews.text:
Hands down the worst resort I have ever stayed in.  We had been working with the resort for 4 months prior to our stay, as it was a large family reunion of almost 30 people.  Thinking that we had blocked rooms and working on a group rate, we would all be together.  But nothing of the sort.  Every reservation had us scattered across 9 different floors, but if that was not bad enough, rooms for the SAME reservation made by a person were not on the same floor, let alone next to each other (I had two rooms, one on the 3rd floor, the other on the 8th).  Every single reservation made by family was like this.  It took us over 2 hours to check in for each group in the family because they were so disorganized. On top of that: NO bell service to help with luggage.  We were told that we had to take our own luggage and we were in the Reserve building of the resort, where we were supposed to have our own concierge. Speaking of the Reserve: if you come in after 6PM, the Reserve office is closed and you have to check in from Building 5, which is an open-air spot in the middle of the floor.  Made no sense to me when the Reserve is in Building 3.  And I could not understand why the Reserve office was not open 24/7, when the non-Reserve check-in area was.  Why not do check-in from there?  Made no sense at all.  

Speaking of the concierge - total nonsense.  She was completely useless.  She would not respond to messages, sometimes had a day off (and we were on the resort for a week), or wouldn't start until midday.  No back up person for us to work with.  Any dining reservations, I would have to go up and down 8 floors to sort out at the restaurant desk on the ground floor (this was EVERYDAY for every family meal).  It was ridiculous.  The pools would run out of towels on a daily basis and it was like toilet paper during the pandemic when they would bring the cart of clean ones out (and you didn't know when that was - people were hovering like vultures).  I have never had to fend for myself as much as I did on this vacation.  I would NEVER come back here and I do not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Anne N
reviews.title: Staff Steals Your Money! Don’t Book Here!!!
reviews.text: I accidentally left my wallet here in their lobby/entrance area 11/3/22 as I was exploring. I realized I left it in it there after 10 mins of leaving it behind. Security "found" it and claimed I left it on the street lol. They took $300+ USD cash from my wallet and returned the wallet back to me with out the cash. Thanks for nothing crooked Paradisus. Security and staff are crooked. To management, if your security tells you a different story, they are lying! They are thieves. From the secuirty who checks in guests at the entrance to the security on the beach side. Thanks for stealing my cash and returning my wallet! I do not recommend anyone booking here. They are untruthful crooked thieves.

reviews.author: Carlos Ameneyro
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio de información en recepción y concierge
reviews.text:
Llame para conocer los servicios de Day pass y los horarios
1- me comentaron por teléfono que a partir de las 11:00 hrs a 17:00 hrs
2- Al día siguiente me presente a las 10:30 hrs, y me dejaron hasta las 11:15 por que no había brazaletes, ya que llegué en el horario que los responables de los mismos y de los Day pass tienen junta,
3- Nadie más pudo atendernos, ni los gerentes de recepción ni nadie más capacitado, totalmente burocráticos 
4- que el Day pass es de 9:00 hrs a 18:hrs
, me comentaron ya los demas colaboradores, muy amables después de lo mal que nos atendieron

-Deben de capacitar mejor a sus empleados de recepción y que sean más empáticos, y que den bien la infomación desde inicio

No lo recomiendo por estas situaciones de mala atención de información y de bienvenida

reviews.author: lawrence g
reviews.title: Fake Liquor
reviews.text: I am currently at the Paradisius Cancun, the liquor they serve is water with flavoring. This is how they make money with all inclusive. I ordered several different Tequilas, they are all water with flavoring. I even asked the bartender if he realized it, he just winked at me and walked away saying nothing I can do Senor. I’m sure the executives at Meliá know about this and are purposefully violating the law. Stay away from any Melia resort. Cheats and scammers.

reviews.author: Cess
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN IN ROOM. Don’t stay here if you want to feel safe.
reviews.text:
DON’T STAY HERE. YOU CAN GET ROBBED AND THE HOTEL WILL REFUSE TO DO THE RIGHT THING.

We had a reservation for 7 nights at the Paradisus Cancun to handle some business while trying to enjoy a bit of a vacation getaway. Half way through our stay we had left money in our room for a few hours and had $2,000 USD in cash disappear. When we arrived back in our room, the room was reset and our money was gone.  

We tried to talk to security and guest services. They triple checked our room and reassured us they would do an investigation to follow up on what happened and who entered. 

To be honest, for most of our stay we have had really great customer service. From Antonio up at the front desk who helped us move rooms our first day (since our original assigned room did not have a working air conditioner), to every smiling face that laughed and joked with us at the 24hr coffee station, and all the very sweet staff at each restaurant who would remember things about us and would joke with the other visitors children.  We really had enjoyed our first few days at Paradisus. It is hard for us to feel so sad and disappointed in the end when we have tried to be patient and understanding, believing in the due process which they promised us would amount to something. Perhaps we were naive to think that any place would be safe from the dark things that can happen in the world but we did expect better from the hotel in regards to a response to help us cope with our financial loss. You come to a inclusive resort to melt your worries away, not to add to the anxiety we already deal with on a daily basis to even make the dollars to get here.

After 72 hours of patiently waiting for their investigation to be completed , speaking kindly to those every morning at the guest services hoping for an update, I am left in tears of frustration that the only reassurance and compensation they are willing to give us is a voucher for 2 nights to come back to the place that tarnished my first memories of Cancun. Imagine paying for a 6 hour flight round trip from CA to stay 2 nights at a place that literally stole your money. How does that even make sense? We asked for at least 3 days to make it more reasonable.  Their reasoning for the result of the investigation, you ask? Their room staff had worked here for years and so they trust them. That’s the whole investigation, justification and conclusion.

We tried to resolve this with them directly but as you can imagine they are protecting their staff and hotel. We understand it is a business and like I told Christian the supervisor at guest services and Astrid the guest services supervisor who assisted us in trying to recoup some kind of compensation for our loss, that we also worked very very hard to even make this trip happen and saved all we could hoping to have a vacation we would remember for a lifetime. We know they work very hard too.

All I will remember now, is not the music at the bars and dancing with the performers, the great dishes at the restaurants, or excellent service from everyone else we had interacted with. But instead the frustration of coming everyday to speak with them when I would rather have been at the beach, the hurt of dealing with people who originally told us they would do nothing, and the last 2 days of our trip that we spent almost begging for them to do more than shoo us away and tell us to forget about it.  I’ll always remember all the tears, the deflation of walking to our room trying to figure out how we could swallow and  recover from this loss, and the shock we first had when we came and couldn’t find it.

In the end all we have is a hotel voucher for 2 nights with the expectation we will have to spend even more money to even make it a reasonable trip, coming all the way from California. Please don’t spend your money here. Pick a different hotel, there are so many other beautiful places in Cancun. Behind all the nice things at Paradisus, there are so many things that can happen that you’d never expect and they will do little to nothing about. This is a warning to all my fellow travelers. And to Paradisus - do better, no one wants to leave a vacation in tears.

reviews.author: Alon B
reviews.title: Worst experience you can imagine.
reviews.text:
This hotel doesn't have a manager. So you could literally see how nothing was functioning:

- The reception had lines almost every time. Once we got to talk with the staff, they 
   were nice, wrote down our requests but never dealt with them.
- The 'booking department' is in charge of the restaurant bookings. Yet they are 
  hardly there. When I finally got the speak with them you could see I was disturbing 
  their chit-chat. You couldn't believe how rude they can get (Alexis).
- The hotel was constantly dirty; the elevators were always wet, we spotted dead 
  cockroaches at the restaurants and there was food in the water in the swimming 
  pools more than once.
- They tell you that they have workshops or parties at the hotel. This is partly true.
  They had 2 events in the week we were there. We attended a cocktail workshop 
   the only consisted of tasting. We did not prepare any cocktails.
- They published to have 7 restaurants. When we got there, one was closed.
   Another cost a lot of money even though we had an all-inclusive package. A third 
   (the tacos place) was always empty, cause you had to wait 10 minutes for every 
   small taco.
- Don't get me starting on their beach: not a nice one to start with. The beds there 
  were constantly dirty. There was no staff. So no drinks and cleaned our beds by 
  ourselves. When we wanted to take one of those big beds suddenly someone did 
  approach us, only to try and sell it to us for 250 $ (!).

One good thing?

Their children's staff was out of this world. Best regards especially to Esmeralda.

Also, many thanks to: Arnulfo, Ada, Manuel, Jonathan and Raul, who tried their best to save our vacation. Single people in a otherwise not recommendable hotel.

reviews.author: beachmamajm
reviews.title: Not Recommended Misrepresented the Reserve
reviews.text: We are seasoned travelers and work in the travel industry and have vacationed in Cancun previously. First the Pros: The servers in Malva (buffet) were wonderful! Housekeeping was thorough. Beautiful landscaping and pools. Concierge at pool & cabanas also wonderful.  Coffee Nespresso shop was very good too.  The views are amazing from this resort making for great vacation photos. Now the Cons:  The Reserve (adult only building) Premium Suites was misrepresented. It was NOT adult only with young children being chased by parents and yelling throughout the halls and lounging areas. I have photos of it all. The so called concierge they provide in the Reserve is nonexistent. Whenever I asked for things or info I received neither. Texts are saved on my phone also. Room service didn’t show up in the morning when I ordered coffee but in the evening was very good and fast too. If you like air conditioning you can forget that at this resort. The room never reached cooler than 75-77 and the resort common areas, Ginger bar/club, most restaurants and lounge areas have zero ventilation or ac. It feels like a rainforest/sauna from the second you leave your suite. Maintenance came twice to our hot humid suite and stated that was as cool as our room would reach. Bathroom door didn’t close all the way and no lock. We did bring to the attention of guest services that families w young children were staying in our building and were loud and their response was yes we put them there and maybe next month we will not. So they charge you premium price for adult only but they are misrepresenting! Food absolutely atrocious everywhere we ate. Room service was the only good food. This is so far from even a 4 star resort that it’s sad. The staff give you free breakfast if you leave good reviews which is why you will find some good reviews. This resort needs a complete updating and new director of entertainment and food service. The app and menus online are all in Spanish only.  Elevators were scarce and poorly lit hallways or no lighting at all.  They did provide a portable fan in our luxury suite which really didn’t do much to cool the room but they tried & offered to move us but when shown the suite it was hotter than ours. This all made for an extremely disappointing stay at the Paradise Cancun Reserve.  I do not recommend this place and I certainly would never come back. Don’t waste your money there are too many great places to stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Phenomjet
reviews.title: Poor quality for 5 star prices
reviews.text: AC in room does not work woke up soaked in sweat told them twice and they never fixed it or moved me to new room!  Spa services total rip off over 200 USD for 75 min massage!  Restaurants are boring and lack entertainment in fact the entire hotel is boring and lacks entertainment.  It’s very dated and showing its age.  Poor design where you have to walk too far to get to your room and back.  Lacks water park type amenities at pool and entertainment at pool basically this place is old and boring with awful AC and food is ok at best.  Not a good deal for 400 a night.

reviews.author: janet g
reviews.title: Hot rooms (77*-82*). Very hot
reviews.text:
We were originally scheduled to go to Paradisus Cancun in March of 2020. And then the world shut down. Fast forward to August 2022. 
We’ve been to many all inclusive resorts (including reserve paradisus punta Cana)

The rooms are hot. 80*. Not kidding. They try to fix by changing the filter but it will remain hot in your room. Don’t pay for ocean view bc you have to keep the curtains closed. 

We stayed for a full week in the reserve section. We had a deluxe ocean view room. Before arriving, we received an email stating we were in a jr suite. When I called CS to make sure they had us in the correct room, the man on the phone was unbelievably rude. Told me to “stop talking” so he could read my reservation info to me. Huh. 

Upon arriving at the resort, we noticed how beautiful the lobby is. Humid but gorgeous. 

Our room was lovely. Housekeeping is exceptional. Eva, I think, did a great job. 

A few mornings a week, yoga is offered at the outside gazebo overlooking the ocean. The waves were so soothing. I wanted to try the stretch class but the instructor never arrived so I used the well appointed gym. 

We used the Bali beds which is a really nice perk. We loved the ocean view ones. Joel at the Bali beds was a great server. Valeria also AMAZING!
Caesar in tower 5 reserve area was great about clearing our glasses and plates during a cocktail hour. 
Lunch box service by Teresa and Antonio and richer was perfect. They checked on us constantly refilling our drinks. 
At Capella, we also had great service. (Maybe Josue. I can’t recall)
Pedro and sofino at sports bar so so good. Seriously Pedro is the best bartender. The. Best. 
Roberto great server also at sports bar. Polite and friendly. 
Sofonia and giovani were friendly and professional. 
Ernesto at Lemon Fish was amazing server. And that food was really good and fresh!
I hate buffets. Hate. But the buffet here was good. Each day had different choices. 
Our favorite restaurant was Cielo. That food was unbelievable. 
We’ve been to many all inclusive and some have cost a lot more money (sandals). The service and food here was very very good. 
Our concierges were Violeta and Mauricio. They were extremely responsive every time we made any request. They were professional and friendly. Ask for them. You won’t be disappointed. 

Would we stay here again ? No. We would not. 

Why? Because the temperature of the room was too warm. Goodness knows they tried several times to make our room cooler. Even with their efforts the rooms temp never got below 77* (it was btw 77*-82* the entire stay) and that is uncomfortable for us. We are from Houston so heat is not foreign for us. But the room was way, way too hot. 

***Don’t spend extra money on ocean view bc we had to keep the blinds drawn or would have been unbearable. That was a rip off for us. Wasted money***

Sadly, that is a deal breaker for us. I understand it’s been a warm summer. We live in Houston, so we are used to the heat. We’ve traveled many places in summertime (Guatemala, Jamaica, DR, PR). My husband has MS and it’s triggered by the heat. And the entire stay, he dealt with issues bc of the warmth of our room. Usually we can go to the room and cool off. Not here. We’ve never dealt with a hot room before. We visited many tropical locations and the heat in the room has never been a problem. 

So sadly, in spite of the good food, great cocktails, and amazing service, we won’t be returning to Paradisus Cancun.

I emailed management about the AC. They responded that I told the concierge that we were enjoying our vacation. 

Management doesn’t address the issue. Before booking checking thr Facebook groups. The room temperature is a constant issue for most of the guests. It’s uncomfortable. And not enjoyable.

reviews.author: Alex Torales
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio al cliente
reviews.text: Llegando al hotel y servicio pésimo. Tuvimos un tema con nuestra reserva y Marisol y Diana según supervisoras de recepción pésima actitud con cero servicio al cliente. En vez de buscar atender el tema de mi reservación, y buscar una solución, tuvieron a mi familia esperando y preocupados, sin acercarse a ver por ellos. En mi vida vuelvo a pararme en un Paradisus o cadena Meliá. A parte  Playa fea.

reviews.author: Paula B
reviews.title: Ferias pessimas
reviews.text: Estou n esse hotel ,pagei por um service com upegrete e nao tenho nada 😔chegei na 2 feira e hoje e 4 feira ja queria ir embora.atendimento zero .nao tinha o meu qarto pelo qual eu pagei depois de reclmar dereme um quarto 3 feiras as 16 h.mas sem vista mar * ao so um qatinho .no rez do chao onde vejo mais relva q mar....nao aconselho a ninguem para vir a este hotel.( e ja viagei muito).sanita avariada .... ....o meu mordono Victor e impecável e muito prestavel.bao merese 5 estrelas....péssimo (comida muito boa)

reviews.author: E4908LVdavidb
reviews.title: Very disappointing. The worse Melia out of the 4 I've been.
reviews.text:
I have been to the hotels in Punta Cana, Playa del Carmen, Tenerife, and Cancun. This is by far the worst of them. 
Room: The room was OK, with a comfortable kind bed, and an extremely uncomfortable sofa bed. We asked for an additional twin bed, which came a day later and was good. The big issue with the room, is that the temperature (of all 3 rooms that we had) is extremely uneven. So the kids were freezing in the twin bed and sofa bed, and we were almost sweating in the king bed. 
Restaurants: Most of the restaurants were OK. The "Cielo" Restaurant had a great lamb dish, and the Italian restaurant was very good. The seafood restaurant by the pool has a pretty good dinner, but forgettable lunches. But in conclusion, the a la carte restaurants were good, and the buffet is sub par. 
Pool: The pool was very outdated and pretty disgusting. There were little to no attempts by the staff to get people from eating in the pool, and the water just looks murky. 
Activities: Very few activities for adults. Also, no organizers that get people involved and going. It is like they don't want to really have any activities, but they feel like they have to. A big different from resorts that create a community between guests. And the kids club which is for ages 5-10, is really for kids 4-7.
Aquaworld: So the hotel has outsourced all their responsibilities to have outdoor activities to a third party called aquaworld. Of course, this third party has only one interest, which is to sell you as much additional stuff as possible. Only midway through our trip did we learn that they had some included water activities like sailing, as these guys just want to rent jet skis or trip to Isla Mujeres. 
Concierge: Literally saw her once. She was fairly good about providing some assistance (and booking dinner reservations) through WhatsApp, but not very proactive or informative. In Paradisus Playa del Carmen, you come back to your room top find a bottle of champagne, a bubble bath with balloon animals for the kids, and little things like this. But in Cancun, you are lucky to have simply requests (like an extra bed) fulfilled in a timely manner. 
Value: You would think that subpar service and facilities would command a lower price... well, that's not the case. 

Overall, I am extremely disappointed with this hotel, and with the entire Melia Organization. They discontinued the Club Melia offering, and now are trying to sell you a new one, while doing the bare minimum to keep their existing commitments.

As a word of advice - If you are not between 18-30, stay out of Cancun. The beaches are full of seaweed, and the place is basically a party place. If you want to go and drink all day by the pool, and party all night, this is the place for you. But if you have a family, or you simply want to do more stuff, go to Playa del Carmen or other locations outside the Yucatan peninsula.  Also, go to the Xcaret parks, which to me is the only reason to ever go back to that general location. Also, skip Isla Mujeres. Not worth the trip.

reviews.author: Victoria García
reviews.title: Decepcion absoluta
reviews.text:
No es un hotel de 5*. Las habitaciones son antiquísimas, los baños horribles, aparte de antiquísimos, no funcionan bien los desagües, las habitaciones están falta de enchufes, algunas con una sola mesita de noche. 
No hay ningún bar en el hotel donde tomar una Copa en vaso de cristal, cierran los bares prontisimos, a las 10 de la noche sólo sirven en un bar. El restaurante deja mucho que desear en cuanto a la calidad 
En la. Piscina no se puede coger una hamaca si no la reservas a las 6 de la mañana poniendo una toalla encima. 
Pagar lo que cuesta este hotel es tirar el dinero. 
No está en relación la calidad con el precio. 
Necesita una grandísima reforma
No volveré jamás y nunca lo recomendaria

reviews.author: Dominika B
reviews.title: Poor experience.
reviews.text: We have stayed in the hotel for few nights prior departure to home. I was glad we stayed for the most of holiday in Meliá Playa de Carmen. The overall experience from the checking was appealing. The Meliá status recognition. Hard sell of resort shares with vague promise of receiving Bali bed which are actually free of charge in Playa de Carmen resort. Poor communication prior arrival with hotel concierge   . I tried to booked in advance some restaurants as I did in Playa de Carmen with no success. In fact I received email at the end of stay suggesting the person was away (no acknowledge email ever sent) I agree with previous reviewer that rooms are outdated with noisy air conditioning. Pools need urgent update as well. Overall I would recommend to Playa de Carmen resort.

reviews.author: Angie C
reviews.title: Only if you want to be frustrated and have your time wasted. Do Better! Mélia not good for your portfolio.
reviews.text:
Well sitting here on my second day at the Reserve desk waiting again, being gaslighted with an understanding tone, but doing absolutely nothing. 

A lot of acting like they will be accountable but really nothing that is of Mélia standard. 

No going above and beyond after compounding factors on their end, and using gaslighting as a technique to make me think it was my fault. 

Below is an email that I wrote to the Mélia corporate and Paradisus, but I know Paradisus does not check. 

“Hello,

I don’t know that this is actually going to get through to anyone. 

I am writing this as I am unable to sleep because I am upset at the situation that we have been through today at your property Paradisus Cancun. 

I chose your hotel because it is a Mélia property,I had recently stayed in a Mélia property in Sitges Spain and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I am a Mélia member. I thought this would be a good place to treat my parents while celebrating my fathers birthday. 

I booked a Premium One Bedroom Master Suite for 2nights through the official Mélia App. 
I was offered an upgraded upon my online check in, it was for a Reserve junior suite. It was a king bed with a sofa. But there were other rooms with additional fees. I chose to keep my room since the layout fit our needs and figured I would ask at the hotel about the Reserve and room upgrades. 
We arrived at 3pm as indicated in the online check in. We did not receive any attention was just directed to the front desk, while others were escorted. Which is fine, but noticeable. At the front desk when checking in I explained the upgrade that was offered and my interest in the Reserve and how I liked the layout of having a separate bedroom and living room. I wanted to know how much the reserve experience was. 
I was told $75 pp, per night. I accepted. But I was not offered a room in the Reserve building or a Reserve room. This is where I believe the misunderstanding happened where they didn’t understand I was asking if there was an equivalent room at the Reserve. 

I now realize the price that I paid for the upgrade is the exact price of what was offered online for a Reserve One Bedroom. 
Why was I not offered this? It is the same layout with a separate bedroom and living room. 

I am paying for it with the upgrade. But we were given our original room in pyramid 2. 

What is making it all the more upsetting is the compounding thing to the whole experience. 
We were told this room was not ready, and would take 30min, at 3:30pm. We went to get a snack and came back 40min after with a long line, was directed to go over to the Reserve front desk.  Went over, they could not help us, was redirected back to the regular front desk.  Waited again and then was told the room was still not ready and needed another 25min. We were offered an addition 2hrs for late check out for our inconvenience. I asked if we could get some information about the Reserve, how it worked, all the amenities, access, reservations, butler etc.  Was offered no information but the map of the hotel and told to go have a snack again.

  My mother saw that other people had someone showing them around the hotel so we requested for someone to show us around and help us make a reservation at a restaurant. I had tried on the app but was not confirmed. 
The young gentleman Charlie volunteered to show us around and to help us. 
We asked about the Reserve and for reservations and when he realized we’ve been waiting since 3pm and now it was close to 5pm he got to trying to help us problem solve. Brought us to the reservation desk, there was no one since we earlier passed the desk at 4pm. The person was on lunch. 
We walked over to the Reserve Pyramid where he spoke to a gentleman there, trying to help us. It was now past 5:40pm. He double checked that our bracelets were activated and said our room was now ready. 
We were brought to our room and Charlie had offered to help us with our reservations and sent for our luggage since I had medication that I needed to take at 6pm. 
We also notified that there was no bedding for the sofa bed.  What were they doing for almost 3hrs? We are three people and one King bed? 

I had further inquired about the butler/concierge service with the Reserve, we were not assigned one, the Bali day bed with the Reserve, the restaurant reservations with Charlie and he was trying to get the information for us. 

I was told It was too late for any of the reservations as everyone was now off duty. I could make all my reservations tomorrow morning at the golden pool at 8am with the butler there. 

At 6:10pm We tried our luck at the Lemon Fish where I had a pending reservation which I made through the app at 3:30pm for 7pm. Inquired about it and were told it was not confirmed. We were told to come back in 30min to wait for a cancellation. We did this, and then was told we could eat sushi at the bar and wait to see if a table would be available. We did this but no tables ever were. 
We ended up going to the buffet afterwards and made it back to our room for 9:30pm. 
This when we are actually spending time in our room and we start to notice the details. 
Never mind it being dated and not at all like the photos, but I am not sure how thoroughly it was cleaned. Attached are photos.  Some weird random dirty thing by the sink, she shower are gritty, also didn’t work properly, even following the instructions. Stained sheets. 

It was late I was tired, I figured I would deal with this in the morning. 
But then I woke up and thought about it and realized, I paid for an upgrade and have received nothing that is suppose to be with it, not the room, and definitely not the service. The only person that even attempted to help was this Charlie. 

We have been very courteous, and patient through out all of this. 
I will go to the Reserve side and speak to a butler tomorrow, to resolve all of this because I have very little faith that anyone at the front desk will actually help resolve any of this for us. 
I want our room at the Reserve, and I want our Reserve experience and service. 

My doubt of the front desk and who ever answers their emails, because I had emailed before our arrival about how this was my parents first time at an all inclusive and we were celebrating my fathers birthday and if we could have some little touches to highlight this. 
The front desk had no notes on this. 

I am thoroughly disappointed, our experience seems exceptionally off brand. 
Hoping there is actually a person at the end of the email reading this and able to rectify anything.”

Now I am being told that I did not pay for an upgrad to the Reserve and. that I was given an upgraded room. Yet I have the Reserve bracelet, I paid the via money with my credit card. I did not pay $450usd to use a pool. 

A few min later. 
After trying to stick me still in Pyramid 2 and not a Reserve in Pyramid 5,  they are willing to give me a Reserve room, but it’s a down grade. 
From a Premium Master One bedroom to. Junior suite. 
Talk about minimum effort.  After all that I have been through, you seriously are telling me that you aren’t even going to try to do better? 

And of course the managers are conveniently all in a meeting. 
Hey @Melia is this the Mélia experience? Do as little as possible to retain a customer. 

So my two night stay turned into a whole day wasted waiting at a damn buffet because they did not offer us to use any other services, pools, beach, just “have a snack at the buffet” 
No dinner, back to the buffet. 
How are suppose to make up for the lost day? 
So I paid all inclusive prices  including a Reserve Upgrade for two nights and what I have gotten is one night in a shoddy hotel room, none of the all inclusive, 1 partial day at the pool and beach at the Reserve dispersed by  having to run in and figure out and be on repeat explaining my paid upgrade trying to get it honoured, since 7am.  I went at 7am to speak to someone, didn’t hear back about rooms till 3pm. it is now 4:10pm. And I still have to wait for approvals on how to fix my missed day and the room situation. Manager leaves at 6pm. Do I trust them? They have not made it easy to. 

Do I feel like I’m being given a run around and  ripped off, you bet!

reviews.author: IY
reviews.title: Poor management. Unfriendly staffs. Be aware of the additional fee they asked for
reviews.text: I was extremely diappointed with this resort. It started at the very beginning of the vacation - the minute we checked in. We booked 5 rooms and requested for 2 beds in 1 room, rest in King bed when I made the reservation months ago. When checked in, the front desk girl said King size bed was not available. If I insist, I should contact the company I placed the booking to discuss.......It didn't make sense to me. also, her attitude was very rude and unprofessional. We requested to see her manager, she immedicate claimed they are in meeting and do not know when meeting would be over. We told her we will not leave until we see her manager. She then went away and came back to tell us there is now room available in king size bed. Then she told us there is additional fee (enviornmental fee) we have to pay and we should pay in cash.....Why cash? very fishy!!? we wind up paid in credit card. Then later on to find out the amount she told us were much higher....Unhappy moment continued. Later on, we went to buffet for dinner. My brother was waiting on the line for taco. The "chef" was talking to the girl behind my brother in Spanish. Then the "chef" made her order first while my brother still waiting on line. My brother then confronted him and told him his in waiting on line forst. He then said "what do you want?". no apology from him. The next morning, we wnt to buffet for breakfast. During breakfast, i was asking a waiter for water. The answer I got ..... "Haaaahhhhh"(Sigh!). Then unwillingly got me a cup of water......Later on, we stayed by the pool. My sister in law went to taco station and asked for taco. When the "chef" finished making tacos, he holded "tip" cup and tapped it. He was asking my sister in law for tips......Seriously what kind of service we are getting from a high quality all inclusive resort!!!???? What an experience.

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: Paradisus Down Hill like a SKI Slope
reviews.text:
We have come to this place 15 times and year after year it gets worse. Booked almost a year ago in the adults only tower only to be told no rooms available. 

Why my family wants to go here’s is beyond me but thins place has steadily gone down hill. 

Restaurants are worse and value has diminished. 

Hard pAss on this place

reviews.author: Carloz C
reviews.title: 5 star priced hotel for 3 star quality venue
reviews.text:
Dissapointing from beginning to end; sub-standard room with no amenities and pretty rundown;  advertised as having “designer “ furniture (a joke);

Food quality at General restaurants for the all inclusive package is disgusting and does not correspond to any 5 star hotel

reviews.author: Venture699938
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK HERE!
reviews.text: Please Read! Family vacation should be stress free and fun! Paradisus Cancun Melia did not add up! The rooms were booked 7+ months ahead. Arrived very long process to be checked in no waters offered had to ask! Not welcoming at all! No area with snacks and cold beverages. Lots of warm water here to drink . Get to our rooms and very out dated… I mean the sockets do not work … ac units not working properly… just saw a German cockroach! I mean Jesus Christ this is a mess! We booked more than 2 rooms and 3 out of 4 were bad needed to be changed … still not up to par! Please save yourself the headache and book the Majestic or somewhere else this place doesn’t care about you and definitely will not satisfy you what’s so hard about that! WHERE IS THE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!!!!!! I’m so unhappy with this experience and the cost of a bad experience. I will not recommend this place and will leave a review on every platform…. Social media next! More photos coming! The entertainment is lacking definitely not enough things for our kids to do like previous places … adult entertainment and shows and interactive staff are not here. For what you pay to come on vacation and what you expect this was extremely disappointed. Definitely will not finish our vacation here. It’s so bad I can’t even tip half the time … I work in a tipping industry this is some sad sad service. The Hyatt Ziva is a absolute delight! Please take my advice!

reviews.author: Dharshini S
reviews.title: Terrible Service!
reviews.text:
This has to be the worst resort we’ve ever stayed at in terms of service. Upon arrival, our room wasn’t ready and we waited until 5pm! I travelled with a baby and a toddler and yet we were the last ones in our group to get a room. Once we got to our room we noticed we were given one king sized bed. We booked a king plus sofa bed for the kids. I was told to wait two days for a new room. Two days later they asked us to pack up our stuff and leave it in the lobby until the new room was available - I refused to do this with kids. The new room was supposed to be ready at 3pm - except new room was the same! One king bed for 4 people. I spoke to the management and asked them to have this sorted ASAP. They said they upgraded us for “inconvenience” & took us to a room with 2 doubles. My husband and I slept like dead bodies with no space to turn. 
We ordered coffee to the room and we were told it would be a one hour wait minimum. We asked for water bottles for the baby’s milk and waited over 2 hours - I asked the bar thinking it would be faster but 2 bars said they don’t have milk. 
The buffet is worse than prison food. If you enjoy grilled onions in 50 forms, this place is a jackpot for you. 

This is the worst experience and I would never return to this resort. 

Room cleaning woke us up at 8am in our “upgraded room” to clean? Woke the kids up for no reason

Beautifully decorated & draped with greenery but that’s where your money goes. 

They tell you premium alcohol but 9/10 times we were told there is no Hennessy. Premium tequila is also unavailable. 

We are on day 3 of our 7 day trip and I can’t wait to get home.

reviews.author: Daniel F
reviews.title: Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text:

The staff went above and beyond to ensure that our stay was nothing short of amazing. As a result, we decided to take our 7 year old twin boys to Paradisus Cancun for our 10th anniversary. The experience was not what we expected. Although we’re still have 3 more days to go. 

I called to book the stay and I specifically told the Representative that this occasion was special and that I needed a bottle of champagne and some rose pedals as a surprise for my wife. Upon my arrival, I was greeted by two ladies who could careless about the reason for my stay and didn’t even bother to offer any refreshments as they did in Paradisus La Perla in Playa Del Carmen. Granted, I’m a member of the melia Club and that I payed extra to stay at the Reserve. I walked into a room where there was none of the things I requested. None whatsoever! Not even a balloon for my children. The worse part is the fact that I was in constant communication with the representative whom I specifically gave these recommendations to. It was a complete disaster. Not how I envisioned spending my anniversary with my family. On the other hand, at Paradisus La Perla the experience was completely

reviews.author: Dianie C
reviews.title: DO NOT Recommend!!!
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever! What a rude environment! We spent almost 2 hours to check in. During that time we asked 3 different customers service reps to help us check in perhaps at a different counter, and they all said that we needed to wait for assistance at the counter we were at, because that was the only one available at that time. After it was finally our turn the girl at the counter told us we needed to go to a different counter because we were part of a group that were there for a convention and the other counter had all of our information and she didn't (but all counters have the same system, so how come she wouldn't be able to see our info?). I refused to go to another counter to start another line after waiting almost 2 hrs for them to tell me that, and after 3 people from their staff had assured us that's where we needed to check in at. After I firmly told her a few times I was not going anywhere else, she decided to check us in.
Also, when I was making the reservation online their system refused my card 3 times telling it declined. I checked with my bank and they confirmed the hotel never ran it through, therefore the bank never declined the transaction, so their system was acting up. I then decided to use the PayPal option they had available at their site. The transaction went finally through. Going back to the day we checked in, the girl at the counter decided to tell me that she was going to have to reverse the transaction because I used PayPal and it was under my business name and not my personal name (so why take the payment in the first place?) What the heck is wrong with this people??? After arguing for a while we were finally able to get our room keys... THE ROOM: Hot as hell! The entire hotel is hot. There is no way to get the AC pumping in your room, they control it. There is not enough lighting either. The phone didn't work. And the wall outlets have all been closed so you can hardly find where to plug your phone or even your flat iron!!! Some of our friends had problems also from lights not working AT ALL to even being getting someone else's room! Imagine being changed from room to room 3X and going into one and finding someone else already there. SHM!
We went into one of their restaurants and when one of my friends went to go serve herself she was told in a very rude way to put the serving spoon back, wait 5 min and come back, because they weren't ready and they were doing us a favor by opening a few minutes earlier. Ahh! And be ready for only bottom-shelf spirits. I mean, we supposedly are at a 5 Star Hotel (not cheap at all!!!), so you would expect some sort of better customer service and come on! Better maintenance too! I DO NOT recommend this place to nooo one! Cancún is beautiful and their people are nice, except for that inhospitable place!!! Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Láiza M
reviews.title: NOT VEGAN FRIENDLY
reviews.text: If you are vegan, has allergies to cow milk protein just DO NOT COME to this hotel. The website says “there are vegan options in all restaurants”it’s a lie. I mean if you are willing to spend money to eat salads then you go. There are very little few people that knows what vegan is, everything and I mean EVERYTHING has butter on it. Guest service is a joke, they solve absolutely nothing. We still have some days ahead of us here and EVERY meal is stressful.

reviews.author: Somer O
reviews.title: Not a 5 star hotel and sadly poor representation of Melia
reviews.text: We chose this resort initially for the all inclusive offering and rating. Upgraded our room to the "reserve" for the extra "perks". The moment we got off the plane is when everything went downhill. We had an arranged transportation from the airport (arranged by a member of the hotel) and they didn't show up. Ended up having to pay extra for a cab. When arriving, our room was not ready. The room ended up having ants, and many issues. Initially complained to the hotel manager ZANNINO, ROSANNA, but she was of no help and did not care. Throughout the week i complained MANY times to staff and asked for a manager in which no one came to check up on me. We did not receive the extra perks that was included in the upgraded "reserve". NOT worth it at all. The all inclusive food is the same everyday.  Many issues throughout the week and was very stressful. Service was HORRIBLE, SLOW and at the end of the trip i was FINALLY approached by the manager who said she would do ANYTHING to make this up to us. 2 days after we left, i received an email providing us a voucher for $50. This was the most waste of a trip and working with a large community, i ensure that we will not be returning. There were a FEW people that were pleasant and were MADE for hospitality, but this was completely unprofessional, not clean and the worst service i've ever had. The Reserve comes with a "butler" who did NOTHING for us. There was a A LOT of seaweed (Which is NOT the hotel's fault or under their control) so looking at making the most of the resort and enjoying our time was disappointing that the hotel couldn't come through. Mexico as a beautiful Country and beautiful people was definitely let down by this hotel. The representation of Cancun and Melia was very poor. The manager should not be in hospitality and was just the most unempathetic and unserviceable person.  I would advise to stay away from this hotel completely.

reviews.author: Paola S
reviews.title: THE WORST. DOESNT DESERVE THE 5 STAR CATEGORY. FOOD QUALITY NOT VERIFIED
reviews.text:
I wanted to show the splendorous Mexico and in this case Cancun to my partner, an Irish hotelier of a 5 star luxury hotel, and erase the bad reputation we have abroad. Nevertheless going to Cancun and specially this hotel, was a total robbery and a disgrace. My partner got a severe stomach infection with the poor quality of water and food service we got in the "all inclusive" package. Then he got medical service from the hotel and they said it was going to be 100 dollars which was already exceeded, and they charged him 800 USD for medicines like antacids, anti diarrhea and Trimetropina which is a very common and cheap antibiotic. The doctor took his pressure and standard check that even the cheapest laboratory in Mexico provide. They charged more expensive that if it were an urgency consultation in the ABC in Mexico City and stayed in the hospital for an overnight surveillance. 
He was in pain for the rest of the stay and the personal that promised that were going to check up us constantly, we didn't see them again.
The chef was supposed to send him a special food service as he promised and we didn't know from them again
IS NOT ALL INCLUSIVE either From the 7 restaurants, 5 are included and were already reserved from people that arrived days before, The same with the beds at the beach , you have to pay extra. There are many things which you have to pay extra, even the buffet service had trays for tips. They don't give service unless you leave a good tip, otherwise you won't hear from them again.
The spaces in the buffet restaurant were restricted, some areas were closed, so they sit us in dirty tables, dark spaces.
The pools were always cluttered and full of Americans.
Alcohol was the cheapest they could serve and the water is dirty, as we got sick since the first day.
DONT BOOK!!!! the facility looks very amazing but it is not worthy for the bad quality of service, the abusive personnel and politics from the hotel.

reviews.author: Maurisa S
reviews.title: Birthday trip
reviews.text:
Horrible is where I will start.
Check-in took forever. You have to reserve a spot to eat at restaurants. All of the food was mediocre, cold and very commercially made.  First room was horrible, old, holes and paints chipped on wall, bed leaned downward where the head rested. Woke up with extreme headache. Had to pay 500.00 to upgrade and was told we would get a personal bar and it was only beer.
Hotel was so damn hot and only relief u had was in your room.
Day of check-out they came 3 times in the morning asking when I would go check-out. But, during the stay only came around 2-3pm to clean room.
Toilet overflowed and they left water all over floor in bathroom and walkway and all over toilet seat. I had to sanitize and clean it myself.
I will never come here again.
This inclusive resort is a scam and joke
Maurisa

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.title: terrible
reviews.text: Terrible! Can’t believe it is a five-star hotel! I just stayed 4 nights but there were problems every day! Plus, Loud AC,aged furniture, lobby party till 11 pm . Here is the list: D1: upgraded to reserve room but the butler let us wait for 2 hours . We found a used fossil by last customer . D2: bathroom ceiling is leaking at 10 pm , reception recommended us wait in a room just for repair repairs. We have to bring our take luggage to the lobby and directly ask for a change room and it’s almost 11 pm. D3 : The cleaning lady did not come during the daytime. And left dirty towels in the bathroom after we called the cleaning service at 10pm. D4: the MOST Ridiculous !The other family opened our door with their digital key while our family members were taking a nap. At least they saw stuff in the room, so they stopped walking in! But everyone was shocked! Based on the above facts, we’ve contacted customer services several times, been told and have never reported to them before by different staff. They were even trying (pretending )to help us. Until the last day when we checked out, the service manger told us will meet us before leave, other staff answered us he will be here later but 5 fives mins later, said he’ll be here afternoon. Only then did we ask to call the manager. He showed up in the next few mins. This hotel ‘s service is a cheating game! Please don’t reply to never showing on your records! It’s not the truth! Family! Never ever stay here and screw up your vacation!

reviews.author: julio d
reviews.title: Muy déspota el gerente RENE
reviews.text:
Fuimos 6 personas al club de playa, antes di ir marcamos para verificar el precio y nos dijeron que eran $4,900 por 6 personas con una botella de vino y un platillo incluido. 

Cuando llegamos no nos respetaron el precio y el gerente llamado RENÉ dijo- “que tontos, cómo va a costar eso, es imposible. Si fuera así yo invitaría a mis amigos siempre”. 
Burlándose de nosotros, confirmamos con la persona por teléfono y nos volvió a confirmar el precio de $4,900. 

Al final nos hicieron pagar $10,000 por todos porque ya habíamos hecho uso de la instalaciones y ya habíamos pedido bebidas. Y era el mínimo para el day pass. 

Aparte nos querían obligar a pagar una propina del 30% por un pésimo servicio y comida insípida 

NO RECOMIENDO ESTE LUGAR 

Espero que la gente encargada tome cartas en el asunto para que no vuelva a ocurrir esto con este gerente tan grosero

reviews.author: emma kim
reviews.title: La Mejor Manera de Arruinar Las Vacaciones
reviews.text: En Febrero 2022, nos hospedamos en el hotel Paradisus Cancun después de haber estado en el Paradisus Playa del Carmen. Realmente es un asco. El hotel tiene mas de 40 años Y SE NOTA!!! Soy parte del Club Meliá, y en este hotel en particular nos tocó el sector MÁS antiguo y sin remodelar. En la pagina web aparecen fotos con habitaciones nuevas, modernas y limpias. En ningún lugar aclaran que siendo parte del Club Meliá estas reservando habitaciones viejas. Apenas llegamos, en la puerta de nuestra habitación, había una tremenda bolsa llena de basura. Jamás la retiraron.  Los colchones son MUY viejos, parece que han pasado por 3 huracanes. Pedimos que nos armen el sofá-cama para uno de mis hijos, y era tan diminuto que la mitad de su cuerpo sobresalía (ni siquiera es alto, mide 1.70). En una de las camas, había una uña ajena. QUE ASCO. La habitación tenía un jacuzzi en el balcón. El jacuzzi estaba extremadamente sucio, imposible de usar. En el buffet, nos dieron un vaso usado con labial rojo. La comida no era rica. Con lo que uno está pagando, no vale la pena. Al quejarme por la habitación, la única solución que me daban era pagar MÁS para así subir de nivel y de ahí cambiarme a otra habitación. Fue tanto el disgusto que después de la primera noche, nos fuimos a otro hotel. Perdimos un día entero de nuestras vacaciones tratando de cambiarnos a una habitación decente, cosa que no ocurrió. Realmente necesitan remodelar todas las habitaciones que no lo están, y mejorar la limpieza.

reviews.author: HappinessS
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING CELEBRATION FOR MY 30TH
reviews.text:
I had high hopes for this hotel because of the reputation (being part of the Melia hotel chain) and it really disappointed me. 

I was there to spend my 30th birthday which I stated in my notes when booking. Upon check in no consideration was made, they made no efforts to make me feel like it was my birthday. Other hotels of this calibre have done a lot more when I’ve noted a celebration. 

However, this wasn’t the main problem, the main problem is I travelled with my partner and we were given two separate beds. I informed the hotel about this as soon as we were shown our room and was literally told "trust me, I promise we will get this sorted straight away". 

We had just come
off a 12 hour flight so went for dinner , and in this time they said they would have it sorted (i.e. we would be in a new room with one bed). When we spoke to the hotel after no update, we were then told it would be sorted the next day as the hotel was fully booked for that night.

The next day came and I was told that the hotel was fully booked, again. 

The day after that I was shown a room in a lower class (which the hotel admitted after) which had two beds AGAIN!! This was very upsetting as on this night, it meant we were late for our dinner reservation for the Mexican restaurant in the hotel. The hotel concierge was made aware and promised they would let them know at restaurant that we would be late because we had outstanding issues to resolve. However when we arrived at the to dine, the manager and staff had no recollection of this, and it was made quite clear that he was doing us a favour if he were to seat us. We were told the restaurant closed at 11pm but when we got there he said it closed at 10pm (we arrived at approx 9.30pm).  Reluctantly with a bit of back and forth we were seated.

The jacuzzi on the balcony was not clean and dated, so we didn’t even use it. 

Our shower drain was blocked and flooded the bathroom. 

There was also a strong sewage smell coming from the bathroom which made the room smell unpleasant. Concierge were told - they said they would provide maintenance - nothing was done. 

The taco restaurant where we ate for lunch didn’t treat our stomachs well the next day either.

Overall: 

The hotel in itself is very nice however the rooms aren’t anything special. The stay at this hotel really did put a downer on the trip, a sad way to spend a birthday.

reviews.author: Daisy W
reviews.title: I Would Never Recommend Staying Here - Not a Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful hotel but don't judge a book by its cover. This is the worst all inclusive experience I have ever had hands down. From the bigger issues we had down to the small details that they do not seem to care about. For example, this is the first time I went to an all inclusive that did not serve welcome drinks when you arrived at the hotel. 

I called a week in advance to ensure our room was close to my mom and brothers so grandma could watch our 19 month old. When I checked in the concierge said they were close to one another but they actually put us in different towers that were super far away.  We went to my mom's room and it was one king bed even though I booked two twins on Expedia and also on our pre-check in form. My 69 year old mom and 44 year old brother do not want to have to share a bed. Then the bellman said my brother could just sleep on the pull out couch. I did not pay $2000 per person for a 5 star resort for my brother to sleep on a couch. So I had their room changed which was a 30 minute ordeal at front desk. They moved them to a room that was even further away from our room (10 mins walk 2 towers away). 

When we went to our room there was no power. Only the lights in the bathroom worked. We could not see anything since it was night time when we checked in. No  one came to fix it for well over an hour, so we went to front desk to change rooms. The first thing the very unfriendly hotel staff member asked is if we tried the light switches. How condescending and rude! Of course we did! It was another 30 minute ordeal for us to get a new room. 

Then we learned that pyramid 1 had only one elevator to access the top floor that we were on and it just stopped working for the rest of the day. So imagine hauling a 19 month old, a stroller, and all our luggage down from the top floor down 6 flights of stairs. At no point did anyone offer to move our luggage with all the room changes. Also while we were making multiple trips to move everything, our old room key stopped working before we got everything out. Another 20 mins at front desk getting our key re-activated. 

They give you water bottles in your room that are not twist off caps and our room had no bottle opener. Small details that are missed. I tried calling front desk to ask where the children's play room is that they advertise online. I couldn't get through after trying at least 10x. The "Kidsdom" is hidden in the basement of Pyramid 2. They are only open at odd hours and turn off the sign so it is very hard to find. We couldn't locate it till the 4th day of our trip. I was first told by staff it was in Pyramid 1 then someone said it was on the main floor. The staff did not even know where it was. 

DO NOT go by the Westjet Paradisus Cancun Photos of this hotel. It clearly has not been updated in a very long time and a ton of the venues and restaurants don't exist anymore and that site was honestly a huge reason I booked there. There is no Avenue Bar, Vento Restaurant, Red Lounge, Family Concierge Lounge, Fitness Centre, or Spin Studio. Covid is their excuse for everything but it was a packed resort. You could not even get a poolside chair at most times. You need to tell people if you are running at half ass service so they can choose not to book there or else discount the rates.  There was really only the Ginger Bar open which is an open club in the middle of the hotel that you can hear from your room in Pyramid 3. It has a very small lounge attached to it. There is literally NOTHING else to do. No other lounges or clubs or theaters or activity rooms. There was no entertainment at all besides Mexican singers and dancers we saw by the pool only one time in the 6 days we were there. Apparently a singer was in the Blue Agave restaurant once but we did not have reservations at that time to hear her. What kind of all inclusive has no entertainment?   We saw one person try to use the pool table in the Ginger Bar and the worker said he was not allowed to till 3pm. Poor kid was just bored because there is LITERALLY nothing else to do but sit by the pool. The Ginger Bar also ran out of tequila one night... in Mexico! Who runs out of tequila in Mexico ... land of tequila!? 

We booked reservations at Ceilos and they said they wouldn't seat us at our time because our entire party wasn't with us. My brother was just using the bathroom. I got in 20 mins after our reservation time as I watched them slowly cleaning our table. At Sal's Steakhouse, I asked for my steak rare and it was over done and chewy. Of course it's the restaurant that is not part of the all inclusive. So we paid $380 American for a meal that was totally not worth it. 

The only breakfast option is the one buffet and good luck trying to ever get bacon which would always run out. All of the food was really mediocre except for the oysters we got at Agua Marina which we also had to pay for. There is an oyster bar at the pool but they never ever served oysters there. 

We pre-booked our Covid test time slot in advance but it didn't matter. We had to still wait in a really long line up. Barely anyone in the line wore masks even though the family in front of us said they were redoing their test because their daughter had a positive result the day before. The 4 of us booked online in advance but they could not find my mother's registration form and took 20 mins to re-register her. Why did they have the other 3 reservations when they were all done together? 

I think all of these mishaps I could have dealt with better if the staff was just nice to us.  No one was apologetic or friendly with the exception of some waiters. Oh except the one who asked my mother if she was going to tip him. This was the most expensive resort I have ever booked at and there is absolutely no way it should be a 5 star hotel. The food is truly mediocre, bathrooms in the rooms are dark and grimy, no entertainment, and staff was rude. I would never recommend this resort to anyone.

reviews.author: Jaime M
reviews.title: Do Not Stay - No A/C, Terrible Concierge, Food Poisoning
reviews.text:
We just returned a day early from our family vacation. I will say that a major reason we decided to return early was due to the terrible experience at this resort. I have screen shots of all of the messages between the hotel concierge and our family. It breaks my heart that we want to take our kids somewhere fun and warm and leave so disappointed.

1. The Melia App is terrible, you are unable to use many of the functions. The first being online checkin. We were not able to check in online and I was told from the front desk via email "this feature may not work and we cannot do anything about it, you will need to check in when you arrive". This is find, but our flight was getting in late and we wanted to make restaurant reservations and work with our concierge to ensure our arrival went smoothly. 

2. Check-in takes a long time. We checked in around 6:00pm and it took about 30 minutes. The part that took a long time was another employee would jump in and use the same computer as the gentlemen that was checking us in. Then finding a concierge to take us to our room took time. We had concierge service because we upgraded to the "Reserve" which included this service for approximately $150 USD more a day. 

3. We were assigned room 5212, do not stay in this room. The AC was not working. At first I thought it would take some time, so we set the thermostat at 70 degrees and left for dinner and a small tour of the resort. We arrived back a few hours later and the temperature had not changed. It was 74.5 degrees in our room and humid. I mentioned this to Janick, our concierge/butler and he said it should be working.

4. We did not have restaurant reservations, so we had dinner at the buffet. The food was ok. The wait staff at ALL of the dining areas are amazing and I hope their hard work is recognized.

5. We requested through our concierge distilled water for my husband's CPAP. The hotel responded like they had never had that request. I cannot imagine that no one has ever needed distilled water for a CPAP? I was told we could walk to the convenient store and see if they have any, but that is where the assistance stopped.

6. I then requested to change rooms or have the AC fixed, we could not get comfortable. Our concierge left for the evening and at 11:10pm a maintenance person came to look. This person spoke little English and I spoke little Spanish, so we had to use google translate. He stated he could not fix the issue and we would have to wait until the morning to get it fixed or be moved to a new room. We slept very little that first night, it was like sleeping in a humid jungle.

7. In the morning, I immediately sent a message to our concierge, and email to the website email address, and went down to the check in to explain we have to change rooms, this is not acceptable. Please be advise, we upgraded to the "Reserve Level" and did not find the value in this at all. After all of these contacts and following up from 7:30am to 2:00pm, we finally were given a new room. We were essentially without a room for most of the second day. The only room they were able to offer us was a King room with a roll away bed. We are a family of 4, so we now had to have one child on a roll away bed and the other on a couch. Again, unacceptable, but were were desperate for a room with working air conditioning. 

8. The service on the beach is hit or miss. We had no service one day and then great service one day. They also ran out of towels on one of the days, so we had no beach towels. I cannot even imagine being a beach resort and running out of towels half way through the day. Our concierge told us he was going to find towels and send them to us, we waited 4 hours and he never sent towels, we could not find him or get a hold of him that afternoon. Just MIA and gave us no other point of contact.

9. On Sunday, we went to a local church for mass. I knew we would need to check in at the main pool for our reserved Bali bed between 9-11am. I asked our concierge to inform the pool concierge that we will be there, but may be late due to mass and taking the bus. Our concierge, Janick, responded back that he informed the pool and to go as soon as possible. We arrived to checkin for our Bali Bed at 11:09am and were told they gave our spot away and there is nothing available for the day. The pool concierge tried to upsell us to Bali Bed for $220 USD per day since we no longer had a reservation. I showed them the message from our concierge and they said there is nothing they can do. When I let Janick know what happened, he again went MIA and never responded and never fixed the issue.

10. Just to top off our terrible experience, we ordered room service through Janick, our concierge, on our departure day so the kids could eat prior to flying out. Janick confirmed our order and said it would take 35-40 minutes. We waited an hour and followed up, Janick said he would check, but never responded back. 90 minutes later, still no room service, still no response from Janick after multiple messages. As you probably can conclude, we had to leave without eating before our departure. In hindsight maybe this was ok because my son started vomiting after we checked in to our flight. He had food poisoning from the meat on the lunch buffet. He was so sick during our flight, God bless the flight attendants on Sun Country he took care of us and helped as much as they could. We concluded that was the only thing he ate that no one else did. Thank you Paradisus Cancun for topping off taking our money for a terrible experience with food poisoning. I would not expect anything less at this point.

Any communication to get resolution for this issue was met with "I need to check and will get back to you", but then no one follows up. I also wrote a review during our trip and posted on TripAdvisor and was asked by the hotel guest experience manager to remove the post if we wanted to be compensated for our experience. I removed the post, but of course, no compensation was given. I believe they do this to all of the negative reviews and most people comply and delete their true reviews. I just hope that you, as a traveler, know there are many options in Cancun and I would highly encourage you to find a resort that you will not be disappointed and is responsive if there is an issue with your stay.

Positives:
The front line employees are friendly
The beach is as described and ocean is beautiful
The bracelets for room entry are a great idea because no one wants to carry around a room key
Cece at the Reserve reception desk is amazing

reviews.author: Jose Armenta
reviews.title: Bad service, and they still owe me a refund.
reviews.text:
I visited Jan 16th  for a week with my family. Before we went on the trip one of the adults on our booking wasn’t able to make it due to covid. We asked for a refund and we have been getting the runaround ever since. The hotel was a ghost town when we went and even still the service was bad, our “consierge” took hours to reply. And on the day we arrived the hotel had no power. We arrived at 6pm and didn’t get into our room until 10pm due to the power issues. The front desk staff overall was very unfriendly, and not pleasant at all. I would go somewhere else. 
THE ROOMS ARE OLD AND DO NOT LOOK LIKE THE PHOTOS 

Also PLEASE GIVE ME MY REFUND THAT IM OWED

reviews.author: Navi D
reviews.title: Needs huge improvements
reviews.text: We came for a couple night stay and our shower was leaking all over the floor, the water was leaking from the room above us into our washroom, and our balcony door handle was broken on the outside.  Although my wife had stayed here previously, what we experienced on this trip definitely was not what she recalled from before.  In addition, we had called down to arrange pick up of room service dishes and towels; however, even after 4 hours this was not done.  Furthermore, when requesting our room bar drinks, even that wasn’t fulfilled.  Very disappointed as we have the hotel ample opportunity to correct this.

reviews.author: Armin D S
reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: This was a total rip off and a fraud. The listing is promoted as "all inclusive" but it's not. You will be asked to pay for a variety of basics when you have already paid a very premium price, including dinner bills, and subbed charges. False advertising and mis-selling by the hotel and the travel platform expedia.  Nowhere in the listing it was mentioned there will be exceptions or extra charges, nor was it communicated when we checked in even though we asked. Hotel manager tried to make ammends with a bottle of sparkling wine since we were there for my girlfriend's birthday - but we were still charged for a petty dinner bill. Will not go back again, and will never trust expedia or any hotel in Cancun with all inclusive promotion.

reviews.author: Victoria
reviews.title: Worst family "vacation", not worth it!
reviews.text: Our family of 3 (husband, wife and 6 yr old daughter) from NYC, booked via Expedia to stay at Paradisus in Cancun for a week (about $2,900+), we paid extra to be apart of the "reserve" club which at first we were sold on all of the "extra" amenities and spaces and thought it might be worth the extra $$. Now, when we arrived, it was another story. Everything was disorganized and unaccommodating! Dinner reservations must be made ahead of time, there will be no more spaces available last minute (ironically, you can only make reservations the day before which is really annoying). We were sold on the idea of a butler doing everything for us, what in the world did they do? They made dinner reservations for us via an app we could do. They were not allowed to reserve any beds by the pool for us. Are you kidding me? The butlers did minimum and sometimes unfriendly, we are generous tippers and honestly felt it was not worth it at all. We had to wake up early and stand on line to get a bali bed by the pools, and I recall multiple guests fighting over this issue. If you were just a minute after 10am and end up at the end of the line, you may lose your chance of getting a bed even though you arrived on time and waited on the line under the sun. EVERYTHING WAS A HEADACHE!!! It was NOT a vacation for us, instead everything was so complicated and time consuming. We wanted to relax, not have to deal with all of this extra drama and this place simply wasn't it. The "reserve" was a joke, they placed us in a room right above the entertainment area (DJ's, events, lobby etc). We didn't even get to stay in the quieter pyramid 5, we didn't mind the loud music until we tried to sleep at night and it was like sleeping above a club. The food was disgusting, what is the point of having so many restaurants but the only one that is really decent is Mole?? Everything was either limited or reserved or require further purchase, what is the point of paying extra for the "reserve" and there still are limitation (WTH)? Honestly, the only good part about the experience was that my daughter loved the Kids Club and enjoyed a lot of the activities. Overall, we will not be returning ever again.

reviews.author: fabiana m
reviews.title: Mi boda una pesadilla
reviews.text:
Por donde empezar .... uno sueña con tener un dia espectacular y la verdad resulto ser todo lo contrario.
Tienen personal inexperto con poca capacidad de respuesta,  desorganizada y no coniocen el tema. infomacion diferente, se tardaron en respnder , me prommetieron cosas que no cumplieron, me cobraron en mi paquete y al final a ella se le olvido incluirlas y le pedi me las descontara al no tenerlas y solo su respuesta fue lo siento no es posible porque ya paso el dia me lo hubiera dicho antes, es esa una respuesta. ? Como perder clientes este es el ejemplo no pasen por esto hay muchas opciones dodne son mas caluidos y expertos en el tema, Cuidao al elegir este Hotel del Teror.  Y si les toca que los atienda ana pidan que las atienda alguine mas si es que su opcion no es cambiarse.

reviews.author: squee-zbear
reviews.title: Construction at 2am?? Unbelievable...
reviews.text: We are on our first of 5 nights at the Paradisus Cancun and already regretting staying here. Loud construction started at midnight. It is now almost 230am. After I complained at least 3 times, and then personally walked down to the front desk, they temporarily stopped working at 145am.  Then at 2am, they are back at work hammering away, running power saws as they build cabanas. WTF are we supposed to do when the property management clearly doesn't care about their guests? We just want to sleep. That is the lowest expectation of a hotel and they are failing.

reviews.author: Zehra Q
reviews.title: Spend your money elsewhere - you're welcome.
reviews.text:
If you can stay somewhere, please do yourself a favor and do it. Save your $ for a resort where you feel welcome instead of trapped. For one, this is an outdated resort- but I could look past that. Before I begin on what made me hate my experience I would like to highlight 1) our concierge was attentive 2) the YHI spa was excellent- Lilian (my spa tech) was probably the only highlight 3) the room was very clean
Now on to the problems.
1) The shampoo/conditioners are in refillable bottles. I felt both were watered down or just downright awful quality. My entire family's hair was feeling damaged after each shower.
2) We paid extra for "The Reserve" experience. Now we've stayed at other hotels/resorts before and when you pay this extra fee- you are PAMPERED! Not here. Once we entered the resort, instead of walking us to the special "reserve" side, someone at the front gave us half sleepy instructions on how to find our way to the special side. Nothing special once we made it there either, three men behind the check in counter- all look distracted, bored and just want to get people away. Which brings me to my third point
3) The staff! this was by far the most drained out, bored and unfriendly staff in general. I heard other guests talk about this too. They have a "you're on your own buddy" attitude. Not room service- that was always on time and on point but at other resorts, the staff feels like family by the time you leave- they make you feel so welcome. The staff can really make or break the environment. At Paradisus, they break the environment. They will be standing starting at walls but don't smile and look very unhappy. The gentleman who serves ice cream was rolling his eyes at kids. Also, at this "kid-friendly" resort they were usually out of the whopping 4 flavors they offered with terribly generic tasting toppings
4) I have never gone to a 5 star Resort to find NOTHING in the room upon arrival. At our other resort, the staff left cute dessert on our dresser daily. Here, not even on the first day did we receive anything special
5) our mini bar and snacks were not stocked after the first day- you had to keep calling for basic things like water
6) This is not a hotel problem but it does matter if you're going there to "relax" but the beach space for the # of guests this hotel has to host is a joke. The beach is a crammed 0.5 mile spread ....its the location, its squeezed next to other resorts. It didn't matter what time you went, it was so packed there was hardly space to sit. The Cabana cost was $200 per day - and if you didn't get that you are pretty screwed with not many seating options
7) For" entertainment" they have music blasting until midnight in the middle of the hotel lobby. We didn't see any beautiful performances or variety. Just different singers each night. 
8) They only have two pools- one for adults one for family. 
9) You will be pushed to attend an onsite meeting - probably to sell timeshare, but we just avoided it at all costs

There's a lot that made this trip a regret- which is not something I say lightly. But it was a lot of money spent on an incredibly underwhelming trip. We have stayed at another resort and EVERY SINGLE thing from the people, to the pools, the variety of entertainment to the service....impeccable! I never write reviews but wanted to save time (and money) for anyone I can.

reviews.author: Gaby L
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: La calidad del servicio no es bueno, muchas cosas son con costo extra. Rente una cama en la playa (las cuales son con costo extra) la pague por adelantado y al hacer uso de la misma me querían volver hacer el cobro porque ellos no tenían registrado el pago, tuve que atravesar todo el hotel para hacer la aclaración correspondiente, por la falta de comunicación, claro y la vergüenza de que me tratarán como si no quisiera pagar.

reviews.author: Patricio H
reviews.title: Estafa
reviews.text:
Hola la verdad q me siento decepcionado por haber pensado q ser socio era un buen negocio… el servicio para hacer una reserva es pésimo ( se corta el teléfono ponele….) y ni hablar q el costo es mas barato  para cualquiera q ingresa a la página q lo debo pagar por ser socio para pasar un vacaciones… realmente una estafa….
Ejemplo 15 días en hotel me sale más de U$s 7000 y uno q no es socio paga U$s 3800 todo incluido y hasta mejor hotel! Una vergüenza.  
Lamentablemente me asocié pagué una membresía q no sirve para nada. 
Espero q mi comentario ayude a que otros no caigan en la trampa/ estafa. 
Feliz año

reviews.author: Inugapoueteca
reviews.title: Won't come back
reviews.text: We always felt pressures to pay more, everywhere. Lots of friendly people but still service is often lacking in some places. Very noisy, the hotel looks very nice but shows its age nonetheless. I recommend you go somewhere else where they understand the meaning of service associated with such a pricy resort .

reviews.author: Road541550
reviews.title: HOTEL HOOORIBLE VIEJO Y SUCIO
reviews.text: es un hotel muuy caro y viejo y sucio, las bañeras en los baños muy viejas y tapadas, cortinas de la regadera con hongos. ojooo, tienen camastros de fierro una tortura. las camas en la playa son las màs caras de todo cancùn.

reviews.author: cccanada2018
reviews.title: A big NOPE
reviews.text:
I'm tempted to write a big "stay away" review but I'll be brief: do not book there and, even more importantly, do not book more expensive Reserve rooms if you're with you're family. Everybody will be "sorry" and you'll get nothing. No special food, can't sit anywhere with your kids, you'll be ignored by servers and everyday will be a battle to get some simple lunch food.

Concierge support is no good either : we simply got nothing of what we prepared in advanced by email for our anniversary. Many disappointments, many hours spent talking. Again, lots of sorries.

The rooms aren't sound proof, at all. Expect very loud music coming to your bed until midnight, every night. Room cleaning happens at 4pm for some reason so don't expect a clean room before that either.

The Bali beds around the pooks are nice but are always magically "taken", despite supposedly being included. The guy in charge will quickly tell you that for 210$, the bed suddenly becomes unreserved though.

One last note for the drinks : all included, sure, but expect diluted alcool, very diluted alcool. Rum barely tastes like rum so we stuck to beer. Cancún used to be nice but this hotel is a good example of things going down in the whole region. Very unfortunate, we won't go back there.

reviews.author: Alejandra Michele
reviews.title: Waste of time and money
reviews.text: Don’t do it y’all. This resort is basically a D level cruise ship on dry land.
