Donde se vio? No voy a estar consumiendo comida ni hospedaje y me quieren seguir cobrando (sabiendo que el hotel está un 70% vacio).. por cada cosa se aprovechan para sacarte Plata.  Lo único que puedo decir que PIENSAN SOLO EN ELLOS y seguir ganando más Plata. Dan VERGÜENZA. No pienso volver a venir

reviews.author: grafaca384
reviews.title: Nos sentimos estafados
reviews.text: Pesima experiencia, todavia estamos esperando que nos devuelvan lo que nos cobraron en la tarjeta sin habernos hospedado. Es muy dificil comunicarse con el hotel. Aun considerando las restricciones que hay por la pandemia, no se justifica de ninguna manera el pobre servicio que ofrecen. Estuvimos alojados 1 semana antes en la cadena RIU y realmente tienen un servicio de excelencia y mejor tarifa que Paradisus.

reviews.author: Terra E
reviews.title: Hopeful this review gets the hotel's attention
reviews.text: I have been trying to get a reservation problem for arrival 2/8/2021 for an entire week. I have called no less than 15 times and emailed 10 times with no response. I get the run around that the manager Patricia isn't available or that another person a supervisor is in a meeting and they transfer me to another guest service person, Cristhian to help?  I guess the only way to get a real response is to write a bad review. It isn't a good way to start a trip. I tried to cancel on Feb 1, a full 7 days before the trip only to be told it had to be by 3 PM Cancun time and there would be a one day penalty which isn't what the website says that it has to be that specific. Then I decide to keep the reservation and try to check in online only to get my free upgrade reward that is on my account for my birthday. They tried to charge me a $67 upgrade fee instead of applying the reward. I called and they said someone would call me back but no one does. Then I find out that the fitness room is closed due to COVID but called the Golden Parnassus and all the Riu's Fitness rooms open. I ask if they can comp me a golf rental to compensate for the loss of the amenity and they say no. This was going to be my second time visiting but now I will never be coming back!!!!  BTW the name dropping on reviews seems like fake reviews and not got information.

reviews.author: Mauricio F
reviews.title: Irritable servicio telefónico
reviews.text: Olvidé una camisa en mi habitación al salir el día 1ro de enero de 2021. Al llamar a la operadora para que me comunique con alguien que pudiera ayudarme, fueron 2 llamadas de 5 minutos de espera en linea cada una (adjunto screenshot), lo cual es bastante molesto, finalmente en el tercer intento pude comunicarme con Guest service, con una chica bastante amable y servicial llamada Aiko. El tema de la camisa está pendiente pero al menos parece que le están dando seguimiento ya. Este detallito arruina mi estadía la cual fue muy buena, el hotel en sí es bastante disfrutable, la comida es buena y el servicio más destacable fue en el buffet del desayuno y alrededor de la piscina con la mesera ASU. Esta reseña sería de 5 estrellas si no fuera por el detalle de la espera tan tediosa al teléfono, por ese motivo doy una estrella para que realmente hagan algo al respecto.

reviews.author: Wilson A
reviews.title: Decepcionante, um fim de ano para esquecer!
reviews.text:
Decidi passar a virada de ano no hotel Paradisus Meliá Cancun.
Acessei a agência virtual Snaptravel aonde o valor da diária era 550 dólares americanos.
Utilizei todas as formas de pagamento possíveis incluindo Paypal, em todas o site apresentou erro.
Fiz contato com o atendimento da agência através do Whatsapp, não houve como contornar a falha e me orientaram a concluir a reserva diretamente com o hotel.
Ligamos para o hotel, no atendimento transferiram para o setor de reservas, ficamos mais de 30 minutos ouvindo musica, decidi desligar e ir diretamente para o hotel.
Chegamos no hotel às 15 hrs, horário descrito como início do checkin. Demorou 1 hora até ser atendido, explicamos todo o ocorrido e exibimos toda a conversa com o atendimento da agência com os "prints" das tentativas de reservas, que incluíam todos os detalhes. 
O atendente simplesmente informou que não iria efetuar a reserva no balcão e que eu deveria procurar por minha conta uma outra forma de efetuar a reserva.
Cansado de esperar e sem alternativas acessei a internet e fiz a reserva pelo hoteis.com, porém pelo valor de 800 dólares americanos, 250 dólares a mais simplesmente pelo hotel se negar a realizar a reserva no balcão.
Mesmo com a reserva efetuada só disponibilizaram o quarto às 18 hrs, me fazendo aguardar por 3 horas na recepção! Um absurdo!
Ao chegar ao quarto haviam 2 camas pequenas, quando a reserva efetuada era para uma cama king! Ao reclamar na recepção informaram que tinham ciência de que a reserva era para quarto com cama king, mas que não havia mais disponibilidade no hotel.
Para acesso aos restaurantes havia apenas disponibilidade no buffet sob a alegação de que não reservamos antes das 18, ora nem mesmo acesso ao quarto nós tínhamos, como poderíamos reservar?
Com tudo isso o Cristian do Guest Service entrou em contato conosco, pediu desculpas por todo ocorrido, ofereceu late checkout às 14hrs uma cama na praia para uso no dia seguinte como forma de tentar minimizar o ocorrido.
Na manhã seguinte recebemos uma ligação no quarto confirmando a reserva na praia, ao chegar ao local fomos informados que não havia disponibilidade alguma e que deveríamos falar com a Fernanda, responsável pelas reservas.
Após uma hora a Fernanda chegou e informou que havia disponibilidade apenas na piscina, tiramos foto e fizemos vídeos haviam diversas camas livres na praia e ficou assim até o final da tarde.
Nós não pedimos nada, foi uma oferta do Guest Service que só causou ainda mais constrangimento.
Desgastados e insatisfeitos com todas as falhas grotescas no atendimento do hotel decidimos ir almoçar e fazer checkout.
Chegamos no quarto 13:50 para retirar nossas coisas e sair. Nossas chaves não funcionavam, fui na recepção 2 vezes para fazer novas chaves que também não funcionavam.
Ligamos para o room service que só enviou o funcionário próximo às 15hrs, ou seja mais uma hora de espera, informando que não havia problema na chave que era um erro de magnetizção na recepção.
Nossa estadia foi um verdadeiro calvário, agravados pela relevância da data e altos valores pagos.
A estrutura do hotel é boa, internamente não é novo mas ainda sim é muito bonito e praia é maravilhosa.
Entretanto o atendimento é péssimo, os processos não funcionam e o Guest Service parece ter pouca autonomia, ficando impotente.

reviews.author: Oscar R
reviews.title: Pésimo servicio...
reviews.text: Hoy cumplimos 4 días hospedados en el hotel y realmente es desagradable estar aquí. El día que llegamos al registrarnos no nos pusieron brazaletes, no nos dieron clave para abrir la aplicación y las preguntas que hicimos en recepción no las resolvían, los camastros no son para huéspedes, es necesario pagar 180 dólares para su uso, el jacuzzi de la habitación estaba descompuesto (daba descargas eléctricas!!). Si  en las noches quieren cenar es necesario reservar, algo que no se puede hacer bien si decides tomar algún tour y no sabes a qué hora regresar, así que terminamos cenando fuera del hotel...

reviews.author: Arce Mexico
reviews.title: Disappointing, do not book luxury Reserve if going with family
reviews.text: Staying at Paradisus Cancun with high expectation since we already stayed at the Playa del Carmen and Cozumel sites, we reserved the highest rate room for a family of 4, Concierge support and all luxury advertised, check in was good at a separated area, but after that, room was average (supposed  to be ocean view but since at ground floor, we can just see a garden and pillars from the balcony), all called “Reserve” area cannot be used with kids!!, so all “Reserve” area attractions included cannot be used by families, need to go to the regular areas passing few pyramids to use external areas. The point is the Hotel Administration should not allow families to book, pay and be located at the Reserve if cannot be used!!, families should pay regular price for regular services, we feel scammed!!. They mention a new administration took over recently, not sure on their strategy but this just harm the “Melia” name and concepts expectations.

reviews.author: Companion704139
reviews.title: Lost his glory
reviews.text:
We live in Mexico and have spent many holidays in cancun and surroundings. As well in Paradisus , in The past I would have recommended this hotel but the last few visits where dissapointing too say the least....recepcion is unbelievable unificient , they insisted to see the ceditcard I paid with , they did not understand I paid with a digital card...... anyway it took them 1 hour too check us in. One lady insisted we would Pay Again and was very rude... Than they told us they would make up the sofa bed for the kids, which they did , but not after 3 phone calls and 1,5 hour waiting ..... the guy who came finally told us he was just ordered to do it....
The food in the restaurants is every year worsed , no suprises in menus, very bad quality, not better than a 4 star resort .....
Also some good things? Yes , Rodolfo the concierge, very polite and profesional, top guy! COVID precausions in te hotel are very good. Staff in restaurants very nice and correct. But.... overall not at good enough, the hotel seems too be mismanaged .....
We dont go back after 5 times, I suggest you better look for something better in this price catogory also

reviews.author: Niko B
reviews.title: Don’t book wedding here
reviews.text:
Don’t book your wedding here! 
Since booking our wedding October 2019, the wedding department Adriana and Diana were a nightmare to work with. Just asking to sign a contract took forever for them to respond. Only communication with Diana the wedding planner was through email, which her responses would take a week to three weeks! I would ask Diana questions and not receive a response for a month to which she would reply she’s busy! I get you are busy but I am a paying bride! I work in customer service and never let my clients wait for answers to their needs. For a bride trying to plan a wedding in another country this is very frustrating! Diana has no idea how to work in customer service.
 Then comes the pandemic- which I had to pretty much beg them to let me reschedule my wedding due safety measures for my guests. Then the hotel closed due to covid, and no one from the hotel or my wedding planners told me! I had to find out when I called the hotel to ask a question. Receiving a refund from
The hotel for a trip I booked in March to plan took 7 months to receive and many emails and phone calls.
The hotel was closed from March and set to open July 1st. Found out on Facebook they extended the closing till October 1st! 
 The hotel opened October 15th then closed again a week later due to a hurricane and once again I found out on Facebook. Not my wedding planners. 
I emailed Diana to find out when they would reopen because my wedding was set for November 1st. She never responded. I found again yet again via Facebook the hotel would be closed for my wedding. Once I called the hotel and demanded to speak to a manager did I finally receive an email notice from Adriana the supposed wedding manager. A week before my wedding date the paradisus Cancun moved me to their sister hotel in playa del Carmen. Ridiculous! What a nightmare this hotel was to work with. If I could go back in time I wouldn’t have booked with them. Don’t get blinded by the beauty of the hotel. I’m still also waiting for my complimentary three night stay there that they promised me to soften the blow of them moving me and my guests last minute. I won’t hold my breath!!

reviews.author: Tx-foodee
reviews.title: Last time here. Most dangerous hotel for families. Stay away!
reviews.text: We’ve stayed here multiple times in the past 10 years, this is our last time here or at any Melia property. This “high end” brand does not take security of their guests seriously. My family was attacked by drunk partygoers at the nightclub, reported this and the hotel did absolutely nothing to make sure my family was safe. After this incident, the same gang members kept threatening my kids in the public areas and still no action from the hotel. We called the federal police to have them look into this but everything seems to be swept under the rug, the hotel probably “takes care of the issue” if you know what I mean. I guess the rates have dropped so much that the hotel has no care or control over who stays here and they clearly do not have a policy to keep families safe. Not the same place, stay away and keep your family out of there.

reviews.author: arcy4
reviews.title: Horrible client resolution
reviews.text:
I booked my vacation through the paradisus/melia website. To my demise I chose to book the flight plus hotel option which without my knowledge sent me to an expedia search engine.
 Melia never disclosed that I was being sent to the expedia website. That was the beginning of my worst booking experience ever. 
I booked my vacation for July at the Paradisus cancun but the property extended their closure to October 1st due to Covid. MELIA NEVER CONTACTED ME TO LET ME KNOW. I found out when I called the property to ask a question. Needless to say we now have no hotel to stay at. I have placed many calls to Melia and all they tell me is that I have to call Expedia. Expedia is useless. I got to the point where all I was asking Melia to do is book me a NEW reservation for paradisus playa del carmen. All I asked was for them to honor my price at paradisus cancun since it was no fault of my own we couldn't stay there.  Melia refused! They offered me a laughable 5% discount! Unbelievable. I have sent emails to Melia to no avail. I cannot believe such a large company can't make this right

reviews.author: Monique R
reviews.title: UNETHICAL MANAGEMENT TEAM
reviews.text: My family and I had a reservation to visit this hotel on April 11 but due to COVID-19 the reservation was cancelled. It is now May 28th and I am just getting a response that they will not be doing any refunds and giving me other dates this year where they will honor the rates. This cancellation is due to COVID-19 so why would they hold customers money which is theft and unethical when their reservation was cancelled. The country is still not fully open and there is so much up in the air with peoples lives and this is the unethical customer service treatment that I have received. I will never recommend this hotel or even want to visit there anymore. This is very unethical and theft if you ask me actually criminal to hold a customer money when visit was not completed due to an issue completely out of my control.

reviews.author: Dianne G
reviews.title: You be the judge...
reviews.text:
We booked a family vacation. Booked it online through a booking site like this one. Got the all inclusive package.  The location is lovely. No complaints there. The room was clean and decent, but nothing to brag about. While checking-in, as part of it, they send you with one of their specialist to finish up explaining your All-Inclusive package. What they don’t advertise is that this “specialist” is smoothing the way for the “pressure sales pitchman/pitchwoman. Ours was a woman, which was a novice and her manager had to be hands on cuz she wasnt cutting it. 

Their trick is to sit you down from early on your trip, throw free stuff at you (which is typically not part of the all inclusive), they give you a special bracelet the staff recognize and they treat you like you’re king and queen of the manor. 

If you say NO to the sales pitch or no to the membership. They switch your bracelet to another one, which must be below the one the walk-ins get, cuz the quality of service went way downhill. It’s like you’ve been blacklisted, but couldn’t throw you out and we’re allowed to remain your stay. 

It’s a terrible terrible system they have there. 

It’s too bad. If they got rid of their little scam membership sales, it would be 5 star rating place.

reviews.author: M_Akp
reviews.title: Unsanitary & Stingy
reviews.text:
If you are even considering booking here, for the sake of your vacation, please keep looking. I have traveled to Mexico every year for the past 5 years and this was by far my worst experience and it’s not even close.

I’ll preface this by saying I stayed at a Melia property in Cabo San Lucas, a 4 star, which was absolutely amazing so naturally I expected nothing less from their Cancun 5 star location. That proved to be a mistake.

This resort is dirty, has a poor smell, the rooms are poorly cleaned, you are nickel & dimed for everything the minute you get to the property, and their service is horrible.

Starting at the beginning — check-in. They are constantly trying to up-sell you for higher priced rooms, services, etc. They offered a “luxury” room for an extra charge of $260. I negotiated it down to $180. Fine.

Upon arriving to the room, I immediately notice a dingy, dirty looking rug in the seating area. Stained throw pillows on the bed, and stuck-on food on the spa brochure (shown)

I went downstairs and asked for a new room, hoping that had just been an isolated incident. They check me into a new room. 
Same thing — dirty rug, stained pillows and this time I even found a blonde hair in the bedsheets. I have black hair. 
Even more disgusting — I turned over the comforter and found a dried yellow liquid stain on the inside (pictured). 
I was absolutely horrified, especially with the serious concerns over coronavirus and the spread of germs. 

From then on, every minute I spent in the room was miserable, wondering what had actually been cleaned or replaced and what hadn’t. That is no way to spend a vacation you spent your hard earned money on. 

I expressed my concerns to their management and I was told that they “looked into their housecleaning processes and found nothing wrong”. 
They offered absolutely nothing to remedy the situation. 

In addition, the nickel & diming was pathetic for a so-called 5 star resort. Never have I been to an all-inclusive resort that charged for room service, especially since it’s the only food option after the restaurants and buffet close. They charge $5 per order and the best part — there’s a good chance your order will be wrong, as mine was all 3 times I ordered.

They also charge a whopping $200 per day to use their beach beds. You are forced to a purchase a “package” which includes a bottle of champagne. Tough luck if you don’t drink
I guess. 

Also, you will be turned away at their restaurants if you don’t make a reservation even if there’s barely anyone there. 
And to top it off, the food is extremely mediocre, except for the taco restaurant. 

In short, it seems at this place their goal is to make your vacation as difficult and expensive as possible. With emphasis on the latter. 

There are too many resorts in Cancun with way better value to waste a minute of your vacation or spend a penny of your hard-earned money here. 

But if strangers’ hair and unidentifiable stains in your bed, and poor food and service sounds like your dream vacay, then book away!

reviews.author: Christopher G
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here...Physically Restrained from Leaving
reviews.text:
In January, we paid in full ($2,400) for 2 rooms for 4 nights at the Paradisus Cancún (March 17 -21) through Bookit.com. We decided to extend our trip for 1 more night (March 21-22), and booked that night through the Melia website. We arrived on March 17, and were not informed of any issues with payment for our stay. We stayed the night of March 17, and at multiple times that afternoon and the next day, the keys to our rooms were deactivated. No one said anything about any issue with payment when reactivating keys. Finally, in the afternoon of March 18, the keys were deactivated again. I went down to the front desk and had the key to my room reactivated—no one said anything about payment issues. Several minutes later, my wife went down to have the key to her room reactivated, and for the first time, the front desk stated that the stay reserved through Bookit had not been paid to the hotel, and that we would have to pay the $2400 again or leave the property. This obviously left a very bad impression upon us. Because we had paid for 1 night through the Melia website (not a part of the Bookit dispute), and only stayed at the property for 1 night, we decided to relocate to another resort. When trying to exit the property with our bags, the bellmen physically blocked our exit and stated that we would not be allowed to leave unless we went to the front desk. After arguing with the bellmen for several moments, I returned to the front desk. I informed the woman at the front desk (Alma), that we were leaving as requested. Stunningly, Alma informed me that if we wanted to leave we had to pay for another night at the hotel. I explained to her again that since we had already paid for 1 night through the Melia website, and only stayed for 1 night, we were even. She then had to go speak to management for approximately 30 minutes about my request to leave. Once she finally came back, she told me that management had agreed to let me leave, but that I would have to pay for a $78 bottle of wine from dinner the night before. This was a surprise, since this is supposed to be an all-inclusive resort and our waiter never mentioned any upcharge for the wine. After paying for the wine, the bellmen were kind enough to let us physically leave the property on foot. 

Melia knew of payment issues with Bookit well before our arrival and failed to inform us or other guests, instead letting their guests stay and then demanding payment in return for being allowed to leave. Absolute scam!

reviews.author: S Desai
reviews.title: Don’t stay if you like to sleep
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel with wonderful beach and water front. 
However they are continually making noise throughout the night, whether it’s music or moving heavy furniture, which makes it sound like elephants trumpeting at 4am. 
Even if they lacked the common sense to be quiet while people are trying to sleep, the doors to the rooms are clearly very cheap and have zero sound insulation. 
Something to consider if you like to rest on vacation

reviews.author: Mayan R
reviews.title: THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DON'T STAY HERE!
reviews.text:
THIS PLACE IS A SCAM! DON'T STAY HERE!

SCAM #1 
When I first booked this hotel, I booked under the refundable rate which charges you upon arrival.  When I checked my bank account a couple of hours later I noticed I was charged in full. I reached out to the hotel to try and get this resolved because it was for a group of 15 of us and some people hadn't decided if they were coming yet. The response I repeatedly got from the hotel was that they can't tell what I clicked and since it is nonrefundable there is nothing they can do about it. At this point, I was already very upset and weary with the hotel.

SCAM #2 
A few weeks later, I got an email from the hotel that they didn't receive payment and that my reservation would be cancelled if I didn't wire them them money immediately. After a couple of weeks of back and forth with the parent company and their accounting department they were able to locate the money that I had already paid a month prior on their end. I was reassured that my reservation was in good standing and would be fine upon arrival at the hotel.

SCAM #3 
Fast forward to the trip. 15 girls from across the US arrive in Mexico. When members of my group arrived earlier than me, they were told that the reservation was not paid for and that since it was not under their name THEY HAD TO WAIT OUTSIDE ON THE CURB FOR 4 HOURS UNTIL I ARRIVED.  Once I arrived, I was told that the reservation was not paid for and that we would have to pay for 7K in full again or we could not stay. 

I explained to the manager of the front desk and his supervisor that I had paid and it had all been sorted out with the accounting department already back in January. I showed them printed out copies of the emails and my bank statements, I even called my bank and allowed them to speak to the hotel. Showing complete and total proof that I had paid. 

The hotel could not find the money within their own internal systems and could not show me any evidence that they didn't have it. The words I was repeatedly told was if you don't pay now, you cannot stay here. After 8 hours of arguing with no food or water or any accommodation for us  15 girls we came to a compromise that I would pay for the first night again while they sorted out the issue and refund me the money in the morning.  I asked for this confirmation in writing and was told that they couldn't give it to me in writing. I was weary to trust that this would actually happen, but 8 hours had gone by and we were in a foreign country with nowhere to go so I reluctantly agreed.

I'm not sure why as a customer with complete evidence backing up payment I was the one who needed to provide the payment while the hotel tries to find the money within their own system. As a large corporation, providing us a few rooms while they sort out THEIR OWN ISSUE would have been the more appropriate way to handle the situation.

Scam #4
When I showed up the next morning to sort out the rest, the men I was working on this with hid in the back room and told the guy at the front to let me know if I don't pay again we can't stay.

So we left to the hotel next door hoping that our bank can resolve the issue and get me money money back.

OTHER ISSUES WITH THE HOTEL
1. They ran out of clean drinking water
2. The bars all close at 11
3. All restaurants require a reservation to get seated, even if they are empty, You can't make a reservation until after checking in.
4. Personal belongings were stolen out of a girl's room
5. The hotel is now flagging our reviews for removal and responding to them saying this situation never happened to try and cover up their seriously gross misconduct

I HAVE NEVER EXPERIENCED SUCH POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE IN MY ENTIRE LIFE!  I spent the first 24 hours of my bachelorette party crying and stressing over a horrific situation.. DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND STAY FAR AWAY FROM HERE.

reviews.author: Cailun G
reviews.title: The Worst Experience. Save Your Time & Money
reviews.text: Something is fishy about this resort and their ethics. Was here with a large group for an event and they claimed that we hadn't paid for our rooms, therefore we couldn't check in. Sometimes there's a mix-up in communications, which I can understand, but this was a complete and utter lack of morals and hospitality. We had full documentation from our bank that we did, in fact, pay for the rooms and all the front desk could tell us was that their bank had "lost the money". We waited 7+ hours trying to resolve this issue, but since this resort's bank is in Spain there "was nothing they could do". They insisted the only way to resolve was to pay in full again and they'd "try to find the money tomorrow". So, being that we were a large group from out of the country without a place to sleep, we paid for a single night. The next morning, the staff we were speaking with the day before wouldn't even speak directly with us to try and keep resolving. We ended up finding last minute rooms at the resort next door and it was 10000% more accommodating and our trip ended up being fantastic.

reviews.author: Amanda L
reviews.title: UNSAFE, UNFRIENDLY, THIEVES, OH AND THEY RAN OUT OF CLEAN WATER
reviews.text:
I'm an experienced international traveler and I WILL NEVER come back to this resort. We had booked a friend's bachelorette party there, paid in full and received a confirmation number straight from the hotel. Well when we got there the hotel staff tried telling us we did not pay and in order to stay we needed to repay. After ignoring our confirmation number and refusing to let us speak to a manager, we were forced to wait in the lobby for 7 hours. We even called our bank (Chase) and confirmed with them they had sent the money and had verification it was sent directly to the hotel. They still wanted us to repay. They also tried telling us that the manager was not available, so we asked to speak to someone in charge of online booking. They claimed that "office" was  in Spain and unreachable given the time difference. This place is a SCAM!!

As a group of women we did not feel comfortable leaving in the middle of the night to try and find another hotel and were forced to pay for only one night and leave in the morning. By the time we checked into our hotel we needed to find something to eat so we decided on going down to the late night restaurant. Before I left the room I wanted to ensure our valuables were locked up in the safe. I noticed the instructions on the safe were rubbed off so I called down to the front desk for instructions. They said they could not give them over the phone and would need to send someone up? They said a staff member would be up in ten minutes. Well, we waited and waited and no one showed up for over 45 min. I called down a second time, no answer. At this point, I decided I didn't want to leave the group of women waiting so I left the room and went down to dinner. After dinner we were taking group photos in the lobby and asked the front desk for water. Their answer... they RAN OUT!!!! The hotel would not be receiving clean water until the morning. I was in utter shock. NO WATER?!

Waterless, we returned to our rooms, and I noticed by RayBan sunglasses were missing. I remembered I set them on top of my iPad which I wanted to put in the safe, but couldn't. I was furious. Was this all another scam?? Had they sent someone up to our room while we were gone? All I knew was that they were in the room when I left and when I returned they were missing. The next morning I filed a report with security. Of course, no help there. The said they would check footage and "look around" for them, but lets be real... 

So after I filed the report, we needed to check-out. They claimed they needed to charge us each $8 dollars to remove our wristbands?? We asked to see where in the check-in documents that we signed did it show this fee. They said they don't. So we refused to pay them and said we would cut off the bands ourselves. Then they threatened to charge us each $150.  

We left that morning and went to the hotel next door (Fiesta Americana). WHAT A DIFFERENCE! For anyone considering Paradisus, save yourself the trouble, thirst and RayBans, and DON'T. Our weekend stay at Fiesta Americana was 1000% better and thankfully saved our trip.

reviews.author: Maddy
reviews.title: Like hell, only worse
reviews.text:
If you enjoy waiting in the lobby for 7+  hours for check in, then trying to be scammed out of thousands of dollars you already paid to get a room, then this is the place for you! There was some sort of problem on the hotels end and their system had a glitch. While they figure it out they, made us sit in the front of the hotel and wouldn't even give us access to basic items such as food/water. It was over 7 hours of us waiting for them to try to resolve the issue. Spoiler Alert: They never ended up figuring it out and we had to repay for the first night because they said the system would be back up and running the next day. It was not, so we were forced to leave the hotel after double paying and find a new location.

The staff was super rude and unhelpful, even after contacting their headquarters in Spain about the ordeal who said everything was ok, they still would not give us the time of day.

We did get the morning at the pool before being forced to leave and the drinks were watered down and the margaritas were bright blue for some reason??? 

The hotel next door was basically heaven on earth compared to this hell hole we came from. Overall, do NOT come here unless you enjoying spending your entire vacation in a humid hotel lobby arguing with people who won't even look you in the eye. On the bright side, we have some lovely vacation photos of us walking down the street of Cancun with all of our luggage!

reviews.author: Sandy
reviews.title: Hate the food
reviews.text:
First of all we have been here for almost a week and could not get reservations for a restaurant. 
The restaurant we did go to Enso was horrible. The food was cold and the food was not good.
The only good thing I can say is that we enjoyed the band “Radiance “ at coco club. Other than that there is zero entertainment in the day time. If you are awake at 11pm they have a night club. 
I will not be returning. One more thing!!!!!! Do not do the presentation good lord the two hrs sales pitch to join timeshare was brutal!!

reviews.author: Teri B
reviews.title: Won't stay again...
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd time staying at Paradisus.  They are not the same.  Was given wrong room then moved and wound up on bottom floor overlooking parking lot.  Lost a night of vacation over room changes, finally gave up.
Food not anywhere as good as back in 2018.  Very disappointed.
Will stay elsewhere next February.

reviews.author: Michael T
reviews.title: Not for kids : Don’t come with kids
reviews.text:
Arrived first day , changed kids, went to buffet , Hostes Mar said they can’t wear swim wear and we need to change.. toolk may starving kids to change again.. came back in 30 minutes.. she said they are closed .. still starving and cranky kids .. we go to the grill.. slim pickings .. no chicken nuggets in the entire resort , good burgers if you get the 175$ a day cabana.. 2nd day we walk in to the marva buffet the same girl Mir, tells my wife she doesn’t like that her dress is opened at the top and we need to go change
.. I asked for the manager Guervo .. who tried to tell me the same until he saw her and then he just walked away .. the rest of the resort is not bad.. adult food and drinks are very good.. don’t come here with kids

reviews.author: Alexis L
reviews.title: Me siento estafado
reviews.text:
Empezamos nuestro viaje en Iberostar de playa del carmen, y quisimos terminarlo en un hotel supuestamente de categoría superior.
Nada de eso.
Desde que llegamos fueron complicaciones. 
Nos dieron una habitación de categoría inferior a la que habíamos contratado, y por la que habíamos pagado un 50 % más que en el otro hotel, que entré paréntesis, fue ampliamente superior.

Al movernos de habitación omitieron mover los alimentos especiales que teníamos en el frigobar, y cuando quisimos recuperarlos, nos tuvieron un día dando vueltas.
Una vez que los obtuvimos, pedimos que los refrigeren en la heladera del hotel, y nos hicieron llenar un formulario.
Al otro día cuando fuimos a retirar, vemos que lo sacan de un cajón sin que esté refrigerado. Su justificativo fue que pensaron que era café.

La comida de los restaurantes era FEA. mucha pinta pero cero sabor y frescura. La comida del bufete era todos los días igual. no la cambiaban. nos quedamos 6 días y terminamos pidiendo delivery los últimos 2 días.

En cuanto a la habitación, la puerta principal estaba rota y filtraba luz y ruido del pasillo.
La puerta del baño estaba inflada por humedad y no cerraba del todo.
El radioreloj, aparentemente de los años 90 no funcionaba y estuvimos un día para que nos lo cambien. 

Si querías tomar un café a la tarde no tenías dónde.
Para bajar a la playa desde la piscina tenés que bajar 2 pisos por escalera y no hay rampa ni ascensor para personas con movilidad reducida.

Por último, sufrimos la violencia de los botones arreglados con la mafia de los taxis cuando no nos dejaban llamar un uber para ir al aeropuerto. la diferencia que pretendían cobrarnos era 4 veces más caro de lo que salía el viaje.

En resumen, es un 2 estrellas disfrazado de 5 estrellas. no volvería nunca ni lo recomendaría

reviews.author: Mohit Gupta
reviews.title: Good resort, but highly irresponsible reservation staff
reviews.text:
Our experience, frankly, was quite terrible. I had made the reservation for my parents. When they arrived at the resort, they were harassed by the reception and reservation staff. Their reason? They wanted me (the person who made the reservation) to be traveling with them. This would have been fine had this been specified when the reservation was being made. However, in the reservation form, I CLEARLY specified that I'm making the payment, and that the guests will be my parents (I put their names down). Despite this, and the fact that their entire stay was pre-paid for, the staff kept harassing them. They even got me to send several documents to them, which I promptly did. 

This was painful, but, I would have understood, and put this down to miscommunication. However, unfortunately, it got worse. During check-in, they AGAIN charged a credit card my parents were carrying for the entire stay (about $1200). After this confusion was resolved, they promised to refund this within 3 days. It has been more than 3 weeks now, and they **still** haven't refunded it. I have written and called several times, but haven't even received a reply. They are taking advantage of the fact that I cannot travel there from a different country. This is unprofessional at best, and bordering on criminal since they have double charged my card and are completely ignoring my requests to refund. 

I had very high hopes, but, am quite disappointed and frustrated because (a) they harassed my elderly parents for no fault of theirs (it is really a bug in their reservation system), (b) I was double charged, and (c) they are not even responding to my emails to correct this (they were extremely responsive when they wanted something from me).

reviews.author: The Doctor D
reviews.title: Not 5 star.
reviews.text:
Pools are quite nice rooms ok.  Make sure if your booked here not to have a room on the 2nd floor we was kept up by the screaming and shouting Mexican and America drunks till about 2:15 am most nights.  Hotel staff in reception are just rude Miguel you should be a toilet cleaner not on the front desk.  What I noticed most is the only thing that motivates the people here is a nice big tip.  Money is all they want.   The hassle the staff give you to sell trips and treatments is way too much. 

As you can see this is not the hotel for me and this is just my opinion.   If you have a different view fair play. I feel this was more then likely a really good hotel once but has gone down hill.  

Pool bar waiters are good they keep coming round and getting you drinks. But I tipped well for that service.

reviews.author: mikegS2957PH
reviews.title: who is rating this place?????
reviews.text:
we were at the jw.marriott wanted to extend our vacation but they were booked.  we booked the paradisus based on the ratings.  walked down the beach to see what we had  booked and began to hear a horrible bass thumping.  it was the 5 star paradisus playing 120 decible boggie bass thumping music and the tattooed residents enjoying it all.  went back to the jw for the last night in fear of the next three days.  checked in around noon and instantly smelled strong mildew and i started wheezing.  the checkin gal was, on the surface, very helpful but i knew what was coming.....timeshare pitch.  i yelled at her in loud enough to be heard over the thumping music NOOOOOOO!!!  asked the bellman if the place flooded and he said the place was full of sand and water last hurricane.  unfortunately the place was not gutted.  took us to the room in tower 5 i thing and it smelled.  we figured we could deal with it at least we got free meals................................called the restaurants and all booked for the 3 days we were there ,but there was always the burger bar and taco salad bar. yum.   looked online and the jw marriott had some cancellations we left and never went back spent $1099 for 3 nights of zeroness.  
moral of the story...UNLESS YOU HAVE VERY LOW STANDARDS,ARE LESS THAN 30, AND HAVE NEVER BEEN TO A GOOD HOTEL,  DO NOT BOOK THIS HOTEL!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Gray52
reviews.title: Beautiful Beach. Downhill Fast From There
reviews.text:
Let me preface this review by saying this was our 7th different all-inclusive (6 in Cancun/Playa del Carmen, 1 in Punta Cana). This our first trip without the entire family. People giving this place 5-star reviews apparently don't stay at many high end resorts. This place is in no way worthy of 5-stars. 
THE GOOD: 
The beach is the best we've ever been. The resort is extremely wide, and the water was stunningly turquoise blue. We got lucky, as there was no seaweed at all during our stay. Unfortunately, that's where "the good" ends. Ladies beware... there are 4 toilets total on the entire beach, two at each end of the main area. None of them are well maintained. 
THE BAD:
Food - The food was, without question, the worst of any resort we've ever been. Their best restaurant was on par with most of the bad we've had at other resorts. Nothing seemed cooked fresh. Everything is cooked into large lots and stored in open areas, and is cold by the time it's served. When it reaches your table/buffet, nothing was hot, or even warm. When we checked in, the staff touted how the buffet was all new and the food was improved. The wife and i were starving, so we headed there to check it out. We were shocked at the limited selections to choose from, and the lack of cooked-to-order selections. Most food items were empty every time we ate the buffet (mostly breakfast), so we stood around expecting a replacement. Nope. So i asked. Out came food. COLD EGGS, COLD BEEF, COLD CHICKEN. It was ridiculous. The next three nights we tried a la carte. It tasted like they pulled the food off the buffet, put it onto a plate, and served it up. Nothing was hot like you'd expect from an a la carte. Most people go to a higher end all-inclusive for good food. This is not one of those resorts.
BALI BEDS are $160/day. That's right, $160/day! and the bed itself is hard as a rock. DO NOT reserve one on the beach. There's a large double stack of speakers at each end of the bali bed setup, and the DJ plays music all.day.long. and it's LOUD. Think Metallica concert loud. Not an exaggeration. POOLSIDE SEATING -  There just isn't even close to enough seating around the pools. There's not even close to enough poolside seating for this resort. We were told the resort was at 80% capacity, and there were people sitting all over the concrete and in the grass areas... and that was at 11am in the morning! There is very limited shade umbrellas for the chairs, and no small tables to hold your drinks. I felt so badly for people arriving each day at noon, not finding a single chair just to put their stuff. Im not sure, but i'm thinking this is on purpose, to get people to rent their $160/day bali beds. POOL BAR had 1 bartender each day we were there. There'd be 20 people at the swim-up area and 1 bartender, so waiting for a drink was excruciating. Drinks were stiff, however, so there's that.
ROOMS - The rooms are TINY. It was just my wife and I and we barely fit. They are extremely clean, however (might have been the $5/day we left housekeeping). DO NOT stay in the main tower. It is loud. Music blared up from the all-night bands/DJ's well into 1-2:00am. We were awoken many times... kinda like a frat party. lol. Overall, there are so many other places that cost about the same that are much better. Moon Palace, Hilton Play del Carmen, and even Paradisus Play del Carmen come to mind. Save the frustration and book elsewhere.

reviews.author: Samantha Z
reviews.title: Disgusting, outdated, not Inclusive!
reviews.text:
Pool and hotel was dirty and in major need of renovations. Food was disgusting and meal service people didn’t wear gloves. In addition there was very little to eat for food allergic people. Kids club was not inclusive to my English speaking children and also dirty and not safe!! Whole
Place was gross!

reviews.author: Hannah C
reviews.title: I will NEVER go back to this place!!! Horrifying experience!
reviews.text:
I gave them the benefit of the doubt and reached out one on one to them but they want to brush it under the rug and tell me there's nothing they can do. 
I'll start with the positives!

Beach was wonderful, cleaning and room service was on point. I will say on a positive note that I have a horrible time sleeping away from home, BUT that bed was AMAZING. If I could have stayed in bed the whole time and go to the beach, I would have. Let me rephrase, I SHOULD HAVE just stayed in the room and in bed, it would have been safer.

Now for the negatives. DO NOT GO ALONE AS A WOMAN ANYWHERE!

The food unfortunately was terrible. It tasted like your average greasy and cheaply made hotel food. In order to get a good meal, I advise you to go off the resort.

Half the lights in the room worked. The outside latch to the balcony door was missing so it was hard to get back in. Not a big deal at all. The power outlet in the bathroom for a hair dryer was coming out of the wall and there was a spark at one time. Again, I can handle that.

What I can't handle is having two of their male staff members sexually harass me. I wanted to leave the second day.

Our second day, we started off at the swim up bar. I let my husband be with a few family members while I ventured to the beach with his cousin. When we came back to the pool area, my husband was being taken towards the resort inside and we were told, "One more outburst and he's going to either jail or the hospital to sober up." Oh no...yup, he got overly excited and got a wee bit drunk. We took full responsibility. We took him to the room and and he fell asleep. One family member stayed with him for an hour to krep an eye on him. His wristband was downgraded to a kids wristband and he didn't drink the rest of the stay, and the rest of the family didn't want to either. No biggie, we're old, we just want to enjoy time away from home.

While my husband was recovering from the pool party he had, I wanted to go dance. They have an awesome dance club for ages 18 and older called The Red Lounge. That place is AWESOME! I felt safe, I felt comfortable. For about a minute.

I requested a song to the DJ (Drop It Low by Ester Dean to be exact) and he smirked at me and said he would play it only if I danced on him. Wait, what!? No. So I went back to the dance floor and hung out with the kiddos. 

Fast forward to me being old and getting tired. I said my goodbyes and headed to my room. Let me just say, when on the last day, I didn't know where my room was. It was so confusing. I got lost. Rule of being in a place where you have no idea where anything is, do your research and study the heck out of it. PLEASE.

I couldn't find my way back and I asked a staff member to help me. He was more than happy to help and understanding until we got to the room. I thanked him as I opened the door and next then I knew he had grabbed me and shoved his tongue in my mouth and I pulled away, ran into the room a few feet and he tried following before I told him my husband was in the room and laying in bed. He apologized and took off.

After two mishaps in the matter of a few hours of each other, please explain to me why I'm suppose to feel comfortable going to any other staff members for what happened? 

Apparently, Paradisus can't do anything since I didn't bring it to their attention during our stay. I reached out a week ago. I heard nothing until tonight after I sent another message telling them I would take matters into my own hands if nothing was done and I had not heard anything within the next week and that I would be reporting them.

They brought up the issue with my husband at the bar which was resolved the second day at our stay. Completely resolved and signed that nothing would partake again the rest of our stay. 

I feel like instead of taking responsibility for their lack of attention and their lack of caring, they immediately pointed the finger at my husband. 

Looking forward to reporting the resort to a higher authority. Any feedback on who I can report this to would be

reviews.author: El Duque
reviews.title: No vuelvo ni regalado.
reviews.text:
Tuvimos problemas desde el principio.

La estancia nos la habían regalado unos amigos y según llegamos a la puerta nos dicen que tenemos que presentar la tarjeta con la que se hizo la compra. Para empezar, la reserva se había hecho a través de PayPal, por lo que es una tarjeta digital que no se puede presentar e independientemente al ser un regalo no teníamos la identificación. Todo esto se resumió en que tuvimos que adelantar sobre 1.000 Euros como si estuviéramos haciendo la reserva en el momento y tardaron al rededor de 15 días en verificar que había sido por PayPal y devolvernos nuestro dinero.
A todo esto cabe destacar lo impertinentes que eran los que nos estaban atendiendo en la recepción.

Las habitaciones no están mal, pero un poco pequeñas.

La comida por lo general bastante desastre tanto en el buffet como en los restaurantes. 

No vuelvo ahí ni aunque me lo regalen, nunca mejor dicho.

reviews.author: Diana D
reviews.title: Muy mala opción!
reviews.text:
Llegamos ayer con mi grupo familiar y hasta el momento solo ha sido una costosa y muy mala experiencia que espero no le ocurra a usted! Reserve directamente con la página del hotel , donde ofrecen unas habitaciones que no corresponde para nada con la realidad, es publicidad totalmente engañosa. Recibimos unas habitaciones viejas, sucias, con mal olor, todo en general en mal estado .... anoche mismo realizamos el reclamo , dijeron que ya no podían hacer nada y que hoy nos cambiarían, desde el medio día esperemos ese cambio con las maletas empacadas sin poder hacer mucho y no sucede, mientras escribo esta opinión llevo 15 minutos escuchando la grabación en la que me dejo la señorita de recepción esperando en el teléfono. 

La alimentación, venden que tienen muchas opciones y variedad ... no hay disponibilidad cercana en los restaurantes con reservas, lo que hace que esa gran oferta se reduzca ... y para entrar al buffet general hay una fila de espera de más o menos 10- 15 minutos más las filas que tiene que hace adentro por unos huevos o pasta 

El servicio, hasta ahora las personas que nos hemos encontrado son medianamente amables pero no algo como para resaltar 

Así que ni lujo ni 5 estrellas ni un servicio acorde con la tarifa pagada 

Espero que con esta opinión pueda evitar que otros pasen por esta situación :(

reviews.author: ddswong
reviews.title: Disappointed Stay
reviews.text: This was my 8th stay at the Paradisus Cancun and it was also my first bad experience with the hotel. Many of the restaurants were closed so dinner times were at 10:30pm which is way too late. Considering I paid to upgrade to Royal Service(which is quite expensive) and had to eat at restaurants outside of the hotel is not a good sign. As Cancun has many, many great options, I would now consider staying at another hotel from now on

reviews.author: Dennis H
reviews.title: List of bad experiences to expect:
reviews.text:
Poor room services. Poor room services and poor housekeeping.
1. Found a used rag by the housekeeping in our room one night.
2. Found a cockroach  in our room the other night 
3. Hotel staff knocked on the wrong door - twice, same staff 
4. Got ignored by the beach server
5. Honeydew with lots of flies
6. Didn’t give us beach towel cards

reviews.author: Juan Luis R
reviews.title: La peor experiencia que he tenido en Cancún.
reviews.text: Empezaré por decir que he ido 9 veces a Paradisus Cancun, en el último año 3. Siempre lo había recomendado como el mejor Hotel de Cancún, pero las últimas tres ocasiones han ido de mal a peor. Me decepciona que ya no se cuiden los detalles en la habitación, simples cosas que te hacían sentir muy bien como un chocolate el día de tu llegada, un paquete de galletas en el minibar, un jugo, la cafetera... ahoa tuve que llamar en dos ocasiones porque no renovaron el servicio... las cafeteras las quitaron y ahora si quieres debes bajar al piso 0... o bien llamar para que te lo suban media hora después... no hay camastros en las habitaciones a menos que los pidas... y si tienes suerte te llevarán lo llevarán después de que insistas porque la primer respuesta es "No hay" ... los restaurantes horribles, deficientes: se acaba la comida, hay que hacer fila para entrar y tardas de 10 a 15 minutos parado esperando que se desocupe una mesa, mientras tanto el restaurante Ilbana lo tienen rentado para eventos privados... no hay forma de reservar cena a menos que lo hagas con 3 dias de anticipación! Faltan camastros en la playa y en la zona de albercas, de poca a nula amabilidad en el "cero" cuando solicitas algo. En general la peor experiencia que he tenido, no sólo en este hotel, sino en Cancún.

reviews.author: Isandro V
reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: This was our second time at Paradisus Cancun and it wasn't the same.  The buffet is not like it used to be 4 years ago.  No variety at all plus some of the restaurants were under construction.  We came back because we were expecting the same restaurants/buffets but all of that have change to the worse.

reviews.author: Y R
reviews.title: This hotel is a big disappointment!
reviews.text: Please don’t go there, it’s a big disappointment especially with the limited food choices and you will have to wait in line at restaurants for about an hour or even more. At the buffet there are only few poor choices, I little had nothing to eat. I’ve never encountered such a hotel. Btw if you want room service they will charge you 5$ delivery fee. On the beach you will never find available chairs and the beds cost $130-170 per day. When I was there was construction going on and smelled like acetone and it was very noisy. This hotel was kind of pricey but the quality very poor. I definitely will never return and don’t recommend it to anyone!

reviews.author: Lesley M
reviews.title: Hot! Not all inclusive, no coffee maker n rm no shade couldn’t get reservation
reviews.text: No ac  not all inclusive Pay for rm service food awful  no coffee maker in room Couldn’t get a single reservation even though there were open tables! Same food all day no lighting in room not enough palapas loud music at beach areas

reviews.author: Wanderer
reviews.title: Terrible Place, stay anywhere but here!
reviews.text: We booked an all-inclusive family vacation here, this place is a scam!!!! First we got a lagoon view room, which was dingy and bad, even the shampoo in the bathroom was of bad quality. We upgraded to a modern room with ocean views and that room was very nice, but smaller beds, family of 4, and 2 queen size bed, go figure how to get a good night sleep! There are only 2 restaurants you can eat food without reservations, Blue Agave and Enso, both are cheap buffet and cheap street taco places, everything is extremely cookie cutter. You can never get reservations to Mole, Lapalapa or Market Grill(which is closed, but doesn't say that on there website), or Bana(you'd have to wait in a 1 hour long line to get average sushi) but there are such limited options and long lines. We complained to the food and beverage department(Jose was extremely and probably the only genuine staff we met there) and he resolved the situation for us, but the point is, why does one has to go through hassle of complaining and wasting there time in long lines for a luxury vacation they have paid for? Shouldn't this be included and delivered as promised in the package itself? I spoke to 5-7 families while waiting in line & all had horrendous experience, one lady was upsold for $600 upgrades and promised a butler, which she hadn't seen in 3 of her 6 days! They try to sell you on timeshare and if you don't agree to even listen to there presentation(we said NO) you are useless to there guest services staff!

reviews.author: jamiet9910
reviews.title: Looking for a adults only trip? DO NOT GO HERE!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have visited Cancun area 4 years in a row, always trying out different resorts to see what we like best. After reading many positive reviews, we decided to go with the “Royal Service” part of Paradisus Cancun. We were looking for adults only, thought we were ok with children being part of the hotel as well. It was made very clearly that the “Royal Service” side was adults only. This was far from the truth. The ONLY adults only restaurant where you should be able to each a nice adults only meal, La Palapa was filled with kids on the evening we had reservations. After talking with the front desk as Royal service, they said well right now we are allowing kids! Absolutely false advertising with stating this restaurant was adults only! 
My husband and I are late 30s, and we look for entertainment and fun adult activities during our vacations. The “Royal Service” side of the resort did not have a single ounce of entertainment. I believe a nursing home would have more entertainment than this losey resort. They didn’t even have music playing at the pool for the adults only side. No swim up bar at the adults only side, no water activities. Nothing! It was extremely boring! They have advertised that there are daily activities, but no one from any activities department let anyone on the adult side know of any activities. My husband and I went down to the beach volleyball court everyday at 10:30 as it is “advertised “ that there was beach volleyball at that time and no one was ever there to get a game started. The entertainment of this resort is non existent. 
The food at the buffets was terrible. Nothing was ever hot, luke warm at best. There was a huge lack in flavor and you could never find salt and pepper! The “restaurants” food was sub-par at best. By day 3 the food became just a necessary substance, not an exciting thing to look forward to.
While the butler service was a nice feature, it was extremely overbearing. We know how to navigate our way through resorts and do not like someone bothering us multiple times a day. Our butler was very nice and kind, but just not something that we would’ve wanted if asked.
The beach was beautiful. That was the best part about this resort but honestly you can find a beautiful beach at any resort up and down the strip.
A few additional positives was the resort was clean and well maintained. The staff was wonderful. Very kind and very attentive. 
All in all, this is not a resort I would ever return to, especially the adults only side.

reviews.author: Ambassador440398
reviews.title: DEFINITELY NOT WORTH THE MONEY!!!
reviews.text: If it wasn't for the beach front, this experience would have been the worst. This hotel is considered a 4.5 star but I think its more of a 2.5 star at best. Rooms definitely need updating, beds were uncomfortable, bathrooms need updating. Food was the worst, no variety, you wake up and instead of being excited of where you are going to eat, you were more contemplating if we should eat or go out to the local restaurants even though we paid for all inclusive. Definitely not worth all inclusive since 2 restaurants were closed for remodel and everywhere else they served same thing for breakfast lunch and dinner. I would definitely not stay here again or recommend this hotel to my friends and family. I would rather stay a cheaper hotel and pay for my own food at the local restaurants!!

reviews.author: Sim S
reviews.title: Beware - reviews and pictures are deceiving
reviews.text:
I don’t think I have ever written a negative review. We travel a lot and understand not everything will be perfect, so we let a lot of things slide. However, this experience is one for the books and not in a good way. I would never come back. This place is a hot mess. It’s been a total waste of money, time and effort. We have 1 more night here and I can’t wait to get out. 

We are traveling in a group of 20+ adults and my 2 year old child. If we didn’t have our extended family with us, my husband and I would have checked out day 1. We have one more night here and almost out of this place. 

Here are a few things 
1. Service: or lack of thereof. This is bad, I mean I have stayed at motels that have better service. Our travels span from best western to the ritz/st Regis. This falls way below anything we have stayed at even 2 star hotels. Since we got to the hotel. Not a single person smiles or is helpful. Even asking a question feels like your being a burden. The check in process took over an hour and this doesn’t include standing in line. I’m just not sure what he was doing. Handing us back the wrong passports, just all over the place. We let it slide, assuming it’s thanksgiving weekend. They are probably overwhelmed. This was just a preview to the rest of our stay here. Rude, unapproachable and curt. 
2. Checking into occupied rooms: check this. My mom was given a room that was already being occupied by another guest. She opens her room and sees the room is occupied. Absolutely not acceptable. Now let’s wait another few hours to get another room given to her. 
3. Food: we know what to expect at all inclusive resorts. The food isn’t something you rave about but it’s decent and edible. Except that it isn’t at this hotel. We have been going outside of the hotel to eat. The restaurant Bana- the staff is incredibly rude. They serve with so much attitude. If you ask for anything, they get extremely frustrated. 
4. Rooms- we had 9 rooms between our family. Most of the room very outdated (I’m talking from the 80s). Bathrooms have a weird stench. Can’t get hot water, lukewarm at best. We had to change out rooms given some were just not acceptable at all. 
5. Room service: again, basically no service. Only thing I ordered was milk. They say 30-40 mins, more like 1.5-2 hours or it doesn’t come at all. When you call to check the status, they will say server is on the way or 2 more mins. Another 15 mins go by, still no milk. I call again, “I’m sorry he’s leaving right now.” And the story continues. They charge you for delivery. Few times my kid fell asleep just waiting and waiting for his milk. I asked them let me come and get it. No you can’t. Or can I get it from the restaurant, no you can’t. Okay so I guess I didn’t have much options. 
6. I took a few pieces of fruit from the restaurant next to the pool, enso. I was stopped immediately and scolded for doing so. Seriously felt like I was a child again and being told how bad I am. Our cabana was next to the restaurant and my son wanted 2 pieces of watermelon and some pineapple. I didn’t leave with a mountain of food. I understand you have rules but you don’t need to be so demeaning. Let me know what the policy is and we will comply.  

Our family stayed at paradisus in playa del Carmen. They had a wonderful experience. So we booked the Cancun property. It was a night and day difference. I would never stay here again even if it was free. Should I argue for a refund, sure. Do I have the energy, no. 

We booked this property also based off the reviews. We are all convinced these can’t be real. There is just no way this place is 5 stars. Poor service, outdated rooms, low quality food, unfriendly staff, and the list goes on. 

Can’t wait to leave, one more night until we go back home. I guess every hotel we stay at after this will always be uphill. This place has set the bar so low.

reviews.author: Riya K
reviews.title: Not a 5 diamond resort!
reviews.text: This was our 3rd vacation in Cancun. This couldn’t be more disappointing. We had 4 rooms in total and we called a month ahead to request king beds for 3 rooms and double for 1 and possibly same floor and we had double beds for majority of the rooms. And different floors. It was more than half and hour to check us in and no one offered us welcome drinks. When I went to my room, there was water everywhere. I went to change my room, they made me feel like I was inconvenient for them. Room sink and bathtub were yellowish and kept clogging(disgusting) It was beginning of our vacation so I did not want to ruin my mood and head to the pool. Few restaurants were under construction and wasn’t updated on their website. Food quality was really bad. Raw and dairy products in the buffet were kept without ice underneath and barely any seafoods options. Very poorly managed property. We had to dine in the same restaurant over and over again since options were limited. Also resort charges you fees to deliver in room dining food. We paid $10 for  two glasses milk for our 5 years old. Very limited pool side entertainment and no activities involving the guests beside volleyball and soccer. Few highlights of our vacation were pool server Auscion and buffet night server Victor. Amazing personalities and very accommodating but we do not recommend this resort and specifically with kids.

reviews.author: Daziz
reviews.title: Third visit and DISASTER
reviews.text: This is our third visit here and we took friends because we used to love it so much. Not only was it not the same but half the hotel was under construction and nobody cared to let guests know or offer any sort of compensation that half the amenities were not usable. We had a leaky AC in our room where me and my husband slipped and fell getting to the bathroom in the middle of the night. By the morning parts of the ceiling were on the floor. It took them until 12:30pm the next day to move, so another half a day wasted. The staff was super unapologetic and offered no compensation for the huge inconvenience. This place is going in a poor direction and fast. Such a shame because we used to love this place.

reviews.author: Escape626395
reviews.title: Muito cuidado no check in! NÃO RECOMENDO ESSE HOTEL!!
reviews.text: Fiz pré pagamento ou seja pagamento adiantado, dai queriam me cobrar novamente no check in caso nao mostrasse o mesmo cartao que havia sido utilizado Para pagamento ha varios meses, no entanto como eu tenho varios cartoes nao estava em posse desse mesmo e fui ameacado que teria que efetuar novamente pagamento embora estivesse tudo ja pago e comprovante da reserva quitada em meu nome!! Por sorte acabei achando o cartao velho e mostrando para o gerente da recepcao ele deixou concluir check in sem cobrar novamente! Foi muito estressante e um clima terrivel, nunca vi esse procedimento e realmente numca mais pretendo voltar para esse hotel! Vc chega cansado p. Se Hospedar resort e é recebido desse modo sendo ameaçado a ter q. Pagar em duplicidade numa reserva que constava paga!!!!absurdo total

reviews.author: alejandra mutio
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel, pésimo servicio.
reviews.text:
Check in duro 1 hr. No tenían mi reservacion lista, no servían sus terminales, nadie se dirigia a mi para explicarme el por qué de la tardanza. Una hr parada esperando a que me dieran mi habitación. 

Reserve en el restaurante de especialidades mexicano y sólo había cupo para las 11 pm, soy vegana y me sirvieron una lasagna de verduras en un restaurante mexicano. La mesera gritaba y aplaudía diciendo "ya nos vamos"... Como si tuviera prisa de que nos pararamos de la mesa por el horario. Me hace pensar que la lasagna y la Falta de creatividad del chef Fuera proque tambien tenía prisa de irse.

En el área de la alberca no usan sustituto de azúcar. Así que la Ndsdf me dijo rotjndamente: no hay, si quiere puede ir al restaurante a pedir su limonada con estevia.

En el coffee Shop le pedí al encargado que me Diera el nespresso más ligero y me dice: se lo voy a hacer pero sino le gusta no me pida otro.

El aire acondicionado lo servía y tardaron 40 minutos en llegar a la habitación.

Al final de mi estancia di toda esta información a concierge y la respuesta principal fue: a la próxima reserve en servicio real ahí no hay quejas.

Pésimo servicio, pésimo seguimiento.

reviews.author: inmacg
reviews.title: Omitieron informacion sobre locales
reviews.text: Mis amigas y yo fuimos hoy martes a pasar el dia al club de playa cocos beach club en paradisus y llamamos para pedir info de vistos para locales y los I got Aton que 2500 pesos por Bali esa para 6 personas y entra hasta cierra cantidad de consumo de bebidas y comida pero estando allá para hacer el feta presumir para llegar el consumo de lo que nos cobraban para aprovechar solo éramos 3 adultos y una ninla de menos de 2 años estando allá mi amiga que había pedido info por corro le informaron que salía entre semana de lunes a jueves 500 por persona y niños menores de 5 años cero costo .. indignadas por no haber wifi informadas le comentamos nuestro enfado al camarero el cual nos atendió muy bien pero también fue la persona que los atendió la Llamada para la información de costos le dijimos la información recibida por correo y nos dijo que lo preguntaría y pues finalmente nos dijo que se quedaría así  como tenías de consumo quecasi llegaba a los 2 mil .. pero los hubiera gustado tener la otra opción pues pedíamos consumo solo para llegar a la cantidad .. u el menú todo era mucho totopos y jitomate y cebolla y poca comida..

reviews.author: Aimee
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text:
My husband and I have stayed at this resort on 9 different occasions, but this will be the very last. We started staying here in 1998 when it was Melia Cancun and we really enjoyed the resort. This was before it became an all-inclusive. The resort had great amenities, good restaurants, and awesome service. It was clean and modern. Over the past several years, many changes were made. Names went from Melia Cancun to Gran Melia Cancun and now Paradisus Cancun. With each name change, services got to be worse and worse. Prior to our last stay, which was 6/22-6/29, was in 2014. What a huge difference 5 years makes. The service was horrible and many rude workers were noted. The food and restaurants were horrible and disgusting. We used to enjoy the Market Grill for lunch, as it was a menu offered with a sit down lunch. This lazy buffet crap has got to go for the price you pay. The rooms are terribly outdated, the check in, check out customer service reps are the rudest in our history of staying there. The pool is filthy, and we never saw them attempting to clean it. We’re done...if you want a relaxing vacation where you don’t have to struggle with laziness, this is NOT your place. I will deter anyone that asks my opinion about staying here. There are much nicer resorts in Cancun...SEE YA, Paradisus! 

BTW...7 nights, we ate at Ruth’s Chris, La  Parilla, the Crab House twice, and La Dolce Vita for dinner. Don’t waste your time on warm melting mousse on the buffets.

reviews.author: Greg Marchand
reviews.title: Horrible Place
reviews.text:
I am reviewing this place as an all inclusive resort in the price range of the Excellence Resort and other high-end resorts.  I am aware there is a way to get this place cheaper and pay a-la-carte.  It is a horrible deal for the money for all inclusive.  1.  Crickets and pigeons are on the menu.  2. Almost none of the staff speaks any English.  3.  they will constantly harass you to come to their time-share rip-off seminar.   

Take your money to one of the excellence resorts instead where you will get good service and better food.

reviews.author: Tina
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
Very disappointing vacation if you don’t do royal service . They knew it was our honeymoon and they sent a bottle of champagne and tiny slice of cake ...  , no flowers, and we got an old outdated room . Other resorts I’ve stayed at they leave cute little towel animals and flower pedals or chocolates . 
And be forewarned .... there’s ALOT of steps and no railings to get to the beach which was very difficult with a bad knee . 
The restaurants were extremely hot . 3 restaurants closed for renovations and the ones left were outside and hot . Not much of a selection .... food no good . Breakfast was buffet only every day ... same old stuff . Hard cold pancakes and waffles . Even all the bars ... very hot .
I was also told that there was snorkeling available on site . Never seen that . There were some water activities but you will have a long walk down the driveway and across a highway to get to those . 
I would say that if you get royal service your stay would be better . More food choices and more help with finding things and maneuvering around the huge resort .

reviews.author: dwceilingslimited
reviews.title: Food poisoning!!
reviews.text:
Never done a trip advisor review & have stayed in many Melia Hotels in Punta Cana,Mallorca etc all of which have been excellent but need to let people who visit this hotel in Cancun aware, we have recently visited with 2 families celebrating a birthday- 11 people in total unfortunately out of those 6 people have been ill keeping them in bed for at least 2 days of our 7 nt stay. Since we arrived back in the UK 2 people have had to go to the doctor for further checks confirming food poisoning/stomach bug ! On arrival at the hotel we found cleanliness not up to 5* standard at all, the lifts in the hotel were disgusting the flooring/carpet within the lifts was filthy, the pool areas needed attention the hotel is very ‘tired’ and in desperate need of renovation. We visited all the restaurants, all of which served lukewarm tasteless food & food that was uncovered therefore open to the elements - if you are going to this hotel be extra vigilant with the food & water.
This experience has put us of Meliá hotels & Mexico

reviews.author: AdriCantuaria
reviews.title: De paradisus NADA!
reviews.text: Pésimo el trato que recibimos en el check in, hasta nos quisieron volver a cobrar por las habitaciones ! Nadie nos explico NADA! Si es tu primera vez en un all inclusive como saber que tenes que reservar para los restaurantes ? Más de 3 restaurantes cerrados por refacción, cierren de a uno! Para el desayuno teníamos que esperar más de 25 minutos en fila por una mesa! Uno de lo huéspedes terminó con picaduras de chinche !!!!!!! Una vergüenza ! Fue un viaje que tanto esperamos y la experiencia fue lamentable !

reviews.author: rene
reviews.title: LA CALIDAD Y LA ATENCION CADA VEZ ES PEOR!!! AUN EN ""ROYAL SERVICE""
reviews.text:
Me dirijo al Sr. Chrystian Rodríguez o a quien este a cargo del PARADISUS  CANCÚN.  Soy cliente frecuente de los PARADISUS Playa del Carmen y de PARADISUS Cancún desde el año 2013 y cada año de manera consecutiva voy con la familia o con amigos.  Y en esta ocasión tanto la calidad de los alimentos y la atención del personal fue pesima!!! El servicio en general no fue a lo que nos tienen acostumbrados y más en el Segmento o el Nivel ""ROYAL SERVICE"" En esta ocasión de plano nos DECEPCIONARON!!!  Y repito a pesar que estuvimos hospedados 8 días 7 noches en "ROYAL SERVICE" que se supone que es el nivel o segmento más alto en calidad y atención, y para nada fue lo que esperábamos comparado con otros años....... Al Grado de buscar otras opciónes para nuestras futuras vacaciones como los Hoteles: HARD ROCK CANCÚN, SECRETS THE VINE CANCÚN, LE BLANC,  LIVE AQUA. ETC ETC.
Algo no están haciendo bien y sus clientes lo están notando esa no solo es nuestra percepción si no también de otros huéspedes con los cuales estuvimos platicando y opinaban igual.

reviews.author: Omer Kurtoglu
reviews.title: Please do not be naive with their advertisement! Be prepared for any shocking suprrise!
reviews.text:
Please be prepared if you stay at this hotel:
They only clean swimming pools in exclusive area. I stayed 7 nights and I had not seen them cleaning the swimming pools at any time! My sun cut his finger in the swimming pool, even after that, (they made a report) they did not clean it. After we checked in, we were told there were a couple restaurants, but 3 out of 7 were closed without any notice. They were supposed to let us know in advance. Also, there are not enough shades for guests. If you have kids, you may be shocked because they will be burned or they will have to stay inside! Even if you asked for it, they will not provide you a shade or place instead, they will try to sell you a bungalow for usd 170!  Interestingly, The water was out in the entire hotel more than an hour and believe me you would not want to see the restrooms. We could not find any restroom to use including our rooms or anywhere in the hotel. The worst part (including the reception or front desk) nobody paid any attention to it! They just said go find another clean restroom you can clean your hands after we have water!.. If you complain about anything, believe you will not be listened, you will be very angry with their carelessness. If you like to swim in the ocean, there are a lot of sea weeds which disables you to swim, No body cleans. Ocean is bad, swimming pools are dirty + no enough shade!

reviews.author: jcamac631988
reviews.title: Food was terrible.
reviews.text: wouldn't recommend this hotel. I have stayed in Melias resorts in the past and I have no complaints but this one in particular most improve on the food and service in general also rooms are outdated and dirty. our cover sheets had bunch of stains on it.  for the price I would've expected a better experience .

reviews.author: Teja P
reviews.title: Quality has tanked definitely stay away
reviews.text:
I booked 25 room nights at the Melia over this past weekend.

I was really happy and excited as the quality of service, cleanliness and experience last year was spectacular, one of the best resorts I've stayed at overall. We were welcomed with a welcome drink, hotel rooms were in pristine condition, everything was clean and we were well taken care of.

This year, it was completely different. The hotel is deteriorating on the inside with half the rooms going under renovation. Even the majority of restaurants were closed leaving us with limited options for food throughout the day. 

Additionally, check in took several hours (also due to the added complexity of having multiple guests), but it looks like their systems were down so they were recording everything by hand this time around.

In addition to check in the room conditions this time around were attrocious. They were unclean with pieces of marble being broken off, the beds not being made/dirty linens, and the views not being as advertised. We booked lagoon rooms but had 2 rooms with a view of a truck. 

My personal room did not have access to air conditioning throughout the entire duration of the trip even though I called the concierge 5 times to come fix it. Given the average temperature was above 88F during the day, this was completely unreasonable and was not a safe place to sleep at even at night.

reviews.author: Sara G
reviews.title: Beautiful resort - but that's about it
reviews.text:
Our overall stay was horrendous. 

Pros:
-beautiful landscape
-rooms were clean 
-bartenders at the pool were outgoing, friendly, and quick. Best staff at the resort hands down. 

Cons:
Everything else
-AC didn't work in main building or in our room. When we called down they said it hadn't been working for days, if we knew that we would have asked for a room that did have working AC
-food was terrible. Room service can sustain you for a day, but other than that - the McDonald's across the street is worth the trip
-as an all inclusive guest, the mini fridge was not stocked daily. We had to constantly call down to the front desk asking for bottled water (which should be a given - no matter where you are). 
-room service will say "30 min" no matter what, but usually takes close to 2 hours
-impossible to make reservations at the restaurants (but the food isn't worth it)
