-the staff is not helpful at all. They would stare at us and then walk away with out answering a simple question ("what time does the restaurant open?")
-front desk calls every morning (early for vacationers) to claim your welcome gift -- which is a breakfast while they sales pitch for a timeshare. EVERY.SINGLE.DAY. 

I would recommend any other hotel, or go in with the above expectations

reviews.author: Ricardo V
reviews.title: La peor experiencia
reviews.text:
Acabo de llegar ayer al hotel me quedo hasta el 25. El señor del front desk desde que llegamos nos decía al preguntar que porque se demora tanto que nos aguantemos que a pesar de que podemos estar emocionados no podía hacer más . Vine con mi hija de 7 meses y a pesar de haber pagado por todo incluido nos quieren cobrar el microondas por esterilizar sus biberones. El restaurante principal cerrado . Se demoraron 40 minutos traerme un huevo revuelto .El secador del cuarto dañado. Si uno quiere una cerveza diez am te dicen q no hay que esperes hasta las once 
. En general la atención parece de hotel 3 estrellas . Para acabar 5 cuartos y les da lo mismo lo que pensamos . La peor experiencia !

reviews.author: hectorespino
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel, no regresaría
reviews.text: Estuve hospedado este fin de semana que pasó y no se ni por donde empezar. Llegué el viernes y ni una bebida de bienvenida o algo así (comparado con otros hoteles de su categoría en los que me he hospedado) sin clima dentro del lobby y elevadores se sentía demasiada calor. Te dan un pequeño recorrido para explicarte las instalaciones del hotel y te dicen que hay dos restaurantes en remodelación y que lo que viste en internet es una mentira respecto a las diferentes tipo de comidas que ofrecen, desde ahí empece a sentirme engañado. Nos entregan habitación con una cama y eramos 3 personas, llamo y dicen que no tienen habitaciones con dos camas pero que mandan una cama extra (durisimo el colchón por cierto). Al día siguiente después de medio día regresamos de desayunar para esto ya habían limpiado la habitación y mi mamá se encontró con que le habían ROBADO dinero dentro de un monedero que dejo en una bolsa de playa, hicieron una "investigación" pero no resolvieron nada. Respecto a los restaurantes ya sea desayuno, comida o cena había grandes filas para que te asignaran mesa, los alimentos normales pero con poca variedad en el buffet, en el desayuno 25 minutos haciendo fila para un omelette. En el snack siempre te atendían de mala gana y en toda la estancia nunca hubo pizza a como anunciaban, para colmo mi mamá y mi hermano se enfermaron del estomago con los nachos y papas con queso que ingirieron ahí. En los bares ya para cierta hora no tenían algunas bebidas, y no cuentan con Bar 24 horas o algo por el estilo, ya para antes de las 12 am no te sirven nada. Lo poco rescatable fue el servicio de algunos meseros que te atendían en algunos restaurantes y en la playa con las bebidas, en fin, no recomiendo a este hotel y no regresaría.

reviews.author: Beatriz Maria V
reviews.title: De Paradisus no tiene nada
reviews.text: Las habitaciones son viejas, feas y tienen que remodelarlas al menos para el precio que tienen, el jacuzy del balcon sucio no lo limpian y ademas no funciona, cuando haces el checkin no te brindan ni un coctel de bienvenida, los restaurantes el  servicio es pesimo hay que hacer lineas y sentarse donde te digan ellos no puedes ni escoger tu mesa, el cafe trabaja por horarios y el helado tambien. La piscina por Dios que horror alguien se va a enfermar alli de la infeccion que tiene CONSEJO no lleven trajes de banos blancos porque salen verdes del lino que tiene pegado a los azulejos de la piscina no se ve pero esta alli una bavilla verde asquerosa la verdad que para lo que pague por la habitacion que fueron 355 por noche por 4 noches y dos habitaciones en total pague 2838.96 y fue el peor dinero gastado de mi vida no vale la pena, ademas si tienes alergias el olor del hotel es a flor de muerto la verdad super desagradable, alli no voy mas.......

reviews.author: Gabita1126
reviews.title: Opinión
reviews.text: En este instante estoy alojada en este hotel tengo más de 12 años viniendo a Cancún vengo mucho y conozco la mayoría de los hoteles y me faltaba este por conocer en su mi estancia ha sido insatisfactoria el hotel según esto es de una categoría buena de vdd he ido a otros hoteles de más baja categoría como el crown paradise y es muchísimo mejor que este aquí hay que hacer filas en todos los restaurantes la comida es mala y para todos los que se alojan aquí ponen poca variedad en todo el hotel no hay clima y la vdd es súper desesperante estar comiendo y sudando o estar en el lobby tomando unas bebidas y sudando el cuarto el clima no enfría mucho en si toda mi estadía ha sido horrible siento que mi dinero lo perdí al reservar este hotel de vdd no se alojen aquí hay hoteles mucho mejores y con mejores tarifas No lo recomiendo en nada ni una estrella le daría a este hotel

reviews.author: Sherri
reviews.title: HOT & FILTHY
reviews.text:
Arroved Tuesday August 12th....  The lobby was an inferno.  Not a little hot, but Mayan  Aztec "you aint made for this heat" HOT!  Its the hottest Ive ever been INSIDE a building I literally sweated all my make up and eyelashes off while I waited to be checked in... LITERALLY! ( the lobby wasnt hot like that everyday but Friday morning at 8 am in the morning is was back to blazing HEAT hot in the lobby.  I came in sweating and they sent me off in a sweaty mess as well.  

So lets talk about my 5 star resort room.  My first room was FILTHY!  Walked in the door and the odor of mildew and the sweet scent of past quest sweat wafted into my nostrils.  I looked around the room which had obviously outlived its youth and tried to mentally move past the dread that was now seeping through me.  I went into denial.  Hey I was in Cancun, like how bad can it be.  Just unpack I said and go to the pool!  So I threw my suit case down opened it up and thats when I got a good look at the couch.  Not only was the frame OBVIOUSLY broken and you couldnt sit on it,  it was stained in a way that only people with small children or drunken relatives would understand.  Looking at the couch mad me start to scratch and itch like I had become allergic to it.  I thought it was my imagination and then my roomate started slapping herself and screaming....  the room had gnats, lots of them!  Oh by the way the outlets in the room didnt work as well.

FInally I accepted I was not going to make it to the pool to cool off after I had literally melted in the lobby the first time and went back to request another room....  hours later we got another room after the manager tried to convince me to sleep in the filthy stankin gnat infested room and he would upgrade me the next day.  I told him to get me transport back to the airport and explain to my company who was paying for this trip why I wouldnt be able to attend the functions.  By the way the pictures of hanging frabric is actually from the box spring in the 1st room, so its fair to say the bedding was less than desirable.

So the second room was clean and defintely more updated...  I still wouldnt call it luxurious but I didnt feel like I was sleeping in a cest pool.  However,  workers from the hotel begin to use the room directly next door from mine as a staging area for their spray painting projects  LITERALLY.  There were all out on the patio  and had the door to the room open because apparently they were chocking as well from the industrial spray paint machine they were using.  Unfortunately they didnt give us mask as well so we started to choke. So back to the inferno, im sorry I mean Lobby I go so we wait for another room....  rooms they initally said THEY DID NOT HAVE!

Its past 10 pm when we get a decent room...  we are still in the clothes we flew in and having been sweating profusely in from the moment we walked into this Hot Box of a resort.  No pool...  no nothing but back in forth to the lobby.  We never had a chance to fix ourselves up for the company dinner and arrived over an hour late.  Did I mention I was suppose to give a speech?  Anywho I was happy to at least sleep in a clean room that night.  I expectactions had been drastically lowered.

Oh by the way.... they owe me a new IPHONE.  My phone would charge sporatically on and off and sometime not at all.  Then the second day I took the cord out of the ipone and literally found soot around the connection like it had been burnt. Now my phone wont charge at ALL!  I checked with other people in my group who experienced the same thing.  Then the last day I overheard the people at the front desk say that its not an AC problem its and electrical problem  that they are working on that is affecting the AC.  Which makes sense im sure my phone took a power surge and was fried.  

 There are multiple people from my group with their own individual horror story.  I will let them share that independently.  Believe me whoever at corporate who booke the hotel is about to catch some heat from some VERY UNHAPPY top producers!

Please puruse the attached pictures at your leisure!

reviews.author: Limarime
reviews.title: Para mejorar o cambiar
reviews.text: Contaminación auditiva al 100% nada recomendado para descansar, en la piscina música del DJ del hotel y de clientes con bocina música corridos mexicanos a todo volumen y la respuesta de la persona del hotel es cada cliente si quiere puede traer su bocina y escuchar al volumen que desee.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.title: DANGER! DO NOT STAY HERE!!!
reviews.text:
First off let me tell you we've stayed at numerous Paradisus and Melia resorts in different countries. They have all been fantastic. This trip was VERY different. It was to be a special family trip having brought my 9 month old daughter. It ended up being more of a nightmare. For any new mothers and fathers, let me give you the inside scoop. 

First, for nearly 3 days we had to ask them to come fix our door. You didnt even need a key to access our room You could simply walk in. ALL FATHERS!!! - How would you feel knowing anyone could access your room with your wife and baby sleeping inside???!!!. 

At one point when we really tried making it an issue, they told us we had to wait by the door for security. Of course, after we told them we have MILK inside the room and our child needs to EAT! They made us wait 45 MINUTES!

Next, for all of you mothers still feeding via breast milk, I'm sure you understand that you need to drink lots of water to keep this going. We asked for nearly 3 days to refill our water in the room. From guest services, receptionist, the maid, the maids in the hallway and even the FRONT DESK MANAGERS - ALMA AND JUAN!!!

Next, the AC goes out in the entire hotel. Our 9 month old cant even sleep in such heat! Of course, After the numerous occasions of trying to address the issues with the "Front Desk Manager, JUAN... I never hear back from him so I have to chase down someone new. This time is was ALMA. Didn't get very far with her either.

"ABSOLUTELY PATHETIC!"

Countless hours later, nothing has been resolved, no phone calls to check on us, not even a knock on the door. 

TO HELL WITH THIS RESORT! 

If you have a family, small children and especially an infant or baby, let this be your warning. This hotel is not a place you want to be.

p.s. We also found BLACK MOLD on our balcony.

reviews.author: rhonday
reviews.title: Worst welcome on vacation
reviews.text:
We just checked in and immediately regret our decision. I wish Hyatt Ziva was available for a quick book but it’s too late to change. (We stayed there last year and doesn’t compare) Strongly advise going elsewhere with the money you spend. Juan (front desk “manager”) and Rosi at the front office didn’t even greet us with  a smile or look at us. We had booked a king room with ocean view and they first said it wasn’t available for another hour when our Check in time was suppose to be 3 and we got there at 5. Then she goes somewhere and comes back and says it’s actually not available at all... Then they’re like it’s not going to be available til tomorrow. I don’t understand this if we’ve made reservationsssssss- can someone explain????!!! 
Then we get to our room without assistance whereas Hyatt ziva or anywhere else usually has a bellboy and even offer you drinks. Our room is a flashback to the 80’s (minibar isn’t even stocked) with a corner view of the ocean. 

Oh we have “towel cards” for every time we need towels and if we lose these cards we have to pay for a replacement. I mean I could literally go on and on about how awful it is and how much we wish we booked elsewhere. 

Shower head was broken, Bathroom had leaks everywhere. They never replaced our hotel room towels for some reason? I had to call every single day to get new ones which was bizarre. 

Im gonna keep it short. My main issue is people like my family work hard everyday- we plan these vacations to look forward to something. These are suppose to be precious vacation time that we work hard for and rightfully deserve. We’re not rude, snobby or inconsiderate people and I expect the same in return when I’m on vacation. It’s a big letdown and I hope you other vacationers have better luck! Cheers-

reviews.author: fredl849
reviews.title: Chambre
reviews.text:
Très déçu nous sommes dans la chambre 3810 a cité de l’ascenseur avec bébé bruit infernal toute la nuit le mécanisme réveille toute la famille 

On se plaint mais personne veut nous changer de chambre. 
Vraiment désolant de payer ce prix

reviews.author: Brainmater
reviews.title: Worst Stay Ever!
reviews.text:
I have travelled everywhere with my kids. I have never ever left a review anywhere before. 8 of us when on this trip. I have 5 kids. I requested many times that our rooms be close to each other. They put us separate floors! Check in took 45 mins and I was first in like. Don’t get me started on the food! Way below average! Like a 2! My kids pretty much into ate desert! Then to make everything worse a group of 300 guests showed up and behaved very inappropriately in front of kids at the pool. Twerking and grinding into booties and very sexual and inappropriate stuff. The DJ was shouting out horrible profanities. I have never been so disappointed and dissatisfied in my life. I will never step another foot into any Paradisus or Melia resort.
Oh let’s not even mention someone tried it break into my room at 2:15 am my last night there.  I was terrified. I looked out the view home and the guy was just standing there. Called down and told them to send someone up right away. They did and took the guy away. Must have been drunk but still terrifying experience. I couldn’t sleep all night! 
 Don’t go to this resort! Don’t be fooled by all the positive reviews! If you are looking for good food at least this is not where you will find it.

reviews.author: roldje
reviews.title: Gooodmorning, I agree and would love to address my MANY concerns, Such as the room advertised is not the room and at the
reviews.text: IT was terrible the room promised was not given and there was no rebate u got what they had and that's how they worked it. I could go on for hrs...the lady that rented it put false pictures up of rentals she did not own...

reviews.author: RCARLOSHUERTAP
reviews.title: De lo peor en Cancún
reviews.text: Todo el tiempo batalle con el personal, aun pagando el servicio de Family Concierge la atención es muy mala, te reservan cenas sin pedir horario ni explicar si te agrada o no. No volvería nunca. El aire acondicinado hace mas ruido que una bomba. Nunca habia toallas. De verdad pésima experiencia.

reviews.author: Inspire30082938877
reviews.title: ceo
reviews.text: the hotel is beautiful but management needs to be changed, they are cheap to even turn the AC on in the buffet or in the lobby of the hotel, everything to them is money , the worst experience ever had in Cancun we reserved 3 rooms  never will go there again and I am a travel agent I will make sure not to reserve to my clients in this hotel

reviews.author: Flyer44634778617
reviews.title: Would never stay there again
reviews.text: Main building is extremely loud, you can’t sleep if any events or music is playing. My entire group got sick from eating at Vento - we were all super sick the rest of the week. Food was just okay. Not enough chairs at the pool. No food served at the pool. Would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Nikki
reviews.title: Stay somewhere else!
reviews.text:
How are people rating this place as excellent??? Where do I even begin. 1st off, the check in process was a joke, took over an hour in line. You have 2 people checking people in while a dozen ladies walk around waiting to talk to you about the resort and to 
“up-sell” you on timeshares for Malia. We had 
reservations for 2 queen beds and an ocean view. They said they had us in the system for non-ocean 
view, whatever, my family and I were tired and hungry so I didn’t care at that point. After check in 
comes the pushy sales pitch. Finally get to our 
room, 1 king bed! Went back to front desk and we were told that 2 queens are not guaranteed even if you booked 6 months prior so we had to request 
a cot. The room was absolutely disgusting! I’m attaching pictures of our room. I’ve been in cleaner Motel 6’s!! We stayed in the room one night and my breaking point was when water started dripping on my head from the ceiling while sitting on the toilet (sorry for the visual). After totally losing my sh*t, 
they put us in the exclusive Malia part of the hotel. The room was amazing, clean and we had a jacuzzi on our balcony. This is what I expected from a 5 star hotel. As for the rest of the resort, the pool is very deep. The shallowest part is about 4 1/2 feet. There is a kiddy pool which is 2 feet deep but what do you
do if you have pre teens? My daughter isn’t a great swimmer so it was hard for her so we bought her a donut floaty. Also, the pool closes at 7pm, which I 
found odd. There are two pools and most activities were around the small pool so I get closing that pool. They have a kids zone but it always looked like there were just a few 5 year olds sitting around in a room watching tv. My 11 yo had no desire to join. Food is very mediocre. There are a few restaurants you do not need reservations for and a few you do. We never got to try the reservation ones cause they were always booked out till 10pm. You can only 
make reservations 2 days out so if you don’t call first thing in the am, you are SOL. My daughter had a great facial and mani/pedi at the spa and my 
husband had a great message. I had a mediocre mani/pedi...of course! A woman I was chatting with at the hotel said she comes to Cancun all the time and by far this was their least favorite of the hotels they had experienced. My opinion...go somewhere else, especially if you have kids!!!

reviews.author: Explore53981383766
reviews.title: Dissatisfied
reviews.text: You could improve our hotel experience by providing your costumers with their basic necessities. When we asked for bottled water, hotel employees sent us from one extreme of the hotel to another. After repeatedly being sent to different parts of the hotel, we were told that they had no bottles of water. It is truly baffling that a hotel with such a high price range cannot offer their costumers even a single bottle of water. Not only that, the food variety was poor. However, if the variety was poor, but good quality then it would be acceptable; that was the case with this hotel. The meat was raw and inedible as it was bland and had no taste. The buffet offered food that lacked flavor and variety. The food that was offered, was restricted. For example, in the buffet, food was not replenished and portions were restricted. Additionally, the pool bar did not allow you to get more than one small pizza per person, WHEN it was available, because most of the time there was no food anywhere. Moreover, the drinks where disappointing. The quality was pessimistic; soda tasted more like water with sugar and no gas, and alcoholic drinks lacked any alcohol whatsoever. Besides the food, the local amenities like the pool were filled with mold and demonstrated the lack of care that the hotel staff displayed towards the cleanliness of the hotel environment. There was also no hotel entertainment for teenagers. No kayaking, snorkeling, or paddle boarding, which are standard activities offered at most, if not all, other all inclusive resorts around the world. Although there was one small game room, it was very difficult to locate and only contained ONE billiard table and three, barely functional computers. Furthermore, this is a VERY big hotel, meant to capacitate a LOT of people. The space in the restaurants were nowhere near big enough to accommodate the amount of guests in the hotel. Lines in the buffet where extremely long and making a reservation was a hastle. There was no space in the restaurants and a reservation had to made around 3 days in advance which is ridiculous. The rooms were nowhere near as maintained as they should be; the pillows had a bad odor, as did the sheets. There was also very limited amount of shade around the pool and beach area. By 7:30 in the morning, all the spots were already taken. Conclusively, this hotel was not worth the price and did not meet our expectations.

reviews.title: Paradisus уже не тот
reviews.text:
Отдыхали в отеле Paradisus Cancun в период с 14.06.2019 по 25.06.2019 двое взрослых и ребенок 9 лет. 
Отдыхают в отеле в основном американцы, канадцы и немного испанцев.
Отель представляет собой 5 пирамид, часть номеров с видом на море и часть на залив. Главная пирамида внутри оформлена в виде зимнего сада со свисающими лианами, от чего создается парниковый эффект, очень влажно и душно, т.к. помещение не проветривается.
Бронировали номер с видом на залив с двумя кроватями на прямую на сайте отеля в декабре 2018 года, была предложена скидка 35% за ранее бронирование, но за две недели до вылета цена была точно такая же, как и в декабре. Отель просто обманывает своих клиентов.
Мы приехали в отель около 3 часов дня, поэтому проблем с заселением не было, но кто прилетал рано утром, должен был ожидать и бродить по отелю.
Нас встретила девочка, проводила на ресепш, на этом все. Никто не рассказал про отель и про часы работы ресторанов, баров, где поменять полотенца. При регистрации образовалась очередь из прибывших отдыхающих, работали только 2 человека и очень медленно, и это в разгар сезона, и рабочего дня. 
В отеле 5 пирамид, 1 и 5 пирамида находятся с краю, эти номера предназначены для клиентов royal service, там тихо. А тем, кто живет в пирамидах 2,3,4 придется забыть о тишине, даже в ночное время, об этом, кстати, отель умалчивает, как и о многих нюансах, о них ниже.
Нам достался номер в основной 3 пирамиде на 8 этаже с «видом на залив», а на самом деле еще и с видом на дорогу, которая шумит и гудит круглосуточно.
Территория отеля: ее просто нет, стоят 5 пирамид, 3 бассейна, вход в одних из которых только для клиентов royal service. Вечером пройтись совсем некуда, сидели на лежаках около бассейна и смотрели на море.
Питание: отель работает по системе all inclusive, действительно главный ресторан открыт всегда, только заканчивается завтрак начинается обед и также с ужином. Еще в 12 часов открывался ресторан около бара с фаст-фудом. С напитками работает бар около бассейна с 10 утра и до 18 часов.
Голодным ты не останешься, но все однообразно. Самые вкусные были фрукты, мексиканская еда на любителя, это еще больший фаст-фуд, чем американская еда. Для маленьких предназначены детей только стульчики, ни детского питания, ни каш, или еще чего-то вы здесь не найдете.
Стандартные очереди на завтраке за омлетом, и это в отеле 5* и стоимость около 20 тыс.руб. за номер в сутки, на обеде тоже самое за пастой, каждый вечер жарили какое-нибудь мясо, но оно было безвкусным. Очень удавался повару тунец, кукуруза и суши. Десерты – это вообще не мексиканское блюдо, готовить они их совершенно не умеют.
В каждом номере есть мини бар, который пополнялся ежедневно (местное пиво, газировка и вода).
Еще в отеле есть рестораны аля-карт, НО никто не говорит о том, что они за дополнительные деньги и даже при резервации, также никто об это не вспоминает, ты узнаешь это по факту, когда садишься за столик, тебе приносят меню с ценами и это отель 5*. И эта «платная» еда ровно такая же как в главном ресторане, потому что кухня на главный ресторан и рестораны аля-карт – одна, блюда с кухни несут по коридорам в разные рестораны. Смотрится вообще на по-райски.
Бар с напитками в фойе днем не работает, только вечером, там есть зона отдыха с диванами, столиками и подушками, которая после вечерних посиделок не протирается, ты днем приходишь, а там залитый диван со стульями, добро пожаловать, садитесь и отдыхайте.
Номер: отель достаточно старенький, потрепанный и требует ремонта, слышимость очень сильная, у нас постоянно не срабатывал ключ на вход, и один раз капало с потолка, пришел мастер постучал и все закончилось. В нашем номере с 2 кроватями предлагают разместится 4 гостям, но нам с мужем, достаточно стройным и небольшим вдвоём было тесно. Номер убирают каждый день, но как убирают, меняют полотенца, заполняют мини бар и заправляют кровати, на этом сервис заканчивается, на балконе следы от пребывания птиц никто не замечал, и никто не пытался вымыть. Находится в номере без кондиционера просто невозможно, он очень гудит и спать с ним невозможно, т.к. отель достаточно старый и вся инфраструктура тоже. Спать с открытым окном невозможно из-за дороги и шума, а в 6 утра начинают орать птицы. 
Но самое «прекрасное ощущение комфортного сна» предает шоу, которое проходит в фойе и начинается оно в 21.30. Поющие артисты, которые включают колонку для усиления звука, играющие на инструментах музыканты, а также все это сопровождается шумом отдыхающих и грохотом тарелок из ресторанов аля-карт, т.к. они расположены в 3 пирамиде в зимнем саду. Шоу заканчивается в 23.00, а рестораны закрываются с последним клиентом, один раз они там развлекались до 3 утра и на 8 этаже все было слышно. Почему отель не предупреждает об этом, ведь есть и семьи с маленькими детьми, которые в 22 уже давным-давно должны спать. Мы полноценно не спали ни одной ночи, спасибо отелю. Еще в темное время у отеля подсвечиваются фасады зданий, это лампочка на балконе каждого номера, которую самостоятельно ты отключить не можешь, все отключается централизованно в 23.00.
Бассейн: все отдыхающие в основном сидели в 2 бассейнах, свободных лежаков около которого уже в 8 часов не было. Вход в 3 бассейн только для клиентов royal service. Бассейн из-за этого не отличается чистотой. За 11 дней мы ни разу не видели, чтобы его чистили.
Также около бассейна находится бар с напитками, которые наливают в многоразовые пластиковые стаканы, которые вообще непонятно моются или нет.
Детский клуб: жалкое подобие и уныние. Аниматорам уже пора на пенсию, а не детей развлекать. Сам клуб находится в полуподвальном помещении на 0 этаже. Вся активность, которую мы видели – это 2 раза надували батут с горкой в бассейн, и каждый день вытаскивали детей в жару в 11 часов босиком, и без головных уборов и воды на пляж играть в футбол. Внутри детского клуба дети просто смотрели телевизор и играли в приставку.
Пляж: Карибское море заслуживает отдельных похвал, очень теплое и невероятной красоты. Но и здесь есть подвохи, о которых умалчивает отель. Про то, что на косе, где стоит отель всегда волны уже писали, но к сожалению, не писали, что еще и водоросли каждый день, и волны такие, что взрослому человеку не зайти, ребенку и тем более, никто не плавает, только убегают от волн, чтобы не накрыло и не унесло в море, вход практически везде резкий и для детей очень опасно, особенно маленьких и не умеющих плавать. Водоросли никто не убирает, только каждое утро ездит вонючий трактор и перемалывает их с песком. Сам пляж, который относится к отелю тоже никто не убирает. Там и окурки, осколки от стаканов, и железные крышки, и в этом играли дети без обуви в футбол.
Лежаков на пляже всегда хватало, так как все лежали около бассейна. Для клиентов royal service есть отдельный свой пляж, вход на который остальным запрещен.
Полотенца обменивают на карточки, которые выдают при заселении, но никто сразу об этом не говорит и тебе их не вручает, узнаешь ты об этом, когда хочешь взять полотенце, и вынужден идти не на пляж, а в поисках карточек. Чистые полотенца заканчивались в обед, т.е. после обеда, если тебе нужно было чистое полотенце, ты его не получишь и делай, что хочешь. Думаю, что в отеле 5* такого быть просто не должно. Так еще и каждый раз при обмене карточек на полотенца тебе навязывали и рассказывали об экскурсиях и предлагали еще потратить N-ю сумму денег.
На пляже постоянно ходят торговцы и предлагают купить сигары, кепки, солнцезащитные очки и прочие пляжные принадлежности.
Также на пляже еще есть отдельные кабинки для отдыха, называются они Cocos beach, за дополнительные деньги. Это мягкие подушки с балдахинами, которые вечером просто вытряхивались от песка использованным полотенцем, а на следующее утро вновь предлагались гостям. В оплату этой кабинки входила бутылка вина, бутылка игристого и порция морепродуктов.
Каждое утро придя на пляж мы сталкивались с черепашьими тропинками, ночью они откладывали яйца, а утром спасатели их откапывали и отправляли со специалистами в инкубатор, после двухмесячного нахождения в котором их выпускали в море (как нам рассказали). 
Развлечения: пару раз была какая-то ярмарка с местными жителями, они продавали картины, бусы, сомбреро и т.д. Каждый день проходило какое-то шумное шоу около бассейна, т.е. люди, которые заплатили за номер с видом на море, тоже не могли насладится тишиной. И вечерние шоу в фойе. На этом все.
Сервис: если ты готов еще потратить деньги в спа, купить экскурсии, ходить за деньги в рестораны, то вас и заметят. Перед поездкой отель прислал нам купон с посещением на выбор ресторана на троих, спа на одного на 2 часа или кабинка на Cocos beach. Но на этом щедрость заканчивается. Оказывается, можно воспользоваться купоном можно только после прослушивания полуторачасовой презентации на английским языке, где все это время вам будут предлагать потратить еще деньги и заманивать на всякие экскурсии и фабрики. В Club Melia, который все это проводит работает русскоязычная девушка, ее зовут Марина. Когда мы к ней обратились в первый раз она сказала, что сейчас занята, приходите завтра. Мы вернулись на следующий день в надежде использовать купон, но не так все просто оказалось.
В целом хочется сказать, что сеть отелей цепочки Melia в Канкуне утратила свой статус, роскошь и очарование. Клиенты едут в этот отель именно за этим, но к сожалению, их ждет разочарование. Отель 5* проявляется в мелочах, сервисе и отношении к клиентам. Мы с этим столкнулись в Paradisus Varadero и очень ждали и от этого отеля, но осталось больше вопросов и сожаление о потраченных 3 000$ по факту за 3*.

reviews.author: Michal R
reviews.title: One of the worst hotel I ever been
reviews.text: It is old hotel and it need renovation/revolution. Everything doesn't work, you need to wait for everything  (breakfast drinks check in). Everything is so old . It is quality for 3 star hotel . Very disappointed

reviews.author: Angel
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, but the food was horrible, i went with a group of 23 people and we all got seek the customer service is horrible too, you ask for a drink they always said, don’t have it they keep the good drink hidden from the customer they have plenty habana club rum which is garbage I think this hotel have business with the cuban government, they don’t have any food service at the pool, i went to order 10 pizza and some chicken wings for our group and they told me i can’t order that many, only one per person, this is ridiculous i point to my group in the pool and i said this not for me only this for all of us and they don’t care, the drink at the beach and at the pool horrible too, they put water on the tequila and takes a lot of time to serving they need more people in the beach and pool area, also if you looking for a good coffee “good luck” they have small station open from 7 to 10am and in the afternoon from 3 to 6pm very ridiculous if you ask for a bottle of water good luck too they have it but they will not gave to you they will gave a cop of water also no recreation at all for the kids they were bored any way it was a really bad experience we will never visiting any Melia hotels in special this one

reviews.author: João Silva
reviews.title: Far away from a 5 star hotel
reviews.text:
The number of negative points and frustrations were high.
At the check-in we founded out that they didn't have the room for 3 people that we booked. They said that they founded a better room and allowed us to stay there at no aditional cost. They allowed to stay in the hotel but couldn't go to the room until 3pm, so far so good. But when we walked in, there was only ONE BED? I paid a 5 star hotel and they expect me to lay on the flor? It took the entire day and they only they put in a new bed at 9PM. Many other problems... They tried to enter the room while someone was in the bathroom. In the swiming pools, there is no chair with protection from the sun unless you wake up REALLY early and get one. Bars at the pool opens only at 11:30AM and closes at 5PM. Market Grill has unprepared waiters and at the check out they wanted to CHARGE $200 for the extra bed. What? It is not my fault that they didn't have the room for 3 people that I booked.
They demanded the same credit card that we did the purchase and that was a problem, so we had to spend most of our money and expect they to reimburse the credit card, which took more than a week, even with many e-mails and phone calls.
It is funny that a 5 star hotel was my worst and most stressful experience regarding hotels ever. So many disorganization and rules that aren't explained at front. Don't recommend to anyone wanting to have a relaxing experience.

reviews.author: Nomad23983196623
reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: The worst experience in cancun air conditioner does not work bad customer service rude people not attentive at all we were so excited to go because we thought it was going to be a good experience but no it has been a very bad experience

reviews.author: King
reviews.title: Отдых или целый месяц переживаний
reviews.text:
Друзья прежде чем спланировать отдых с семьей да ещё и с двухлетним ребёнком на Канкуне в отеле Paradisus Cancún прочитайте мой отзыв ! 
Ни в коем случае не попадайте в этот отель если даже его предложат за бесплатно ! Полная антисанитария !!! Рестораны старые ,грязные, столы затертые десятилетиями, на столах скатертей нет они все жирные, приборы официанты бросают прямо на голый стол. Брали All inclusive , ну просто одни харчи, есть практически нечего, коктейли тоже дешевая бурда. Пляжи песок грязный беседки тоже не обновляли лет 15. Единственный плюс это номера на 4+
Я сброшу одну фоточку как там делают омлетики, повар во всем грязном затертом сарафане готовит омлет а вокруг её все в ужасной антисанитарии, плита на которой жарят чёрная, некоторые повора без перчаток хватают сыр и кидают в твой будущий омлет, и сразу аппетит куда-то пропадает..
Очень переживал за своего ребёнка который постоянно трогал своими ручками эти грязные столы и стулья а потом брал хлеб или фрукты в руки и тащил всё в рот, но на момент отдыха всё обошлось.  
Были в этом отеле 15лет и 10лет назад., было все супер , отель назывался Meliá Cancún 
Сейчас приехали, у всех кишечные расстройства лечимся .

reviews.author: Traveler435327
reviews.title: Not sure what happened
reviews.text: First, the hotel and food/buffet were great. Now for why I came to right this review. My wife and I flew down to Cancun with another couple for an extended weekend.  My friend and I had spent the afternoon drinking at the pool bar and we have this specific tequila we always drink when we’re together, it’s a high end tequila.  We asked the bar tenders if they had a couple shots for us, and they came back 20+ minutes later.  The tequila they poured us was from the true bottle but it was a dark brown.. the tequila from that same bottle should be white.  We instantly knew we were being jerked around because this tequila they were charging us $20 per shot, but when we called them out on the color.. they offered it to us for free.  Red flags all over that.  Unfortunately for us, we still took the shots and it was the last thing we remembered.  I’m NOT accusing anyone of anything, but I’ve been blacked out drunk before and this wasn’t blacked out drunk, nor had either of us consumed enough alcohol to be like this.  From that shot on, neither of us remember a thing over the course of the next 10 hours.  This 10 hours wasn’t sleep time either.. we were awake and our partners were trying to keep us under control.  Take it for what you will.

reviews.author: Natalia27
reviews.title: Stay ANYWHERE but here!
reviews.text:
I have stayed at several different hotels in Cancun but this was by far the worst experience I have ever had. The food was barely edible and the service was very poor. The first day we got there we ate at the poolside snack bar which serves hot dogs, hamburgers, nachos, and pizza. All were very bland, chips were very stale, and my nachos had strands of hair in it. For dinner we went to the street taco restaurant (Blue Agave). Tacos were not good at all with several chunks of fat still on them. We asked for sour cream and the waiter brought us a plate of warm milk. We left there and decided to go to the the buffet since we were still very hungry. Everything looked like it had been sitting out for a very long time and multiple items looked like they were the leftovers from the lunch buffet. We left there (still hungry) and ordered room service (pizza, spaghetti, and fries). All very bland, tasted old, and the spaghetti was basically noodles with barely any meat sauce on top. 

The next day we learned from one of the pool entertainers that since there was an upcoming election in Cancun they would not be able to serve any alcohol in the bars for the next 2 days. They would only be able to serve at the restaurants while you were eating. That was the deal breaker for me, especially since the food was not edible I needed to at least enjoy the alcohol I had paid for in my all inclusive package. I went to the lobby and asked to speak to the manager and out came Margarita, the WORST person anyone could have hired to work in management. She did not care about the situation at all, did not care that her guests were unhappy. She pretty much laughed in my face and made me cry. I travel ALOT and have never been treated this way at any resort I have stayed at. The second our conversation was done I went up to my room and booked a new resort for the last 2 nights of my trip and got the heck out of that hotel as fast as I possibly could. 
I would like to add that while checking out I heard the family next to me speaking to management very loudly and they looked visibly upset as well (I wish I could understand what they were saying, but they were not speaking English). I have a feeling this kind of thing happens often and I am not shocked at all.

reviews.author: Meg
reviews.title: Stay here if you don’t plan on not eating the whole time.
reviews.text:
The good reviews left for this resort absolutely baffle me. The initial experience when checking in and getting the room were positive. The room is clean the beds were as expected, building 5 where the lobby is and most restaurants is beautiful. The pool is ok. The service isn’t the best by any means, many times they made me feel like I was inconveniencing them with my presence. The food... was not good. At all. Barely edible. I’m being 100% serious, I am not picky by any means I cannot tell you the last time I dined somewhere and didn’t enjoy the food. But here I was completely at a loss for words I just wanted to look around at people and see their expressions and wondered if they felt the same as me because I couldn’t believe how disgusting it was. On the second day me and my friends were approached by someone from the entertainment staff (if you can even call them that) with warning that they would stop serving alcohol at the pool and bars at midnight for 2 days. My understanding from management was that it was for a local election that was taking place and they could only serve alcohol at some of the restaurants and the bars would be closed. I was completely outraged, I only drink on vacation, I paid for an all inclusive vacation and that’s not what I was getting. And the cherry on top was the way we were treated by the guest services manager with the name that is the same as a drink. She was so awful to us that my friend started crying.

We weren’t expecting a whole lot. We understand it’s a law it’s out of your hands (but really why would a local election affect tourist areas???) but a bit of courtesy, kindness and RESPECT was all we wanted. And at this resort it was too hard for them to give that. Maybe if you paid more for the royal service you would get treated better having the pink bracelet. After being treated like garbage me and my girls went back to the room and booked a different resort for the remainder of our vacation. We couldn’t stay there any longer. Yes, we paid more just to get the hell out. Thats how the manager made us feel. And guess what? The resort we stayed at reminded me what it’s supposed to feel like! Being treated like literal family! When you get in the pool at an all inclusive resort you feel like you are in paradise, which is not the case for Paradisus. I will never stay at another Melia hotel again and will do everything in my power to make sure no one I know stays at this resort.

reviews.author: Nancy A
reviews.title: NUNCA REGRESO!!!
reviews.text: Pésimo todo!!! Check in lento no, lentisimo. Buffet espantoso!!! Me cobraron de más (letras chiquitas). Vine de congreso, y en donde hice mi reservación decía niño incluidos y borraron el acceso a la página.  Todo mundo le echa la culpa a otro. Obvio no me van a regresar los 10000 pesos que me hicieron pagar por noche, pero esperaba un servicio de primerísima que, para lo que me están ofreciendo, no vale ni la cuarta parte...

reviews.author: Road24671596682
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: I visit Cancun at least twice a year, and I read the reviews and try to apply them to me. This hotel is not worth but 1 star. Hotel rooms need updating, such as lighting flickering the whole time, TV picture not clear on all channels, bathroom fixture and shower were falling apart, bathtub was literally sinking in the middle and Wifi was very very bad and connectivity was horrible on ALL DEVICES, had to log in every 2-3 min. NEVER AGAIN

reviews.author: Emily Braga
reviews.title: PLEASE DO NOT STAY
reviews.text:
I was hesitant to book this resort because some of the reviews were not good, but I thought with a 4 star average rating, it must not be that bad. I was wrong. From check in, we needed to put a deposit down on our credit card of the full amount we were being charged for our stay after we already paid. This is crazy. Luckily we had a credit card with $3,000 available on it but I’ll tell you that most people don’t know about this. What would they do if we didn’t have a credit card on us? I digress. 
We get on the elevator to go to our rooms and our smacked with a stench that is so gross I don’t even know how to describe it. Smelled like a child peed in it three weeks ago and they never cleaned it. I brushed it off as maybe it was just that particular elevator but it ended up being all of them. 
The food here is below subpar. I could eat chips & guac for breakfast lunch and dinner. I’m not picky. Everything tasted frozen or stale. Simply gross to be blunt. We tried multiple restaurants and the only one worth going to was market grill. this is because they give you fresh cooked meats so you know it hasn’t been sitting out for hours. If you order room service, be aware they charge you $5 for every time you order it. You have to call the front desk to restock the mini fridge. My mother started complaining about stomach pains 2 days into our stay and started puking. She was completely out for the count for an entire day of our vacation. Some will chalk this up to drinking, how ever that was not the case.
The pool is beautiful. Problem is they don’t start giving out drinks before 10AM. If you’re an early bird and get out to the pool at 8, you will have to wait 2 hours before being able to get a water or any other beverage poolside. 
The rooms. Our AC was leaking the entire time. Although it had been running all day, it was still not as cold as my Mother’s room. The double beds are very small. My brother & I were sharing a double bed. we both weigh about 120 lbs & it was uncomfortably tight. By the second night of being there I noticed a couple of bugs in the bathroom. I shook that off as no big deal. As night four came around there were even MORE bugs. It was seriously grossing me out because they were beetle like creatures. I’ll move on. The last night of our stay they set up vendors in the hotel hallways selling bracelets and all sorts of souvineers. This was fantastic idea until they harassed us every time we walked by which felt awkward and cheap.

reviews.author: MrFlatwhite
reviews.title: Not the right hotel for a relaxing stay with kids
reviews.text:
We selected the family concierge package for our trip and was our first and last experience at a Melia - Paradisus hotel. The family concierge lounge is really nice with a good set of amenities. The welcoming  team was very pleasant and helpful. We had very high expectations since the hotel markets as a good place to be with your family. 

We visited with my 18 month old and some family friends with kids. Our experience turned sour the first night (Tuesday) when we realized they had 2 different events at the hotel and we could not go to bed because the music was so loud (8-9pm). I do not recommend this hotel to families with children that are looking for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Family trippers
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: What I bought and paid for was not what I was given when wr arrived and no remedy was offered to fix the issues. Additionally horrible smell of sewage being fanned our from under center bar and restaurant, smell of sewage was terrible next to children’s pool

reviews.author: cipitin
reviews.title: Dishonest Business
reviews.text: We booked and fully payed for this hotel before our vacation, but upon checking out they claimed that our payment didn't go through so they held my family hostage until we resubmitted the payment, and sure enough, we ended up paying double. Now we are dealing with the credit card company to refund our double payment. Obviously we'll never go back and discourage all of our friends from visiting this dishonest resort.

reviews.author: Jeffrey S
reviews.title: Be ready to fight
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is a very different experience from our previous experience at Paradisus Punta Cana. The location is beautiful, there are a lot of activities and the pool and bar are great. Ask for DD st the pool. He’s amazing! To me, the above are expectations of any warm-weather trip. 

Once you get over the beauty, the everyday operations will leave you wishing you had chosen a different place to visit. Here are our notes through the first three days of our stay:

- Wrong Room-We booked king bed and got two full sized beds- We only picked Paradisus Cancun because of previous very positive experience at Paradisus Punta Cana and that a king bed was available for our family. The hotel was unable to make a change in the accommodations that we booked online through bookit.com. 
- Dinner Reservation- the dinner reservation we made through the Meliá App and confirmed with an employee on the phone was given away to people who had the “Family Concierge” package at Mole Restaurant. We then had to call in a manager to resolve the issue.
- Air Conditioner Leaking- The AC was leaking... and then fixed... and then needed to be fixed again the next day due to continued leaking into the room.
- Flood in room- woke up from a nap and found 2-inches of water in our room. This required our room to be moved to another room mid-stay with wet luggage.

This has not been the vacation we had hoped for. The Melia name is ruined for us.

If you travel here, expect an app that is not dependable for dinner reservations and be ready to fight for anything you expected through your booking or your experience.

reviews.author: bruno
reviews.title: Triste experiencia
reviews.text:
Este hotel tienen que ser remodelado y tener un staf que sean más educados .
No hay nada por los niños en este hotel a parte de un kids club .
Las nuevas habitaciones son muy básicas
Las Hab vista al mar hacen un ruido terrible con el viento

reviews.author: Jose Luis C
reviews.title: Fue la peor experiencia en el caribe que tuve... servicios no incluidos en un all inclusive...
reviews.text:
Peor experiencia... venden la sombra... los mismo empleado reservan las ubicaciones en la pileta a cambio de propina... 
no nos efectuaban cambios de moneda (usd / peso mex) porque no tienen donde... nadie sabe... todos contestaban señalando a cualquier lado... 
en la recepcion nos dijeron la mitad de las cosas... habia restaurantes de pago a pensar que era un all inclusive... no tiene snack 24hs... asi que solamente en ciertos horarios quedaba el room service... no cobraban la comida pero si el "servicio"... 
poca variedad de alimentos... los restaurantes son muy especificos en sus comidas... practicamente terminas comiendo lo que ellos deciden que comas... no hay variedad... 
el bar cerraba a la medianoche... pedimos un cafe a las 11pm y nos contestaron que no se podia porque la maquina ya habia sido limpiada... ante la insistencia la prendieron de mala gana y una hora antes del cierre... 11.30 habia el 50% de bebidas... a la medianoche huian de la atencion...
Tienen una heladeria/cafeteria... que por la tarde abrian de 3-5pm... o sea... no se toman helados/cafes ni a las 6 ni a las 7pm... irrisorio... y si vas fuera de hora... el dispenser del self-service de cafe no lo reponen...
La habitacion barata (lagoon) tenia bidet pero cortina de baño de tela (año 2019) pero la habitacion cara (vista al mar) tenia mampara de baño pero no tenia bidet... vista al mar reemplaza bidet (?)
Los accesorios de baño muy escasos... no daban cepillos de dientes ni pasta dental ni peine... por suerte llevamos...
Debe haber un monton de cosas mas que no recuerdo en este momento... pero en conclusion... el hotel """Paradisius""" Cancun de la cadena Melia... es CARO y DESASTROZO...
Quedan avisados... vayan bajo su responsabilidad...

reviews.author: Mun D
reviews.title: Flop Experience
reviews.text:
Good: clean, aesthetic common area, ambience, decent rooms, staff works hard, that’s about it. 

Bad: slowest checkin, even gave wrong keys (mixed up room with friend’s), not enough activities even in busy spring time, services are not coordinated, room amenities were not routinely replenished, most of the pool area is 5.5ft deep and not kid friendly, average food in buffet, have to ask for better liquor else they serve cheap one mostly. 

Worst: beach towels run out all through out the day, not enough chairs at all- mostly to push renting cabanas, room amenities, water and minibar was not replenished most days as advertised and needed to call service to address almost everyday, coffee and gelato  stations do not open promptly as advertised, reservations for restaurants is hard to make and food is lackluster. 

Visited with a group of five families. Will never return or recommend this place. Worst all inclusive experience out of four all inclusive vacations in past five years. The place was hardly even busy through spring break. I wonder why the rating is high for this place. Maybe only Royal Service is focus for them. Besides aesthetics, everything else is pretty flop.

reviews.author: Paco M
reviews.title: Decepciónate y vergonzoso
reviews.text:
Se que esto no lo leerán a quien me gustaría que llegara mi queja. 
Después de 15 horas de viaje desde Barcelona y a las 8 de la tarde llegamos por fin al hotel. Grupo de 9 personas con 4 niños. Vamos hacia recepción en ella 3 personas y nadie esperando. La señorita amablemente solicita una tarjeta como garantía. Entregó tarjeta y el bono con tres habitaciones familiares pagadas hace más de 3 meses directamente en Meliá, vía telefónica. Ante mi incredulidad me dice que no acepta mi tarjeta al no ser la que en su momento pague mi estancia..... cuando realice el pago, desde la central de Meliá, no podían cargar los más de 6.000€ que costaba mi estancia, lo cual tuve que dar otra tarjeta que no utilizo casi nunca. La doy las explicaciones pero no entra en razón. Lo más surrealista que jamas me ha ocurrido. Los niños cansados del viaje y yo cabreado como una mona. Suerte que encontré una de las tarjetas con las cuales pague la estancia. Pero no acaba aquí, utilizan mi tarjeta para ver si tenía saldo!!!!!!! Pero quien demonios se creen que son!!!la estancia acreditada por el bono estaba pagada hacía meses. INDIGNANTE. Más de 1 hora para que nos dieran las habitaciones 
Llegamos a una habitación ridículamente pequeña. Baño austero y también pequeño. Pero no solo eso, tres habitaciones “familiares “ con solo dos camas. Después de tres meses de la reserva otra hora más para que pongan un misero plegatin como tercera cama en habitación “ familiar”. Los niños de 13 años pagaron la estancia como adultos y dormían en un camastro penoso. 
Soy, perdón, era miembro del Meliá rewards. Por mi trabajo viajo por España 3 semanas al mes. Siempre escogía hoteles Meliá en las ciudades que había. Eso ya paso a la historia. Quédense con los puntos y su dorada tarjeta. Y para finalizar, durante la estancia cenábamos cuando la señorita de las reservas de mesa en los distintos restaurantes del complejo quería. 
Nunca había sitio, y cuando conseguíamos mesa, 4 de las veces fueron cambiadas a la hora que ella quería. Siempre después de las 9 de la noche.
Bien aleccionados todos los trabajadores del hotel en servir a los americanos por sus suculentas propinas..... españoles, atención mínima y con desgana. Y hay más, pero no vale la pena. Lo que si vale la pena es no volver nunca más a ningún hotel de esta horrorosa cadena. 
Se que soy una pulga y mi opinión no llegará a ningún sitio, pero señores de Meliá, háganselo mirar, soy insignificante para ustedes pero las vacaciones de mis hijos no tiene precio y ustedes consiguieron que no fueran lo especiales que queríamos
Seguro que no les importa en absoluto, pero han perdido un cliente

reviews.author: Maria S
reviews.title: Pésimo hotel
reviews.text:
Estoy en este momento en este hotel, llegue hace 3 días y ya quiero irme.
Nada en este hotel funciona, si queres almorzar solo podrás comer una lechuga y sino mira las fotos en donde está todo absolutamente vacío q las 13 hs.
Si queres toallon para la pileta o Playa tendrás que dar  con algún huésped que sea muy bueno y desee compartirte de su toallon porque nunca tienen alguno disponible.
Si te dicen que ahora tienen una app para reservar el lugar para ir a cenar, no les creas o te pasará como a mi que con un bebé llegamos a cenar y nos dijeron que la aplicación no andaba asique mejor vayan a un lugar sin reserva.
Si quieren tomar un café, mejor olvídalo ese servicio nunca está disponible.
Si quiere usar la pileta recuerda que a las tres de la tarde te pedirán q te fueras porque tienen q armar el show de la noche.
Ah y olvídate de buscar a algún responsable nadie del hotel da la cara. Todos son empleados y nadie puede hacer e cargo de nada.

Un consejo nunca vengas a este hotel si queres un buen servicio.

reviews.author: Mile High Traveler
reviews.title: Better Options in Cancun
reviews.text:
I have stayed at other Melia properties and the one in Plays is still in my opinion the best one we have stayed at in all our trips (18) to Mexico.  However this property fails in almost every way.

Rooms:  The rooms are much smaller then they seem in the pictures.  I mentioned this to the GM and he told "The hotel is a pyramid and they get smaller on the way up".  Doesn't make any sense to me, but OK.

Room Service:  I do not like waiting until 5:00PM to 6:00PM to have my room cleaned.  I mentioned this to the GM as well and his answer was "We are very busy property".  To me being busy is not excuse for poor service.  Also, they were very bad at stocking the mini bar.  Even knocked on my door two nights at 11:00PM to do so.  So unless you call down and ask for them to come clean your room it could be dinner time before they get to it.

Food:  Was just Ok.  Good selection but typical resort food.  Their other property I felt the food was outstanding.

Beach/Pools:  Beach is nice, service on the beach is good, however you have to get down there earlier to claim your spot.  People were laying towels out at 6:45 in the morning to claim their spots and not coming back until lunch time.  If you didn't claim a spot earlier they run out of chairs very quickly.  Pool is the same.  Also, not a lot of organized beach activities like other resorts have.

Other issues:  They burn an incense through out the hotel the is very strong and over baring and besides myself I heard numerous people complaining about it.

reviews.author: Jet17239223278
reviews.title: Ruined my travel
reviews.text:
Terrible concierge service
A rude employee
Screwed up my memories about Cancun
Giving me uncomfortable situations
Noise at disaster level from AC
The damp bed
I lost my voice for this hotel
As same with my comments for Check In

reviews.author: Lily S
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: Extremely disappointed! Starting off while checking in the front desk person named “ Juan “ was trying to give me a lot of trouble trying to charge me a lot of hidden fees that were not there when I paid in the moment because it was not something I wanted at the moment. After a concierge named Martha tried to sit us down with to give us the lay out. She talked us into going to a timeshare tour we agreed but after finding out the next day that it’s over a 90 minutes long and it was our last day and my husband birthday. We decided to not do the timeshare to enjoy our last day/birthday in Cancun. Concierge Martha confronted us and we told her that we didn’t want to do the timeshare and she completely disrespected myself and my husband on his birthday. I was completely in shock that the Concierge Martha was pressuring me and my husband and disrespecting us at the same time because we decided to not do it. Which was completely disrespectful that me and my husband did not deserve to get disrespected by anybody there to the fact that we were not asking to stay or rent a hotel room for free we paid over 1k for our hotel room. If you’re thinking about staying at Paradisus Cancun with an infant or toddler think about it twice and please use the pictures as reference. My child’s life was in danger while trying to sleep in a broken crib. The crib was extremely disgusting and nasty and dangerous. Crib was stained with bite marks, broken, unscrewed.  I’ve contacted the front desk person named “ Juan “ who checked me in to try to resolve this issue and it was not handled at all. Most of the people who work at Paradisus Cancun have really bad attitude they try to make it seem like they are better than you and you’re asking for food or drinks for free when you’ve paid for the service and everything else. Extremely disappointed!

reviews.author: Domingo C
reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: This is a complete scam. They charge you at check in with 150 USD per person for a package for premium spirits of course if you want, but you are already pating for a 4 star hotel. The issue is that most premium spirits are already available and those that are not they never have them. Never pay for this package. A second package, for the modest charge of 300 USD per room/day you can stay in tower 5, a complete cementary, bore to death.

reviews.author: Fernando
reviews.title: Disappointing.. definitely it's not the paradise....
reviews.text:
My Daughter was doing a fifteenth birthday, so my family decided to find an amazing resort in Cancun to host for somedays. We found good options in Cancun, and choose the worst, the Paradise Cancun.

It has been paid around a one hundred days before my check-in. So, since the payment, i'v receiving informations from the Hotel in my e-mail, like my reservation,  login to use the app hotel, always information saying  that everything about my reserve was ok.

But, for my surprise, when I arrived there, they asked the original credit card (that used a hundred day ago), and that moment I haven't. I was with other credit card. 

So, I tried to explain , the payment was ok, but they almost put me out. So, I paid again (twice) the reserve. Well, that time I understood that hotel just  think  about money.

I has been hosted in several hotels in the world, I never had such problem. I read again and again my  reservation and there is nothing saying about to bring the original credit card, NOTHING. If anyone want I can send it to prove (number 1804101125).

After this inconvenient, I realized others bad things about this Hotel. For example, the juice is not natural.. and very very bad. 

Coke is worse than Coke Machine... very bad also.

The food is very similar for all day... and the room is to simple for the price...

I'm writing this comment to help you, because there are other good options with better service and  price.

ah.. And about the first payment ???

I yet not received the refund... I hope not be necessary involve the authorizes to get it.

Att,
Fernando.

reviews.author: Rockgirlca1
reviews.title: How do you run out of towels at a beach resort ?
reviews.text:
Gorgeous day in Cancun we have sun however been  waiting for over 1 hour ... it’s pretty bad when you come to a beach and they cannot accommodate their guests with the basics ie beach towels ! 

BRING YOUR OWN TOWEL (BYOT)

reviews.author: Imrankhan M
reviews.title: Rude front desk staff - horrible service
reviews.text: The electricity in our room was not working, after repeated complains and having to bath in darkness and feed our little baby in darkness - we were left to wait in the lobby with a hungry baby for an hour. The front desk staff Samuel and manager Luis were rude and told us it was ok, we just had to wait. This level of service is unacceptable in a motel, let alone a 350 $/nt hotel claiming to be five star luxury. Absolutely disgraceful and blood boiling - this hotel needs to be ashamed of themselves for starving a baby.

reviews.author: Jessica L
reviews.title: No es lo que esperaba.
reviews.text:
No suelo escribir reseñas sobre mis viajes pero en este caso creo que es necesario hacerlo. 
El hotel se ve bonito por fuera, por dentro no lo es tanto, ya está algo descuidado. 
No vi indicios de que sea un hotel de varios diamantes o estrellas, ya que tú tienes que despacharte sol@ al llegar y al salir lo mismo, es decir, nadie te recibe como normalmente en otros hoteles con alguna bebida o toallita, el check in es un caos porque en la recepción solo hay 2 recepcionistas para todo el hotel! Y tienes que esperar más de 30 min en la fila para que te atiendan y que al final no esté lista tu habitación y tienes que regresar y volver a formarte. 
Se nota mucha desorganización, la persona que nos atendió y no nos explico o ayudo en nada, se notaba su inexperiencia. 
Los restaurantes siempre están llenos y es complicado encontrar disponibles para reservar.
La habitación no es nada fuera de lo normal y nos toco habitación no remodelada, lo cual no indica nada de eso en su página. Las fotos no corresponden a las habitaciones que dan y son muy ruidosas por la noche por los shows que hacen. 
La salida otro caos, hay que salir con mucho tiempo si quieres llegar a tiempo a tu transportación, otros 30 min para que te atiendan y como siempre esta lleno el hotel con grupos nos explico la Srita que nos atendió, nunca hay late check outs y las maletas las tienes que bajar tu sol@ porque los bellboys ni se aparecen. 
Yo recomiendo definitivamente otros hoteles donde el precio es similar y el servicio es mejor, u hoteles más baratos con este tipo de servicio.

reviews.author: William O
reviews.title: This one is a pass....
reviews.text:
Pros: nice beach, and pools. Cons: dated property, bad service, cheap food, hidden fees, bad policies, etc....
Since we all work hard for our money, better pass on this one as there are better options!

reviews.author: Guillaume D
reviews.title: Une catastrophe
reviews.text:
Déjà il faut préciser que je suis client Melia Platinum depuis près de 10ans.

Normalement, j’ai accueil VIP et des Upgrade.

Mais là, en arrivant à l’accueil VIP, ils n’avaient pas ma réservation.
Accueil anonyme et pas digne d’un 5 étoiles et encore moins d’un membre Platinum.

Longue attente....
Après 45 mins, on arrive à la chambre mais finalement le numéro indiqué sur la carte était pas le bon. Retour à l’accueil.
Une heure plus tard, on ouvre la porte de la chambre pour découvrir une chambre anonyme, mais le pire surtout avec une terrasse donnant en vis-a-vis direct sur les building. Merci bien, pas de vue mer ni rien lagune.
A ces tarifs et pour le membre Melia Platinum, c’est scandaleux.

De manière général, nourriture correcte mais service moyen.
Malheureusement sur la plage, on a eu le droit a du service que le premier jour, les jours suivants, rien.

Pour les lits baleinée disposés autour de la piscine ou sur la plage, c’est 150 USD, quelle arnaque !

Mais le pire du pire du séjour, on nous a volé notre argent dans la chambre !!!!!
Voleurs !!!!

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: This place is a dump.  Don't be fooled by the reviews here
reviews.text: This is the 2nd year I was forced to attend a conference at this hotel by my employer.  The food is absolutely HORRIBLE.  The resort while having the appearance of being clean is filled with mold.  The resort burns incense continuously to mask the horrible smells of mold and rot.  The resorts is very dated and dark. And if you stay in the main town, they play blaring music well into the night.  I would NEVER bring my family here and hope I never have to stay here again.  If you like nice, airy, CLEAN resorts with good food there are so many other choices in Cancun.  Heed my warning

reviews.author: Bah
reviews.title: Great Disappointment
reviews.text:
My husband had food poisoning after eating sashimi at the hotel, our last day at the hotel was simply wasted because of that. When we reached the customer service they acted as nothing had to do with them and Margarida the manager was very rude. I contacted Melia corp which only provided another cliche response saying again that they had nothing to do with his intoxication. 
Funny thing is that on the next night, after we complained, the Japanese restaurant was closed. Now I wonder why? Obviously they will never assume the possibility of having contaminated fish on their restaurant, but if I were you would think twice before giving your money to this group. The hotel and accommodations are not impressive, lots of noise in the rooms, they put terrible incenses all over and some areas need renovation.

reviews.author: Alicia C
reviews.title: TOTAL DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text:
I don’t even know where to start with this review, I usually do not write many reviews but I will this time because I don’t want customers to be fooled and be sold something that’s not worth what they are paying for. 

For starters this is supposed to be a five stars hotel, apart from the waiters good customer service I don’t know where else this fits in the category. 

Starting with the check in, the receptionist named Yuli was the slowest receptionist I have ever encountered! It took about an hour to get us checked in, and at the time of our check in (3pm) 3 of our 4 rooms were not ready. We also had to come back to get our keys and where inside the room by 4pm. 

When I booked this hotel it caught my attention because of the “many different restaurants this hotel has” but don’t be fooled, we were not able to eat in any of these restaurants because they were always “full.” We even tried booking two nights in advance and still had no luck. Some of their restaurants were closed, and I saw that their restaurants do not hold the capacity for the amount of guests they have in this hotel. We had to eat at the buffet Naos every night and the food wasn’t even good, not many varieties either. I would give it 2/5. 

Unlucky for us the weekend I spent here rained everyday none stop, on the last day my room and my friends room were flooded due to the rain, I called reception and they told me I wasn’t the only one, that every other room in the side of the hotel we were in were having the same problem, but if they know this why don’t they fix this? 

Also a lot of the common areas had water on the floor and water dripping from their roofs. The rooms are old and not very clean. They charge you $5 if you want room service and alcohol bottles are not included in your room. 

The receptionists were not very helpful at all. For any inconvenience I had to call a couple times before they helped me do anything. 

Overall for the price of this hotel I do not recommend this hotel. DONT BE FOOLED!!! I have been to other resorts in Cancun and this is such a disappointment.

reviews.author: Rigotto
reviews.title: Need some SERIOUS renovation!
reviews.text:
Looks like this was a great hotel in the past.  It is falling in pieces. Everywhere you walk inside the hotel, there are white towels covering the floor due to infiltration. 
The rooms maybe are clean but you cannot guarantee as everything is a shipwreck, old and not working. 
The food is poorly prepared. 

The attention is the teams is good although at reception it looks like they treat you badly to create a disappointment and then you finally see some good service from the others. 

I guess there might be several other places in Cancun to stay that would provide a better experience. 

Have to admit again that the crew at hotel restaurants and bar are well trained and carefully. It is just the place that needs some SERIOUS renovation.

reviews.author: Africa forever
reviews.title: good stay, bad restaurants service
reviews.text:
The hotel is clean and not very crowded, you can hangout at the lobby and there are multiple lounges and places where you can chill.
Unfortunately, very bad service from all the girls at the restaurants reception.
Here is a story that happened multiple times:
I have a reservation at 20:00. So i come with the family at 19h30, the restaurant is empty, about 30%-50% max.
The girl looks at us and says you have to wait until 20:00 so ill let you in.
I totally get the part where you have to be on time, but sorry, if your restaurant is empty, you don’t leave your clients waiting in the rain for no purpose...the girl looks at us and says no ! You have to wait until 20:00 lol...

There is also a big lack of animation, if you are unlucky to get rainy days, well you are gonna be bored.

The hotel deserves a 3 stars, ill give 1 though just to show how much the bad service at the restaurants affected the whole experience.

reviews.author: Antonio V
reviews.title: Would not stay at the Paradisus/Melia resorts again
reviews.text:
We arrived on Sunday, January 20th 2019 to check into our oceanfront king bedroom only for the front desk to tell me that they don't have an oceanfront kind bedroom available until the following day. So we were inconvenienced to start our 4-day vacation by telling me they would have us in the two bedroom (cramped because of two beds in one room) the first night. 

They told us that we would need to change rooms by 12 pm the next day. That means we are not on our time but theirs, wake up early and pack and we could not go on our excursion the following day because I did not want to leave our valuables with the bell boys (has our passports, jewelry, and DSLR Canon 70D Camera). That evening my Fiance and I were washing up and getting ready for bed. The bathroom sink did not drain so it filled and filled until it overflowed. I took pictures to document.
The next day we waited in the room until they came to pick up our luggage at 12 pm. We held onto our valuables until 3pm the next day until they could check us into the next room. This made us miss most of the day outside and the great weather (the weather was stormy and pretty awful the rest of the trip). 

Went to Paradisus Punta Cana in 2018 and it was so amazing so we thought it would be great going to the Paradisus Cancun. I am deeply unimpressed with the customer service we received.I thought we would continue going to Melia owned resorts but I will start looking elsewhere now.

reviews.author: TrailBlazer745860
reviews.title: Extravio de dinheiro, mesmo utilizando cofres
reviews.text: Recomendo nunca deixar qualquer valor nos cofres disponibilizados pelo hotel. Dólores foram retirados do nosso cofre e o hotel não assumiu a responsabilidade. Ainda que tenhamos a certeza de que fechamos o cofre ao sair do quarto e ao retornarmos percebemos a falta de valores, a resposta do hotel foi totalmente subjetiva e evasiva, apenas alegando que o cofre permaneceu por muito tempo aberto, sem indicar quando e por quem foi aberto.

reviews.author: Cara
reviews.title: Customer Service from Management is Lacking
reviews.text:
We choose this time and location due to the desire to travel with friends who are owners.  Our reservation was for a King room on the ocean side.  When we checked in there weren't any king rooms available.  After seeing a few options we opted to keep our room and have the beds put together.  The first two nights were wonderful.  On the 3rd day a group of 600 conference attendees arrived.  During lunch the entire group came into the buffet at the same time and took over the restaurant.  They removed plates from tables that were occupied in order to be able to be seated.  Granted this wasn't their problem as the hotel and the conference planner should have had the fore-site to accommodate the attendees while avoiding interruption for the hotel guests.  The conference attendees were rude and pushed hotel guests out of the way in order to get their food first.  we decided to let this go and move on.  However that evening, the Red Lounge which stays open until 2:00 AM stepped it up a notch to entertain the attendees.  As mentioned before we had no issues the first two nights despite being in building 3 which is where the clubs are located.  The first night that the attendees were present the DJ turned it up and the attendees were so disruptive that we complained.  The manager on duty, Alejandro chose to do nothing despite the fact that the concierge admitted that they were trying to get the music turned down and the security guard said it was out of control.  Alejandro was rude and dismissive to us as we are females  The following morning we were moved to an "owner" building and given bracelets which allowed us to go to the adults only portion of the resort.  The front desk admitted the situation was handled poorly.  This would have been great but our travel companions/owners did not have the same privileges so we did not partake in the benefits (with the exception of being moved to a more quiet building.  
Thinking that all the inconvenience was behind us we went about our way meeting other guests/owners and enjoying the resort.  One challenge is tipping all the wait staff and we were running out of pesos.  I had previously gone to the concierge and converted dollars to pesos.  Knowing that the staff appreciate american dollars I went to concierge and attempted to break $20.00 bills into smaller amounts to tip the staff.  I was informed that I needed to check with the bellhop or bar staff.  the bellhop didn't have enough so I asked  front desk to again convert dollars to pesos.  I was informed by Guadalupe that  i would need to go downstairs in order to do so.  Mind you we had already done it at the desk as had our friends.  In my frustration I returned to Bana where we were eating dinner and the manager noticing my frustration immediately was able to get me smaller american dollars.  The next day I went to the front desk and brought the situation to their attention.  The day manager was out ill so they said they would take it up with her the next day and let me know what the plan was.  Today (Friday) we went to the front desk and after several go rounds with Margarita were informed that because we signed off for an upgrade on the noise level that nothing more would be done.  We were also informed that they were having trouble with the front desk staff and that the general manager was addressing it.  Neither the manager nor the general manager contacted us nor have they made any efforts to address the situation.  I was a previous owner at ME Cabo and can tell you that I would not recommend the resort to anyone until the management and front desk staff get their stuff in order and figure out that customer service means putting the customer first.  
Before any nay sayers respond, this is my 7th stay at a Melia resort, I paid full price, and have confirmed with the owners we are traveling with as well as the ones we have met that this is not appropriate.

reviews.author: Helen
reviews.title: The Horible Experience!!!!!
reviews.text:
We travel to Cancun and Riviera Maya over 25 years.
We had been at most Secrets resorts, Dreams,Riu Palaces,live Aqua, 
This time we went to TRS CORAL Costa mujeres, IT WAS AMAZING!!!!
We decided before to fly home to stay in Cancun for 2 nights and shop.
We choose Paradisus Cancun. WHAT A BIG MISTAKE!!!!!!!
LET ME SAY IT AGAIN WHAT A BIG MISTAKE!!!!!
The smell in the hotel is Horible, it is like in old 2 star hotel in Vegas.
 The rooms are outdated,and the food I can not even know how to describe, it looks like they throwing food on some trays to feed dogs.
All the meat burned, cold,HORIBLE!!!
FOR COLD CUTS THEY HAVE PINK MORTADELA HA HA.
They have 9 restaurants 6 were closed, the rest at 7pm not available.
The only place we could find is at Thai Restaurant. I can not tell you the experience because I can't use bad words, we just left.
All floors are dirty,the carpets in Elivetors are dirty!!!
 The check in counter all broken the carpet has soooo many dirty spots!
I would like to ask all the people who writing good reviews WERE DID YOU TRAVEL BEFORE? WHAT KIND OF FOOD DO YOU EAT AT HOME? IS THE SMELL DID NOT BOTHER YOU?
AND FOR THE REST OF THE PEOPLE PLEEEEASE SPARE YOUR SELF A BIG DESPONDENT AND DO NOT GO TO THIS HOTEL.

reviews.author: Vivababe
reviews.title: Stolen shoes from luggage stored after check out
reviews.text:
