We stayed here in November and needless to say we ended up arriving home missing 1 pair of my husband brand new sport shoes...we did not check bags and after our check out this is what went down:we had our shuttle scheduled at 3.15pm and we went to the bell desk at 2.45pm and we were kinda told to take the shuttle loaded at the entrance not knowing why they are pushing us to leave...but clearly the shoes dis-appeared at this time the bellman should have just asked us if we can give him these shoes...we would have just gifted him these...anyway I hope the resort gets to the bottom of this issue asap
Otherwise the entertainment non existing so I have to share that days and evenings are boring not much happening here...
The food is excellent at the Buffet thou! 5 star for the buffet for sure! 
Sam and Flor at the beach bar are awesome, friendly and professional!

reviews.author: Alejandro P
reviews.title: Bad Experience
reviews.text: Worst check-in experience, they gave us a room used by someone else, it took almost an hour because they try to sell you lot's of overpriced stuff. We also had an issue with our reservation and hotel staff didn't helped us at all.

reviews.author: onboard2000
reviews.title: Not for Experienced Travelor
reviews.text:
We just returned from a family trip 7 adults. Two children.  Unfortunately, they purchased the family upgrade.  They are trying to contest the additional $500.00 charge.  It wound up being a dinner reservation service.  Big deal, lol, pick up the phone and make your own dinner reservation.

I often wonder who writes these reviews.  This is not a resort for experienced travelors who have been to the high end resorts.

Our impression was this resort caters to quantity and not quality.  Food was cold at many places and precooked.  We observed pans of burgers with no taste and cold.
This was par for their food.  The restaurants also precooked the food and served it cold.

Money was not an issue for us, we went at the last minute,because the other resorts were booked for Christmas. The kicker was were we had to step over water sogged towels laid out by the elevator. These wet towels were there for three days.  We were told there was a flood somewhere.   Never again!

P.s, The pool was ice cold and when I asked pool bartender if the water ever warms up, he shook his head and said never.   Lol

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Worst hotel experience EVER
reviews.text: Food was NASTY!!!! Totally inedible. They also charged us for another person's room because they had written down my credit card number on somebody else's file. Would never stay here again or recommend to my worst enemy.

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.title: Dont go there
reviews.text:
I dont know where to start from:
1-Check in: it took about an hour to check in,room wasn’t ready and we had to wait.
2-room:alot of ants on the floor and on the mini bar,i called three times in the beginning they said will change the room or will clean it,in the end they sent somebody with spray for ants to clean it,and still coming out and i was cleaning it for the whole stay.
3-fridge:they dont fill up the fridge with water at least unless you request( all inclusive hotel) !!!
I called one time to request and the front desk told me we dont restock the fridge and on pardisus website says we restock your fridge everyday!!!
4-safe box: it wasnt working and need to be programmed,somebody came on the first day to fix it and he said you cant set up a code you just need to use your room keys to close and open,the second time missed up he came and set up a code!!!
5-front desk:you need to spend 10 min at least to reach them,and sometimes need to call the room service to let the front desk answer your phone call!!
6-food:all inclusive hotel means eat whatever you want whenever you want but the reality its not,you have to make a reservation for the dinner a day before and in the end they tell you its full so you can go and eat from the buffet! Disgusting food.
One of the days we ate in blueagave its a tacos restaurant,my wife found a staple in the quesadilla!! The waitress came and saw that and he call the manager and everybody saw that we left,and I ignored what happend but after all of that happend to me I decided to complain for the manager,i talked to a manager his name is alex and said im going right now to the restaurant and i will call you back,he called back after saying that i meet the manager of the restaurant and he said nothing happened in the restaurant like that!!! Alex ignored and he believed the restaurant manager!!
The most disgusting i saw while i was setting on the beach,i saw one of waitress there picking up the plastic cups from the trash cane and take them back to the bar on the beach!!! 
I have more to say,but its enough for now,i will make sure that nobody go there from people i know.
And its not the end with Paradisus,i know how to get my right back.
Thanks for the worse staying in Mexico ever.

reviews.author: Udi S
reviews.title: Xmas 2018 - Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Context: Relevant read if you’re traveling with young kids (ours are 7 & 4).

Staying at Paradisus Cancun at peak time - this is our fourth day here. 

For our family vacations we typically look for all inclusive resorts which offer kids clubs rich in activities and experiences.

Based on our experience so far, we would never come back to Paradisus Cancun or to any Club Melia hotels.
If good service is the best sales agent, then Paradisus Cancun and Club Melia have made all the wrong impressions:

Strike 1 - if you’re used to kids clubs, Paradisus Cancun doesn’t have a true one. Even the Club Melia timeshare sales people told us so. Their solution for 1-5 year old is one small indoor room. They don’t really tend to the younger kids. We saw a 1 yo crying unattended for 15 min and they called back her parents. They have access to an indoor playground but can play there only under parent supervision.

Strike 2 - if your child is at kid-zone 5-12, they have the option to go to lunch with the group. While it is the parent responsibility to opt the child in, and we forgot to do it one day, our expectation was that between kids zone and family concierge they would confirm with us before deciding he could skip lunch.

Strike 3 - one of the most fun functions for kids so far was the foam party at the pool. They didn’t have enough towels for all the children that attended. We waited over 30 minutes after event was over for towels

Strike 4 - club Melia. Don’t fall for this. We asked one of the service desks for directions to Expedia’s travel agent it turned out it was a club Melia opportunistic sales desk. They offered us a great deal on our destination, undercutting Expedia who we were headed toward, if we sat through a timeshare presentation. 60 min turned into 120 min... that part is ok we knew what we were in for... we got our voucher for the price they promised. The next morning we woke up very early and watched tour bus after tour bus leave.. finally an hour after scheduled departure time, we went to see the hotel’s travel director. She told us our reservation was never booked with the tour company. Unbelievable!

Bright spots - family concierge butlers, reservation-only restaurants offer great food and service.

reviews.author: Sbeen A
reviews.title: Nice hotel and staff but beware of the lies and promises
reviews.text:
I had did my research for months and confirmed all the booking and questions I had before booking about the kid and baby club. Well it was all a lie. I asked over a dozen times if my 8 month would be allowed to stay alone without parents in the baby club, and if my 4 year old could be at the kids club. Well I was assured over the phone numerous times and then when I got here it was not true. I had to hire sitters for both kids to stay in the baby club and kids club as they were under age and they needed a care taker. I spent hundreds of dollars for baby sitting during my 6 night stay but that wasn’t even the start of it. You have to book the day advance and then the time they are suppose to come and your waiting to go out the don’t show up. I had numerous cancellations. Last minute . Even the hotel cancelled on me last minted and I had to rebook all my travels the day before. 

I was promised dinner for two at tempo for the sales rep when booking my stay and then when I got here, there was no sign of anything said or written about my dinner promise. 

Also I waited two hours to checki in with a 4 year old and 8 month who were tired and hungry . Despite checking in online on the melia app and calling to confirm. They don’t stand by their word. I was super angry and frustrated waiting as their system was down and could t check us in. 

They promise all hat they don’t deliver on. I wanted to love this place but I don’t. Staff was amazing on the restaurants, pool and room service, but melia management really is poor. 
Stay away during the holiday season.

reviews.author: spice traveler
reviews.title: Beware Bait and Switch!
reviews.text:
I'm looking for a great spot for our family to go in Mexico. Our travel agent recommended the Paradisus. She was able to give us a short summary of what was included so I called the number on the website directly to find out exactly what was included.

I provided the exact dates we are traveling and she quoted me the rate, telling me it was inclusive of a $550 resort credit, 2 free dinners at the "fancy" restaurant and other amenities. When my agent called back ten minutes later, she was told these bonuses were not available the dates we were traveling. I had been on the phone with the hotel reservation desk for 10-15 minutes specifically to understand exactly what was included during the dates we were traveling and they promised things which are not included. 

I called customer service today and they could do absolutely nothing (although I gave them the name of the agent I'd spoken to and provided all the details.) I'm glad I didn't book there! If they can't keep a promise after 10 minutes, what would happen when we arrived?

I was promised a call back within 2 hours and have heard nothing and it's been a full business day.

Very, very disappointed.

reviews.author: Sheri L
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
We had a nice stay.  The ocean view is beautiful.  Staff was excellent.  However, I would never stay at this property again.  

Food is below average for a property of this type and price.  The food was just not good.  I didn’t realize nacho cheese sauce could be like water until I ate here.  I did not think nacho cheese sauce was something that could be ruined but it was literally LIQUID.  Very disappointed with the food.  

Restaurant reservations are a joke.  I think they want you to book reservations and tell you nothing is available so you eat at the buffet.  

The main areas of the hotel are hot and humid all the time.  It is hot and muggy inside the main area at all times of the day and night.

There was only one elevator working for the side of the building (8 floors) where we were staying on.  We had to always use the stairs and because the main area is always so hot, we could not even go to dinner without sweating.  

Steps?  OMG...you don’t need to work out while on vacation when you are staying in this resort.  There are steps, steps, and more steps to go around on this property.  If you have a family member who cannot walk well or is in a wheelchair, do not stay at this resort.  

To get a beach towel you have to get them from people selling trips and excursions.  If I wanted more than a beach towel, I would go see the concierge.  I just want a towel to go relax by the beach or pool.  

I will no go back, and I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Explorer622
reviews.title: Family Vacation Nightmare
reviews.text: Took our whole family(12 people) on an 8 day vacation over Thanksgiving and to celebrate stepson's birthday. The location and views are spectacular. That is where positive ends. Had booked 3 rooms(side by side) in the Family Concierge section and another room for our step daughter and her husband in the Adult section. Upon arrival we were informed they did not have a room for my wife, myself and our twin grand daughters. Called our Travel agency and Delta Travel. Our agency said that they had confirmed with hotel 2 days earlier. thru email. For some unknown reason the hotel had canceled our reservation. The hotel did get my stepson and his other 2 children plus their cousin and his family into their side by side rooms. After about 2 hours they were able to put us into a room on a different floor and nowhere near the rest of our family. In addition, my step daughters room was suppose to have a king bed instead had two doubles. The family Concierge section is suppose to come with your own butler/Concierge. We saw ours twice in the 8 days we were there. After all this they didn't even apologize or offer some type of compensation. As for the rest of the resort, as I said they resort location is fantastic, the food is average at best, the service was sporadic, there were a couple of employees I saw that worked very hard to make sure you were taken care of but the rest were just there and other than the beach and swimming there is very little to do at the resort.

reviews.author: Mickey R
reviews.title: QUALITY IS VERY BAD. NOT WORTH THE MONEY
reviews.text: We were a family of 16 that was having a family reunion. The customer service of Parasidius resort owned by Melia group is very very bad. Once you book they will never discuss about anything. Before we booked we forgot to ask them about a special discount for such a large group. By mistake we all booked individually without asking for the discount. After the booking they were not willing to discuss. Also it was my daughter’s 21st birthday. They would not provide a cake or do anything special for her  eventhough it was an all inclusive resort. Also in advance you cannot contact the resort. When you call the 800 number it goes to a call center in Spain. I would keep away from this resort. The beach access was good. Check in personnel are not friendly or welcoming. When we checking out & getting into taxi we were told we need a check out receipt. I wish they had mentioned this before we stepped our of the door. The line was very long and they would not do anything to help us out. We would have missed our flight. Luckily we were going to the airport 3 hours early.  There are not great common places to hang out.

reviews.author: Blair
reviews.title: My first cancun was awful
reviews.text: I can’t believe this hotel is a five star resort but it pretend. I felt like the employee was looking down on me because i’ve already paid. Concierge is too slow and in absence. Why didn’t anybody answer?

reviews.author: SauminShah
reviews.title: Bad reservation system and rude phone customer service
reviews.text: This review is not for the resort itself but for its reservation booking and customer service to make reservations. I booked my stay from Dec 18 to Dec 24 for Cancun Paradisus online using their Melia Rewards programme. However, my 2000 points did not apply to the reservation. I made a non refundable booking which Is what I intended to do. But When I called customer service if they could apply the points so that I would get the discount which was worth $100 at the time of booking, they very rudely told me that they cant do anything with it. I asked them if I could escalate it or reach out to someone who can help apply those points. They said they cannot do anything about it. They were vey rude on the phone. $100 is a lot of money to loose. I am already not looking forward to staying at this hotel. We booked a family concierge ocean view room but I have very low expectations now and cant cancel it now. Also i had emailed resort itself wanting to know what kind of baby food they serve as i am travelling with a 7 month baby. I also wanted to know if they provide mirowave and high chair in room but they hav not got back to me. Real disappointment since i need to think about packing

reviews.author: Zhana K
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text:
We had the worst experience in Paradisus and I would never stay here again. Our usual hotel is under construction and based on the reviews we booked this hotel for 2 days. Stayed on November 18 to 20. We arrived early and the check-in wait was about 45 minute.The room wasnt ready which was expected since it was 9 am. I used the hospitality suite to change and noticed a small cockroach. I undertand it's a big hotel and hard to control what comes inside. I didnt pay it no mind.  We went to the pool and did our own thing. At around 130 PM our room was ready and looked clean. In the evening when we came back, there were small roaches all over the table. I wish I can post a video of this nightmare. They were everywhere. I lifted my purse. And a huge roach ran out. We called downstairs right away. The lady asked us "do you want us to spray the room??what ???spray the room?no, I want new CLEAN room. After we went downstairs, the manager was not on site. About 5 minutes of screaming, he reincarnated and was able to move us to a different room. For such a large hotel, they could get the place fumigated.
The food was horrible,except at the royal service restaurant.  And the beach is nice. But the place is horrible and the workers weren't very friendly. 
Anyway,if you wish to bring some new friends home, stay away from here. I ended up washing and spraying all my bags prior to entering my home.

reviews.author: Deshayc
reviews.title: Worst stay of my Life
reviews.text:
This was the WORST hotel I have ever stayed in! Do no I REPEAT DO NOT STAY HERE. For an all inclusive hotel at $440 per night + tax It was terrible. Where do I begin: 

Check in: they could not find our reservation and you CAN NOT book at the front desk so I had to go Via Expedia (God Bless them) and book another room. It took us 3 hours to check in. The entire process was SLOW!

Food: I tried all the restaurants including room service and NONE of it was good. I mean barly etable! The eggs where pink and the pasta tasted it came out of a can. The pizza was bad I mean how do you mess up pizza. The cookies where even bad. I could go on but o don’t have enough time. 

Checkout: trying to leave the hotel in a timely fashion we waiting in line for 40 min to check out and you have to stand in the line because you need a check out card in order to leave the hotel. They literally would not let us leave because I needed to swipe my card they already had on file for the equivalent of $20USD. 

Positives: The staff - they are SUPER friendly and helpful and the service other than check in and check out is pretty swift. 

Unfortunately, I would never stay here again which is a shame because I am due back to Cancun 3 more times in the next year.

reviews.author: Matias M
reviews.title: Pésimo, no vale ni la mitad lo que cuesta
reviews.text: Todo lo que ven lindo en las fotos... es todo lo que no van a ver si no contratan el royal services. Te hacen sentir la diferencia del que paga el extra del que no! Y uno ya está pagando muucho por este hotel. Cuando llego nos dicen q el buffet principal y el restaurant fuego están cerrados por lo que el desayuno almuerzo etc se hace en el buffet de la playa en cual no tiene Sifuentes lugar y la comida es POBRE no hay reposición y para pedir unos miseros fideos debes hacer una cola de no menos 6 personas unos 10 min. no te llevan comida a las palapas ni camastros de la pileta. La atención es limitada, los empleados no tienen idea de las actividades. Definitivamente no es un hotel familiar! No hay suficientes palapas ni reposeras, lo q si sobran son infinidad de camastros “Vip” q te cobran desde 80 dólares hasta 150 x día!! Pero q nadie ocupa, porque evidentemente el precio es ridículamente excesivo. No volvería jamás al hotel, realizamos un reclamo en recepción y jamás nos dieron una respuesta. Sinceramente este hotel no vale más de 150 dólares la noche, no se dejen engañar.

reviews.author: Adrian F
reviews.title: Muy malo
reviews.text: Realmente la atencion del hotel y la capacidad para resolver los inconvenientes que tuvimos fue muy muy muy mala. Me he hospedado en hoteles en todo el mundo y nunca tuve tan mala atencion y tan poca capacidad para resolver un inconveniente el cual era ajeno a mi persona, ya que despegar se equivoco en mi reserva. Muy excesivo el costo adicinal por la diferencia que tuvimos que pagar por un menor de 17 años abusivo el precio!!  Si van a contratar este hotel asegurence de tener todo confirmado y no depender del gerente del hotel quien nunca se hizo presente ni de el personal de reserva quien tampoco nos pudo resolver nada.

reviews.author: 218marksmith
reviews.title: Food awful no premium drinks
reviews.text:
Just back from a week here been was looking forward for a while to come here.
Hotel is beautiful room lovely see view recommended.
Staff fantastic they work hard, however this hotel is not worth the money for the food and drinks hardly any vegetarian food and they cook the meat same place as they cook vegetarian food as in omelettes and use the same tools etc all rice pasta and soup is cooked in chicken and beef stalk but staff will tell you it’s vegetarian because it has no meat nothing is clear here so it’s hard to know what your eating. Please educate your staff on vegetarian food and how to cook it and what is acceptable  for them to eat it’s really not that complicated.; 
We love Mexico and having been coming for years for the amazing standard of food and premium drinks you certainly won’t get it here.
if you manage to book a restaurant 3 days in advance and if they’re not closed the food wasn’t great either, buffet same food repeated constantly. 
Every hotel We’ve stayed in served us premium drinks as in grey goose 1800 tequila etc here it’s smirnoff and cheap tequila which considering the price we paid is totally unacceptable it’s been the most expensive so far.
We stayed in dreams royalton Rui to name a few the food standards and restaurants there are amazing and always premium drinks.
The drinks are also watered down massively as mentioned in previous reviews. 
I wished I had paid attention to the reviews about the food before booking but I really wanted to stay at this hotel. We feel so disappointed.
The coffee shop is open for about an hour a day as with the ice cream station so catch it when you can think they’ve closed them down because it’s not high season as with the restaurants.
The beach was beautiful weather amazing.
We love you Mexico and can’t wait to come back but wouldn’t come back here we could have saved thousands by booking a cheaper hotel on the hotel zone with the same standard of food and drink.

reviews.author: dlpearsonjr
reviews.title: Don’t go
reviews.text: Went for anniversary and birthday trip. Got food poisoning on the second day and was sick almost the whole stay. Observed a worker dropping food then retrieving it and putting it back on the bar, and this was the location where I had ate and got sick, saw a worker retrieve something out of a drink with his bare fingers and deliver it to a guest. Also observed workers picking there nose.

reviews.author: claudiamN5129HL
reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.text: First and last time in this hotel.  I can not complain about the service but the food is terrible, the rooms are dated and small. My husband got really sick we only ate at the hotel. (350 dlls to see the doctor at the hotel) had to come back one day earlier.  The only thing they gave us for leaving earlier were two bottles of electrolytes for my husband.

reviews.author: Shawn M
reviews.title: Terrible Honeymoon
reviews.text:
We went to Paradisus on our honeymoon for Labor day weekend. First of all right I had requested high floor and noted we were going to be celebrating our honeymoon. They gave us a room on ground zero on the first floor next to the pool the opposite I had asked for. Called to switch our rooms they wouldn't switch it out since there was no availability. After a long phone conversation with the manager they found a room but we have to stay the night and switch the rooms next day. So the next day they switched out the rooms we got the high floor we asked for but the room was a much older and smaller room what we didn't pay for and the bed was terrible. Also the shower tub was clogged and called them to come and repair it while the maid came to make the room but nothing, no one came to fix the tub.
Restaurants were okay, food quality isn't good, only restaurant that was decent was Fuego. The alcohol at the bars were terrible barely put any alcohol. Save your money and time and go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Trfigueredo
reviews.title: Entrada fatal
reviews.text: Espero que mejore la estancia porque hasta el momento califico como fatal mi entrada al hotel. Deficiencia de atención en cuanto a solucion de problemas. Llevo 2 hrs esperando para hacer check in. El cual no me dan soluciones adecuadas si no somos nosotros los que la damos. El Niño sin almorzar y aún estoy esperando. Horrible. Espero sinceramente que mejore. Muy mal para Melia. Tenía mejor criterios para ellos.

reviews.author: Melissa B
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Paid for an ocean view (most expensive hotel we booked) and got the view of a brick wall....after we complained we got a better room with 2 double beds which isn’t ideal for a newly engaged couple (which also wasn’t celebrated). Couldn’t get a dinner booking on our first night and our room key continually didn’t work. Rooms weren’t cleaned daily until 4pm and staff were unapologetic. Drink service at the pool was the best part.

reviews.author: Ivanagi
reviews.title: Decepción
reviews.text: Se fijan mucho ser estructurados y no miran las necesidades del cliente ya prácticamente en la playa no tienen servicio y el hotel está muy caído en sus instalaciones. Las dos ultimas veces que estuve ( en febrero de 2018 y ahora ) tuve problemas. El único esmero es y servicio es en el royal Service. Una lastima que no elija volver. 15 años eligiéndolos pero estas dos ultimas decepcionantes

reviews.author: Fearless794946
reviews.title: Pesimo host de eventos
reviews.text:
El trato profesional a los clientes que llevan grupos deja mucho que desear. Poco profesionalismo. Mala atencion. Solo ven el mercantilismo y no la atencion al cliente. Relacion precio/calidad es deficiente. 
EVITAR HACER EVENTOS TIPO CONGRESOS.

reviews.author: qissa96
reviews.title: horrible management!
reviews.text: the resort itself is beautiful, however management is awful and unprofessional daughter was injured, resorts fault she was seen by dr at resort. I asked for incident report was refused but they wanted me to sign release of liability, very selfish and controlling! i called cheap Caribbean and they tried to reach out to them multiple times, however they ignored all emails and correspondence. cheap Caribbean is making them soooo much $$$$ however they disrespect your customers and YOU. spent so much money and have this happen ruined the vacation!!!

reviews.author: Claudbon
reviews.title: Non ci siamo
reviews.text:
Parto prima di tutto dicendo quello che non trovo sulle recensioni, o meglio la maggior parte delle recensioni non sono recenti: DA FEBBRAIO 2018, LA RIVIERA MAYA È INVASA DALLE ALGHE.
Cancun ne è invasa ma a tratti si riesce a fare il bagno.
La struttura: è enorme (quasi 700 camere), ERA una struttura lusso, va rimodernata (piscina, bagni delle camere ecc).
Camere: livello da 2-3 stelle. Anche qui tanto lavoro da fare
All inclusive/ cibo: salvo volentieri il ristorante a buffet Nasos, ma gli altri 6 ristoranti un disastro. 
Piscine: al solito invase da americani e latini ubriachi (e agosto è bassa stagione)
Spa: bella ma costosa (massaggio da 50’: minimo 180 dollari, ceretta inguine 69 dollari).
Niente ... direi che c’è di molto meglio altrove a Cancun e consiglio la parte con spiaggia di fronte a Isla Mujeres senza alghe

reviews.author: Stan S
reviews.title: Big Disappointment!
reviews.text: We started off waiting for an extended period of time after our check-in time because the room was not ready. When we finally arrived to the room some of the pillowcases and sheets were dirty and clearly have not been changed. We informed housekeeping on the floor had them change out the soiled linens. We had a mini fridge in the room. I opened it to get a bottle of water and it was warm. The fridge was plugged in, but not working. We called the front desk to notify and they said someone would be up in a few minutes. The maintenance man did not come until about 3 hours later. I called to make a reservation at a restaurant for the following day. Only one place had availability to make a reservation. When we arrived there the hostess could not find my name on the list. It took some convincing and we were finally seated. The whole hotel has NO air conditioning in the atrium or hallways. The restaurant was in the center of the hotel and everyone was hot and uncomfortable. We were literally sweating and did not even feel comfortable to eat. The next morning I was woken up to a sound of dripping water. I investigated the sound and found water to be dripping from the bathroom ceiling. I called the front desk. I was shocked that they sent someone up and they were unable to fix it and did not move our room. I asked the manager to please relocate us since the floor was very slippery and my girlfriend already fell. I feel this property has potential, but the management is terrible and leaves their customers unsatisfied. I cannot believe the property does not even have air conditioning in the common areas. I would  not return to this hotel again. Very disappointed. When we left we reported and even took pictures of our concerns, and not even an apology was received. As a corporate travel agent who has many clients travel to the area, I will not be recommending your property in the near future. I had hoped very much to have a pleasurable experience and was very let down.

reviews.author: gr8tfulkim
reviews.title: Club Melia Timeshare - Extremly disppointed/Feel scammed
reviews.text: Paradisus is amazing - beautiful and excellent customer service.  Do not sign up for the timeshare.  We were scammed.  They did not tell us that we could only use the points on even years (not odd), and also they told us that we could use the points toward other sister hotels. These sister locations only honor a small portion of your points toward your stay, and also the sister hotels are not in prime locations (far away from sites).  Also be careful, they serve you champagne and move quickly as you are signing all of the paperwork (small print).   We have lost thousands of dollars.  My husband and I are extremely disappointed.

reviews.author: Isabel Cristina M
reviews.title: Decepción total - Si ocurre un accidente en sus instalaciones nadie responde!
reviews.text:
En el mes de junio tuve un accidente al interior de la habitación y cuando se solicitó ayuda llego la brigada de emergencia pero ante la solicitud de un médico (se trataba de una fractura), me indicaron que yo debía pagarlo, ante la urgencia les dije que sí, así que tuve que pagar el médico y la ambulancia porque el hotel no te responde.
Como el accidente ocurrió el día que terminaba mi estadía, el hotel estaba preocupado no por mi estado de salud sino por que sacará mis cosas de la habitación, así que estando en el hospital a la espera de la cirugía de urgencia por la fractura recibí varias llamadas de personal del hotel preguntando por el momento en que liberaría la habitación, por lo que ese mismo día tuve que pedir a alguien que recogiera nuestras cosas y al regresar a mi país (luego de la hospitalización y cirugía), nos dimos cuenta que se perdieron algunas pertenencias.
Este mes le escribí al hotel reportando lo ocurrido y preguntando por el procedimiento para realizar la reclamación, sin embargo, la respuesta que recibí de la Gerente de Calidad no corresponde con lo que pregunté y aun sin saber cómo ocurrió el accidente contesto que ellos realizaban mantenimiento al hotel, cosa que no está relacionada con las medidas de seguridad que deben tener para evitar este tipo de accidentes.
Aún sigo esperando una respuesta del hotel..

reviews.author: tphan2018
reviews.title: Biggest Mistake of all our travel years around the world
reviews.text: The resort was old and smelly. The aroma they used to mask the smell was so bad, my kids and my mom got headaches from them. Buffet food were the same over and over again. Lack of choices for lunch. Dinner reservations were ridiculous. We stayed in Paradisus Punta Cana and loved it. We stayed at Paradisus Cancun and hated it. If you have small children, go to Aruba when the beaches are calm and warm. The tap water is safe and the people are friendly. The locals are kind and don't try to hustle you in buying things.

reviews.author: yannickmartel81
reviews.title: Pas de service digne d'un 3 étoiles
reviews.text: Service nulle,aucune information à notre arrivé.restaurent moyen ressemblant à Cuba.L'ocean horrible plein algue et surtout ne payer pas pour le service de luxe des chambre aucune différence. Bref je déconseille fortement.Vous êtes mieux servie à Cuba ou dans tout autre hôtel à Cancun.Derniere fois ici pour nous.

reviews.author: Dominique L
reviews.title: super bel hotel digne d'un cinq étoile le seul probleme c'est les marches
reviews.text: nourriture très bonne , ambiance bonne, cuisine bonne, la plage surtout quand on est sur la plage privée excellente, hotel à recommander à cancun, dommage pour les marches pour les personnes un peu handicapés pour monter les marches, mais excellent

reviews.author: liengpho
reviews.title: TERRIBLE
reviews.text:
TERRIBLE RESORT. We've been to Cancun 3 times and this is the worst of all the resorts.
Food was not great, dining reservations was a nightmare.  They will yell at you and threaten security on you if you DARE inquire about an extra table. 
A lot of problems with the rooms, including water leak in ceiling, no running water, no HOT water, no fridge refills. insecure doors.

reviews.author: Christina N
reviews.title: Worst experience ever!
reviews.text: The room was beautiful but everything else in the hotel seemed outdated and was humid/had an odor. Management staff is not friendly at all and don’t expect personalized services from the butlers. Food and drinks were horrible. The check-in process took a long time. We were staying for 4 nights for a family vacation but rarely saw our “butler”. This was the worst all-inclusive hotel I’ve ever been to. We tried to make reservations for some of the restaurants but ultimately it was difficult because they were always booked but when we would come around, there were so many empty tables... our butler also messed up our dinner reservation and told her boss it was our fault. I will never return nor do I recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: marktduong
reviews.title: It is not Paradise not even close
reviews.text:
We planned a family reunion with 6 families with a total of 24 people. We notified the hotel well in advance and still we had issues with reserving a la carte restaurants where we can all at least sit in the same area. The restaurants and reservation desk are not connected. When you call the reservation desk they note all restaurants are booked however, when you go to any of the a la carte restaurants they are completely empty. It would seem the hotel prefer guests to eat only at the buffet for all three meals. This was very frustrating and such a hassle. I would recommend the hotel review this operational hiccup as it really was a sore point for our whole family.

It was so unpleasant and in all my years visiting Cancun this was the first time a staff (Sonaya) threaten to call security on me for asking if we can take the empty tables. I was perplex on how a guest requesting to sit at empty tables warrant a request to call security. I was deeply offended and confuse on how a simple process escalated into an unpleasant and unforgettable moment of how not to treat guests at a hotel.

The food was horrible however the service staff was worse.

Our family elected the Royal Service which came with Butlers. In theory this sounds like a good feature and benefit for guests however, the staff are not trained properly so most of the time they are just waiting on you to ask them questions. I would recommend the hotel review the tangible benefits with the Royal Service and regular service as our family couldnt distinguish the difference other than the fact we paid more for no added benefit.

I would not recommend going to this hotel. We will not be coming back ever.

I hope the hotel shapes up. Here is my booking number so you can do your due diligence 1800689129 and really take this review seriously as i know all 24 of us has the same sentiment.

reviews.author: Julie N
reviews.title: Horrible experience with Royal Service
reviews.text:
Bad food, bad service, paying extra for the "Royal service" was a waste of money, hotel is old and
smells like mold/mildew. Trying to make a reservation for dinner was always difficult but there were always empty tables when we showed up. Paying extra for the royal service is not worth it. Avoid it at all costs. It's just a way for them to make more money but with mediocre service.

reviews.author: 123FletcherZ
reviews.title: Book elsewhere...
reviews.text: I’m here now with my family and all we want to do is leave. This place is a 3 star at best. No welcome champagne, or cool towel. Feels like a cramped, overcrowded bad beach resort. The opposite of a relaxing beach vacation. I’ve been waiting for the guest services manager for over an hour...there is no customer service here. The food is horrid.

reviews.author: Grayson S
reviews.title: Not what we expected...
reviews.text: My husband & I, along with our friends, stayed at the Paradisus Cancun with the Royal Service upgrade.  I figured we've been to Cancun multiple occasions (Excellence & Secrets resorts), and we loved the experience & service, it would be comparable.  Unfortunately, our experience started on a bad note:  it took 2 hours to check in!  We went to the lobby, and the 3 clerks were taking FOREVER to check in couples before us.  While we were waiting, we saw other families being very disgruntled towards the clerks.  Just 3 clerks checking in 3 families in front of us!  What's the hold up?  2 hours later, we were able to finish our check in uneventfully, and then one of the employees directed us to the Royal Service section.  There was a lounge area, where one of the employees explained to us about the butler service, map, room service, Wifi, etc.  Apparently, we had to wait on the butler to direct us to our room, and he wasn't available yet.  So another 1 hour wait!  Eventually, Arturo, out butler, directed us to our room.  Once in the room, he explained to us about the process of making reservations for restaurants for dinner, that we can't dine unless we confirm reservations through the butler.  He told us there were no reservations available for the night, and nothing available until 10:00 PM the next evening!  He told us the only option we had was the buffet for the night.  So we ended up eating at Naos, the intercontinental buffet that you can eat with no reservations.  The food was sub-par.  Surprisingly, Arturo was able to work his magic, and arrange dinners @ Enzo, Vento, and Bana for the next 3 nights.  Apparently, he spoke to his manager and was able to get us in.  Unfortunately, except for some of the tapas dishes in Vento, the food was lackluster.  We felt like we were eating packaged food from grocery stores!  Why do we even need reservations for this quality of food?  Oddly, there were so many empty seats in all the restaurants!  Also, when we ordered alcoholic beverages (restaurant, beach, lounge, etc.), there was barely any alcohol in the drinks!  Overall, the organization and service structure of the resort is very questionable.  They need to figure out a way to work check-in and the butler system to become more efficient, and vastly improve on the quality of beverages & food.  For what we paid for, it was not worth it.

reviews.author: ottoniel p
reviews.title: The worst hotel and service I have ever experienced
reviews.text: This by far has been the worst hotel I have ever been for such a high price I paid. As soon as they gave me the room I opened the door and the room was not event cleaned up, the smell of the room was like Hell, when I went to talk to the managers about it they did not even care about that, then it took them 1 more hour to give another nasty room, and I say nasty because the 2nd room they tried to give was dirty as well, actually the AC did not work at all and I made the claim and they did not care about it...they just dont care about you after you paid......IF YOU DONT WANT TO LOOSE YOUR MONEY DONT COME TO THIS NASTY HOTEL.... And by the way the service is the worse you can ever find in hospitality...,

reviews.author: ALBANIA
reviews.title: Go somewhere else!!!
reviews.text:
The hotel appearance is ok. But everything else not good at all.
Only one restaurant (naos) doesn't need reservations at night, the rest which have better options for dining requires a reservation the crazy thing is that if you call today it will be booked for that night and also for the following night. So good luck getting reservations. The same goes for any activity for adults or for your kids. Oh here is the catch if you become a club melia member then things will be good for you. Im disappointed at doing all-inclusive resorts because the service and everything its only good if you have shares or own weeks at the hotel. The pool bar waterdown the liquor so if you want to have a great time just drink straight up things not mixed drinks. Also boring atmosphere by the pool be prepared to not hear any music some days. Overall experience? Terrible!! We won't go back

reviews.author: Miriam
reviews.title: Opinión sobre el equipo de ventas del Club vacacional
reviews.text:
El hotel es de los mejores en Cancún, el club vacacional vale la pena a no ser por el equipo de Marketing y Ventas que ahora si se pasaron de listos!!!
Esta opinión es sobre ese equipo y no el hotel!

En esta ocasión nos invitaron a un desayuno (en el que quieren venderte o hacer el up grade) pero la intención era comentarnos que ahora el programa vacacional que compramos a 50 años se llama Circus y te ofrecen subir de grado pero disminuyendo los años si no te interesa el Circus (que es cambiar tus opciones onpuntos de semanas a noches y de una suite con cocineta a cuarto de hotel (cosa que no es un beneficio en absoluto), porque quieren rescatar inventario del club vendido a 50 años!!!

Cuando indicamos que no era de nuestro interés cambiar el plan contratado hace 10 años, se enojaron y me amenazaron con que tenía que firmar un docto. en el que se redacta que te informaron de los beneficios “disfrazado el interés real de que sueltes el inventario” y que si no lo firmaba me atenía a las consecuencias.

Todo esto por una srita. Colombiana que es como la supervisora del área de ventas.

No me quiso dar su nombre pero pedí hablar con el Gerente, quien solo te da el avión!!

En definitiva es una lástima que un hotel que hasta ahora es de los mejores, tenga un equipo de ventas de  esta calidad y traten a sus socios con la punta del pie!!

reviews.author: Yesenny M
reviews.title: Beware of the Club Meliá scam
reviews.text: The hotel itself is great, I previously had it at a 5 Star rating, but then the facts were painted differently. Within 24hrs of arrival, we signed a Service Agreement for Room Upgrades at any resort as part of Club Meliá. Everything we were told were lies!!! Sales person Adrian, and his Portuguese Manager named Artur, complied lies, withheld disclosures, and ultimately scammed us. They make everything they do as complicated as they can so it takes you a bit to figure out how bad you got taken advantage. Even after attempting to cancel within 24hrs, it’s your words against this “Network”. We’re in the process of filing with the BBB. Google Club Meliá scams, it’s pure deception!!!

reviews.author: Vipul G
reviews.title: One star is still too much - Pools are very dangerous
reviews.text:
I would like to EXCLUDE Restaurant Enso from this review. 

Paradisus Cancun - Good experience only lasts during checkin. Even at checking the waiter offering a chilled drink will not leave you until you give him a few bucks. Below are some of the things that went wrong during our 4 day stay. 

*** Their KIDS pool (2 ft deep) uses glass pebbles for flooring and is extremely dangerous. I slipped and fell trying to lie down on Chaise lounge (built in the pool). I fell hard on my head and started bleeding from my elbow.
****** See attached picture. AVOID using these.

#1) Restaurant staff is beyond rude and unreasonable
We had an incident where Naos restaurant hostess took a plate of food away from my wife because it was 6PM and she could see her swimsuit under her seethru dress. I complained to front desk but they neither apologized or did anything. When I went back to confront the hostess, she said she offered a new story about the incident. Later two waiters joined her and said that they are the enforcers for dress code. Its a FREAKING BEACH RESORT !!!! Everyone is wearing a swimsuit most of the day. They could have dealt with the situation in many better ways.

#2) Constant room flooding
Thank god our room didn't flood. But we were constantly walking around to avoid water in lobby. With 3 year old running around this is quite a hazard.

#3) Poor air conditioning
Air conditioning is very weak. We had it set to 65 and it was still warm in the room. So they got us a standing fan to help.

#4) Poor Room cleaning and restocking
Our bed was only made once during our 4 day stay. We called and let them know but nothing happened. Water was restocked once during 4 day stay. I had to call for water bottles every day.

#5) Poor room service
First day we ordered coffee and snacks with Room service and it was fine. Second day they told me that they don't offer coffee for room service.

#6) Overwhelming use of Incense all over the hotel
They use incense all over the place and its just overwhelming.

reviews.author: Yanet Vega
reviews.title: Horrible Stay from beginning to end
reviews.text: I'm so upset and livid with this place. I prepaid my reservation June 12 for $864 dollars and the transaction was posted that same date. When I went to the hotel they made a huge deal saying that they needed a new card to charge the whole transaction  since i did not have the original card that i paid with. I agreed to put a hold on a new card ( my husband's card)  for $864 and then be charged $864 once i checked out. Today 6/20/2018 i checked my bank accounts and i was not reimbursed for the $864 on my original card and if that was not enough i was charged $877 dollars. I called the hotel and they stated that they forgot to send the email to reimbursement and they charged me in Mexican pesos so there's nothing they could do. They lied and Veronica stated that my husband agree to that and that there was no way for them to charge me in american dollars. ( 2 lies - he never agreed to that and i know they have a credit card machine that charges in dollars) Instead of owning to their mistake and amend the problems that they created they blamed us for that? Horrible, horrible customer service.  Believe me i not trying to be petty and i can definitely afford the $13 dollars difference but the fact that i had to go through all of this hassle during fathers day weekend has been horrible. Besides all of these issues i would like to add that I paid for the Royal Services and i do not know where to start but i had a horrible time. From the moment we walked in we were supposed to have drinks and towels at check in.. I saw the drinks and the towels but the services were never offered as well as the famous beach bag that i never had in our room. Our butler was supposed to make reservations for us and he forgot to make them and in top of that he lied about it. We showed up on fathers day to the restaurant and we did not have a reservation and the captain straight up told him that he never made a reservation. The food was horrible, the only good place where we had a good time was the palapa restaurant were the food was amazing as well as the servers. I am beyond livid with this company and the way we were treated i spent over $1600 to spend 3 days in Mexico as a gift for fathers day and I never in a million years expected to turn out this way. Would not recommend this hotel not even to my enemies.

reviews.author: CarlosFS
reviews.title: MUST READ, especially for families with kids
reviews.text:
I am a very experienced Cancun traveler. Have been at least 20 times, each time to a different resort.  I have been with family/kids, and on other trips with just my wife.

The paradisus Cancun is BY FAR the worst I have been to.
Note - these are not emotion-driven complaints, they are simply facts of my stay:

- elevators did not work 50% of the time I was there.  And when they did work, they smelled real real bad, like rot.

- certain public bathrooms smell like sewage, had to cover my face to enter it.

- they were heavily promoting the World Cup - have set up with lots of TVs for their guests.  I am a die hard fan, so I show up excited to watch a game. But their service wasn’t working! So no one got to watch the game.

- time share sales are annoying.  People are nice, but i don’t like being aggressively sold time shares the second i check in. To top it off, what they offer doesn’t make any sense. They asked me to pay ~$13,000 USD upfront for their time share service. Ha!

- very low quality spa. The girl that gave me my massage was good and very nice. But the spa itself is terrible.  The entire time I was getting my massage, I could hear children screaming through the walls! Not pleasant while you are trying to get a relaxing massage.  The “hydrotherapy” is a scam... DO NOT do it. It is expensive, yet all it is is a shower, a steam room, a sauna, and a private pool with jets.  And the sauna didn’t even work, and half the jets in the pool didn’t work!  And the pool smelled really bad, like mold.

- food is generally TERRIBLE - breakfast and lunch are extremely low quality (especially lunch).  Food seems recycled and simply cheap. For dinner, stay away from the Brazilian option - Denny’s has better meats. Vento is 5/10, fuego is 7/10, sushi place is 7/10, and enso is 7/10.  Didn’t go to Mole (their Mexican place).

- speaking of their dinner restaurants, good luck getting a reservation.  We tried to get a reservation at Mole over and over, and they kept telling us there wasn’t availability.  So we had to speak to the manager and insist, and eventually got a reservation, at 8:30pm, 4 days from the day I called to make it (I didn’t make it to this reservation because my baby boy got sick... more on this below).

- final point about the food - I am Mexican, so I am used to the Mexican cuisine.  Nonetheless, my entire family got diarrhea (sorry for the directness, but it’s true) while being here. My baby boy got so sick we had to take him to the doctor. This is why I didn’t make it to Mole - because I was stuck in our room caring for my baby boy who was very sick.  

- in addition to getting stomach bugs while at the resort, my son got a nasty virus - hands foot and mouth disease.  (I have pictures and thought about uploading but they are graphic so I have elected not to). 

- maid service didn’t arrive my first full day. 

- mini bar in room wasn’t restocked first 2 days I was here.

- my key card to enter my room stopped working half way through the trip.

- drinks are TERRIBLE.  Everything is made with cheap syrups and everything is overly sweet.  They do have decent brand options, but, when you’re combining a good brand with cheap syrup, it destroys the drink.  This, I admit, is a common problem with most all-inclusives, but this resort takes the cake.

- WiFi is TERRIBLE - flat out doesn’t work in most parts of the resort.  select areas have good coverage, but overall, it is too spotty to be a good experience.  If you have to get work done, need WiFi to entertain kids, access news, etc, don’t count on it.

- the vast majority of the good areas near the pool are shaded beds that you must pay for. And they are very expensive.  Outside of these expensive shaded beds, if you want to be near the pool, given the limited number of chairs relative to the number of guests, my advice - set your alarm to 5:30am, go to the pool with your belongings, and place them on a chair to save them.  Otherwise, you will not be near the pool. For some this may not matter because you want to be near the ocean, and that is fine. But we like being next to the pool, which was a constant challenge...

- for me this was particularly a problem...  I have two young children, and both are very active. I have family in Cancun, so I asked them to help me find a local nanny that could come to the hotel with us to help us with our children.  And they found one.  I called the hotel in advance to confirm this was okay. They said I could purchase a day pass did the nanny. At first they said the day pass is from 9am - 6pm. I told them I was hoping the nanny could stay with us during dinner as well, until around 8pm or so. They said it would be fine, and even confirmed with their manager. So I booked it.  When I arrived at the hotel, they confirmed the same.  So all was good. Then my nanny arrived... and then they changed their mind. They said she needed to leave by 6, before dinner, or they would charge me a lot more per day.  I didn’t want to pay the additional fee so I explained the situation. They didn’t care, and so ultimately, my vacation was very different then planned.  I love my kids, but having a nanny help on your vacation is nice!  Too bad the hotel staff didn’t care, especially since I had already confirmed.

- if rained when I was there.  Many areas of the hotel started leaking, including next to my table when I was having dinner at the sushi restaurant! 

The service people at the hotel are extremely nice, and are not at fault for the issues I had.  That being said, the hotel facilities, and management, are the worst I have experienced.

And, as you will note from many of my comments, the hotel is generally dirty/broken... many areas smell like rot/mold, the food/drinks are low quality, and when it rained, I felt like the hotel was going to flood.  And apparently, this is the case to a degree that it may not be safe, given that we got sick.

If you want a family vacation, go to the Barceló.  If you want a couples vacation, go to a secrets property.

The paradicus Cancun, at least for me, was been a disaster.

reviews.author: maria jose c
reviews.title: Lo peor que he visitado en mi vida
reviews.text: Increible!! En nuestro tercer día de estadía en Paradisus Cancún, han venido unos amigos caminando por la playa a saludarnos desde Hard Rock Hotel y los invitamos a sentarse en las reposteras de la playa, pero en ese momento se acercó la gente del hotel y sin ningún criterio nos han montado un escándalo tremendo en frente de nuestros amigos, ojo, que perfectamente podían ser futuros pasajeros de este hotel, pidiéndoles que se retiren porque no pueden pisar las instalaciones del hotel...La verdad es que no se imaginan lo mal que nos han tratado, prácticamente como si ellos fuéran unos delincuentes!!!!! En frente de ellos nos trataban de explicar que es por ‘seguridad’ y que la alternativa era pagar US$150.-....realmente una verdadera verguenza!! Además llevamos 3 días reclamando por un ruido excesivo del aire acondicionado de la habitación que no nos deja ni dormir y todavía no tenemos una respuesta....definitivamente PARADISUS CANCUN un desastre...la peor decisión que hemos tomado fue contratar este hotel...para más colmo, al dar a conocer nuestras quejas a un supuesto ‘gerente’ nos dicen que son las políticas de la empresa!!! Osea con suerte una mano y que lastima lo que les tocó!!! Un verdadero chiste!! No volvemos nunca más!!!!!

reviews.author: Nilam
reviews.title: Worst ocean view with no view of the ocean...views of straw huts ONLY.
reviews.text: The staff was very rude and it took us 2 hours to check in. Then they Gabe’s us a room that has a obstructed view of only straw huts. The hugest guest manager did nothing for us And stole our money of pizza crab view

reviews.author: gitanjaliraghav
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!
reviews.text: Very poor room maintenance. Coffee machine in the room was not working, bathtub and washbasin were always clogged. During our stay, the last day AC in the room was also not working. It took the staff 8 hours to look into the matter. Finally at around 10 PM we were made to shift to other room which was not cleaned (dirt everywhere) & smelled like fresh paint . My 8 month old baby couldn't sleep all night due to the smell. I requested refund for my last day stay at the hotel and I haven't yet heard from the hotel manager. It was a complete waste of our time and money.

reviews.author: Melissa12340
reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text:
I came with 3 friends on a bachelorette stay at Paradisus. We were really excited to begin our adventure but at our check in the person at the front desk said that we needed to have the credit card which we had used (6 months ago) to pay our reservation with. Of course we didnt have this credit card since my friend’s fiance was the one who paid for her trip. 
The hotel said that it was hotel policy to show up with the exact credit card used 6 months ago and wouldnt let us do the check in even though it was paid for and we had other credit cards we could use for backup. 
In the end we had to give another credit card and the hotel charged the whole stay all over again! It is a really expensive hotel and they treat you like garbage; we asked them to show the terms and conditions where it stated that we had to give the exact credit card and they didnt have them. It was all a lie.
If a parent paid for their kids trip or you credit card was cancelled how can the hotel expect you to bring this exact credit card?

reviews.author: marianqdea
reviews.title: Me robaron plata de la caja fuerte
reviews.text:
Estoy en el hotel y el dia qhe llegue luego de instalarme y acomodar mis cosas me desapareció plata de la caja fuerte
Hice la denuncia correspondiente pero aun no me dieron ninguna solución, es para tener en cuenta y tomar cuidado con eso, me parece algo importante que el hotel resuelva!!!! Y que me devuelvan el dinero

reviews.author: Paola R
reviews.title: Decepcion
reviews.text: Regrese por segundo año consecutivo a este hotel. Buffet y restaurantes tematicos bajaron calidad y variedad. Servicio malo. Son incapaces de preparar una simple sopa dieta si te enfermas Pedi kate check out y a pesar de eso me anularon la llave y tuve q esperar una hora que abran mi habitacion. Pesimo, no merece cinco estrellas. No lo recomiendo. Servicios medicos malos y demasiado caros.

reviews.author: lillbit411
reviews.title: UNREASONABLE AND SHAMEFUL
reviews.text: My husband tried to do a nice thing and book this hotel for my 40th birthday as a surprise. Well, he booked it without realizing that our daughter had a medical procedure taking place on one of the days we would be away. I tried to call the hotel so that we could move the trip to the following weekend (NOTE: I DIDN'T WANT TO FLAT OUT CANCEL, I WANTED TO RE-BOOK FOR THE FOLLOWING WEEKEND!) and even provided the medical documents proving our dilemma. THIS HOTEL DENIED ME NUMEROUS TIMES. I CAN NOT BELIEVE THAT AN EXCEPTION CAN NOT BE MADE. It's just unethical. I don't care how gorgeous this hotel is or how many great reviews it has received. It is shameful that they aren't flexible. Even the airline is willing to change my flight! You may not care, Paradisus because in this messed up world it's all about the almighty dollar, but shame on you!

reviews.author: dbbritt2018
reviews.title: Spring Break w two 14 year olds
reviews.text: My first review ever.  We have stayed thruout the Caribbean and Mexico.  Currently staying in 3464 at Paradisus in Cancun.  This place is not as advertised.  Beach chairs are not available.  Beach or pool cabana beds are available at $180 USD per day.  Nothing for young teens to do.  No billiards, no x box, no pool games,etc. No available restaurant reservations!  Only buffet.  If you have stayed at other all inclusive resorts do not stay at this one.  You will be disappointed!! Less than 1 star!!

reviews.author: John G
reviews.title: Paradisus disappointment
reviews.text:
What a disappointing experience. First, we pull up to hotel and there eas absolutely no one to greet us or take luggage, but instead we get bombarded with people selling timeshare. 
Now it gets better......
We specifically paid full price for an upper floor suite and we get a standard room on ground floor. 
Things happen and I understand, but I don't appreciate being lied to.
After arguing with front desk they said they would give us what we paid for but they can't right now because they gave out room to someone else....and of course while I'm arguing here comes the timeshare people again. 
Dining staff lacking and very unattentive.
We visit Cancun every year and typically stay at Hard Rock but we thought it would be a good idea to mix it up this year, big mistake.
Nonetheless, we are still
 here and I will update as this worsens im sure.

reviews.author: Danny R
reviews.title: Stay away! Absolutely disgusting trust me!
reviews.text:
Where do I begin. We stayed at the paradisus playa del Carmen last yr and it was a truly amazing unlike this dump. I warn you this is nothing like that experience and I don’t understand why people give this place a 4 star rating. This place is sooo old and crusty. The start of the experience was supposed to be introductory but all they did was sell sell sell leaving us to try to find our room and the logistics of the hotel. 

The room: 

was above the market grille where all you heard was dishes clinging together all day long. Not the mention it was also above a night club in which all you heard was loud bass and people screaming until 3am. When we woke up the 1st day we realized they had given us blood stained sheets. After giving housekeeping a call they then brought us all new sheets with blood stained towels. (This is no joke) When we brought this up to a manager on staff she acted like it wasn’t a big deal and disregarded the fact that it was blood. 
Room service was unbelievable as they never would show up and when you call to ask about the order they would hang the phone up on you. After six phone calls it would finally come almost always wrong and missing something. The room is so dated you can tell it has seen its time. The electrical outlets/bathroom lights went out almost all the time along with our hot water (cold showers everyday)  The ac unit was so old it rattled all night. Although we actually didn’t mind the rattling as it took away a little from the night club action.

Food:
We were not able to get a reservation for dinner for the first two days because the place is so big. We ended up eating at the buffet the first day and from that point on we became deathly sick where it ruined our entire vacation. I have stayed at many all inclusive resorts in the past and I have to tell you I have never seen or tasted food anything like it in my life. 

For management you are some of the rudest people I ever seen and you could care less about your guest’s comfort. So please save your auto generated response as it is a lie. 

Please LISTEN and stay far away from this place!!! So many better places in Mexico. What a waste of a week of complete sickness. Can’t believe we paid for that nightmare. Literally felt like a ant in a ant farm and we tried to go home on day number 2 it was so bad. They shouldn’t even be allowed to carry the name “paradisus” as it is not even close to a Melia resort.

reviews.author: 335tracyt
reviews.title: Horrible place to stay!
reviews.text: So many reasons why to pick a different place to stay!  Poor food quality, poor service... our room flooded from a blocked drain on the deck... poor clean up and did not offer anything for our inconvenience  Gourmet coffee bar not open until noon!  What!?  Wanted to exchange $100 for $20's.. We were told "no".  The language barrier was so bad that even when they could speak English you good not understand what they were saying.  Will NEVER go back and NEVER recommend!

reviews.author: Fernando P
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: No es barato (400 dolares americanos a diario de matrimonio) y ofrecen una mínima cantidad de sombrilla, es decir, si quieres tener vista de la piscina o del mar con sombra tendrás que quedarte en una silla al abrasador sol o tendrás que despertar mucho temprano para coger la sombrilla (excepto el paquete de servicio real, mucho más caro). Además, el primer día tiene una "presentación", supuestamente del hotel, lo que es en realidad una venta de una asociación al club Meliá, de un costo mínimo de US$30.400 (treinta mil cuatrocientos dólares americanos), que es muy, muy malo(pesquise en la internet) y que le toma unas cinco horas de la mañana, o sea, usted pierde su mañana y aún toma el desayuno con el vendedor, quitando la privacidad de la familia. El resto de la estructura del hotel, la comida y bebida son buenos, pero la atención de Liz empleados es sólo razonable, ya que tarda mucho. En fin, no lo indico.

reviews.author: Alicia T
reviews.title: Could Careless About Their Customers
reviews.text: I received the worst customer service possible from this hotel. My flight leaving JFK was canceled and had to be rescheduled for another time due to weather conditions. As soon as I knew I would not be able to fly to Cancun, I contacted the hotel to explain the situation. I was told to contact them via email, which I did immediately. I also made sure to provide proof from the airline, that my flight was canceled. When I did not receive a response back from the hotel regarding canceling, or re-scheduling my booking, I called them the next day. Once again, they directed me to an email address that I should send my inquiry to. I went back and forth with hotel staff regarding re-scheduling my booking, and they came back with the solution for me to pay $800+ to book at a later date (mind you they already charged my credit card $432 for my booking). This did not seem fair or reasonable, so I also inquired about canceling my reservation, to which they flat out said no. My last email to them, asking them if there were any other options that they were willing to work out with me, has gone unanswered. This hotel claims to be 5 star, but it can barely provide proper customer service to be given any stars. Such as disappointment, as I was actually looking forward to staying here. Now I will never go near it, and I will tell anyone I know to stay away.

reviews.author: OK_Traveling2014
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.text:
Exceedingly poor hotel for the money.

I booked a lagoon view suite only to have a view of a wall. The light switches are cracked and broken, there is only one working power point, the floor is dirty, the safe in the room was locked when I arrived, etc. 

Additionally, the staff couldn’t seem to care less about issues. When I went to check in, they insisted my company had not paid for the room despite my having a confirmation number. They said they would take an imprint of my credit card but wouldn’t charge it until we could sort it out in the morning. They of course charged it immediately.

Additionally, when I went back with the booking confirmation form showing the credit card imprint from the travel agent, they insisted on seeing the bank statement to confirm the payment had gone through. 

My EA emailed them 4 times without response, and I have been to reception 6 times now without resolution.

reviews.author: Lilia S
reviews.title: Grimes old Rooms with cockroaches!
reviews.text:
AVOID THIS HOTEL!  

I’m just going to leave these photos for you to enjoy and judge for your self - would you pay $$$ to stay at a place like this? 

This is Room 3210 by the way,if the hotel management wants to reach out to me.

reviews.author: elar9
reviews.title: Ripped off
reviews.text:
My number one issue was that my mom came down with a bad cold, she went to the hotel  doctor, which we've have has to do in the past, the bill was $600! They had told her it would be apx. $140 for the consultation and medication and ended up gouging her at the end! 
Aside from that terrible experience,  the food was just not good at all! & you have to call every morning for dinner reservations. So annoying! The drinks at the beach and pool are horrible! The juices are disgusting. Ended just drinking water the whole time with an occasional beer. Loud blaring music ever morning by 9am. But the view and beach are incredibly beautiful

reviews.author: P_1015
reviews.title: Badly managed, poor facilities and terrible food.
reviews.text:
This is a massive hotel but the amenities and facilities don’t match up to the number of people it hosts. We were hoping for a relaxed stay but we found ourselves constantly fighting for space - at the breakfast buffet where there were no seats available to accommodate even half the population of the hotel, same story for other restaurant reservations and even in the swimming pools and pool beds which are woefully insufficient for the number of people in the hotel. 

The restaurant reservation system is very badly managed - bookings have to be made over a day in advance, else you’ll pay an all-inclusive price and end up eating the buffet daily. We had to literally fight for a dinner table because the entire restaurant was empty and yet the concierge kept insisting that all tables are reserved. The tables stayed empty for most of our stay. The reservation system is a complete mess. We asked for some drinks to the room and were told that to drink, you have to go to the bar. Very stressful and not the least bit relaxing if one has to fight for food in an all-inclusive resort. When we finally did get a reservation, the things we wanted to order on the menu were not available or had sold out, and the rest of the food was terrible.  We left our meal and walked out halfway through it. 

We were trying to have a relaxed nap but a concert in the lobby made that impossible too - very loud music and extremely noisy so we couldn’t sleep during the day either. Room cleaning was average and on one of the days, there were no fresh towels in the room. 

You have to pretty much pay extra for everything - cabanas at the beach/pool, late check out etc. Again, all-inclusive in name only. While requesting a late check out, we were told that the charge would be $10 per person. What they didn’t tell us was that this was an hourly rate and then hit us with a $40 bill for two hours. Absolutely ridiculous. 

It’s better to stay in a bed and breakfast because that’s what this hotel is. 
We have been to several all-inclusive places, and this has been the worst experience for us so far - noisy, crowded, poor amenities, bad food and badly managed. Wonder what all-inclusive means If you can’t even get a table for dinner at restaurants that are empty anyway or space in the pools. 

At every point during our stay, we felt that we were being fleeced. We felt very unwelcome and we certainly will not be coming back. 

Totally avoid!

reviews.author: Yolanda D
reviews.title: Worse hotel ever!! A motel looks cleaner!
reviews.text: So first of all I am mexican and I’ve been in Cancun plenty of times so you can trust my advice when it comes to hotels, so I did my reservation 2 months ago and asked for 1 bed! I got here and they give me a room with 2 beds and asked Arturo Prieto who was the one to inform me that they cannot guarantee rooms with 1 bed or 2 beds that they only give you whatever is available (so whats the point of doing a reservation with so many information!).. I paid around 600 dls per night since I had an ocean view and I did not pay that amount of money for “whatever they have available at the moment” then he tells me that maybe they can change my room the next day but he tells me that I have to go to the reception and confirm! Seriously??!! So I ask him if I have to sign something! And he said no you just need to confirm it here... So what he means is that he just wants me to spend my time and go downstairs and remind them to do their job!! Ok and thats not it.. here are some pictures of the room.. I think a motel looks cleaner!! Good thing I’m only staying 3 days! I’m seriously grossed out! I think the westin is a little bit more expensive but so much cleaner and prettier and smaller than this huge cruise hotel!

reviews.author: Avideh S
reviews.title: Charged us TWICE for 7 nights stay and did not give our money back!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 7 nights through Christmas and New Years this year (2017), we were content and comfortable for the most part expect for the mediocre food and TERRIBLE service we received at the front desk on our last day during checkout!! The front desk staff charged our credit card twice for our stay and has yet to reimburse us the money!!
We had originally pre-paid a few weeks earlier for the full amount via Melia Reservations. At checkout on our last day, they claimed that no payment has been made and they demanded us to pay again and would not let us leave the hotel until we do so! We kept telling them that we had already made the full payments a few weeks prior and showed them the email confirmation, but they kept saying no payment was processed and they do not have it on record. They demanded that we must pay (AGAIN) until we could leave the hotel. At this point, we were running late for our flight as they kept us at the checkout desk for over 40 minutes going back and forth. We finally gave them our credit card to process the payment thinking that maybe they were telling the truth and we had to leave or we would miss our flight.
After we were on our way and checked our credit card transactions, we saw that they DID infact charge us TWICE! We then phoned the hotel back within 10 minutes of leaving, asking for a refund and they kept saying to send an email to the supervisor, or that they didn’t understand English, or kept making excuses to not reimburse us our money. We emailed the reservations and have YET to hear back from them so we were forced to call our credit card company to have them get involved!! We still HAVE NOT gotten our money back!! Be very careful when you are paying as they will make you pay twice and when you do ask for a refund for THEIR mistake, they are unresponsive!!!

reviews.author: jstaub7676
reviews.title: Dinero tirado
reviews.text:
Durante mi estancia en diciembre, con la familia, a todos nos parecio dinero tirado.
Inexistente Family Concierge, olor a humedad, zonas comunes mal cuidadas y sucias.
Sin posibilidad de reservar en restaurantes...etc, etc

reviews.author: jtst95
reviews.title: Winter break vacation - never again in this place
reviews.text:
After reading all reviews and visiting Paradisus in Playa de Carmen, we were very excited to come to Paradisus Cancun. And we were disappointed on the first day.
But lets do it in order
Pros:
-	Resort is in the middle of resort area in Cancun – 25 min drive from airport.
-	Resort itself is very pretty and large, was nicely decorated for Xmas
-	We stayed in pyramid 3 (center one) on 7th floor, facing ocean – view was spectacular
-	Beach – probably should start with that – is breathtaking – sand, water, palm leaves umbrellas with lounge chair – this was the best part of whole vacation. New definition of happiness is when you are in the ocean up to you shoulders and can see your toes.
-	Have to give credit to Market Grill restaurant – the only decent place in the resort – food was OK and staff was professional.
Well, this is it
Cons:
-	Rooms are very old and need Major renovation, some furniture is broken (please see pics).
-	Food is blunt, there is no variety, no decent selection (did not see hard boiled eggs, for example), not even fruit carving decoration.
-	Tables for dinner were not set even with tablecloth, same old place mats from breakfast.
-	Service in restaurants is slow and not up to standards, and I mean SLOW. We were not in a hurry, but with 2 hungry teenagers it was difficult to wait for 2 hours. 
-	Bana restaurant – was the worst – waiter forgot about our teenagers and their food and they just got up and went to buffet.
-	Small cafeteria with espresso opens at 11:30. Yes, not 7am, not 9am, but 11:30 – outrageous
-	Resort did not have a ping pong table, there is tennis court, but rackets were very old and at some point they were out of balls.
-	Overall waiters are not professional and looked like did not care what so ever.
-	Waiters by the pool and beach were better but could disappear for hours and people would just help themselves by the bar. Not a bad thing – to move around – but it is not what you expect from 5-stars resort.
-	Bali beds were only for reservations (USD 50/day)– and of course they were almost all unoccupied. Not a smart way to do business.
-	Nightly shows…….what can I say ……..there is no stage, so people sat on stairs and performance was done on a small concrete space on the way to the beach
I can go on and on. It was an experience, we still had a very good time, but I will never ever go to this resort again

reviews.author: 657narinei
reviews.title: Horrible experience, it looks fancy yet its so cheap and low quality with an awful service
reviews.text: I wish i could mention what was satisfying about our stay! As every experience i had at your facility was nothing but a nightmare. I chose this hotel based on my past experience with Melia as i stayed at Me couple of years ago. We paid a lot to be simply eating frozen chicken wings and guacamole all day since those were the only edible things after a horrible experience at your restaurants, buffet and room service. The food only looks like a food no taste, no flavor and 0 quality. We stayed at Royal Paradisus yet not only the room was not royal nor was the service. Our butler Giraldo was incompetent and could not even reserve our pool side beds that we were promised we would get for 2 days. What was astonishing was the level of poor service and poor quality food at every single facility let alone the quality of your alcoholic beverages. What a waste of $$$! If you are reading this, i would like to escalate this issue to the management in the hopes that you would compensate me for such terrible experience!

reviews.author: louisu499
reviews.title: Dont stay here
reviews.text: We had family concierge and our bulter was horrible. Not so kid friendly as it should be. Kids pool was freezing. Kids zone was disgustingly dirty. Spa is over priced. Our room was not kid friendly. We had to ask the front desk to take our garbage out after asking our bulter for three days. We requested a king size bed and was put into a full size bed.  Overall was a horrible stay not worth the money. It was my wifes birthday i asked our butler if we can do something he said he will decorate the room, that never happened.
