When I received the email it had charged me an additional $684 for my 12 year old. I called back the agent and she told me she could not see that promotion on the screen. I took photos from my screen and emailed them to her. When she called back She said that the dates I was booking were not included in that promotion. I said there was no disclaimer on the pronation We went back and forth and then she said well you booked a rate that could cancel so just cancel. I wrote to their customer care department and the response said that the dates I was going to book were not included.
So why is the promotion on the website and once I put my dates in are still flashing free kids and 1500 resort credits if booked through Melia. We went to Cancun and stayed elsewhere.  We took that rude agent's advice and canceled.  Beware and review your confirmation if you are booking with Melis.

reviews.author: serenachow
reviews.title: Getting worse every day
reviews.text:
1) Checking in was terrible, priority line is much slower than not priority lines  even there were only 2 groups in front of me. It was an hour waiting 
2) while checking in, I was asked to pay even I have the receipt. They went in the system and said I haven't pay. So I gave them my credit card and let them charge on it. Soon enough I checked my credit card on my phone and the transaction went through 2 weeks ago. I had to wait another 30 minutes to get the payment return. 
3) finally got my room key card and nothing else.  No one told us which way to go, where to eat, what time the restaurants open, password for wifi, who to call for dinner reservations Nothing at all
4) went to Fuego for dinner, took forever to get something to eat. Bring the desert was a joke, my kid literally took a nap about 20 minutes  to wait the desert.

5) room card didn't work! I went down to front desk and they "fixed" it. Of course it didnt work, went down 2nd time to have a new card key
6) market grill burger is very good but again took too long to get 

7) no hand towels after the housekeeping cleaned the room, also we need some dry towels too. We called  room service 3 hours ago, and now I am still in this room waiting for a dry towel 

This is our 2nd day here and it is Xmas eve,   What a terrible experience , especially during this time of year. There are something actually good: coffee shop, beach, kids club and the weather .

reviews.author: 884gabrielao
reviews.title: muy viejo y sucio
reviews.text: el personal en general es muy amable, pero la verdad para estar catalogado como un hotel 5 estrellas 4 diamantes le falta mucho mantenimiento y aseo. no me volvería a hospedar ahí, se ve que no le quieren invertir dinero al hotel que pena, antes era tan bonito.

reviews.author: Emilio G
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful. We came here last year and fell in love with the resort and the service. This year we decided to come back for more. First of all, our whole complaint had to do with the cleaning people, the people who service the rooms and the operator in charge of pyramid one. They weren't restocking our refrigerators and when we asked for beer they limit us to four beers per day when it's supposed to be all you can drink. Then everyday the cleaning people would sabotage something in our room. From shutting off all the power breakers in the room one day to the entrance cards to the room not working the next. When confronted they got defensive and started lying to our face about the situation. The bottom line is we will take our business elsewhere next year. We will tell all our friends and family not to book with Paradisus.

reviews.author: Boniouk
reviews.title: Noise noise and more noise
reviews.text: Building work in pyramid 4 meant a very unrelaxing week. Every morning from 6am through to around 11pm. Banging and hammering. Reported 7 times in the week and nobody cared, or they agreed and said it has to be done, or from their office 200 yards the other way said they couldn't hear it so it wasn't happening.

reviews.author: billgreene14
reviews.title: Aweful.
reviews.text: The food was all inclusive, but we ended up having to spend more of our money on local food because the food at the Paradisus was so awful. Soggy, unflavored, raw, we even had bone in our chicken quesadillas one night at the resort. This was a aweful expirence. The hotel had all kinds of different smells just walking down the hall. And not the good smells either. I wish I had just saved my money and stayed home. Once in a life time trip for me, will not be forgotten because of the pleasurable expirences we had. Thanks for waisting my money and my once in a life time expirence, Paradisus

reviews.author: Dollyd321
reviews.title: Stairs everywhere! Dimly lit. Very dangerous! Constant pumping of insence everywhere and no washrooms easily found!
reviews.text: Pools are too deep for children.  Not family friendly.  Too many stairs to beach. Two full flights! Biggest problem is lighting. So dark. Very scary. There will surely be accidents from anyone falling!  Beds in lounges rather than chairs. Again not comfortable! Do you want to lie down with strangers? That's the bottom line.

reviews.author: sergiocL8939AY
reviews.title: MUY MAL SERVICIO DE SEGURIDAD Y  ME HOSPEDARON EN UNA TORRE EN REPARACION
reviews.text: Me hospedaron en la Torre 5, en construcción, imposible descansar, los obreros llegan a trabajar desde las ocho de la mañana. Pero el precio que cobran es de habitaciones de lujo en Hotel 5 Estrellas.   agradezco tengan en cuenta mi Opinión.

reviews.author: Cesar Benavente Leigh
reviews.title: Una estadía poco agradable
reviews.text:
Desde que llegamos tuvimos problemas, la atención del personal deja mucho que desear, el EL CAPITAN DEL BUFFET (alto, blanco, cabello ralo, ojos claros) muy, muy malcriado . 
El último día nos impidieron ingresar a almorzar, a pesar de tener el VB de recepción, lástima de un hotel que dicen ser de 5*. 
El concepto del hotel de poca iluminación es totamnete perjudicial ya que dos de nuestras amigas se cayeron al ir al Restaurante Enso, puesto que hay gradas y todo oscuro.
No tienen un teatro adecuado para los espectáculos, generando incomodidad a los huéspedes, al hacerlo en un lugar improvisado y son poco los afortunados que pueden ver (pesimo concepto).
Nos cambiaron las cenas reservadas sin avisar previamente, generando malestar y tener que ir al Bufet nuevamente.
La buena estadía la hicieron mis amigos, pero no recomiendo este hotel, otros se quejaron del olor a humedad de sus habitaciones y la poca disposición de los mosos, malcriados.

reviews.author: Ira E
reviews.title: Рыба гниет с головы
reviews.text:
Отдыхали с семьей в этом отеле в сентябре 2016 года. Хороших отелей на этом побережье немало, однако выбор пал на Paradisus, так как он является частью известной сети Melia, в чьих отелях мы бывали и осталось положительное впечатление. Никак не ожидали, что Paradisus настолько не оправдает надежд. Обычно мы "угадываем" с отелями. Начнем с прибытия и заселения в номер. Скажу сразу, муж взял опцию "фэмили консьерж", что предполагает лучшие комнаты, более высокий уровень сервиса и еще некоторое кол-во ништяков, недоступных "простым смертным":) Доплата, кстати, за эту чудо-опцию была не маленькая:) Но, вернемся к заселению. Приехали мы вечером, во время ужина,  и рассчитывали сразу покушать и пойти спать в номер. Следует отметить, с нами был грудной семимесячный  и 6-летний ребенок. Женщина на вип-ресепшене нам все оформила, выдала ключи и карточки, нас повели к номеру. Когда нас туда привели, оказалось, что номер на 1-ом этаже, а это было абсолютно неприемлемо для нас. К тому же он был рядом с основным рестораном, откуда хорошо слышно шум и громкую музыку. Вернувшись на ресепшн мы стали разбираться, однако там нам было сказано, что комнат других нет и нужно ждать два дня (приехали мы под выходные). Мы стояли на своем, но воз был и ныне там. Более того, проблема не решалась и ладно, но администрация (женщина и еще пару человек) даже не пытались быть с нами "kindly", "friednly" и "понимающими"!!! Наоборот, предлагали заселиться вообще в другой отель!! Вроде вам не нравится, вот и валите...Мы много путешествуем и, честно говоря, столкнулись с таким отношением впервые. В общем, закончилось все тем, что проторчав на вип-ресепшене после перелета с детьми целый час, мы, понурив головы, потопали в этот несчастный номер на первом этаже. С оговоркой, что переедем оттуда, как только появятся свободные комнаты. Через пару дней мы переехали, не много лучше, но все же хоть не в такую шумную комнату. Однако, на этом наши "злоключения" в этом чудесном отеле не закончились:) Стоит сразу отметить, что в отеле все требует ремонта, еда в ресторанах похожа на питание в столовой. Ничего против столовых не имею, но раз заявляете себя рестораном, будьте добры готовить ресторанную пищу. Возвращаясь к ремонту:) В одну из ночей я услышала дикий грохот из соседней комнаты (у нас были коннектед румс), войдя в комнату где спал муж (мы с детьми в другой спали), сначала не могла понять, что случилось, а потом под ногами увидела картину!! Огромную!! Она рухнула со стены с ужасным грохотом посреди ночи!! Все конечно проснулись и перепугались:)) Такая вот история:) Далее про фэмили консьерж, дали нам при заселении специальный телефончик, по которому якобы можно вызывать нашего помощника и он решит все проблемы...стоит ли говорить, что за весь отпуск трубку никто ни разу не снял:)) в итоге телефоном этим мы и не пользовались и для себя отметили, что фэмили-консьерж в этом отеле - пустая трата денег. И это еще не все, к сожалению...Было много разных неприятных моментов, которые мягко говоря не делали отдых приятным. Нет, мы отлично отдохнули, вопреки этому ужасному отелю:)) Но больше туда ни ногой! Позиционировать себя как пятизвездочный, а по итогу три звезды - это смешно и грустно. Испортили положительное впечатление о сети Melia и в принципе о Мексике...Хотя океан очень красивый и пляж, должна признать, был одним из лучших, на котором мне приходилось бывать. Вот пляж и спас наш отдых:))) Отелю, менеджменту и всей администрации хочется пожелать профессионализма (отправьте на обучение что-ли?!) и добросовестности в работе...а также огромного ремонта!!!:)))) в номере все держалось на соплях, уж простите! 

С уважением, 
Очень недовольный клиент

reviews.author: Bjetttttt
reviews.title: Disappointing - and this is our FOURTH trip to this resort!
reviews.text:
Let me /begin with CHECK-IN.  Arrived at noon.. our room was not ready until 3  - fine, but arrived at 3:30 - was given keys to a room with NO AIR CONDITIONING!  We were tired from the flight, and it would have been considerate when checking in for the front desk to let us know that the A/C was out throughout the entire property until approx 8pm!!  We would have left the resort and went to somewhere else with A/C if we had known!   What did they do?  "don't worry we will compensate you'.. So they gave us keys to another room in tower 1 - long walk to the other side of the property - to the same type room but still with NO A/C!  Then offered another room (same as our ocean view) - which was the SAME - NO A/C.  The blower was even broken in this room - so no air flow at all.  The supervisor Veronica came to the room and told us the blower was working.  She didn't believe me until I stood on a chair and showed her what we meant.   Seriously?  She was the one who said we would be 'compensated', -- why in the world would you not accommodate a guest who had to stand on a chair to prove the blower was not working?  Why would you not compensate a guest who you knowingly handed keys to a HOT room that would remain HOT for 5 more hours??  All she could say was that this was the best they could do and the manager was in the next day.   We expected to hear something from the manager, but never a word-- and this is day 6!

So we stayed in the room we had our luggage in - and did not have a cool room until 9pm.   Compensation?  No - nothing.  They called to see if our a/c was working later that night, that's it. 

I noted we have been to this resort 4x in past two years and loved it.  This time is different.  We wonder if the management has changed because things were NOT the same and we were just here in February on our honeymoon!  This trip was an anniversary of my husband proposing to me last September, so it is sentimental to both of us - and we had planned on returning every year to celebrate.  Now we are thinking about looking elsewhere.  We spend a LOT of money when we come here and we have other choices, but we chose Paradisus to stay. 

Bana:  The food was subpar.  That is the restaurant where he proposed to me, so it was kind of special to return there, but we were not happy.  The food was sooo much better in February and the other two times we visited!!!  

I wrote a review on day 2 here at Tripadvisor and it told me it was 'under review' and I have not seen it posted.. so let me recap our 7 day trip. 

Today is day 6 of our stay and in addition to the lack of caring on check-in problems with no a/c -- here are other things that happened. 
1.  Had to call for soda and ice delivery 3x each time we made a request. 
2. Had to call for toilet paper -- did not receive it until late afternoon when they made up the room. 
3. Room keys.. during this stay - had to have the keys re-keyed 3x .. so far. 
4. The room mattress was completely broken down -- my husband's back is bad and on day 2 - had to have this replaced.  That did happen.. but took a couple of hours. 
5.  Pictures.  Oh the pictures.  We ALWAYS commemorate our trip with pictures taken by Outdoor photography, an company on-site.  We have been so pleased always with these photos, until, of course, this time.  I do NOT recommend the photographer we had Enrique -- as the photos turned out terrible.  He didn't seem to know the basic fundamentals of being a photographer.  Which is really truly sad because the water was amazing and the day was perfect for photos.  We were excited to see the 50+ shots until we viewed them.  Oh my gosh.. only two were acceptable which we reluctantly purchased. 

It is ridiculous to book a trip like this 6 months in advance in anticipation of greatness that you had the other 3 trips before and then have these things happen.  We feel like it really doesn't matter that we are patrons who keep coming here and recommend this place to EVERYONE we know!  The lack of response from management speaks loud and clear that we do not matter to them. 

I had seen on facebook that a lady wrote a review for Paradisus and said that she was complimentary upgraded to Royal Service for FREE upon checking in as well as other people in the lobby.   I wrote a letter to Paradisus last month, not asking for Royal Service, but an upgrade to a bigger room.  They wrote back and said no- but for $75/night I could have royal service lagoon view.  We do NOT like lagoon view as we always pay extra for the ocean view.   I thought being 4x patrons, asking for a bigger room was not really asking for much, but apparently it was.  I wanted to surprise my husband, but was not able to.  We spent $2800 to visit Paradissus -- spent over $600 in tips/gifts throughout the week.  Spent a lot of money shopping in Cancun.  All of this -- for a week.. to have a less than acceptable visit.  

 If the management of this establishment cares about their repeat patrons, they should really fix all of this!  That will determine whether we ever visit Paradisus Cancun EVER again.   We were actually going to plan a family trip next year for us and our 3 daughters; however, seeing the cost that would be involved, we want the trip to be memorable for our kids -- soooo glad we did not bring them this time!  We always RAVE about this resort and if they came with us during this stay - we would have looked like liars to them.

reviews.author: adrianv300
reviews.title: Pésima experiencia
reviews.text: Planeamos con tiempo estas vacaciones, y al llegar nos dieron una habitación y al entrar estaba ocupada por otras personas justo cuando se estaban cambiando, me hicieron pasar una vergüenza, aparte de la vergüenza de las personas que estaban en el cuarto, posteriormente me dieron otra habitación que no era, me dieron una para discapacitados, finalmente me cambiaron el brazalete y me dieron uno con derecho a entrar a otras áreas del hotel y al llegar a la 3ra habitación o sorpresa, después de haber confirmado que era de una cama King Size me volvieron a dar una de dos camas, definitivamente ya me canse, desespere y demás, y tendré que quedarme aquí, la verdad muy mala experiencia.

reviews.author: Diana D
reviews.title: Terrible Experience!
reviews.text: My family and I ran into multiple issues with room 3501. We had to go to the concierge at least 1-2 times a day (we stayed 5 nights) to get our room cards re-keyed. They said it was because we held it close to our phones and tech devices. That was proven not to be true. They key would work as soon as they were re-keyed but within 1-2 hours of sitting at table near NO tech devices, it would not read. The concierge was aware and had sent someone to check but it continued to be an issue throughout our trip. (This was very annoying having to visit the concierge twice a day.) The last night we were here, a terrible accident happened where the restroom mirror in our room fell over on my dad. Luckily he caught it and held it so it wouldn't fall on his feet. There were shattered glass everywhere! I dialed "0" the concierge and explained the situation, and stressed that someone needs to go to our room immediately as my dad was still holding the glass mirror! I called twice and waited in the hallway for just anyone to come by and saw no one. I was getting anxious and scared since I didn't know if my dad was hurt or cut in anyway, so I went down 4 floors to the concierge. I was very upset then, since no one still had come up and it took faster for me to go to them then to us. I had to explain how serious this situation was so the girl at the front called someone to make sure someone came by. This could have been fatal if my dad had not caught the mirror. This is very disappointing coming from a 4.5 star hotel. There was no sense of urgency! All in all, the way the hotel handled the situation ruined my perception of the Paradisus Hotel.

reviews.author: Andrew Bloch
reviews.title: Don't be fooled by the nice photos on the website!
reviews.text:
The website looks lovely.  When you walk in, the reception is pretty cool.  A bit dark, but nice and modern and a lively atmosphere.  From there on in, that's where the positives end.  I checked in with my family for what was due to be a one week stay.  I'd stayed at lots of Melia hotels in Spain and they have always been great.  This one, however, was nothing short of a disgrace.

The check in process took over an hour - two different receptions, numerous forms to fill out, wrist bands, voucher books, a phone to reach your butler...it went on and on, to the point where I had lost the will to live.

 Eventually, we got to the room - a family suite, and apparently the best room in the hotel.  What a dump.  Old fashioned, basic, dirty, no storage, a balcony with high concrete walls you couldn't see over.  The photos on their website must have been twenty years old. It was like looking at a different hotel (it wasn't...I double-checked!)

By this point, we were tired and hungry, so we left the bags in the room without unpacking and went downstairs to get something to eat.  The buffet was a health hazard.  Food and mess everywhere.  No one to show you to your table, no waiters.  The food was inedible. It was like being in a prison canteen. 

With that, I had seen all I needed to see.  After spending literally a couple of hours at the hotel (mainly at the check-in desk!) we told the reception we would like to check out.  He implied that he wasn't surprised and he would arrange a full refund via our travel agent the next day (we paid in advance).  We left and booked into a different hotel.

Needless to say, no one contacted our travel agent, and nearly three weeks later and after numerous unanswered  phone calls and emails, we are still trying to get our money back.  

A very disappointing experience.  

There are lots of nice hotels in Cancun.  The Paradisus isn't one of them.

reviews.author: Karlene A
reviews.title: Terrible - from check in to check out!
reviews.text:
Made requests before arriving at the hotel and none of it was registered, at check in the staff seemed clueless. Not a place for teenage kids, my two kids were absolutely bored. The bar service at Avenue bar was horrible, the night time activities were sorely lacking. The menu at the buffet was repetitive, some days the restaurant was dirty. I requested a wheelchair for my son and was never told I had to pay a daily rental for this service. Had to pay additional for the beds both beach and poolside, not a true all-inclusive experience! I stayed 5 nights and enjoyed none of it! 

When we couldn't take the boredom at the resort and decided to rent a car and go out to the cenotes, on arriving back to the boulevard, we were pulled over by the police and asked to pay, "off the records" for speeding. The officers told us the fine is USD300 and if we paid USD150 we did not have to go to the police station. We later found out that the fine for speeding is USD80 bucks.

Cancun is a beautiful place, outside the resort the Mexicans are great people.

reviews.author: Grisel M
reviews.title: DO NOT TRUST AT ALL THIS REVIEWS, YOU BEEN ADVICE.
reviews.text: Let me start by i made the reservatio beliving on the reviews when i book this hotels food in the hotel buffet is horrible,hotel is very tired,so as the rooms ,the hotels is a quarter of a mile from the main road so you have to walk from the main road everyday if you do excursions or go outsite the hotel,after that walk,be ready for 60 steps(my family call it the chichen itza) every single day 60 steps ,there is no golf car for the guess to provide that service,we went with my parents 75 and 71 year old with a mild disability and a 7 year old child that after been out the whole day that child was exhausted,the golf car is only available in the morning to "sell you" a vacation plan .       the pool was horrible, if you check the bar by the pool is falling apart and has mold really discusting .the front of the hotel is nicely painted "the back" hasen't been paint in years .only went to the pool one .the beaches in cancun are "not good"actually it can be dangerous, a lot of waves and very very deep .the specialties restaurants are ok,you have to make reservations at 7:00 am the night before bc it gets pack very quickly. PARADISUS CANCUN  the scents in the lobby give you a head acheT NEVER NEVER AGAIN.

reviews.author: Fletcher3233
reviews.title: Horrible Experience!!
reviews.text:
Let me first off start with Ive honestly never written any kind of negative survey in any sort including yelp etc. 
My son and I arrive late Sunday night and they did not have my reservation. I explained to the front desk manager I did not bring my confirmation since all the correspondence was through my work email etc and I did not bring my work phone or laptop. However I was able to look up my billing statement through my credit card and calling my credit card company of the charge to the hotel. Didn't matter! The manager stated that it didn't matter because in their system they did not have any reservation under my name.  At one point he basically stated that there was no possible way they made the mistake and sincerely became down ride rude. Because it was Sunday they night they said their reservation offices were closed and they could not verify till the morning. I ended up having to pay $380 for Sunday night on a separate credit card. I talked first thing to the reservations office on Monday and they greatly apologized for the mistake and they would refund the $380 and everything was taken care of. Since I'm running out of space I wish I could continue about the rest of the week and horrible service as well its now been over 2 months and Ive never received the refund of $380 and had to report the issue to the credit card company. There are tons of beautiful hotels and resorts in Cancun and I would kindly plea for you to stay anywhere else!!

reviews.author: Ktwa2
reviews.title: false advertisement horrible customer service
reviews.text:
Our family booked our trip because this was our 15th wedding anniversary and my husband and I were going to renew our vows.  Trip was booked over a year via a travel agent.  We booked an 8day/7night family concierge ocean view room because the hotel offered a Wish Package for weddings and such.  We had a very hard time getting our vow renewal finalized because people wouldn't return our emails and were sending us peoples personal information about a wedding in February to our email.  After trying to work with each dept that we had to after getting a manager involved.  During our stay at the hotel our "butler" Fernanda and the rest of the butler staff were horrible.  We were supposed to get certain things in our room for the family concierge services and we didn't.  Kids size items ex bath soaps, bath robes, kid size pillows, kids welcome bag with sand toys, nightly milk and cookies, parents pillow menu.  
Well needless to say the kids size bath soaps are baby soap baby lotion and baby shampoo not for a 10yr old.  Kids welcome bag we had to ask for since our daughters were excited and looking for it when we walked in the room.  They got a Barbie tooth brush and tooth paste and a toddler size tee shirt.  (Our youngest child is 10)
Milk and cookies yeah that happened 2 nights only.  Pillows for kids never saw them at all kids bathrobe had 1st day and house keeping took it and never got it back.  parents pillow menu when we asked about it no one knew what it was.  Dinner reservations were a joke as well.  Had to beg for a restaurant for 6 even though we should get a confirmed reservation according to the concierge info.  They put us in a restaurant that both my dad and husband had allergies to the food and gave us a hard time to get reservations at a different location.  
Wedding coordinator was supposed to meet with us and confirm all the details for the renewal.  Melina sent an email to me confirming to meet us at 3:00pm to go over details for our renewal.  Well she NEVER showed up no one knew where she was nor could they find her. After 2 attempts we meet with someone else whom had not a clue about our renewal and offered little input as to what we would be doing.  Spoke with the manager of Concierge because of us not being able to get the coordinator and the fact that we still didn't have confirmation on restaurant changes. She was rude and said I will confirm them.  Next day our Butler told us she couldn't get the dinner locations we requested there was no availability. (even though the manger the day prior said she will get them).  Her answer was No Ma'am there are no tables available at Market Grill for your family tonight.  I later got a call from the manager scolding me like I was 2yrs old telling me I told you I confirmed the table you have a reservation. I tried to explain what Fernanda had told us and her response was I don't care I told you this yesterday and you shouldn't have asked the butler about it.  When I told her that Fernanda came to me about it she said I don't care.  After having an issue after issue at the hotel we asked to speak with the hotel manager.  The concierge manager came to us (same lady that we had been speaking to) we were trying to explain what was going on.  When we were speaking our 10yr old had started to say something and the manager stops her and said Im speaking to your mother not you as she grabbed her arm and squeezed it.  At that point I told her she was out of line and don't ever speak to my child in that manner and DONT ever place a finger on her.  I went and spoke with the Hotel Manager at that point. He apologized for everything and told me he would get to the bottom of the issue and help us make our stay (which was just one day) nice.  He would do something special for our family especially our kids.  He agreed with us that the kids amenities are geared towards babies and toddlers that his 11yr old son makes the same comments about the baby style things he gets when he stays there.  He asked that I forward him some of the emails and he would be in touch with me.  I forwarded him an email that evening after our vow renewal because once again things weren't done.  As part of the wish package you get special things one was a bottle of wine the night of the ceremony.  When we went to open the bottle we couldn't cause the cork was one that needed an opener nothing was provided called down to room service and the concierge office and we were told someone would be right up no one came.  Our license and our sand we did during the ceremony was to come to our room that night.  Nope had to fight with them the next day as we are packing to leave.  We got the items with in 15 mins before we were to leave the room.  After all this we were to get our refund to our card for the vow renewal it is a deposit and refund with in 2 weeks home 3 weeks and refund is still not received.  The special stuff the manager said he would do for the kids resulted in absolutely NOTHING.  I would not at all recommend this hotel for the family concierge services.  It is a scam and falsely advertised to us.  The details I have written here are just some of the problems.  Will add this note BE CAUTIONS WHEN WALKING INTO THE POOL  THE TILE IS VERY SLIPPERY AND I ALONG WITH MULTIPLE GUEST FELL GETTING INTO THE POOL.

reviews.author: Manuel O
reviews.title: Pesimo
reviews.text:
Desde que llegas tienes que esperar aunque en recepción no estén haciendo algo. Los meseros te hostigan para venderte champan y si no das una buena propina no los vuelves a ver. Nunca hay lugar para reservar cena. Todos los días te llaman para que vayas a un desayuno y forzarte a entrar en su Club Melia. Todo es mas caro que en cualquier otro o
Hotel de la misma categoría. No lo recomiendo y nunca regresaría.

reviews.author: Sabina D
reviews.title: Não vale a pena sob nenhum ponto de vista
reviews.text: O chek in é demorado. As camas não foram trocadas nenhuma vez nos 10 dias que ficamos lá. O hotel é barulhento durante todo o dia, a música é alta embora não seja ruim. As camas não eram confortáveis. Reclamamos, sem sucesso, do barulho do ar condicionado.

reviews.author: MarinaOrtiz
reviews.title: Lua de Mel - Com algumas decepções
reviews.text:
Nosso problema começou no check in, infelizmente. 
Somos "socios" e fomos direcionados para a pirâmide 1, chegando lá além de não termos sido muito bem recepcionados fomos descobrir que faltaram inúmeras informações. 

O Meliã têm um serviço chamado Servicio Real, na maioria dos hotéis este serviço é incluso para nós, a atendente cometeu um grande erro ao sinalizar as áreas e restaurantes que poderíamos ir. 
Nosso primeiro café da manhã foi péssimo, fomos até um restaurante que segundo a atendente do check in podíamos ir e passamos a maior vergonha, tivemos que levantar e sair. Sim, por um erro dela fomos convidados a nos retirar.

Fomos tirar satisfação na recepção sobre o ocorrido, a atendente apenas não tinha nos passado uma informação importantíssima, não estavamos no servicio real (informação bem contraditória aos restantes que ela havia marcado) 

Ok, e agora?! Como podemos resolver?! 
A primeira informação é que temos que pagar uma taxa extra pelo serviço (que na maioria da vezes já está incluído para nós) 
Ficamos bem indignados com a situação. Deu a entender que eles omitiram a informação pois o hotel está cheio... E aí no dia seguinte dada a nossa insatisfação surge essa solução. 
Porquê não deram à opção no check in? 

O hotel está precisando de muita manutenção, teve um vazamento no corredor e ficou com muita água por uns 2 dias. 

Os funcionários do Club Meliã estão mais preocupados em captar novos "sócios" do que tratar bem quem já é. 

Ao falar com a supervisora 3 dias depois do ocorrido comentei que podiam ter nos oferecido um upgrade na "joia" (como chamam o pacote dos sócios) assim pagaríamos muito mais do que a taxa pelo servicio real, e era uma coisa que já tínhamos interessante. Mas como disse, só os novo "socios" ganham essa atenção. 

De maneira geral só não fomos bem tratados pela área do Club Meliã, nos demais lugares inclusive elogiamos o atendimento. 

Parece que os cargos mais altos estão falhando e muito nesse hotel. Tudo problema de gestão e falta de bom senso na hora de solucionar os problemas. 

O hotel precisa melhorar muito para virar mesmo um Paradisus, esse hotel surgiu como Gran Meliã e não basta mudar o nome, a cor das toalhas e das luzes para se tornar o que a rede considera ***** á nivel Paradisus.
Recomendo outros Paradisus, esse não. 

Felizmente eu e meu marido conseguimos curtir bastante a nossa lua de mel, infelizmente não fomos para outro hotel.

reviews.author: Sonny D
reviews.title: Don't stay here
reviews.text: Pool staff were awesome, most staff work really hard. Some (very few) are lazy. Painting during stay. Very pushy timeshare. Reservation screw ups, lack of towels. No communication about activities. Hot hot hot, some restaurants not so good. Mole and Market Grill were awesome. Poor quality of breakfast. Two of us were sick after we got home from travelers diarrhea...

reviews.author: sean P
reviews.title: Hardly a 3 star hotel
reviews.text:
- Most of the advertised amenities on the website are only for Royal packages so if you purchase a regular all inclusive package, be ready to be rejected at the pool table, some restaurants, Jacuzzi, beach benches, etc ...
- This hotel (not resort) is hardly 3 stars. This hotel is more of a giant arboretum than a resort and it is only air conditioned in the rooms and couple of the restaurants so prepare for sweating after dinner for any activities.
- Room check in: Disaster. We got our room at 4pm. No one gives you an straight answer specially for big groups.
- Food: same mediocre food minus good seafood every day and nights.
- Activities for kids: unlike what the website says, there are non except one sand volley ball court for the whole hotel guest. Pool table are only for Royal members. So is the Jacuzzi. So much for ALL INCLUSIVE.
- The rooms: the ocean view rooms have a good view of the ocean but the A/C sounds like a truck all night.
- The beach is very choppy and deep so no playing for small kids. 
- Pools: clean but the water is boiling hot after 10am.
- My friend dented the corner of the outdated TV in the room by accident and the security took his luggage hostage until he paid $1500 US dollars. 
- Last but not the least, part of the restaurant ceiling fell down and almost injured the guests due to old building and poor maintenance. (Photos attached)

reviews.author: iñaki1998 8
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Las instalaciones son sorprendentes y el personal amable, pero perdieron nuestras valijas, nos dieron un cuarto sucio e incompleto, y la fila para el check-in duro una hora y media. Teniamos un solo dia en cancun y lo perdimos por culpa de este horrendo hotel, vayan a cualquier riu

reviews.author: Flavia Rossi
reviews.title: Péssimo
reviews.text:
Fui com minha família no pacote all inclusive. Chegando lá fomos informados de que haviam 9 restaurantes, mas alguns são pagos. 
Existem muitas regras de uso dos serviços, as quais ninguém lhe informa com antecedência, principalmente antes da escolha do hotel!
Dos 9 restaurantes, é preciso reservar jantar em 7 deles, caso contrário não se pode entrar. A reserva precisa ser feita com 2 dias de antecedência ou não se consegue lugar. Só que estes "detalhes" ninguém te conta...você descobre sozinho com o passar dos dias, tentando e dando errado.

Vazamentos no banheiro (sim, no plural), Wi-Fi de péssima qualidade (a ponto de não estar disponível em alguns momentos do dia), problema com o cofre, frigobar que não fechava a porta e vazava, atendimento ruim do front desk. E para fechar com chave de ouro...larvas na pia do banheiro da piscina.

reviews.author: Esteban D
reviews.title: No es lo que presume
reviews.text:
En la publicidad e incluso en el hotel, en textos y en grabaciones en el teléfono presumen de ser un hotel de lujo y que será una increíble experiencia. 
Le doy esta calificación ya que es un hotel regular para nada de lujo. 5 de las veces que pregunté algo básico como ingredientes de platillos, horarios o recomendaciones, al personal que pregunté no sabián pero lo malo es que no tenían la mínima intención de ayudar.

Es un hotel regular, para nada es de lujo.
Bueno, comparado con cuál?

reviews.author: vallarta76
reviews.title: Terrible Experience / Very disappointed as I've been a loyal Paradisus guest
reviews.text:
My husband and I have stayed at Paradisus La Esmeralda in PDC for 6 years straight.  This time around we decided to stay at Paradisus Cancun in hopes we would experience the same exceptional service and wonderful vacation as we have at La Esmeralda, Boy was I wrong.  My husband, 3 year old, 8 month old and I (party of 4) stayed from June 24, 2016 thru July 1, 2016

1) We arrive at PC at 4pm and it took about 40 minutes to check in, mind you there was only 1 person ahead of us to check in, so I am not sure why the delay.  Geovanny was the desk agent who was helping us.  Very unfriendly and dry, not a way to make an impression when you first arrive and you are so excited to start your vacation. 

2) We go up to our room and as we enter our Key and open the door, we discover this room is occupied! The guest who were in the room and my family of 4 were completely in shock, humiliated and embarrassed to say the least.  We went back to check in desk and advised Geovanny of the embarrassing situation and the big mistake he had just made. At the time he was helping another guest, whom by this time was very upset at the long check in process.  30 minutes later he hands me new keys to a different room.

3) 2nd room AC doesn't work, it was super hot and settings were at their lowest.  This was unacceptable.  My husband went back to front desk and Geovanny told us he couldn't do anything because all rooms were booked for the night and to return the next morning. Of course that was unacceptable, so therefore we asked to speak to a manager and was directed to Guadalupe.  Guadalupe apologizes for the inconvenience and tells us she will upgrade our room and give her about 1 hour so they can clean it. She suggested we go have dinner and when done our room should be done, Wrong!!!

3) 7pm and still no room, 3 hours later with 1 crying baby, 1 restless toddler and 2 adults who are tired from a 5 hour flight and due to the above circumstances we still don't have a room.  We go have dinner as suggested and on our return at 8pm, we see Guadalupe to tell us that our room is still not ready. At this point, I've had it and give her a piece of my mind in a calm way as I don't believe yelling gets you anywhere.  Of course, at this point she suggest we go have dinner and come back. Ugghhh, Excuse me you suggested that 1 hour ago did you forget?  I bluntly told her that her lies were unacceptable and that I was very sure that the room wasn't ready because they forgot about it and now they were going to have housekeeping have it ready.  She did acknowledge that they screwed up again but rest assure this time would be ready and give her 40 minutes. I was very clear that I wanted a room that had no issues because I was not putting my kids thru hell a 4th time. She said this room was perfect and she gave her word we wouldn't have any problems.

4) Finally we check in at 9:30pm, yes 5 1/2 hours later!!!! Room looks great.  Not too soon, Our bed is broken and  we wake up at 6 am to find our bathroom flooded and a broken toilet. Called in front desk and we were evacuated at 9 am and were let back in around 1 pm once they fixed the problem but of course their was a possibility that they would change us to another room.  I was not looking forward to it since our first day was a day from hell and now into our second day we didn't start off on a good note either. Bathroom was eventually fixed and we opted to stay in the room as we didn't want to move our kids for the 4th time.

5) Dinner reservations were set for Enso at 7:30pm for Saturday 25th, I called to confirm our reservation of 8 as we were traveling with another family and they tell me my reservation was cancelled.  Of course they couldn't tell me who cancelled it, other than all restaurants were booked and they couldn't offer any other seatings but Naos the buffet.  I was very clear that they had to figure it out and I wanted my reservation back.  In the meantime the whole reservation process was a nightmare because you can only reserve for next day and if you don't do it by 9 am they tell you they are book and they can't guarantee the restaurant you want.  Mariana was the gal who helped me and I was very upset and told her that our vacation had already started off rocky and thats the last thing I needed.  I made it clear that I would write a bad review.  She then tells me she would talk to the captain and call me back in 20, she was going to try and fix the error and investigate as to who could've canceled my reservation.  Mariana calls me back as promised, to tell me that they were able to make an exception and give me back my reservation and she filled in my request for the following days.

6) Service all around was Hot & Cold. One waiter would be so nice and happy to service you and the next would provide crappy service.  I did tip those that provided great service and went on and beyond.

7) Dinner at Fuego was the best all other restaurants food was okay nothing to ride about.  Naos breakfast buffet was not great but not bad either and they had a big selection of items to choose from.

All in all I wont be returning.  Definitely does not meet my expectations of a 4.5 star hotel from a run down hotel, to the inconsistency of their service.

PS, please tone down the incense.  It's so overpowering, it just makes you feel dizzy and spikes up your allergies.

reviews.author: mviseh
reviews.title: Don’t waste your money
reviews.text:
•	Wrong information about the rooms on their website.
•	I couldn't find any manager to complain about the rude staff. The hotel runs without manager. 
•	The Hotel was Hot because the both sides doors were wide open.
•	We had hard time to find a room with a decent AC. The technical staff had no idea of fixing the stuff at hotel.
•	We had to call several times for fixing the TV.
•	We couldn't get an appointment from any hotels' restaurant even there was no people at the restaurants. Basically, they push people to the buffet.
•	We could leave the Hotel at 12 noon and we let them know as well, but they turn of the AC and cable around of 10:00 am.
•	This was one of the worst vacations I ever had and we picked this hotel because of their 5 stars and best reviews. I don’t know how they got these reviews and who gave them. 
•	Don’t waste your money.

reviews.author: Ericatgp
reviews.title: Destruiram nosso sonho!!!
reviews.text:
Fomos roubados dentro de nosso quarto,abriram nosso cofre e levaram todo o dinheiro que havia dentro .Um dos funcionários  derrubou o carrinho da bebê  dentro da piscina com todos nossos pertences. E a única coisa que me deram de retorno foi que por normas da casa as informações  nao poderiam ser relatadas a mim , as filmagens não  poderiam ser passadas a mim .Nao podiam me passar uma cópia dos processos que abri.Que a pessoa que derrubou seria punida e que ja estavam tomando as devidas providencias . Deixei uma carta para ser entregue ao Sr Riviera um dos diretores, mas este carta nem chegou em mãos  de ninguém.  Acredito que jogaram fora ...sem importância.  Assim que me siti o tempo todo. 

 Destruiram o sonho  de nossa família, me sinto humilhada, de mãos atadas  sem poder recorrer a ninguém  fizemos o boletim na delegacia e disseram que iriam fazer investigação.  Um resort  com este porte , contra uma família  brasileira. Somos simplesmente  mais um ali, sem importância sem segurança  alguma . Nao estamos em nosso pais, nao tendo direito a nada...

Fechamos o pacote para este resort para comemorarmos nosso aniversário de  casamento de10 anos e pela salvação de nosso filha no diagnostico de um tumor no Fêmur. Ao chegar fomos  atendidos bem , mas de cara ja nos perdermos para chegar até o quarto. Ficamos bem longe da recepção piramide 1. O quarto que ficamos havia uma cama de casal e um sofa que nao vieram nenhum dia arrumar para minhas filhas dormirem, solicitei uma cama auxiliar  de solteiro para que elas dormissem. No segundo dia  fomos para a piscina por volta das 16h30 deixamos a bolsa com todos nossos pertences dentro do carrinho e com uma toalha por cima, um dos funcionários ao ir tirar os copos e a toalha derrubou nosso carrinho dentro da piscina. Nos não vimos, ao chegar para pegar o carrinho e colocar de baixo da tenda o casal ao lado nos informou que a funcionária  derrubou o carrinho dentro da agua  mostrou quem era fomos atraz para pegar o nome mas ela simplesmente sumiu ... liguei na recepção  ao chegar no quarto expliqhei o caso e pedi se era possível verificar nas câmeras o ocorrido  pois nosso carrinho  ficava de frente com uma. 
Giovan da recepção  me enviou arroz que disse que sulgaria toda a água,  no dia seguinte fui na recepção  para informar que o celular nao tinha voltado a funcionar,  abriram uma ocorrência  para levantar uma investigação  levei o rapaz que abriu a ocorrência no local e assim me pediram para aguardar. No terceiro dia iriamos a um passeio mas achei melhor remarcar pois so meu celular havia a camera boa. Mas nada foi feito.... fui todos os dias ... fechei um passeio no dia 19 pois iria embora dia 21 de junho .Fui ao passei ao retornar ao hotel  nos deparamos com nossa porta quebrada nao abria com nenhum dos cartões.... chamei por ajuda na recepção  demoraram 45 minutos para irem abrir, so entramos com a chave do técnico, ao entrar no quarto deparamos com o cofre aberto e nosso dinheiro simplesmente sumiu. Liguei na recepção  pedindo ajuda e se poderiam chamar a polícia,  mandaram 5 homens ao meu quarto onde tiraram foto e revistaram todos nosssos pertences. Me pediram mais uma vez para aguardar. Ja cansada de tanta espera fui até a recepção  chorando ...nervosa.... pois sem poder tirar fotos de nossos momentos la e nem poder realizar  o sonho de nossa filha de ir ao xcaret pedi que me enviassem um e mail , para me posicionar uma vez que não estava em meu país e nao havia provas de nada. Solicitei as filmagens e nada puderam fazer. Chamaram um rapaz chamado Abraan onde se sentou comigo na recepção me fez falar toda a história novamente e me disse para retornar as 13h30 . Cheguei as 13h30 e a posição foi a seguinte que as providências ja estavam sendo tratadas que seria normas internas e que meu celular tentariam entrar com o seguro do hotel ele levou meu celular que ficou todos os dias dentro de um jornal com arroz e voltou dizendo que estava carregando e que estava funcionando ....se poderia deixar la para carregar.  Mas que infelizmente  quanto ao roubo no quarto nao poderiam fazer nada pois nao teria como provar quanto havia de fato ,pois poderia falar um valor e nao ser verdade, resumindo nao havia provas que lá tinha dinheiro ou realmente o valor informado e que nos sistema deles eu deixei o cofre aberto ,ou seja mais uma vez o hotel nao tem comprometimento com seus clientes. Mesmo que aberto,  sumiu nao pode os deixar onde camos que se derrubam não tem comprometimento com nos clientes. Cade a segurança ???? Cade as câmeras deste hotel ? Disseram que a funcionária  trabalha lá a muitos tempo que nunca houve a reclamação  dela anteriormente e que os funcionários são  revistados ao saírem,  pois bem ...revistam bolsa ...bones ..sera que  calcinhas ...sutiã tb??? Eram 5 notas de 100 dólares.  Que passa tranquilamente em qualquer parte do corpo .Não era muito mas eram meus, ninguém  podia ter entrado la e mechido em nada. Aqui minha indignação.... um sonho distribuído uma recordação  que nao teremos deste local. Não tenho como avaliar todo o hotel pois nao houve tempo para poder aproveitar fiquei mais tempo reclamando ...chorando...lutando para ser ouvida e entendida do que curtindo com minha família.  Lá há pessoas boas sim , os poucos momentos que tivemos nos restaurante Naos foram perfeitos em tudo, mas com tantos contratempos a angústia, medo, e desrespeito tomaram conta. Não desejo isso a ninguém.  
Me coloco a disposição se houver dúvidas a quem interessar.

reviews.author: N Belcher
reviews.title: Seriously dead plants on the balcony
reviews.text:
Ok, I am currently at Paradisus Cancun and all I can say is please update your rooms and your service.  Here is my list
1. Outdated rooms 
2. Dead plants on the balcony 
3. Mold on the ceil 
4. Nasty toilets bleach is awesome 
5. Never have enough towels always calling the service express.
We have 4 people in the room and you always give me 2 towels.  Yet you seen four people leave the room.
7. Waited almost an hour to get towels
Being dirt must be common here.
6.  Workers always using regular elevators so you have to wait when coming from kids zone.
They do have a service elevator, why not use it.

Seriously, never again.

reviews.author: Nick A
reviews.title: TV was not working in room 3528 breaker was going of line, maintenance came for 3 straight night and they did not offer.
reviews.text: bad service for room 3528 the TV was not working and the breaker was going of line. Maintenance personal were called for 3 straight night. They didn't really fix the problem and they did not offer to upgrade my room or give me a discount at the end.

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: My heart will not go on.
reviews.text: I'm in my room right now trying to relax which is impossible because they are BLASTING god dam Celine Dion my heart will go on. Oh wait now we've moved on to Toni Braxton unbreak my heart. Is this supposed to be relaxing? I've never experienced anything like this in any of my 11 trips to cancun. It's totally ridiculous.

reviews.author: jendelosreyes
reviews.title: Worst vacation
reviews.text:
My husband and I and my cousin and her husband decided to take a trip to cancun and stay in paradisus because of all the hype, even our travel agent recommened it. However, from the moment we stepped into the hotel the experience was mediocre at best. First of all, our room wasnt ready at the promised time. On our second day, my cousins roof in her room started to crumble and fall on her head. About 40 minutes later maintenace get there. By this time we had already wasted half a day. Understandably so we were very upset; so they promised to move our rooms and UPGRADE both rooms. My cousin got an upgrade but my husband and I got 2 separate beds in the same room type we had before. When we went to inquire, they said they were out of the room they had promised us. At this point we were furious so they promised us 4 free massages. The massages were anything but free... we had to sit through a 90 min presentation and then they only wanted to give us 2 massages. We asked for them call manager and they said they had none on campus. What kind of hotel doesnt have a manager?

Another issue- In order to eat at any of their restaurants you need to reserve 1 day in advance, forget about walkin they never have space. 

The last straw was we took pictures paid for them and when we went to pick them up they said they werent ready and would ship them to us. When we paid for the pictures we were clear and told them we would be leaving they said no problem they would be ready, that obviously wasnt the case. 

Then to try to"fix it" they gave us a voucher for a "free vacation"  which is far from free, its actually 180 pp per night. 

I have never been more dissatisfied with a vacation, I will not be coming here again.

reviews.author: Dave Enrique Z
reviews.title: Trato Xenófobo
reviews.text: Recibimos trato xenófobo de algunos de los empleados del hotel, lo vimos igual con turistas de Colombia y Ecuador. Además como no aceptamos desayunar con un asesor comercial para informarnos de Melia VIP, la persona que nos recibió nunca más volvió a a aparecer. Nos precionaron para hacer el checkout y bloquearon nuestra tarjeta de acceso pese a que estaba sobre el tiempo. No volveré.

reviews.author: A1574HVRyan
reviews.title: Poor Customer Service
reviews.text: I was charged twice, it took almost 2 weeks to resolve the issue. Our butler almost never answered the phone, when he did, he never did anything we asked him to do. We did not have enough towels in our room. We requested towels 2 days in a row and never received them. Water leaked from the ceiling in the bathroom, we were told to "just turn the air conditioning off!" It was 95 degrees outside! Hostess was rude at the Market Grill. Our waitress at the Bali Beds only came to check on us once. Our friends waiter came like every 20 minutes! Very Poor Customer Service, the resort is nice minus the people.

reviews.author: Maria R
reviews.title: STAY AWAY FROM LETICIA ROYAL SERVICE
reviews.text:
"We stayed from January 20 to January 24 the acting honestly and found amazing staff , warmth and kindness, and to say our Rodrigo butler! It was very funny and made ​​us laugh all the time, he recommended restaurants and food and became good friends , plus we kept in touch with him and he told us is Dad !!! Every day you were leaving an envelope with $ 50 for the baby from the first day , and when we said we never got NOTHING we feel angry !!! Every day the concierge LETICIA received the envelopes. And now Rodrigo tells us not to receive anything ! LETICIA STOLE A BABY !!! WE FEEL VERY ANGRY WITH THAT !!! Rodrigo work so hard and so well, and she stole it! Do not trust her, just trying to fool people in a sexist way! I hope to do something about it, there are many butlers who are in Royal Service and surely it also robs them ! For her NEVER be back! Please do not leave your money or belongings near her !
I want her to be fired !!!!, She does not deserve to be surrounded by such great people."

reviews.author: cjmspcun
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text:
My daughter and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun over Spring break this year and from the first moment we arrived it was a pain! We arrived at 6:00 pm and were told we would have to wait for an hour for our room. We were given over to a Concierge who proceeded to sell us hard on every adventure she could think of as well as trying to get us to sign up for an hour and a half breakfast the next morning at 7:30 am to see the condos that were for sale. We signed up just to get away from her. 

When we arrived in our room we were given one King bed and not the two double beds we had booked. For the next three days we were told we would need to come to the front desk and check to see if any other rooms were available. The problem was that every morning no matter what time we stopped we were required to wait in the check in reception line for nearly an hour- we never did get a different room and after several days gave up!

To cut to the chase, room was not as described, room was never cleaned before 3:00 in the afternoon, no pool chairs or beach chairs even at 7:00 am in the morning, towels ran out every day and you couldn't get a clean towel, general helpfulness of the room service staff and front desk borderline RUDE!! 

I will NEVER go back to this hotel or ANY of its properties. Not four stars. I wouldn't give it more than two at best and not worth the expense. 

Hotel rooms need to be updated. Linens and towels (when available) were old and threadbare.

Worst vacation we have ever had and we have been to Mexico and Cancun 6 times over the years. Couldn't wait to leave!!!

reviews.author: Nikola B
reviews.title: Would definitely not recommend it!
reviews.text:
Well. Were to start? 
Room: it looked as if it never has been refurbished since 1988, when the hotel was first built. Bathroom-disaster -sink so dirty my wife was not able to brush her teeth without wishing to vomit. 
We paid extra for "family concierge" they told us teh room will be spacious etc. yes it was spacious. And....NOISY funnily the family room for small kids etc was situated next to the pool, where all the fun was. So everyday at exactly 14:00 when obviously is the time for kid to sleep the music starts with such power that frankly nobody could even hear  her/his thoughts. We asked several times for our room to be exchanged ... No way. Usual explanation: the hotel is fully booked. The next time they promised that there will be no more music at the pool. Well. The music went on and on :-( 
Another really important point: food. Well there are plenty of options. But they are not for human beings. No fantasy. No taste. Full with all kind of artificial tastes and addidtives. We tried to get booking for Tempo" restaurant-where you have to pay extra. For 4 days no one returned us call they put us on some imaginary "waiting list" but no one ever bothered to inform us. I could add many more points. I have also pictures but prefer not to waste anymore time even with memories for that joke of a hotel... There are so many better and surely cheaper options in Cancun and zone na Hotelera. 
Probably the only good thing there was the care from the kids corner... But that faded so fast...

reviews.author: Carlitos C
reviews.title: Muy mal servicios
reviews.text: En este hotel hay una mala atención sobre todo en la puerta principal estábamos explorando el hotel nos salimos y luego tuve que dar una na vuelta descomunal para poder entrar de nuevo al hotel camine tanto que no me dieron ganas de disfrutar mis vacaciones

reviews.author: tkastner60
reviews.title: Hot as hell where is the air!
reviews.text: I am a very cold natured person. I am dying here!! The air conditioning is horrible!!! This resort has gone downhill in the last year! Miserable vacation! Just want a little comfort! 👹 hot has hell!!! Don't waste your money on Royal service it is a sweat box too!

reviews.author: Anna D
reviews.title: Horrible Wedding Location
reviews.text:
If you're thinking of doing your wedding at Paradisus Cancun, please consider another location.  First off just a brief description, I had my destination wedding for 61 guests in February.  There were so many things that went wrong so I broke up the review into wedding details and the hotel itself.  

The wedding details:
I would have looked away for many of the issues, however on the day of the wedding, the wedding coordinator, Cynthia, was cold, rude and completely inflexible, literally holding our wedding hostage!   We had our ceremony on the beach and it was beautiful until it all of a sudden rained.  I understood that this was a change in plans, however the manner in which she approached things was not right.  She asked if we would want to wait and see if the rain would stop or if we should just move inside.  Given that it was raining really hard and suddenly the tables were already soaked so we decided to move inside right away.  She stated it would take her about an hour to set up the inside "ballroom" location (looks more like a crappy convention center). We agreed that this would be best and we waited in the avenue B lounge with other hotel guests, which was ok.  However my guests did not get any of the cocktail hour snacks, which I had paid for.  Then the unprofessionalism started, after over an hour I went to get an update from Cynthia and she was extremely rude.  I asked if the wedding was going to be extended to make up for the lost time and she said the rain was not her fault and she can cancel the wedding if she wanted.  She didn't allow us to start the reception until my husband went to the office and paid for the extra hour on the spot since we did not want a 1.5 hour reception.  Besides for being so unaccommodating and unfriendly, first off, she was late at the start of the wedding also.  She brought my bouquet, my bridesmaid's bouquets and my mother's corsage to the room late so we couldn’t even take photos and worst of all she was late picking us up to start the wedding.  So right away we were starting off on the wrong foot.  She didn't know which side the guys were supposed to go vs the girls when they were walking down the aisle. 
 Even despite this I would have been ok, except for the fact that they are thieves too.  We were supposed to receive credits which we did not receive, in fact they were charging us for the credits.  We had over 30 rooms booked at the resort and were supposed to get some money back from that but they did not give us any of the incentives that were promised to us.  Basically if your friends booked through other websites like hotels.com or expedia, etc.  They did not count as a guest.  They required you to book in a group rate, which is significantly more expensive than other websites.  So I didn't want my guests to get ripped off.  They told me we can get up to 3 free rooms based on our size and in the end they did not honor it, even though they initially stated they would honor the other guests’ bookings. (We only received credit for one room)  We were also supposed to receive $500 credit based on the amount of money we spent during the wedding and they only have us a portion of that.  In addition to the extra hour that they charged us which was out of our control, they charged us for decorations we didn't use and food we didn't get to eat as well as welcome bags that were never delivered.  After the wedding they ignored all requests to discuss these payments.  We paid for all these extra things just to be able to move on and we thought we can work it out later.  After about 50 emails back and forth and escalations to the regional manager, Marilyn Cairo- with no response, I stated that I will be putting in my review and then I finally got a response.  Ester stated that they were so sorry and that Cynthia was no longer at the organization (likely for being a poor coordinator) and she would help me out and I never heard from her again.  All I have wanted is to get my money back and the credits that were promised to us.  Essentially they are holding just under $2000 hostage and that does not include the credit of 2 rooms, which they are not crediting us for even though I have email confirmations that say they would.  Likely in total we are looking at close to $5000 loss for no reason.   So that is why it has taken me 2 months to write my review because of all the back and forth.  The issue is still not resolved, however I didn't want other people to book their wedding here and having such a bad experience.  
During the planning process, it was also very difficult.  Again I would not have even mentioned these things if they didn't steal our money and hold our wedding hostage.  They want you to use their decorators, photographers, DJ etc, and if you find someone else w better reviews and want to bring them in, they charge $500 per outside vendor.  We wound up using all their vendors to avoid fees, except the DJ since the one we found was much more highly rated and much, much cheaper even despite the $500 fee.  The decorators did a good job but coordinating the wedding with them was extremely difficult and both the decorator and the wedding coordinator were not always responsive.  The wedding coordinator was also responsible for setting up dinner reservations for us and she did not do it for 2 of the nights despite putting it on our itinerary.  

Hotel Review:
The resort is nice and seems impressive when you come into the lobby, however the check in process was much to be desired.  We came in with a few of our guests as the first to arrive.  The wedding coordinator insisted we send our picture to have great service, well that did not happen.  The reception desk had no idea that we were the bride and groom and that there was a wedding going on.  As the bride and groom, we were supposed to receive an upgrade and they did not have that available to us until the following night.   We were checking in with a couple of our guests and they had to wait several hours to get their rooms and weren't able to access their luggage.   Once we finally sorted out the check in business we wanted to grab a bite and all the restaurants were closed.  So we needed to wait 30 minutes to even get anything to eat.  Once we got to the rooms, they were ok.  A bit outdated, but clean.  The food was mediocre and it was very difficult coordinating dinners.  I wanted to have some dinners with a large group and they only accommodate 15 people at a time.  You need to make your restaurant reservations in advance to make it to the smaller ones.  The Bana restaurant was not very good, with average sushi.  The Mexican restaurant is mediocre which I would have expected more.  However the biggest disappointment is 6 star Michelin rated restaurant Tempo.  The service was excellent, however there was nothing significantly impressive about the food.  I’ve dined in  Michelin rated restaurants in NYC and around the world, this restaurant was good and it was definitely fine dining, but nothing special.   The staff didn’t even know the cost of the wine and the dinner.  Vento was the only restaurant that was accommodating to fit my guests however they offered wine to my guests that was not all inclusive and didn’t let us know and we were charged $500 for that dinner because of their deceit.   The beach was nice however there was significant seaweed on certain days making it disgusting to go in the water.   So we went to the pool most of the days and the floor of the pool is so broken down that you need to be really careful walking on it or you'll definitely get hurt.  There were huge pot holes essentially on the pool grounds that are in desperate need of repair. 

Overall, I would never recommend this resort given their lack of integrity, professionalism, mediocre food and drinks.

reviews.author: Santiabello
reviews.title: No respetan la reservas
reviews.text: De que sirve reservar los restaurantes en la noche y tener un todo incluido si no respetan las reservas confirmadas de los clientes en los diferentes restaurantes. En estas grandes cadenas los huéspedes no son iguales, así paguemos lo mismo se ven privilegios. Es desgastante estar de vacaciones y estar pendiente de donde se va a cenar. Ultima vez en esta cadena.

reviews.author: Gerardo Cantu Yeverino
reviews.title: Horrible trato
reviews.text:
Si eres mexicano mejor no vengas, tardamos mas de 1 hora en hacer check in, en la recepción te tratan de la peor manera, en especial Adriana y Veronica, que triste que nuestro México este en manos de estas personas...

Hasta que pedimos hablar con el gerente pudo hacer algo por nosotros, el problema es que a los extranjeros les dan prioridad en la asignación de habitaciones.

reviews.author: Gaetania
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our second year of staying at the Paradisus    We very much enjoyed the first visit   Service was great as well as the staff   Our concierge did a fantastic job!  Even though it was in need of quite a bit of renovations and updating they were working on some of the problems so we assumed all would have been completed by the time we arrived this year.  Big mistake on my part!   It was in worse condition!!   We stayed in room 4305 both times   Nothing was improved upon at all    This could be a really nice room as it is a one bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms   Also has 3 balconies   Unfortunately none had outdoor furniture!   We asked our concierge Gabriel 3 times for that and never got it    We were supposed to have 12 noon room cleaning and 6 pm turn down service    Most days we had to call for the room to be cleaned and very rarely did the whole suite get cleaned   Turn down service happened 3 times   Just a note we stayed almost 2 weeks!!   The first 3 nights we received evening snacks which consisted of champagne & berries,  wine & cheese twice  all tasted like vinegar   So disappointing!!   Constantly had to call for restocking of mini bar and water    Also had to call quite a bit to get dinner reservations that the concierge was also supposed to take care of   When you're paying for concierge services you expect them at the very least to just do their jobs!   The high point of this resort was that the food was really good   Wait staff was excellent   This will be my last trip to Paradisus or any of the Melia resorts even though I am a member!   This vacation was so bad that I've booked a trip to St Martin in a few weeks for a do-over!!

reviews.author: douglas l
reviews.title: Black Cloud Over 50th Birthday Vacation
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Resort for 6 nights.  Upon arrival at 9pm, the desk said our travel arrangements setup online with BookIt.com had not yet paid for our rooms. they explained that "this is common and to give us your credit card so they could have reassurance that they will get paid" and "check with us in the morning and Bookit should have paid for it by then".  It was late so I agreed.  I checked back the next morning and still no payment, they told me to call Bookit and maybe they will expedite the payment which I did that afternoon.  Bookit claimed they paid for the room, again the hotel said they had not.  This went on my entire stay with a lot of time on phone calls and at the desk until finally the night before my checkout, the hotel said that Bookit paid for the rooms at 330pm of that day.  Basically, the entire trip I had the sinking feeling that I might have to pay for the room twice!.  My issue with Paradisus is they knew and have been having problems with Bookit.com for sometime. They continued to tell me that "I'm not the only one" and "this has been happening with Bookit a lot".  My response was "why are you allowing Bookit to book your hotel if you know this has been a problem".  It's a shame that they would allow this company to put their guests through this.  I'm extremely disappointed in how they handled our situation and hope this sheds light on others so they do not get "trapped" in this scenario.

reviews.author: flor_solari
reviews.title: Hotel para no elegir
reviews.text:
El hotel es muy lindo en cuanto a lo edilicio aunque se nota la antiguedad del mismo, Nosotros nos alojamos en la torre 3 convidta al mar, los pasillos habia muccho olor a comida, en el balcon tambien mas el humo que salia de los restoranes, poca amabilidad del personal del hotel, muy lentos muy ineficientes, solicitabas algo y no t lo enviaban, tanto en el restoran cuando pedias sal o bebidas , o en el room service que te enviaban o mal el pedido o tardaba o no t lo enviaban, la comida muy poco sabrosa, poca variedad, te retiraban la comida del
Buffet 40 min antes de que cerrara. No habia reposicion de alimentos o de especies para realizar cualquier comida. La picina estaba muy fria la cual nadie usaba.

reviews.author: lunaemma
reviews.title: À éviter
reviews.text:
Nous sommes actuellement au Paradisus Cancun. Nous avons 2 chambre en Familly concierge 

Nous avons eu des problèmes dès notre arrivée. Au buffet sans réservation il n'y avais plus de tables de disponibles il fallait faire la queue et attendre. C'est la première fois que nous voyons cela. Dans un restaurant où il ne faut pas réserver de devoir faire la queue pour être placés ! 

Le problème a été résolu avec le manager et notre concierge et nous avons eu une table de 4 pour 6 personnes! 

En ce qui concerne les chambres elles sont petites, la salle de bain est minuscule. La porte d'entrée tape dans celle des toilettes 

Il faut spécifier que nous sommes allez en Mars 2015 au Paradisus Playa del Carmen et nous avons adorer!! Tout était absolument parfait du concierge aux infrastructures sauf la plage. C'est pour cela que cette année nous avons choisi celui de Cancun pensant avoir le même service excellent, la même qualité de chambre et de restaurant.... Nous avons choisi celui de Cancun pensant avoir un accès facilité à une plus belle plage mais l'accès est aussi difficile que celui de Playa del Carmen par contre la plage est très belle. Quelle désillusion!

Nous sommes au 3 eme étage avec 2 bebe et 2 poussettes, c'est une vrai galère car nous devons toujours attendre très longtemps les ascenseurs car il y a beaucoup de monde

Quand nous sommes arrivés nos filles n'ont pas étés accueilles avec les sacs d'amenites comme à Playa del Carmen j'ai dû le réclamer. 

Dans nos 2 chambres la TV ne marchais pas, nous n'avions pas de débit pour l'eau chaude, la télécommande et le sèche cheveux étaient casses, la baignoire ne se vidait pas... Tout a été résolu en temps et en heure par le personnel. 

Nous avons réserver un lit balinais pour notre séjour. Sachez que c'est 50USD par jour mais que vous n'avez pas le choix de sa situation. Nous voulions un lit balinais entre mer et piscine avec vue sur la mer, ceux ci sont à 163USD par jour!!!! Mais ils ont concédés de nous faire un geste spécial et de nous faire à 50 dollars par jours un bel emplacement. 

Je tiens à féliciter l'excellent service de Sofonia le serveur de la piscine face à notre lit balinais numéro 108 et d'Alexander

Le manager du Naos restaurant est Juan de Dios est d'une grande gentillesse. 

Notre concierge Alvaro est très sympathique et tous les soirs nous avons des attentions dans la chambre mais les concierge sont très différents de ceux de Playa de Carmen qui viennent vous voir 2 fois par jours à la piscine pour savoir si tous ce passe bien et si vous avez besoin de quelque chose. On les vois courir partout et le service est digne d'un 5 étoiles. Au Paradisus Cancun les concierges restent dans leur zone et si vous n'avez besoin de rein pendant le séjour vous ne les verrez pas. 

De plus l'eau des piscines est froide nous ne pouvons pas nous baigner. Au Paradisus Playa del Carmen l'eau du Familly concierge est à 35 degrés !

Une jeune fille m'a également prise de haut à la réception du Familly concierge quand je lui ai demandé de voir pour mon transfert retour et rigolait avec sa collègue. Ceci ne serai jamais arrivé au Paradisus Playa del Carmen. 

Toutes mes remarques ont étés prises en compte par Farnsico qui a essayé de faire de son mieux pour changer notre opinion mais le mal est fais. 

Le pire c'est que nous nous marions ici le 18 février!! Une chose à vous dire concernant les mariages au Paradisus ils sont hors de prix et la moindre petite chose que vous voulez ajouter comme une tour IPad pour la musique vous sera facturée. Leur photographe vous prendra 1000Usd pour une heure et 100 photos!!!!!!

Si vous voulez pendre un photographe extérieur comme nous faisons qui nous prend 180 dollars par heure pour 2 photographes et 200 photos l'hôtel vous fera payer 1000Usd de pénalités !!!!
Nous avons pu négocier à 500 Usd mais je ne paierai que la moitié. C'est une vrai arnaque
Nous aurions du faire notre mariage avec un prestataire extérieur comme me l'a proposé ma photographe en dehors de l'hôtel mais nous avions déjà payer!

Nous avons pu négocier à 500 Usd mais je ne paierai que la moitié. C'est une vrai arnaque

Cet hotel vous prend pour un porte feuille ambulant!!! Vous serez toujours sollicités pour adhérer au club Melia. C'est fatiguant!!

Au Paradisus Playa del Carmen tout est plus simple et tranquille. 

Nous ne nous ferons pas avoir 2 fois, plutôt que de choisir une plage nous irons là où le service est irréprochable!

Le concept d'un Paradisus à l'autre est tellement différent !!!

Ne faites pas comme nous  réservez directement au Paradisus Playa del Carmen côtés Familly concierge vous ne serez pas déçus

Une chose est sûre le prix est trop élevé pour là qualités des services. 

A bon entendeur...

reviews.author: Egle J
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
The hotel feels like 2.5 stars and definitely not 4.5 as they claim. It lacks in all aspects. Upon check-in they gave us an old ugly room in the basement of the hotel facing the main street, after I complained they gave us another ugly outdated room with dirty sofa and broken cabinets, very ugly. Then after I screamed on them that their rooms are nothing like displayed in Expedia pictures, they gave me a third room, supposedly "nicer". We didn't want to adventure through more rooms so we stayed there. The room was outdated, bathroom (with one sink) old, bathroom door broken with no lock at all, light switches broken, dirty towel, no bathrobes or slippers... Also the room was in the main pyramid, we (with 2 kids) couldn't sleep half of the night due to noise, loud music and drunk people screaming in hallways. 
The buffet was the worst I've ever experienced (we've been to Mexico 15+ times), food for lunch and dinner cold and really really bad, with very little options.
Pools cold and very old. Service OK. We are experienced Travelers who travel to Cancun, Rviera Maya 2-3 times a year and stay only at 4/4.5/5 star hotels. We know how 4.5 star hotel feels like, and this was a total dump, 2.5 stars at most. 
Total disaster, I wish I could get my money back.

reviews.author: Dee M
reviews.title: Lovely hotel disappointing experience
reviews.text: We are currently staying at Paradisus, the resort and all inclusive has been a wonderful experience. However, we have booked couple months in advance for a King size room which hotel management could not accomodate us but instead they put us in double bed room on the top floor which we were pleased with. 2nd night, our hotel room had no water and maintenance came up and told us to have front desk take care of us..and when we spoke to KAREN at front desk she simply asked why we had no water in our room and told us why bother coming down stairs (as she laughed in our face). Then we asked for management if they could provide us with any assistance and she told us a simple no, and that she could stick us in double bed room (again) on the ground floor. She did not offer us with any inconvenience services which we were very disappointed in after the way we were treated by KAREN. But eveything from the beach, amenities, hotel, and staff was a pleasant stay here at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Vanessa K
reviews.title: Péssimo
reviews.text:
Estrutura boa. Comida razoável para péssima ... porém ... o pior de tudo foi o atendimento. Péssimo , horrível , sem educação , sem trato e todos os piores adjetivos que posso encontrar !!!!
Nosso quarto não havia sido arrumado até as 19hs. Pedimos com toda educação e mesmo assim nada. Tivemos que ligar novamente e sermos mal educados para que fizessem a arrumação do mesmo. Fomos tomar um sorvete no restaurante ( All inclusive ) e quando sentamos a mesa o garçom nos disse " pode sentar mas não desarrumem a mesma ). Eu e meu marido não acreditamos que estávamos ouvindo aquilo. Pedi a camareira que abrisse meu quarto pois havia esquecido a chave com meu marido que havia ficado na praia e estava com meu filho para dar um banho nele ( o mesmo estava com muito frio ) e a mesma disse que não tinha a chave do meu quarto , sendo que a vi abrindo o quarto ao lado. Além de vc pagar caro , te exigem proprinas e mais propinas por um serviço que não merece nenhuma recompensa. Não sei se todos os hotéis tem este tratamento. Mas PARADISUS CANCUN nunca mais.

reviews.author: paradisusinjustice
reviews.title: Hotel from Hell
reviews.text:
