If only one potatoe was ordered you would get one whole potatoe.  I think they were portioning.

I hope this helps you on your pick.  If you are looking for a quiet place you will find it with and overall mediocrity of service and experience.

reviews.author: Mike M
reviews.title: Will not go back and won't recommend this hotel.
reviews.text: Sloppy service and mediocre food. Food choices in this hotel are hit and miss. Will not go back and will not recommend. Hotel credits are useless and you have to pay extra for premium alcohol. This hotel is not fully all inclusive.

reviews.author: Henry R
reviews.title: Save Your Money and Go Somewhere Else!
reviews.text:
The staff at the resort is very friendly and reliable. Everything else is just a complete mess: non-existing A/C throughout the property, outdated rooms, one person handling restaurant reservations for over 1000 people - so good luck eating at one of their restaurants.

The buffet area is just as hot as the pool area, time-shares hustlers greeting you as soon as you arrive....even the luggage guy tries to outsmart you - he called his cab-friend to take us to airport on and tried to charged us twice what a regular cab cost for the same ride. To make matters worse, I noticed the driver paying him off at the back of our van. When I balked at the price and said we were taking a regular hotel cab, they dropped the price from $750 MX Pesos to $320. I am a very good tipper (tipped everyone who provided quality service throughout our stay) but not a sucker.

To top it off, our son got a throat infection and we had to call the so called doctor. And  guess what?, she too, charged us $60 more than what she wrote on the bill. Please do yourself a favor if a family member gets sick, pay in cash and not with your Credit/Debit Card. You will be overcharged.

Needless to say that I will never go back to this or any other Melia Resorts properties.

reviews.author: Diana Fernanda M
reviews.title: Hotel de 3 estrellas.
reviews.text: En la agencia de viajes me dijeron que eran de 4 diamantes, y por el precio que pagué lo creí, estoy muy decepcionada del servicio, la comida y el hotel en general, no me divertí ni la pasé bien en absoluto.

reviews.author: Sonia Liliana G
reviews.title: No era lo que pensaba
reviews.text: No me gusto nada !!! Llenisimo el hotel , filas para todo ! Para desayunar era una pesadilla , para reservar restaurant tenias que levantarte a las 7:00 porque sino ya no ppdrias acceder a reservar para cena del siguiente dia . Cobran sombra en el area de la alberca y playa . Y las que eran gratis a las 7:00 am ya estaban resevadas con toallas y los vigilantes ni se daban cuenta. Los meseros del NOA estaban tan saturados que hasta pedirles una cuchara era maltrato para ell

reviews.author: therealreview20
reviews.title: Family concierge staff is bad
reviews.text:
The family  concierge staff is incompetent. The butlers are good but the people who handle the requests are not customer service oriented. When i checked in i made reservations for a bali bed for 2 days and they messed that up when i go to my bed for the day i reserved the pool staff had no idea.  Iy was not the pool staffs fault but the family concierge staffs fault. When i twll the staff my issue she blamed it on me for not paying. I had my credit card swiped when i cked in and they had the amount authorized. The manager found out and told me they messed up and comped me but the point is the staff member tried to blame me.the butler arabica was real good. He knew how to calm a person down and he fixed the problem   i hope mgt realizes he is probably one of the best customer service oriented workers they have. 

Food is okay. Japanese place is best. Bartenders are great.

reviews.author: Paris007007007
reviews.title: Horrible Never going back
reviews.text:
Okay, before I get into the complaining... I'll start with some positive things. The beach is awesome. The server on the beach is awesome. The meal at Vento and at Tempo was awesome. And the staff are always cleaning, so it seems like a clean resort. Hmmm.... I think those are the best points about this hotel. And the fact that it's close to the airport. 

Now, the complaining. As soon as you arrive (which we did at around 11:00 a.m.), no room was ready. Not cool. Rooms wouldn't be ready until around 3:00 p.m. so why were we there at that time? Sucked because we had nothing to do, couldn't really change.

There's a very pungent smell in the main building and a nasty chemical smell in all of the elevators. It's awful. I gagged whenever I went in. They need to get rid of that smell. It's overpowering. 

For dinner, if you like to sweat, then go to the buffet or the Asian inspired restaurant. It's in the middle of the main building and it's boiling hot in both! So uncomfortable that I had to leave.

Let's talk about the noise. I was in level 5 of the main building. I was told (because I have a small child) that it wouldn't be noisy. So why did they blare the karaoke until 9:00 p.m. some nights or 11:00 p.m. other nights? The walls are wafer thin! Baby slept OK thank God but I didn't. I considered changing rooms (actually, I considered changing hotels to the Beach Palace, but felt that I should just see it through). 

The resort is not stroller friendly. I had to lug my kid and my stroller to the beach by going down 20+ stairs. Not cool. 

The food It's edible. It's mediocre. I think I lost weight by not craving / eating things. I'm not a picky person. But their food was sometimes weird (shrimp broth for breakfast anyone?).  The veggies are undercooked. The egg station grill is black (not cleaned) so your eggs may come out burnt tasting. The bread seems OK at the a la carts during the evenings, but I think they microwave it for the next day breakfast or lunch because it's way too stale . We had some issues with hamburgers (it's hit and miss as you may get one fully cooked and you may get one bloody raw). 

I was the person getting up at 6:00 a.m. to save a spot for my family on the beach. And apparently you have to defend it because in the late morning / early afternoon, people come by (because they don't have enough chairs) and ask the staff to move your stuff (which they will!). Lack of chairs = unorganized / mismanaged.

We were told they didn't have any plan pen, but our friends got one. So we switched. Why lie about it? 

Want to order room service? They have a directory there with like 10 things to choose from for breakfast and 10 to choose for lunch and dinner. That's it. No customization. I had burgers, fries and ice cream all week from room service. It was better than the buffet, but not by much.

Unless you're a Melia club member, you're a second class citizen. Need a reservation, bali bed, butler, good tequila, access to their upgraded facilities, etc.? Nope. You're not a club member.

I killed a cockroach in my room on the 4th day. No, I didn't have food in the room. It was just looking at me in the hallway in the morning. I was like? So we had to corner it and grab it and flush it. Not cool. Never happened to me before. 

The pools are really, really deep (I'm almost 6 feet and it went up to my neck). How can most people swim in this? How can I take my little boy in this water?

The rooms were basic. Nothing awe inspiring 

Want to take food from the buffet to your room? Should be a no brainer. We did it before in other resorts without issue. Here, it's a no-no. And they told us we couldn't.

We found out 2 days before we left to come to Canada that they had a kids' pool. The staff at the Kids Area told us they didn't, but you have to keep walking to the right after exiting the main building to find it. We spent a lot of time there once we found it (as it's hidden behind La Perla restaurant). 

Will I go back? Nope. Will I recommend it. Just the beach, the service, and some of the a la carts. Did I enjoy myself? Yes, because I make the most out of every trip. Plus, I took a 1 day trip to Xplor, and I bought lots of great tasting tequila from the local Walmart and had a great time at the beach with some friends. So we made the most out of it.

reviews.author: Maria C
reviews.title: Horrible don't stay here
reviews.text: The food was disgusting!! No ac in the entire hotel only in the rooms!you have to make dinner reservations for all the restaurants 2 days in advance. Waist of our money! Never staying there again? It's really not worth the head ache.

reviews.author: Louis Vincent F
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I just recently got back from staying at the Paradisus and I could not be more disappointed. The food was the most disgusting we both got sick. Room had leaks and ants. Just terrible.

reviews.author: Lacey
reviews.title: Horrible experience!  NEVER AGAIN!
reviews.text:
This was a 5-night girls trip.  (Just me and another girlfriend sharing a room)  When we checked in, Felipe said that upgrades were available.  He said he had a lagoon view suite available for $600 more or an ocean view suite for $750 more.  We opted for the ocean view.   As soon as we made that choice, he said "Well... I actually don't have an ocean view available until tomorrow.  You would have to switch rooms tomorrow.  They are the very same room except one faces the lagoon, the other faces the ocean."  So, being flexible, we decided to do the lagoon view for one night and would switch to the ocean view for the rest of the trip.  The next day, our butler Hector took us to the ocean view room.  It was a SMALLER room.  Even the bathroom was smaller.  We went from having 2 sinks to 1 sink.  We ended up refusing that room and just went back to the lagoon view.  I was angry.  And the solution to the problem?  They told us there was a couple checking in the next day into the ocean view room that was the same size as the one we had.  But instead, to make us happy, they were going to give the people just arriving the smaller ocean view room and give us their room since they would never know the difference.  Nice thing to say, right?!

After the room situation was resolved THREE DAYS into the trip, we tried to relax at the pool.  Getting a Bali bed was next to impossible.  The first day we tried to get one, we were told we would be put on a waiting list.  The second day (when we DID have a reservation) we were told the same thing again... WAITING LIST.  So... AGAIN... I got a manager involved (Melisa) and asked her why I was paying for an "upgrade" when the Bali beds weren't even available to us to be used.  She basically told me that the hotel was booked at maximum occupancy and there just weren't enough beds to accommodate everyone.  I said, "Okay... so you're telling me I'll be able to enjoy a Bali bed 2 out of the 5 days I'm here?  Why did I even pay for an upgrade when I can't even use what I paid for?!"  I suggested that my room rate be changed.  She ended up resolving the issue by offering me a Bali bed at Coco's (which they normally charge $100 extra for) or I could choose a Bali bed by the pool I originally wanted to lay by.  She also offered to give me the lagoon rate on our stay instead of the ocean view rate.  I thought that was fair considering all of the issues we had.  And the best part of all of this?  My name WAS on the Bali bed reservation list.  She said it was just written really small and it was somehow overlooked.  So basically it all could've been avoided.

Just when I thought the problems had ended, the filter in the pool stopped working.  There was all kinds of disgusting stuff floating on top of the water.  The filter had basically backwashed everything it had cleaned out.  It was so gross!  Tons of guests were complaining about it.   No one wanted to even get in the pool.

On our last day, our butler had scheduled a time for the bellman to come get our bags from our room.  The bellman never even showed up at the scheduled time... so we hauled all of our bags all the way through the hotel.  This was not at all shocking to me considering the string of other problems we had experienced.  Seemed like a typical way to end this nightmare trip.

As for food at this hotel... it was average at best.  The drinks were extremely inconsistent.  We would order Sex on the Beach when lounging at the pool and it would be made differently every single day.  Some bartenders wouldn't even put orange juice in it!

The doors on the rooms at this hotel slam very easily.  Walls are paper thin.  Noise was an issue.

This hotel also had issues with air circulation.  The AC in our room worked great.  But when walking throughout the hotel in common areas, it was SO STUFFY!  The air didn't move.  It was VERY HOT.  There was no point in even putting makeup on when it was just going to melt off of my face.

The best part of this hotel is the beautiful beach it's on.  That is the only one good thing I can say about it.  Unfortunately, it's going to take a lot more than just a beach to make me ever want to return.

I just felt like so much was promised with the upgrade and it was one big empty promise.  I couldn't relax on this trip because I was constantly fighting to get the things we paid for.

With that said, I will never be returning... not even if they paid me to.

reviews.author: Magdalena L
reviews.title: No están capacitados para recibir a un grupo
reviews.text: Desinformación, mal manejo. Se vieron sobrepasados en todo momento por el grupo (grupo de personas adultas, de negocios, del sector IT). En todo momento el grupo parecía ser una molestia para el hotel

reviews.author: Adriana M
reviews.title: Paga mucho por poco
reviews.text:
Pésima comida en el buffet no hay variedad
Parece un hotel de pocas estrellas por todo menos por sus instalaciones
No son amables menos 1 o 2 personas
No tiene. Shows por la noche
No es un hotel de playa ni tropical sino muy chillout

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Difficult place for business
reviews.text:
I visited this hotel for a business trip where I was presenting as a guest speaker for a business convention. The experience was dreadful , the first night they would not let me meet with the organizer since I was not staying at the hotel and I was forced to pay $85usd for a night pass in order to meet with him in one of the locations of the convention center. Instead of offering a solution like meeting at the lobby or business center I was pushed to buy the night pass (bracelet ).
Once in the service was slow the cafe (indoors) was awfully hot and my drink was made with cheap liquor ( after 85 entry fee I expected something better ). The day of the conference everything was just a sign that this hotel time had passed. Terrible coffee service ( and old coffee pot bowling all day ) almost no electrical outlets in the convention center and noisy AC on the conference rooms. This might be great for tourists but not for business travelers and conventions

reviews.author: John K
reviews.title: A Group of Crooks Lead This Hotel
reviews.text:
It is my fifth time in Cancun but the first time staying at this hotel. This is the most terrifying and stressful experience I ever had while on vacation. The hotel staff stole 570 pesos from my pants while I was having breakfast at the restaurant. Neighbor sitting close to me saw the hotel staff stealing my stuff. 

I went down to reception angry and said I wanted to report the case to the police, the management (Sergio) refused to call the police. I explained to him that one of his staff removed my things from the umbrella and stole 570 pesos. He did not care and his answer was “we will investigate”. I told him that I’m disgusted in this hotel. I told him ''I can accept of being robbed of 570 pesos  but I can not accept you management refusing me to report the case to the police.. 

Also there is a terrible musty smell around the stairs and rooms. It smell's like sick and sewage. The rooms also stink so bring Fabreeze. I believe no matter what hotel you stay at in Mexico there is a strong chance of something getting robbed, but what disappointed me the most was management reaction to it and how they did very little to help us once. Maybe if they did i could of just accepted it as one of those things and bad luck. Their behavior and how I was treated it left me with an impression that the Hotel management staff is connected to Mexican drug cartels.

ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTED and DISAPPOINTED with this hotel and will NEVER be returning to a Paradisus again!!!!

TRAVELLER BEWARE!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Macarena G
reviews.title: Que feo hotel
reviews.text: Para ser sincera le dije a la chica de lan que keria un hotel de lujo y me ofrecio este hotel pero cuando llege n me gusto la en la comida n hay variedad jamas encontre sitio para cenar en otro restaurant la piscina espeña no hay diversion es como un hotel cualqiera no me gusto para nada asi de simple

reviews.author: Scott M
reviews.title: Underwhelming!
reviews.text: We paid for the Royal Service w/butler. Not worth it! Extremely slow check-in process, smoky room (would not change rooms), stained pillows, broken drawers, poor to no internet service, frig. not stocked daily, clogged drains, etc. Had to call 3 times just to get extra pillows. Woke up at 3 a.m. to a beeping safe, never fixed! The employees were nice, but just told you what you wanted to hear. No follow up, very frustrating. The 2 positives were the beach and pool area are beautiful and the food was good!

reviews.author: Bob L
reviews.title: Stolen Items in our room as we checked out
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at this hotel, it was clean, good service and beautiful views.  However, as the week progressed staff were constantly trying to come in our room at very unusual times.  They even caught us in our underwear a couple of times...They would knock once and then just come right in...BIZARRE 

Seems like everyone and their mother had a key to our room.

The last day, as we checked out, my Wife's wedding band,bracelet and BlackBerry were missing OUT OF THE SAFE.

We called them and they did not find it, which means even if we left it (we didn't) they took it, same thing as stealing.

If you decide to stay there Do not bring anything of value. We stayed in tower 1 on the ground floor definitely BEWARE of that location.

Phone aside, It's just crushing to lose such sentimental pieces :(

reviews.author: cmcdon5
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 nights. First of all they gave us 2 double beds when we requested king. It wouldn't have been that bad but the double bed was about size of a twin bed! Not one day could we get a chair for beach or pool. This hotel needs more chairs!!!! Food was okay. The hotel he ugly. Looks like a shopping mall. Only thing we enjoyed was the sushi restaraunt and Roberto at sushi was great server. It also took them a few hours to get our room ready after we arrived. So annoying. Definitely should not be number 13 on tripadvisor. Westin lagunamar is a lot nicer of a hotel. We stayed there before.

reviews.author: Wayne R
reviews.title: Money gabbing machine
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week at the Paradisus Cancun, a week shorter than planned due to illness. 
When you consider the amount of money that we paid for the holiday were expecting the height of luxury.The hotel had an impressive entrance and that was about it. The room was pokey and small not luxury at all. There was peeling paint, a noisy old fridge that was the 'mini bar' and a sofa that smelt of stale urine. The so called mini bar was supposed to be refilled every day but it was only done twice in the week. The hotel information said if we wanted more of the drinks etc in the fridge we would have to buy them so we were rationed to two cans of coke in fridge, not in my view all inclusive. We ordered room service and the food arrived cold and unappetising. 
The hotel itself was a pure money making machine and had no interest in the all inclusive package. The restaurants were not of a brilliant standard and the service you received was very so so.  There was no where to go and simply get a coffee or cold drink and just sit and relax or as a takeaway, so you could only drink either with your meals or when on a sun bed outside meaning there was a risk of dehydration in the heat. We got charged for cold drinks from the hotel shop. A serious issue is one of sun beds, they did not provide enough sun beds for all the guests but offered the Bali style beds at a heavy fee. This was blatant money grabbing. We all should have been able to lay on a sun bed without extra costs as we had already paid for the privilege with our holiday. The hotel pumped a heady scent throughout the buildings that after a few minutes made you gag this even went into the dining areas making eating very hard indeed, this aggravated my partners sore throat. Another important point is I was fed up of hearing about 'Royal Service'. The Paradisus offered this at a massive extra cost entitling those with it to get easy reservations at the restaurants, Bali beds, own pool and loads of extras. It made me so cross considering the amount I paid for the holiday that we were treated as second class customers in the hotel. The one small positive is the friendliness off most of the staff. We paid for all inclusive which I would have understood that we all should get all the perks. It's just not a fair environment to holiday in.

reviews.author: Vikvak
reviews.title: Waist of money!!! Terrible food&service!!! Never again
reviews.text: It's not my first time in Cancun all inclusive, but deffently the one I want to forget!! We got small dusty room with a view to the parking (I paid for big room with a lagoon view) the food was horrible I got sick from the food twice!! The staff is very rude and not friendly, a lot of them not speaking English!! The service taking hours!! And you have to make reservations to all the restaurants that not the buffet, the buffet have the same bad food every day. And the restaurants even worse. We had bags in the room(more then one) the wifi was very bad we couldn't use it in the room!! You don't have service on the beach and in the pool when they taking an order it is taking hours!! Somebody steal my sunglasses and no one in the staff didn't try to help me find them!! We didn't had any bath robe in our room!! Everything there is old and not updated. It is maybe 3 star hotel and not from the good 3 stars hotel. I have been in sandos, and live aqua before and they not even close to this hotels!!! Don't go there!! I have no idea how this hotel have this rating in tripadvaisr but you have way better hotels for this kind of money !!! So make yourself a favor and go to anther place  !!

reviews.author: VisitT0r
reviews.title: Кошмар
reviews.text: Отель декларирует себя как 5*, туроператоры его продают тоже как пятёрку. Согласен с Trip, отель еле-еле тянет на 4. Если коротко, то так: стены давно не ремонтированы, грязь везде, лифтовые ковры не пылесосят, кровать шатается, сантехника течёт, халаты и тапочки приходится "выколачивать" из сервисной службы. Персонал не просто тормоз, он бездушный, официанты кучкуются и весело общаются между собой. Но это цветы. Главное, что отель каждые 2-3 дня забивается делегациями конференций - парикмахеров, строителей, продавцов всего чего можно. Так что если вам нравятся толпы американцев, бесцеремонных, напивающихся с утра в буфете, днём на пляже, вечером на коллективных пати, вечно орущих и хлопающих по плечам, ребята - вам точно сюда.

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Old Hotel, Poor Service
reviews.text:
A disappointing experience, so many problems:

1) I arrived and was promised an upgrade to a room with a Jacuzzi and ended up in an old rom that made me feel like I was at a dime store hotel. After complaining to reception they moved me into a new room which matched what I had reserved but the experience of being told you are given an upgrade and then being given a downgrade is not acceptable, even if they did put me back in the room I had reserved.

2) The restaurant reservation service is rediculous.  I arrived back at the hotel after being out and about and went to guest services to make a reservation as I had arrived at 4:55 and the reservation service shuts down at 5.  Guest services was busy and couldn't attend to me right away.  When they were able to help me at 5:01 I was told the reservation service was down and I couldn't have a reservation.

3) The restaurant service was also horrible and after one night of dining at the restaurants I couldn't bring myself to go back.  I ate at Bana which I should add was 3/4 empty at the time.  So amazing that they couldn't make reservations after 5.  It wasn't like the restaurants were hoping.  Then the food was lack luster and didnt seem fresh and on top of that the service was awful.  I was traveling alone and as such dining alone.  I expect restaurant service to be tailored to the customer.  If you are there in a group or with a significant other I can see long waits between courses, but to wait over 30 minutes for an appetizer consisting of 3 dumplings and then another 40 minutes for a main course of four sushi rolls, when I was obviously sitting alone awkwardly in an empty restaurant was an embarrassment to the hotel.  After that I could not get myself to go back.

4) I was going to use the spa services but ended up not doing so after the restaurant service and seeing the exorbitant prices.

5) The pool bar did not have many non-alcoholic options.  I do not drink alcohol and while yes all-inclusives are often taken as an excuse to get drunk and party I was paying for a more expensive all inclusive to avoid that atmosphere.  I was sadly surprised to see that pool bar staff had a very limited repertoire which was pretty non existent for non-alcoholic options.  Generally places have a few non-alcoholic mocktails and here it was bad daquiris or piña coladas.

On the good side, Ignacio on the reservation line was spectacular.  If only the rest of the experience was like dealing with reservations.

reviews.author: abroto b
reviews.title: definitely not Paradise
reviews.text: first you are welcome to hotel Paradisus with sales pit, members rewards and time share! This experience was daily approached by staff to sell. This is not a all inclusive hotel since some items in menu in the restaruants are for purchased. the food is either awful or basic with a over powering after taste of poor olive oil. The drinks was water down and wine was not included must be purchased. Restaruants are not available on a daily bases including the buffet restaruants. traveling off or returning could be hazard to your health due non handrails and eight flights of steps.

reviews.author: tcm312
reviews.title: Very disappointing experience
reviews.text: Don't stay at this hotel! The rooms are ridiculously small, the staff is extremely unfriendly & unaccommodating, and the food is mediocre at best.  Our Deluxe Ocean View Junior Suite was anything but "deluxe"..and very "junior". The room is very crowded, minimal storage for clothing (only 3 small drawers), small bathroom....we had to store our suitcases on the balcony. Speaking of balcony... there was only one chair on the balcony. We requested 2 additional chairs and the front desk gave us an attitude about it. The pool side wait staff were very rude & unfriendly. Most of the hotel staff don't speak English. Ultimately, we met with the hotel manager Alberto to express our disappointment & request a larger room that we would pay extra for. Alberto was no help whatsoever, struggled to offer us a larger room (the hotel was only at 22% occupancy rate) & couldn't have cared less about our dissatisfaction with our experience. Needless to say, we will never stay here again. One last note: There are an endless amount of steep steps to get to the pool and beach with no hand rails. Pretty dangerous set up.

reviews.author: NATILIN
reviews.title: No vuelvo a este hotel!
reviews.text:
Estuve en Cancun a fines de junio, realmente este hotel me decepciono..
De movida te quieren ofrecer un Tiempo compartido a cambio de 3 noches gratis... un almuerzo y que se yo que mas... un fiasco cuando uno esta de vacaciones, 
el bufete deja mucho que desear, no había reposición asi que si llegas tarde... comes lo que hay..
Ni hablar del fuerte olor a lo que el cocinero esta realizando, se ve que no le funcionan los extractores...
La playa, divina!!!! super recomendable...(es la parte en la que el hotel no tiene nada que ver... es la naturaleza la que hizo su trabajo.)
Las piletas, definitivamente no son para niños... a no ser que hayas pagado el Family plan... ahi si podes usar la pileta baja, sino a la general y a flotar, porque no haces pie en ninguna parte (mido 1.70 mt) solo podes estar parado en la parte del bar, o en una especie de jacuzzis que siempre estan llenos de gente...
Ni hablar de el dia que nos ibamos, el remis nos pasaba a buscar a las 17 hs y no nos daban una habitacion de cortesia... con dos chicos de 3 y 6 años que haces.... volas con el agua de mar encima??? Una barbaridad que no lo contemplen-.... Por suerte como me puse muy mal logre que nos extendieran nuestra habitacion hasta las 16... pero despues de muchas idas y vueltas, que la verdad te complican el momento del año que uno espera para disfrutar....  
Por todo esto a esta cadena hotelera No vuelvo mas.........

reviews.author: pranieri
reviews.title: Food was not impressive
reviews.text: I spent a week at the paradisus and I will say for the first time ever on vacation I was glad it was over! After reading the reviews I had high expectations so I did expect a five star experience.  First off the good points. Hotel, beach and service at the pool bar and beach was amazing! However the food in the restaurant was very poor quality.  The buffet was good but u can get sick of the same food every day! I can honestly say I will never go back because one of the important things to me is the food.  The entertainment was none existent...they had it only three nights out of the seven so it can be very boring after dinner with kids.  Kids club was so so and there were no events going on during the day.  Oh ya when we got there I was told it was going to be 28 dollars each room to have the rooms beside each other. Really? We paid for two rooms now they want $56 dollars a night to be beside each other.  The management should be embarassed! Again I would recommend somewhere else if u like food and have kids!  I got a T-bone steak one night and was looking forward to it till it got there! It was the worst steak ever so I took a bit and ended up at buffet.  I never take time to send reviews but I don't want people to spend top dollar and be disappointed like my family was!

reviews.author: TellingWHOLEtruth
reviews.title: Ants, dusty, misleading filth Paradisus
reviews.text: Charge me $56 USD for 4 -1min calls. Hotel is dated, needs renovating. Waited 1.5 hrs in our luggage. We finally got it ourselves from the front door. We called them 3 times and they claim they didn't know where it was. We changed rooms 5 times in 3 nights  literally.Rooms were unclean, extremely dusty, 1980s curtains. Ironing board cover had  massive hole and stains in it. The tub didn't drain. ANTS! Tub fixtures a loose from the wall-looked like cheap patch up of fancy fixtures in all 5 rooms. Looks like mole. Got 7 mosquito bites from inside the atrium. More ants.The royal service is a joke! You will not get the preferential treatment reservations or the turn down service. If ur from US, u will hate the food with passion and disgust even at the themed restaurants. Ibana has very basic sushi-rice rolls which was the best restaurant. The extremely small buffet consisted of gross salads like scrambled eggs in red sauce. Everthg had a sauce on it. No cheddar cheese or simple fajitas. Hardly any mexican food u can recognize and I'm from Texas. We had to get gaucamole from the pool area only. Nearly same foods repeated daily. WthYou will have go out to eat on the strip. WTH.This resort ruined our trip!!!!!

reviews.author: Taylor G
reviews.title: Honeymoon of ANT-INFESTATION + No apologies March 2012
reviews.text:
They changed their name from Gran Melia for a reason...avoid bad publicity

So I made two requests

1) Honeymoon suite
2) NO alcohol since my wife was pregnant

This is what we found. A bottle of cheap wine in a bucket of warm water, cheap beer in the not-even-stocked fridge, a plastic bag like it was just thrown on the counter, and a beautiful rose pedal heart on the bed COMPLETELY INFESTED WITH ANTS. We waited for thirty minutes to get a bed change, I then called again yelling at them, then finally a small terrified boy came twenty minutes later and changed the sheets and cleaned up the pedals. That is enough for me to demand some sort of compensation since we were already way jet lagged and exhausted. They made no sort of apology or compensation. The kicker is that the general manager personally inspected the room and left his card there. Don't worry, I have the whole thing on camera. 

Besides that we enjoyed our stay, but sorry...that makes it one start for absolute failure. When someone pays more, you cater more. That's how business works. When you go beyond the realm of failure into incompetence without apology. You lose.

Save your money, go somewhere else. Food was cheap too. All-inclusive for a reason. 
/

reviews.author: Arissa F
reviews.title: Highly Overrated Hotel
reviews.text: I was very disappointed in my trip to Paradisus Cancun. We "Upgraded" to the Family Concierge service and I couldn't wait to take my children to this luxury experience. Upon our "private" check-in we were assured we would have a private butler (which we never got) and our own cell phone to call if we needed anything (which we never got) our room wasn't ready so we went to eat at one of the restaurants that didn't require reservations (since all of them pretty much did) and the food was horrible. Next we came back to get our room after about another hour of discussion of all the great amenities (ok ok I get it) so after ooohing and ahhhing over the photos online most of this place is run down with fountains that don't work and a distinct mildewing smell and we get taken DOWNSTAIRS underneath the hotel to our "lagoon view" room which is basically an underground room with a view of a wall and a parking lot. Honestly, this is my first time leaving the country by myself with two young kids and even they are ready to go. So we try to make the best of it but it just gets worse. The room looks nothing like the pictures (it's awful) and even THEY want to leave. We try to tough it out but finally give up. We never get our nightly turn down service or milk and cookies even AFTER the second night when I say we are leaving can we at least get it for our final night?? So I at least hope we can get some help from our concierge canceling our spa appointments and tour bookings since they haven't done anything else but they just look at me stupidly. There was one very nice woman at the main front desk that at least arranged our shuttle back to the airport at 4am very efficiently and I appreciate her very much for getting us the heck out of there. Oh and since I have gotten home I have been getting emails from the spa asking for payment for treatments the girls received because they took part of my resort credit away for not staying the entire 5 nights but charged me for them....what the heck???  Customer service at its WORST!!!

reviews.author: sergio a
reviews.title: vacaciones de terror¡¡¡¡¡
reviews.text: desde que ingresas, no te respetan la habitacion tienen sobrecupo, te dan 1000 dolares en cupones que no puedes utilizar, las habitaciones viejas sucias, almohadas apestosas, la misma comida todos los dias, personal prepotente y no resolutivo, ademas estoy viendo que no soy el unico, que tambien otras personas han pasado por lo  mismo. aguas con este hotel no gastes tu dinero, melia paradisus ha decaido. no compres membresia, es un engaño

reviews.author: tom d
reviews.title: worst vacation ever
reviews.text: we had reservations for 22 may thru 28 may, at check in we were told we had no room!  That the air was out, this was an outright lie, they had a large tour group coming and were overbooked.  we were moved to paradisus resourt an hour from cancun in the jungle, this was not what we paid for, if this is the way paradisus treats guests never again, beware, lie No 2 promised a 4 night stay in the future which we did not get.  we did get moved back after the tour group left for a day and a half, in that time we move rooms twice beware of this hotel, they are dishonest.

reviews.author: Jesse V
reviews.title: Not worth the $$
reviews.text: The waiter service was amazing (Note: I do provide nice tips)! Wonderful food and restaurants! The facility has lot's of potential but experienced many service outages. Was left with no running water for a day. Another day no hot water or power. These outages also caused the elevators to stop working for a few days. Very difficult to carry a stroller up and down 5 flights of stairs. Pretty major flaws for a so called 4-star, 4-diamond rating. All of this was communicated to management which did a horrible job in providing any resolution or compensation. Management also failed to communicate any of these problems to hotel guests. This resort has plenty of potential if you have the right staff running the place. I would not recommend this hotel especially at the prices they are asking due to the reasons stated. I paid twice as much as most other resorts only to be very disappointed.

reviews.author: Perspective Hospitality
reviews.title: VERY RUDE Reception/Bell Staff, Constant Smell of Mold....
reviews.text:
If you want to be treated like a second-class citizen, and you LOVE the smell of mold, this is the resort for you.

Also, it is AT LEAST a $20 USD cab ride to get anywhere. To get to the downtown area, its about $40 USD.

RECEPTION STAFF:
I was also in the group with the reviewer below. The hotel staff CLAIMS that they cannot not guarantee a room type, but this simply is not true. When we checked in, the hotel KNEW that they were being dishonest because when we entered the room, the extra bed was ALREADY SET IN THE ROOM!

This meant that the hotel was aware that they had sold the room type that we paid for. The front desk staff treated us like we were just trash. The Petrobras group that were at the hotel were great people, and very kind, and the hotel staff could have taken a lesson in courtesy and kindness from the Brazilians.

FOOD STAFF:
Amazingly helpful people. We always tipped them as much as we could because they gave us excellent service. One problem: they were always trying to sell us DRUGS AND PROSTITUTES! Invariably. I'm not joking. Maybe they were joking around with us, maybe not. Who knows. It was weird.

Food quality was excellent.

PUBLIC SPACE:
It was constantly being cleaned, which is excellent, because the hotel was always spotless. This however didn't seem to eliminate the constant smell of mold around the entire hotel. I have a very immediate and drastic reaction to mold, so I spent my entire stay with a swollen throat and inflamed sinuses.

BELL STAFF:
Bottom line: Petrobras was leaving at the same time as us, so needless to say, the front of the hotel was very crowded with people and bags. At one point I was standing on the sidewalk, minding my own business, and I got plowed down by a bell cart being pushed by a bellman. He didn't even ask me to get out of the way! He just rammed it straight into me!

Whoever responds to this review from the staff, if they even care to response, will probably respond with some stupid policy about the rooms, and some dishonest promise of their dedication to service. All of it is a farse.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS RESORT!

reviews.author: shellied_13
reviews.title: Paradisus Pitiful!
reviews.text: If you are contemplating this resort, let me save you the trouble!  They are not a 5 star, very misleading, a lot of smoke and mirrors.  We arrived and waited at least 30-45 mins to check-in.  Not one welcome drink or cool towel.  The rooms are never what you seem to reserve, they always down grade you once they have your money, no refunds or compensation offered.  Buffett is very repetitive and limited, finding hair in our food more than once.  Restaurants are never full, but they seemed to have a problem seating you if no reservation.  The lounges were odd, and not enough seating.  The avenue bar is where they held the evening shows, get their early so you dont have to lay in a cabana bed.  Cleaning\service staff always seemed to be in our rooms but it didnt show by the lack of cleanliness and lack of water in rooms, and yes, we were tipping!  Room keys constantly not working, many daily trips to the lobby.  Main pool is very noisy with the "party" tunes all day.  Serving staff was always friendly and attentive, with the exception of administration.  Not very helpful or into resolving issues.  This was our 3rd time to Mexico, and probably our last.  Definitley not a good value for the price.

reviews.author: Christine S
reviews.title: Resort from Hell!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for 5 nights.  It was the worst vacation of my life.  We had a dirty toilet in our room to start it all off.  It had dried urine on it.  The food was disgusting and inedible 90% of the time.  Also, on one occasion there was hair in my husbands food and on another there was plastic in it.  No one made up our rooms so we needed to call for towels and water daily.  We had to call for toilet paper and tissue as well.  The entire hotel smelled of mold, and later in the week causing Sinus Infections for us both.  All the while, this hotel is said to be 4.5 star all inclusive resort.  I could go on but this is a 200 word minimum.  I would not recommend this place to my worst enemy.  On top of all this, we contacted them to see about some kind of refund and they said they would do nothing.  Of course not!  They already have our money so what does it matter to them.

reviews.author: Eduardoname
reviews.title: Falta mantenimiento urgente
reviews.text:
Goteras en los pasillos, el aire acondicionado del cuarto nunca enfrio encima de que lo reportamos mas de 10 veces, el personal de seguridad tiene muy mal caracter, los meseros no se aparecen en horas.

No tienen taxis tienes que salir hasta la calle a tomar uno

Nos tuvimos que cambiar de hotel a medio viaje. 

Jamas volvere

El unico que merece ser felicitado es Jacobo de Royal Service

reviews.author: Aralc Z
reviews.title: PESIMO SERVICIO
reviews.text:
He estado hospedada junto con 5 personas más del 8 al 12 de Febrero de este año (2013) y hemos salido sumamente desepcionados y aún más súper enojados.  Recibimos un PESIMO SERVICIO.
Iniciando con el Check In; tardaron 1 Hr. aproximadamente en asignar nuestras habitaciones, la persona que nos atendió la cuál se llama ANA se sentía una "DIVA" parecía que ibamos a pedir un favor, nada amable y con muy mal actitud; en cuanto nos dío las llaves, ni siquiera se tomo la molestia de indicarnos la hubicación de las habitaciones. Una vez llegando a ellas, OOOOH!! SORPRESA, no era el tipo de habitacion que se pago; se pidió con vista al mar y nos asignan con vista al Patio Pffff... regresamos a solicitar el cambio y tardaron otra hora para poder realizarlo PÉSIMOOOO... 
Por otro lado; Es muy DISCRIMINATORIO el trato que se le da a los Mexicanos,cosa que está muy mal, ya que tanto personas extrangeras como Mexicanos podemos pagar sus precios y no tienen por que tratarnos diferente. 
En el restaurante Buffet, solo dos personas nos trataron bien, Nadie nos asignó mesa pero si intentabamos tomar otras sillas ó cubiertos se síper molestabaN "NO ESTABAMOS PIDIENDO REGALADO".
El Hotel es Precioso y muy grande, pero el servicio da muchisimo que desear, es sorprendente que los empleados de mas bajo rango en el hotel sean los mas amables y siempre te sonrían y los que TIENEN LA OBLIGACIÓN DE DARTE UN TRATO DIGNO, no lo hagan 

OJO VACACIONISTAS, NO SE DEJEN GUÍAR POR LAS APARIENCIAS, DE VERDAD SALDRÁN SUPER DESEPCIONADOS. 
JAMÁS REGRESARÍAMOS Y MUCHO MENOS RECOMENDARÍAMOS AL MENOS ESE HOTEL, LÁSTIMA DE TAN BELLAS INSTALACIONES....

reviews.author: William H
reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: It is a 3 star hotel and that's it. We are 10 days into 14 and are almost anxious to get back to Canada. The staff are horribly under trained. This place is too big there are too many deficiencies to post. Frankly ill be surprised if the internet here is even fast enough to send this review. We drove to Playa do Carmen and are a bit sad we didn't stay there, try the Aldea Thai hotel.

reviews.author: Jesús G
reviews.title: DISAPPOINTING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I have been to Cancun several times  and still thinking is the most amazing and beautiful place to enjoy a family vacation or a second honey moon.  HOWEVER my friends, please do not stay in this hotel. I stayed here from January the 4th to the 9th 2013, traveling together with a group of  five other Mexican  families from Monterrey Mexico and Austin Texas. 

I have to tell you that I have had the beautiful experience of staying before in other Paradissus hotels in Punta Cana Republica Doninicana  and in Playa del Carmen Mexico, and the comparison is like from heaven to hell.

Since our arrival, the check in process was a night mare. After several hours, I did receive my room at 6:30 pm at night, after several mistakes regarding my reservation and room assignment,  Finally I got a room full of old furniture and terrible physical exterior conditions. 

I asked to have an interview with the Manager, and he kindly visit my room and confirm the terrible conditions the room presented. He offered his apologies and told me that they were doing their best.  I gave him a lecture regarding Business Strategy and explained him the risks of offering a promise that can not fulfilled.  I guess, I was speaking in the dessert because I received the offer of another room in worst conditions that the original one.

My friends. Do not get confuse regarding the beauty of Cancun, as well the nice beach and gardens this hotel has. I can speak very well in behave of the people that gave us service. Waiters. Lifesavers  and other workers  were warm and kind. However they can not compensate through their effort, structural problems this hotel has. Specialty food is 3rd class quality (Brazilian food is a joke and breakfasts are ok), the rooms and exteriors are old, and the MANGERS need to be trained urgently. 

By the way, careful with your children and  do not leave them unattended. Sometimes the sea is rough.

Please, if you have doubts regarding visiting Can Cun, I strongly encourage you to do it.
PLEASE FIND ANOTHER OPTION FOR YOUR STAY

Regards

reviews.author: cpavilag
reviews.title: DO NOT waste your money on this hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was a nightmare from the very begining, took almost 30 min to check in 2 rooms with nobody else but us at the reception. The quality of the food was very poor, not to mention uncooked rise and very limited options for dinner.  Nobody told us where our rooms where located at a different tower therefore it was impossible to locate our rooms. Now after a whole week since we stayed there I haven´t received my bill, I have been calling eveyday for this situation but yet I have not had any answer. Trust me this is a very bad option for accomodation in cancun, the price if extreamly high for what you are getting, I will strongly recommend other hotels.

reviews.author: Thais C
reviews.title: Hotel lindo. Serviço pessimo.
reviews.text: Ao chegar, a recepcao impressiona pela linda decoracao e a grandiosidade. O quarto tambem é muito confortavel e o lounge é lindo, assim como é delicioso o restaurante japones e todos os drinks. Entretanto, o hotel all inclusive nao deixa ninguem à vontade. Muito do que se pede está fora do "tudo" incluído, o que trona constrangedor pedir qualquer coisa e ficar obtendo a rssposta NAO ESTA INCLUIDO. O tempo todo. Os funcionarios oferecem o tempo todo coisas nao incluidas, ou seja, voce passa o tempo todo sendo assediado para comprar. Acho que eles nao poderiam se chamar "all inclusive", pois só oferecem parcial inclusive. Até as lindas camas de descanso na piscina sao reservadas e nao podem ser usadas pelos normais, embora a tarifa paga por todos seja alta..

reviews.author: Marcela C
reviews.title: Do NOT stay here!
reviews.text:
What a terrible experience! Upon our arrival, after 2 hours to check-in and a very tired baby, we are informed that the promotion we booked with EXPEDIA was actually a little booklet with some louzy coupons. The reason we booked this hotel was because we would get a $200 dollar hotel credit, that we thought we could use to buy food, go to the spa, etc.

After that, the hostess kindly take us to our rooms and tell us that the first morning breakfast was free. We happily get to the NAOS restaurant the following morning and look like complete idiots when informed that there was no free breakfast, but a charge of 35 dollars per person for a crappy buffet.

We came with our daughter who wakes up early, so we were always the first ones to get to the pool in the morning. Let me tell you that there were no chairs available to use, they were all marked with towels/books/sun lotion. We found out that there was a "mafia" of people who pretended to be guests, who actually worked at the hotel for tips to get you a chair. Ridiculous! These people will do anything to get your money!

I felt unsave the whole time. Now reading some of the reviews I consider my family lucky because we didn't get robbed.

The hotel is beautiful, it looks like a 5 star hotel but has a 1 star service. The food SUCKS. Service the worst I have ever experienced. I had to ask for shampoo, soap, new towels EVERY SINGLE DAY.

The bathroom smelled like sewage and I had to call several times to get someone in maintenance to take a look. The guy arrives at the room with some scented bleach and tried to cover the problem.

I would NOT recommend this hotel to my worst enemy!!!!!

reviews.author: Aimen
reviews.title: Horrible stay
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days in september. Its a horrible hotel, dirty and poor service. will not stay here again. The in hotel  restaurants are sub-par and too expensive for the quality. Find another hotel. There are much better deals for your money.

reviews.author: Lovetotravelygc
reviews.title: Disappointed in Cancun
reviews.text: We stayed here in a group of 17 (friends and family), and everyone was hugely disappointed.  We have all been to Mexico countless of times.  This hotel was supposedly renovated, but it shows no signs of same.  The place is horrible.  The rooms smell of mold. The buffets and food everywhere was mediocre.  Upon checking out we were prevented from physically leaving in the car because we hadn't received what they call an exit voucher from the checkout staff even though we had prepaid in full and had a credit card on file.  Upon trying to receive the voucher, they made countless mistakes delaying our hotel departure unreasonably.  All 17 of us have traveled extensively, and we were all shocked at the low standards and bureaucracy at this hotel.

reviews.author: JDNY23
reviews.title: Fast fall from Gran Melia standards
reviews.text: It pains me to write this, because I look forward to our annual trip to Cancun every winter and had even impressed hard to please in laws with a fabulous stay at the Gran Melia in the past. Prior to arrival, I was told in 4 separate emails that construction would be finished by the time we arrived on Dec 18th. That was not the case, and while the work was being done very quickly it still created a lot of noise, kicked up debris, and smelled like a mix of chemicals. Shortly after arrival, we ran into 2 different people who had been robbed which was very unsettling. Negative reviews that we had read on TripAdvisor before coming suddenly disappeared mid stay, all the way back until Dec 2011. Weird. On to drinks. Be careful with the margaritas. They use some sort of sour mix that got me sick after having 2 the first day of vacation. I'd recommend sticking with beer, pina coladas or trying tequila with soda water and fresh lime instead. Reservations at the restaurants were very difficult to get even with the help of a concierge. Make sure you have the reservation slip in writing. Don't bother with the sushi restaurant unless you enjoy blocks of rice with cream cheese cubes. On a positive note, the waiters at the restaurants were very good and attentive, which helped ease the frustration. Things came to a head when our group of 8 was at first turned away for our reservations at Tempo due to 2 of the gentlemen wearing jeans. Upon arrival, we were given a paper outlining the required resort casual attire for men as including jeans and had to go back to the room to get this piece of paper as proof. This issue could have been handled by management in a non-combative way. Once we got through that, dinner was very good and if you can get into Tempo, I'd highly recommend it. Fit for foodies. Checkout was a nightmare with long lines and miscommunication. Thankfully, we were heading to Playa del Carmen afterwards so real relaxation could begin. Every time it seemed like things were getting back on track something else bad would happen. The beautiful beach front and private balcony facing the ocean aren't enough to carry the rest of the baggage involved.

reviews.author: Randy D
reviews.title: Not happy
reviews.text: Booked this resort 6 months ago and was told today this was not available because of the name change from the Gran Melia now we were suppose to be there in 2 weeks and was told they had a alternative place for us for 40.00 dollars a day more we are a group of 21 so this is not acceptable.

reviews.author: Seeeway
reviews.title: This noisy hotel doesn't allow you to sleep and relax
reviews.text: This hotel is definitely over-reviewed by people. It took forever to check in and I got a "ocean-view" room that can barely see the ocean. After a heavy load of school work, I was really expecting an relaxed vocation here, however, when I was trying to get sleep first night, the performance in the below floor started, and the noise make my room like a karaok room. I got headache and can never sleep under such horrible noise. I asked front desk for help, but no one was able to help and said that it is like this everyday, sometimes it's even worth. I have never wrote a negative review of a hotel in my life. My mum is sick and I am so sad that I cannot get her a good sleep here. This so called "4-star" hotel doesn't even have a 2-star level of sound proof! Plus, this hotel is still under construction and it is also very noisy during the day time!

reviews.author: Christy D
reviews.title: 5 Star Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience from start to finish! When we arrived they gave us a delicious welcome drink made with different kinds of juices. My room was very clean and comfortable. The food was amazing, I never ate anything I didn't like. A few memorable staff members: David at Kao, Cinthia at Agua Marina, Manuel at Blue Agave, Jesus at Capella, Omar in reception, Anahi in reception. The host Geovanni was so accommodating and kind when dealing with lots of hungry people. Very convenient location in the hotel zone. The gym was spacious with plenty of weights and a Smith machine. I did not get a service at the spa but the facilities looked beautiful. It was family-friendly but not overrun with kids.

reviews.author: stubell85

reviews.author: Flavio B
reviews.title: Despectivos y mal encarados si no eres extranjero
reviews.text: Espera que te traten pésimamente si no eres extranjero. Los bar tenders de la alberca principal son muy groseros y mal encarados m al igual que CASI TODA la gente en los restaurantes. Fuimos a un viaje de trabajo al rededor de 100 personas de la empresa donde trabajo y no había quien no platicara un mal trato y un mal servicio. A unos compañeros les abrieron la puerta los de servicio de limpieza y los vieron sin ropa. Un cuarto se le inundó a un compañero, a dos más se les fue la luz y a otros dos no les salía agua caliente. En recepción cuando nos dieron habitación, a los americanos les explicaban todo el mapa del hotel y los servicios, a nosotros solo nos daban el tríptico y nos decían que ahí venía toda la información. Nos negaron mesas pero si preguntaban extranjeros los pasaban inmediatamente. La comida pésima! Sin chiste, insípida y siempre tienen muy poca variedad. Solamente tres meseros fueron sumamente amables y atentos, todos los demás del personal con quien interactúanos fueron groseros y despectivos. Pésima experiencia con el servicio. Ni se tomen la molestia de responder si van a dar una respuesta genérica y sin ninguna intención de hacer un cambio al respecto. Cómo encargado de un departamento de UX es preferible que no respondan a que solo den la misma respuesta que dan a todos que solo evidencia su poca empatía e intención de hacer un cambio. Después de años de reeeñas negativas y que sigamos muchos quejándonos de las mismas cosas es claro que no han hecho nada al respecto para exigir una atención más amable y servicial con los clientes.

reviews.author: Schesmila annie T
reviews.title: Not a good experience at all
reviews.text: I spent a week in the hotel with a group of 25 executives. Overall, our stay was disappointing. Many of my group had to request room changes due to problems with the AC, a leaking room size, etc. I came in with my family (3) and was assigned to a king-size bed. I had to switch rooms on my second day without being advised that it would be a noisy area. It was six nights of bad sleep. Even though my dedicated manager (Gerardo) was great at accommodating all my requests, the hotel could have better services. The AC and power in the meeting room went off twice. The F&B were very poor. The quality of pastries and desserts was terrible. Overall, the food was okay, but the all-inclusive package did not offer a good variety of dishes. For my group dinners, I had three main course choices. The only fish offered was sea bass. It was challenging to have avocados for breakfast or guacamole with meals. This shouldn't be an issue in Mexico. For breakfast, there was no freshly squeezed orange juice. That is the least any hotel can offer. The hotel was old, falling into pieces. Unfortunately, the weather wasn't good that week, so the hotel should come up with indoor activities and announce them. Loud music should not pass 10 pm. It disrespects the families and people working, even though it's a vacation resort.

reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: For a 5 Star Resort - The Reserve - You would expect MUCH better!!!
reviews.text:
Arrived Sunday Nov. 3, 2024 - for a work conference.  The check in process was slow - but that was expected with a large group.  Most of the group had paid for the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - adults only - along with perks outlined on their website.    
Once in The Reserve - pyramid 5 - we were advised that any issues or concerns moving forward would be addressed at the Customer Service Desk within The Reserve.   
We were escorted to the room we paid for - an OceanView Suite - when the door was opened - there was a very strong chemical smell - ignoring the smell for a moment and excited to see our OceanView - I ran to the curtains to open them...just to find a large grass berm - you could "see" the ocean if you looked past the berm to the left or right - but there was definitely no OceanView - to pay additional for - very disappointing.  
...back to the smell - it was so bad our Bell Hop was waiving his hand in front of his nose - and made the comment "you can not stay here".  
I went to the Customer Service Desk - I sat down to discuss our concerns with ALANDRA - I expressed the fact we paid extra to be in the OceanView Suite and along with the smell - we would like to be moved to another room.  She very quickly and rudely said "no" - no care for our situation at all.  I pleaded with her - stating even their Bell Hop said we could not stay in the room - and she very bluntly again said "no - we have no where to move you"    ....again pleading with not only her - but her coworker beside her (I did not get his name) - I asked that either one "please come to the room to smell the odour - and you will see - we are not able to stay in the room" - they then spoke Spanish to each other ...laughed...and the gentleman looked at me and said "I will not be going anywhere with you ma'am" in a VERY sarcastic manner.    I WAS MORTIFIED....this is a 5 star resort - and we paid EXTRA to be within The Reserve section.  And to be treated this way - I couldn't believe it.   
It was at this time - a concierge came over - understanding I was upset at this time.  He spoke to them and it was only then that we were told they would "try" to help us get a different room.   Three hours later we were shown to a room in Pyramid 4 and settled there - being told we could keep our "Reserve" wrist bands so we could still receive the benefits of paying for The Reserve upgrade. 

After speaking with many of our business associates - they also had the same experience with ALANDRA - she was rude - unwilling to help with concerns that were brought to her attention.  On more than 1 occasion (myself included) we were told that even though we paid the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - since we booked with a group - we were considered "lesser" (Alandra's words) and we would not receive what the website stated were "perks" of paying for the upgrade in The Reserve section.  Shocked to say the least.

On top of Alandra being so unprofessional:
- the food was...at best...a 6/10 - most of the time coming cold to the table.   
- for being an all inclusive - there were many things that you still needed to pay for if you wanted to take part - food on the menu's / seating at the pool / certain alcohol's
- Spa credits - as part of paying for The Reserve were not honoured because we were part of a group
- MiniBar/Snacks were not replenished daily (for our Reserve business associates either)
- Front Desk - Customer Service - if concerns were brought to them - they also would tell us - they could not help because we booked as a group.  

I just want to make this very clear - when we booked with our group - I am very diligent at researching the resort and pricing myself (I just want to know what we are paying with the group vs. booking ourselves) - I went on Expedia - the exact same dates - in The Reserve - for a OceanView Suite - was $1,500.00 cheaper than what we paid for with the group - so to continually be told we were "lesser" somehow because we booked with a group - we paid $1,500.00 more than if we would have booked ourselves AND we would have not had an issue what-so-ever receiving the "perks" of being a Reserve Guest.   Unreal!

The service outside of The Reserve was great - poolside / waiters/waitresses / cafe's / bars - they were all professional and kind. 

The ONLY thing that deserved a 10/10 for this resort ...the Beach - if you are willing to forego everything I just mentioned above - the Beach is beyond gorgeous!  
White Sands - Turquois Water - Gorgeous!

reviews.author: Chelsea B
reviews.title: The people ❤️
reviews.text:
I want to take a minute to recognize how amazing the staff is. 
We stayed in the Reserve side so most of our interactions were with the staff who worked on that side. 
      Jose was our concerige and he made sure that everything ran smoothly and was constantly in contact with us and making sure that we got the most out of our experience.
      Oscar was the first face we saw as he checked us in and such a nice guy. You couldn't help but stop by for a chat on the way by.
      Julio was the bartender indoors on the reserve side. Friendliest face to come across with the best smile and always ready to mix you a drink.
      Martin was a waiter in the buffet, who has the most charismatic personality. Gave us all a great history lesson and made thee best cantarito that nobody else could replicate. 
      David and Victor at the cabanas were also two great guys. So friendly, had lot of great conversations with them and they were always checking that we had everything we needed.

I saved the best for last ....

Miguel worked around the reserve pool and Sante resteraunt. His service was top notch. He kept the drinks flowing and the food coming. He took incredibly good care of us and we definitely developed a friendship during our stay. 

The hotel was beautiful and very clean and I was in awe over the whole place but the people is what what made it incredible.

reviews.author: Paula J
reviews.title: Nice hotel but could use some updating in the rooms
reviews.text: The resort is quite nice. I do love the vines hanging in the interior. I know they have been renovating the hotel and the rooms. Unfortunately we were in a room that wasn't renovated. Most of the plugs didn't work so it was difficult to charge our devices (we had to do some work while at the resort so devices were vital). Having said that the wifi worked well enough to run Zoom meetings so that was great! They were willing to move us but we decided to stay given the proximity to the pool. The staff were excellent - most were very friendly and genuinely wanted to make your stay memorable. I wish I wrote down the names of some of my favourites. There was one woman who seemed to be hosting at whatever restaurant we went to. She remembered that I was vegan which I honestly appreciated. Also, the server at lemon fish brought us our wine in an ice bucket and included two Coors Light as he remembered one of our party of four liked to drink it. He was great! He also brought us fries even though they weren't on the menu...so fun! The food I ate there (vegan sushi) was excellent! The food was was very good overall. I found something I could eat at every restaurant we tried. There was a separate vegan/ vegetarian menu at each place. There were a few times when the menu item was mislabelled as vegan when it contained cheese but overall I think they did a great job of catering to vegans. My only "complaint" was the buffet. I really wish there were some more options. The food I ate was good but a bit repetitive. Maybe a vegan burger for the grill or vegan cheese for the pizza bar (by the pool)? That would be amazing! I know we are in the minority and I really appreciate the effort made to include my preferences. I can't believe how deep the pools are and how warm. I loved it! I have found at other resorts that the pools are shallow and on the cold side. These were anything but! The property was under capacity but I still found that there were not enough loungers and not enough shade. Many of the loungers were also not working entirely - they did not allow for various settings - sitting upright or partially down etc. I do wish there were more swim up bars. I like to be in the quieter area and found that getting a drink was a bit cumbersome. The servers were great but sometimes I like to go up to the bar itself and check out what they have but I didn't like going into the restaurant to do so.

reviews.author: meshellatl
reviews.title: Good for a work conference but wouldn’t pay for a personal vacation
reviews.text:
Mixed feelings about this all-inclusive but glad I didn’t have to pay since it was a work trip. The good: nice private beach area, a couple of good restaurants (Lemon Fish was definitely the best… Flora and Blue Agave were decent… Malva, the buffet, was average) and the overall grounds were nice and well kept. The air conditioning in the conference area was great and they did a good job accommodating all of us (almost 500 people) during lunch.

The reason I wouldn’t pay…. 1) Made sense that the communal areas didn’t have a/c bc it’s a big lobby - would be a nightmare to keep cool. But the room a/c was minimal at best. Luckily, I requested a floor fan and they brought me one so that saved the trip… not sure how I would’ve been able to sleep without it as the room temp with a/c at the lowest setting felt like 75-80 the whole time. 2) Request to get more bottled water took 2 hours and 2 calls to get 3) it just didn’t have the 5 star feeling. The room was dated, there was duct tape holding one of the elevator panels on… for $450/night for their basic room (I extended my stay) it also seemed tacky to charge $5/usd for each room service delivery (and you had to call them to pick up the dishes after). 

Recommendation to the hotel: get Melia to update your app so customers can order through it and stop charging room service delivery. Invest in updating rooms so there isn’t rust around the faucets, better lighting and air conditioning

reviews.author: Hunter R
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE!! Housekeeping STEALS!!
reviews.text:
DO NOT STAY HERE!! My Lululemon shorts were STOLEN from the room. Management refused to reimburse or replace, even though I found out the housekeeper who cleaned the room have been fired meaning they were stolen. security even went through all of my personal possessions and luggage in case I was lying about not having the shorts which is an invasion of privacy to say the least. 

Another co-worker had her purfume laptop charger stolen from her room. 

Air conditioning does not work in many of the rooms.

Horrible customer service and you may not come home with all your things, DO NOT STAY HERE!

reviews.author: guest25000
reviews.title: May 2024
reviews.text:
We spent 7 days at this hotel. It’s a huge hotel and has growing vines/plants coming down from each level- like a luxury jungle. It’s an amazing design… I wish I could stay longer, I really loved it. So much light from the glass ceiling!!
On the negative side is a bit too warm inside the hotel on the hallways, specially on the last floor (8), not much ventilation. Also, water leaks on hallways (warning signs are in place), ocean is rough (red flag is up) and we had some weeds which I don’t know if anybody remove them from the beach. Swimming pools are clean, towels are available, crew members are very polite and helpful, food is fresh and good ( not much avocado available though). Pizza baked fresh was amazing. Ice cream available by the swimming pool was awesome. Our room was at the second level, didn’t have cutleries or microwave but we had plates and cups, no coffee maker available in the room, but we were close enough to the coffee shop by the buffet. 
Overall I had a good experience and I would happily return

reviews.author: Nelson C
reviews.title: Nice hotel. Bad management decisions.
reviews.text: Bars close at 10:45pm. And when you want to watch the playoff hockey game the response is "we don't get that channel" or "we lost the remote" even though everyone was watching hockey a few nights ago. BTW, some rooms don't have air conditioning. Don't blame the staff, they do their best.

reviews.author: jr0dney
reviews.title: El hotel es espectaular.
reviews.text: La atención del Hotel y servicio es 5 estrellas, piscina, playa, comida y comodidad del cuarto lo hacen un Hotel sin igual.

reviews.author: MaryAnn R
reviews.title: GREAT PEOPLE, beware of CLUB membership.  Research the reviews on it.

reviews.title: Es muy bueno

reviews.author: Sandy O
reviews.title: Agradable experiencia de trabajo

reviews.author: Alan B
reviews.title: Great for business and vacation
reviews.text:
From check in to check out, the staff and experience were wonderful. The facilities are in great shape and the choice of restaurants is very good. The only thing I would have liked is for the A/C in my room to get colder.

We had a conference there, as well, and the room and A/V were top notch. 

I was very impressed that at every restaurant they asked about food allergies and restrictions when you check in or ask to be seated. At the buffet, someone walked it with me, showing me which items had no gluten. There are symbols on many of the items (although I didn’t see a legend to know which is which - some were more obvious that others).

They made me gluten free pancakes the first morning, which was nice, but they were small and had that gummy texture which is common. There was a section of the buffet with gluten free bread (which was a little crusty) and a muffin (I couldn’t really tell what kind, but it was fine for breakfast).

At the fish restaurant, they brought me gluten free soy sauce for my sushi and there were gluten free dessert options. The staff is very attentive to our GF needs, better than most restaurants in the US.

reviews.author: Musicjaime
reviews.title: Average facility. Good food, excellent breakfast servers.
reviews.text:
I was at the Paradisus last week for a work conference and decided to extend my visit by a day to relax end escape New England winter. I had stayed there last year for the same conference as well, and also extended. The hotel has good and average aspects to it in my opinion. I never wrote last year but meant to so I’ll make my one gripe from that now. I spent 2 nights in the “adults only” Reserve and there were kids running around and screaming constantly in the atrium area like it was their playground. I asked reception about it and they did nothing. At least if they made an exception to allow them with their parents they should have controlled the noise for the benefit of those of us who paid extra for a quieter experience. This year I did not bother with the reserve. The Sante restaurant was good, I thought Sel was average. 
This year I was very specific that I wanted a room with two beds when I made the reservation. I was told that that was noted in the reservation. When I arrived, the “gentleman” who checked me in was not friendly or helpful and when I was specific about the two beds he said the room that had been reserved for me had a king bed and if I wanted a second there was a pullout couch. I pulled up my reservation confirmation to show him the two beds and he didn’t care. The rooms are definitely outdated. Mine smelled musty, the floor was dirty (needed to be polished) and while there was a balcony (I only paid for lagoon view) there was no furniture on it. I wanted to dry my bathing suit a bit with the hair dryer before leaving and it didn’t work. In the gym, the equipment is sparse for a hotel of that size. There were free weights, maybe 5 treadmills and 3 elliptical machines. I tried one elliptical and it didn’t work. I tried another and it worked but only for 10 minute intervals, after which it needed to be reprogrammed. To me, all this combined equals average, not a 5 star “luxury” resort. I don’t need 5 stars personally, but when it is billed as 5 stars and priced as such, I expected more.
I ate in the Mexican, the taco (Blue Agave) and the breakfast restaurants, plus group lunches and dinners for the conference. The restaurants were good overall. The highlight for me was the two servers who took care of the outside space for the breakfast restaurant (definitely sit here and not inside…it is far more pleasant with good music and great views). Manuel and Anatola (I may have gotten this name slightly wrong) were both excellent, remembered me and my colleague every day as well as what we like for beverages and laughed and joked with us easily. We had fun with them and service was excellent, which made breakfast a great start to the day.
I’ll go back again next year if the conference is there again and will likely extend my stay by a day or two again, but have a realistic perspective of what to expect, and not. Maybe two beds next year…

reviews.author: Enrique G
reviews.title: Solía ser un muy buen lugar.
reviews.text:
Felicidades a Stelian mi concierge y al equipo del restaurante de alberca/playa en The Reserve incluyendo a Gaby, Valeria y a los chicos de negro. Si, gran parte del personal pone todo de su parte para que tengas una muy buena experiencia. Aquí algunos de los puntos por los cuales pensaría seriamente el regresar a este hotel al cual tengo varios años asistiendo:
HABITACIÓN: En el muro de la cabecera de la cama hay una tira de leds la cual es un buen detalle. Sin embargo, en mi habitación no se apagaban del todo por lo que durante la noche tenias luz en la cara. A pesar de haberlo reportado en repetidas ocasiones, mantenimiento no hizo nada durante toda la estancia. Bastante incómodo. Igualmente se hizo el reporte de un problema en la regadera el cual fue reparado mediocremente.
RESTAURANTES: Para los restaurantes de especialidad alguien tuvo la idea de eliminar el sistema de reservaciones. Ahora, uno debe anotarse al momento del consumo ante lo cual se tiene la respuesta de regresar dentro de hora y media!!! Esto no es lo ideal, verdad? En el caso de “Cielito Lindo” el comentario de la hostess fue que, a pesar de haber mesas disponibles, solo tenia un mesero y un cocinero por lo que no podía asignar mesas.
RECEPCIÓN: Siendo las 2:50 pm me indican que vaya a comer y regrese mas tarde ya que la política del hotel es entregar las habitaciones a las 3:00 pm. Really? Espere ahí mismo hasta que dieron las tres en punto. A esa hora tengo el comentario que “no hay certeza de que la habitación esté limpia” y que no hay comunicación con el area correspondiente. Efectivamente, en Housekeeping no contestaban el teléfono.
ROOM SERVICE: Llamé a solicitar más cápsulas de Nespresso (hay cuatro en la habitación), recibí por respuesta que esa era mi asignación diaria y que no me las llevarían, cosa que cumplieron. Comento que en cuatro días solamente consumí: dos coca cola light, unos cacahuates, un paquete de Oreos y si, bastante café. Parece que hay una nueva definición sobre ALL INCLUSIVE.
EVENTOS: Asistí a una plática en su salón principal. Se sirvió la comida al final de la misma. Los platillos se puede decir eran “minimalistas” por no decir escasos además de que si se requería algo mas que agua, uno debía salir de la sala a conseguir la ansiada bebida.

CONCLUSIÓN: En esta ubicación lo pagado bien lo valía. En esta ocasión no lo fue. La razón de mi visita fue un evento de una institución. No pagué la tarifa del evento sino que me registré normalmente pagando la tarifa “full” en The Reserve por lo que no hay pretexto de que tenía una tarifa reducida. En fin, recibí comentarios de los ejecutivos de la institución organizadora que muy probablemente el próximo año no regresemos, con justa razón y es una lástima. Cuando aquí mismo comenté que no regresaría a Melia Nuevo Vallarta hace cinco años, claro que lo cumplí!!!
