reviews.author: monicopas82
reviews.title: La conferencia en el paraíso
reviews.text: Fuimos por la conferencia ingenieril y que increíble hotel. Desde el momento en que llegué, fuimos recibidos con calidez por parte del personal. El equipo de los restaurantes se lució con su excelencia, brindándonos deliciosas opciones. Realmente se nota la dedicación que ponen. Además agradecer al gerente por su amabilidad y atención a nuestra llegada. Muy buena onda y disposición para asegurarse de que nuestra estancia fuera perfecta fue excepcional.

reviews.author: franciscodiaz1988
reviews.title: buenisisismo!!!!
reviews.text: breve mensaje para expresar lo increíble que fue nuestra experiencia en la conferencia.  No puedo dejar de mencionar el trato espectacular que recibimos en el hotel. Los chicos de Aqua World fueron de gran ayuda para que pudiéramos seguir nuestra apretada agenda sin contratiempos. Las habitaciones estaban impecables gracias a las amables ama de llaves que hicieron un trabajo excepcional.Un agradecimiento especial al señor Atauri, quien estuvo atento desde nuestra llegada hasta nuestra partida, asegurándose de que todo estuviera bien con los inges. Y, por supuesto, la comida fue absolutamente deliciosa

reviews.author: Diego T
reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.text:
Bonito lugar y muy agradable. Se agradece la atención del personal que estan muy atento a cualquier duda o necesidad.

Excelente atención de la srta Anabel glez y Liliana en restaurant malva

Felicidades para ellas.

reviews.author: Samie T
reviews.title: Rafael de lemon fish e Ivonn Nespresso
reviews.text: Buena atención ☺️ las entradas exquisitas y muy variadas, coco de bienvenida super rica , el mesonero Rafael de lemon fish super atento, y los servicios de Nespresso y la atención de Ivonn super excel

reviews.author: Compass41507201153
reviews.title: ALL INCLUSIVE ,NOT INCLUSIVE.
reviews.text: Es un establecimiento confortable en el diseño y ambientación, las habitaciones standares, con personal con un fastidio inherente, pocos cortes o pobremente dispuesto. No es todo incluido, la carta ide restaurantes, incluye cargos adicionales, es limitada y monótona. Hay restricción hasta para el uso de camastros, horarios poco flexibles.

reviews.author: Dawn N
reviews.title: Cielo
reviews.text: Cielo, is a marvelous experiences of senses. The chef, caterer to my vegan lifestyle therefore not making me or the dishes a substitute but as if time stopped and I existed to live in a space where I had my own chef and waiter. I invite you to feel special at Cielo.

reviews.author: Javon K
reviews.title: Cielito Lindovis amazing
reviews.text: Authentic Mexican food made with care and pride. The chef accomadatiles us and even came out to meet us before he prepared our food. At the end I was left feeling like they shared some of the culture with me. Definitely an amazing experience.

reviews.author: FERNANDA R
reviews.title: PESIMO SERVICIO Y ACTITUD DEL PERSONAL
reviews.text:
Hola buenas tardes,

Queria compartir mi experiencia y la verdad es que no fue nada buena:

- Actitud de los meseros y concierge es muy mala. 
- Recibieron un grupo grande y no puede ser que no se prepararon con los insumos suficientes, en todos los centros de consumo de lo que ofrecian en la carta no tenian, si pediamos ciertos platillos su respuesta era "uy no de ese no tenemos" hasta agua del dia decia que no tenian. 
- En el bar del piso 1 solicitamos botana (cacahuates, ya que en su mayoria de los bares ponen y al ser un hotel todo incluido suponiamos que tenian) 
y la respuesta de los meseros y bartenders fue de "uy no aqui no manejamos cacahuates a veces tomamos de un cuarto la botana que sobran de los que ponen en las habitaciones) que respuesta es esa? 
Minutos despues cuando dimos $100 pesos de propina, pudieron conseguir botana y nos la llevaron. 
- No hay buena comunicaciòn entre el personal, nos daban mal los horarios de los centros de consumo, decian que el  ultimo sitting era 10:30 y ya que llegabas al restaurante te decian que no, que era 10:00 pm 

No se si los empleados no se sienten motivados por sus jefes pero si les encargo que mejoren el servicio, me sorprendio bastante la actitud negativa del personal siendo un hotel en Cancùn.

reviews.author: ARACELI D
reviews.title: Congreso médico en paradisus.
reviews.text: Excelente servicio en el restaurante lemon fish, muy buena atención del mesero Antonio, comida de excelente sabor. El mesero Antonio es sumamente amable y conoce a la perfección el menú. Muy recomendable 10/10

reviews.author: Mario Carrillo
reviews.title: Bien en general, muy lindo lugar, puede mejorar
reviews.text: Las instalaciones en general son muy lindas y hay muchos lugares para disfrutar y muchas actividades para hacer. Sólo la infraestructura de los cuartos ya es muy vieja, algunas cosas necesitan ya mantenimiento como los enchufes, por ejemplo, pero la experiencia general es muy buena.

reviews.author: Molly Mae
reviews.title: The Paradisus was an amazing experience!
reviews.text:
The resort is beautiful!  When you walk in you are greeted with a smile from every staff member.  It was a 5 star experience.

We stayed at “The Reserve” portion of the resort and was so impressed with our personal concierge, Diego.  He took care of our every need while we were there!  Be sure and request him when you arrive.

We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Marta S
reviews.title: We are grateful 🙏
reviews.text:
We are so grateful to all the amazing personnel, your hospitality and high lever of professional service. 

No doubt, we will still meet many good people, who are working in this hotel, therefore, right now it is important to say big Thank you to Cielo restaurant team: Adriana Sanchez, David Corrales, Kenya Rias, and, mostly importantly, Moises  Morales. Ernesto Lemano (Lemon&Fresh restaurant).

Many thanks!

God bless your team 🙏 from Canada and Ukraine 💕🇲🇽🇺🇦  🇨🇦

reviews.author: Ada Arrazola
reviews.title: Convención a Cancún 2023
reviews.text:
Súper experiencia fui con mi equipo de ventas . 
Y el servicio es increíble . 
Orlando y Rodrigo de pull bar son super increíbles ( bebidas , atención y rapidez) 
Gracias por esta gran experiencia!
Regresare prontito !!
Los amo❤️❤️❤️😘❤️

reviews.author: Dominique L
reviews.title: Cancun is beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel. Great for relaxing. Found the child free spaces great. Cancun is expensive though. Conference facilities were good and meal options varied and tasty. Staff were friendly albeit a bit reserved. Would travel back for a holiday.

reviews.author: serangoran
reviews.title: Muy recomendable
reviews.text: Me encanta la temática y ambientación del lugar dándole un toque de naturaleza que te hacen sentir increíble, las instalaciones siempre al 100 y por supuesto el personal además de ser colegas y amigos son meramente profesionales . Comida exquisita y mi habitación muy bonita con un toque de color te hace sentir con energía y vida.

reviews.author: Fabio G
reviews.title: Bellissimo resort che sente un po’ i suoi anni
reviews.text:
Il resort e’ molto ma molto bello anche se mostra i suoi anni (oltre 30). Vista la bellezza sarebbe il caso di investire un pochino.
Cibo buono. Non eccelso ma molto vario.
Vorrei menzionare Aaron Ruiz. Abbiamo avuto qualche problema all’inizio ma Aaron ha risolto tutto in maniera perfetta. 
Per Aaron punteggio 5 stelle plus!

reviews.author: stijn r
reviews.title: Thank you Chris!
reviews.text: Super goed geholpen door Chris van de guest service. Fantastische service. Ontzettend bedankt!! (10/10). Verder heerlijk gegeten en prachtig hotel. Fijn dat we na het uitchecken nog mochten blijven en van alle faciliteiten gebruik mochten maken tot onze vlucht vertrok

reviews.author: J-RO
reviews.title: Beware .   slip and fall Hazzard
reviews.text: Hotel rooms are outdated . overall a ok hotel .   Best experience was the Pool bar near " lunch Box " the server Gabby was amazing . Best employee by far .    Twice I fell on wet floors with no caution signage present .  I was offered creams and was told they would go to Pharmacy to grab advil if I gave them Money.  Requested accident report twice and told not ready yet.   Buffet food was the same everyday  The Lemon fish was good . service was shaky .

reviews.author: Marc K
reviews.title: Great food and wonderful people that treat u like family
reviews.text: Hotel room had some water leakage problems from the ceiling, but aside from that, I can’t say enough about how great and friendly and helpful the people and staff were.  Food was especially excellent also.  A great shout out to Gaby and Seney from by the pool bar, they were so amazing, happy and attentive, wonderful charming people that make u feel welcome like family!  They truly heightened our experience and we will miss them! We wish them the best and hope to see them again in the future!  Cheers! Hola!

reviews.author: Tam N
reviews.title: Whatever you do, do not book here!!!!
reviews.text: This place is absolute horrible. Front desk staff has zero clue about customer service or being proactive regarding concerns from guest. Everything is simply ignored and pushed off to the next shift. No issue I brought to this staff was ever addressed and even when it was it was 2+ hours for any kind of resolution!  And to be clear they never resolved anything without prompting. I wouldn’t suggest booking here if you’re looking to have a restful and relaxing vacation. Now if you want a vacation where  you’re constantly arguing for basics like towels or even having a room with  working plumbing (literally no water in the suite and couldn’t flush the toilet)  this is the place for you. Water dripping from the ceiling outside the room for two days. When I reported it to Johnathan he said they would have to investigate…I said no need let me show you the video! It’s like this place opened yesterday and everyone in management is clueless! Literally everyone! They offered a spa service to accommodate us for our troubles…this is after three days of fighting but at that point why would I trust you all to do ANYTHING! Now the wait staff worked hard and as best they could but I certainly see why they went on strike a week ago! Do. Not. Book. Don’t waste your money!

reviews.author: Yair Balderas
reviews.title: No lo recomiendo
reviews.text: El hotel se ve muy bonito, tanto por fuera como por dentro, pero los cuartos son viejos y tuvieron muchas fallas tecnicas, la maquina de la puerta que cierra el cuarto se quedo sin bateria un dia y no pude entrar a mi habitacion hasta como 30 minutos despues. El personal es muy atento pero es lento. La comida es buena. El hotel tiene muchas plantas internamente por lo que puede causar alergias a los que no estan acostumbrados.

reviews.author: Lina M
reviews.title: El mejor servicio
reviews.text:
Excelente servicio, comodidad y opciones en los restaurantes.
Lo más destacado: la atención de Gaby en el
Sector de la playa, con recomendaciones apropiadas y la mejor disposición para hacer de nuestra estadía una experiencia especial.

reviews.author: karenruiz2023
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel
reviews.text: El servicio estuvo excelente, solo le hace falta una remodelación urgente a las habitaciones, el A/A no funciona bien,  le hacen falta contactos eléctricos en las áreas publicas, ya que no te puedes poner a trabajar en ningún lado si no es tu habitación. El hotel esta muy bien ubicado

reviews.author: jamesV8732NO
reviews.title: 3-star, not a 5 star property
reviews.text: Needs a renovation. Property calls itself a 5-star; it is three star at best. All areas including guestrooms need a renovation. Very worn looking. AC was LOUD in the guestrooms. Some of my associates had rooms that would not cool down. No AC in open lobby areas - very hot and humid. And this is not open air - these areas are separated by doors to the exterior. Staff was very friendly and food was ok. Lemon Fish (Paid restaurant) the food was great.

reviews.author: ronhubbard
reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: the bartenders in the Ginger bar ,Luis Cortez, Cecila Sostre, Wendy Morales, David Conlinero were outstanding in services they provided to us and our group,they are a great asset to your hotel also nighty entertainment was fabulous

reviews.author: Discover35685026830
reviews.title: All inclusive the right way
reviews.text: Friendly staff.  Solid food.  Beautiful beach.  Working air conditioning.  Clean facilities.  This is top notch for all-inclusive.  Armando and Atilano keep the coffee flowing and provide excellent service in the buffet/beachfront dining area.  Very happy here!

reviews.author: Amadea N
reviews.title: ABSOLUTELY AWFUL AND I WILL NEVER VISIT MEXICO AGAIN
reviews.text:
EVERYTHING is wrong with this place. To be clear, I stayed at the Reserve side of Paradisus Cancun. This means $500USD/night. My company then had an offsite at the regular side of Paradisus Cancun. This is  day 3/10 and I’m already close to tears. 

Service:
They love to talk the talk, but won’t walk the walk. Everyone here is trained to be super nice and accommodating, but when push comes to shove, it’s still a no no no. 

Day 1 - Check-in:
On checkin, they found two bookings as my company  booked through the reservation desk and there were two overlapping nights. My company confirmed with me they had not booked the overlap, but the front desk kept insisting I pay the additional cost. They did this “pleasantly” by showing me a piece of paper with the amount due repeatedly. I insisted no, and they
 kept going back and forth/calling people/checking with managers until after an hour or so confirmed they would not charge me the overlap and cancel it on their own. Given the mishap, which made me miss the sunset/ability to go to the pool or beach, management said we could keep our Reserve wristbands throughout our whole stay. 

The Reserve room, Junior Suite Ocean View:
The room was nice upon arrival, the view was really nice. But the room felt “new” and it’s hard to explain until you experience it itself but once again it was like the service - empty promises. Things were broken, super cheap, lights wouldn’t turn off, TV only played cable and couldn’t connect to anything despite having all the right cables. 

The Reserve concierge experience:
As part of the Reserve, you get a personal concierge that communicates with you via text and is supposed to book things for you. Great! Don’t get excited, it’s just a texting buddy. Because they don’t onboard you - they don’t tell you what parts of the resort require reservations (that they help you to book). Why does this matter?

Things that require a reservation here:
1. ALL restaurants except the Mexican place and the buffet place. This means if you do not reserve, you will NOT be eating at any of these restaurants. We arrived on Saturday, and everything was booked upon arrival. ??? 
2. Bali beds by the pool AT THE RESERVE SECTION THAT YOU PAY FOR. All beds are booked, they remain unoccupied for hours but you can’t have them unless you actually book them through your concierge. The service staff will tell you to leave nicely though LOL 

So yes, we paid the Reserve price but could never use any of these exclusive things LOL. 

CALCULATIVE to the tee:
Forget hospitality here. It’s all about what they can overcharge you for. Spent so much time negotiating with the front desk that you are right up to your checkout time? $50 an hour if you want to have a late checkout. 

Bring your own stuff because the cheapest small bottle sunscreen here is $27USD. My boyfriend bought one and left it at the counter of the shop, we came back the next morning for it and they said they’d have to check the cameras and it would take 3-days. Made us buy the sunscreen again. 

Coconut water? $10 each coconut 

Daybeds? $250 each. 

Food:
The Mexican place is dank, and I think it’s because it does exactly what it does without trying to pass off as a international cuisine. All other international foods were subpar. WITHOUT MY CONCIERGE’S HELP, because she had told me it was impossible, I managed to get into Sal. Sal is a steakhouse included in the Reserve experience, but reservation only. We got there right on opening and waited an hour for the host to see if he could fit us in. Despite the restaurant being 40% empty, they gave us a table. Food was ok. 

If you don’t drink alcohol, which we do not, this resort is not worth it. Their regular drinks are bad, their fruit juice is all canned and not actual juice. I’ve only been drinking water and while writing this seated at Senta, I have purchased a $10 coconut.

Check-out/Switching rooms:
Despite having already booked me for the second room AND not granting me a late checkout, the Reserve front desk said my next room would not be available until 3pm. On checkout, they said we would have to return our Reserve wristbands, even though they had said we did not need to as a courtesy. Seeing that this was another empty promise, I insisted and they obliged. This band only gives me access to the Reserve pool, no food or reserve desk etc. 

TLDR: ABSOLUTELY NOT. I could be paying $500 a night at a plethora of other hotels and being perfectly satisfied. But no, I’ve been on the brink of tears since arriving and today I finally cracked.

reviews.author: steve p
reviews.title: Lots of fun. Food was good
reviews.text: We visited the ginger bar several times.  Luis, Cecilia, David and Wendi were the best!  They were super friendly and helpful.  We have traveled often and they were some of the best we have met!  They made us several different drinks and were accommodating to any different requests we had

reviews.author: Patricia P
reviews.title: Find Cecilia she is AMAZING
reviews.text: I have never traveled to Mexico until this trip. I was not disappointed. On our first night we met Cecilia. She instantly became my go to . I asked each evening where she would be working so that I made sure to have our group at her bar. She was attentive , she shared stories of Mexico and always made sure we had what we needed before we even asked. Cecilia was the absolute best , she deserves 10 ⭐️ stars ! Thank you Cecilia for making our trip the best . We wish you the best ! Love your new Maryland family

reviews.author: Ricardo S
reviews.title: excelentes los meseros del bar
reviews.text: La atencion de la srita Karina y Salvador de Kanna  en el bar enfrente de la playa en las salas, muy atentos, amables, cordiales y amistosos. no dejaban de preguntar si se nos ofrecia algo mas. cinco estrellas para ellos

reviews.author: Daniel G
reviews.title: Discriminación en su personal
reviews.text: El hotel muy bien, desafortunadamente el trato del personal en general malo; se les notaba estresados y con muy mala actitud hacia nuestro grupo. ¡Eso sí!  su actitud hacia los demás huéspedes extranjeros cambiaba radicalmente  y era muy notoria la diferencia de trato y la discriminación. Sigo sin comprender esa postura del mexicano pateando al mexicano. Lamentable!

reviews.author: Braulio G
reviews.title: No vale lo que cuesta
reviews.text: Habitaciones anticuadas, plagas en los cuartos, falta de contactos, falta de luz en habitaciones, servicio pésimo, comida sin sabor. Discriminación de compatriotas a pesar de dejar propina. Auque, como dejar propina con semejante experiencia?.

reviews.author: elenaromo
reviews.title: Horrible servicio
reviews.text: Discriminación por parte del mismo personal de restaurantes y barras, si no les hablas en inglés no te atienden, las habitaciones en malas condiciones eléctricas. El minibar y plancha no servían, las bebidas tibias y no se podía ni planchar por que no servía nada

reviews.author: Dom I
reviews.title: Apoyo profesional
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene un área de alimentos y bebidas que los encargados Enrique y Wagner tienen la mejor actitud de servicio.
El córner de Nespresso es una delicia y la persona que está en la mañana Alejandro es muy servicial y atento .
Nos hicieron una paella 🥘 que estuvo de 10
Solo las habs tienen unas almohadas poco adecuadas y cómodas
Alma y Marisol

reviews.author: Alejandra Rodriguez
reviews.title: Sante en Paradisus
reviews.text: Amo profundamente la comida y la atención de todo el personal y en especial a Diego, Valeria y Moises de Sante ❤️❤️❤️❤️. No dejen de probar los chilaquiles y el pan francés en el ares de Reserve. Y disfrutar Del Mar

reviews.author: Eric L
reviews.title: Phenomenal vacation/ work trip
reviews.text: Atilano Eligio Herardo Manuel was the best service in town. Never had to wait and always was attending whatever we needed did a phenomenal job will come back. We never thought we would enjoy our first time like we did.

reviews.author: corporatetripper
reviews.title: Great place to relax
reviews.text: Though not for those who are on a tight budget, it is a great place to relax and do nothing but experience the scenery and food. The view from even the second floor was beautiful and the lagoon side is still great for sunset views.

reviews.author: Joe and Becky L
reviews.title: Amazing Trip!
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved this resort!  Entertainment every night and excellent customer service.  The staff did a very good job keeping such a big resort so clean.  Everyone was extremely helpful and personable.   

We would like to recognize Rodrigo, Arnulfo, Pascual, and Martin in the buffet restaurant that went above and beyond for us.  All of them always made sure we were taken care of.  They made sure our wine glasses were always filled.  They appreciated us on our last day and made it very special for us.

We would also like to appreciate Adriana in the buffet restaurant for taking care of us.  As well as Alejandro in the Nespresso Cafe.  He always had an excellent attitude and smile.  He talked to every customer and made sure we were all taken care of.

Axcel was very friendly and always approached us to make sure we were having a good time and if we needed anything.

The dancers were phenomenal and worked and mingled with the audience.  They made every night and theme something we looked forward to nightly.

We loved our room and felt very comfortable in it.  The housekeeping service did a great job cleaning it.

As you can tell from our review, we were completely happy and satisfied with how nice the resort and staff are there.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Tere Q
reviews.title: Experiencia maravillosa!!!
reviews.text: Porque las buenas experiencias deben también de compartirse, estoy impresionada y agradecida con la calidad de atención al servicio que tienen y en especial darle gracias a Estephany Gonzáles, me contacte con ella para pedirle ayuda y poder darle una sorpresa a mi esposo el cuál estaba en un viaje de trabajo en Cancún y yo en Puebla, le platique mis ideas y ella hizo un momento mágico, le llevaron una rebanada de pastel al restaurante y Estephany fue aún más allá y me pidió unas fotos de nuestra familia las cuales imprimió y decoro la habitación de mi esposo sin duda alguna ella sabe cómo crear experiencia y superó todas mis expectativas si quieren un momento increíble en el hotel Paradisus Cancún lo hacen posible y Estephany hace magia

reviews.author: Sonia M
reviews.title: Trabajo
reviews.text: Wendy la mesera del bar muy buena pudo muy bien ambiente súper buena onda el servicio de la alberca genial el servicio del bar es muy poco tiempo lo deberían de agregar por más tiempo porque el hambriento muy bueno se acaba muy temprano

reviews.author: TomL911
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant: Excellente!
reviews.text: Outstanding meal and service at the Lemon Fish restaurant. Very nice atmosphere. Terrific assortment of sushi. Raphael was an amazing server…friendly and attentive for our group of  seven. Highly recommend this standout restaurant at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Luana S
reviews.title: Rafael Lemon Fish
reviews.text: Rafael was actually the best. Not only did he give us the best food recommendations but also the energy level was spectacular. He was was excited to be here for us & get our travels started. The food was absolutely incredible & amazing

reviews.author: Anabell
reviews.title: Muy bueno!
reviews.text: Muy buena experiencia!, mi equipo y yo disfrutamos de una estupenda cena. Todo estaba delicioso, los meseros son muy amables y la picaña estuvo espectacular! El lugar es hermoso y el ambiente es muy relajante. Los cócteles están muy buenos

reviews.author: itsmartinelli
reviews.title: You MUST dine with Rafael at Lemon Fish!
reviews.text: Lemon Fish and its staff (Rafael specifically) made our night so special! The food was outstanding and such a meaningful way to end our time in Cancun. Our team was able to relax after a three day conference and experience some of the best food that Paradisus Cancun has to offer. Don’t miss this!

reviews.author: Ronald K
reviews.title: Amazing Food and Service at Lemonfish
reviews.text: Everything from end to end was incredible. I can't believe the best sushi in Mexico is at an all inclusive. Rafael treated my group and I like we were foreign dignitaries or corporate executives or movie stars. Would recommend this resturant to anyone who wants a world class experience at the Paridisus.

reviews.author: Fabiola M
reviews.title: Conferencia Santander Enero
reviews.text: Fue una muy buena estancia, los cuartos y la alberca muy lindas. Mi queja es al final, tuve que hacer el checkout rápido el 19 de enero del cuarto 3104 y olvide unos tennis. Cuando me di cuenta fui al Lobby y me ayude el bellboy Felipe, no los registraron en lost and found y checamos el cuarto y no estaban. Regrese al Lobby a poner mi queja, deje mis datos y me trataron como si Yo hubiera tenido la culpa, que revisara bien mi maleta cuando es obvio se donde los dejé. Yo perdí unos tennis pero ustedes pueden tener pérdidas mayores, los dejé en el cuarto no tengo duda y limpiaron casi después que salí. Adidas blancos con la parte de atrás rosa.

reviews.author: agarcia2023
reviews.title: Cucarachas en las tuberías y mala atención en recepción
reviews.text: Mi cuarto tenía cucarachas que salían de las tuberías por la noche. Además, un amigo tuvo problemas con su pago y lo trataron como vagabundo en lugar de ser comprensivos y dar una ayuda servicial. Al final el pago procedió pero no nos quita el mal sabor de voca.

reviews.author: Rocio M
reviews.title: Servicio exceptional
reviews.text: La experiencia en Paradisus fue inigualable, la calidad del hotel y el servicio sobretodo; insuperables. Destaca el personal siempre amable, súper resolutivo y con una atención al cliente impecable. Especial agradecimiento a Natanel que nos atendió en el Lunch Box el 13 de Enero para una cena de empresa grande, y salió todo perfecto. Un servicio maravilloso. Espero volver pronto!

reviews.author: Rubria l
reviews.title: Máster osteoporosis 2022
reviews.text:
Excelente atención en el restaurante malva desay, por martin,Gerardo y eddi, estan al pendiente de tus bebidas , retiran los platos , y siempre con una gran sonrisa .
Las mesas con adecuada higiene y muy bien montadas .
Una excelente vista al mar

reviews.author: Julio Cesar H
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia
reviews.text: El mejor servicio por parte de Karina y salvador… totalmente recomendable. La atención fue de primera, en kanna el bar cerca de la playa la atención fue súper, siempre al pendiente de todo lo que necesitamos

reviews.author: Alejandro E
reviews.title: Buena atención, limpieza y organización por el staff
reviews.text:
Excelente atención de Rodrigo Gorocica en el restaurante buffet, buena experiencia y limpieza de todas las instalaciones
Bebidas excelentes , bares y ambiente
Servicio de habitación bueno, excelen late vista 
Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaasssaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

reviews.author: OOliver D
reviews.title: Repetiría mi estancia
reviews.text: Me gustó el lugar, siento que si es un buen calidad-precio, sin embargo, tuve un problema en mi habitación con la televisión. Hacía un ruido extraño, les comenté, pero no le pudieron dar solución inmediata. La comida y el servicio fueron buenos, por ello volvería.

reviews.author: Leticia Imelda S

reviews.author: Lilian s

Foi tudo muito maravilhoso, fui super bem recebida pelos funcionários Janeth,  Alberto e Fernando, eles são maravilhosos, muito educados, uma experiência inesquecível. Tudo perfeito 
Grata equipe Brasil 
Beijos

reviews.author: Andres21216
reviews.title: No fue proporcional en mi caso el costo al servicio en general
reviews.text:
Prácticamente fueron 3 motivos:

1. Habitación.- tenia una tv que ni prendía, si bien es cierto estuve por un evento que llegaba muerto a la habitación esos 15 o 20 minutos de ver tv para mi son relajantes. Tampoco servía la lámpara del medio entre las 2 camas y finalmente el sistema de aire acondicionado es muy viejo.

2.Comida.- solo probé a parte del buffet que le doy 3 estrellas de 5 Lemon fish que le doy 4 de 5 y blue agave que a ese si le doy 5 de 5. El día viernes de mi salida me encontré con una cucaracha entre la decoración de la pared a 30 cm de mi. NO TERMINE MI DESAYUNO

3.- Servicio personal.- es importante que SIEMPRE EL PERSONAL SALUDE CON UN BUENOS DÍAS, en su mayoría parecían huéspedes los trabajadores muy hostiles, incluso me negaron una bebida que nada tenía que ver con mi “pulsera” un jack con coca

Con esto el precio cancelado no tiene nada que ver con el servicio prestado… preferiría ir a los hoteles de grupo palace o secrets

reviews.author: Palmitos1965
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN, AN UNBEATABLE PARADISE ☀️
reviews.text:
PARADIDUS CANCUN, is a special place surrounded by great service and amazing nature. The best beach you can ever imagine is awaiting for you there. What I love about that All Inclusive hotel is that you can choose your stay based on your own budget. My experience in Reserve was absolutely great, my concierge  assigned Mr. Aaron was able to meet all my needs and expectations in a timely manner! 

We produced two big events this past two weeks with 100% success. 

BANQUET MANAGER, Mr. Jose Vargas was without any doubt one of the most important leaders of our events. His leadership and knowledge was key to manage from room blocking to all the logistics involved in the complicated world of food and beverage.

CHEF Apolinar, was always open to bring creativity and quality to the table, while managing our budget efficiently.

SOMELIER Iran, was always in the perfect location to bring passion and knowledge of the best wine your meal can be accompanied. 

LOGISTIC MANAGER Ricardo, truly understood our needs, offering the best route for our group. 

The overall team of Paradidus is difficult to find in any other hotel of the world! 

Thank you Mr. Mynor, you are a leader that understands how important your people are. Without any doubt, we will repeat 💚

reviews.author: Christian C
reviews.title: Excelente Experiencia !!
reviews.text:
Raul y Rosane fueron muy attentos à todos los détalles que necessitaba. Fueren muy profesionnal.

reviews.author: Resort229241
reviews.title: Conference Stay
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus for 10 days and it is truly one of the best hotels I've ever stayed at. Aside from the gorgeous grounds and facilities, what amazed me was the fantastic attitude of the staff. It's not possible to walk past a staff without them giving a warm hello. In particular, Astrid was amazing, she is an absolute ray of sunshine who went put of her way to help me, she even gave me her WhatsApp number and would check up on me regularly. I have never seen this level of good customer service. Raphael and Moises from cielo and lemon fish restaurants were also really kind and welcoming. I would feel privileged to come back here!

reviews.author: T0sin
reviews.title: Remarkable experience
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancún is beautiful, warm, it has a heart! Lunch at Lunch Box, dinner at Lemon Fish  served by the most efficient waiter ever- Alejandro Camelo. Alejandro deserves to be commended and he needs to share the secret to his amazing skills. He is a thoroughbred professional. Fernanda Paola at reservations was so kind, patient and helpful as our trip neared. She supported with all information. She is a leader.  Astrid at the front desk is worthy representative of this hotel. She was so helpful when we needed to find our colleague who was not answering her calls. Coolio Ceasar is very responsive and responsible.  Jesus at the pool side is a remarkable young man who made a lasting impression. All these people and more will make us come back!

reviews.author: Robert F
reviews.title: Great stay and fun hotel ,great services of food ! And personal
reviews.text: Great options of food at Paradise Cancun , The rooms are good mine was Facing the pier  here and the atmosphere is quiet and relaxing. Staff will go way and beyond to help. Specially Ramiro Arrulfo Teresa !

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Back to this hotel after five years - third visit in fifteen years
reviews.text: I came here for business meetings again, not by choice. Five years later and I get an outdated room again. Maybe some rooms are renovated but don't be fooled by the website pictures. My friend's room ceiling collapsed while she was in the room because of water damage.   She was lucky not to get hurt.   The hotel changed her room and upgraded to the V.I.P section.   My room had two queen beds.  The balcony overlooking the lagoon was not very appealing; the chairs were dirty, and so was the balcony, but great views. I also called to complain I had no hot water; the receptionist told me to let the water run longer. I took cold showers during my whole stay.   The buffet restaurant had a good selection of food. The wine in the all-inclusive package was horrible. We could order wine; however, if it is all-inclusive, please have decent wine for the guests. The restaurants were ok, not fine cuisine but acceptable. The pools and the beach are lovely; come early to find good chairs. The lobby where you check in is charming, then the main area in the middle of the hotel is a central jungle of plants; that produces too much humidity. In fifteen years, I have been here three times. I think it's time they change this look. Although the hotel seemed short-staffed, most employees I ran into were always pleasant at the bar and restaurants. I have to add I appreciated the coffee shop at the exit to the main pool area with muffins and donuts. I tried to change my room, but because it's a group reservation, the staff told me it was impossible. The best part of this hotel is the ocean view rooms, pool area and beach views. Depending on which room you get once you check in can change your experience.

reviews.author: Nathalia M
reviews.title: Lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text: Visité el restaurante de limón y fish con mi familia, el servicio fue excelente, la comida fue maravillosa, el servicio fue impecable.  Cuando visites, pregunta por Jorge y Miguel.  y un agradecimiento a los chefs Karen y Antônio por hacer la noche más especial.

reviews.author: Usman B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: After visiting 6 resorts and numerous restaurants I can honestly say Lemon Fish has been the best experience ever and special thanks to Jorge & Miguel who were our servers along with Mario & Karen the chefs! I can not emphasize enough how amazing they all were and making our dinner the best night so far! Hands down they deserve a 10/10!!!!!

reviews.author: Dianie C
reviews.title: DO NOT Recommend!!!
reviews.text:
Worst experience ever! What a rude environment! We spent almost 2 hours to check in. During that time we asked 3 different customers service reps to help us check in perhaps at a different counter, and they all said that we needed to wait for assistance at the counter we were at, because that was the only one available at that time. After it was finally our turn the girl at the counter told us we needed to go to a different counter because we were part of a group that were there for a convention and the other counter had all of our information and she didn't (but all counters have the same system, so how come she wouldn't be able to see our info?). I refused to go to another counter to start another line after waiting almost 2 hrs for them to tell me that, and after 3 people from their staff had assured us that's where we needed to check in at. After I firmly told her a few times I was not going anywhere else, she decided to check us in.
Also, when I was making the reservation online their system refused my card 3 times telling it declined. I checked with my bank and they confirmed the hotel never ran it through, therefore the bank never declined the transaction, so their system was acting up. I then decided to use the PayPal option they had available at their site. The transaction went finally through. Going back to the day we checked in, the girl at the counter decided to tell me that she was going to have to reverse the transaction because I used PayPal and it was under my business name and not my personal name (so why take the payment in the first place?) What the heck is wrong with this people??? After arguing for a while we were finally able to get our room keys... THE ROOM: Hot as hell! The entire hotel is hot. There is no way to get the AC pumping in your room, they control it. There is not enough lighting either. The phone didn't work. And the wall outlets have all been closed so you can hardly find where to plug your phone or even your flat iron!!! Some of our friends had problems also from lights not working AT ALL to even being getting someone else's room! Imagine being changed from room to room 3X and going into one and finding someone else already there. SHM!
We went into one of their restaurants and when one of my friends went to go serve herself she was told in a very rude way to put the serving spoon back, wait 5 min and come back, because they weren't ready and they were doing us a favor by opening a few minutes earlier. Ahh! And be ready for only bottom-shelf spirits. I mean, we supposedly are at a 5 Star Hotel (not cheap at all!!!), so you would expect some sort of better customer service and come on! Better maintenance too! I DO NOT recommend this place to nooo one! Cancún is beautiful and their people are nice, except for that inhospitable place!!! Very disappointed.

reviews.author: Ms. Young
reviews.title: Attended a business event at Paradsisus Resort
reviews.text:
The    Paradisus is a beautiful, all inclusive resort in Cancun. The staff in all areas of the hotel were #1. They were sweet, easy spoken, helpful and polite. They took the time to take care of all of your needs. I ate at the Malva Restaurant most days there. I came in the next night and the waiter remembered me and told me that I had lost an earring there the night before. I couldn't believe it. The guest services rep, Raul was really nice and held conversation with me while I waited for security to bring my earring. 
The room is large but a little dated. The junior suite does not have enough electrical outlets and some of the lights did not work. The property it self is absolutely beautiful and I would highly recommend it to anyone traveling to Cancun.

reviews.author: MauricioAlbert9

reviews.text: Lo mejor es el platillo Tacu Tacu y los postres, muy agradable lugar y sobre todo el servicio de Rafael Cime y su amplio conocimiento de la cocina, supo explicar cada platillo a detalle. Felicidades por el lugar y decoración

reviews.author: Amber
reviews.title: Boujee
reviews.text: Don’t believe the negativity. The resort was very clean, the staff was amazing. We had a private check in since we were there for business but the staff went above and beyond to make us comfortable: beautiful drinks when we arrived, our room was ready on time and we loved the key bracelets! So much nicer than plastic neon ones. We spent most of our time on the adult side so I can only speak to that: the restaurants were fabulous, the buffet always had something to eat even if your picky, we also had 24 hour room service and a fully stocked mini bar with 3 different kinds of beers; chips, peanuts, candy, all the things so if you really aren’t happy with the food.. you can’t blame the resort lol. There was gorgeous solariums and decor all throughout one of the most lovely entrances I’ve seen. There was no pressure for tips (of course appreciated) we found transportation easily off the resort and overall just had a 10/10 experience. This is my 5th time to Mexico and I’ve been to a few different resorts in my travels. This was by far the best. Sadly I didn’t take too many photos because I was too busy having an absolute blast and enjoying the beauty and serenity of the resort.

reviews.author: Lucy M
reviews.title: Muy Buen Servicio en Paradisus Resort
reviews.text: Todos los empleados de el hotel se portaron muy amables. Siempre ofreciendo ayuda y sobre todo Didier de Malva que siempre está al tanto de los huéspedes que deciden comer en el restaurante. Siempre al tanto de los huéspedes Didier, Alfredo y todos los servidores me han tratado con mucho respeto y me han echo sentir como en casa. Y además la comida es muy buena con mucha variedad. De verdad recomendó este hotel y el restaurante Malva.

reviews.author: Ariana V
reviews.title: PH Viaje
reviews.text:
Hermoso lugar! 100% recomendado el hotel y El Staff siempre muy amables y buenísima onda. Los siguientes fueron los que nos atendieron y muy recomendados 

Activities
Jesus
Saul
Celeste
Andrea
Luis

Tomamos una clase de cómo hacer guacamole con el Chef Carlos y salió riquísimo! 

También tomamos la clase de Pole dance con -Martha. Muy hermosa y buena maestra
Asistimos la actividad de Tequila tasting con Hugo y Andrea 

Restaurantes que asistimos y el Staff que recomendamos (porque no asistieron al 100)

https://www.tripadvisor.com.mx/UserReviewEdit-g150807-d282106-Paradisus_Cancun-Cancun_Yucatan_Peninsula.html

reviews.author: Britnee O
reviews.title: Princess house
reviews.text: The staff at the hotel paradisus has the best service/staff BY FAR! Truly the best experience ever. The staff goes above and beyond. We got to meet Alfredo, Alberto,Rafael& didier ❤️ Can’t wait to be back !

reviews.author: Noemi S
reviews.title: Guess service
reviews.text: Miguel de front desk nos atendió muy amable nos contestó muchas preguntas que teníamos y refirió a diferentes restaurantes. También espliclo de los puntos Meliá.Miguel fue una persona muy eficiente estábamos muy perdidas y el nos dio la información para los eventos de princess house.

reviews.author: Marcela G
reviews.title: Vacaciones padrisimas
reviews.text: La zumba con Saúl y la gimnasia acuática con Axel fue fenomenal!! Las chicas y chicos tienen una súper energía para la zumba tienen buenos pasos y muy linda motivación. Hojala nos la pasemos bien en las siguientes activities de hoy.

reviews.author: Kike
reviews.title: Increible el nivel de detalle en el servicio
reviews.text: Me encantaron las instalaciones del hotel, integran mucha naturaleza y detalles que te hacen sentir en un paraíso, gracias Daniel caballos por el detalle de la habitación y ni hablar de la decoración qué me realizo Fabiola de guest servicio ¡espectacular!. En mi llegada me atendió Teresa en restaurante principal para mi desayuno del día 1 y desde ese momento dije wow el servicio  excelente atención por Teresa y si tienen oportunidad de ir por la noche  restaurante Lemon fish y pedir los tacos con tortilla de jicarazos o ñas brochetas de picaña y salmón recomendadas por Fabián qué me atendió y me dio un servicio de 5 estrellas, bravo por enfocarse tanto en los detalles, me voy triste por dejar este lugar de ensueño pero con muchas ganas de regresar pronto

reviews.author: Menv
reviews.title: Un hotel que ofrecerá tranquilidad o party!!, dependerá de tu mood
reviews.text:
Hotel All inclusive
Servicio con brazalete dorado  muy bueno, te permite acceso al restaurante con vista a la alberca y playa, donde la comida es a la carta y muy buena yo pedí un Kebab y un Falafel.

Si algo mejoraría es el horario del gym, porque abre a las 7am y cundo vas de trabajo en ese horario ya no funciona, pero igual puedes caminar por la playa.

Las habitaciones son amplias y tienes todas las amenidades necesarias, secadora, plancha, kit de baño.

reviews.author: Marnae L
reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Axcel was great playing volleyball with us. We played on the beach and in the pool. Then we also did pole dancing with Gina and Axcel. Pool food needs to up their game. Nothing even remotely healthy. Need better options. Beach service was good though

reviews.author: Dan B
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Service as Food
reviews.text:
Alejandro Camelo really looked after us. He was amazing,he suggested all the best menu items and kept the food and wine coming. 
We had all the sushi and Nigri abs were not disappointed. We also had the shark tacos which were very tasty. We finished off with the spiced pineapple dessert which was the cherry on top! 
Make sure to visit Alejandro at the Lemon Fish. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Julie C
reviews.title: A taste of paradise
reviews.text:
Beautiful area and wonderful ocean however it was an added extra touch to have such thoughtful and kind servers- Samuel Sosi and Martin.  

Regardless of what time I came down, Samuel Sosi and Martin  remembered me and my drink preferences and made sure to say hello even though I'm sure there are thousands of guests.  

I'm just going to suggest that their manager, Rafael, give them a paid vacation and a raise. ;) 

Mucho gracies!!!

reviews.author: Randy S
reviews.title: Those who served us this week at Paradisis Cancun were awesome!
reviews.text:
Atilano and Orlando were amazing servers in the buffet restaurant! They treated us like family!

Laura was an exceptional server it by the pool. She got to know us throughout the week and was so kind and attentive!

reviews.author: Katherine N
reviews.title: Vacaciones
reviews.text: Cancun una experiencia única y repetible es un complemento de paisajes hermosos, atendida por personas maravillosas llenas de energía amabilidad y un servicio excelente... gracias liliana garcia, verónica mendoza, Daniel mejía, Rafael chavez por hacernos sentir en casa... el restaurante malva pm es perfecto .

reviews.author: Tatielle T
reviews.title: Dedico a: Guendoline Flores from Premium Moments
reviews.text: Contatei a Guendoline Flores from Premium Moments, sempre muito solicita, paciente, excelente atendimento, e o serviço impecável, fiquei muito feliz e satisfeita, super recomendo, são maravilhosossss!

reviews.author: PacmanSanDiego
reviews.title: Do Not Think Twice
reviews.text:
Literally blown away! We have a medical company and we came here for our 10 year anniversary. I was so nervous because usually the service, food options and alcohol quality can differ so much from resort to resort in Cancun. 

However Paradisus Cancun blew it out of the water for our company trip, I can’t think of a single complaint. If you are considering all-inclusive for a company trip or a family reunion, look no further. 

Also so many people I could shout out but our group host Nataly was amazing. I would hire her to work for our customer service department if I could. Nataly, thank you so much for making our trip, our company event and even the beach party. This hotel is lucky to have you.

reviews.author: Excursion635709
reviews.title: Excellent service oriented resort, with or without kids 😊😎
reviews.text:
This resort is geared towards service and making sure you have everything you need. A great all inclusive resort.
Tonight was the best experience of all. I had a package delivered that was essential for work. The bell hop David Hilario was so very kind and helpful and then I went to guest services and Wen Wagner went out of her way to get the package. They went searching at 9:00pm!!!!   To my enormous relief, Wen came back with my package after going out of her way, she had to get into the package area that was closed and then find it and she ran with purpose!  Icing on the cake of a fantastic work (and a little vacation) Thank you so much to Paradisus Cancun for your commitment to taking care of your guests.  Wen Wagner and David Hilario, I am grateful for you both.  
Thank you!

reviews.author: BoardingPass562625
reviews.title: Precious Moments has excellent customer service!
reviews.text: Guendoline Flores Navarro with the Precious Moments  department really helped to arrange and surprise my wife for Valentine’s Day. She helped to surprise my wife with sunflowers, champagne, and a massage. Guendoline was very responsive, creative, and she followed through with everything we had discussed in a timely fashion. I would highly recommend working with her!

reviews.author: Ruth Ortega Camargo
reviews.title: Gracias !!!
reviews.text: Excelente lugar y la atención de primera !!! Todo el personal Muy respetuoso y servicial. La comida preparada con alimentos de buena calidad.   El salón de eventos adecuado para que todo saliera de maravilla durante nuestro evento.   Gracias Luis en atención a clientes por tu apoyo y gestión !!!

reviews.author: ReneeW
reviews.title: 2nd trip to Paradisus is paradise!
reviews.text: Excellent service and lovely well maintained resort. Food is really good. Not all restaurants were open but there was enough variety to enjoy many different options. Beach is beautiful and private. Guest services is amazing and will work hard to make special requests a reality. Thank you to Luis and Daniella!

reviews.author: Siri R
reviews.title: FUN Relaxing Stay
reviews.text:
Came to Paradissus for Business trip ended up coming with my wife a few days early.  

While lounging by the pool met a fun group of people played some awesome games beach volleyball and pool volleyball.  

 Agustin AKA “Tequila Guy” was so much fun and hilarious.  He  kept the games going, recruited people and made our stay fun, relaxing and enjoyable.  

Thanks Paradissus and Agustin “Tequila Guy” for the great memories 👏

reviews.author: Ashanti
reviews.title: Liliana @ Yhi Spa
reviews.text:
Liliana is amazing! I got the relaxation massage and she was so great I had to come back the next day! 
Highly recommend her to get out those knots and kinks . She was also very kind. Thank you Liliana!

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: Sunrun
reviews.text: Estoy escribiendo del parte de Cristel, quien esta trabajando el el Lunchbox. Me apoyo’ en un nivel encima buena, con atención más que regular. Tenía preguntas, me contestado clara y fue mi guía hasta un lugar perfecto para fotos durante el presentación con percusión. Es mí opinión que ella está muy buena en su posición y está lista para advancer en su carera con Paradisus. Muchísimas gracias a todos y un saludo espacial hasta Cristel.

reviews.author: Janiceraneross
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Restaurant
reviews.text: After a long flight and chaotic airport experience we were greeted with a refreshing beverage and clean beautiful room.    We did not read the fine print requiring a reservation to eat at the “fine restaurants but showed up hungry at Lemon Fish.   After much pleading we got a seating       Rafael our waiter was superb.   He detailed the menu and made excellent suggestions on the food and drinks.      In addition Rafael gave us traveling tips on the resort, pesos and nightlife at the resort.    Lemon Fish was a 5+ and Rafael will see us again before we leave

reviews.author: andresmedoza
reviews.title: BUEN SERVICIO
reviews.text: La pase muy bien una vista fenomenal gran ubicacion ya que te puedes mover facilmente a varios puntos, gran servicio regresaria en el corto plazo la comida es buena las piscinas estan super. Solo tuve 2 detalles la puerta de la habitación 2 veces se trabo y un filtracion muy pequeña de agua por la lluvia

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Ginger Bar 2
reviews.text:
Mi más sincera felicitación para Wendy Morales del Ginger Bar 2 (siempre pensé se llamaría Sports Bar o algo similar) si bien todos al momento de brindar el servicio que les corresponda Wendy se destaca sobre todos por su amabilidad, vocación de servicio y platica amena.
My sincere congratulations to Wendy Morales from Ginger Bar 2 (I always thought it would be called Sports Bar or something similar) although everyone at the time of providing the service that corresponds to them Wendy stands out above all for her kindness, service vocation and pleasant conversation.

reviews.author: Eva V
reviews.title: Deliciosa estancia
reviews.text:
Tuve la oportunidad de vivir la experiencia Paradisus y fue genial, El impecable mantenimiento de sus instalaciones es impresionante, la limpieza y desinfección en todo momento, en todas las areas, a pesar que por tener tanta planta viva y superbien cuidada!! Todo es natural a tu alrededor, la comida exelente en todos sus restaurantes y areas de Snack.
Casi todos con vista al mar Turquesa .
las bebidas siempre innovándose, en uno de los pool bar probamos un coctel Perico Verde con sabor y aroma tan distinto a lo comun... que sorprende
Super recomendable, playa, ubicacion, alimentos y bebidas... y la atencion siempre amable y linda de todos los ue ahi laboran. Mucho mas de lo que yo me imaginaba.

reviews.author: Fabio T
reviews.title: El menor serviços en malva
reviews.text: Todo muy bien en el restaurant malva grávidas ala atention de Alejandro camelo Javier jiemenez nunez y Veronica Mendoza todos muy atentos y amables el gerente del restaurant carlos chay muy atento con lá mesa y mi família grávidas a todos…

reviews.author: camilanigris
reviews.title: Lá mejor serviços en restaurante malva
reviews.text: Todo estubo muy bueno gracias ala atencion de Javier jimenez Nunez Veronica Mendoza y alejandro camelo El Capitan Carlos chay increible atencion regressaremos pronto a mi família y a mi nos encanto los felicito a todos

reviews.author: Emily H
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text:
What can I say about the last 8 days to sum up our experience??! 
It was awesome!   The service is wonderful, the food was amazing! Views spectacular! 

We stayed in the reserve side.  A definite if you can swing the extra $$.    We loved that there weren't kids on that side so all you hear from your Bali bed were conversations and the ocean.  I'm glad the party and daily DJ were on the other side, we could join that when we wanted to.  We had 2 concierges that split our week.    They accommodated every request.  Dinner reservations, room change requests etc. Big thank you to Ceci (Ce-CHI!) and Violeta! 

Sante restaurant was our favorite for breakfast and lunch.  It's in the reserve, so quiet and wonderful. Amazing food on the patio under shade with an amazing view.  (see photos) The menus are at this resort are creative and wonderful.  We noted at the pool that those complaining about the food didn't even try anything!  They didn't recognize anything on the menu and would leave!  What a shame.  If you are looking to eat American food all week and hotdogs, go somewhere else. We were NOT disappointed with anything we ordered the entire week.  (And we are foodies and travelers) Everything was cooked perfectly from lamb to steak to fish.  They are extremely accommodating- anything you want, they will do it so just ask.  We would combine favorite menu items together etc.  Hats off the chefs here.  It was great!
Pool service on the reserve side was unbeatable.  Thank you to Lucas, the pool concierge,  for getting our bali bed everyday with a smile!  Because we were there for 8 days we had different wait staff at Sante for breakfast and for the pool.  A huge shout out to Valeria, Ruben, Moises, Joel, Julio, Josue, Yamil, and Maria!  And to Oscar for sharing your love of Tequila, the amazing history lesson and taste testing!   We appreciate Tequila now!  They were ALL fabulous.   Seriously, thank you everyone. 

The absolute only thing I can complain about is it is definitely hot in the lobby.  It's structured like a botanical garden so beautiful and unique, but humid like a greenhouse.  I don't know if this is on purpose or something needs to be fixed.  It did make dining at the buffet during the day uncomfortable (its fine at night) and the Italian restaurant, which is located in a side part of the main lobby, is very warm in there.  Some restaurants have outdoor seating only so make reservations about 8pm when the sun is down.  It's pleasant and they have fans.   Sals and Blue Agave have great air conditioning as well as the sports bar in Ginger lounge.
We did have to call for a fan in our room which helped tremendously.  If you like it cold when you sleep, the rooms do not get colder than 70/71, a common theme among those we met also.  The Asian restaurant is under construction in the middle of the lobby.  
No place is perfect and this would not keep us from coming back!  We miss it already.  Melia has not disappointed us thus far.  We enjoyed this as much as Spain and Orlando.

reviews.author: Fernanda P
reviews.title: Buena opción
reviews.text: El servicio es excelente, el personal muy atento y siempre dispuesto a hacerte sentir como en casa. Arnulfo, Edier, Antonio y Baltazar de los mejores staff del hotel. La comida podría mejorar pero las instalaciones están en muy buen estado. Se ve que dan mantenimiento seguido.

reviews.author: Leslie F
reviews.title: Excelente servicio!
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancún es un hotel con buenas instalaciones y el servicio es excelente!!! Baltazar y Arnulfo los mejores!!  Una excelente opción de all inclusive para toda la familia!! 
Variedad de restaurantes y albercas para todos los gustos!

reviews.author: Kindel
reviews.title: Amazing Staff
reviews.text:
We had a lovely, relaxing time at The Paradisus Playa del Carmen for a corporate event September 16-20, 2021. The staff was exceptionally polite and helpful. Everyone always had their masks on and could speak very good English. Lots of cleaning being done all the time and it was super convenient to have COVID testing on site. We felt very safe here. 

Special shout out to Ivan who served us at the Market Restaurant, Luis at Fuego and our favorite Jose at the Water 💦 Park for the incredible and personal service. 

Mil gracias Jose para el servicio rápido y amigable. Nuestros mejores deseos a ti y tu familia.

reviews.author: katyayres
reviews.title: Restaurante Mole
reviews.text: Mejor restaurante mexicano. Comida tradicional y atencion excepcional. Noe, nuestro camarero muy atento y servicial. Para las personas que no comen carne es el unico restaurante en el hotel que tiene platos vegetarianos.

reviews.author: Heliana Alf
reviews.title: Recomendadisimo!!!
reviews.text: Excelente atención de todo el personal del Paradisus y en especial de su gerente, el señor, José Palesti... Hermoso lugar para visitar en familia... Muy recomendado, grata experiencia, Muchas gracias 😊

reviews.author: Renato D
reviews.title: Bana sushi paradisus
reviews.text:
Bana restaurant was so good and Rafael and Guilherme  gave us a really nice service during our dinner.
Great experience, from the start to the desert. The restaurant was beautiful and good vibes around.

reviews.author: ANA PATRCIA O
reviews.title: Excelente atención, comida y servicio!
reviews.text: Todo estuvo de ensueño. Fuimos a conocer cómo se llevan las medidas sanitarias en el hotel, y superaron mis expectativas. El personal en todo momento utiliza su cubre bocas, hay dispensadores de gel en todos lados, tapetes desinfectantes, cuidados en la habitación para estar seguros. El uso de la tecnología les ha ayudado a tener menos contacto con el cliente, y así sentirnos más seguros en nuestra estancia. En cuanto al servicio y la calidad de los alimentos y bebidas... todo excelente! Quiero destacar a René Aguilar del Club de Playa Kenna. Excelente atención, siempre con una sonrisa, y solo tenías que decir más o menos qué querías, y el traía al menos 5 opciones de ese ingrediente. También hay opciones sin alcohol. Siempre atento y con mucha actitud. Vengo muy contenta de haberme hospedado ahí. Lo recomiendo!

reviews.author: richi671
reviews.title: Accountant
reviews.text: My experience at Paradisus Cancun was a delicacy among the choices available in the hospitality business. The staff is caring, the food is delightful, and the activities and amenities are pristine. Best value for an all-inclusive so far.

reviews.author: Shelby Richardson
reviews.title: WONDERFUL SERVICE
reviews.text: We came to Fuego for breakfast and enjoyed our visit so much that we came back for lunch the same day. Both meals we were taken care of by Atilano, Eddie, David, and Arnulfo and they were spectacular. I wish we found them sooner as we probably would’ve come here for every meal. Thank you for the best service and your kind gestures. We will be back!

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: Un gran restaurante con excelente servicio
reviews.text: Un gran restaurante. Muy buena comida, en un agradable jardín zen y con excelente servicio, en especial de los meseros, como el amable Rafael. Para veladas tranquilas, tanto en solitario como en pareja o amigos.

reviews.author: Chef Eva M
reviews.title: Mesero japones
reviews.text: Rafael nos atendió increíblemente bien,nos sentimos como clientes vip .cada tiempo de comida fue acompañado de la atención del mesero Rafael y del chef que salió muy amable a darnos cada explicación y nos mimó.

reviews.author: Ramon Zapata Sirvent
reviews.title: Excellent service and great people
reviews.text: Everything great. Hostess: Tete; Capitán: Guillermo Cuenca; Mesero: Moisés; Chef: Ángel. Thank you very much, excellent service and food. Thank you again. A number 1; excellent; come and enjoy this excellent service

reviews.author: Pompeu M
reviews.title: Excelente serviço e cordialidade
reviews.text:
Tivemos uma estadia maravilhosa. Habitação impecavel, intalações do hotel excelentes e o serviço de todos que nos atenderam,  maravilhoso.
Mesmo durnte estes dias de pandemia, tivemos segurança e tranquilidade com todo que nos foi proporcionado. Toda equipe esta muito preparada e cuidadosa.
Voltaremos muito em breve.

reviews.author: Julian C
reviews.title: CONVENCION ASF 2020
reviews.text: Puedo decir que quede gratamente sorprendido del lugar pero sobretodo del servicio y la atención del personal, se esforzaron por que la estancia de todo mi grupo fuera excelente coordinando en cada momento los eventos con mi grupo, un agradecimiento a rossana la concierge asignada, estuvo siempre en contacto para facilitarnos lo necesario para que la convención fuera todo un éxito, que si lo recomiendo? Claro que si y espero visitarlos pronto con mi familia.

reviews.author: Kaden K
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week on a company trip. There were some stand out employees! Salvador is the best bar tender ever, he was crazy busy but made you feel important and was creative with drinks and remembered you each time you would come up. His team was very helpful as well of Karina and Sofonia were making sure the drinks were passed out and collected so the area remained clean. 

Also my wife and I had a couples massage and Anna had as our masseuse. She gave the best massage I’ve ever had, I would highly recommend getting a massage by her to anyone who stays here.

reviews.author: MATTHEW SCOLES
reviews.title: VP SALES AT KNIGHT WATCH
reviews.text:
We had our company trip here. The staff went out of there way to make us feel welcome. The resort itself was beautiful. The food and restaurants were aesthetically very classy. The rooms were very nice. The royal service butlers and maids were off the charts. Daniel and Rosanna were so accommodating.
Melia is a first class company. The wait staff for banquets

reviews.author: Andre G
reviews.title: No solo lujo sino tambien servicio..!!💪💪💪
reviews.text: El hotel increible y magnifico, pero la atencion del personal sobre todo de nuestro amigo ISMAEL MENDEZ increible..!! La calidad humana y como te hacen sentir super increible, lo recomiendo a ojos cerrados la infraestructura, la comida todo A1, si quieren engreirse con la familia o para neegocios lo recomiendo, el clima super increible una muy buena experiencia..!!💪💪💪💪

reviews.author: carloseduardocadavid
reviews.title: PARADISUS CANCUN
reviews.text: Excelente Experiencia, Estuvimos en viaje de negocios, y aunque nos encontrabamos trabajando, siempre tuvimos la oportunidad de aprovechar las instalaciones y la comodidad del hotel para realizar otras actividades.

reviews.author: rhsrhs2018
reviews.title: Paradise Cancún es buena opción
reviews.text: Salvo porque no tenían cambio en la caja ni en mostradores o tiendas, todo muy bien. Si va lleve billetes de diferente denominación para propinas. Los restaurantes excelentes. Sugiero incluir salsas no picantes para extranjeros que verdaderamente no sean picantes, sin ají.

reviews.author: Diego
reviews.title: Buen hotel en Cancún
reviews.text:
Primera vez que me hospedé en un Paradisus y realmente no es una mala opción. Se encuentra en plena zona hotelera, cerca del aeropuerto y con acceso directo a la playa. 
Respecto a la calidad del servicio, esta es regular considerando que se define como un Resort de Cinco Estrellas, a veces se demoraban realmente demasiado en traer las bebidas en el buffet. 
Independiente de todo es una buena opción en Cancún.

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent installations , location and management down to waiters . Starting  with Mr Martinez , Mr Ascencio , Sonyia , Mr Palesti , Iran , Mario , Alex, Daniel , Nachito , Christian , Sandra , to mention some . Not to forget the cooks ( Angel , Hector , and the others ,,,, ex relent team .
Will send everyone I know to Paradisus Cancun ! See you guys soon .

reviews.author: Sanyam G
reviews.title: Very luxurious
reviews.text: Superb all inclusive resort! Great private beach, amazing drinks, good service. Resort has everything you would want, multiple restaurants, bars, pools, a club, casino, golf course, spa and everything that you can think of. A must stay place if in Cancun.

reviews.author: Hugo S
reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text:
Business meeting with  partners of US /MX /CAN very nice hotel with a lot of garden. Clean beach!!! Excellent food. Comfortable alocations. Several pools. Very nice environtment. Friendly guys.
Reccomended!!

reviews.author: Nancy Mtz
reviews.title: Lindo pero...
reviews.text: Es un hotel muy lindo, la comida no está mal y los postres están más o menos pero hace falta amabilidad y hospitalidad con los huéspedes, los de animación nunca están y se siente aburrido el hotel....

reviews.author: Gerardo M
reviews.title: Muy decepcionado...
reviews.text:
A este hotel le URGE un “refreshment” está atrapado en los 90’s y todo el lo grita...

Mi estadía: 03 de sep 2019 al 08 de sep 2019

Si bien esperas que un hotel de la cadena Melia sea un hotel de altísima calidad, la verdad es que declaró que de su nivel ha sido el menos agraciado de los hoteles visitados ( y vale decir que he visitado decenas de hoteles de 5 estrellas y gran turismo del caribe mexicano) su oferta gastronómica regularmente ofrecida con tu reservación “todo incluido”  es muy pobre, por ejemplo: su restaurante Agave Azul sirve comida estilo mexicana y te ofrece tacos de terrible calidad, quesadillas que dan pena.

Su opción de Restaurante estilo Rodizio, creo que es la más baja opción de calidad en sus carnes, todo parece estar hecho solo para cumplir pues, cuando vez llegar las espadas a tu mesa casi prefieres pasar de largo, la que mejor pintaba..... cruda!! 

De las bebidas ni hablar nada más lejos de ser Premium en su oferta tradicional y sus barman en general mal entrenados por lo que las bebidas, la que me digas... de regular calidad en su preparación y presentación.

El único restaurante que promete.... TEMPO BY MARTIN BERASATEGUI ..........NO ESTÁ incluido en nada y vaaaaaya que es caro.

Vamos a lo mas importante La habitación!!!!

Nos dieron una habitación en donde pensábamos que recién había salido Mauricio Garcés!! Muy descuidada en todos los sentidos y lo peor de todo el baño, sentado en la taza literalmente podrías tomar agua del Bidé. Lo tienes a 20 cm. Terrible.

Conclusión, quedó cordialmente invitado a no volver, con tanta calidad ofrecida en Cancún este, será siempre la última opción como hotel en este destino.  Pa que me entiendas, de lo malito que está quise salir antes y ni eso pude hacer jajajaja.

Pero que se yo de hoteles si solo viajo 25 semanas al año .....

reviews.author: JongwanSON
reviews.title: 가성비의 올인클루시브 호텔입니다
reviews.text: 부족한 부분도 많지만 가성비 하나로 단점을 전부 상쇄합니다. 물론 지내는 동안 불만족스러운 부분도 많았습니다. 폭우가 쏟아지는 날에는 호텔 로비가 빗물이 넘치고, 몇몇 식당은 객실에 지내는 동안 한번도 문을 열지 않았습니다. 또한 오픈된 식당들은 메뉴가 거의 바뀌지 않고 몇일동안 그대로 유지되는 문제도 있습니다. 체크인 카운터는 매우 느리게 일처리를 진행하지만 중남미 국가의 기본적인 특성이라고 여겨집니다. 실제로 체크인 과정상 맞이하는 카운터 직원들은 매우 친절하게 손님을 대해줍니다. 이러한 모든 부분들을 다 고려하더라도, 매우 저렴한 가격의 올인클루시브이기 때문에 단점을 다 이해할 수 있게 해줍니다. 비즈니스 출장을 위해 방문한 경우였기에, 개인적으로는 매우 만족스러웠습니다.

reviews.author: Carlos C
reviews.title: Rode salva el día
reviews.text: Están los niveles de servicio excelentes y arriba está el de Rode, el Butler que tuve la fortuna de tener al lado. Me ha ayudado infinitamente incluso después de mi salida. De no ser por gente como él, el resto del crew quedaría mal calificado con los niveles de respuesta que tuvieron a mis llamadas y peticiones de aclaración. Bien por él y por los que sean tan dedicados al servicio como Rode. Mil gracias!!

reviews.author: Sherri
reviews.title: HOT & FILTHY
reviews.text:
Arroved Tuesday August 12th....  The lobby was an inferno.  Not a little hot, but Mayan  Aztec "you aint made for this heat" HOT!  Its the hottest Ive ever been INSIDE a building I literally sweated all my make up and eyelashes off while I waited to be checked in... LITERALLY! ( the lobby wasnt hot like that everyday but Friday morning at 8 am in the morning is was back to blazing HEAT hot in the lobby.  I came in sweating and they sent me off in a sweaty mess as well.  

So lets talk about my 5 star resort room.  My first room was FILTHY!  Walked in the door and the odor of mildew and the sweet scent of past quest sweat wafted into my nostrils.  I looked around the room which had obviously outlived its youth and tried to mentally move past the dread that was now seeping through me.  I went into denial.  Hey I was in Cancun, like how bad can it be.  Just unpack I said and go to the pool!  So I threw my suit case down opened it up and thats when I got a good look at the couch.  Not only was the frame OBVIOUSLY broken and you couldnt sit on it,  it was stained in a way that only people with small children or drunken relatives would understand.  Looking at the couch mad me start to scratch and itch like I had become allergic to it.  I thought it was my imagination and then my roomate started slapping herself and screaming....  the room had gnats, lots of them!  Oh by the way the outlets in the room didnt work as well.

FInally I accepted I was not going to make it to the pool to cool off after I had literally melted in the lobby the first time and went back to request another room....  hours later we got another room after the manager tried to convince me to sleep in the filthy stankin gnat infested room and he would upgrade me the next day.  I told him to get me transport back to the airport and explain to my company who was paying for this trip why I wouldnt be able to attend the functions.  By the way the pictures of hanging frabric is actually from the box spring in the 1st room, so its fair to say the bedding was less than desirable.

So the second room was clean and defintely more updated...  I still wouldnt call it luxurious but I didnt feel like I was sleeping in a cest pool.  However,  workers from the hotel begin to use the room directly next door from mine as a staging area for their spray painting projects  LITERALLY.  There were all out on the patio  and had the door to the room open because apparently they were chocking as well from the industrial spray paint machine they were using.  Unfortunately they didnt give us mask as well so we started to choke. So back to the inferno, im sorry I mean Lobby I go so we wait for another room....  rooms they initally said THEY DID NOT HAVE!

Its past 10 pm when we get a decent room...  we are still in the clothes we flew in and having been sweating profusely in from the moment we walked into this Hot Box of a resort.  No pool...  no nothing but back in forth to the lobby.  We never had a chance to fix ourselves up for the company dinner and arrived over an hour late.  Did I mention I was suppose to give a speech?  Anywho I was happy to at least sleep in a clean room that night.  I expectactions had been drastically lowered.

Oh by the way.... they owe me a new IPHONE.  My phone would charge sporatically on and off and sometime not at all.  Then the second day I took the cord out of the ipone and literally found soot around the connection like it had been burnt. Now my phone wont charge at ALL!  I checked with other people in my group who experienced the same thing.  Then the last day I overheard the people at the front desk say that its not an AC problem its and electrical problem  that they are working on that is affecting the AC.  Which makes sense im sure my phone took a power surge and was fried.  

 There are multiple people from my group with their own individual horror story.  I will let them share that independently.  Believe me whoever at corporate who booke the hotel is about to catch some heat from some VERY UNHAPPY top producers!

Please puruse the attached pictures at your leisure!

reviews.author: dbaird2019
reviews.title: Make sure the A/C in your room works.
reviews.text: Our overall experience was positive, with the exception of the service for the a/c in our room, and the inability of front staff to make decisions on their own to provide a “problem fixed” experience.

reviews.author: gsolo
reviews.title: 5 star prices for 2 star quality of food
reviews.text:
First impression at checkin is excellent, great service, attentive, good bilingual communication. Lobby and central patio are impressive and certainly attractive. So is the pool and beach area.

Hotel was built in the 80's and needs significant remodelling. Rooms are aged, only one working electric outlet in the entire room, none next to beds, other outlets were used for TV or nightstand light. Air Conditioning never dropped below 78F (24C) even at 3am.
Very small step into bathroom can be a killer at night. Mirror is rusted and at checkin water was out, it came back an hour later.
Fully stocked refrigerator, but another member of our convention drank the chocolate milk and got food poisoning, later realized it had expired a while back.

Breakfast at Naos is excellent, lots of options for adults and kids. Service is good.
Other restaurants have great presentation of food, but very poor quality, wine is very cheap, I was unable to drink it, and meat is tough, after trying meat dishes at three restaurants, I went to chicken and pork for the rest of my stay. Drinks are served to the minimum, and had to request refills often, rather than giving you a good amount.

The entire hotel has an air conditioning problem, most rooms are warm, even the conference rooms. In a city that is so hot, you want a convenient 72-74F (21-23C) room temperature to cool down.

reviews.author: osler2015
reviews.title: Enorme, lindo e que quase requer um GPS
reviews.text:
É desses hotéis luxuosos "all in" que abundam na Costa Maia. Possui vários restaurantes (a menos que fiques uma semana não conseguirás visitar todos) e o que visitei tem cozinha muito boa, tanto para o café da manhã cujo buffet consegui agradar gregos e troianos. Os quartos são muito amplos, bem decorados e confortáveis. Seriam perfeitos se tivessem tomadas que admitissem vários tipos de conexão. O wifi funciona em todo o complexo. Há inúmeras atrações internas (piscinas, spa, boutiques, restaurantes temáticos, lojas, etc), que infelizmente não pude visitar já que lá estava para um simpósio. O centro de convenções está instalado no local e é muito adequado.
As pessoas são gentis e diligentes e raramente tens que esperar por qualquer coisa.
O hotel só tem um defeito: é pessimamente sinalizado e é muito fácil se perder, não saber onde se está e não saber como chegar onde se quer ir. As indicações verbais dos funcionários são algo confusas, mas em compensação aparecem muitos deles dispostos a levar o hóspede até os locais onde deseja ir. Infelizmente o mar está com um problema de algas, não permitia banhos pois exalava um mal odor.

reviews.author: FlashLosAngeles
reviews.title: Great room and beach, forget the front desk
reviews.text: I was in Cancun on business.  When trying to check out the night before departure -- I had a 4 AM pick up for the airport -- I realized that there were errors on the bill and they could not run the final bill since the last night would not post until later that evening.  While I believed that we resolved some, but not all of the errors, and was not completely pleased before going to bed late, I did expect that I would receive a copy of the bill when leaving the hotel at 4 AM.  At 4 AM they could not give me a copy, I was told to leave my email, which I did and that they would email me later that day.  Well, now more that 2 weeks later no copy of the bill, which is critical for travel reimbursement.  Not only that, but in calling the hotel they could not provide me with a bill.  Perhaps it is ok for a vacation but not for a conference in Cancun. In addition, I came back ill, which I believe was from the ice.

reviews.author: Navigate694440
reviews.title: Servicio decepcionante
reviews.text: Estuve 2 días alojada por asistencia a un Simposium; al final decidí permanecer 2 noches más de las cuales me arrepiento; me cambiaron de habitación a una con vista al mar; que no se ve nada porque las bardas de los balcones son muy altas; la tina de hidromasaje demasiado sucia, con restos de jabón o no se de que; la cafetera no servia y los contactos de luz infestados de hormigas. Eso si el precio como si fuese perfecto. No regreso, ni lo recomendaría. Muy mal 👎  👎

reviews.author: agomces
reviews.title: Hotel Bien / salida y entrada MUY MAL
reviews.text: El Hotel es una Maravilla; instalaciones de primera.  Vale mucho la pena.  El problema es el personal tanto en el check In como en el Check out.  Quizás fue mala suerte; el horario o que se yo...Pero resultó una pesadilla.  A la llegada una hora y otra hora a la salida.  Afortunadamente contaba con tiempo; de lo contrario hubiera perdido el avión

reviews.author: Alejandro Guízar
reviews.title: Define "Europeo" como cero servicio a un precio excesivo.
reviews.text:
El hotel se encuentra en una etapa de remodelarse o caer, algunos de sus acabados ya se ven viejos, gastados u oxidados, los baños tienen sarro y las regaderas son todo un rompecabezas que descifrar. 
Es un hotel gigantesco con todos los servicios que uno puede esperar en un lugar así, la comida es buena y tiene gran variedad, sin embargo, si visitas el hotel en modalidad "Europea" te espera una de las peores experiencias hoteleras en general; No habrá agua potable en tu cuarto, ni un frigobar lleno al cual hacer el cargo, y no hay forma que la administración proporcione una botella de agua de cortesía bajo ninguna circunstancia, aunque el huésped esté deshidratado. El costo de un desayuno buffet en esta modalidad es de $390.00 MXN más la propina del 15% que esperan todos los meseros.
