El WiFi, fue imposible de conectar con tres diferentes claves, culpando al dispositivo con el que se estaba intentando realizar la conexión, aparentemente un iPhone X es demasiado viejo para sus estándares.

reviews.author: Curious20534140409
reviews.title: Experiencia muy agradable
reviews.text: Es un lugar con muy buenas instalaciones, aunque no son nuevas, lo cual se nota sobre todo en las habitaciones, se encuentran en buen estado. Allí encontré una excelente atención y al cual estaría muy interesado en volver a visitar esta vez con mi familia.

reviews.author: Trek02406956878
reviews.title: Muito bom
reviews.text:
Destaque para a equipe do hotel que em todos os lugares e serviços se mostraram muito atenciosos, alegres e eficientes.
Serviço de praia impecável. Boa localização. Todas bebidas servidas de ótima qualidade.

reviews.author: Jim S
reviews.title: Great Experience @ Paradisus
reviews.text: I stayed at the resort for 3 nights for a business conference.  Hotel was very well maintained with beautiful public areas and expansive pool(s) and beach areas.  Rooms were nicely appointed and the conference facilities were very good.  What really stuck out for me was the great employees.  I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts in the Caribbean and Central America and have always been very disappointed in the attentiveness, professionalism & attentiveness of the staff.  I can say without a doubt that Paradisus was the best experience I've had hands-down.  Everyone I encountered was polite and very helpful, from the porters to the servers to the front desk personnel.  Had a wonderful time at the resort and plan to come back with my family for a vacation.

reviews.author: Macnhoz
reviews.title: Only love
reviews.text: We went here on a huge group trip. Wow . The service is over the top. Extra nice on everyone’s part. The beach was clean and cozy. Pool and bar rocks. The hotel was alittle hot even for a southern boy . The food was ok but the display was great. I caught fish from the shore of the hotel. Great place and I would go back.

reviews.author: Adventurer652895
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Second time here and will be back for a third. The whole food, hotel,beach is perfect. Staff is very attentive and helpful to guest. The Adults Only Royal Service is the way to go if it's an option...

reviews.author: Omar MD
reviews.title: El trato de todo el equipo del hotel fue muy cordial y respuetuoso
reviews.text: Pirámide 2, piso 0. La ubicación y vista de la habitación fue muy buena. El ambiente al salir de la habitación siempre fue agradable con los aromas que se colocan en las áreas comunes. ¡felicidades a todo el personal que siempre tuvo una sonrisa y un saludo!

reviews.author: Crdbl
reviews.title: Work Reward!
reviews.text: Visited Paradisus as a reward for my jobs 2018 accomplishments. First time we went out the country but we were sure to make the best of it for how hard we worked. The Hotel made that easy. We spent days by the pool and he service there was great. They made sure we had a good time. Michael, Sergio and Rene helped us each day even when it came to getting the Cabanas for the day. At night we had reservations at different restaurants but the food was always good. Fuego was my favorite. This trip was so good, the views, the pools, the beach. I have to bring my family back next time.

reviews.author: Marvin Theodore
reviews.title: My home for unforgettable experiences
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun took the word paradise and turned into an experience to be remembered. 

I'll never forget the warm authentic greeting that I recieved right out my airport transportation. Then there is an entire rainforest jungle integrated into the facility that is the size of an entire shopping mall!

The view of the beach and the ocean are clearly seen from just about every window. The service is led by people that actually WANT to be there, a crucial factor that must not be ignored. 

The food quality, the waiters and the view while eating all combine to an unforgettable experience.

The area is clean and there's always technicians discreetly working proactively on the maintenance of the facility. 

Introverts will especially love the huge quiet area if ever in need of some introspective space to breath and just be. 

There are front desks everywhere to serve you and solve any issues with breathtaking decor at every angle.

reviews.author: 2SunsetSailors
reviews.title: Guacamole Workshop
reviews.text:
What to do after a long luxurious breakfast and a morning basking by the pool?

A fun, informative and delicious Guacamole making class where you literally get to eat the fruits of your labor! 

Chef Diana & interpreter Angel Avel guided us effortlessly through the process of customizing guacamole to our own tastes. They took the time to offer additional ideas of ingredients we may like to create our own custom recipe once we return home. 

I highly recommend skipping (or delaying) your siesta to take this  short workshop hosted by knowledgeable and personable staff at Paradisus Cancun.

Angel Avel, interpreter & Diana, Chef

reviews.author: Quincy S
reviews.title: Beautiful Property / Poor Communication
reviews.text: Visited Cancun for a long weekend on a company trip. The property is beautiful. The staff is friendly and helpful. BUT....check in and check out are long and involved. Communication is poor as to exactly what services are included in the upgrades, how check out works, and group dinner reservations were difficult. There was no communication as to shows and activities going on at the property so we missed a lot of fun. BUT...the property is beautiful and the staff are friendly. Overall it was a wonderful, relaxing trip.

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: This place is a dump.  Don't be fooled by the reviews here
reviews.text: This is the 2nd year I was forced to attend a conference at this hotel by my employer.  The food is absolutely HORRIBLE.  The resort while having the appearance of being clean is filled with mold.  The resort burns incense continuously to mask the horrible smells of mold and rot.  The resorts is very dated and dark. And if you stay in the main town, they play blaring music well into the night.  I would NEVER bring my family here and hope I never have to stay here again.  If you like nice, airy, CLEAN resorts with good food there are so many other choices in Cancun.  Heed my warning

reviews.author: Shannon S
reviews.title: Had an AMAZING trip
reviews.text:
We had an AMAZING trip! All of the staff were so helpful and friendly! LOVED the energy of the dancers and the music playing all weekend. Would highly recommend and WILL be coming back. 

Rodrigo, Julio, and Saul were amazing!!

reviews.author: Rigotto
reviews.title: Need some SERIOUS renovation!
reviews.text:
Looks like this was a great hotel in the past.  It is falling in pieces. Everywhere you walk inside the hotel, there are white towels covering the floor due to infiltration. 
The rooms maybe are clean but you cannot guarantee as everything is a shipwreck, old and not working. 
The food is poorly prepared. 

The attention is the teams is good although at reception it looks like they treat you badly to create a disappointment and then you finally see some good service from the others. 

I guess there might be several other places in Cancun to stay that would provide a better experience. 

Have to admit again that the crew at hotel restaurants and bar are well trained and carefully. It is just the place that needs some SERIOUS renovation.

reviews.author: AGLZB
reviews.title: De regular a malo
reviews.text: Un edificio que se ve bastante viejo, unas habitaciones que bien pudieran ser las de un hotel de 3 estrellas, las opciones del buffete son muy limitadas, los restaurantes a la carta tienen muy poca capacidad y la barra libre bastante corriente, los meseros y bar tenders ignoran a los mexicanos y se enfoncan solo en los extranjeros, hasta el momento que se les da una propina, que si no es generosa, continuan ignorandote

reviews.author: Uli Camacho
reviews.title: Excelentes Instalaciones, pero...
reviews.text:
Falta mejorar el servicio en los restaurantes, es tardado y prácticamente corren a la gente cuando quieren cerrar...
Los elevadores son muy lentos. La
 atención del personal staff y de limpieza muy buena.

reviews.author: StephTheGray
reviews.title: Royal Service and the pool conscierge, Degnar are the BEST!
reviews.text:
Here for my husband's annual sales meeting, staying 6 nights.

Arrival was a rough start.  Our flight arrived early, so we were on site trying to check in at 11:30am.  What else are you gonna do?  Fully-clothed, luggage, been up since 3:50am... but alas, our room was not ready yet.  We waited.  And waited.  And waited.  Colleagues were being placed in their rooms... not us.  Finally at 4:30pm, my husband blew a gasket and was speaking with Roberto, one of the front managers, and he took care of things right away.  We upgraded to Royal Service for $100 extra per night, ocean view, room 5608 and it was the best thing we could've done.

Once on site we found the Royal Service to be quiet, no kids, and nearly unpopulated.  Every day you have to reserve a Bali Bed if you want one (awesome, canopied beds around the pool and beach.  Degnar ALWAYS was kind, courteous and professional.  He always tried to accommodate whatever needs I had.  I hope the hotel will consider giving that man a raise.  He arrives every day at 5:00am and works hard to create a clean, inviting space for guests, including me.  Thanks, Degnar!

*The gym is excellent, I used the elliptical machine, treadmill and free weights.
*Room service is excellent.
*La Palapa (Royal Service exclusive restaurant) is excellent.
*Beach service food and drinks are excellent.  Be SURE TO TRY THE SPRING ROLLS.  
*Surf is beautiful aqua blue and is very, very rough with RED FLAGS always up.  There are only a couple of yellow flags further downs the beach in sections wheret it's a little safer to swim.
*Lots of easily accessible bathrooms.
*Waitstaff speak pretty good English and they helped me with my fledgling Spanish.
*Nespresso machine in my room... YES!
*Nicely stocked room refrigerator (chips, M&Ms, beer, water, juice, etc).
*Weather in January is incredibly wonderful, not nearly as hot as Punta Cana this same time of year.
*You get your own personal assistant while you're here (Royal Service only).  We didn't use him much, but others seem to use theirs a lot.
*Clean, clean, clean!!! (at least in our RS area)
*Plenty of well-located beach chairs.
*Aqua - World is across the street inland and it's fun and free to go watch people in the surf machine.  Or you can pay and try it!
*Tipping is optional.

I'm going to visit the Myan Pyramids tomorrow (Chitzan-Itza)... $89 for a Royal Service guest.  It's an all-day (7-7pm) excursion, I will update when it's over.

So... come here.  But DO get the Royal Service.  You won't regret it.  It's crowded and noisy in the other sections.  Building FIVE is great.

reviews.author: rotceh75
reviews.title: Hotel de gran nivel, excelente!!!!
reviews.text: Excelente calidad calidez y servicio, el director del hotel el Sr. Cardozo de lo mejor, muy atento y siempre dispuesto a dar la mejor atencion, la Srita. Lizeth Escudero excelente en su atenion y supervision del evento excelente organizadora. Todo de lujo.

reviews.author: Al K
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
This is a pic of the interior of pyramid three .
You can enjoy fine dining in the Japanese restaurant located in the middle
This is a large resort with a boutique feel. This is because there is wide selection of restaurants and eating areas. The service is superb. The staff are always smiling and so helpful. Housekeeping was five stars . Overall a wonderful experience

reviews.author: work2travel991
reviews.title: warm getaway
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel both inside and out.  Beach was large and spacious.  Plenty of chairs, large pools and ample bars.  Food was not the best that I have experienced.  Making reservations was a joke unless you are willing to eat at 10pm.  Not a place with much night life or entertainment which was fine with me.  Good place to stay and enjoy the wonderful weather.

reviews.author: Sheri L
reviews.title: Not Impressed
reviews.text:
We had a nice stay.  The ocean view is beautiful.  Staff was excellent.  However, I would never stay at this property again.  

Food is below average for a property of this type and price.  The food was just not good.  I didn’t realize nacho cheese sauce could be like water until I ate here.  I did not think nacho cheese sauce was something that could be ruined but it was literally LIQUID.  Very disappointed with the food.  

Restaurant reservations are a joke.  I think they want you to book reservations and tell you nothing is available so you eat at the buffet.  

The main areas of the hotel are hot and humid all the time.  It is hot and muggy inside the main area at all times of the day and night.

There was only one elevator working for the side of the building (8 floors) where we were staying on.  We had to always use the stairs and because the main area is always so hot, we could not even go to dinner without sweating.  

Steps?  OMG...you don’t need to work out while on vacation when you are staying in this resort.  There are steps, steps, and more steps to go around on this property.  If you have a family member who cannot walk well or is in a wheelchair, do not stay at this resort.  

To get a beach towel you have to get them from people selling trips and excursions.  If I wanted more than a beach towel, I would go see the concierge.  I just want a towel to go relax by the beach or pool.  

I will no go back, and I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: PaddyGMurphy
reviews.title: Cancun could
reviews.text: The Paradisus Resort was a very good holiday venue. Bit worn and weary with a couple of restaurants being rebuilt nonetheless despite the many stairs up and down the place was good and the beach lovely. Above all else got to say the staff were most efficient and friendly.

reviews.author: reginagaciaol
reviews.title: El mejor servicio y spa
reviews.text: El servicio es excelente, es all inclusive pero un concepto luxclusive en donde todo es de la mayor calidad! Además es muy grande y no sientes que haya mucha gente, tienen experiencias increíbles, la playa está enorme y divina y los restaurantes muy buenos además de que tienen Tempo, restaurante del Chef Martin Berasategui. El spa tiene más de 60 tratamientos, alberca, sauna, vapor y un jardín oriental con cabinas independientes y sus terapeutas están muy capacitadas.

reviews.author: Noemi L
reviews.title: Estive no Paraíso
reviews.text: Fiquei impressionada com o design do local e o que ele tinha a oferecer. Superou minhas expectativas. Opções de alimentação e atrações. Trata-se de um resort: de frente para o mar, com piscinas e restaurantes. A equipe é muito prestativa e os quartos, muito aconchegantes.

reviews.author: Deshayc
reviews.title: Worst stay of my Life
reviews.text:
This was the WORST hotel I have ever stayed in! Do no I REPEAT DO NOT STAY HERE. For an all inclusive hotel at $440 per night + tax It was terrible. Where do I begin: 

Check in: they could not find our reservation and you CAN NOT book at the front desk so I had to go Via Expedia (God Bless them) and book another room. It took us 3 hours to check in. The entire process was SLOW!

Food: I tried all the restaurants including room service and NONE of it was good. I mean barly etable! The eggs where pink and the pasta tasted it came out of a can. The pizza was bad I mean how do you mess up pizza. The cookies where even bad. I could go on but o don’t have enough time. 

Checkout: trying to leave the hotel in a timely fashion we waiting in line for 40 min to check out and you have to stand in the line because you need a check out card in order to leave the hotel. They literally would not let us leave because I needed to swipe my card they already had on file for the equivalent of $20USD. 

Positives: The staff - they are SUPER friendly and helpful and the service other than check in and check out is pretty swift. 

Unfortunately, I would never stay here again which is a shame because I am due back to Cancun 3 more times in the next year.

reviews.author: Jennifer M
reviews.title: Experiencia regular-mala
reviews.text:
Nos hospedamos en este hotel como sede de un congreso. A la llegada, etiquetaron mal mi maleta (3518 en vez de 3815) y estuvo pérdida en otra habitación por 3 horas. Hasta que no me puse intensa y llamaba cada 10 minutos, me hicieron el "favor" de ver qué sucedía y llevarla a mi habitación. Llegué al evento con 1 hora de retraso gracias a su error.
La comida regular y pocas mesas disponibles para el tamaño del hotel (habitaciones). En algunos restaurantes el tiempo de espera era de 30 a 60 minutos. 
A una amiga le entregaron su habitación hasta la noche y no servia el aire acondicionado y no había sillas para la mesa/escritorio.
A pesar de estar en el octavo piso, el viernes por la noche/madrugada (00:00-01:00 hrs) se pusieron a limpiar con una karcher el puente de madera del restaurante que se localiza en medio de la torre 3 y el ruido era perceptible en mi habitación.
Algunos meseros fueron poco atentos y parecía que te hacían un favor al servirte lo que previamente te ofrecían (café, agua, etc).

reviews.author: salipime
reviews.title: Royal Service, una verdadera experiencia
reviews.text: Felicito a Leiner, mayordomo de Royal Service. excelente presentación y servicio. el hotel confortable y el servicio es excelente. Los alimentos deliciosos....y los helados geniales. hotel recomendado

reviews.author: Cesg
reviews.title: Instalações lindas
reviews.text: Hotel bem grande na zona hoteleira de Cancún.  Otima localização,  com praia muito bonita e limpa. No sistema all inclusive,  ótima comida e excelentes bebidas. Apartamentos relativamente pequenos em comparação a hoteis de mesma categoria.  Poucas opções de lazer dentro do hotel, piscina relativamente pequena, deixando a desejar a diversão para famílias.

reviews.author: jenniferb_carson
reviews.title: Whoo whoo was awesome
reviews.text: Great trip & Service Wonderful experience staff awesome would come back, Red Lounge was fun enjoyed that ear phone thing never done that before great drinks with premium alcohol used; plenty of room at pool & beach

reviews.author: pablo382
reviews.title: Hotel de sobresaliente
reviews.text: Viajo por negocios y no lo aprovecho mucho, pero es un hotel muy recomendable para pasar unos días de relax, yo voy un par de veces al mes desde hace casi un año y con estancias de 5 o 6 días, buenas instalaciones y el personal es muy proactivo, en todos los viajes siempre aprovecho una noche para cenar en el magnifico restaurante "Tempo" de Martín Berasategui

reviews.author: fachago
reviews.title: Decepción en servicio
reviews.text: Aunque el hotel es bonito y con buenas instalaciones, quedamos decepcionados del servicio. Asistimos a una convención, pero claramente el hotel discrimina a los que no son miembros del club Meliá o de royal Services. Nos hospedamos 5 días y no solo habían áreas del hotel restringidas, sino también restaurantes y bares. Y las reservas en los restaurantes tenían tantas restricciones que fue imposible asistir a los restaurantes con servicio a la carta que nos tocó en el buffet todos los días. En la playa y área de piscina igualmente discriminan a los que fuimos como huéspedes de convención. El gym muy bueno y el desayuno variado. La mayoría de meseros prestan buen servicio. Por todo esto fue una decepción

reviews.author: 530arturoa
reviews.title: Buena opción en relación al costo.
reviews.text: Atención amable, cómodo y agradable, la habitación mostró falta de mantenimiento en algunas áreas y a pesar de reservar directamente en su portal me dieron una habitación con vista a los aires acondicionados. No tiene acceso de primera intención a todos los bares y restaurantes.

reviews.author: cazadorRolo
reviews.title: Excellent view, 360 degrees of the best in Cancun
reviews.text:
The hotel is located in the best corner of Cancun. To enjoy it you have to have enough time for your excellent services.
What we liked most was the center of convections and the views from each habilitation with exclusive terraces with total privacy.
At breakfast time you see a sea with 7 colors, which only invites you to visit it and rest on the beach.

reviews.author: Ramon Valencia Jr
reviews.title: Business trip with company exec's and others
reviews.text: Nice stay, included everything,  fitness center, all inclusive restaurants,  Japanese to Mexican and buffets. All you can drink also, nice Red Lounge on lobby floor, nice little club. Convenient meeting facilities,  good restaurants,  great 5 star service at all aspects. Saturday night buffet and pool show. Great room service, full of Pokemon Stops. Kid and adult friendly , although no special catering to them or section. Very friendly staff, except for 1 obnoxious waiter by the poolside buffet. 99.9% of staff were great. Great pools, nice beach, showers accessible, rooms awesome and spacious.

reviews.author: Maria V
reviews.title: Me sorprendió
reviews.text: Fui por trabajo y tuve tiempo libre para disfrutar de este hermoso lugar, lleno de vegetación por dentro como otros Meliá, la comida es buena para ser all inclusive y estan bien separadas las zonas de adultos solos y familias con niños. Habitaciones grandes comidas y bien equipadas, y una hermosa guardería para quien vaya con niños. Lo recomiendo me gustó mucho.

reviews.author: Diego D
reviews.title: Me encanto
reviews.text: Hace unas semanas estuve ahí y realmente me encantó el hotel y sus instalaciones. Aunque no tuve mucho tiempo de disfrutar por que iba de negocios el tiempo libre que tuve me la pase muy bien, pero lo que en verdad quiero agradecer y quedé fascinado es que en mi último día entrando al hotel de ver la playa por último momento vi que estaban dando muestras de masajes y en verdad me sorprendí sólo me quedaban 2 horas en el hotel. Decidí tomar la demo cosa magnífica esa chica wow me enamoro, tiene unas manos que hizo que en el último momento le comprara el masaje de 50 minutos y tuve la suerte que ella fuera quien me diera el masaje, una chica muy joven su nombre samantha pero muy amable, atenta, super profesional con unas manos que a todo mundo le recomiendo, me quito el stress de esos días de trabajo, me hizo desconectarse de Todo. Es la mejor jamás había tomado un masaje tan perfecto, el ambiente, el aroma, la comodidad, pero sobre todo la terapeuta que hizo un día inolvidable, no sabia la calidad de spa con la que contaba el hotel, cuando vuelva será lo primero que haga ir al hotel y buscar a samantha. Gracias totales paradisus!!

reviews.author: Fearless794946
reviews.title: Pesimo host de eventos
reviews.text:
El trato profesional a los clientes que llevan grupos deja mucho que desear. Poco profesionalismo. Mala atencion. Solo ven el mercantilismo y no la atencion al cliente. Relacion precio/calidad es deficiente. 
EVITAR HACER EVENTOS TIPO CONGRESOS.

reviews.author: Felipe C
reviews.title: Gran hotel para tus convenciones!!!
reviews.text:
Hotel de buena calidad!!! El staff esta realmente preocupado por que no se acaben las opciones en los buffetes / gran cantidad de restaurantes, con diversas opciones para diferentes paladares... ( me gusto la magia de no sentirme dentro de un all inclusive, ya que todas las noches puedes tener cenas distintas y divertidas. Lamentablemente no pude probar un restaurante que existe dentro de el resort, que es de 5 estrellas a un precio mas que conveniente)

Cabe la pena destacar a Aldo Ronces, lejos el mejor gerente de grupos y convenciones con el que he tenido el placer de trabajar. 

Es como una sombra que siempre esta atenta a las necesidades de tu evento!!!

Si van a realizar eventos en Cancun, Melia es una buena opcion!!!

reviews.author: Nidia M
reviews.title: Espectacular!
reviews.text: Su arquitectura y diseño lo hacen especial, la atención de su gente. Ubicación privilegiada. Variedad de restaurantes de alta calidad, es de los hoteles de Cancún que cuentan con un centro de convenciones de gran capacidad y de excelentes instalaciones. Se ajusta perfectamente tanto para planes empresariales como convenciones y congresos como en plan faliliar

reviews.author: Lorena C
reviews.title: Buena experiencia.
reviews.text: Me hospedé por trabajo 10 días. Al momento de entrar aprecias lo bonito del hotel y sus miles de enredaderas y vegetación en el centro. Los bell boys son en general amables. En recepción todos muy bien! La habitación era muy linda, un día en lugar de hacer limpieza completa solo tendieron las camas. Las amenidades de baño son buenas pero no fui fan del olor del shampoo y acondicionador, así que tuve que comprar otro ahí. La comida del buffet naos es buena solo que se volvió muy rutinario. Felicidades al mesero Atilano y a la hostess. Hay otra opción para desayunar que es en el centro del hotel pero hace calor y no tienen tantas opciones. Market grill lo mejor su arrachera! Y su mesero Juan muy atento y divertido. Enso en platillos fuertes no me gustó mucho pero appetizers sí. El servicio de ahí fue excelente! Blue agave tiene buenos tacos, el de lengua es sorpresivamente delicioso! El pozole le hace falta mucho sabor y las quesadillas muy ricas. Servicio regular. El café nesspreso que está afuera de blue agave tiene excelentes e inusuales combinaciones, solo que el servicio es muy malo. Bana mi favorito! La comida exquisita, prueben el tartar de atún y aguacate, el maki especial y la bebida coconut white. Miguel nuestro mesero muy buen servicio. Vayan a cocos bar con sammy, ofrece un divertido servicio y es muy buen barman. En fuego la crema de cangrejo deliciosa y el ceviche de salmón, también el sirlon muy rico. Servicio regular. El centro de convenciones está en muy mal estado, tiene goteras y humedad por todas partes. Hay un olor en los pasillos también muy desagradable. El aire acondicionado en los salones es demasiado frío. De no haber sido por el servicio constante de coffe break, no habría nada bueno que comentar. Los shows por la noche son lindos y entretenidos.

reviews.author: pablo382
reviews.title: Hotel muy tranquilo, recomendable para desconectar y relajarse.
reviews.text: Voy con frecuencia a Cancún por motivos de trabajo y siempre me alojo en este hotel, la verdad es que me da pena no poder disfrutar durante el día de sus instalaciones, pero aun así puedo decir que es un hotel impresionante.

reviews.author: StreathamVoyager
reviews.title: Sub-par business trip
reviews.text:
Stayed here for 10 days for a conference in June 2018. It all went wrong as we tried to check in, as staff were giving contradictory advice about where to check in. You’d think it would be at the main “check-in” desks by the big front door. But oh no - we had to go down stairs, along a corridor, round a corner and then down an escalator to find another check-in desk for conferences. I was checked in efficiently and given a room number but no guidance on how to find it, so spent 15 mins walking round the hotel, dragging my suitcase, looking for the room. Suddenly no staff could be found for directions... Anyway, my room was tucked away in a basement level and if I leaned out far enough from its terrace, I could just about glimpse the parking lot. The room was large and perfectly clean, with a separate seating area down a small step. It’s what they called a “Junior Suite”. The light switches were a constant source of entertainment for the full ten days I stayed ... I still didn’t really work out which switch did what. They were like one of those logic puzzles where you have to align them all, in the right order, to get a light to switch on. In the bathroom, the towel rail and shower curtain rail were barely clinging to the wall thanks to a few loose screws. 

The hotel communal areas had a constant strange smell of rancid swamp. Some guessed it was the insecticide they use to keep the mosquitos down. If that was the intention, it was only partly successful. But at least being in the basement was good for my health - it meant using lots of stairs to get anywhere else in the hotel. As others have mentioned, the doors and windows (and on a few occasions, ceilings) leaked profusely whenever it rained, and apparently, it rains a lot in Cancun in June. Most of the bars and restaurants had their windows lined with towels most of the time. One lunchtime, a large part of a ceiling collapsed into the lunch buffet and water sprayed liberally over food and guests. 

A positive word for the staff, who were very helpful and friendly,and mostly spoke good English. Samuel at Coco’s bar by the beach was very helpful. 

This was my first experience of staying in an all-inclusive resort hotel, so I’m not sure what I was expecting from the restaurants. Having to book a table the day before you wanted to eat was strange (unless you want dinner at 6.30 or 10pm, that is). I’ll review some of the restaurants separately. 

Summary: I was travelling on business.  I wouldn’t spend my own money on coming back here.

reviews.author: Coni812
reviews.title: Gorgeous View! Mediocure Food
reviews.text:
Was here in April for a work conference.  The resort location was beautiful!  Pool and beach well maintained,   Lots of chairs and palapa's.  Our room was on the first floor overlooking the pool and ocean. The room itself was disappointing.  We were missing a bathroom door.. which is a little awkward when rooming with someone you work with and don't know well. But the view was so wonderful we decided not to request another room.  Our lighted mirror and coffee maker didn't work though the front desk was quick to have someone come and fix them.   

We were with a large conference and on the all inclusive.   Food was very disappointing.  I survived the week on dinner rolls and chips and guacamole (the guac was fantastic though) and some fruit.  Most of the meals were barely warm. (that scares me)  The night we had Mexican was good.  Other nights there was Thai and Italian etc.  The pool food was much better - pizza, chicken wings, chicken sandwiches.  Also many in our group raved about the Sushi restaurant.  (I don't care for Sushi so didn't go).  There were also a few other restaurants that I didn't try because of time restrictions and wanting to spend time at the pool or beach.  Feedback from coworkers were mixed, some good some bad.   The drinks are weak, I'm not much of a drinker so that really wasn't an issue for me.  The meeting venues were really nice and the resort itself seemed clean though needing some maintenance (like our bathroom door, some paint touch up etc)  All the employees were very friendly and helpful. 

We have stayed at another resort twice that was much nicer but didn't have a view.   It wasn't an all inclusive and food and drinks were much better.   I didn't pay for this stay so I've given it an average score but probably wouldn't stay here if I were paying for a vacation.  I like to eat.   But the view and ocean was unbelievably beautiful!!!

reviews.author: tenderfille
reviews.title: Weekend fabuloso - Royal Service
reviews.text: Acabo de regresar y la verdad me he quedado enamorada del hotel, es uno de los mejores hoteles todo incluido en los cuales he estado. La atencion era A 1- el servicio, la comida, las instalaciones, tuve la suerte de estar en la zona excluisiva Royal Service, mi mayordomo Hector, fue optimo, de gran ayuda, hizo de todo porque mi estadia fuera agradable, viniendo por viaje de negocios, no pude disfrutar tantisimo de todas las instaciones, la habitacion que me otorgaron supero mis espectativas, era una vista al mar estupeda. Me encantaria regresar pero esta vez con mi familia...

reviews.author: Barski42
reviews.title: Comfortable spot in the Hotel Zone
reviews.text: Spent three nights here last week. Nice beach, good restaurants, Agave great tacos.Large, comfortable guest room, fridge and flat screen tv. Spaceous bathroom complete with a bidet. View of lagoon from deck was nice.Staff were all friendly and helpful, premium liquor available as part of all-inclusive.

reviews.author: DJ S
reviews.title: Extended business trip
reviews.text:
A group of us extended a business trip to add 
some personal time , the conference areas and areas we had group dinner and get together where great we had over 600 people for our event. We stayed a couple days later for some free time. We had great experiences everywhere we had great food great drinks and the service was amazing.  Edwardo and Edwin at the buffet took great care of us with a personalized meal, Hugo by the pool was there everyday and we made sure to sit where he was working . I would definitely recommend this resort for a business group as everything was great on the attendee side , for regular guests I would love to come back. Many restaurants right on property, areas for all types of family’s or just adults.

reviews.author: potosina
reviews.title: Expectativas no cumplidas
reviews.text: Yo no elegi el hotel. Fui a éste por motivo de congreso. El hotel se nota una edificación vieja con un mantenimiento regular los elevadores no tenía aire acondicionado las habitaciones están bien conservadas..pasable. Lo que no me gustó en Absoluto  es la comida  de los restaurantes más concurrido para desayunos y comida El Naos y el Market Grill. Es bufett. El sabor deficiente.  Arroz quemado. Sopas insípida. Carne asadaen grandes volúmenes...mala cocción. Muy dura. El servicio de losmeseris extremadamente deficiente.  Si usted busca calidad y servicio...elija otro. No lo recomiendo. Ni volvería

reviews.author: Martín G
reviews.title: Una experiencia deficiente
reviews.text: En un hermoso lugar, de clima delicioso se encuentra uno en un hotel de buena vista de lejos. De cerca se nota el paso del tiempo. Con un diseño confuso que acaba por vencerse. Hermosas albercas y un servicio regular. Su mayor deficiencia son los restaurantes, donde los meseros atienden en pequeñas porciones... A pesar de ser "all inclusive", tardas mucho en comer porqué los meseros se ahogan en cuanto aumentan los comensales. No te llevan todo lo que pides, solo pequeñas porciones. No es un servicio fluido y solo es "rápido" si les das propina... Decepcionante.

reviews.author: Ana C
reviews.title: EXCELENTE SERVICIO
reviews.text: Me hospede a finales de Febrero, y la experiencia fue muy buena. Los puntos a resaltar son:  El excelente nivel de servicio, todo el personal es muy atento y pendiente del servicio. Lo más recomendable es el Restaurante Naos, ofrece un buffet super completo, variado, con alimentos de gran calidad. Por la mañana puedes obtener un licuado recién hecho.

reviews.author: Jm L
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio, La comida de buena calidad y mucha variedad en restaurantes de Especialidades!
reviews.text: Me hospedé del 28 de Febrero al 3 de Marzo, el hotel tiene muy buena variedad y calidad de alimentos, el servicio es muy bueno y todo el personal muy atento. Marcas de licores premium yl as habitaciones de muy buen tamaño, definitivamente una de las mejores opciones en todo incluido en Cancún.

reviews.author: angiejennifer
reviews.title: My first time in Mexico :)
reviews.text: A few days ago I visited for the first time Cancun, Mexico. I stayed at Paradisus Cancun, the gorgeous and Magical Paradisus Cancun!! I will never forget that experience. The Hotel is amazing, the staff is awesome, so nice and so attentive!! the center of the hotel simply magical. I felt in love with Paradisus Cancun, the layout, the Beach, the staff, everything. I ate too much, best tacos ever!!!! can´t wait to come back with my mom and daugther... :)

reviews.author: Gloria M
reviews.title: Yoli Annual Incentive Trip
reviews.text: This was our Second trip to the Paradisus Resort and the experience was very memorable, From the time that the shuttle picked us up at the airport to take us to the Resort until the time we left we were treated with the utmost respect and attention to detail by a super friendly and very knowledgeable staff. We were definitely impressed with the quality of the food and the quality of the entertainment. In addition we were treated to a very special Dinner cooked by Chef Eduardo Mukol,he was amazing with the presentation of our dinner and it was better than most 5 star restaurants that we have visited. The beach at the resort was beautiful and very clean and the waitstaff were extremely courteous and professional. We were so impressed that we also joined Club Melia so we can return more often.

reviews.author: Diana W
reviews.title: Royal Service Wonderful!
reviews.text: I was at Paradisus for business and was fortunate enough to stay in the Royal Service area.  The rooms are very spacious and views to either the ocean or the bay.  I had a butler - Rode as well.  He went above and beyond, always there for every request and was outstanding!  Thank you Rode!! Dinners in each of the restuarnts were very good.  We had a dinner on the last night out on the golf course that was outstanding.

reviews.author: 335tracyt
reviews.title: Horrible place to stay!
reviews.text: So many reasons why to pick a different place to stay!  Poor food quality, poor service... our room flooded from a blocked drain on the deck... poor clean up and did not offer anything for our inconvenience  Gourmet coffee bar not open until noon!  What!?  Wanted to exchange $100 for $20's.. We were told "no".  The language barrier was so bad that even when they could speak English you good not understand what they were saying.  Will NEVER go back and NEVER recommend!

reviews.author: RodrigoGC
reviews.title: Qué buen hotel!
reviews.text:
Estuve ahí casi una semana, por motivos de trabajo, y en todo momento me sentí en un gran hotel. Todo, todo refleja una gran atención a los detalles. Desde el check-in hasta el momento en que uno lo abandona, siempre se disfruta de sonrisas con acción.
La comida estupenda en las diferentes opciones que el hotel provee.
La verdad, es de los mejores hoteles de playa que he encontrado.

reviews.author: TravelerForLifeNow
reviews.title: The food is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Stayed at this all inclusive resort for a business conference.  The property is run down and dated.  The food is absolutely horrible, especially the buffet restaurants.  The remaining restaurants all require reservations.  I would NEVER stay here again

reviews.author: MissXTraveller
reviews.title: Great resort with all the expected perks, though inconsistent housekeeping
reviews.text:
I recently stayed here for 6 nights for a work conference. I stayed at the Jr Suite Lagoon View and had the "all inclusive" package. It was pretty special being able to go to most of the restaurants and bars on-site and have unlimited food and drinks. You did feel very VIP. 

The resort itself is lovely, large with many downtime options, including pools, bars, spas, the beach just at your doorstep, etc. Also, the staff were all varying degrees friendly and accommodating to very much so. 

The only main gripe was the housekeeping. I always find it quite disappointing when 5-star venues do not uphold consistent and standard housekeeping. Always makes me suspicious about what other standards may not be upkept. For instance, my bed was always made up differently, sometimes my toiletries were refreshed, sometimes not. Sometimes I got clean towels, sometimes not. Sometimes my toiletries items were nicely organized, sometimes they were left scattered. Sometimes the floors were cleaned, sometimes not. (You can tell by sand). 

Also, on my first evening, while I was in my room for a quick outfit change, I was almost instantly disrupted by very loud, ongoing knocking on the door - I had to YELL "one minute!!!" on the top of my lungs... And all it was, was a staff member asking if I wanted more bottles of water. He didn't even give me 30 seconds to respond before he kept incessantly knocking. I had to put the DND sign on my door every time I was in my room.

Also, the restaurants on-site to vary in quality, and aside from Bana (which I found to be very western, unauthentic Japanese, with sashimi not being fresh, and certain dishes very oily), all the restaurants were fine to very good. 

All in all, very good resort, adjoining the beautiful beaches with plenty to do on-site.

reviews.author: Stephen C
reviews.title: Awesome Vacation - set a new bar in Awesomeness
reviews.text: Stayed here for 5 incredible nights for my company’s annual sales conference and it was spectacular!  the food was phenomenal in all the restaurants, the service was top-notch, the views and the accommodations were absolutely awesome.  Will be heading back there for my own personal vacations very soon highly recommend place

reviews.author: Carlos Rodrigo O
reviews.title: Perfect Resort
reviews.text:
Very nivel resort. Five stars.
Food, room, staff are perfect.
Swimming pools are more than perfect.

Shows in the night is very nice
This is a very nice place for families.

I didn't like some rules.
The bars close to swimming pools , they close at 05:00 pm.
They should leave one of them open until later.
We left the swimming pool and tried to go to the restaurant. You have to take a shower and change the clothes.

This is a very nice place, of course I recommend it for everyone.

reviews.author: SamerDaher
reviews.title: All inclusive means all inclusive - almost
reviews.text:
Annual conference. Where else? Cancun.

Where in Cancun? The Paradisus...

I have mixed feelings about the place which is no fault of their own. The food is abundant but dietary restrictions are one thing they’re not sensitive to. I don’t eat pork or non-halal meat so it was quite a feat to convince the staff on the pasta station to use a clean skillet and clean utensils that aren’t tainted by ham. Not their fault I have dietary restrictions but they’re insensitive to it as well and will look at you like a Martian.

The beach is awesome. Fine smooth sand. Even on a cloudy and windy day, the sea is refreshing.

The restaurants aren’t that great. The fish has a funky taste as if it’s been in the open for longer than it should be. The sushi place is NOT recommended. It qualifies as the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Sincerely.

The Spanish tapas are good and yummy for a change but we ended up in Naos, the main buffet most of the time.

The staff are helpful, the views are amazing (see attached pics).

My trip was disrupted by a visitor. The culprit was a cockroach lying dead on its in the bathtub. Apart from that, the rooms are clean.

Would I go there again? Yes. Overall it was a positive experience.

reviews.author: 357grgrgr
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Friendly staff various restaurants and a great beach. The golf is tiny and seems a bit dangerous but ok for a pitch and put. Breakfast is great and the restaurants and bars are excellent. A special mention for the market grill.

reviews.author: kfheimer
reviews.title: Paradisus is Paradise for Smaller Meetings
reviews.text:
We hosted a smaller sales kick-off event at the Paradisus for a week and everything went perfectly. Claudia from the sales department was responsive and helpful in her response to our RFP. Apolo in the meeting groups department was beyond excellent, and was there every step of the way - from check in to check out and everything in between. 

The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach with loads of restaurants, food choices and is always immaculately clean. Our group was able to find small meeting spaces when we needed it, and the bars and clubs provided options for night time activities.

The conference center was larger than we expected, and although our rooms had no windows the set up was perfect and kept us focused.

Overall a great event, and we hope to go back!

reviews.author: 240garyo
reviews.title: woudl have like to spend everday in the ocean, but there was a rip tide
reviews.text: Hotel was all inclusive and very nice. But I would like staying not all inclusive to go and explore more of the area. Swimming in the ocean was not possible due to the rip tide. I had hope there would be snorkling there or near by, but it was not clear enough.

reviews.author: Jennifer K
reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: We stayed with a big group and had a ton of fun.  The service no matter where you ate or even on the beach was great.  Our first experience with an all inclusive resort.  They are very organized and the resort was well maintained and clean. Market grill was our favorite restaurant.  Raphael and Manuel were so funny and we had a good time.

reviews.author: Andy Z
reviews.title: Sales Reward Trip/Meeting
reviews.text: We had a great time for the 4 nights we were here.   The staff were all great, friendly and attentive.  In particular Sofonia and Hector were great keeping us fed and watered.  Lots of places to hang out and eat.   We ended up using the Enos restaurant for morning meetings and it worked well by just using multiple laptops.

reviews.author: dlw240
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! We have never stayed at an all inclusive place before and didn’t know what to expect. My hubby and I went as part of a work conference so we got to see how they do two large dinner events in addition to the normal day to day activities. Staff and service were amazing. The food was delicious...everything from the conference buffet dinners to the buffet to the many restaurants. We didn’t have time to try them all! Everything was clean and comfortable. The pools are huge and gorgeous. Lots of beachfront with cabanas and lounge chairs. There is a lifeguard and the staff walked the beach keeping it clean. There was a lot of live entertainment, which was all excellent (and we are disappointed we missed the jet ski in the pool with some acrobats doing a routine!). We are thinking about going back with our kids and grandkids. We did see they had a kids indoor play area but didn’t go inside. It is showing its age in some places (some ripped/broken beach chairs and cabana cushions, for example). Although we were supposed to get our in room mini bar restocked each day, that wasn’t done, nor did they give us more coffee or water for the room after we used what we had been given. I feel certain had we brought this to management’s attention they would have fixed it, but it wasn’t important enough to us to bother with. Don’t expect great TV in English - there was only one channel with English-speaking shows...reruns of CSI, NCIS and Criminal Minds. We we’re too busy enjoying the resort to care, but this is something to keep in mind if TV is important to you. As other reviewers have mentioned, bring cash to tip the terrific service staff. All things considered we had a great time and would definitely go back.

reviews.author: Gio1977
reviews.title: Buen servicio, hermoso hotel
reviews.text:
Estuve hospedada en este resort para una convención de mi empresa.
Son 5 torres de aproximadamente 4 pisos cada una, el hotel cuenta con aproximadamente 8 restaurantes, de los cuáles 1 tiene una estrella Michelin del chef Martín Berasategui; 3 bares ( uno de playa), dos nocturnos; 3 albercas ( una de ellas es para los huéspedes de la torre 5 con membresía dorada), precioso jacuzzi, área de masajes, spa. 
El hotel está muy bien ambientado, con música agradable, tuve la sensación de estar en un lugar en el cuál se puede descansar a gusto.
Las habitaciones muy limpias y espaciosas, bien equipadas con pantalla, servibar, caja fuerte, sombrilla, toallas para la alberca y hasta una bolsa de mano, por si necesitas espacio para cargar el bronceador, lentes de sol, etc.
Aunque estuve de trabajo, disfrute mucho mi estancia, porque observé que la playa estaba muy limpia, hubo música en vivo. La mayoria de los restaurantes deben de reservarse para la cena,aunque también existe la opción del buffet. No tuve oportunidad de estar en todos, pero me gustó mucho el denominado "Fuego" con una fusión de comida peruana y chilena. El único restaurante que no requiere reservación y está abierto casi 24 horas es el Blue Agave. cuya comida es mexicana, honestamente muy bueno. Pero para los amigos extranjeros, también pueden hacer su reservación en el restaurante Mole que es comida mexicana contemporánea.
Por otra parte a medio día, trataba de tomar un café en la estación de Nespresso o bien saborear un riquisimo helado o una crepa.
También hay desayuno buffet o americano con excelentes opciones de alimentos y bebidas.
No observé muchos niños, quizás sea por la temporada, pero creo que es una excelente opción por la calidad del servicio, felicito al personal, todos eran muy amables.

reviews.author: OK_Traveling2014
reviews.title: Poor hotel
reviews.text:
Exceedingly poor hotel for the money.

I booked a lagoon view suite only to have a view of a wall. The light switches are cracked and broken, there is only one working power point, the floor is dirty, the safe in the room was locked when I arrived, etc. 

Additionally, the staff couldn’t seem to care less about issues. When I went to check in, they insisted my company had not paid for the room despite my having a confirmation number. They said they would take an imprint of my credit card but wouldn’t charge it until we could sort it out in the morning. They of course charged it immediately.

Additionally, when I went back with the booking confirmation form showing the credit card imprint from the travel agent, they insisted on seeing the bank statement to confirm the payment had gone through. 

My EA emailed them 4 times without response, and I have been to reception 6 times now without resolution.

reviews.author: Daniel B
reviews.title: buen hotel, mal servicio
reviews.text: Mal servicio, habitación sucia con cabellos de mujer, trabajos de remodelación en el mismo piso, no hubo horario para reserva de cenas en restaurantes, una sola cama para 2 pasajeros hombres, pisos sucios. Mala experiencia para ser un 5 diamantes

reviews.author: Angie R
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: El hotel en general es muy moderno, todas las instalaciones cómo deben ser. Se nota la limpieza en sus espacios. Me hospedé en el lado de adultos -Royal Service- nada que envidiar! A veces daban ganas de no salir de la habitación a mi capacitación, me trataron como una reina! Gracias a Rode que fue mi mayordomo y a todo el personal!!

reviews.author: Revtra0151
reviews.title: Para pasar un tiempo placentero
reviews.text:
Es un hotel tipico de playa.

Es muy masivo y a veces los desayunos son bastante caoticos. Muy buenos los omelettes de Viridiana y también de Cristal. Se los pedí sin aceite y con solo clara

Dan mal impresión algunos camareros tirandose en picada sobre los turistas norteamericanos para conseguir alguna propina. Incluso le traen el champagne, etc.
Muy correctas las recepcionistas del comedor. Y en general muy atentos los camareros y todo el personal del hotel .

Fuimos a un congreso y como el hotel es All Inclusive se hicieron carga del cocktail que fue decepcionante. Mal servicio y comida raquítica .Si van y organizan un congreso en el hotel tengan cuidado con este punto.

Cuando hay mucha gente se cubren los palapas ( sombrillas de paja) de la playa.
Pero es agradable y menos agresivo estar debajo de las palapas de la piscina.

El mar es bastante variado de día a día. A veces el pozo está muy cerca de la playa y a veces está lejos. Solo en este último caso es agradable visitarlo

Para comida de más alto nivel reservar en los restaurantes que salvo uno de Martin Berasategui estan incluidos en el all inclusive. Como la atención es personalizada creo que es justo dejar una propina aunque no es obligatoria ni está definida. 
Muy encomiable el trabajo que toman sobre la encuesta previa sobre los alergenos para cada comensal. 

Muy bien mantenido el fitness center con algunas clases.

A veces hay filas muy largas para el pago. Hacerlo con tiempo..

Pedir el folleto de actividades para estar bien orientado desde el primer día

Algunos gritos de ebrios a la noche dificultan el dormir.

La ubicación no es buena ya que está lejos de la zona del intercontinental y de los malls pero en esa zona el mar es muy quieto. Pero es más tranquila porque en la zona del intercontinental suela haber mucho ebrio a la noche.

reviews.author: Lígia
reviews.title: Decepção
reviews.text:
Fiquei hospedada durante 5 dias, em uma viagem à trabalho, e parecia que a cada dia surgia uma nova decepção. Posso citar algumas delas:
- Meus colegas de trabalho e eu chegamos às 10h no hotel e não houve nenhum esforço para conseguir ao menos um quarto como early check-in, para tomarmos um banho e trocar de roupa. Ficamos de 10h às 12h monitorando um possível check-out e acabamos desistindo. Quando minha colega chegou ao quarto, por volta das 16h, havia uma mensagem de boas-vindas às 10:50h da manhã (será mesmo que o  quarto estava ocupado quando chegamos pela manhã?).

- Dias depois, quando fui solicitar um late check out, fui informada que eu poderia fazer o check out no meu horário normal, aproveitar as amenidades do hotel (piscina e praia), que depois eles cederiam, por 30 min, um quarto para eu tomar banho e trocar de roupa. Por que essa opção não foi oferecida quando eu cheguei? Tenho certeza que os funcionários perceberam o interesse que eu e meus colegas tínhamos após uma longa viagem.  

- A comida do restaurante buffet, no almoço e janta, tem uma qualidade muito abaixo do esperado de uma rede Meliá e os demais restaurantes requerem muita antecedência para reservar. Em algumas ocasiões, preferimos fazer a refeição fora do hotel.

- No nosso primeiro almoço, tivemos que solicitar 4 vezes ao garçom que trouxesse guardanapos à mesa. Na última, ele informou que não tinham mais guardanapos disponíveis. Somente quando perguntamos se não tinha nem de papel, ele conseguiu alguns.

- No último dia, minha colega matou uma barata no quarto. 

O hotel possui uma arquitetura muito bonita e piscinas/praia muito agradáveis, mas em termos de serviços existem pontos a melhorar. 

Espero que os demais hóspedes tenham uma experiência melhor que a minha.

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Nice looking hotel, great Beach, not an all Inclusive
reviews.text:
Just stayed there last week because of a Congress. The hotel is beautiful with great scenery and landscapes, beach is outstanding! However to be sold as an "All Inclusive" when you have to pay extra to get a bed by the beach or by the pool, then is not really an all Inclusive. We had to pay from $105-$150+ to get a bed by the beach (and of course, you get a bottle of champagne and food delivered), but the mere fact that you have to pay extra to get the better things of the hotel is definitively a bad thing. I have stayed at many other All Inclusive type of hotel, and when you say All Inclusive, is really all. Don't advertise like it if you are not ready to deliver... 

The other bad thing that was although my room was very nice, my mattress had an inclination on the head side. I didn't realize that for a couple of days, and as result, i had gastritis and reflux. When i noticed what created the problem, i tucked in the cushions from the living room under the head side of the mattress and problem solved. Good sleep (actually the mattres could have been better), but the best of it, gastritis and reflux were gone. 

Bad place to stay if you are an smoker. I don't really care that much about that, but certainly having to walk outside of the hotel to smoke or just having one single area for smoking by the beach is not a good thing if you want to relax and enjoy a cigar.

reviews.author: SMETIN
reviews.title: Nice hotel but staff are not so kind!
reviews.text: Hotel call its rooms suite but these are normal standard rooms .service are all inclusive it looks good but if you have guest from outside of hotel they want to charge you 120 usd for entering fee for hotel even your guest want to drink coffee with you !it means it is not convenient for any kind of business stay in this hotel .we were there for conference which makes us uncomfortable ..they have some restaurants for dinner such as japanese food service(it is good) and far east restaurant (taste meals are not good),fusion latin restaurant (i can not advice for my friend) and open buffet ( every day foods are same which is not convenient also. Generally it is good sea side hotel

reviews.author: Atti S
reviews.title: Big hotel in CAncun
reviews.text: This is an ' all inclusive ' hotel but that is a bit misleading because not everything is included. Good beach and pool and average food. Rooms are good especially the ones facing the ocean but the registration, checking in/out is a disaster, be prepared for long waits.

reviews.author: Caldeira Bertoli
reviews.title: Very good if you are on vacation mode and mood
reviews.text:
My stay was pleasant and you cannot complain about the all-inclusive fare. The food is quite reasonable, the drinks are server non-stop and the people nearby the pools are pleased to serve.

The inconveniences I found were on the instructions for the use of the  safety box - do not match with what you have to do to use it - and the not pleasant smell inside the drawers which prevented me from putting my clothes inside.

The pool and the beach are very pleasant to stay and I found it weird that the guest has to pay for the use of the bungalows by the pool.

If you are in a vacation mode and mood you will enjoy it.

reviews.author: naughty2000
reviews.title: All Inclusive in Cancún
reviews.text:
Just returned from Cancun where I attended the Alacero 58 Congress.

The large hotel complex has already seen it’s best days. The style and lay out (pyramid style) is outdated. Especially the lobby and the center of the pyramid are too dark and hot. The room (pyramid 4) was behind expectations. Bathroom boring, the room in white, average furnitures. However, the TV set was modern. 
What was really good is the beach aerea including two large pools. The beach very nice and clean.

It was my first time staying all inclusive but cannot understand the advantage of such concept. The lobby service was more or less missing. Especially during the day many outlets were not open but idle. Sometimes no chance to order an espresso or somehing else. Most staff had problems speaking English and/or were not motivated at all. Nevertheless tip exspectations were always evident.
May be for the many US tourists no problem but for many others.

The all inclusive concept together with many other things were not according to my taste and therefore do not plan to check again into this hotel or other hotels having the same concept. In my opinion all inclusive hotels should be excluded from common star ratings as it easily could be misguiding.

reviews.author: Maria D
reviews.title: Mala experiencia en el Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Visitamos el hotel Paradisus Cancun y tuvimos muy mala experiencia.
El cuarto era muy ruidoso, empleados del hotel hacían ruido incluso en la madrugada, sin importar que los huéspedes dormíamos. 
El spa, olía a agua estancada. El circuito de hidroterapia, no sabíamos ni para donde irnos.
El colchón de la cama y las almohadas viejas y deformes.
Y para terminar nuestra pesadilla, nos encontramos un enorme cucaracha en la regadera.
Por parte del hotel, no hubo ninguna respuesta, una lástima.

reviews.author: PitaRG
reviews.title: Great for a business conference
reviews.text:
Was there for 1 night as part of a business conference.  Since I arrived I was checked in at a special concierge then taken to my room.  Jr. Suite was clean and with enough space.
Service was good and friendly staff.  Had good lunch at the Palapa and breakfast at Naos, which is ok. 
Dinner at Tempo (not included in all-inclusive plan) was a great surprise!!
Even though I was there for a business conference, I saw a lot of families and couples.  The hotel is quite big so there is plenty of space for everyone.
Hotel and rooms in general are quite old but are decently maintained.  Not a luxury hotel but worth the price and type of business conference.
Would recommend and would return for a business conference.

reviews.author: Brigitte V
reviews.title: Magnifique hôtel
reviews.text: Hôtel, service, plage, nourriture... tout est vraiment 5 étoiles. Je le recommande pour votre prochain voyage au Mexique!!! Il est vrai que le coût est élevé alors si vous pouvez vous gâter, faites-le!

reviews.author: Jaz A
reviews.title: Buena categoría
reviews.text: En general son hotel bonito, que deslumbra con su diseño. Tiene habitaciones cómodas, con una vista excelente al mar. Su ubicación es buena porque está cerca a la zona de vida nocturna. Lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: Miguel Ubilla
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia!
reviews.text:
Estuve en febrero por una convención de trabajo, sin dudas recomiendo este hotel All Inclusive, los salones y equipos audiovisuales estaban perfectos, las habitaciones completamente equipadas, la comida de calidad, las áreas de relajo como piscinas, playa, camastros, excelentes!
El personal siempre dispuesto a ayudar y a dar sugerencias, gran trabajo!

Sigan así!

reviews.author: armando v
reviews.title: Huge complex with lots of choices
reviews.text:
Stayed there at large convention.
The place is huge, many pools, restaurants, bars, very Long Beach, night clubs, activities.
Service was quite good for a place this big.
Food was good, not excellent; but with so many choices one has lots of possibilities; although since it is all inclusive, all the best places fill up very fast and one might end up in a large line to eat.
Rooms are quite big

reviews.author: Michael L
reviews.title: Average resort to enjoy the climate and beach of Quintana Roo
reviews.text:
This past weekend I had the chance to stay at this resort for work from Monday through Friday. The resort was fairly empty, I would guess around 50% occupancy. Upon arriving the people at that front desk were very nice and helpful, with the customary cooling towel. I was checked in and given my wristband, a sort of colored nylon fabric with a wooden token intertwined with the fabric. 

I was taken to my room with the help of the bellboy. The room was very clean and nice with a King sized bed. The air-conditioner worked very well, which was really helpful as there isn't a ceiling fan, which made me sad. The mini fridge is stocked with water, snacks, and a variety of malt beverages. There are no liquor spirits in the room at all. I am not a fan of this at all, though I didn't consider calling anyone to see if that could be changed. The bathroom is a good size, and is elevated about 4 inches off the room floor, which my big toe repeated found throughout the trip. The shower has great pressure and heat, but is also again elevated a bit off the bathroom floor. If you have arthritis, or bad hips, etc, etc, I would consider finding a different resort as you will have difficulties getting in and out of the tub. 

The property as a whole is a smoke free environment, save for a few designated areas, though I did see quite a few people smoking in various outdoor areas without consequence. The buildings are very pretty inside, but the common areas are either not air conditioned at all, or are so poorly done that they feel as though they aren't. The restaurants were all comfortable except for The Market Grille, which is outside so this makes sense. The restaurants are all next to each other, and in a few instances we were seated in closed restaurants to eat in in a restaurant that was open at the time. This is how close they are to each other, which made for some confusion. I never had the opportunity to make a reservation and eat at a nicer restaurant because I forgot pants and didn't want to break the dress codes. It didn't alter my experience at all I believe. The room service is actually some of the best I have ever had at an all-inclusive resort. It was also delivered about 20 minutes after it was ordered, which is far and away the fastest I have ever had. The gym was nice, A/C'd and a great place to get some exercise in with cable machines, free weights, treadmills, and ellipticals. I was very happy with this amenity.

The Pools are all nice and clean, there aren't any floaties and I didn't see too many people who had brought there own actually. The music was never too loud and a good vibe. The beach is kept very clean and is pretty expansive and deep for Cancun. I did not at all appreciate the bars near the pools closing before the pools close. Not a fan at all.

Overall this was a pretty nice place. If you are in decent enough shape to get in and out of the tub, and love the hot weather, this may be a good option for you.

reviews.author: Camila B
reviews.title: Fantastico, lindo!
reviews.text: Ótimo! Gastronomia, limpeza, entretenimento, luxo, sossego e diversão...Qualidades para tornar uma viagem especial. Acabei de voltar de Cancun e fiquei por 2 noites hospedada neste hotel. A praia em frente ao hotel tbem é muito bonita, estava com um pouco de algas, mas nada que atrapalhasse o banho de mar.

reviews.author: Suzanne M
reviews.title: Last minute relocation
reviews.text: Thank you to Apolo Calderon Sanchez for helping us make a smooth relocation from Puerto Rico when Hurricane Maria hit. The group had a great time and Apolo was very helpful in arranging the last minute meeting space and reservations for the group.

reviews.author: charles R
reviews.title: If you love food one place to consider
reviews.text:
I have to say that the Cheff Manuel Martinez and Javier are Excellent. They know their kitchen back and forward.

The place is 31 years old but still looks great. The staff overall is friendly but in Hard Rock Cancun you get a more warm welcome. 

You know for me the food is a most because I don't drink alcohol or party. This is why when I find excellent food I don't hesitate to recommend and give you my feedback.

I hope this help.

Best regards,

reviews.author: SoyTuya R
reviews.title: Rest Naos mesero Alberto
reviews.text: Excellent servicio en general pero quiero resaltar la atencion del personal del restaurante Naos en especial al mesero Alberto , exclente altencion. 100% recomendado el Hotel y el Restaurante. solo un comentario adicional los precios en la sala de belleza son supremamente altos.

reviews.author: yanethlinda
reviews.title: Excelente experiencia
reviews.text: Quiero darle las gracias por todo en verdad no hay palabras para describir lo maravilloso que fue en mi vida estar en el hotel paradisus cancun . felicitaciones la comida excelente y la atencion muy buena el retaurante TEMPO felicitaciones comida exquisita y quiero darle las gracias a todo el personal en especial a Roberto de avbar por  la  atencion que tuvieron con nuestros ejecutivos de ZRII.💖

reviews.author: JorgeGalindo
reviews.title: El Check Out fue un DESASTRE
reviews.text: Te tratan de una manera muy buena  al llegar y una muy distinta al salir, lo que daña por completo la estadía, y por su puesto deja un muy mal recuerdo. De hecho con el paso de los días ves ese cambio de conducta en todos los empleados del hotel. Es una lástima

reviews.author: Angel H
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Service and All Inclusive Meals
reviews.text:
Just spent one night in this place and I was very comfortable, slept very well and ate delicious.
This is a very well maintained resort with great service and attitude from people working on it.
Many options to eat and for snacks.
Rooms nice in all aspects.

reviews.author: DanielZl
reviews.title: Good hotel, all inclusive
reviews.text:
The hotel was very good, good service, lot's of varieties of restaurants and food, all inclusive. Ac couple of pools with amazing view, private beach, the rooms were very good as well.
The hotel is a bit old but you don't feel it since the decoration and everything is great.

reviews.author: RebeccaF
reviews.title: A Wow!   Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous
reviews.text:
Service, interior, food, restaurants, timeous. The location and access to the beach is too good to be true. Shuttles and busses to the markets and shops as well as accurate and quick trip bookings by the hotel staff. 
Room changed due to inconvenient details and most of all lovely food and facilities.

Its on my wish list and I have wanted to go back ever since, I went for work and then again for a holiday and both ties just relaxing and exceptional.

reviews.author: anniafrank18
reviews.title: Increíble
reviews.text: Espectacular hotel! Todos los servicios que necesites están ahí! La playa fantástica, piscinas amplias. La cómoda variada y riquísima para todos los gustos. Decoración agradable en cada rincón. Muero por volver!

reviews.author: Spartyan
reviews.title: Una estancia inolvidable!!!
reviews.text: El entorno, la ubicación, el personal, el clima... todo esto se une en este fantástico resort en el que pasamos unos 3 días inolvidables. No hay que dejar de saborear su Royal Service.. una atención exquisita y continuada que te hacen sentir como un rey.. nos vamos con un grato sabor de boca y esperando regresar pronto!! Gracias!!

reviews.author: Traveller & Foodie
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive Resort however not perfect
reviews.text: I came here on business 3 nights.    Check-in was smooth.    The first room they gave us was on the third floor.   After a sleepless night because our room was right over the disco (3353) we called the reception the next day and changed our room to the 8th floor (3806).   Stay away from rooms on 3rd floor over the disco (Building 3), the noise of the music was very loud into the early morning.  However our room 3353 had a better view than the one on the 8th floor.    Once we changed room we had no issues sleeping.   The room is a bit outdated, and so is the bathroom however the service for room was very good and the room was clean.   The lobby area was a jungle so there was a lot of humidity because of the plants/trees.   Honestly I would get rid of the jungle and make this area more modern as it was a very hot lobby while having dinner in the Japanese/Sushi restaurant.     To me the jungle was a bit outdated and with the beautiful area on the first floor near the Concierge and Check-in area I see a lot of potential for this hotel to be a bit more fancy in that section, the trees and jungle have to go for a more luxury feel to a very nice hotel.    The are 3 pools, one with a bar in the pool area, another bigger pool with lots of chairs always available and the Royal Service pool which was for Royal customers only and more intimate.     The ocean view from the pool was breathtaking.    Beach chairs were a bit hard to find if you didn't come early, like before 8:30 am if you wanted an umbrella.   Restaurants, Naos: international buffet for breakfast, lunch and dinner:  breakfast amazing, lunch sometimes not consistent, first hamburger was delicious and the second time it was under cooked and so was their chicken. I must mention that the buffet had really good service, the waiters were very attentive and caring.   Market Grill was a Argentina/Brazil style restaurant which was actually very nice.    The house wine served from the all inclusive plan was very ordinary however they have a great wine list which we ordered from and enjoyed the wine with their grilled meats.    The Asian restaurant, not the lobby one near the jungle the one you have to walk over to through the rooms on the first floor was just ok to me.    The service was just ok too, and the food tapas was ok to me.    I would of liked to have tried Mole, Vento and Tempo however we did not have time because the dinners were sometimes in the area the company had chosen for us to eat as a group.    The last night we had a buffet dinner outside near the Royal Service pool area and honestly the buffet food was cold and not amazing like the food at the Naos buffet.   We were all very disappointed.   Overall a nice 3 night stay for an all inclusive.  This hotel has a lot of potential if they can change a few things.   I must add that they had live music near the beds on the beach was very nice.  The band was pleasant and the music was very good.     Again overall a 4 star hotel with a potential to me for a 5 with a few fine tuning in certain areas.  The disco and the bar lounge was amazing.  Every night during our stay they had different shows at the avenue bar, some were quite interesting.  The Red lounge disco was also very fun, the music was great.

reviews.author: Margaritaicq
reviews.title: Excelente hotel y servicios
reviews.text: El personal es atento y con vocación de servicio. Recomiendo ampliamente Family Concierge, la atención es esmerada y el Mayordomo Alexander es excelente, deben reconocer su buena labor. Los salones están bien equipados y cómodos para reuniones

reviews.author: GratitudeBryn
reviews.title: One of the best resorts/all inclusives we've ever stayed at!
reviews.text:
What a phenomenal experience from start to finish.  We were treated like VIPs and every thing we asked for was provided.  My wife has food allergies and eating abroad is always a challenge, but not at Melia.  We turn in her allergy list and every dining experience comes with custom dishes prepared just for her, and they are all delicious!  

The hotel is filled with "Wow!" and "Look at that!" moments from the design to the lighting to every little detail.  My wife LOVES it when I tell her we are staying at a Melia resort.  She almost doesn't want to go anyplace else.

reviews.author: Alejandro Canales
reviews.title: Buenas dependencias pero serios problemas de atencion al cliente.
reviews.text:
Las dependencias son muy buenas, un acceso a la playa envidiable pero se descuidan importantes puntos de atencion al cliente. Las reposaderas con colchon en la playa son carisimas, las reposaderas en la piscina se hacen pocas, la comida en el buffet principal es buena pero poco sabroza. 
Perdi mi billetera en sector de computadores y luego de discutir con el jefe de seguridad, amenazar con llamar a la policia y hacer un escandalo, extrañamente mi billetera aparecio.

reviews.author: Deric T
reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: We just checked in yesterday, somehow our reservation got mixed up at the hotel and they booked us for 1 person instead of 2. the price difference was $50 online and we were ok with paying it but at the counter they demanded $386 instead. We spent 2 hours at the front desk to get it resolved when they would not help us, we finally had to call the US and rebook it through a 3rd party and get the proper rate. Truly a nightmare experience, worst customer service ever.

reviews.author: TheRosses2014
reviews.title: Poor Service, Quaility and Follow thru
reviews.text:
I've been reluctant to post a bad review, thinking someone from the hotel would be willing to make the issues I had while working with them right.  Apparently that is no the case.  I host retreats around the world for women entrepreneurs, and am always looking for great service and willing to pay extra for it.  I contracted with the Paradisus not once, but twice to bring my group there.  The first time I visited with my group there was some mix up with the contract and the hotel ended up charging me an extra $5,000 Dollars, so to make it right the next time I brought a group the credited me $2,500.  I reluctantly said yes, as the service I received was not great.  This last trip was the worst.  

As the host of the group you would expect the hotel to be interested in taking care of you, they did the opposite.  I paid for a larger room, with Family Concierge and needed to be near my group.  I was put in a smaller room with my toddler (which DID NOT work) and when I requested them to make it right was given an OLD room with a roach problem in 4 pyramids over (it was a hike to say the least).  See the photo.  Per our contract the hotel still

reviews.author: Den_MERIDIAN_TRAVEL
reviews.title: Безпроигрышный выбор
reviews.text: Отличный отель в нужном месте. С шикарным спокойным пляжем. и хорошим входом в воду.Может показаться немного староватым внутри, но это обманчиво. Отличная как бы компактная терриория  с невероятными захватывающими видами на океан с верхних этажей. Обязательно бронируйте верхние этажи  и только в  Де Люкс Джуниор Сьют  центральной пирамиде и вы получите 100% удовольствие от Мексики и от Канкуна в частности.Бесплатный вай фай.Номера свежие , не обшарпанные.Хорошая тема Фемили консьерж, кто едет на отдых с детьми.

reviews.author: Sunil S
reviews.title: All in ⛱ Resort
reviews.text:
Excellent suites , food , location, service.
Beach access from the resort and place to rest are great.

Downtown is just 20 mins away.

Access to ferry for traveling to isla mujeres is just 30 mins away. This island offers great options to enjoy with family. 

Do not forget to checkout amazing ocean view from this island.

reviews.author: Adrian R
reviews.title: Un hotel muy bonito
reviews.text: La habitación es muy amplia, el baño cuenta con su tina (sin hidromasaje) y la vista es excelente, ésta vez fui de negocios y la atención fue muy buena. Cuentan con una variedad amplia de comida y bares para el consumo a cualquier hora practicamente. Lo mejor fue el ambiente en la disco que tiene el hotel por las noches. Lo recomiendo.

reviews.author: AkemiValencia
reviews.title: Excelente estadía
reviews.text:
Habitaciones excelentes , cómodas amplias ,cama queen  con jacuzzi . El hotel y las instalaciones muy buenas , la playa excelente una zona de la playa hermosa , y personal muy amable.

En el tema de la comida , es sistema todo incluido y puedes hacer uso de cualquiera de los restaurantes disponibles (con o sin reserva) o de comida de "playa/piscina"  la comida es abundante , y si bien no es mala es más tipo internacional , a mi gusto las carnes tenían muchas salsas.

La bebida también entra en este sistema todo incluido y algo muy bueno con respecto a otros hoteles de este tipo es que mantienen siempre buena calidad de productos.

reviews.author: Jacobo Mora
reviews.title: GRAN LUGAR
reviews.text:
Excelente instalaciones, modernas, limpias, excelente "arquitectura de olores", muy buena cocina; y si tienes un evento, convención, etc., sin duda es una gran opción.
La ubicación es excepcional "cerca de todo".
Las camas y almohadas son fenomenales, el descanso es MARAVILLOSO.
no se lo pierdan¡¡
Y el servicio de todo el personal es excepcional.

reviews.author: Patrick F
reviews.title: Fantastic , friendly service
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun and had a wonderful stay. The hotel, located on a beautiful, white sandy beach, offers something for everyone. There are multiple, great restaurants to choose from and there is nightly entertainment.
The staff at the Paradisus Cancun is top notch, especially Eddie C. and Valerie at the LaPalapa restaurant. They were so friendly and attentive and made us feel welcome.

reviews.author: shailabs
reviews.title: I'd go back again and again!
reviews.text:
We spent 5 days and 4 nights at this incredible hotel. The view of the sea is breathtaking! But also the service was amazing: housekeeping spoiled us each day, all the restaurants have great food and the waiters are super attentive. The shows and activities were very fun. 
During our stay, we were able to meet Abraham Franco, who does a great job of room manager.
I can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: 832eliasc
reviews.title: Pesima experiencia
reviews.text:
