reviews.text: Si quieren recibir un mal trato por la mayoría del personal del hotel, y si quieres arrepentirte de tus vacaciones, aquí encuentras el mejor lugar para ser las vacaciones de tus pesadillas. Poco que rescatar del hotel...

reviews.author: TiguerGus
reviews.title: Buen hotel
reviews.text: Buena ubicación, estacionamiento, bonita playa, muchas opciones de restaurantes, la calidad de las bebidas es muy buena, habitaciones amplias y cómodas, servicio de alimentos y bebidas en tu habitación 24 hrs, internet incluido. Las habitaciones son amplias y cómodas, el servicio de camaristas excelente. Gracias por sus atenciones.

reviews.author: Louise E
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only,beautiful beach, swimming pools and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your own cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.I stayed in the Royal service building,but was reconized in all 5 buildings and resturant by our wraistband.

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Excelente en todos los aspectos
reviews.text:
Este hotel "todo incluído" fue una maravilla, las instalaciones son espectaculares, el personal muy atento y el formato de todo incluído en realidad es tal cual se describe, puedes entrar y salir de los restaurantes, tomar una copa en el impresionante bar central o incluso acudir a algunol de los bares "hazlo-tu-mismo" que están en algunas de las torres satélite.

Fui por negocios pero la verdad me sentí en una verdadera vacación. La habitación tiene un excelente diseño y cuenta con las amenidades básicas y algo más.

Recomendadisimo!

reviews.author: Mozart Mattar
reviews.title: Muito, muito, muito bom!
reviews.text: Foi uma experiência fascinante. O hotel é muito bom, com uma excelente localização. A vista do mar é espetacular. Bem na frente do hotel tem ponto de ônibus, McDonald's e uma espécie de agência de passeios.

reviews.author: verojo15
reviews.title: Perfecto
reviews.text: hotel con excelente servicio, habitaciones cómodas y wiffi gratuito, participamos de un congreso donde adema de nuestro espacio científico pudimos relajarnos y divertirnos. La comida muy buena, comimos sushi dos noches muy rico. El personal amable y dispuesto a ayudar, volvería en mi próxima visita a Cancun

reviews.author: Eduardo_272014
reviews.title: Hotel All Inclusive excelente !
reviews.text: Fui para um congresso com minha esposa. O hotel tem uma infra estrutura excelente, um átrio no centro, facilitando o acesso e visibilidade dos atrativos (restaurantes, lojas, recepção,..). O atendimento é um ponto forte , todos os funcionários são muito educados e atenciosos. Tem vários restaurantes (8), apenas 1 não esta na lista do "all inclusive" . O Naos é um buffet quase 24hs, se vc não quiser sentar e pedir a la carte, essa é sua melhor opção. Bares dentro e fora do hotel sempre a disposição, atendimento na piscina e na praia (inclusive wi fi free). A vista pro mar e para as piscinas é imperdível (pegue um quarto com vista, vale a pena). Se tiver oportunidade, faça uma massagem no Spa , serviço classe A (serviço cobrado). A gorjeta não é obrigatória, vc dá se achar que foi bem atendido ( e realmente vc acaba premiando o atendimento). Parabéns ao Edgar do Naos, ao Miguel da praia, ao sommelier Carlos.

reviews.author: Travelero224
reviews.title: Excelente servicio e instlaciones
reviews.text: El mejor servicio y con excelentes instalaciones. Los restaurantes super variados y con excelentes horarios. Servicio en bebidas muy bueno. Las amenidades son geniales, chocolates muy ricos y el tequila wooow!

reviews.author: Bobbi E
reviews.title: Excellent all-around!!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun last weekend and it was phenomenal!! We had the Royal Service in building 5 and it was everything I thought it would be and more. The Royal Service pool was huge and the Bali beds are great. 

The beach was beautiful and extremely clean. Royal Service beach waiter service is great. We had buckets of water, glasses with ice, cold drinks, & food delivered all day long. (I think we had the Mahi Mahi everyday lol.)

The food is great at the Paradisus Cancun, especially the Mexican food at 'Mole' and the Latin food at 'Fuego'. I'm not a huge ceviche fan; however, the grouper was the best I've ever had.

For us the resort's top service came from Jose Luis & Ignacio at 'Naos'. Every morning we were greeted with coffee and a smile!! Its incredible service like theirs that makes me want to return!! Thank you Paradisus Cancun for a great stay, we look forward to returning next year!!

reviews.author: MyEscapeVacation
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.

reviews.author: CLAUJEW
reviews.title: Excelente x demas!!!
reviews.text:
Este hotel esta excelente. Atencion,servicio,instalaciones,amabilidad del personas. habitaciones y sobre todo la playa Ancha amplia y bonita ..
Yo estuve en viaje de negocios pero pude disfrutar de la atencion del personal y no tengo palabras para agradecer lo excelente del servicio

reviews.author: Carlos.. R
reviews.title: Excelente hotel
reviews.text:
Para negocios o placer, una excelente opción en Cancún. La atención es de primera, así como la calidad de las instalaciones. Muy bien ubicado, la playa es muy buena.
Los salones de reuniones son amplios y cómodos y la atención impecable!

reviews.author: Dwest858
reviews.title: Very Good Stay!!
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus Cancun from September 27-Oct 02 and stayed in the Royal Service section.
Pros: Very clean and well kept resort. 
Ample food selection which was also pretty good overall
Top shelf liquors with nice pours all around
Great beach
Cons: Aging resort (although well kept and clean), 
Food was a bit redundant, essentially the same food you can get at their buffet with a different presentation.
Ok, so here are my thoughts, I stayed at RS which I stated before and I am glad I made that choice. While staying in RS you are in a separate building which is at least 10 degrees cooler than the rest of the buildings, its very quiet relaxing and has a lot of ambience. There is also a small area for food and drinks which is not busy at all and allows for quick and easy snacks, drinks, ice and such. In addition, with Rs you get 2 days use of a bali bed which is great, in low season, you can also get additional days if they aren't reserved. I went to the beach and stayed at the papilla's which were also very nice. My room was nice cool and clean. Turn down service every night, never needed to call for anything.  I did not receive a phone from my butler Juan, but as I walked through the lobby each day he always asked "is there anything I can do to make your day special"
Pool Bar was very busy happening place, not my scene so glad I was in RS.
Bana- Decent sushi, good drinks, not my favorite
Vento- Very good food, nice overall experience
Blue agave- good quick snack or meal, margarita of the day made fresh were tasty
La Papala- RS- good for a poolside lunch or snack, limited selection
Naos- This is their buffet, I was super surprised with this one, Probably the best restaurant they offer.. I would recommend a walkthrough prior to eating at the ala cart places, see what they are cooking fresh, likely it will be more fresh and better tasting than the other restaurants with a "not as pretty" presentation 
Oh, and starting the week I was there it was a no reservation needed policy for the specialty restaurants during the remainder of low season. 
To just touch base on a few things I was concerned with prior to visiting..
I was never approached by a timeshare person, although I saw them doing the breakfasts.
There are 58 steps to the front door, but my driver bypassed them and dropped me off at the front door.
No reservations for restaurants
Good AC in my room with a great view
Was warm in the main building but I never found myself very uncomfortable
They will convert from USD to peso at a 12.5 rate with no additional charges
Overall, this is a great resort, with great staff.. Its aging but well kept and none of which effected my stay at the very least. Nicest place Ive stayed within Cancun
Oh and the Main pyramid is pretty awesome at night

reviews.author: FRANCISCO EDUAR... Q
reviews.title: en todos los aspectos bien.
reviews.text: la recepción, el personal, los restaurantes muy bien. Las albercas muy bien cuidadas al igual que las áreas verdes. Tiene un detalle que hay escaleras y  rampas a la vez y no se ven bien los escalones por los cuales hay que tener cuidado (mas en las horas de poca luz). ES UN HOTEL MUY GRANDE, HAY UNA TORRE EN DONDE HAY JUEGOS INFANTILES POR LO QUE SUGIERO QUE ESA SERIA UNA ZONA DONDE PUEDES LLEGAR CON TUS HIJOS.

reviews.author: Dominic Z
reviews.title: Nice stay but was stolen from by housekeepers
reviews.text: Overall the property and employees were very nice. Settlement to our experience was having money stolen by housekeeping. After talking to front desk and being questioned by "investigation team" of hotel employees we were never offered anything in retribution. We were told at checkout to contact their chief concierge. Due to this I would not stay or recommend this property.

reviews.author: Melody707
reviews.title: Tempo at the Paradisus Cancun is Outstanding!!
reviews.text: Our time at the Paradisus Cancun was Amazing!  From the time we checked in until we said our good byes, we felt like we were the most important people at the hotel.  The Outstanding service from the staff made us never want to leave. The highlight of our time at the Paradisus Cancun was our dinner at Tempo.  Chefs Ismael & Felipe prepared us a meal like no other.  We had the tasking menu with the wine pairing.  Each course was better than the next, there were 10 courses.   The presentation was out of the ordinary.  The flavors of each course exploded with flavors.  Carlos, the Sommelier brought out the pairing wines that complimented each course. Our waiter Raul was attentive to our every needs.  We will be back to Cancun, and I guarantee I will be back at Paradisus Cancun and Tempo.

reviews.author: Venture1141
reviews.title: buen servicio. excelentes instalaciones
reviews.text:
Estuve 3 dias por viaje de trabajo. Excelente recibimiento.  Las instalaciones muy bien conservadas.  La habitacion con vista a la laguna estándar con respecto a otros hoteles en la zona.  El servicio de desayuno y comida tipo buffet muy bueno.  La cena enredoso las reservaciones.
El check out muy rapido.
Solo que al esperar por el transporte al aeropuerto no siquiera me ofrecieron un vaso de agua. 
Un poco de atención a los que se retiran.

reviews.author: Ernesto L
reviews.title: Una experiencia memorable
reviews.text:
Desde la llegada me sentí una celebridad, sin alfombra roja, pero con un trato distinguido y excelente. Cada noche recibí una amenidad diferente en mi Suite.
La playa es enorme por lo que salir a correr en las mañanas te quita el aliento, más por la vista que por el ejercicio.
Quiero destacar la atención de Lázaro de Royal Service que en todo momento estuvo pendiente de mis necesidades.
Excelente opción en Cancún.

reviews.author: Maucalvet
reviews.title: Hormigas, falta de espacios, amabilidad
reviews.text:
El concepto del hotel realmente extraño, la arquitectura simula una pirámide maya y por dentro todo estilo oriental? No hay match. 

Restaurantes insuficientes. Siempre están llenos. SIEMPRE. y en sept es temporada baja. La comida muy regular. Normalmente es así en los resorts all inclusive pero aquí exageran. Todo medio frío, las filas lentas, ojo ahí. (Los chicos de la barra de omelete generalmente son mal encarados, aquí exageran un poco con su mal humor)

Les faltan espacios en general: Increíble que no hay suficientes camastros y todo es con el propósito de rentar unas camas que son exclusivas para socios y que te cobran 700 pesos para poder ocuparlas. Ridículo pues es un resort all inclusive. 
Los elevadores sólo funcionaba uno en la torre tres y un caos subir y bajar! 

Primera vez que veo hormigas en la playa. Impresionante como esta lleno de hormigas al rededor de los camastros! No quiero imaginar que hay abajo de esta arena que nunca han de limpiar su zona de playa para que haya hormigas!!!!
Eso si, la playa hermosa. 
El servicio espectacular. Muy amables todos. Te atienden rápido y con un una sonrisa siempre. El equipo de grupos excelente servicio! Tuve un evento de tres días y excelente apoyo y coordinación. 

En cuanto a las habitaciones están amplias aunque las pantallas muy chicas para esos espacios. El aire acondicionado no funcionaba muy bien en la habitación 3337. De repente congelaba y de repente muchísimo calor. 

Conclusión: caro para lo que ofrecen

reviews.author: Christelle L
reviews.title: Uno de los mejores hoteles... Impactante!
reviews.text:
Me hospede hace 15 días en la habitación 3560. 
Llegue alrededor de las 11:00pm y la bienvenida dada fue excepcional, desde la entrada, el aroma, luces te envuelven y te hace olvidar el largo viaje...
Llegando a la habitación, misma sensación: impecable, todo en su lugar y perfectamente bien colocado.
Durante la estadía solo pudo probar el restaurante mexicano y fue todo un encanto, mencionar al camarero Oscar quien nos dio un servicio excepcional. También nos visito el asistente de A&B, un francés cuyo nombre no recuerdo.
El hotel esta excelentemente bien mantenido, decorado y dirigido.
Felicidades a todo el personal y en especial a su director.
Volveré pronto, sin duda.

reviews.author: Karina K
reviews.title: Maravilhoso
reviews.text:
Resort maravilhoso!! Local agradável, funcionários educados e atenciosos, comida excelente!! 
A praia no período que eu fui estava mto suja de algas, não sei se sempre é assim....várias opções de restaurantes!!

reviews.author: AntilleanOriental
reviews.title: In a word... AWESOME!
reviews.text: I have been to Cancun several times... this time for work. The hotel is amazing and the staff makes it even better! the Mole restaurant was my favorite. I didn't experience Tempo but did tour the wine room... WOW!

reviews.author: alessandra c
reviews.title: Paraiso
reviews.text: Hotel realmente 5 estrelas. Vista maravilhosa do quarto, quartos grandes e bem cuidados, muitas opções de restaurantes com comidas maravilhosas, piscina lindas, all inclusive, boa carta de vinho e funcionários atenciosos.

reviews.author: GFR2011
reviews.title: Go for the "Royal Service". You can't go wrong.
reviews.text:
I have just been at the Paradisus Cancún for five nights, staying at the building #5, which is the one reserved for "Royal Service" guests. Though the hotel has been around for quite a while, it still is in great condition. Both room and bathroom were large and were generously equipped. The 10sqm terrace offered direct sea view and plenty of privacy. The room features an efficient AC, free mini-bar which was daily refilled, flatscreen TV, free safe, ironing equipment, Nespresso coffe machine, king-size bed, bathrobe, slippers and towels intended for the pool/beach as well as for the Spa.

I especially enjoyed the food. Outstanding quality and variety. I wouldn't mind to stay there for a couple of weeks more. But best of all, the service. All employees are extremely friendly and costumer focused. They made me feel home away from home.

Absolutely recommendable. As mentioned in the title, you can't go wrong choosing this resort.

reviews.author: Oskar R
reviews.title: Excelente Resort!!!
reviews.text: Estuve hospedado sólo 2 noches en esta ocasión ya que era un viaje de negocios, pero ya me había hospedado en 2 ocasiones anteriores. Simplemente es maravilloso el hotel y sin duda regresaré nuevamente de vacaciones. Las instalaciones son muy buenas, la comida es muy buena, las bebidas son buenas. En experiencia global si buscan calidad, éste es el Resort para hospedarse, muy buena relación calidad-precio.

reviews.author: bsaitow
reviews.title: Great View
reviews.text: I traveled to Cancun for a Convention and the hotel is amazing. First, I got a Junior Suite oceanfront. Waking up with that amazing view from your balcony is priceless. The food is delicious and the hotel offers many options. I called for room services several times and everytime the employees were totally polite and we happy to serve you. You could feel that! If you have the chance to stay at Paradisus... You won regret!

reviews.author: Sebastian N
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text:
Año con año asisto a un Congreso Científico en Cancún, y siempre me hospedo en este maravilloso hotel.
Este año tuve que cancelar mi reservación por un problema de salud inesperado.  A pesar que el lapso de la cancelación ya había acabado, las personas del área de Reservaciones, tuvieron a bien escuchar y entender el problema y me cancelaron la reservación, sin ningún cargo adicional.   Esto es servicio al cliente.
Uno de mis hoteles favoritos, regresaré siempre cuando pueda.

reviews.author: Sanjaya S
reviews.title: Nice Location, Average Staff and Food
reviews.text: The location is great but what wouldn't be on Blvd Kulucan. The rooms are a nice size. However, the service, particularly the poolside was unfriendly. The food was average and even at the special restaurant where we paid $50 pp extra it was not worth it. The desserts had so much sugar they set my teeth on edge.

reviews.author: Fernanda P
reviews.title: No me deslumbró...
reviews.text: De todas las opciones que hay en Cancun no se si volveria a este hotel. La verdad es que el personal fue muy amable en todo momento, pero no saben resolver las cosas a tiempo. Durante mi estadia sucedió que llovió toda la semana y el hotel se inundó en gran parte de sus habitaciones. Mi habitación particularmente se habia inundado todo el baño y en lugar de buscar una solución inmediata, me pusieron un cesto de basura para reparar las goteras que caian del techo y mandaron más de 3 personas a revisar la habitacion pero nadie solucionaba nada, por lo que el cambio de habitación me lo ofrecieron recien para las 10 de la noche del dia siguiente. Después en cuanto a los restaurantes manejan un sistema de reservas que no es muy facil de enteder, ya que las mesas estan vacias y te niegan cenar alli porque tienen todo reservado o sino tardan mas de lo debido para traer los platos o bebidas correspondientes. Igual no todo es malo, en cuanto a la playa, tiene una playa mucho más bonita que otros de cancun, las habitaciones son lindas y algunos de los restaurantes son muy lindos tambien.

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: Everything about my experience at the Paradisus was excellent. The hotel was clean, the staff was amazingly helpful, and the restaurants were delicious. I had never been to Mexico before, and this resort truly exceeded my expectations. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Kristen S
reviews.title: Amazing place to stay!
reviews.text: My stay at the Paradisus was incredible.  Every part of the resort is breathtakingly beautiful.  The pools are great, and the beach is right outside the door.  The rooms were very clean, and I had a good nights sleep every night I was there.  The people at the resort were also extremely kind and helpful.  Im hoping to be able to make another trip to the Paradisus, and I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a place to get away!

reviews.author: jrich2014
reviews.title: Paradisus was great!
reviews.text: Recently I stayed at the Paradisus hotel, and had a great experience. The food was amazing, the staff extremely professional and accommodating, and the hotel itself was beautiful. I would love to go back, it was great!

reviews.author: Lisa I
reviews.title: AMAZING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Hi friends! I am writing to let you know about the amazing experience I had at the Paradisus Cancun Resort. The staff went ABOVE and BEYOND in their service and the resort is beautiful with the rooms including breathtaking views of the ocean right outside. The food and buffet offered a variety of items changing daily and the gym was huge even containing an extra Pilates room with mirrors that was always available for your own use for exercises. I highly recommend visiting this resort, you will be extremely happy with your time spent at the Paradisus!

reviews.author: Brenda M
reviews.title: Cuidado com os detalhes
reviews.text: Os funcionarios são muito atenciosos e tem muito cuidado com os detalhes. Senti falta de um canal  brasileiro, pois minha estadia foi um pouco longa. A reposição do frigobar era diária e a limpeza do quarto também.

reviews.author: LucianaAlves2014
reviews.title: Um paraíso
reviews.text: Tive a oportunidade de me hospedar no Paradisus Cancún e foi uma experiência incrível. Além do mar azul turquesa maravilhoso, que banha a zona hoteleira, o hotel tem serviços de altíssima qualidade e uma gastronomia de alto nível. Você pode escolher entre o bufê com pratos mais tradicionais, mas não menos saborosos, e com muita variedade, ou por um dos vários restaurantes requintados, alguns com alta gastronomia, como o do chef espanhol Martin Berasategui, considerado, segundo me contaram, o restaurante número 1 de Cancún. Para quem gosta de exclusividade e tranquilidade, o serviço royal service é perfeito, com delicadezas a todo momento, como travesseiros aromatizados, agendamento nos restaurantes, acesso exclusivo para pessoas que estão neste serviço, com piscina e bares exclusivos. Isso sem falar nos amplos apartamentos e a beleza das dependências. A educação e cordialidade de todos os funcionários também chamam a atenção. É um luxo que só 'vivendo' para saber. Adorei e recomendo!

reviews.author: Tushbikinis
reviews.title: Thank you Paradisus Cancun!
reviews.text:
The Paradisus Cancun resort and staff were AMAZING! The hotels was very clean and always offered extra towels and snacks. The staff always made sure that their guests were happy and greeted at all times. The resort was huge and offered many options for families. Relaxing poolside, listening to the DJ at the other pool, excursions, spa and even a kids spa! Thank you for making our vacation extra special! 
Thank you!
Leigha Marie

reviews.author: locolos13
reviews.title: Solid Beachfront Option
reviews.text: Stayed here for a couple of nights while in Cancun for business. The property isn't huge in comparison to some of the other AIs in Cancun. Rooms were nicely updated and decorated. Try and get a beachfront room with a balcony. Definitely worth the view! Food was really good too. Lots of options for everyone. Beautiful pool area and great drinks to go along. I would stay here again if traveling to Cancun again.

reviews.author: Lisa F
reviews.title: It was amazing
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel.The staff was amazing nice fun friendly and they went above and beyond!!! Food was great the hotel itself is beautiful.  the beach is gorgeous Can't wait to go back!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Tory S
reviews.title: Paradise at it's finest
reviews.text: I had the wonderful opportunity to stay at the Paradisus Cancun resort this past month and fell absolutely in love with it. The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly. The environment was tranquil, making it easy for resort-goers to relax and enjoy their stay. If you have the opportunity, sneak over to the juice bar at the buffet in the mornings; their options are absolutely delicious! My group and I felt so welcomed and truly enjoyed our stay. I would recommend this resort to anyone interested in traveling to Cancun looking for a premier all-inclusive resort option.

reviews.author: Alyssa M
reviews.title: A trip to remember!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved the vibe of the resort. From the minute you walked in the doors, you felt a peaceful and relaxed feeling. The food was awesome with a ton of healthy choices along with some fabulous deserts. The pools were always really clean and the room service was also fantastic. They accommodated us with anything we needed and really were there to help us out and make us feel like we were on a great vacation. It was nice because there was entertainment and activities all day long but you could also find quiet spots as well where there was just some nice music playing and you could tan in the sun. I would totally recommend the paradisus cancun to anyone traveling there!

reviews.author: sheilaws
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text:
Let me preference my review by stating that I was a paid guess in attendance at a Travel Professional Training Forum held at this property. 
Upon arrival I was checked in, a cloth bracelet with wooden logo oval placed on my wrist and asked to return later as my room was not yet ready. I chose the time to get some breakfast, as I arrived on a night owl flight. The buffet selection was vast and the food tasty. The service was fantastic. When I returned to the front desk my room was ready and I wen to my rm where my luggage was already waiting. I had requested a King and my room was a Double. The front desk informed me to try in the morning and I would be moved if a King became available. The room and its amentities were fantastic and the view was beautiful. The free internet connection was wonderful. A fruit basket and bottle of champaigne were in the room upon my arrival and later that evening a lovely pastry amenity was delivered. I spent the afternoon exploring. The resort consists of 5 towers. Tower 5 is for Royal Service guests and has its own entry to the adult pool and beach areas. it appeared that all of the othr towers must walk to Tower 5, in order to get to the pools or beach(not a feature I would count as a +). I went to the ave bar that evening and got one of my favorite Tamarindo Margaritas. I ate that night at Vento the Italian inspired Restaurant (reservations) serving tapas plates. The service was so good they went to the ave bar to get a Tamarindo Margarita for me. 
The next morning I called the front desk and was told a King would be available for me to be moved to but it would be some time before it was ready (3 hours). Once ready, I was given the key and my bags were moved by the staff. This room was just as lovely but the internet connection was horrid. I had to stand out side my room or sit out on a sofa a few feet from my room to have a connection. I picked up my forum registration materials in the ave bar and ordered a Tamarindo Margarita. The bartenders in attendance informed me they have been out of Tamarind for a week. I informed them I had 2 Tamarindo Margaritas there the previous night. One of them went so far as to tell me he worked last night and i must be mistaken (I still dont undertand the reasoning of this except laziness). I was able to get Tamarindo Mrgaritas at the nightly receptions the forum hosted however. Each time the staff would retrieve the Tamarind just to make my drink. 
With only 1 beach entryway, I found a lot of walking to get to anything outside. The beach front wedding gazebo setup was lovely as was the palaba they use for receptions and private functions. All requests for service from my room were met with immedate response. The internet service in many of the areas of the hotel is non-existent, however. Nice array of restaurants andtypes of food hich tastes good. I as so bsy with forum events/receptions each night I did not get a chance to experience nightlife and events. My pet peeve is wristbands; I dont like tham and don't see the need. If many All Inclusive Resorts can do without them; hy cant they all? Overall a nice resort.

reviews.author: Brittany D
reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun Resort was amazing. The resort was so clean and the staff was by far the friendliest bunch of people I ever met. The pool and beach was outstanding. One of my favorite things about the resort was the relaxing feel and zen like quality the resort gave off. I always felt so relaxed when I was in the lobby. Also, the food was very good. The chiefs and cooks really made me feel at home, especially, with my weird requests ( no salt, oil, or butter). I really hope I can stay at the Paradisus again because it was a vacation I will never forget!

reviews.author: Tracy S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - INCREDIBLE RESORT!
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a paradise.  While Inside the resort you feel like you're outside, in a tropical paradise. Gardens, fountains. The food is delicious and so much to choose from. The staff is attentive, courteous, friendly; the service is outstanding. The pools are fun, the beach is picture perfect. The rooms are beautiful and spotless. We never ran out of things to do. e didn't want to leave! This was a business trip. I will absolutely return to vacation. BEST RESORT EVER!

reviews.author: cathytravels
reviews.title: Great Hotel! Luxury at a reasonable price on the CancunStrip!
reviews.text:
Paradisus has the right combo of beach hotel outside, luxury inside! The only small issue for me is the tub/shower combo. Anyone of a certain age, or physical limitations would find it extremely difficult, if not impossible to climb over the tub edge to take a shower. The shower is so complicated to operate, there are instructions on the wall, which help a little....The theme of the hotel is very zen, with incense smells difused throughout all public areas, pleasing to me, but not to everyone--anyone who has issues with scented product will have a problem here!
The food and bar is excellent all around, the night clubs awesome, absolutely an ideal spot for families, singles, honeymooners, everyone. Hotel has a family concierge as well as a well separated Royal Club for adults only. It is a large hotel, which you will really notice when you take a walk down the beach, takes 10 minutes or more to reach the hotel next door! Section of beach is wide, flat, lots of seating. Inside lobby décor is reminiscent of the south Pacific, lots of wood, tropical plants, fish, totally spectacular. What are you waiting for? Book your next holiday at the Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Nach0_Arg
reviews.title: Buen equilibrio
reviews.text:
Es un gran hotel, en una zona increíblemente bella: buen servicio, buenos restaurants, cava, salones para convenciones.
Algunos detalles que deberían revisar: olor desagradable en la disco (alfombra) y servicio en determinadas zonas donde se amontona mucha gente (ej.: una sola persona cociando huevos y omelettes durante el desayuno).

reviews.author: Amandas12345678
reviews.title: Incredible week at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
The staff at the Paradisus Resort Cancun went above and beyond my expectations.  Every level of the staff went out of their way to make sure guests were satisfied.  I was traveling with a group and the entire hotel did a wonderful job of recognizing us and accomodating our every need.  A special thank you to Gerardo at the Market Grill for always making sure we had bottled water at the table!

The cleanliness levels were definitely up to standards which is very important to me when choosing a hotel.  I would love to stay there again if I had the opportunity!

reviews.author: LorenaBurgos
reviews.title: Excelencia en servicio, relación precio &calidad,
reviews.text:
Muy buen servicio. Armonía en el diseño, acogedor, busca satisfacer todas las necesidades, gustos y tendencias de los huéspedes. Puede ser para distintos tipos de clientes, negocios, solteros, parejas, familia. Tanto jóvenes como adultos.
Tarifa muy acorde al servicio y nivel del hotel. Buenos restaurantes y gastronomía.

reviews.author: zadik_11
reviews.title: In contact with the wildlife
reviews.text:
Once again, I experienced the dichotomy between the people that work close to the guests and the bean counters somewhere in an air conditioned room somewhere in the world.
From the modest house keeping lady, to the maintenance guys, the waiters and hostesses in the restaurants, all did a great job. They all let me feel welcomed.
So where is the problem?
1. Wildlife. The hotel might been built on a huge ant colony, since there is no way I can explain being on the 4th floor and having ants crawling on my desk, near the windows, inside the closet (yes, on my shirts, pants, socks, etc).
They guy had to come every second day to spray the room, but it didn't help much. 
2. A fish is not a crab!!!! Surimi is not crab. If you mention in the restaurant menu that you are serving a crab with the pasta, than serve a crab with the pasta. If you want to serve a crab imitation, that fine by me, just call it that way. "Surimi (Crab imitation) with fettuccini". 
Normally I wouldn't make a fuzz of this, but if you consider yourself a 5 star hotel, than at least treat your guests with basic decency and don't lye to them.   
3. Lack of Taxi service. The hotel doesn't provide transportation from and to the airport or any other destination. Ok, lets say that this is common in a 5 star resort. But when I asked them to call me a service and charge it to my room, they also said that they don't supply that service. I don't have pesos and I don't want to carry local currency, for a short 3 days trip.

reviews.author: Ale C
reviews.title: Buenisimo! Excelente Hotel
reviews.text: Pase una semana en Noviembre 2013, las instalaciones son excelentes, impecable,  la comida bastante bien. es muy recomendable. La atencion es excelente muy predispuestos a que la pases bien, La decoracion, el centro del hotel con un resto de sushi muy bueno sobre maderas y pequeños lagos con peces y todo esto bajo un manglar gigante, a la noche las escaleras ilumindas con faroles de velas, simplemente muy bueno!

reviews.author: Andrea Pérez
reviews.title: Ganas de quedarse
reviews.text: Debo destacar la atención de su personal, amabilidad, buena disposición, atención a las solicitudes son características permanentemente presentes. Muy cómodas las instalaciones intra y extra muros. La calidad y variedad de la propuesta gastronómica vale destacarse. Las únicas críticas que haré: i) en varios de sus shops no acepten dólares en efectivo y que ii) los tragos con alcohol son con concentrados de fruta y no con jugos naturales de fruta lo que hace perder calidad al producto final y iii) la música deja mucho que desear, en general en la playa escuché electrónica y por la noche la propuesta fue muy similar. Estamos en en Caribe, en América, ¿dónde están los sonidos de tan rico continente en su propuesta musical?. De todas formas son detalles menores a tan buena propuesta global que invita al disfrute.

reviews.author: MHB1971
reviews.title: Beautiful location, needs remodeling and new HVAC
reviews.text: I spent 5 days at the Paradisus for a business meeting. The price was certainly great for an all inclusive stay. However, food options are extremely limited if you have any dietary restrictions (e.g., gluten-free for medical reasons, thus cross contamination is an issue). While there are some restaurant options that could work, we were consistently told our only option was the main buffet restaurant. We had difficulty getting into the Japanese restaurant despite it being virtually empty one evening.  Overall, the hotel is extremely humid and air quality is poor - it smells very musty and moldy. Of course, that's hard to avoid due to all the indoor plants and water features. But, it was also that way in the meeting rooms in the convention center. And, it carries into the guest rooms.    It was quite strong in the bathtub area with the plexiglass bathtub shell moving under my feet, as well as in the toilet area.  Fortunately, the beach was nice so I minimized the time spent in the room. Since the Internet in the rooms did not work well at all (connecting for 2 minutes and then dropping all the time!), there wasn't much to do in the room anyways.

reviews.author: Regula_9
reviews.title: Lovely and very good
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful, the lobby very exotic with lots of plants. I attended a Forum. Too many steps to get to the convention center, first you can use a ramp, then go up two steps, walk a few yards, then go down 5 steps (why not keep it on one level and descend 3 steps??), then walk another few steps, another step down, repeat same and finally get to the escalator. My knees were killing me after doing this several times a day.  The single steps are not marked, if you are distracted you can easily miss it and fall.
The hotel lacks clear markings, very few places indicate room numer locations. Many of us kept getting lost, I finally learned my way around on the third day. Everybody was very friendly and helpful, housekeeping a bit spotty, out of 3 nights I received turn-down service the second night only.. Coffee in the room was replaced after I asked for it, not automatically. 
The food was good, some of it delicious. You have to be a good walker in that hotel!
I did not see a lot of installations for handicapped guests, except the one ramp going down to the convention center. Could stand some improvement in that regard.
The hotel gives a relaxed feeling, the music in the evening in the hallways is very soothing. The view of the ocean is breathtaking, the beach is OK, of course it has waves and can be rough, but after all, you are in Cancun. If you want calmer waters go to Riviera Maya. I hear Paradisus just opened a hotel there.

reviews.author: Luis G
reviews.title: De Luis González R.
reviews.text:
Hola 
 
Aunque me voy a tomar los minutos que sean necesarios para llenar la encuesta, quiero decirles algo antes, que a mi juicio les va a servir de algún interés y está relacionado con algo que pudiera redundar en un mejor servicio en la recreación de los turistas en el hotel.
 
Lo que no vi bien para un Hotel de tan alto nivel en el servicio, fue la recreación nocturna. No se, si fue por el hecho de que sesionó el evento en el Hotel, pero creo que deben buscar más recreación nocturna para lo huéspedes del Hotel.
 
A  mi me parece que ese Hotel, que deja de ser un centro Nacional para tener un carácter Internacional, debe tener en cuenta la multinacionalidad de sus huéspedes para llevarle en esos salones subterráneos una recreación nocturna que una a las personas de nacionalidades diferentes, donde a través de sus culturas, puedan intercambiar con otras personas.
 
Lo que trato decir es que esa área que está en el sótano se pueda configurar y hacer como un cabaret donde el huésped pueda disfrutar en la semana de un día de su cultura y se organice cada día un espectáculo según la nacionalidad de los huéspedes del hotel, lo cual será de atractivo de los nativos de esta cultura y de curiosidad de los que no lo sean, logrando una comunicación, un roce e interrelación entre los huéspedes lo cual le falta a mi juicio al Hotel. 
 
Esta acción crea un punto de retorno en estos huéspedes que pueden ver en este lugar un momento especial para sus vidas que los haga retornar nuevamente al hotel.
 
Por otra parte se le da un uso cultural a esos salones en función de los ingresos del hotel, lo cual pudiera estar incluido en los gastos de los huéspedes, y con los huéspedes de los hoteles cercanos pudiera ser una acción de ingreso adicional, pero igual ayudaría a que las personas intercambien, se relaciones y se conozcan entre si lo cual es lo único que le falta al Hotel, cosa que percibí en esa semana que disfruté.
 
Por otra parte, creo que deben incorporar en el restauran que siempre fui y ahora no recuerdo el nombre, otros platos de comida, como la de mi país, que se conocen a nivel internacional, y que aquí los turistas persiguen de manera atroz, como es el congrí, el arroz Blanco (sin nada, o sea solo con sal y aceite) los frijoles Negros, colorados, la fabada con garbanzo cocinados con jamón, el  tamal en hoja, que lo probé en la fiesta del miércoles, pero no en ese restauran. O sea que hay que husmear mas en la cocina de los países del área y poner a disposición

reviews.author: Magdalena L
reviews.title: No están capacitados para recibir a un grupo
reviews.text: Desinformación, mal manejo. Se vieron sobrepasados en todo momento por el grupo (grupo de personas adultas, de negocios, del sector IT). En todo momento el grupo parecía ser una molestia para el hotel

reviews.author: Carolina S
reviews.title: Maravilhoso!!!
reviews.text: Ficamos hospedados na área reservada, com mordomo e foi uma experiência ímpar, o Hector (nosso mordomo) foi maravilhoso e tudo no hotel simplesmente espetacular, parece um oásis! Saímos apaixonados pelo hotel, pela cidade e pelas praias! Atendimento de todos os funcionários do hotel é algo maravilhoso, simpáticos, cordiais e muito queridos!

reviews.author: Alfredo M
reviews.title: La mejor experiencia en un hotel bajo régimen todo incluido
reviews.text: Instalaciones de primera, servicios de calidad, atención inigualable. Por mucho la mejor experiencia en alojamiento, oferta gastronómica y atenciones. Es el mejor hotel bajo régimen de todo incluido que he visitado. Los servicios del bar y mini bar están excelentes, atención esmerada. Todo es de altísima calidad.

reviews.author: Juan Carlos Soto
reviews.title: Genial!
reviews.text: Un hotel muy completo, donde puedes encontrar variedad en todo, para ir en cualquier plan. El mar picado, no muy recomendado para niños y tienen lugares en la playa en el cual toca pagar un precio exagerado para mi, pero en general, excelente.

reviews.author: Edna S
reviews.title: Excelentes instalaciones y atención
reviews.text: Instalaciones, atenciones y comidas excelentes! Personal muy amable y dispuestas a ayudar y colaborar. Habitaciones amplias y muy cómodas. Restaurante Naos con comida deliciosa y para todos los gustos. Los meseros muy amables y siempre dispuestos a atenderte. La playa es hermosa! Lo recomiendo ampliamente.

reviews.author: Irritant
reviews.title: Nice Beaches, Good Rooms, Ok Food
reviews.text:
I spent a week at a business meeting in this hotel.  The rooms are modern and clean, most with balconies.  The beach is well tended and pleasant, with plenty of chairs.  I saw no problem with people trying to "reserve" spots, and they have a policy against it.  They have a nice pool, and reasonable entertainment.  The staff does go out of its way to make the day pleasant.

The food itself was sort of classic All-Inclusive fare.  In that location, you're better off with the package than not with it.  One caution: if you are a vegetarian, selections are quite limited.  I didn't see any activities team for children, but that doesn't mean there wasn't one.  There is also a "Wet and Wild" park not far away, but I didn't try it.

For those who are in business, the Internet service is a bit slow and not 100% reliable, but it was free.

reviews.author: Fabio G
reviews.title: Classico hotel all' americana !!
reviews.text: Un hotel enorme . La costruzione e' decisamente pacchiana , ma i servizi all interno sono ottimi. Bella la spiaggia e la piscina e veramente ottima la colazione . Le camere sono spaziose , comode , pulite e molto ben attrezzate . Insomma un hotel di una buonissima levatura . Diciamo che noi europei privilegiamo aspetti piu' etnici e meno scenografici.

reviews.author: Adriana M
reviews.title: Paga mucho por poco
reviews.text:
Pésima comida en el buffet no hay variedad
Parece un hotel de pocas estrellas por todo menos por sus instalaciones
No son amables menos 1 o 2 personas
No tiene. Shows por la noche
No es un hotel de playa ni tropical sino muy chillout

reviews.author: Denise O
reviews.title: Nice place on the beach!
reviews.text: I just spend six nights here for a business meeting.  The architecture is stunning; the main lobby is full of lucious plants and trees.  Given that the property is on the beach and salt water can make upkeep a challenge, management does a great job.  We were on a resort plan which included most meals.  The restaurants were nice; the wait staff quite good.  However, there is only one breakfast buffet which was always very full.  The best tables in the Brazilian themed restaurant on out on the balcony.  Two areas of concern - all the floors are glossy tile or stone.  They can be a little fightening if damp / slick.  Also several of my colleagues agreed with me that the in-room A/C units are very loud making it hard to sleep.  Overall, if you want a beach resort experience, you should be happy at the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jose Adalberto F
reviews.title: Unforgetable
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere, excellent facilities, the employees at Royal services including the swimpool services are by far one the best that I have had so far. It is a resort that I would be back in the future with my family and friends.

reviews.author: Jose C
reviews.title: Difficult place for business
reviews.text:
I visited this hotel for a business trip where I was presenting as a guest speaker for a business convention. The experience was dreadful , the first night they would not let me meet with the organizer since I was not staying at the hotel and I was forced to pay $85usd for a night pass in order to meet with him in one of the locations of the convention center. Instead of offering a solution like meeting at the lobby or business center I was pushed to buy the night pass (bracelet ).
Once in the service was slow the cafe (indoors) was awfully hot and my drink was made with cheap liquor ( after 85 entry fee I expected something better ). The day of the conference everything was just a sign that this hotel time had passed. Terrible coffee service ( and old coffee pot bowling all day ) almost no electrical outlets in the convention center and noisy AC on the conference rooms. This might be great for tourists but not for business travelers and conventions

reviews.author: Amy S
reviews.title: Fun in the sun
reviews.text: The location was amazing, beach front and beautiful! Staff were helpful and always available. The food was awesome and dining variety tasty.  Safe, comfortable and good for couples, families and small kids.

reviews.author: Tulius2013
reviews.title: Um bom hotel em Cancun
reviews.text: Um hotel bem grande com uma boa estrutura de lazer com piscinas de frente para o mar e ótimas esteiras na areia. A comida é bem variável e tem um ótimo restaurante asiático interno que precisa de reserva. Alguns frutos do mar fazem parte do cardápio diário, os quartos estão renovados mas não são super novos. O único problema maior é o atendimento que com certeza não é um ponto forte do hotel. Um cheiro forte de óleo nos elevadores, não fica muito distante da parte de compras e da vida noturna, mas precisa pegar taxi.

reviews.author: Daniel Ricardo A
reviews.title: Excelencia en Servicio
reviews.text: Todo el servicio fue excelente. Es un hotel de muy buena categoría, los servicios ofrtecidos y todo lo relacionado con el trato a los huespedes fue excelente. felicitaciones continuen trabajando de esta forma

reviews.author: drFernando64
reviews.title: EXCELENTE ATENCION  Y PRECIO
reviews.text: estuve  el  dias  5 en  un  congreso  medico  en este  hotel de  ensueño  desde  la  habitacion  con  jacuzi  en la  terraza   el  servicio a  cuartos   la  comodidad  y el  confort  son  indescriptibles ademas    cocina  con  sus  distintos  restaurants  son  excelentes  felicidades.

reviews.author: Alexbarrat
reviews.title: Muy recomendable para familias y/o parejas
reviews.text: Un hotel muy bueno para relajarse, ya sea si va uno en pareja o en familia con los niños, tienen servicios con todo lo necesario para pasar unas vacaciones inolvidables. El servicio excelente, aunque le falta un poco de vigilancia en el desempeño de algunos miembros del personal, pero el resto de la atención hace que esos detalles pasen por alto

reviews.author: Dr. Angel Velazquez
reviews.title: Insuperable, el mejor de la zona hotelera de Cancún
reviews.text:
Vuelvo a este hotel gracias a la gran experiencia de mi última estancia en este hotel.
Una estímulo a todos los sentidos: excelente vista al Caribe; exquisitos alimentos; aromatizado invita al relax; escucha el fluir del agua en arroyos internos; gratas texturas en instalaciones. El mejor Spa que estimula un sentido más: el sentido del humor. Volveré.

reviews.author: Marcia M
reviews.title: Um pedacinho do paraiso
reviews.text: como o titulo ja diz nao tem como nao elogiar , no momento em que descemos do aviao fomos recepcionados por guias extremamentes simpaticos , e quando chegamos no hotel quem nos deu toda atencao foi o Gerente de Operacoes  , o SR FRED BOUTOUBA  . O que posso dizer do PARADISUS CANCUN RESORT  e simplesmente maravilhoso em tudo , GASTRONOMIA , ACOMODACOES, RELAX, CONFORTO, MORDOMIA, ATENDIMENTO, BOM GOSTO, E UMA PAISAGEM SEM IGUAL . EU E AS 280 PESSOAS DA BROTO LEGAL ALIMENTOS TIVEMOS UMA SEMANA MARAVILHOSA EM FEVEREIRO DE 2014

reviews.author: daed1524
reviews.title: отель
reviews.text: Прекрасный отель с интересной функционалистической архитектурой, интерьерами - оранжереями, имитирующими тропический лес и просторными номерами. Несколько ресторанов по системе "Все включено". Один платный ресторан с шеф поваром, отмеченным "Мишленом". В номере есть одна евророзетка, если забыли купить переходник, - но включается она мудрено через мастер-выключатель, постичь принцип действия которого я так до конца и не смог :) . Огромный балкон с клумбой и шезлонгом. Отличный пляж, бассейны, близость к центру водных развлечений (через дорогу).  Очень приветливый и предупредительный персонал, но не забывайте давать небольшие чаевые.

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Excellent Service , experience, value , etc.
Paradisus gave me what Zi was looking for , the opportunity to relax and at same time do business in the same city ,. Paradisus is no doubt the place to be all year round

reviews.author: WD27
reviews.title: Great Service, perfect location!
reviews.text:
If you're staying here and not paying for the Royal Service, well,........ You could always stay elsewhere.

Being that I'm madly in love with Hawaii, I was quite hesitant to be in Mexico and at first felt a little like I was cheating on my life's partner. Well,...... let's just say, taking a sample of a different menu can often be fruitful!

Seriously, this place is nutz!! Sooo beautiful! Soooo welcoming, soo inviting, near perfect.

Where to begin?,.... oh yeah... choosing your stay. The perks of the Royal Service outweigh everything else, so I'm glad that's where I was and can't imagine anything else. If you go to the melia website, you'll note that it states: Unparalleled. All-encompassing, Elevated, Preferential and Private specifically for Royal Service tower. This is no joke and I know because I was there.  

You arrive at this all-inclusive and if it's busy like it was when I arrived than sadly, you have to wait in line to check in. (4 stars because of a few little things.... this is one of them... little things do add up) Okay, so you check in, you get a cute little bracelet (signifying which bldg to which you belong), you get your butler and you're in heaven..... paradise.

Paradisus boasts a bunch of fantastic restaurants for any palate. It has a little store downstairs. A spa is great place to truly forget the bill you'll pay at the end of your stay and for some laughs, there's entertainment... At Christmastime, it was a special dedicated to MJ. Obviously, the music we all know and love and good dancers but the Michael they had..... boy oh boy.. waaaay too short to make you forget that your not looking at Michael (<--- even though he was wearing a prosthetic on his face to become MJ's twin). Anyways, it was an awesome production in a small space and definitely helped you to feel like you didn't need to leave the resort for a thing.

Later on, after dinner (secured by reservations), we even went dancing at one of the bars/clubs.... great music, crap dance floor but when you're at an all-inclusive, you take things as they come.

The room was very clean, there's English TV (watched a marathon on Big Bang when it rained one day).... And then there's the pool.

So, the beach in front of the hotel is incredible but if you can't convince your butler to carry you down there and you don't feel like schlepping your bumbum down there, well,..... there's the pool. First of all, order the Guacamole and Tacos. YUM!!!!!! Bring sunscreen or prepare to be baked and burnt and lastly, go get your chairs by the pool nice and early as much like at most hotel pools, seats will be gone and you'll be out of luck. Here's another tidbit, Royal Service folks have their own pool!!! No kiddies allowed! Sorry!!!

Honest to goodness, until I make it to Bali, Bora Bora, Fiji... I'll continue to do Hawaii every year, but without question, there's always room in a year to take a tiny jaunt to Cancun and should you make it so, Paradisus should be your choice. The room is definitely not the high end of luxury but again, that's not why people go to Mexico.

Happy travels!
WD

reviews.author: fulvia s
reviews.title: Non plus ultra
reviews.text: Ci ho soggironato durante un viaggio in Messico, che dire...........forse l'unica nota negativa puo' essere nella struttura vista dall'esterno, che non si integra propriamente con il paesaggio, per il resto un luogo incantevole, a partire dalla hall, che ti ladcia letteralmente a bocca aperta appena entri: sembra di essere in una vera giungla di piante, ed infatti sono vere, cosi' come lo sono le carpe nei laghetti inseriti sul pavimento, solo che le hanno sistemate dentro la hall!Camera bella con eccezionale vista dal terrazzino(svegliarsi la mattina con oceano e palme non ha prezzo)Buonissima cucina, eccellente anche la spa, io ho provato un massaggio fatto da un'operatrice orientalem veramente ben fatto e professionale. Da consigliare per una vacanza da sogno!

reviews.author: Jorge A
reviews.title: Una opción excelente
reviews.text:
Un lugar muy agradable, el ambiente es maravilloso y la atención personal es gratificante.
Lo malo es que la comida parace menú para diabéticos hipertensos, pues sabe un poco mejor que la comida de hospital, pero tras una encuesta parace que están mejorando el sabor de los platillos.

reviews.author: Harry__Hood95
reviews.title: Beautiful beach, average food
reviews.text:
Just got back from a week-long stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  We were booked at the Paradisus Playa del Carmen, but after the hour-long bus ride to Playa, we were told that they had over-booked and would have to send us to Cancun.  We weren't happy, but made the most of it because this is a very nice resort.  Nowhere near as nice as the resort in Playa that we paid for, but still more than adequate for our needs.

To start, we had an ocean view room on the 5th floor, and the view was stunning.  The room itself was nice but not special,  The fridge was stocked with beer and soda, but no liquor for cocktails which was disappointing as most resorts I've stayed at in the past provided whatever you wanted in your room.  Our TV went out one day and it took longer than it should have to get someone up to take a look at it.  And we only had one chair on our balcony, even though we could see plenty of other rooms that had two.  

The food was good...not great but I didn't have any complaints.  We ate at most of the restaurants and nothing stood out for being especially great or poor.  Only real problem was that it was almost impossible to get reservations at a decent hour.  Seriously, book your reservations EARLY if you don't want to be eating dinner at 9:30 or later.      

The pool was nice & big, very good swim-up bar and it allowed you to enjoy the sun almost all day.  Not even close to enough chairs, and no floats or anything to lounge around in the water.  Also, it's not a big deal but the pool was really deep (I think 5+ feet) with no shallow areas besides the kids area.  Not enough chairs is a pretty big negative.

Beach was very well maintained, which is a big plus for me. Again, not even close to enough chairs, but I don't mind laying down a towel in the sand so it didn't bother me.  I did a fair amount of walking up and down the beach, and it seemed the Paradisus's beach was as-well or better-maintained than almost any other resorts on that strip of beach.  

Service was very friendly, although things seemed disorganized.  We waited 2-3 hours to get our room, with very little input as to what to do in the interim.  There wasn't much of a map, or list of restaurants or spa services or pricing for excursions that I saw.  I was interested in either taking a day-trip excursion or getting a massage at some point; however it was near impossible to tell what desks were for what, who worked for the resort or who was a "tour-guide pitchman", or how much things cost.  

I would definitely stay at this resort again for the right price, and would recommend it to a friend as the resort was clean, the staff was friendly and the beach was gorgeous.  It's not a 5-star place, but you're not paying 5-star prices so as long as you have the right expectations you should have a great time.

reviews.author: Brent B
reviews.title: Hit and Miss
reviews.text: This hotel had some good points and also some bad points on our trip.  The facilities are mostly very nice.  They have 3 nice pools, one of which is no kids, if you upgrade to the "Royal Service".  The staff was nice and seemed to be very customer minded.  The rooms seemed a bit dated and in my opinion, need updated.  Every morning when we went to the beach and pool, it seemed there was not enough beach chairs with umbrellas and the chairs around the pool seemed to be in short supply.  We actually did not sit on the beach any because of not having enough chairs and umbrellas.  The spa was so-so.  Not the worst message but a far cry from the best I have had.  The food was ok for an all inclusive.  I did think the breakfast was not very good.  I would go back, but also would have my eyes out for something better.

reviews.author: Aur_lio_M267
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Resort
reviews.text: Hotel simplesmente maravilhoso, magnífico, como o nome diz, é o paraíso. Recepção linda e lobby encantador, funcionários muito simpáticos e que gostam do que fazem, todos os restaurantes são muito bonitos e com uma comida excelente, quarto excelente também, bonito, elegante e muito bem decorado. A localização do hotel é ótima, possui uma infra-estrutura muito boa, muitas piscinas e o esplêndido mar de Cancun logo a frente. O hotel é lindo tanto por fora quanto por dentro, como já tinha falado. Cancun é um destino lindo, vale muito a pena ficar nesse hotel, pois ele é maravilhoso. Fora o perfume que ele possui devido á incensos. Recomendo muito a todos. Com certeza terá uma estada inesquecível.

reviews.author: Thomas T
reviews.title: Nice property on the ocean with friendly service
reviews.text: Recently returned from business meeting at this property.  Nice all-inclusive option with premium liquors and obviously unlimited supply.  Found food in Naos to be more of the same as the four days wore on - plenty of variety but not all that high quality.  Had a room in the 'C' Pyramid (main building) and found that the noise from loud music went fairly late into the night.  If you go to be early, ask for any rooms not located in 'C'.  WiFi coverage throughout the property is spotty at best but if you are there on vacation, this should not matter,

reviews.author: Zachary C
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Excellent place. I had a blast. The service was remarkable. My only complaint is that the place had a little bit of a mold/mildew smell in the main hotel and my room. In my room there were actually a few black mold spores on a picture hanging in the room. This is an easy fix. Overall great place!

reviews.author: Phil1200
reviews.title: Great Place to be
reviews.text:
I had a nice suite 1 bedroom , 1 living room , 1 bath room with view on the lagoon, 1 wc and 2 balconies (1 with jacuzzi)...

Just disappointed that I was there for business and could not really take advantage on it .. :(

But this will be a place I would go back to make holidays for sure...

reviews.author: Ray L
reviews.title: One of the Finest Resorts I've Ever Visited
reviews.text: Extravagant is the appropriate word to describe the Paradisus.  From the sights and sounds (the resort is all about 'the 5 senses'), to the excellent staff and the food (I highly recommend Tempo), you won't be disappointed if you visit the Paradisus on your next stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Anna C
reviews.title: SERVICIO DE PRIMERA
reviews.text: Me hospedé en este hotel y quiero decirles que es una experiencia magnífica, un lugar súper especial, aromas únicos, descanso total, y una atención de primera. Cuando regrese a cancun no dudaré en hospedarme en este estupendo hotel.

reviews.author: Georgann G
reviews.title: Fun in Mexico
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent four nights at the Paradisus this December.  The staff was helpful and our room was clean and comfortable.  We enjoyed dinners at the Market Grill and the tapas restaurant.  

One note: If you want a hut on the beach, make sure you head there early as they fill up early in the day.

The wait staff at the beach were friendly and attentive to our need for cocktails.  Look for Miguel and Enrique on the beach- two great waiters who will take care of you and assure you have a good time!

We would definitely return- next time bringing the kids along!

reviews.author: David C
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: The company I work for took 1300 people to this resort for our Holiday Party in December 2013.  It was the best vacation I have ever been on.  I stayed in Pyramid 5, which is the Royal Service area of the resort.  You were treated like kings and queens.  My favorite part was meeting one of the workers, Francisco.  He was nothing but professional, kind, and took care of our every need.  I enjoyed talking to him about the resort, and they type of business we are both in, Customer Service.  It was truly a pleasure to meet him and be taken care of by him.  The resort itself was spectacular at every angle.  The food in every restaurant was far better than any other resort I have ever been to.  The smell and aroma of the resort made you feel like you were in paradise.  I would recommend this place to anyone, including families.

reviews.author: Michael P
reviews.title: Really Great Resort!
reviews.text: Had an incredible experience at the resort. Staff was amazing as were the rooms. Food was great and accessible. Would recommend this resort to anyone and hope that I can make it back soon in the near future!

reviews.author: Ramon R
reviews.title: Best Company Trip Ever!!
reviews.text: The company I work for (Power Home Remodeling Group) treated the entire staff to a four day paid vacation to Cancun, Mexico and chose the most incredible hotel; Paradisus Resort. We rented the ENTIRE hotel in order to accommodate 1,200 Power peeps!! The hotel staff was very hospitable and friendly. The food was great and the beach was amazing! What more can I say, it was an epic vacation thanks to Power Home Remodeling Group and Paradisus Hotel! We hope to be back soon....

reviews.author: Sarah S
reviews.title: Best Vacation I've had in a long time!
reviews.text: Best resort on the entire strip - Stunning decor with incense burning throughout the hallways making it a very relaxing environment. The rooms were beautiful and our cleaning crew made sure to tidy up the room each and every day. The food was average but there were tons of items to choose from so you can never run out of options. The entire resort staff was extremely accommodating from opening every door to carrying your plate from the buffet to your table for you. Great drinks and entertainment - Will definitely be going back!

reviews.author: Chris M
reviews.title: Amazing experience (PowerHRG Employee)
reviews.text: We had a company party of 1200 people at Paradisus. The staff was extremely nice and polite. the hotel was beautiful. the Pool was a blast. two minutes away (walking) was aqua-world where you can swim with dolphins , drive personal speed boats, snorkel, and jet ski. The water was as blue as the sky. We had the chance to eat at Tempo the food was honestly the best food i have ever had.  This Resort was a A+ experience.

reviews.author: Erica B
reviews.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviews.text: This resort was incredible! The service was amazing and the staff was always so friendly and helpful. The view and scenery was amazing, I would suggest getting an ocean view if possible. I only ate at the Blue Agave and of course the Naos/ buffet restaurant. Food was great, service was incredible. The staff was always around to make sure you were provided with everything you needed. If you are coming for a more peaceful and quiet vacation I would suggest not staying in Pyramid 3, that is where a lot of the bars/lounges are and can get a little noisy at night. I would recommend this hotel to both family and friends!

reviews.author: Crystal H
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text:
This resort is absolutely fabulous! My company was there for our end of the year celebration. With such such a large group, I could only imagine that the Hotel staff must have thought that our stay would have been too much to handle. Quite the contrary! The service was OUTSTANDING! The food was wonderful and the staff was willing to accommodate us in any way. I was lucky enough to have a brief conversation with the hotel manager. She was simply a delight. I would recommend this luxury resort to any friends!
-Crystal

reviews.author: Leo M
reviews.title: Best vacation of my life. Would love to visit again.
reviews.text:
This resort is simply amazing the staff is always courteous and friendly. There are so many different activities to do and the scenery is breath taking. 

I visited a few of the restaurant but I was very impressed with Naos for the simple fact that the staff was incredible. I showed up every morning just to see Enrique Zaval who worked the morning shift. He always went above and beyond to make sure I had a smile on my face and food in my stomach.  These guys made the impossible possible. Providing me with everything I wanted and always was around to check to see if I needed anything else. This was quite a experience for me the way I was treated. We love having breakfast with Enrique.  Definitely recommend stopping by.

reviews.author: Mark E
reviews.title: Best Value in Cancun
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun provided a great working environment in a very relaxing setting.  The food was not as vast as other resorts but the ambiance was amazing and vibrant.  It`s location to La Isla and Kukulcan Mall was very close and walking the beaches were fantastic.

reviews.author: Yuriria V
reviews.title: INCREÍBLE PARAÍSO
reviews.text: Visité el hotel hace muchos años, siendo aún Grand Meliá, sin duda alguna de los más reconocidos en Cancún, ahora que regreso me sentí como en casa, excelente hotel, excelente servicio, los chavos de animación súper atentos y amables, la infraestructura excelente, me gustaron mucho las actividades sobre todo la zumba freddy es muy amable me tuvo mucha paciencia, la comida muy buena.. Sin duda alguna si visitan el paraíso de Cancún vayan a Paradisus

reviews.author: Samuel G
reviews.title: Muito Bom
reviews.text: Resort muito bom, no estilo all inclusive, fizemos um evento muito bom neste hotel, porém o mesmo peca pela alimentação, não tem uma alimentação muito boa. A arquitetura do hotel é muit bonita, e bem decorada com plantas, funcionários muito bons.

reviews.author: Jeremias2013
reviews.title: Excelente servicio y profesionalismo
reviews.text:
Para todas las personas que deseen hacer convenciones en Cancun Zona Hotelera el Hotel Paradisus Cancun es una excelente opción, el servicio de convenciones es excelente muy profesional, puntual cumplido el personal de apoyo muy profesional las instalaciones de hotel la ubicación del hotel, recomiendo mucho este hotel para sus convenciones y para estadía en Cancun.

Jeremias Lasso Diaz 
Colombia

reviews.author: salatiel g
reviews.title: UNA ATENCION EXCEPCIONAL
reviews.text:
Me gustaría mencionar que fui a un congreso fuera del hotel y aun así los doctores que me acompañaron se quedaron sorprendidos desde su llegada hasta enviarnos al servicio ROYAL SERVICE, habitaciones súper amplias, sus vista majestuosa del mar que hace su entrada todas la mañanas, sus desayunos que nos deja disfrutar de una mañana de satisfacción y como no hablar de la comida, en el restaurante de la playa donde el personal te envuelve con sus platillos de la predilección de uno, como el querer probar un pescado aguachile, como los camarones al ajo, como también un seviche de pescado, etc. Y como no terminar una tarde empezando una noche de especialidades en varios restaurantes, tantas opciones tan interesantes, que se hace complicado su elección, como un restaurant de espadas en cortes de carnes, empanadas argentinas, un restaurant mole que te hace disfrutar de una comida mexicana y tequilera, un buffet  internacional de cenas variadas, un restaurnat fuego con mariscos y sopas de elección, junto con una bebida de tradición y así puedo seguir hablando de varias opciones, como también un jacuzzi con su sauna, vapor, alberca de masajes  en un área de meditación, relajación y mucho mas, todo se deduce a una sola cosa, que estancia tan mas placentera y maravillosa.
Principalmente agradezco al Sr. CONRAD BERGWERF por su cálida atención los días de nuestra estancia. MUCHAS GRACIAS Y SALUDOS. Estaremos regresando.

reviews.author: Luis R
reviews.title: Como si estuviera en casa.
reviews.text: El ambiente que se inspira con calidad y calidez humana, invitan a regresar ya sea de placer o negocios haciendo de este hotel la necesidad de acudir nuevamente por las magnificas instalaciones así como una  comida deliciosa.

reviews.author: Mauriciommx
reviews.title: Boa Opção
reviews.text: O hotel pertence a rede espanhola Meliá e esta bem localizado na entrada da Zona Hoteleira. Conta com bons restaurantes que servem comidas bastante variadas e típicas, desde a espanhola até a japonesa. A área da piscina é bem ampla e conta com serviço de bar que também funciona para a praia. Os aptos são amplos e tem sacada.

reviews.author: esanchez147
reviews.title: Excelente Servicio
reviews.text: Felicitar al Hotel por su excelente calidad en servicio al huésped. La atención de todos los colaboradores del hotel para  los huéspedes es de bastante calidad, la barra del bar es estupenda y sobre todo la vista que tiene de interiores y exteriores el hotel es fenomenal.

reviews.author: GregoryD33139
reviews.title: Everything you'll need
reviews.text: Nice, clean, elegant hotel. Food and drinks also amazing. Room are spacious, well equipped. Small detail but well appreciated, the shower products are Thierry Mugler, really nice smell. Overall great stay, great staff

reviews.author: cmxc5
reviews.title: Great choice if you find a good deal
reviews.text:
There are many good things about this place and some things that are not that great. 

The rooms definitely need some upgrade: the AC system is really loud, twin beds are small, bathroom needs deep cleaning, bathtub didn't work, coffee machine didn't work, tv remote didn't work...

Now the good side about this hotel is probably when you you step into the lobby and you see the vegetation and the nice atmosphere created, for first timers it is just WOW... staff is friendly but i got the feeling that they expect to be tipped... but let's be honest when travel ALL INCLUSIVE we expect to have everything taken care of....food for breakfast is pretty ordinary, my favorite restaurant was BANA, the sushi there was really good and you can have as much as you want.
I would recommend anyone to stay in this place only and only if they find a good deal, but if the price is high, then you can try to find something else.

reviews.author: Kenneth W
reviews.title: Most Incredible Experience!!
reviews.text:
WoW, WoW, Wow!! This is one of the most memorable trip my wife and I ever had. We have stayed in 100's of Hotels worldwide but this had to be the best to date!! It did not start out that way.... First night we had to change rooms because i was on crutches and the walk to all the meeting rooms or dining facilities would have been to much. Then we had to change to another room because of minor house keeping issues. Finally we arrived in room 3712. Our rep Natalia for the Royal Service was so helpful and caring, she made us feel like family!! Everyone was so helpful and friendly everywhere in the hotel!! Special thanks to Valeria Gallardo at the Naos restaurant for extra care and service. Guadalupe at the Check out counter and Raul "Paul Newman" our Bell guy, whose service was exemplary!! This was our second trip to Cancun and we do plan to stay at Paradisus the next time we go!! If you want to stay at a place where everyone from check in to check out smiles, says Hi and are incredibly helpful, look no further!! Give our friend Natalia a call and she will give you a Royal welcome!! Thanks Agains Natalia and may God Bless you and your incredible facility!!
Ken and Ratna Wendling  Texas USA!!

reviews.author: jarodri1
reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text:
This was my 9th business trip to Cancun and my first time in paradisus hotel. I have to admit that the personnel and the quality of my stay far surpassed my expectations. Thank you for the wonderful experience.
John Martin

reviews.author: Maria F
reviews.title: Excelente hotel 5 estrellas
reviews.text: Fui por trabajo pero pude aprovechar mucho las instalaciones, el servicio del hotel es muy bueno, los restaurantes muy buenos, tiene una disco dentro del hotel que visitamos todas las noches para tomar unos buenos tragos, las piletas grandes, espaciosas, es una experiencia fabulosa desde que uno ingresa al hotel, es inmenso (me perdi varias veces) Tiene bajada a la playa propia y tambien alli siguen atendiendote muy esmeradamente!! Altamente recomendable.

reviews.author: Vladislav
reviews.title: Отличный отель
reviews.text:
Все на уровне 4+. Обслуживание и сервис 4+. Море в 2х шагах. Официанты медленные, т.к. в Мексике никто ни куда не спешит.
Морепродуктов в меню ресторанов отеля минимум, ожидал большего, чем просто филе 1го вида рыбы...

reviews.author: Keith H
reviews.title: I'd stay here again
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun proved to be a great place to stay for my business/leisure trip.  There is a nice combination of business people, couples, singles and families so no one feels out of place.  The restaurants are all good with nice presentation.  The staff is friendly and willing to help.  All of the water sports that are included are located in the AquaMarina right across the street on the lagoon side. They only have an agreement with hotel and are not hotel staff, hence there are tip boxes everywhere and they have no qualms about asking for tips either.  They require a waiver form where we would be responsible to pay $40/square inch of damage, so be careful.  I still rented windsurfing equipment and a Hobie Cat and did a little sailing.  There are also kayaks for rental.  I am into fly fishing, so I spent a half day with a guide from CancunTarponFishing.com and it was excellent.

reviews.author: SVETLANAGS
reviews.title: Классный отдых
reviews.text: Отличный отель, с отличным сервисом, питанием и всем остальным что нужно для отдыха. Советую всем, не пожалеете. Всегда весело вечером и при этом ни чего не мешает сну. Если хотите расслабиться для этого СПА. Хотите парашют или водный мотоцикл - все есть. Вообще все очень и очень.....

reviews.author: Laurielee2013
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Tropical, aromatic,uniquie and Mayan in its architecture  this resort is lovely.  For all ages. They offer the family concierge along with an adults only area.As you enter the lobby it is beautiful and very tropical - jungle vines and very appealing to the eye.  Open atmosphere and an abundance of food options.  Offering an incredible convention area it is great for those small, medium, and large conventions and Destination weddings.  Beach front property on a lovely white sand beach in the heart of Cancun.  You can walk a great distance on a nice flat beach. Easy access to public transportation .  The Spa holds up to  the reputation of the Paradisus properties and even has a little kids spa.....a dream for every little lady in the family.  Pedicure and manicure station.  Hair and make up station and a choice of candy for the little guest.   Food and service over the top. Fabulous destination resort for wedding or honeymoon for certain.  The rooms are spacious and very nice. Room category will vary throughout the pyramids.  I would recommend the upgrade for Royal Reserve area for adults only and upgrade to the family concierge for those traveling with children.  The Paradisus Cancun is quite incredible and I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Eliane064
reviews.title: muito agradável!
reviews.text: A localização é ótima não fica muito distante do centro,o Hotel é enorme com vários restaurantes para diferentes gostos,comemos até grilo frito em um deles,o restaurante Tempo é imperdível!Os quartos são amplos com vista para o mar ou para a lagoa,piscinas enormes de frente para o mar,cada uma tem seu bar e os atendentes são de enorme cortesia,algo desabonador é a insistência para tentar vender um programa de férias fidelizadas para a rede de hotéis,de resto é muito bom

reviews.author: Libra24
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text:
This a a lovely hotel, with beautiful decor.  The staff are amazing people and just cannot do enough for you.  The are all always friendly, greeting as you walk past - and humble.  

We stayed at the hotel as part of a conference. Although there were over about 1000 people from our group staying there and being transported around - all arrangements ran seamlessly.

One bit of advice, this a HUGE hotel and you can to get lost finding your room (however there is usually a friendly staff member around to help you find it)

reviews.author: IZALIA A
reviews.title: INOLVIDABLE
reviews.text:
No hay realmente palabras que  describan lo hermoso y perfecto que fue este viaje a cancun .Nos hospedamos mi esposo , mi bebe y yo. El trato fue de lo mas amable, he visitado acapulco y ixtapa, pero nada que ver, el servicio y la atencion es de lo mejor, creo sinceramente que otro hotel vuelva a llenar mis expectativas. 
g r a c i a s

reviews.author: Lorenita Z
reviews.title: DE MARAVILLA!!
reviews.text: muy complacidamente les comparto mi experiencia en el paradisus mi estadia fue de 7 dias que sin duda alguna repetiria de nuevo desde el servicio de toooodos y cada uno de los integrantes del hotel fue maravillosa dsbordan calidez y amabilidad sus comidas cualquiera de ellas son exelentes y muuy completas su playa es increible el area de albercas ni hablar que tengan taaan integrada la naturaleza dentro del hotel te llena de paz y tranquilidad por eso reitero estas vacaciones en el paradisus se las recomiendo ampliamente no queria regresar vale la pena invertir ya que uno queda mas que satisfecho insisto la calidez y la amabilidad de todos y cada uno de los integrantes de este hotel es maravillosa estoy sumamente agradecida

reviews.author: Jorgego83
reviews.title: Viaje de juegos deportivos de CONAGUA
