reviews.text: Mi estancia en este hotel fue Excelente, la experiencia tienes que vivirla para saber que el servicio que te brinda es de primer mundo, fui a participar en los juegos nacionales deportivos de CONAGUA representando a mi bello estado Chiapas, la satisfacción que me dio fue el descansar en sus instalaciones después de los partidos, poder disfrutar las albercas, así como deleitarme con su alta cocina nacional e internacional, disfrutar de la vista tan impresionante del precioso mar azul desde mi habitación, recomiendo a todo aquel que viaje por placer, por negocios o en plan familiar y amigos tome en primer opción este Hotel porque no se arrepentirán, hacen que uno no extrañe la casa y disfrute a todo lo que da el paraíso de Cancun gracias por sus atenciones Jorge Gomez, Chiapas

reviews.author: Jorge G
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: 100% RECOMENDADO, para las personas que desean un descanso placentero o disfrutar una luna de miel. Los restaurantes excelentes con mucha variedad de comida el bar interno con un show diario para que lo disfrutar al 100.

reviews.author: CarlosLozano2013
reviews.title: The best service ever!!
reviews.text:
Los edificios en si son imponentes y sobrios en su interior al mismo tiempo. Pero lo que se destaca principalmente es la actitud de servicio de todo el staff...desde los bell boys, la recepción, los conserjes, las camareras, hasta el personal de la playa, zona húmeda y el spa siempre tienen una sonrisa en sus labios y un saludo para vos. 
Adelantamos un congreso académico de dos días y la calidad de los salones y las condiciones técnicas de las ayudas fueron óptimas. Todo resultó como estaba planeado.
El servicio personalizado de la torre de Royal Service es impresionante. Siempre tenés una persona dispuesta a darte una respuesta. Eso si, si querés estar más en el centro de la acción, tiende a hospedarte en la torre central (3).
Aun cuando la vista desde todas las habitaciones es bonita, para mi es muy superior la de las que dan hacia la playa.
Si va con niños hay un servicio especial para su cuidado, de tal manera que los padres puedan disfrutar con plena tranquilidad.
Si su propósito de viaje es turismo, creo que debe evitar el mes de septiembre, pues escasamente sale el sol y no es justo no poder disfrutar de esa magnífica playa.

reviews.author: Sandra A
reviews.title: Experiencia
reviews.text:
Completamente satisfecha con los servicios, las instalaciones, la amabilidad de la gente que trabaja ahí, por mi parte quede muy entusiasmada con los servicios.

Mi visita fue por cuestiones de trabajo, pero agradezco principalmente a sus colaboradores de el restaurante "MOLE", porque me hicieron sentir como en casa, a pesar de estar sola en mi viaje, muy atentos, simpáticos, respetuosos... sonrisa a cualquier momento, agradezco a las personas que me atendieron, Mesero Angel y Hostess Carol, que bien trabajo hacen.

Sin embargo, no todo es excelente, algunos empleados tienden a ser un poco desatentos e incluso a la vista de nosotros a veces groseros, porque como mexicanos, tenemos una cultura de servicio muy especial, sin embargo varios meseros del restaurante NAOS, no atienden con los mismos estándares a mis compatriotas mexicanos.

Les agradecería tomaran en cuenta  este punto.

reviews.author: pelforioc
reviews.title: EXCELENTE
reviews.text: Situado en plena playa de Cancún, ya su estructura impresiona. Una vez dentro, lo mejor el servicio, las habitaciones y todas las instalaciones en general. Recomiendo cualquiera de las habitaciones, con terraza, que dan a la playa. Vistas privilegiadas. Ideal para unas vacaciones paradisiacas.

reviews.author: Alessandro M
reviews.title: Bom resort
reviews.text: Hotel amplo, bem decorado, os funcionários sempre simpáticos, o quarto é confortável. O sinal wifi(grátis) era fraco no meu quarto, reclamei e colocaram um roteador no mesmo, resolvido! Poucas opções de restaurantes, mas com boa qualidade.

reviews.author: BarbaraMarshall
reviews.title: Vale a pena
reviews.text:
Estive neste hotel participando de um Workshop, não sei se em virtude disso tivemos um atendimento diferenciado!

O nosso grupo era de aproximadamente 500 pessoas, portanto o nosso check in foi separado dos demais hospedes.

O hotel é muito grande portanto solicite quartos próximos ao lobby.

Se você esquece algo no quarto é realmente desanimador ter voltar, o meu quarto era bem 
longe de tudo.

Fiquei em um quarto que a vista era para o lago ou seja, de frente para rua e de costas para o mar.

A internet no nosso caso foi free

Em relação a comida é tudo muito farto porém não há muitas variações de pratos durantes os dias é quase sempre a mesma coisa.

O room service funciona 24 horas por dia e o serviço sempre que solicitei foi rápido e os funcionários super educados.

A pizza vale a pena nas madrugadas depois de um Coco Bongo por exemplo.

O atendimento dos funcionários realmente é encantador.

Passei mal um dia e a camareira entrou no quarto para arrumar como viu que eu ainda estava deitada.
Perguntou: A senhora estava bem?
Respondi que não 
Logo ela perguntou o que a senhora tem diarreia?
Respondi que sim
A mesma disse que na loja do hotel vendia o remédio que eu precisava.
O garçon que me atendia neste dia olhou e perguntou se eu estava mal e logo trouxe coca cola com suco de limão falou que era o que ela dava para os filhos quando estavam com o meu problema.

Fica a dica: Tomem cuidado com a água sempre bebam água mineal e cuidado com o que comem.
Achei que era exagero o que acontece no filme Sex in the city em relação a diarrea, porém acho que deve ser considerado pois 6 pessoas do meu grupo passaram mal no mesmo dia que eu.

Depois de medicada e o problema resolvido pedi uma canja maravilhosa no quarto que não demorou mais do que 20 minutos.

No meu último dia começou a vazar água do ar condicionado dentro do quarto, nem me preocupei por que já estava indo embora mesmo.

Acho que faltam opções de diversão a noite.

No geral o hotel é ótimo.

reviews.author: sandradk2013
reviews.title: O PARAISO É AQUI
reviews.text:
Hotel imenso. em forma de pirâmide.
Aproveite os restaurantes temáticos do hotel.
Lojinha de souvenires com preço honesto e atendimento gentil.
Equipe do hotel extremamente eficiente e simpática.
Da janela do meu quarto, a cor do mar mais linda que já vi em toda minha vida!!!

reviews.author: AndyTetila
reviews.title: Hotel excelente e bonito.
reviews.text: O local é lindo, a vista para o mar do caribe ou para a lagoa são lindas. O Hotel possui uma ótima estrutura. Bons restaurantes, bons quartos. Somente o atendimento nas piscinas e praia: achei um pouco demorado. Mas atendentes cordiais. Recomendo.

reviews.author: melissa g
reviews.title: buen hotel
reviews.text: el hotel es muy bonito en general muy limpio el personal muy antento en todo momento, en los restaurantes la comida muy rica pero nada variada pero en general las atenciones muy buenas me toco ver a una tortuga desovar y el cuidado y las atenciones que dan a esos eventos de la naturaleza es excelente estan muy al pendiente de esos detalles en general muy buen servicio no ahy duda.

reviews.author: IdealistRealist
reviews.title: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
reviews.text:
This is my seventh time in Cancun and I have always selected this hotel (previously the Gran Melia) due to their attention to detail.  I have used their Royal Service each and every time (worth it).

Melia Hotels International still owns this hotel which recently changed names from the previous Gran Melia to the Paradisus.  The big difference is that now they are all-inclusive.

Unfortunately, I did not have the usual excellent experience during my stay from July 14th to July 19th.  Let me explain:

THE GOOD
The new butler service at the Royal Service Tower was quite good.  My assigned butler, Hector, was attentive and professional.  The best change was the all inclusive package.  The food from Vento, Fuego and Mole were delicious!  This was not always the case when it was the Gran Melia.  As usual, the Royal Service desk personnel were courteous and highly professional.

THE BAD
As I mentioned before, I have been a guest at this hotel several times, always choosing the Royal Service Tower.  I previously requested via email (never received a reply) and made a follow up phone call to Reservations get a room either in the 4th or 5th floor.  During the phone call, I was assured by the reservations representative, Victor,  that all was OK.  Upon arrival, I found out I was assigned to the basement level.  Personnel was unable to accommodate me and did not offer a complimentary upgrade.   Mind you, I am a loyal client and paid top money for the Royal Service.  Oh well, the room was OK but, did not have the views that I was accustomed to.

THE UGLY
In the past (when it was the Gran Melia), it was customary for Royal Service clients to request late check out (up to 4:00 p.m.).  This time I was told that I had to pay (an additional $90) to do so.  Interesting, in various traveling websites, the Paradisus offers late check out up to 4:00 p.m. as part of the Royal Service package.  I was still charged the additional $90.00.  I later contacted via email the hotel's General Manager Conrad [--](conrad[--]@melia.com) and the Royal Service Manager Lazaro [--] (lazaro[--]@melia.com) on July 21st requesting they look into this matter.  As of today (8/3/13) neither has responded. I intend to contact Corporate offices in Spain.

In sum, I am very disappointed with the new Management of this Hotel.  The previous General Manager, Rolf [--], would respond to my emails in a timely manner. This hotel has been a home away from home and I was hoping to come back soon.  I am not sure anymore.

reviews.author: MrLomas
reviews.title: Not a bad spot on the strip... Nice interior courtyards.
reviews.text: The six story high ceiling to floor hanging green vines in the courtyard of each compound are what help save this resort from Cancun-strip mediocrity. They make for a somewhat surreal and exciting atmosphere. The staff are wonderfully accommodating, with the only let down (for me) being a slightly dated room and non functioning spa. Still, location is perfect and the greenery that adorns each compound makes for a superb in-resort experience. Not half bad if Cancun is your thing... it isn't mine though.

reviews.author: Maria Fernanda A
reviews.title: Muy bueno
reviews.text: Me encanto este hotel, el lobby es impresionante, la comida muy buena, la playa hermosa y la piscina enorme. Mi habitación era un poco chica pero comoda. Me hospede en 2011 por una conferencia. Es muy recomendable.

reviews.author: Paulo Cavalcanti
reviews.title: Muito Bom
reviews.text: O hotel  tem acomodações muito boas, e é no sistema tudo incluso onde todas as comidas e bebidas estão dentro. Tem um bar dentro da piscina muito agradável e colocaram tipo uma barraca ao lado da piscina onde servem opções para almoço. Sempre com hambúrgueres e cachorro quente no estilo americano, mas também tinha uma panela enorme de Paella que salvava qualquer brasileiro. O hotel é enorme e não falta comida nenhuma hora do dia. Gostei muito e recomendo.

reviews.author: FERNANDOC65
reviews.title: EXCELENTE OPCION
reviews.text:
Me hospde parte por trabajo y parte por descanso.
La atencion es exelente, el peronal muy mable y servicial.
La comida variada y muy buena.
el servicio en el restaurante a la hora del desayuno, espectacular.
las playas son preciosas.
Totalmante recomedado.

reviews.author: Sa11yMc
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. The main entrance area is gorgeous with green vines hanging from the top floor to the bottom floor. The pool area is great - pool bar - and right on the beach. The room on the other hand, was a bit disappointing. The air-conditioner which was under the front door leaked. I didn't realise it was leaking and slipped on the water which was on the floor. The same thing happened in a colleagues room too. For a 5* resort I really did not expect this. I went to order room service and was advised it would take over 1hour!!

reviews.author: toddmac29
reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: great place right on the beach! room was huge and staff very friendly and helpful. Only downside was the food. pretty average. beautiful lobby area. great for couples and familys as close to the beach and shopping as well

reviews.author: Sez0sborne
reviews.title: Fairly good
reviews.text:
The hotel itself is huge I didn't even get to see it all as I was only there 2 days.
Large rooms, but there was a group of us an we all had items in our rooms that didn't work, eg hair dryers, phones.

Staff were friendly and great location.
This is not a quiet hotel, there is music going and water fountains but fantastic if your in Cancun for a party.

reviews.author: Dawn T
reviews.title: Amazing Resort!!!!!
reviews.text:
I just attended a conference in Cancun and stayed at the Paradisus Cancun, what an amazing resort. The staff was so helpful and directed us to every area we had a question going to.  Food was very good and wait staff polite and very quick with service even on the beach.  

Speaking if the Beach and Pool areas both are kept very clean and despite the number of us at the hotel we had no problem getting chairs.

I loved the decor of the hotel, with the ivy vines and koi pond, even inside you felt like you were in a tropical paradise.  The rooms are goregous and kept very clean and airconditioning rocks!

If you need to question where to stay in Cancun I would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun. 

I have to give a big thank you to all the staff as you made our conference even more spectacular. 

Dawn

reviews.author: Just_Traveler
reviews.title: Great Hotel to Enjoy and Relax
reviews.text:
Paradisus hotel is a great option to enjoy Cancun.  Overall hotel is comfy, really nice and has a lot of amenities you can make the most of.  The place ambience is great ( lots of plants and water ).
The rooms are great, spacious comfortable, and enjoyable.  Several pools to choose from and a wide wide variety of restaurants and bars.
Staff is friendly and runs a good service through all the hotel. 
Spa is amazing, super zen, delightful and well placed.  The hydro therapy pool is a relax by itself but massage is totally worth it. 
It's was a convention we went on, but had enough time to enjoy the premises. 

Overall a great place to enjoy the sun and have a great time (even on a work trip).

reviews.author: wanda a
reviews.title: UNO DE LOS MEJORES HOTELES QUE HE VISITADO
reviews.text: Desde que llegue al aeropuerto olimpurs tours me ricebio una calidad sonrisa y excelente servcio hasta que llegue al hotel. a  la llegada al hotel fue extraordario el recibiento fue excelente el hotel es precioso las habitaciones. el buffet  frente al mar  estraordinaria.los restarunte a la carta preciosos, la vista de noche del hotel es bello, la discoteca me facino.espero volver pronto

reviews.author: JOSE IGNACIO C
reviews.title: un todo incluido de clase
reviews.text: un hotel, que tiene todo lo necesario para pasarte unas vacaciones inolvidables con la familia, excelentes instalaciones, trato amable, buenos y gran variedad de restaurantes.la playa es linda, claro es cancun, una belleza unica, únicamente que este fin de semana nos toco lluvia en el inicio de la tormenta tropical barbara, pero el hotel suple tu diversión con otras opciones.

reviews.author: Alejandro M
reviews.title: Excelente opcion para viaje de negocios o placer
reviews.text: El hotel tiene magnificas instalaciones. La atencion por parte del personal es la mejor, ellos siempre estan al pendiente de las necesidades del huesped. Tuve una grata muy experiencia en esta, mi tercera visita a este hotel y pienso regresar en cuanto haya oportunidad.

reviews.author: Patty B
reviews.title: Paradise found!
reviews.text:
I was on a business/leisure trip and was just so very pleased with the Paradisus Cancun. It exceeded my expectations in every way!  Just a short and easy drive from Cancun Intl Airport, the hotel is Beautiful, on a most amazing stretch of white sand beach and the dining and meal/drinks service was impeccable.
I would like to personally commend Ms. Ivana at Restaurant Naos for her superb and friendly service.  She truly went to great lengths to see that everything was seamless. 
 I would also like to acknowledge Mr. Israel Ortiz, Regional Sales Manager, for his Excellence in representing his property and chain and making us feel like family!
I already have my next trip to the Paradisus Cancun planned! Hasta Pronto!

reviews.author: Felipe
reviews.title: Good All Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: Formerly Gran Melia Cancun, this hotel is not on the top of the top of cancun, but it's right below that level. Went there for a conference/tradeshow. Group Check-in was a bit messy, but by the time I got to my room the bell staff had my bag in there already. Room was really nice, but not outstanding. Had a very nice view, a big balcony and a decent bathroom. Didn't like the shower that much, but the rest was nice. The pool was very nice, as was the service at the bar over there. Burgers for lunch were very good. The other restaurants were good for an all inclusive, but again, nothing outstanding. Breakfast buffet was very nice though. Fitness Center was very well equipped and always empty. Conferece facilities were great.

reviews.author: Gabrielo69
reviews.title: Una muy buena opción en Cancún...
reviews.text: Diferente a lo que la marca Paradissus nos tiene acostumbrados pero no por ser diferente es de menor calidad. Lo recomiendo totalmente por ubicación, por la playa que tiene, el área Royal tiene muchos plus que hacen que valga la pena pagar la diferencia de tarifa de standard a Royal. La atención y calidez del personal es súper, te hacen sentir consentido y siempre te saludan con una sonrisa. La comida es excelente y el buffet muy variado. Si llevan niños tiene un servicio llamado Family Concierge que vale mucho la pena por todas las amenidades que incluyen para los niños (batas de baño, pantuflas, juguetes para la playa, etc)... si volvería a este hotel sin pensarlo dos veces.

reviews.author: MikelMex
reviews.title: Excelente para Eventos!
reviews.text: Asistí a un evento la semana pasada y el lugar es magnifico para la organización (Un area especial para los eventos con todas las instalaciones y equipo) y tambien para pasar el tiempo libre en las areas comunes del hotel, la piscina y sus entretenidos bares. La ambientación del hotel va de lo clasico (naturaleza y madera) hasta lo más Chic al estilo las Vegas con la decoración de sus bares y restaurantes. Sin duda, en la noche hay muchas opciones para comer (6 restaurantes) pero en la tarde solamente encuentras el Grill y el Buffet. Si realmente pasaras tu tiempo por la tarde en la piscina y en la playa... no importatá no encontrar platillos "a la carta" por las tardes. Les sugiero que compren este hotel a través de una agencia de viajes y pregunten por el Royal Service, ya que tienen muchas ventajas y amenidades adicionales que no estan incluidas en todo el hotel.

reviews.author: AtlanticTravelGroup
reviews.title: Excellent Service Royal Service Samuel Is Great and German Agular
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the restaurants service and food is great. We stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel. This area has its own check in , bar area, beach area, and you are assigned a butler to your room. Our butler was Samuel , he spoke great English , was super friendly and willing to go above and beyond to provide great service. he had my laundry done in 2 hours, met me at the pool cabana and went off to buy me sun glasses. I recommend requesting Samuel as your butler. On a separate note I have to give thanks to German Agular who was the bartender in the main lobby from 3 p.m. to midnight. He makes great drinks, great conversations and he very professional .He also gave a great ideas for sites and tours. Both of these people my our stay enhanced. Be sure to visti both of them and please stay at the resort , you will not regret it. Take from me , I work in the travel industry !

reviews.author: don l
reviews.title: great building, beach and setting, service was spotty
reviews.text:
The building and facilities are first rate and the hotel has plenty of staff. The ocean views are very good. the pool is excellent. the atrium is impressive and well maintained. The beach is pleasant and if the wind is not up you can swim in the ocean. 

service-- most staff were friendly and smiled ,but you could tell that they were not all well trained. For example, I had to ask several times for a drink in the restaurant. A specific waiter, Victor, just ignored me and his supervisor in a black shirt and earpiece (v impressive--secret service?) just forgot.  I finally stopped a waiter and just took a drink off his tray. The minibar guy just barged into my room even though i told him to come back later. the front desk staff were slow. so they have some work to do.

reviews.author: AlbertOlivar
reviews.title: buen all inclusive
reviews.text:
Aquí algunos puntos sobre Paradisus Cancun: 
Puntos a favor: 
Buenas instalaciones cuidadas y se ve lindo el lugar
El lugar muy adecuado para un descanso agradable
La playa linda (obvio es Cancun)
La comida en prácticamente todos los restaurantes es buena
Ubicación esta Ok puedes llegar rápido a los malls pero esta relativamente lejos del centro
Puntos a mejorar:
El aire acondicionado hace un ruido en grande 
Algunos muebles se nota que el tiempo ya paso
Después de las 9 de la noche en el mostrador el personal no te puede resolver una petición especial por que no esta algún manager.

reviews.author: tonymanfre
reviews.title: Excelente Estadia
reviews.text:
Desde la llegada te hacen sentir en casa gente muy amable y siempre dispuesta a colaborar ante cualquier solicitud, muy buenas instalaciones y una gama muy variada de opciones para comer una de ellas no puedo dejar de recomendar el restaurante Mole excelente comida y servicio no se olviden de hacer la reservación.
En el área de la piscina gente muy atenta y servicial para con cada huésped que esta en el área ofreciendo siempre bebidas y sugerencias para pasarla bien
Los felicito gente autentica muy amables y serviciales que se esmeran para que el cliente se vaya complacido de haber estado bien atendido y seguro de su pronto retorno al hotel

reviews.author: Darryl F
reviews.title: Wonderful hotel, exceptional service
reviews.text: Company award event at the hotel was stellar. Great room with a majestic view of the beach and ocean, perfect weather for snorkeling and scuba diving, and the welcoming people of Cancun made the trip worthwhile. The food in all of the restaurants at the hotel, along with the buffet, was fresh and varied each day, and the service welcoming and personal. Our waiter in the buffet, Carlos Lopez Garcia Naos, gave us his full attention, always making sure we had our drinks refilled and plates cleared in a timely manner. When we had our last meal the day we left, it was like leaving behind a new friend. Although this trip was on the company dime, it definitely would be a destination for us in the future.

reviews.author: Mauricio H
reviews.title: Una opción cien por ciento recomendable.
reviews.text: Definitivamente cada que regrese a Cancún, Paradisus Cancún Resort, es el lugar que elijo para mi entancia. Todo perfectamente bien pensado para pasar una estancia excelente. Desde que llegas el servicio y las atenciones son confortables, como por ejemplo las atenciones en recepción por el sub gerente Alberto Chan, una persona sumanete capacitada. Cada uno de los espacios estan perfectamente bien pensados para representar un exquisito escenario y tributo a la belleza, además de brindarte todas las comodidades, tanto el lobby, como salas, restaurantes o hasta los pasillos. Los acuarios son un atractivo impresionante, las albercas y sus diversas alternativas para tu estancia, hasta llegar a las habitaciones, estas últimas, impecables y cuidando cada detalle posible, como en el caso de la habitación 5412, un super lugar.

reviews.author: Adriana S
reviews.title: Excelente cede.
reviews.text: Excelente cede, mis compañeros y yo quedamos muy complacidos  con la seleccion de este  Hotel para nuestro congreso. Las plantas,  salones y  alberca hermosas.Muy  buena atencion, 100% recomendable.Saludos y agradecimientos  a José Vargas porque  siempre estuvo para apoyar en todo momento. Felicitaciones por el brindis de bienvenida y la maravillosa cena de clausura Esperamos regresar, aunque no sea de Congreso ;).

reviews.author: CL5309
reviews.title: Mixed review
reviews.text: Common areas including beach, bars, restaurants and conference facilities were nice. Bartenders, restaurant and concierge staff were friendly and efficient. Checkin staff in Royal Service office seemed poorly trained (eg lots of confusion regarding my credit card at checkout).  My room was large, but had strong musty odor which took getting used to. Also ants were in room. I was glad I was here by myself for business because I would not have wanted to have my family put up with room. Bed was very saggy. Food was ok. 3 or maybe 3.5 star property at best. If you like the whole all-inclusive scene this may not be a bad choice, but if quality vs quantity is your priority and willing to spend more I would probably check out the JW next door.

reviews.author: 197milenam
reviews.title: A Wonderful Stay
reviews.text:
We were on paradisus cancún  2 weeks ago  and was and amazing experience  juan on the front desk was amazing because he always   was taking care to  us  he is a polite person and always has the initiative .  We wish to return again  ,the food have an awesome flavour each restaurant is unique  we love paradisus

Miss Milena Marowski

reviews.author: Erich G
reviews.title: Excelente  personal
reviews.text: Me encanto el diseño del hotel, las instalaciones muy bonitas además del personal único que colabora en este hotel hicieron mis vacaciones inolvidables, la comida es exquisita y el spa maravilloso, me hubiera gustado poder estar mas tiempo, pero regresare en mis próximas vacaciones además estoy seguro que estaré mucho mas lindo ya que la gente trabaja para formar un verdadero paraíso.

reviews.author: Mario A
reviews.title: Evaluación
reviews.text:
Hotel muy lindo, muy buena atención.
Por ser antiguo algunos problemas por falta de mantenimiento como poca de presión de agua y agua estancada en la tina pero al reclamar lo solucionaron de inmediato.
Mala señal y velocidad del internet aunque escuche que si llamas te ponen un router que mejora la señal.
En líneas generales servicio de primera y uno de los más bonitos.
Muy recomendable!

reviews.author: NadiaWood
reviews.title: 2010 Global Incentive Trip
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Gran Melia Paradisus Cancun for a total of 4 nights in October 2010 whilst travelling with 200 delegates from Europe. We were attending a Global Incentive Trip in Riviera Maya for 3 days, however due to varying flight times to and from Europe we needed an alternative place to stay near to the airport for our travellers. 

We stayed on a bed and breakfast basis and I was upgraded to one of the suites which had a stunning view of the ocean. The hotel reception team were helpful and efficient at checking the group in, however concierge took some time delivering our bags (probably due to the volume of luggage!) 

The suite had a beautiful lounge area and king sized bed opening up to a balcony overlooking the pool area & with a sea view. The breakfast and hotel restaurants served a good selection of food, and there were a number of nearby restaurants too. There are some lovely little tourist shops within the hotel, perfect for purchasing gifts to take home! 

Overall we had a fabulous stay and would definitely recommend this hotel to both business and personal travellers. The passing hurricane didn't even ruin our time there!

reviews.author: Irodrigu
reviews.title: Genial
reviews.text: Muy bueno en todos los aspectos, la habitación muy amplia y cómoda, la atención excelente. Las instalaciones del hotel en general muy bonitas, estuvimos en una convención y los salones también estaban cómodos, la playa inmejorable. También tuve oportunidad de ir al spa, recomendadísimo! Tal vez lo único que se podría mejorar un poco es la comida, pero hay suficientes opciones para no aburrirse.

reviews.author: dcindc2003
reviews.title: Standard all-inclusive resort
reviews.text: I stayed here with work colleagues this past weekend and overall the service was good and the food was decent.   Nothing special here but it is a quick trip to the airport and perfectly serviceable.   It is close to the downtown area, but road at night is very busy so expect the trip to take 45 minutes.

reviews.author: legendair1
reviews.title: Quiet retreat excellent accommodations
reviews.text: Quiet retreat, the accommodations are very modern did not have time to access the 'a la carte' restaurant but the buffet was only average. All the premise were very clean and staff were polite. Plenty of pools and beach surface

reviews.author: secondfloor
reviews.title: Luxe, but not Mega Posh
reviews.text:
This new all-inclusive resort has a lot to offer. There are amazing beaches, three gorgeous pools, tennis courts, organized sporting activities (soccer, volleyball, aqua-aerobics, etc), a well-equipped gym and a spa that has high-caliber treatments, a sauna, a steam room and a really cool aquatherapy element that is offered gratis to Royal Service (the highest caliber) package members, daily! Phew. And then there are the food options, of which, I think there are eight. Basically, you will find almost any kind of cuisine without leaving the premises. But make reservations early, upon arrival or you'll be eating at 11pm. And if you don't see it, ask -- they can generally rustle it up (ask for real shredded cheese on the nachos instead of cheese sauce, if there's no salmon at the breakfast buffet on the weekends, ask for it and you will receive it). 
My issue is with the Royal Service, adults-only highest caliber service offered at the resort. I don't know if everyone experiences what I did, but mine was not the stellar service experience I associate with staying at a place with butler service (like a St Regis resort). First, when I moved rooms b/c I was concerned with the safety of my first room on the ground floor, it took them over an hour to bring my suitcase. My butler offered two specific services, I agreed to take them, and then he never followed through with either. My colleagues all received things like daily newspapers, petit fours in the room, requested items in their mini-bars and I got none of this, though I asked daily. We each asked for specific toiletry items and it took at least three requests before we got them. On my last full day there, a Saturday, I left my room at 930am and when I returned at 5p, my room had not been touched -- there were still dirty dishes there from the night before. And after offering luggage pick-up, no one came for my bags. It seemed like there were a lot of cracks in the exclusive service. If I were to go again, I would perhaps pay for a lower level of service, adjust my expectations and probably be a lot happier.

reviews.author: AlvaroGutierrez
reviews.title: Excelente hotal
reviews.text: Estuve la semana anterior en cancun disfrutando del paradisius cancun.  la comida es excelente, la atención inmejorable, el estado y limpieza de las habitaciones es muy bueno.   El cuidado de la piscina y la playa tambien es muy bueno.   Lo recomendo para ir en pareja y en familia.

reviews.author: Lili I
reviews.title: !Increible...Sin Comparación!
reviews.text: Vine con mi grupo de trabajo, somos aproximadamente 140 personas , es la primera vez que me hospedo en Paradisus Cancun... Simplemente tengo palabras de agradecimiento, porque han hecho que hasta el momento sea la mejor estancia ... el personal siempre esta al pendiente, los meseros cuidando que todo este en orden, quiero hacer una mencion especial al sr. eleazar el mejooor, con una sonrisa en el rostro y pendiente de cada uno de los detalles... deberian promoverlo, las habitaciones muy amplias y confortables me hacen sentir en mi hogar.... El lobby es impresionante, la vegetación y tan bien cuidado, los peces hermosoos. que  bello es el maar de Cancun!!! y no puedo terminar sin mencionar, una vez que llega la noche el hotel se transforma, si se transforma, se siente un ambiente tan romántico, con velas como ambientación... increible....Aun no me he ido y ya quiero regresar de vacaciones con mi familia y disfrutarlo plenamente... SIMPLEMENTE SE LOS RECOMIENDOOO!!!!!!

reviews.author: braziltraveler11
reviews.title: Excelente opção
reviews.text:
Hotel luxuoso, com acabamento de primeira, tudo do melhor, funcionários prestativos, tudo limpo e funcionando. Limpeza e arrumação do quarto duas vezes por dia. Café da manhã luxuoso com diversas opções. Ótima localização, próximo ao aquaworld e ao mc donalds. 
Fui em fevereiro e tinha um vento maral forte que prejudicava atividades aquáticas, mesmo assim fizemos passeio de barco e snorkel. Mas as correntes eram fortes e com muitas ondas. Disseram que de maio a julho venta pouco ou nada e o mar é bem calmo.

reviews.author: Eric_Bassetti
reviews.title: Hotel "almost" all inclusive
reviews.text: Hotel grande, com centenas de quartos, que mudou recentemente de nome (Meliã) mas que mantem a estrutura antiga. Hotéis de praia se desgastam facilmente. Muitas opções de restaurantes, mas devido ao volume de refeições, não espere muita qualidade. Boa área de lazer, ótimas piscinas (nem todas disponíveis a todos os hospedes; prepare para saber que nem tudo é "all inclusive", pois há hóspedes e Hóspedes...Muito boa localização. Staff gentil e atencioso.

reviews.author: stacey O
reviews.title: Can't wait to go BACK!
reviews.text: I LOVED this place!  Friendly staff, nice selection of dining options, great drinks, plenty of amenities.  I got a great deal the night before and was taken care of upon arrival.  They offer a tour of the property in hopes that you will buy and in exchange you get a 20 dollar massage.  Ask for Lucy!  At the buffet ask for Francisco and Antonio, they are the BEST!  They made a flamin’ coffee that was TO die FOR!  The lifeguards kept us all safe and the wait staff kept us happy with top shelf liquor which was nice considering I had the all-inclusive package.  The nightly shows in the main lounge were fascinating, I was happy to be there FAT Tuesday, that show was amazing!   Loved it, sad to be back in the cold... Clean beach, beautiful sand.... No real hot tub outside, I heard it was part of the pool.  The hot tub in the spa was killer....

reviews.author: Steve C
reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here.  The property is exquistely appointed and the staff is very friendly and attentive.  I especially enjoyed Victor, Webster and Yareli,  they were awesome servers in the Grill.

reviews.author: RAUL R
reviews.title: Bonito hotel lleno de detalles...algunos no del todo agradables.
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene buen aspecto aunque en el momento que nos hospedamos muchas áreas estaban en remodelación, tal vez eso explica los "detalles".
Lo bueno:
La comida en general fue buena y de buen sabor.
La ambientación es muy buena y seguro cuando lo acaben de remodelar estará mejor.
A pesar de ser un grupo grande se nos atendió de forma ágil.
El área de alberca y playa están bien cuidados.
La habitación es amplia y cómoda.
Lo malo:
El primer día que entré en el baño de la habitación había una cucaracha muerta en la bañera, llame y limpiaron, pero al otro día lo mismo.
En el balcón de la habitación dejaron los de mantenimiento todo su equipo tirado y no lo retiraron hasta el día siguiente.
Había unas cajas de café (o al menos recuerdo que de eso eran) con costo extra en caso de utilizarlas, pero estaban todas dañadas (a mi parecer parecían mordidas de ratón, pero les dejo el beneficio de la duda), pedí que mejor las retiraran de la habitación.
Es un hotel todo incluido pero hay que tener cuidado CON LO QUE TE SIRVEN DE TOMAR, en especial si se tiene cierto gusto por las bebidas de calidad ya que si pides un vodka, ron, ginebra, etc. y no se tiene el cuidado de fijarse al momento de que están preparando tu bebida, utilizan de las marcas más baratas y de menor calidad.
Conclusión
Me parece que el hotel acaba de cambiar de dueños pero de cualquier forma deben de estar atentos a los detalles ya que esto no es escusa, me gustaría llegar nuevamente y comprobar si los detalles presentados se debieron a esta "inestabilidad".

reviews.author: Yezi
reviews.title: Muy buen hotel, completo y de muy buen servicio
reviews.text: Muy buen hotel, es lindo, completo, las habitaciones muy buenas, con opciones de restaurantes, excelente y bella playa. Es un hotel apropiado para pasar vacaciones en familia o pareja. Es muy completo. Tiene muy buen servicio y buena comida, tiene discoteca. Y la playa es espectacular. Recomendado

reviews.author: cpavilag
reviews.title: DO NOT waste your money on this hotel
reviews.text: This hotel was a nightmare from the very begining, took almost 30 min to check in 2 rooms with nobody else but us at the reception. The quality of the food was very poor, not to mention uncooked rise and very limited options for dinner.  Nobody told us where our rooms where located at a different tower therefore it was impossible to locate our rooms. Now after a whole week since we stayed there I haven´t received my bill, I have been calling eveyday for this situation but yet I have not had any answer. Trust me this is a very bad option for accomodation in cancun, the price if extreamly high for what you are getting, I will strongly recommend other hotels.

reviews.author: Steve T
reviews.title: Saved My Life!
reviews.text: While swimming in the ocean on a beautiful day last December I got caught in a riptide and floundered off shore, exhausted.  If not for the assistance of Angel, the Lifeguard at the hotel, I think that I would have drowned.  He is typical of the exemplary employees there.  Thank you,again.

reviews.author: Alejandro019
reviews.title: Un Lugar espectacular
reviews.text: Hace unos dias estuve en Cancun por negocios y me hospede en este excelente Hotel Paradisus y definitivamente de lujo y un servicio de excelencia. para empezar no hay niños y sus instalaciones son fenomenales y la comida de lujo y ni que se diga de las suites espaciosas y preciosas y esta cerca de Cancun y la ribiera maya ..se los recomiendo amigos.....!!!

reviews.author: CL0111
reviews.title: Nice beach side hotel
reviews.text:
Stayed here back in November 2012 when it was the Gran Melia Cancun.  Was here for a conference so I didn't get to enjoy all the amenities.  
Ride from airport to hotel took about 20 minutes.
Check in was reasonably quick, make sure they give you the bracelet thing so you can enjoy the all inclusive stuff.  When eating at the fancier restaurants in the basement, make sure to ask if it's included or if you have to pay extra.
Room was facing the road, but I could see the beach and ocean from the balcony.  The rooms on the other side of the hall were facing the beach and ocean as well, just closer.
Went to the buffet in the basement and it had a decent variety of food.  There's a carving station with a soft taco made to order station in the back corner.
The air conditioning in the room was great, but in the public areas like the lobby and hallways, it was humid.  Be sure to go outside (to the back) and enjoy the beach - I only got to walk it since there was no free time with the conference though.
